revisionDesc.change: Compiled into a single file, transliterated to IAST, and converted to basic TEI encoding by the ERC-funded Intellexus project.

text.body: <1> mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracitaṃ samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmadheyaṃ vāstuśāstram mahāsamāgamano nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ| devaḥ sa pātu bhuvanatrayasūtradhārastvāṃ bālacandra kalikāṅkitajūṭakoṭiḥ | etatsamagramapi kāraṇamantareṇa kārtsnyādasūtritamasūtryata yena viśvam ||1 sukhaṃ dhanāni ṛddhiśca santatiḥ sarvadā nṛṇām | priyāṇyeṣāṃ tu saṃsiddhayai sarvaṃ syācchubhalakṣaṇam ||2 yacca ninditalakṣmā ca tadeteṣāṃ vighātakṛt| ataḥ sarvamupādeyaṃ yadbhavecchubhalakṣaṇam ||3 deśaḥ puraṃ nivāsaśca sabhā veśmāsanāni ca| yadyadīdṛśamanyacca tattacchreyaskaraṃ matam ||4 vāstuśāstrādṛte tasya na syāllakṣaṇaniścayaḥ| tasmāllokasya kṛpayā śāstrametadudīryate ||5 athaikadā jagajjanmahetumamburuhāsanam| pṛthvī pṛthubhayabhrāntā cakitākṣī samāyayau ||6 praṇamya praṇatiprahvanikhilatridaśeśvaram| sagadgadamuvāceti bhūtadhātrī pitāmaham ||7 bhagavannahametena pṛthunā pṛthutejasā| upadrutā tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptā trāyasva māṃ tataḥ ||8 vadantyāmiti medinyāmāvirāsīdatho pṛthuḥ| saṃrambhamuktahṛdayo brahmāṇaṃ praṇanāma ca ||9 jagādainamatha snigdhadhvanigambhīrayā girā| kurvaṃstadyānahaṃsānāṃ payodadhvaniśaṅkitam ||10 tvayāsmi jagatāṃ nātha jagato'dhipatiḥ kṛtaḥ| sthāpitāni ca bhūtāni sarvāṇyapi vaśe mama ||11 teṣviyaṃ mama viśveśa kadācidvaśavartinī| samīkaromi pāṣāṇajālānyasyāḥ kilādhunā ||12 vyastāni dhanuṣā tāvadgaurbhūtveyaṃ palāyitā| dogdhukāmo'hamapyenāṃ ciramanvagamaṃ mahīm ||13 yatrakvāpi prayātyeṣā tatra māmeva paśyati| apaśyantyanyatastrāṇamadugdhā tvāmupasthitā ||14 asyāṃ varṇāśramasthānavibhāgaśca vidhāsyate| iyaṃ ca durgamānekakṣoṇīdharakulākulā ||15 vidhāsye'syāṃ kathaṃ tvetaditi me śaṅkitaṃ manaḥ| pṛthunetyatha vijñapto bhagavānabjasambhavaḥ ||16 uvāca bodhayannenaṃ kṛtvā bhūmiṃ ca nirbhayām| iyaṃ mahī mahīpāla vidhivat pālitā satī ||17 sasyairutpādya niṣpannaistava bhogyā bhaviṣyati| yacca te syādabhipretaṃ sthānādiviniveśanam ||18 tadeṣa tridaśācāryaḥ sarvasiddhipravartakaḥ| sutaḥ prabhāsasya vibhoḥ svasrīyaśca bṛhaspateḥ ||19 viśvābhisāyidhīḥ sarvaṃ viśvakarmā kariṣyati| rājannasau mahendra sya vidadhāvamarāvatīm ||20 anyā apyamunā ramyāḥ puryo lokabhṛtāṃ kṛtāḥ| tvayā kṣetrīkṛtāṃ mūrttiṃ dṛṣṭvā sādri drumāmasau ||21 sanniveśān puragrāmanagarāṇāṃ vidhāsyati| tadgaccha vatsa lokānāmitastvaṃ hitakāmyayā ||22 bhayojjhitā tvamapyurvi pṛthoḥ priyakarī bhava| kāle smṛtaḥ smṛtaḥ puṇyo rājñaḥ priyacikīrṣayā ||23 tvamapyakhilamevaitad viśvakarman kariṣyasi| ityuktvā gamanamupeyuṣi prajeśe svaṃ sthānaṃ kṣitibhuji cāśrite mudorvyām || prāleyāvanibhṛtamājagāma khelatsiddhastrīparigatamāśu viśvakarmā ||24 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre mahāsamāgamano nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ| <2> atha viśvakarmaṇaḥ putrasaṃvādo nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ| atha pṛṣṭhe himagireḥ śaśāṅkaśucirociṣi| siddhāmaravadhūbhuktamaṇimañjuguhāgṛhe ||1 vistīrṇāsanamāsīnaṃ sarvajñamatha saṃsmṛtāḥ| āyayurviśvakarmāṇaṃ catvāro mānasāḥ sutāḥ ||2 jayo vijayasiddhārthau caturthaścāparājitaḥ| tamupāgamya śirasā nemuḥ prāñjalayo munim ||3 tānuvāca munirvatsā viditaṃ vo yathā purā| vāstubrahma sadā viśvaṃ vyāpnoti sakalaṃ jagat ||4 dharmyaṃ karma tadā sveṣṭaprāptyai lokāvanāni ca| vyavasthāpya cakāraiṣa lokapālaśca kalpanām ||5 ahamapyamunā viśvanāthenāmbujajanmanā| lokānāṃ sanniveśārthamādiṣṭo'smi svayambhuvā ||6 ramyāṇi nagarodyānasabhāsthānānyatho mayā| surāsuroragādīnāṃ nirmitānyātmabuddhitaḥ ||7 gatvorvīṃ vainyanṛpatervatsāḥ priyacikīrṣayā| nagaragrāmakheṭādīn kariṣyāmi pṛthakpṛthak ||8 kārye tvamuṣmin sakale mama viśvasṛjārpite| samyaksāhāyakairbhāvyaṃ bhavadbhiriti naḥ sthitam ||9 yatastribhuvanālokaprodyatasyābjinīpateḥ| sahāyatāṃ tamaśchede kalayanti marīcayaḥ ||10 svayaṃ kariṣye'hamatho nivāsāya pṛthoḥ purīm| vicitranagaragrāmakheṭāmatimanoharām ||11 bhavantaḥ punarāgatya catvāro'pi caturdiśam| tāṃstān niveśān kurvantu pṛthagjanakṛtāśrayān ||12 antareṣvadhvapāthodhiśailānāṃ saritāṃ tathā| vidhātavyāni durgāṇi nṛpāṇāṃ bhayaśāntaye ||13 varṇaprakṛtiveśmāni saṃsthānāni ca lakṣmabhiḥ| vidheyāni pratigrāmaṃ pratipūḥ pratipattanam ||14 tānitthamātmatanayānabhidhāya samyak| sārārthabhūtamaparisphuṭatojjhitaṃ ca || sthānārpitorubharanirvṛtacittavṛtti-| stūṣṇīṃ prabhāsatanayo nayavijjagāma ||15 iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre viśvakarmaṇaḥ putrasaṃvādo nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ | <3> atha praśno nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ| atha teṣu jayo nāma vākyaṃ tadviśvakarmaṇaḥ| śrutvā kṛtāñjaliḥ prāha snigdhagambhīrayā girā ||1 jñānaikanidhirapyasmān yat sahāyatayā kila| vṛṇoṣi tena na vayamātmānaṃ bahu manmahe ||2 tadidānīṃ hitārthe naḥ prajānāmapi ca prabho| aprameyaprabhāvastvaṃ sarvamākhyātumarhasi ||3 pūrvamekārṇave jāte jagati pralayaṃ gate| mahābhūtāmarapurījyotiṣāṃ kathamudbhavaḥ ||4 kimākārā kimādhārā kiṃpramāṇā ca medinī| vistṛtiḥ paridhiścāsyā bāhulyamapi kīdṛśam ||5 ucchrāyavyāsadīrghatvaiḥ kaiḥ ke'syāṃ kulabhūbhṛtaḥ| kati khyātāni varṣāṇi dvīpā nadyo'bdhayastathā ||6 kāḥ sūryendugraharkṣādigatayaśca pṛthakpṛthak| bhūmerupari kiṃ caiṣāmanyonyaṃ proktamantaram ||7 kimādhāraṃ divi jyotiścakraṃ bhramayate ca kaḥ| loke kathaṃ mahābhūtānyūrdhvādho bibhrati sthitim ||8 yugadharmavyavasthābhiḥ kāścādau lokavṛttayaḥ| kaścādimastato rājñāṃ grahāṇāṃ varṇināṃ katham ||9 kati deśāḥ kati bhuvaḥ pṛthaktvena nirūpitāḥ| kāryaḥ kva ca kathaṃ sanniveśo janapadāśrayaḥ ||10 vyaktacihnaiḥ svanasparśagandhavarṇarasādibhiḥ| kāḥ śastā ninditāḥ kāśca purāṇāmapi bhūmayaḥ ||11 kāryaṃ kena vidhānena bhūbhṛtpuraniveśanam| kiṃ phalaṃ suniviṣṭe'smin durniviṣṭe ca kiṃ punaḥ ||12 katiprakāraṃ durgaṃ ca durgakarmakramaśca kaḥ | kimagrapurasaṃsthānamanindyaṃ kiṃ ca ninditam ||13 kaścātrānukramavidhiḥ pramāṇairupapāditaḥ| prākāragopurāṭṭālaparikhāvaprakarma ca ||14 tamaṅganirgamadvārapratolyaṭṭālakādibhiḥ| kīdṛśaḥ pravibhāgaśca rathyācatvaravartmabhiḥ ||15 bhūmipramāṇasaṃsthānaṃ sīmā ca kṣetradikpathaiḥ| nagaragrāmakheṭānāṃ niveśāḥ syuḥ pṛthakpṛthak ||16 purasyābhyantare pūrvaṃ kairdra vyāvayavakramaiḥ| kasmin sthāne kathaṃ kāryaṃ śakradhvajaniveśanam ||17 pratisaṃvatsaraṃ tasya niyuktasya kathaṃ punaḥ| hitāya nṛpalokānāṃ vidhātavyo mahotsavaḥ ||18 gṛheṣu keṣu keṣvatra kāsu kāsu kakupsu ca| bhāgairbāhyāntaraiḥ kaiḥ kaiḥ kāryāḥ kāḥ kāśca devatāḥ ||19 kaiḥ kairyānaparīvāravarṇarūpavibhūṣaṇaiḥ| kāryāḥ kaiḥ kaiḥ surā vastravayoveṣāyudhadhvajaiḥ ||20 pramāṇamitisaṃsthānasaṅkhyānocchrayalakṣmabhiḥ| prāsādāḥ kasya ke vā syuḥ surarājadvijātiṣu ||21 prākāraparikhāguptaṃ pure syādgopuraṃ kva ca| yugmamadhyāmbuveśmāni kva ca syuḥ kva mahānasam ||22 koṣṭhāgārāyudhasthānabhāṇḍāgāraniveśanaiḥ| vyāyāmanṛttasaṅgītasnānadhārāgṛhādibhiḥ ||23 śayyāvāsagṛhaprekṣāveśmādarśagṛhaiḥ pṛthak| krīḍādolāśrayāriṣṭagṛhāntaḥ puraveśmabhiḥ ||24 viṭaṅkabhramaniryūhakakṣāsaṃyamanādibhiḥ| aśokavanikābhiśca latāmaṇḍapaveśmabhiḥ ||25 vāpībhirdārugiribhiścitrābhiḥ puṣpavīthibhiḥ| etairviśeṣairanyaiśca vicitrairvipināśrayaiḥ ||26 mānonmānakriyāyāmadra vyākṛtivinirmitaḥ| niketananiveśaḥ syādrā jñāṃ bhāgāśritaḥ katham ||27 purodhaḥsainyabhūśreṣṭhadaivacintakamantriṇām| kaṃ kaṃ ca bhāgaṃ prāpya syurniveśā nṛpaveśmanaḥ ||28 pure syurdikṣu bhāgeṣu padabhāgeṣu keṣu ca| viprarājanyaviṭśūdrā stajjairantarajaiḥ samam ||29 tathā kṛṣitulāśilpakalāpaṇyopajīvinaḥ| hiṃsāśritāśca puruṣā niveśyāḥ syuḥ kathaṃ kva ca ||30 niveśāḥ kīdṛśāścaiṣāṃ kiyanto vā bhavanti te| śasyaṃ lokena vā teṣāṃ kaiḥ praveśajalabhramaiḥ ||31 dhiṣṇyamādyaṃ katividhaṃ dra vyāṇyādyāni kāni vā| hetureṣāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ syācca kidṛganukramaḥ ||32 bhajante yogamanyonyaṃ kāni dra vyāṇi kaiḥ saha| kāni yogaṃ na gacchanti kairvā kaḥ kva vaset pumān ||33 iṣṭakākarma kiṃ ceṣṭaṃ kīrtitā katidhā ca bhūḥ| parikarmakramastāsāṃ vahnyambupavanaiśca kaḥ ||34 guruvarṇidhvajorvīśatadbhṛtyapratimā purām| vṛkṣāḥ ke ke praśastāḥ syurgṛhārthe ke ca garhitāḥ ||35 tacchedasrāvasaṃbhūtaṃ śabdadikpātagarbhajam| vijñāyate kathaṃ kartṛkārakādiśubhāśubham ||36 pramāṇaṃ takṣaṇacchedaiḥ śodhitānāṃ kathaṃ bhavet| āhṛtya sthāpanaṃ pūrvaṃ dārūṇāṃ sthānake kva ca ||37 sāmānyato'khilānāṃ kāḥ kāśca jāterviśeṣataḥ| praśastairlakṣmabhiryuktā bhūmayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||38 śalyoddhāravidhiḥ kīdṛk kīdṛśaṃ bhūmikarma ca| diggrahaḥ sūtraṇaṃ cādhivāsanaṃ ca kathaṃ bhavet ||39 pramāṇaṃ mūlapādasya śilānyāse ca ko vidhiḥ| vibhajyate kathaṃ veśma śālālindavibhājanaiḥ ||40 mānāni kāni bhittīnāṃ pīṭhānāmucchrayāśca ke| kathaṃ tāni vikalpyāni varṇānāṃ mekhalādibhiḥ ||41 samastakānāṃ stambhānāṃ dvārastambhāsanaiḥ saha| nāgavīthyupadhānānāṃ samaṃ kaṇṭhavinirgamaiḥ ||42 jayantīsaṅgrahatulākāryāṇāṃ vāstuno'pi ca| kīdṛśaṃ phalakānāṃ ca pramāṇaṃ parikīrtitam ||43 svamānāt sarvavarṇānāṃ talocchrāyāstu kīdṛśāḥ| kā gavākṣakapotālivedikājālakakriyāḥ ||44 sthūṇā nisṛṣṭikotsūkā mṛgālyupatulāstathā| sāntaḥprāṇiśirovaṃśāḥ kiṃpramāṇāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||45 chādyodayāḥ kiyantaḥ syurvṛttacchādyakramaśca kaḥ| tryaśrāṇāṃ khaṇḍavṛttānāṃ lupānāṃ ca kriyāḥ katham ||46 sīmālindaśirastāsāṃ kīdṛśī cāvalambanā| katiprakārāḥ prāsādaśirasāṃ ca vikalpanāḥ ||47 yaccānyadevamādi syātprāsādabhavanādiṣu| dra vyakāṣṭhakalāsaṅgi pramāṇaṃ tasya kīdṛśam ||48 śālālindapramāṇāni catuḥśāleṣu dhāmasu| jyāyomadhyayavīyassu mūṣābhiḥ kāṣṭhakalpanā ||49 ekadvitricatuḥśālānyeṣāṃ saṃyogato'pi ca| kathaṃ kati ca veśmāni kalpyante pravibhāgaśaḥ ||50 kathaṃ ca ṣoḍaśacatuḥṣaṣṭyekāśītayaḥ śatam| saṃvibhāgāḥ padānāṃ syuḥ kathamatrāmarasthitiḥ ||51 ādyo navapado vāsturantyaḥ sāhasrikaḥ katham| aṅgapratyaṅgabhāgeṣu keṣu keṣu kva tasthuṣaḥ ||52 kathamete surāḥ sarave vāstorasya vyavasthitāḥ| etadvaṃśaśiraścakṣuḥkukṣihṛnmūrdhamarmasu ||53 jāyeta pīḍā dra vyeṣu sanniviṣṭeṣu kasya kā| vāstvārambhapraveśeṣu yātrāyāṃ sthāpaneṣu ca ||54 dūtasvapnanimittādyaiḥ kathaṃ jñeyaṃ śubhāśubham| kārukriyāsu citreṣu tathā lepyakriyāsu ca ||55 yojyaṃ kiṃ kaimayogyaṃ ca kiṃ bhūpabhavanādiṣu| hastasya lakṣaṇaṃ mānasaṃjñā vai jñāyate katham ||56 kiṃ havyeṣvagnilakṣma syāt kiṃ ca niryuktalakṣaṇam| anukrameṇa varṇānāṃ balikarma ca kīdṛśam ||57 vidheyaṃ vidhinā kena bhavane ca praveśanam| patite sphuṭite jīrṇe pluṣṭe vajrāśanikṣate ||58 nimagnabhagnanirbhinnapraśīrṇeṣu ca vāstuṣu| madhuvalmīkasaṃbhūtau pravirūḍhe ca dāruṇi ||59 jāyate kiṃ phalaṃ kutra prāyaścittena ko vidhiḥ| ityevamādikamanekavidhaṃ vidhānaṃ veśmopagaṃ ca pṛthagāśrayasaṃbhṛtaṃ ca | asmāsvanalpakaruṇārdri tacittavṛttirvyākhyātumarhasi samastamanukrameṇa ||60 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre prāśnādhyāyastṛtīyaḥ| <4> atha mahadādisargaścaturtho'dhyāyaḥ| jayasyeti samākarṇya viśvakarmā ca tadvacaḥ| jagāda garjadambhodadhvanigambhīrayā girā ||1 sādhu vatsa tvayā samyak prajñayātiviśuddhayā| praśno'yamīrito vāstuvidyābjavanabhāskaraḥ ||2 sa tvaṃ nidhāya praśnānāṃ samudāyamamuṃ hṛdi| vadato me'vadhānena śṛṇu yadbrahmaṇoditam ||3 idamāsīdyugāntāgnipluṣṭaṃ saṃvartakādibhiḥ| samutsṛjadbhirambhāṃsi viśvamekārṇavīkṛtam ||4 tamobhūte tatastasmin bhogaparyaṅkamāśritaḥ| hariḥ suṣvāpa salile kṛtvodaragataṃ jagat ||5 athāsya nābhāvambhojamabhūt tasminnagāyata| sarvajñānāśrayaḥ śrīmāṃścaturvaktraḥ sureśvaraḥ ||6 sa kadācid dadhaccetaḥ prajāsṛṣṭiṃ prati prabhuḥ| mahāntamasṛjat tatra pūrvaṃ viśvasya hetave ||7 tridhāhaṅkṛtametasmānmano'bhūt sāttvikādataḥ| rājasādapi cākṣāṇi tanmātrāṇi ca tāmasāt ||8 tebhyaḥ pañca mahābhūtānyāvirāsannanukramāt| vyomādīni dharāntāni svaiḥ svairyuktāni tairguṇaiḥ ||9 adharottarabhāvaśca samyageṣāmathocyate| ādau pṛthvī tato'dhastādāpastāsāṃ ca pāvakaḥ ||10 tasyāpyadhastātpavanastataḥ khamavakāśadam| bhūtādisthaṃ viyatso'pi mahatā parivāritaḥ ||11 mahāṃśca viśati vyaktaṃ vyaktamavyaktakaṃ punaḥ| grāhyagrāhakabhāvena vyakto bhūtasamudbhavaḥ ||12 ādhārādhāryabhāvaśca yathārthau ca sthitivyayau| mahābhūtāni saduṇānyevaṃ sṛṣṭvā tataḥ prabhuḥ ||13 manaḥ punarasau sarge bhautike samyagādadhau| surāsurān sagandharvān yakṣarakṣāṃsi pannagān ||14 nāgān munīnapsaraso manasā samajījanat| arkendū cakṣuṣo jātau gaganabhramaṇakṣamau ||15 gātrebhyo'pi ca nakṣatracakramasmādajāyata| indri yebhyaśca pañcabhyo'bhūttārāgrahapañcakam ||16 grahatvaṃ punareteṣāmindri yagrahaṇādviduḥ| surendra cāpacihnānāṃ vidyudvalayaśālinām ||17 bhīmāśanibhṛtāṃ cāsītkeśebhyo'mbumucāṃ bhavaḥ| viśvamāpūrayan kṛtsnamāvirāsīttadicchayā ||18 trilokīpāvanastiryaggāmī caṇḍaḥ samīraṇaḥ| tataścaṇḍāniloddhūtamuparyarkāṃśutāpitam ||19 vāyubhiḥ śoṣamānītaṃ jagāma ghanatāṃ payaḥ| tasyopariṣṭādambhodheradhaḥ kuṇḍalitaṃ vapuḥ ||20 viṣṇoḥ sajyātvamabhyetya dhatte'nanto'khilāṃ bhuvam| na taptaṃ yeṣu yeṣvambhaḥ pradeśeṣvarkaraśmibhiḥ ||21 nītaṃ na vānilaiḥ śoṣaṃ tatra tatrābdhayo'bhavan| mahāmbhovīcisaṅghātā vikṣiptāścaṇḍamārutaiḥ ||22 yatra yatrāpuraikyaṃ te tatra tatrādra yo'bhavan| niścalatvārthamavaniścarmavadvitatātha taiḥ ||23 śailaiḥ kīlairiva sthāneṣvācitā teṣu teṣviyam| vṛddhiṃ gatādri niḥṣyandairbhūbhṛtāṃ pravibhāgajā ||24 nimnagābhūttato'mbhodheḥ kāntā nimnānusāriṇī| medinyanteṣu jaladhiparyanteṣu viniryayuḥ ||25 ambhāṃsi yatra yatrāsaṃste dvīpāścitrarūpiṇaḥ| sanimnagāmbudhidvīpā vibhaktākhilabhūdharā ||26 vyaktā babhūva kṛtsnaivaṃ bhūmirbhūtāni bibhratī| sa cakre rauravādīnāṃ nirayāṇāmadhaḥ kṣiteḥ ||27 svakarmaphalabhuktyarthaṃ sthānaṃ duṣkṛtakarmaṇām| jarāyujāṇḍajodbhijjasvedajaiḥ saha sa prabhuḥ ||28 caturdhetyasṛjalloke bhūtagrāmaṃ carācaram| dvedhā jarāyujāstatra manuṣyāḥ paśavastathā ||29 grāmyāḥ saptābhavaṃsteṣu saptāraṇyakṛtālayāḥ| pumān gausturagacchāgau meṣo vegasaraḥ kharaḥ ||30 grāmavāsaikaniratāḥ saptaite parikīrtitāḥ| siṃhadvipoṣṭramahiṣāḥ śarabho gavayaḥ kapiḥ ||31 araṇyagocarā jīvāḥ saptaite vatsa nirmitāḥ| dharmādharmavivekitvācchreyān grāmyeṣu pūruṣaḥ ||32 araṇyacāriṣu śreṣṭhaḥ siṃhaḥ śauryabalādibhiḥ | suparṇā bhujagāḥ kīṭā ye'pi ca syuḥ pipīlikāḥ ||33 caturdhetyaṇḍajanmāno janminaste prakīrttitāḥ| kledakeśasamudbhūtāḥ kṛmiyūkādijantavaḥ ||34 sarve'pi svedajanmānaste prajāpatinā kṛtāḥ| udbhijjāḥ pañcadhā bhūtvā nirdiṣṭāḥ sthāvarāśca te ||35 drumā vallyaśca gulmāśca vaṃśāḥ satṛṇajātayaḥ| channāntaḥkaraṇatvaṃ ca svasthānāttyāgitāpi ca ||36 chinnaprarohitā caiṣāṃ vaiśeṣikaguṇatrayam| gāyatrī bhūtasaṃjñaiṣāṃ caturviṃśatiparvikā ||37 jñātvaināṃ puruṣaḥ puṇyāṃ bhavati svargabhājanam| bhuvanabhūjalavahnimarudviyatpramukha eṣa bhavastava kīrttitaḥ| vaṃsumatīparimāṇaviniścayaṃ kathayataḥ śṛṇu samprati vatsa me ||38 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre mahadādisaṅgādhyāyaścaturthaḥ| <5> atha bhuvanakośaḥ pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ| atho yathākramaṃ bhūmeḥ kṛtsnāyāḥ kathayāmi te| viṣkambhaparidhī vatsa bāhulyamapi ca sphuṭam ||1 viṣkambho'syāḥ samuddiṣṭo daśayojanakoṭayaḥ| lakṣāṇyapi ca medinyāstadvadekonaviṃśatiḥ| viṣkambhatriguṇo yāvadviṣkambhāṃśaśca pañcamaḥ ||2 medinyāḥ paridhistāvadyojanaiḥ parikīrttitaḥ| dvātriṃśatkoṭayaḥ ṣaṣṭirlakṣāṇi paridhiḥ kṣiteḥ ||3 aśītiśca sahasrāṇi yojanānāṃ prakīrttitaḥ| yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi viṃśatirlakṣayordvayam ||4 iti bāhulyametasyāḥ kṣitervatsa tavoditam| caturṇāṃ salilādīnāṃ bhūtādermahato'pi ca ||5 uttarottaramurvīto mānaṃ śataguṇaṃ viduḥ| toyādiṣu sthiteyaṃ bhūścakravadvṛttaśālinī ||6 pātrasthāparapātraśrīhārīṇyanyānyapi kramāt| pramāṇamidameteṣāṃ kṣityādīnāṃ tavoditam ||7 dvīpādīnāṃ tu pāthodhiniveśaḥ punarucyate| dvīpānāmambudhīnāṃ ca saptānāmapi madhyagaḥ ||8 jambūdvīpo bhavedvṛttaḥ sahasraśatavistṛtaḥ| himādri rhemakūṭākhyo niṣadho nīlasaṃjñitaḥ ||9 śvetaḥ śṛṅgī ca ṣaḍamī bhavantyasmin kulācalāḥ| etasmāduttareṇādre stuṣārāṅkitamekhalāt ||10 pūrvāparāyatāḥ sarve'pyadra yo yāvadambudhi| antarā nīlaniṣadhau jambūdvīpasya nābhigaḥ ||11 vṛttaḥ puṇyajanākīrṇaḥ śrīmān merurmahācalaḥ| udagyāmyāyate meroḥ prāgbhāge mālyavān giriḥ ||12 sevitaḥ siddhanārībhirānīlaniṣadhāyataḥ| sumeroḥ paścimenādri rgandharvakulasaṅkulaḥ ||13 mālyavatsadṛśāyāmo mahībhṛdgandhamādanaḥ| parvatābubhayāntasthau himavān śṛṅgavāṃstathā ||14 yojanānāṃ sahasre dve sārdhe syāducchrayastayoḥ| śvetaśca hemakūṭaścetyantayoḥ pṛthivīdharau ||15 yojanānāṃ sahasrārdhamekaikasyocchrayastayoḥ| niṣadhācalanīlādri mālyavadgandhamādanāḥ ||16 sahasrayojanocchrāyāścatvāro'mī pṛthakpṛthak| ete'ṣṭāvapi śailendrāḥ sahasradvayavistṛtāḥ ||17 ucchrayārdhamadhaścāpi vilagnāḥ saha meruṇā| meroḥ samucchrayo'śītiḥ sahasrāṇi caturyutā ||18 ṣoḍaśādhaḥ sahasrāṇi dvātriṃśanmūrdhni vistṛtiḥ| jambūtarurmahān madhye sumerorniṣadhasya ca ||19 dvīpasyāmuṣya yadyogājjambūdvīpa iti śrutiḥ| śṛṅgairhimaśilānaddhaiḥ sarvato himavānayam ||20 mahānto nivasantyatra piśācā yakṣarākṣasāḥ| kūṭairhemamayairhemakūṭa ityavanīdharaḥ ||21 yaṃ sarvato niṣevante sadā cāraṇaguhyakāḥ| taruṇārkaprabhājālapratimo niṣadhācalaḥ ||22 nivasanti sukhaṃ tatra śeṣavāsukitakṣakāḥ| hemābjakarṇikākāraḥ sumerurmaṇikandaraḥ ||23 atrāmarāḥ sāpsarasastrayastriṃśadvasanti te| vaiḍūryanaddhaiḥ śikharairnīlo nīlamahīdharaḥ ||24 kalayanti taponityā yatra brahmarṣayaḥ sthitim| śvetaḥ sa kāñcanaiḥ śṛṅgairgaganollekhibhirvṛtaḥ ||25 dordarpaśālināṃ yatra nivāsastridaśadviṣām| mahānīlamayo barhipicchacchāyo bahirmahān ||26 pitṝṇāmālayaḥ śṛṅgairucchritaiḥ śṛṅgavān giriḥ| himācalasya yāmyena kṣārābdhivṛtamanyataḥ ||27 varṣaṃ syādbhārataṃ nāma prathamaṃ kārmukākṛti| tuṣāranilayasyādre rhemakūṭācalasya ca ||28 madhye kiṃpuruṣaṃ nāma dvitīyaṃ varṣamīritam| antare hemakūṭasya niṣadhasya ca bhūbhṛtaḥ ||29 harivarṣamiti proktaṃ tṛtīyaṃ varṣamuttamam| niṣadhācalanīlādri mālyavadgandhabhūbhṛtām ||30 caturṇāṃ madhyagaṃ varṣaṃ turyamasminnilāvṛtam| uttare nīlaśailasya yāmye ca śvetabhūbhṛtaḥ ||31 pañcamaṃ varṣamatyartharamyaṃ ramyakasaṃjñitam| śvetaśṛṅgavatoḥ śailarājayoranayoriha ||32 madhye ṣaṣṭhaṃ hiraṇyāṃśuramyaṃ hairaṇyakādvayam| asyottare śṛṅgavato yāmye ca kṣāravāridheḥ ||33 kuruvarṣābhidhaṃ varṣamuttareṇa pracakṣate| antarā nīlaniṣadhau prāgbhāge mālyavadgireḥ ||34 bhadrā śvamaṣṭamaṃ varṣaṃ prāksamudrā ntamīritam| gandhamādanaśailasya pratyak prākcāparāmbudheḥ ||35 navamaṃ varṣamācāryāḥ ketumālaṃ pracakṣate| iti proktāni varṣāṇi navāmūni mayā tava ||36 sāmprataṃ punareteṣāṃ pramāṇamavadhāraya| pramāṇena sahasrāṇi catustriṃśaccaturdiśam ||37 yojanānāmihecchanti caturaśramilāvṛtam| prākpratyagbhāgage varṣe tasyodagyāmyataḥ same ||38 ekatriṃśatsahasrāṇi kiñcit prākpratyagāyate| yānyuktāni ṣaḍanyāni varṣāṇyebhyo'varāṇi te ||39 teṣāṃ navasahasrāṇi pratyekaṃ vistṛtirmatā| varṣe kimpuruṣe nāryo narāśca plakṣabhojanāḥ ||40 jīvantyayutamabdānāṃ jātyajāmbūnadatviṣaḥ| harivarṣe narā nāryo vasantīkṣurasāśinaḥ ||41 sāyutaṃ ca sahasraṃ te jīvanti rajatatviṣaḥ| ilāvṛte narāḥ padmarāgabhāsodgatāstathā ||42 jambūphalarasāhārāḥ sapādāyutajīvinaḥ| nāsmin merutaṭacchanne tārakārkenduraśmayaḥ ||43 svāṅgaprabhābhiḥ kintvatra kṛtodyotā vasantyamī| kairavodarasacchāyā bhadrā śve sāṅganā narāḥ ||44 nīlāmrakaphalāhārā bhavantyatrāyutāyuṣaḥ| dalatkuvalayaśyāmāḥ ketumāle śarīriṇaḥ ||45 śaradāmayutaṃ teṣāmāyuḥ panasabhojinām| śvetābho ramyake ramye nyagrodhaphalabhugjanaḥ ||46 harivarṣa iva proktametasmin mānamāyuṣaḥ| śyāmatviṣaḥ striyo varṣe pumāṃsaśca hiraṇyake ||47 jīvantyayutamabdānāṃ sarve'pi lakucāśinaḥ| kuruṣvabhīṣṭadairvṛkṣairjīvanti strīyutā narāḥ ||48 sapādamayutaṃ devagarbhabhā gaurakāntayaḥ| puṇyakarmā vasatyeṣu varṣeṣu nikhilo janaḥ ||49 śokavyādhijarātaṅkaśaṅkonmuktaḥ sadā sukhī| vanaiḥ kīrṇāni sarvāṇi kusumastabakānataiḥ ||50 udbhijjādbhirnadībhiśca taistaistuṅgaiśca pādapaiḥ| udañcadvīcimālena lāvaṇenābdhinā bahiḥ ||51 prakṣito'yamuktaste jambūdvīpo mayāliḥ| dvādaśāmbunidhāvatra pṛthagbhūmibhṛtaḥ sthitāḥ ||52 trayastrayo diśi diśi sphārormisthagitopalāḥ| mainākaśca balāhaśca cakranāmā ca dakṣiṇe ||53 nāradākhyo varāhākhyaḥ saumakākhyaśca paścime| udagbhāge'pi ca dro ṇakaṅkacandrā iti trayaḥ ||54 dhūmrako dundubhiścaiva sārdra kaśceti pūrvataḥ| sahasraṃ yojanānāṃ te dīrghāstasyārdhamucchritāḥ ||55 magnāstadardhamambhodhau vistṛtāśca dharādharāḥ| juṣṭāḥ sarve suraiḥ śṛṅgaprauḍhilīḍhavihāyasaḥ ||56 jvalitauṣadhayaḥ kāntavicitradrumavīrudhaḥ| dvīpāḥ śākakuśakrauñcaśālmalya iti ca kramāt ||57 gomedaḥ puṣkarākhyaśca ṣaḍamī bāhyataḥ sthitāḥ| kṣīrājyadadhimadyekṣurasasvādvambhaso'rṇavāḥ ||58 dvīpān śākādikānete parivārya sthitāḥ kramāt| svadvīpatulyāḥ sarve te pramāṇena yathākramam ||59 amī śākādayo dvīpā jambūdvīpapramāṇataḥ| yathākramaṃ syurdviguṇāstathāmbhonidhayo'pica ||60 śāke saptādra yasteṣūdayo jaladharastathā| nārako raivataḥ śyāmo rājato'thāmbikeyakaḥ ||61 catuḥsāhastrikasteṣāṃ viṣkambho'rdhaṃ samucchrayaḥ| tadardhaṃ bhūpradeśaśca sevitānāṃ surarṣibhiḥ ||62 vṛttānāṃ dvīpavatteṣāṃ bāhyato'mūnyanukramāt| varṣāṇi sanniviṣṭāni sapta tāni bravīmi te ||63 jaladākhyaṃ kumāraṃ ca sukumāraṃ maṇīcakam| kusumottaramodākīmahādrumavanāni ca ||64 kuśe vidrumahemākhyau dyutimānatha puṣpavān| kuśeśayo harikṣmābhṛnmandaraśca kulācalāḥ ||65 viṣkambho'ṣṭasahasrāṇi teṣāṃ pratyekamīritaḥ| tadardhamucchrayastadvaducchrayārdhamadhogamaḥ ||66 udbhidaṃ veṇuvatsaṃjñaṃ sarālamatha lambanam| varṣaṃ śrīmatprabhākṛcca kapilaṃ pannagābhidham ||67 krauñce krauñco'ndhakāraśca devo govindavāmanau| dvividaḥ puṇḍarīkaścetyasmin sapta kulādra yaḥ ||68 viṣkambho'yutameteṣāṃ viṣkambhārdhaṃ samucchrayaḥ| adhogatistadardhaṃ ca varṣāṇyeṣāṃ tu bāhyataḥ ||69 kusalākhyāṣṭavarṣākhye parāpatamanonuge| munivarṣāndhakārākhye saptamaṃ dundubhīti ca ||70 girayaḥ śālmalidvīpe raktaḥ pītaḥ sitastathā| vaipulyameṣāṃ dvātriṃśatsahasrāṇi pracakṣate ||71 vaipulyārdhaṃ samucchrāyastadardhamavanau gatiḥ| varṣe śāntabhayaṃ vītabhayaṃ cetyatra saṃsthite ||72 gomede tu suraśceti kumudaśceti bhūdharau| yojanānāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭistau sahasrāṇi vistṛtau ||73 ucchrāyo vistarasyārdhaṃ tadardhaṃ cāpyadhogatiḥ| dhātakīkhaṇḍanāmāsya madhye varṣamudīritam ||74 astyadriḥ puṣkaradvīpe mānasottarasaṃjñitaḥ| bāhyato varṣametasya mahāvītamiti smṛtam ||75 vistṛto'ṣṭau sahasrāṇi śailo'yaṃ dve tathāyute| sahasraśatamanyacca surasiddharṣisevitaḥ ||76 vyāsārdhenocchrayastasya tadardhenāpyadhogamaḥ| sureśānāṃ nagaryo'smin mayā vatsa niveśitāḥ ||77 aindrī vasvokasārā prāg yāmyā saṃyamanī tataḥ| prācenasī sukhā paścāttathā saumyuttare vibhā ||78 dharmarakṣārthametāsu catvāraścatasṛṣvapi| tathā lokavyavasthārthaṃ pṛthaglokabhṛtaḥ sthitāḥ ||79 lokālokācalaḥ svādusalilāddviguṇo bahiḥ| svādūdābdhipramāṇātsavistārāddviguṇo'pi ca ||80 samucchrito'sau niyutaṃ niyutārdhamadho gataḥ| pañca krośāḥ pratidiśaṃ niyutāni tathā nava ||81 tadvacca niyutasyārdhaṃ merumadhyāttadantaram| samudbhāsitadehārdhastigmāṃśoḥ kiraṇairayam ||82 tatsamena ca bhūmyardhenāvṛtaḥ parataḥ punaḥ| bhautānyāvaraṇānyurvyā yasyaitāni sthitānyadhaḥ ||83 bāhyato'pi ca bhūmyūrdhvaṃ niviṣṭāni tathānagha| iti vatsa tava proktaḥ sanniveśo'khilaḥ kṣiteḥ ||84 sthitiṃ gatiṃ ca kathayāmyarkādīnāmataḥparam| sūryendudhiṣṇyajñasitabhaumārkitridaśārcitāḥ ||85 saptarṣayo dhruvaśceti bhūmerūrdhvaṃ kramāt sthitāḥ| catvāri dve tathā bhūmerūrdhvamā sūryanandanāt ||86 ṣaḍevamantarāṇi syuḥ sahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ śatam| grahāntarāṇi yānyanyānyavaśiṣṭānyanukramāt ||87 tāni catvāryapi dve dve lakṣe proktāni mānataḥ| dharitrīdhruvayormadhye yojanānāṃ caturdaśa ||88 niyutāni samutsedhastrailokyasya prakīrttitaḥ| ekātha dve catasro'ṣṭāvantaraṃ koṭayaḥ kramāt ||89 mahojanastapaḥsatyalokānāmupari dhruvāt| ye sthitāḥ satyalokordhvamadhastādaṇḍakarparāt ||90 ekā koṭirbhavetteṣāṃ pañcāśanniyutānvitā| athāvaraṇayogo'sya vihitaḥ padmajanmanā ||91 yathaivādhastathā niryaktathaivordhvamapi kramāt| vahe'bdāḥ pravahe sūryaḥ sthitaḥ śītāṃśurudvahe ||92 saṃvahasthāni nakṣatrāṇyāvahasthāḥ punargrahāḥ| saptarṣayaḥ parivahe dhruvaścāpi parāvahe ||93 pradakṣiṇamamī sapta maruto bhramayantyamūn| meghībhūtaḥ sthito madhye sumerukṣmābhṛti dhruvaḥ ||94 samastamapi tadbaddhaṃ jyotiścakraṃ bhramatyadaḥ| saptāśvenaikacakreṇa rathena rathināṃ varaḥ ||95 tejomayena satataṃ bhrāmyati jyotiṣāṃ patiḥ| ketumālerajanyardhaṃ karotyastaṃ kuruṣvapi ||96 madhyandinaṃ ca bhadrā śvestaṃ gacchan bhārate raviḥ| rasābdhipakṣasaṅkhyāni yojanāni nimeṣataḥ ||97 saptaviṃśatikāṃ cāṣṭau bhāgānsarpatyaharpatiḥ| yojanānyadhvinandarnu guṇasaṅkhyāni kāṣṭhayā ||98 navāṃśakacatuṣkaṃ ca krāmatyahimadīdhitiḥ| vahnyagnivasukhendra kṣmāsaṅkhyātānyabjinīpatiḥ ||99 yojanasya tribhāgaṃ ca prayāti kalayaikayā| viyatkhavyomabhūtāśviguṇapāvakasaṅkhyayā ||100 yojanānyuṣṇakiraṇo muhūrtena prasarpati| rātryaheṇa sahasrāṇi pañcāśannavakoṭayaḥ ||101 lakṣāṇi saptanavatirgatiḥ syāt tigmarociṣaḥ| madhyena puṣkaradvīpasyārko gatyānayā vrajan ||102 nabhastalena punarapyudayādudayaṃ śrayet| itthaṃ gatiriyaṃ samyaktigmabhānornirūpitā ||103 gatiṃ candra graharkṣāṇāṃ bhogaṃ cārkādvibhāvayet| proktaṃ tavetyahorātrapramāṇamadhunānagha| pakṣamāsartuvarṣādīnvyavahārāya kalpayet ||104 iti nigadita eṣa dvīpaśailāmbudhīnā| mavanivalayavarttī kārtsnyataḥ sanniveśaḥ| gatirapi dinabharttuḥ kīrttitā viśvamānaṃ| punariha yugadharmaṃ kīrttyamānaṃ nibodha ||105 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre bhuvanakośādhyāyaḥ pañcamaḥ| <6> atha prākkathitādasmādbhūtasargādanantaram| prajāsīdamaraiḥ sārdhamiyaṃ pūrṇajanākulā ||1 śokavyādhiśarātaṅkavimuktāstridaśā iva| purābhavan kṛtayuge pumāṃsaḥ sthirayauvanāḥ ||2 te nikuñjeṣu śailānāṃ nadīṣu ca sarassu ca| vaneṣu ca vicitreṣu cikrīḍurdaivataiḥ saha ||3 helayā te samutpatya kadācidamaraiḥ saha| nirargalāḥ samāsādya svarviceruḥ surā iva ||4 citrāmbarāvṛtāḥ sarve nānābharaṇaśālinaḥ| vimānākṛtayasteṣāmāsan kalpadrumā drumāḥ ||5 manojñābhiḥ saha strībhirvicitrābharaṇāstriyaḥ| kalpadrumeṣvakārṣuste vāsaṃ krīḍāṃ ca teṣvatha ||6 kṣuttṛḍduḥkhojjhitāḥ sarve babhūvurayutāyuṣaḥ| ratnāvadātadehāste kadācidbhūrasāśinaḥ ||7 ratiprāyāstadāsaṃste svecchāhāravihāriṇaḥ| svīkāravigrahacchedaviśadīkṛtacetasaḥ ||8 nāsminnarkastapatyugraṃ na vāti prabalo'nilaḥ| nīhāracchedasundaryo niśāḥ pūrṇendubhūṣaṇāḥ ||9 bhinnasnigdhāñjanaśyāmāḥ sataḍinmandra nisvanāḥ| acaṇḍāśanayaścāsan kabarīkāntayo ghanāḥ ||10 mādyatpikavadhūdaṣṭamākandamukurāṅkurāḥ| āsansadāpuṣpaphalābhogā yeṣāṃ vanālayāḥ ||11 eko'grajanmā varṇo'smin vedo'bhūdeka eva ca| ṛturvasanta evaikaḥ kusumāyudhabāndhavaḥ ||12 rūpaśrutasukhaiśvaryabhājaste nikhilā api| samatvānnābhavatteṣāmuttamādhamamadhyatā ||13 na kheṭanagaragrāmapurakṣetrakhalādikam| na daṃśamaśakakravyādbhayaṃ vā na grahādi ca ||14 kalpadrumāptabhogānāṃ na caiṣāṃ prabhurapyabhūt| purāsmin bhārate varṣe teṣāṃ nivasatāmiti ||15 jagāma subahuḥ kālaḥ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ suraśriyām| ajñātatatprabhāvānāṃ sahasaṃvāsasaṃbhavā ||16 athaiṣāmabhavaddaivādavajñā tridaśān prati| apūjyamānāste pūjyāḥ sarve'pyakhilavedinaḥ ||17 ādāya tatkalpataruṃ nipeturdyāṃ divaukasaḥ| divaṃgamanaśaktiśca divyo bhāvaśca tadgataḥ ||18 sarasaḥ paramo bhūmau bhūrasaśca nyavartata| smṛtvā kalpadrumāṃstāṃstān krīḍāstāśca suraiḥ saha ||19 vyalapan bahudhātyarthamanarthakṛtacetasaḥ| tato vilapatāṃ bhūri svairamāhārahetave ||20 prāṇatrāṇārthameteṣāmabhūt parpaṭako bhuvi| bhūrasenaiva tenaite kurvāṇāḥ prāṇarakṣaṇam ||21 vinā kalpadrumairvāsamanyavṛkṣeṣu cakrire| athaiṣāṃ paśyatāmeva kadācidbhāgyasaṃkṣayāt ||22 viparyayācca kālasya bhūmeḥ parpaṭako'pyagāt| tataḥ parpaṭake naṣṭe tuṣaśūkakaṇojjhitāḥ ||23 akṛṣṭapacyā medinyāmabhavañśālitaṇḍulāḥ| śālyodanena tenātha sukhāduvyañjanena te ||24 paramāṃ tṛptimāseduḥ paritoṣāttacetasaḥ| tannāśaśaṅkayā śālitaṇḍulānāṃ drumeṣvadhaḥ ||25 te vyadhurmahato rāśīṃstatkṣetrāṇi ca cakrire| ajāyata tato lobho mātsaryerṣyāpurassaraḥ ||26 tatra tatra śanaiścakre padanyāsaṃ ca manmathaḥ| dvandvaprāptyā tatasteṣāṃ bibhratāmuttamāṃ gatim ||27 dhairyadhvaṃsādabhūt strīṣu bhṛśaṃ rāgaturaṅgamaḥ| dārakṣetranimittāni bhūyāṃsyeṣāmanantaram ||28 parikleśaikamūlāni dvandvānyāsanpṛthakpṛthak| tataḥ svakḷptamaryādocchediṣveṣvajitātmasu ||29 avinīteṣvabhāgyeṣu sa śālistuṣatāmagāt| pravṛddharajasāṃ teṣāṃ sā puṇyaślokatā gatā ||30 malapravṛttirabhavat tuṣadhānyopasevayā| tuṣadhānye tato naṣṭe paribhukte ca sañcaye ||31 cīravalkalavastrāṇāṃ kandamūlaphalāśinām| ṛtavaḥ kālaparyāsāt ṣaḍ vasantādayo'bhavan ||32 tatasteṣāmabhūddoṣarogaśokākulaṃ vapuḥ| manaśca kāmakrodherṣyādainyāsūyādidūṣitam ||33 ādhidaivakamuṣṇāmbuśītādijanitaṃ mahat| ādhibhautikamapyāsīdduḥkhaṃ vyālamṛgādijam ||34 itthaṃ duḥkhatrayārttāste vyavāyādyabhiguptaye| himanīhāraśītāmbuvātādyāpacchide'pi ca ||35 ajātaprītayo vṛkṣaiḥ kuṭṭimāni gṛhāṇi te| vyadhuśchittvāśmabhirvṛkṣānanyān duḥkhārtecetasaḥ ||36 smṛtvā kalpadrumākārāstadrū pāṇi gṛhāṇi te| ekadvitricatuḥsaptadaśaśālāni cakrire ||37 śabdā prākāraparikheṣvācchanneṣu tṛṇādibhiḥ| hṛṣṭāsteṣvanayan kālamāpteṣu gṛhamedhinaḥ ||38 ityamīṣu gṛhiṇo gṛheṣu te śītavātajalatāpanāśiṣu| harṣasaṃvalitamānasāściraṃ sannirastavipado'vasan sukham ||39 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre sahadevādhikāro nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ| <7> atha varṇāśramapravibhāgaḥ saptamo'dhyāyaḥ| athāmaragaṇaiḥ sārdhamājagāma pitāmahaḥ| duḥkhacchedāya martyānāmādāya nṛpatiṃ pṛthum ||1 sa tānūve prabhurvo'sau marutāmiva vāsavaḥ| daṇḍadhārī ca duṣṭānāṃ prabhāve lokapālavat ||2 pratāpatāpitārātisiṃhaḥ siṃhaparākramaḥ| yuṣmākamādhipatye'sāvabhiṣikto mayā pṛthuḥ ||3 rakṣākṛtsarvaśiṣṭānāmucchettā duṣṭacetasām| vṛttito bhītihartā ca bhaviṣyatyeṣa vo nṛpaḥ ||4 bhavadbhiretadāyattairbhavitavyaṃ mamājñayā| kariṣyatyeṣa vo nītyā cāturvarṇyāśramasthitīḥ ||5 uktveti brahmaṇi gate nāthamāsādya te'tha tam| avocan duḥkhitā duḥkhādasmāt trāyasva naḥ prabho ||6 kalpadrumāmaratyaktān dvandvārtiklāntacetasaḥ| vyasanārṇavanirmagnān pāhi naḥ pṛthivīpate ||7 atho pṛthuruvācaitān mā bhaiṣṭasukhamāsyatām| duḥkhānyapahariṣyāmi kariṣye ca sukhāni vaḥ ||8 tataḥ sa caturo varṇānāśramāṃśca vyabhājayat| teṣu ye vedaniratāḥ svācārāḥ saṃyatendri yāḥ ||9 sūrayaścāvadātāśca brāhmaṇāste'bhavaṃstadā| yajanādhyayane dānaṃ yājanādhyāpanārthitāḥ ||10 dharmāsteṣāṃ vimucyāntyāṃstrīṃstulyāḥ kṣatravaiśyayoḥ| ye tu śūrā mahotsāhāḥ śaraṇyā rakṣaṇakṣamāḥ ||11 dṛḍhavyāyatadehāśca kṣatriyāsta ihābhavan| vikramo lokasaṃrakṣāvibhāgo vyavasāyitā ||12 eteṣāmayamapyukto dharmaḥ śubhaphalodayaḥ| nisargānnaipuṇaṃ yeṣāṃ ratirvittārjanaṃ prati ||13 śraddhādākṣyadayāvanto vaiśyāṃstānakarodasau| cikitsā kṛṣivāṇijye sthāpatyaṃ paśupoṣaṇam ||14 vaiśyasya kathito dharmastadvatkarma ca taijasam| nātimānabhṛto nātiśucayaḥ piśunāśca ye ||15 te śūdra jātayo jātā nātidharmaratāśca ye| kalārambhopajīvitvaṃ śilpitā paśupoṣaṇam ||16 varṇatritayaśuśrūṣā dharmasteṣāmudāhṛtaḥ| brahmacārī gṛhastho vā vānaprasthastathā yatiḥ ||17 ityāśramāḥ pṛthak tena catvāraḥ pravibhājitāḥ| guruśuśrūṣaṇaṃ bhaikṣaṃ vratacaryāgnikarma ca ||18 svādhyāyaścābhiṣekaśca dharmo'yaṃ brahmacāriṇaḥ| pūjāgnyatithidevānāṃ svavṛttyā jīvanaṃ damaḥ ||19 asamānarṣigotreṣu vivāha ṛtugāmitā| parasya strīṣu vaimukhyaṃ parānugrahaśīlatā ||20 vinivṛttirakāryebhyo dharmo'yaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ kṛtaḥ| devatātithisatkāro brahmacaryaṃ vane sthitiḥ ||21 valkājinajaṭācīradhāraṇaṃ śayanaṃ bhuvi| upoṣaṇairvratairdehakarśanaṃ niyamaistathā ||22 āhāro'kṛṣṭapacyaiśca dharmo'yaṃ vanavāsiṣu| vairāgyamindri yajayaścintātyāgaḥ praśāntatā ||23 ākiñcanyamanārambho yatidharmaḥ sadā smṛtaḥ| kṣamatvaṃ gurvadhīnatvaṃ śaucaṃ svādhyāyanityatā ||24 viśuddhirvyavahāreṣu śiṣyadharmo'yamīritaḥ| śucitvaṃ vāṅmanaḥkāyaiḥ patiśuśrūṣaṇaṃ kṣamā ||25 pūjanaṃ patipūjyānāṃ strīdharmaḥ śaucameva ca| evaṃ varṇāśramān samyak kṛtvā varṇāṃstadudbhān ||26 vibhajya teṣāṃ vainyena te te dharmāḥ prakīrtitāḥ| vṛttiṃ karmāṇi caiteṣāṃ pṛthaguddiśya so'bhyadhāt ||27 svadharmāvasthitānāṃ vo bhāvi lokadvaye sukham| ya etāṃ sthitimullaṅghya mohādanyadvidhāsyati ||28 tasyāhaṃ yamavatkruddhaḥ kariṣyāmyanuśāsanam| yuktānāṃ karmasu sveṣu vṛttyarthaṃ bhavatāmaham ||29 kheṭakagrāmaveśmāni vidhāsyāmi purāṇi ca| ityuktvā tānatho koṭyā kārmukasya pṛthurnṛpaḥ ||30 viṣamāṃ sādhayāmāsa pṛthivīṃ pṛthuvikramaḥ| tatsaṅkleśena gaurbhūtvā naśyantī tena medinī ||31 vidherniyogādduduhe sādhu sasyāni bhūtaye| kalpitāstena śailānāṃ saritāmantareṣu ca ||32 sameṣu cāvakāśeṣu purādīnāṃ vibhaktayaḥ| tena sīrāgrakṛṣṭeyaṃ dhānyairuptairyathāvidhi ||33 sasasyā kriyate kṣoṇī bhagavatyambudāgame| ityudbhavo nigaditaḥ prathamo nṛpasya| dharmeṇa sārdhamapi cāśramavarṇabhedāḥ| proktāḥ kṛṣivyatikaro'pi ca darśitaste| kārtsnyena vatsa śṛṇu deśavibhāgabhūmim ||34 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre varṇāśramapravibhāgo nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ| <8> atha bhūmiparīkṣā nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ| deśāśca deśabhūmyaśca samāsāttava samprati| tatsaṅkhyā tadvibhāgāśca procyante'vahitaḥ śṛṇu ||1 deśaḥ syājjāṅgalānūpasādhāraṇatayā tridhā| trividhasyāpyathaitasya yathāvallakṣma kathyate ||2 dūrāmbuririṇaprāyo hrasvakaṇṭakipādapaḥ| rūkṣoṣṇacaṇḍapavanaḥ kṛṣṇamṛtteṣu jāṅgalaḥ ||3 nimno bhūrijalaḥ snigdho bahumatsyāmiṣo himaḥ| syādanūpaḥ saritprāyaḥ snigdhocchritabahudrumaḥ ||4 yaḥ punarnātiśītoṣṇaḥ syāddeśadvayalakṣaṇaḥ| sa sādhāraṇa ityukto deśo deśaviśāradaiḥ ||5 jāṅgalādiṣu deśeṣu tripuṇyeṣu svalakṣaṇaiḥ| yuktāḥ ṣoḍaśa vijñeyā bhūmayaḥ pravibhāgataḥ ||6 bāliśasvāminī bhogyā sītā gocararakṣiṇī| apāśrayavatī kāntā khanimatyātmadhāriṇī ||7 vaṇikprasādhitā dra vyasampannāmitraghātinī| āśreṇīpuruṣā śakyasāmantā devamātṛkā ||8 dhānyā hastivanopetā surakṣā ceti ṣoḍaśa| bhuvaḥ saṃjñābhiruddiṣṭā lakṣmāsāmatha kathyate ||9 bhūbhujā bāliśenāpi śakyate yā praśāsitum| yā ca bhadra janā sā syādbāliśasvāminī kṣitiḥ ||10 vitarantyadhikaṃ yasyāṃ bhāgabhogādikān karān| narā bhūriśriyaḥ sātra bhogyeti kṣitirucyate ||11 yasyāṃ nadāśca nadyaśca girirmadhye'thavā bahiḥ| vibhaktakṣetrasīmā sā sītā gocararakṣiṇī ||12 saridadri vanādyeṣu trāsādyasyāṃ viśejjanaḥ| janāpāśrayayogyatvādapāśrayavatīti sā ||13 vanopavanavatyadri saritkuñjamanoharā| dehino ramayatyurvī yā sā kānteti kīrtitā ||14 yasyāṃ sadaiva jāyante kaladhautādidhātavaḥ| lavaṇāni ca bhūyāṃsi prāhuḥ khanimatīti tām ||15 yātyantaṃ nānugṛhyeta daṇḍakośāsanādibhiḥ| sphītalokāśrayā yā ca sā syādbhūrātmadhāriṇī ||16 prasidhyantyasakṛdyatra paṇyopakrayavikrayāḥ| vaṇikprasādhitetyuktā sā bhūrvaṇigalaṅkratā ||17 śākāśvakarṇakhadiraśrīparṇīsyandanāsanaiḥ| veṇuvetraśarādyaiśca yuktā dra vyavatīti bhūḥ ||18 yasyāṃ janapadāḥ sādhu vibhaktāstyaktavikramāḥ| yogaṃ yānti ca mitrāṇi syādbhūḥ sāmitraghātinī ||19 na kṣudrā vandino yasyāṃ durgapratyantasaṃśrayāḥ| bhūḥ sāśreṇīmanuṣyeti vinītairāśritā janaiḥ ||20 mantrotsāhādivaimukhyaṃ yasyāṃ sāmantabhūbhujaḥ| bhajante sā smṛtā śakyasāmantā bhūḥ samantataḥ ||21 jīvanti kṣetriṇo yasyāṃ nadī nadyādivāribhiḥ| tāṃ devamātṛketyāhuranapekṣitavāridām ||22 niṣpadyante'dhikaṃ yasyāṃ bījānyuptānyayatnataḥ| kṛṣṭānupahṛtakṣetrā dhānyā sā dhānyaśālinī ||23 paryanteṣvadra yo yasyāṃ yā ca hastivanāśritā| sā hastivanavatyurvī bhūbhṛtaḥ sainyavardhinī ||24 duṣpradhṛṣyaiva yā nityaṃ viṣamatvādarātibhiḥ| viṣamādri saridguptā sā surakṣeti bhūḥ smṛtā ||25 ṣoḍaśetyuditā bhūmyaḥ pravibhāgādyathātatham| anyā janapadādīnāṃ brūmaḥ sammiśralakṣaṇāḥ ||26 dhātusyandollasatkuñjagulmadrumalatāvṛtaiḥ| utsaṅgitāḥ pṛthuśilaiḥ samantādavanīdharaiḥ ||27 tīrthāvatārakāntābhiḥ svādutoyābhirāvṛtāḥ| nadībhiḥ pulinaprāntairvicitradrumaśālibhiḥ ||28 kokilālāpasubhagairmadhumattāliśālibhiḥ| vicitraphalapuṣpāḍhyaiḥ kānanairupaśobhitāḥ ||29 dalatkuvalayaśreṇīkvaṇanmadhupahāribhiḥ| sarasīdevakhātādyairbhūṣitāḥ prājyavāribhiḥ ||30 samaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ svāduśītaiḥ kāntairabhaṅguraiḥ| kṣetrairakṣatasīmāntaiḥ sasyaniṣpādibhirvṛtāḥ ||31 niṣkaṇṭakāśmavalmīkaiḥ prabhūtayavasendhanaiḥ| vibhaktakṣetrasīmāntairgocarairupaśobhitāḥ ||32 sthale tṛṇasamudrā ṇāmantareṣu vasundharāḥ| praśasyante samāsannasvāduśītalavārayaḥ ||33 durātmanāmadhṛṣyā yāstathānekāśrayānvitāḥ| saṃrambhatrāsanirmṛktaṃ manaśca ramayanti yāḥ ||34 tāsvevaṃguṇayuktāsu mahīṣu viniveśayet| yathāsthānaṃ janapadān kheṭagrāmapurādi ca ||35 yutā mahīdhramūlā svaprākāraistu pṛthakpṛthak| catasraḥ kīrtitā dhanyā bhūmayo durgahetavaḥ ||36 durārohatayā durge ṭaṅkacchinna ivāntataḥ| samapṛṣṭhe'mbuyuktādrau giridurgāvanirbhavet ||37 kaṇṭakidrumanīrandhranaddhe sāmbhasi kānane| gūḍhapraveśamārge bhūrmūladurgeti kīrtitā ||38 dvīpeṣu svādutoyeṣu bahvāgādhajalā bahiḥ| ramyāvakāśadeśā syājjaladurgā ca medinī ||39 snigdhāḥ sārabhṛtaḥ śuddhāḥ pradakṣiṇajalāśayāḥ| bahūdakāstarucchannā nibiḍāḥ prāgudakplavāḥ ||40 dūrvāsastvauṣadhīmuñjakurundakuśavalkalaiḥ| paritaḥ pariṇaddhāśca svādusvacchasthirodakāḥ ||41 vāstuyajñāmarasthānādyārāmodyānasaṃbhṛtāḥ| taṭākavāpīsthānaiśca yāḥ samantādalaṅkṛtāḥ ||42 yā vāhanānāṃ sukhadā mithunānāṃ ratipradāḥ| purārthaṃ tāḥ praśasyante bhūmayo janitaśriyaḥ ||43 kuṅkumāgurukarpūraspṛkkailācandanādibhiḥ| sugandhā miśritairebhiḥ pṛthaksthairvā vasundharā ||44 kalhārapāṭalāmbhojamālatīcampakotpalaiḥ| sthalāmbuprabhavaiścānyaiḥ sugandhā kusumaistathā ||45 gomūtragomayakṣīradadhimadhvājyagandhabhāk| samānagandhā madirāmādhvīkebhamadāsavaiḥ ||46 śālipiṣṭakagandhaiśca dhānyagandhaiśca yā tathā| praśastākhilavarṇānāmīdṛggandhā vasundharā ||47 sitā raktā ca pītā ca kṛṣṇā caiva kramānmahī| viprādīnāṃ hi varṇānāṃ saraveṣāmathavā hitā ||48 svāduḥ kaṣāyā tiktā ca kaṭukā cetyanukramāt| varṇānāṃ svādataḥ śastā sarveṣāṃ madhurāthavā ||49 gharmāgame himasparśā yā syāduṣṇā himāgame| prāvṛṣyuṣṇahimasparśā sā praśastā vasundharā ||50 mṛdaṅgavallakīveṇudundubhīnāṃ samā dhvanau| dvipāśvābdhisamasvānā ceti syurbhūmayaḥ śubhāḥ ||51 idānīmapraśastānāṃ bhuvāṃ lakṣmābhidadhmahe| purādisanniveśārthaṃ parityājyā bhavanti yāḥ ||52 bhasmāṅgārakapālāsthituṣakeśaviṣāśmabhiḥ| mūṣakotkaravalmīkaśarkarābhiśca nirbharā ||53 rūkṣā prarohiṇī nimnā bhaṅgurā suṣiroṣarā| vāmāvartajalāsrāviṇyasārā viṣamonnatā ||54 kaṭukaṇṭakiniḥsāraśuṣkaniṣphalapādapā| kravyātpakṣisamākīrṇā kṛmikīṭavatī ca yā ||55 sukṛtānyapi bhojyānnabhakṣyapānāni tatkṣaṇāt| yasyāṃ vināśamāyānti saha tūryādinisvanaiḥ ||56 sarit pūrvavahā yasyāṃ purārthaṃ tāmapi tyajet| bahunāpi yatastatra kālenāyāti sā punaḥ ||57 vasāsṛṅmajjaviṇmūtramalakothapatatriṇām| samagandhāṃ tyajedurvīṃ tailasya ca śavasya ca ||58 sadaiva dhūmravarṇā yā miśravarṇāthavā mahī| vivarṇā rūkṣavarṇā vā sā na syādiṣṭadāyinī ||59 tiktāmlalavaṇā cāpi bhūmiryā svādato bhavet| tāṃ lokavidveṣakarīṃ tyajet puraniveśane ||60 yā rūkṣakharasaṃsparśā sadaivoṣṇā himāthavā| aniṣṭasukhasaṃsparśā yā syāttāmapi santyajet ||61 kroṣṭūṣṭraśvakharasvānā yā ca nirjharanisvanā| bhinnabhāṇḍasamakrūradhvanitāpi ca neṣyate ||62 iti gandhādibhirbhūmiḥ kathiteyaṃ śubhāśubhā| halena kṛṣyamāṇāyāṃ bhūmau kāṣṭhe samuddhṛte ||63 vidyādbhayaṃ vahnibhavamiṣṭakāyāṃ dhanāgamam| pāṣāṇeṣu tu kalyāṇaṃ kulapradhvaṃsamasthiṣu ||64 sarīsṛpeṣu sarveṣu stenebhyo bhayamādiśet| anūṣarā bahutṛṇā śastā snigdhottaraplavā ||65 prāgīśānaplavā sarvaplavā vā darpaṇodarā| śubhe'hnyupoṣitaḥ snātaḥ śuciḥ śuklasragambaraḥ ||66 svasti viprān vācayitvā vāstudevān samarcya ca| karapramāṇaṃ kurvīta khātaṃ tadbhūmimadhyagam ||67 tatastanmṛdamākṛṣya tat tayaivānupūrayet| khātādhikamṛduktā bhūḥ śreṣṭhā madhyā ca tatsamā ||68 prahīṇakhātamṛt kṣoṇī hīnā śastā na sā nṛṇām| khanyamāne yadā khāte tanmṛdo'ntarvilokyate ||69 maṇiśaṅkhapravālādi tadātiśreyasī kṣitiḥ| sāpi praśasyate bhūmiryasyāṃ syuḥ khātapāṃsavaḥ ||70 tuṣakeśopalāṅgārabhasmāsthilavavarjitāḥ| bhṛtvādbhiḥ khātamāpūrṇe tasmin padaśataṃ vrajet ||71 tāvaccedāgame'mbhaḥ syāttadā bhūḥ sārvakāmikī| madhyamātraprahīṇe syāt tato hīnatare'dhamā ||72 khāte sitādimālyāni yasyāṃ niśyuṣitāni ca| yadvarṇāni na śuṣyanti sā tadvarṇeṣṭadā mahī ||73 khātasyodakprabhṛtiṣu dikṣu prajvālayīta vā| dīpān yasyāṃ ciraṃ tiṣṭhet tadvarṇeṣṭapradā hi sā ||74 ityevaṃ kīrttitāḥ kārtsnyāllakṣmabhiḥ purabhūmayaḥ| kharvaṭagrāmakheṭānāmetā eva smṛtā hitāḥ ||75 varṇināṃ varṇadhāmnāṃ ca śibirāṇāṃ ca sarvadā| prāsādayajñavāṭānāmetā eveṣṭadā bhuvaḥ ||76 ityevamādibhirimāḥ śubhalakṣmayuktā| bhūmyaḥ śubhā nigaditā nagarādihetoḥ| ābhyaḥ pareṇa bahudhā parikalpyamānaṃ| brūmastridhā sthitavato'pi karasya mānam ||77 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre bhūmiparīkṣā nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ| <9> atha hastalakṣaṇaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ| hetuḥ samastavāstūnāmādhāraḥ sarvakarmaṇām| mānonmānavibhāgādinirṇayaikanibandhanam ||1 paridhyudayavistāradairghyāṇāṃ syuramī yataḥ| jyeṣṭhamadhyādhamā bhedā yaṃ ca jñātvā na muhyati ||2 idānīṃ tasya hastasya samyaṅ niścayasaṃyutam| kathyate trividhasyāpi lakṣaṇaṃ śāstradarśitam ||3 reṇvaṣṭakena vālāgraṃ likṣā syādaṣṭabhistu taiḥ| bhaved yūkāṣṭabhistābhiryavamadhyaṃ tadaṣṭakāt ||4 aṣṭābhiḥ saptabhiḥ ṣaḍbhiraṅgulāni yavodaraiḥ| jyeṣṭhamadhyakaniṣṭhāni taccaturviṃśatiḥ karaḥ ||5 so'ṣṭabhiḥ parvabhiryuktaḥ karaḥ kāryo vijānatā| karasyārdhaṃ catuḥparva śeṣaṃ syādbhaktamaṅgulaiḥ ||6 tatrāgre parvarekhāḥ syustisraḥ puṣpakabhūṣitāḥ| śeṣāsvaṅgularekhāsu puṣpāṇi vidadhīta na ||7 atrārdhe madhyataḥ kāryaṃ dvedhā pañcamamaṅgulam| madhyaṃ tridhāṣṭamaṃ kāryaṃ caturdhā dvādaśaṃ tataḥ ||8 hastaḥ svāṅgulamānena vidheyāṅgulamiṣyate| tatsādhaṃ dviguṇaṃ vāpi bāhulyaṃ tu tadardhataḥ ||9 kathitaḥ karabhedo'yamaṅgulānāṃ vibhedataḥ| tasya nirmāṇadārūṇi devatāśca pracakṣmahe ||10 khadirāñjanavaṃśādi ślakṣṇaṃ hīraṃ manoramam| sāravacca bhavediṣṭaṃ dāru hastaprakalpane ||11 granthilaṃ laghu nirdagdhaṃ jīrṇaṃ visphuṭitaṃ tathā| adṛḍhaṃ koṭarākrāntaṃ dāru hastāya neṣyate ||12 trividhasyāpyathaitasya parvarekhāsu devatāḥ| madhyādārabhya vijñeyāḥ krameṇa nava vacmi tāḥ ||13 brahmā vahniryamo viśvakarmā nāthaśca pāthasām| vāyurdhanādhipo rudro viṣṇuścāgre jagatpatiḥ ||14 vāstudra vyavibhāgeṣu yāneṣu ca viśeṣataḥ| prārabheta yato mānaṃ kalpayeddevatāstataḥ ||15 viddhaiśca dra vyamadhyaiśca devatābhiśca pīḍite| pratyekaṃ tridaśasthāne yathoktaṃ phalamādiśet ||16 śirorttiranalaploṣo maraṇaṃ sthapatervadhaḥ| atisāro marudvyādhirarthabhraṃśo bhayaṃ nṛpāt ||17 kulapīḍā ca mahatī kartṛkārakayoriti| yathākramamamī doṣā brahmādīnāṃ nipīḍanāt ||18 brahmānalakayormadhye yadā hastaṃ tu dhārayet| karmasvadhigatasteṣāṃ putralābho bhaviṣyati ||19 karmaṇaḥ suṣṭhuniṣpattistiṣṭatebhogamakṣayam| brahmā yamastayormadhye yadā hastaṃ tu dhārayet ||20 kartā saśilpikaścaiva nacireṇa vinaśyati| viśvānalakayormadhye hastasūtraṃ yadā dhṛtam ||21 sukarmaṇi madhyāntaṃ niṣpanne puravṛddhitā| yamajaladayormadhye madhyamaṃ ca vinirdiśet ||22 pavano viśvakarmā cobhayormadhye ca dhāraṇam| yadā tu tatra karmāntaṃ śubhaṃ tatsarvakāmadam ||23 nīradhanadayormadhye madhyamaṃ ca vinirdiśet| eṣāṃ madhye yadā vatsahastaṃ tatra yadā dhṛtam ||24 anāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ loke deśabhaṅgo na saṃśayaḥ| rudra pavanayormadhye rucihastaṃ tu dhārayet ||25 tatra lakṣmīvatastasya kāryasiddhirna saṃśayaḥ| viṣṇudhanadayormadhye yadā pāṇikarāyataḥ ||26 vividhāstatra bhogāśca prajāyante narasya hi| jyeṣṭhādīnāmathaiteṣāṃ saṃjñābhedo vidhīyate ||27 yacca yena bhaveddravyaṃ meyaṃ tadapi kīrtyate| yavāṣṭakāṅgulaiḥ kḷptaḥ prakarṣeṇāyataḥ kila ||28 jyeṣṭho hastaḥ sa vidvadbhiḥ proktaḥ prāśayasaṃjñitaḥ| yaḥ punaḥ kalpitaḥ saptayavakḷptairihāṅgulaiḥ ||29 tajjñaiḥ sa madhyamo hastaḥ sādhāraṇa iti smṛtaḥ| mātretyalpaṃ yataḥ proktaṃ hastaśca śaya ucyate ||30 tena mātrāśayaḥ sa syāddhasto yaḥ ṣaḍyavāṅgulaḥ| vibhāgāyāmavistārāḥ kheṭagrāmapurādiṣu ||31 prāsādaveśmaparikhādvārarathyāsabhādiṣu| mārgāśca nirgamāścaiṣāṃ sīmakṣetrāntarāṇi ca ||32 vanopavanabhāgāśca deśāntaravibhaktayaḥ| yojanakrośagavyūtipramāṇamapi cādhvanaḥ ||33 prāśayena pramātavyāḥ khātakrakacarāśayaḥ| talocchrayān mūlapādān jaloddeśānadhaḥ kṣiteḥ ||34 tathā dolāmbuśastrādi pātamānavinirṇayam| śailakhātaniketāni suruṅgāmānamāntaram ||35 sādhāraṇena vāṭyadhvamānaṃ ca parikalpayet| āyudhāni dhanurdaṇḍān yānaṃ śayanamāsanam ||36 pramāṇaṃ kūpavāpīnāṃ gajānāṃ vājināṃ nṛṇām| araghaṭṭekṣuyantrāṇi yugayūpahalāni ca ||37 śilpyupaskaranauchatradhvajātodyāni yāni ca| vṛsīdharmopakaraṇapaṭavānādikaṃ ca yat ||38 nalvadaṇḍāṃstathā mātrāśayahastena māpayet| bhedatrayānvitamapi proktaṃ hastasya lakṣaṇam ||39 saṃjñābhedo'tha sāmānyamānānāṃ pratipādyate| syādekamaṅgulaṃ mātrā kalā proktāṅguladvayam ||40 parva trīṇyaṅgulānyāhurmuṣṭiḥ syāccaturaṅgulā| talaṃ syātpañcabhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ karapādāṅgulairbhavet ||41 saptabhirdiṣṭiraṣṭābhiraṅgulaistūṇiriṣyate| prādeśo navabhistaiḥ syācchyatālo daśāṅgulaḥ ||42 gokarṇa ekādaśabhirvitastirdvādaśāṅgulā| caturdaśabhiruddiṣṭaḥ pādo nāma tathāṅgulaiḥ ||43 ratniḥ syādekaviṃśatyā syādaratniḥ karonmitaḥ| dvācatvāriṃśatā kiṣkuraṅgulaiḥ parikīrttitaḥ ||44 caturuttarayāśītyā vyāmaḥ syātpuruṣastathā| ṣaṇṇavatyāṅgulaiścāpaṃ bhavennāḍīyugaṃ tathā ||45 śataṃ ṣaḍuttaraṃ daṇḍo nalvastriṃśaddhanurmitaḥ| krośo dhanuḥsahasraṃ tu gavyūtaṃ taddvayaṃ viduḥ ||46 caturgavyūtamicchanti yojanaṃ mānavedinaḥ| ekaṃ daśa śatamasmātsahasramanu cāyutam ||47 niyutaṃ prayutaṃ tasmādarbudanyarbude api| vṛndakharvanikharvāṇi śaṅkupadmāmvurāśayaḥ ||48 tataḥ syānmadhyamantyaṃ ca paraṃ cāparamapyataḥ| parārdhaṃ ceti vijñeyaṃ daśavṛddhyottarottaram ||49 saṅkhyāsthānāni kathitānyevametāni viṃśatiḥ| idānīṃ kālasaṅkhyāyāḥ pramāṇamabhidhīyate ||50 dṛṅnimeṣo nimeṣaḥ syāt taiḥ pañcadaśabhiḥ smṛtā| kāṣṭhā tābhiḥ kalā tābhirmuhūrttastairaharniśam ||51 triṃśataitat trikaṃ vidyātkramādityuttarottaram| ahorātraiḥ punaḥ pañcadaśabhiḥ pakṣa ucyate ||52 pakṣadvayena māsaḥ syādbhavenmāsadvayādṛtuḥ| ṛtutrayaṃ syādayanaṃ vatsarastvayanadvayam ||53 daśadhāyamiti proktaḥ kālaḥ kālavidāṃ varaiḥ| ityuktametadakhilaṃ karamānamatra samyaktayā nigaditāpi ca kālasaṅkhyā| antaḥpuraṃ janapadāmaradhāmamārgairācakṣmahe nagarasaṃpravibhāgamatra ||54 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre hastalakṣaṇaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ| <10> atha puraniveśo daśamo'dhyāyaḥ| purasya trividhasyāpi pramāṇamatha kathyate| prākāraparikhāṭṭāladvārarathyādhvabhiḥ saha ||1 jyeṣṭhaṃ tatra catuścāpasahasraṃ puramiṣyate| madhyaṃ dvābhyāṃ sahasrābhyāmekena vyāsato'dhamam ||2 sāṣṭamāṃśaṃ sapādaṃ vā sārdhaṃ vā vyāsamāyatam| kuryādekaikamāyāmaṃ caturāsrīkṛtaṃ śubham ||3 catuḥṣaṣṭipadākhyena puraṃ sarvaṃ prakalpayet| dviraṣṭakoṣṭhaṃ tatkuryātṣaṭpathaṃ navacatvaram ||4 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre prāgudīcyantamāgatāḥ| caturbhāgāntarā vaṃśāḥ kāryāstasya trayastrayaḥ ||5 vaṃśaṣaṭkavibhakte'smin padaṣoḍaśakānvite| rājamārgaḥ śubhaḥ kāryo madhyamaṃ vaṃśamāśritaḥ ||6 kāryo jyāyasi ca jyāyāṃścaturviṃśatikaḥ karaiḥ| viṃśatyā madhyame madhyo'dhame ṣoḍaśako'dhamaḥ ||7 balasya caturaṅgasya paurāṇāṃ pārthivasya ca| asambādhasamaścaiṣa kāryo'yaṃ kāśmaśarkaraḥ ||8 mahārathyādvayaṃ kāryaṃ tadupāntasthavaṃśayoḥ| taddvādaśa daśāṣṭau syātkarān jyeṣṭhādikaṃ triṣu ||9 padamadhyagataṃ kāryaṃ yānamārgacatuṣṭayam| jyeṣṭhādiṣu pureṣveṣu tatpadyaṃ ca catuḥkaram ||10 uparathyā mahāmārgasyārdhaṃ vā dviśayādhikam| śeṣā rathyāstadardhena vidhātavyāḥ pramānataḥ ||11 yānamārgacatuṣkasya kāryau pārśvadvayāśritau| padāṣṭakapadāntasthau dvau dvau jaṅghāpathāvapi ||12 pure jyeṣṭhe trihastau tau madhyame'rdhakarojjhitau| madhyamādardhahastena hīnau syātāṃ kanīyasi ||13 purasyāntargatau kāryau ghaṇṭāmārgau tathāparau| rājamārgaguṇopetau pramāṇena ca tadvidhau ||14 prākpratyagāyatāḥ saptadaśa mārgā itīritāḥ| yāmyottarāyatāstadvadanye syustatpramāṇataḥ ||15 ghaṇṭāmārgapramāṇena ghaṇṭāmārgasya bāhyataḥ| samantato vaprabhuvaṃ sthāpayet tadvidhānavit ||16 mahārathyāpramāṇena tadbhūmerbāhyatastataḥ| vyāsakhātāntaraiḥ sārdhaṃ vidheyaṃ parikhātrayam ||17 khātotpādojjhitaṃ kāryaṃ satryaṃśenārdhato'pi vā| vyāsataḥ syādaśeṣeṇa mūlatastadvadeva tat ||18 kuryādvapraṃ svabhūbhāge parikhotkhātayā mṛdā| sotsaṅgaṃ gajapṛṣṭhaṃ vā gotrīyapadatāḍitam ||19 khātodvṛttamṛdā vapranirmāṇādhikayā tataḥ| bhūpradeśānpurā nimnānāpūrya samatāṃ nayet ||20 evaṃ saṃśodhya parikhātritayaṃ parito'śmabhiḥ| vidheyamiṣṭakābhirvā samyagbaddhatalam sthiram ||21 sirāvāribhirāpūrṇaṃ pūrṇaṃ vāgāgināmbhasā| vicitrābjamanohāri sasaṃgrāhāmbunirgamam ||22 sarvapāśveṣvathaitasya gandhāndhamadhupāṅganān| sumanoviṭapārāmān kuryād vāsān samutsakān ||23 bāhyabhāgaṃ punastasya vidadhyātsarvatodiśam| drumamūlairlatājālaiḥ kaṇṭakairapi saṃvṛtam ||24 vaprordhvabhāgagaṃ madhyaṃ sthūlopalaśilācitam| kuryātprākāramuddāmaṃ yadvā pakveṣṭakāmayam ||25 jyāyānkarairdvādaśabhirdaśabhirmadhyamaḥ sthitaḥ| kanīyānaṣṭabhirhastairvistāraḥ syāt tridhetyasau ||26 ucchrāyaḥ saptadaśabhiḥ karairjyāyān praśasyate| madhyamaḥ pañcadaśabhistrayodaśabhirantimaḥ ||27 ūrdhvaṃ na saptadaśakānna trayodaśakādadhaḥ| prākārocchrayamicchanti nāpi yugmakaronmitam ||28 haste haste'ṅguladvandvamāyataḥ samyagucchrayāt| yasya vā dvādaśakarā mūle bhavati vistṛtiḥ ||29 caturasro cchritistasya śiraḥ syāddaśavistṛtam| hastoccaṃ kapiśīrṣaṃ syāddvihastā kāṇḍavāriṇī ||30 kāryāḥ karṇāśritairdvārakarṇāntasthaiśca saṃyutāḥ| prākāre'ṭṭālakāstasmin dikṣu dikṣu caturdiśam ||31 dvibhaumāṃścarikordhvaṃ ca prākārocchrāyavistṛtān| tadardhaṃ nirgamān kuryātsasālāṭṭālakānatha ||32 śataṃ śataṃ syāddhastānāṃ mithaścāṭṭālakāntaram| itthaṃ puramagamyaṃ syātpattyaśvarathadantinām ||33 carikāṃ saṃcaradvārāṃ sukhārohāṃ savedikām| sasopānāṃ saniryūhāṃ kuryātsakapiśīrṣakām ||34 rājamārgamahārathyāsaṃśritāni caturdiśam| trīṇi trīṇi vidheyāni pure dvārāṇi tadvidā ||35 rājamārgamahādvāracatuṣkaṃ vistarānnava| aṣṭau sapta karā norvyā dviguṇaṃ trikarojjhitam ||36 mahārathyāśrayaṃ dvāraṃ tatṣaṭpañcacatuṣkaram| ucchrayātsārdhasārdhaikahastonaṃ vistareṇa tat ||37 kuryātpratolīḥ sarveṣu mahādvāreṣvatho dṛḍhāḥ| dṛḍhārgalāścendra kīlāḥ kapāṭaparighānvitāḥ ||38 rājamārgasamā śālā syātpratolīvinirgamā| tadardhaṃ koṣṭhakāntaḥ syādvyāso'dhardhaṃ tayoḥ smṛtaḥ ||39 caturaśrāmiti nyasya pratolīṃ vadanāyatām| vyāsatastryaṃśavinyastamārgāṃ mūṣādvayānvitām ||40 antarbhittau caturdvāraṃ mahādvāreṇa sammitam| vikalpakoṣṭhakānteṣu dārubhistadvibhūṣayet ||41 dvāre cobhayataḥśāle dve dve dvāre ca mūṣayoḥ| te kārye sammukhe vyāsāddvikare dviguṇocchrite ||42 taddārumūṣayoḥ paṭṭamadhyaṃ pañcakarocchritam| tadvatkāryā dvitīyā bhūrdvāraśeṣodayocchritā ||43 bahirdvāravinirmuktāṃ pūrvavattāṃ prakalpayet| puraḥsaṃrodhanasahairgavākṣairagrato yutām ||44 talaṃ tato mahādvārasyordhve baddhvā tṛtīyakam| rodhanadvārayugharmyasaṃyuktaṃ saparikramam ||45 sannyastastambhavedyanyadūrdhvaṃ tasyopakalpayet| vyālajālaśataghnyastraśastrayastrādibhiryutam ||46 vṛddhiśobhābhiguptyarthaṃ purasya pravikalpayet| bṛhaddvārāṇi paritastritalābhiḥ pratolibhiḥ ||47 pratolyā dakṣiṇādbhāgāducchrito vāmato gataḥ| yāvaddvitīyaṃ tatpārśvamekaḥ kāryo bahiḥ sthitaḥ ||48 dvitīyo vāmabhāgāttu nirgatyāsyaiva veṣṭakaḥ| kāryaḥ syādā tadutthānātprākārastasya bāhyataḥ ||49 etayorantarālaṃ ca rājamārgeṇa sammitam| kartavyaṃ syādihaivaṃ tu vaktradvārakamuttamam ||50 dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvopabhogārhānsaridgirijalāśayān| pakṣadvārāṇi kurvīta svecchayā tatra tatra ca ||51 jalabhramānpure kuryācchilādārutirohitān| dvikarānkaramātrānvā sāmbhaso'smin pradakṣiṇān ||52 chinnakarṇaṃ vikarṇaṃ ca vajraṃ sūcīmukhaṃ tathā| vartula vyajanākāraṃ cāpākṛtidharaṃ ca yat ||53 śakaṭadvisamaṃ yacca vistārāddviguṇāyatam| vidiksthaṃ sarpacakraṃ ca tat puraṃ ninditaṃ bhavet ||54 chinnakarṇe vasaṃllokaḥ pure taskarato bhayam| vyādhibhyo vāparebhyo vā prāpnotīti vinirdiśet ||55 vidviṣṭasvāmitā sarvalokagarhānapatyatā| jāyate svalpamāyuṣyaṃ vikarṇapuravāsinām ||56 strījayaṃ viṣarogāṃśca bhedāṃśca vividhāṃstathā| jano vasannavāpnoti vajrākṛtidhare pure ||57 vrajanti prāṇino nāśaṃ kṣudvyādhiparipīḍitāḥ| nivasantaḥ sadā sūcīmukhākāradhare pure ||58 svāminā saha hīyante sarvataḥ sañcayojjhitāḥ| svalpāyuṣaśca jāyante janā vṛttapurāśrayāḥ ||59 asatyavādinaḥ svalpāyuṣaḥ pavanapīḍitāḥ| janāḥ syuścalacittāśca nagare vyajanākṛtau ||60 duścaritrāṅganāyuktastathā bahunapuṃsakaḥ| cāpākāre pure loko nivasan bhavati dhruvam ||61 rogaśokānalastenabhayaṃ tatra prajāyate| śakaṭadvisamākāraṃ puraṃ yadviniveśyate ||62 ārambhāsiddhidaṃ viprabhayadaṃ jñātibhedakṛt| paurāṇāṃ svāminaśca syādgajavājikṣayāvaham ||63 parairākramya bhujyeta tatpuraṃ balaśālibhiḥ| dviguṇāyatasaṃsthānaṃ yatkvacidviniveśyate ||64 janakṣayo'gnidāhaśca strīkṛtāni bhayāni ca| pure bhavati diṅmūḍhe na ca niryogameti tat ||65 śastrānilapiśācāgnibhūtayakṣabhayārditāḥ| rukpīḍitāśca naśyanti bhujaṅgakuṭile janāḥ ||66 purāṇāmapraśastāni saṃsthānānīdṛśāni yat| ekasminnapi tenaiṣāṃ na puraṃ viniveśayet ||67 saṃsthānamekamapyeṣāṃ pramādātkriyate yadi| tadā rāṣṭraṃ nipīḍyeta kṣuddviṣadbhītimṛtyubhiḥ ||68 śāstrajñaḥ sthapatistasmātprayatnaparayā dhiyā| yathāvatkathitaṃ cāru nagaraṃ viniveśayet ||69 vedīniveśayātrāyāṃ devāgārābhicārayoḥ| nadīkarmaṇi maitre ca śāntiṃ kuryācchrameṣu ca ||70 yajñe puraniveśe ca sthāpane prayataḥ sudhīḥ| kuryāttathābhyudayikaṃ yadvānyadapi kiñcana ||71 pure bhītikaraṃ śaśvadanāyuṣyamapauṣṭikam| kṛtamaprayataiḥ karma nṛpatighnaṃ ca jāyate ||72 vihitaṃ yadaśāstrajñairyacca nirlakṣaṇaiḥ kṛtam| kṛtamaprayatairyacca tadaśastaṃ phalojjhitam ||73 śāstrajñaḥ sthapatirjyotirvidā tadvatpurodhasā| adhiṣṭhitaḥ pure karma vidadhyācchāntikeṣu ca ||74 purohito'gniṃ juhuyāddadyānmauhūrttikaḥ sthiram| sthapatiśca baliṃ dadyādyojayediti śāntikam ||75 tadā tasmin pure śāntiryatra marmasthitāḥ surāḥ| pūjyante satataṃ pauraiścatvarasthāyinastathā ||76 catuḥprakāraṃ sthāpatyamaṣṭadhā ca cikitsitam| dhanurvedaśca saptāṅgo jyotiṣaṃ kamalālayāt ||77 sāmānyalakṣaṇotpātanimittāni ca sarvaśaḥ| brahmā viṣṇuśca rudra śca tyajantyete na tat puram ||78 nagarasya vibhāgo'yaṃ yathāvatsamudīritaḥ| kheṭaṃ tadardhaviṣkambhamāhurgrāmaṃ tadardhataḥ ||79 yojanena purātkheṭaṃ kheṭādgrāmaṃ pracakṣate| gavyūtiparimāṇena grāmādgrāmaṃ pracakṣate ||80 dvikrośādviṣaye sīmā tadardhena purasya sā| kheṭake purasīmādhaṃ grāme kheṭārdhataḥ smṛtā ||81 triṃśadghanūṃṣi viṣkambhaḥ pure digvartmasu smṛtaḥ| viṃśatiḥ kheṭake mārgo grāme daśa ca darśitaḥ ||82 nava grāmasahasrāṇi navatiśca pracakṣate| catuḥṣaṣṭimapi grāmān jyāyo rāṣṭraṃ vidurbudhāḥ ||83 daśārdhaṃ ca sahasrāṇi grāmāṇāṃ triśatī tathā| grāmāścaturaśītiśca madhyamaṃ rāṣṭramīritam ||84 sahasramekaṃ grāmāṇāṃ tadvacca śatapañcakam| dvyūnā ca grāmapañcāśat kanīyo rāṣṭramucyate ||85 adhyardhasaṅkhyayaiteṣāṃ jyeṣṭhamadhyakanīyasām| vidhāya navadhaikaikaṃ vibhajedvidhivatsudhīḥ ||86 rāṣṭreṣvevaṃ vibhakteṣu yathābhāgaṃ vidhānavit| niveśayetpurāṇyeṣu sapta sapta yathāgamam ||87 vibhāgaśca pramāṇaṃ ca lakṣaṇaṃ cādimasya yat| jātivarṇādhivāsaśca yathāvattadihocyate ||88 suvarṇakārānāgneyyāṃ tathā vahnyupajīvinaḥ| niveśayet karmakarānanyānapi vidhānavit ||89 vaiśyānāmakṣadhūrtānāṃ cakrikāṇāṃ ca dakṣiṇe| naṭānāṃ narttakānāṃ ca gṛhāṇi viniveśayet ||90 niveśayet saukarikān meyīkārān mṛgacchidaḥ| kaivartān nairṛtāśāyāṃ damanādhikṛtāṃstathā ||91 ratheṣu kauśalaṃ yeṣāṃ yeṣāṃ syādāyudheṣu ca| vāruṇyāṃ diśi tān sarvān purasya viniveśayet ||92 karmasvadhikṛtā ye ca ye cāpi parikarmiṇaḥ| śauṇḍikā ye ca tān sarvān vāyordiśi niveśayet ||93 yatīnāmāśrayān brahmavatsānāṃ ca tathā sabhām| prapāśca puṇyaśālāśca kuryāddiśi dhaneśituḥ ||94 ghṛtavikrayiṇo ye ca phalavikrayiṇaśca ye| niveśitāḥ praśasyante purasyeśānadiggatāḥ ||95 pūrvabhāge balādhyakṣān rājño mukhyāṃstathā bale| niveśayettathāgneyyāṃ balaṃ nānāvidhaṃ sudhīḥ ||96 śreṣṭhino dakṣiṇāśāyāṃ tathā deśamahattarān| yāmyekahārān kurvīta tathā kakubhi nirṛteḥ ||97 kośapālamahāmātrādeśikān kārukānapi| niryāmakāṃśca kurvīta salilādhipaterdiśi ||98 vāyoḥ kakubhi kurvīta daṇḍanāthān sanāyakān| purohitajyotiṣikānuttarasyāṃ niveśayet ||99 viprāḥ saumya diśo bhāge kṣatriyāḥ śakradiggatāḥ| vaiśyaśūdrā stu kartavyā dakṣiṇāparayoḥ kramāt ||100 nigheyā vaṇijo vaidyā mukhyāścāpi caturdiśam| caturdiśaṃ viśeṣeṇa sthāpayīta balāni ca ||101 nagarasya bahiḥ prācyāṃ liṅgasthān viniveśayet| śmaśānāni tathā tatsthān yāmyāyāṃ sthapatiḥ sudhīḥ ||102 sarvatodiśamuddiṣṭo vibhāgo nagare yathā| tathā grāmeṣu kheṭeṣu senāyāśca niveśane ||103 nagarābhimukhau kāryau saṃpūrṇāṅgamahodayau| dvāre dvāre saumyamukhau lakṣmīvaiśravaṇau śubhau ||104 rāṣṭraṃ kheṭamatha grāmaṃ paśyantetapuraṃ mahat| tatrārogyārthasaṃsiddhī prajāvijayamādiśet ||105 kleśabandhavadhairlokāḥ syurmithaḥ sūtrahiṃsakāḥ| grāmaṃ kheṭaṃ puraṃ rāṣṭraṃ yadetau naiva paśyataḥ ||106 sthāpyante ye yathā devā nagare sarvatodiśam| bāhyāntarāsu bhūmīṣu brūmahe tānataḥparam ||107 caturdiśaṃ samārabhya prākāraparikhāntataḥ| bahiḥ śate śate sārdhe dhanuṣāṃ dviśate'pi ca ||108 dhanuḥśatamitaiḥ śuddhairanindyairdharaṇītalaiḥ| svasvaprāsādayuktāni svasvānugagṛhaiḥ saha ||109 niveśanāni kurvīta tridaśānāṃ yathākramam| nagarābhimukhaṃ citravanabhāñji śubhāni ca ||110 yāmyottarāyataṃ vaṃśaṃ vikalpapuramadhyagam| bahirantaśca kurvīta devānāṃ viniveśanam ||111 prācyāṃ pratyaṅmukhānkuryātprāṅmukhāṃścāmbubhṛddiśi| yāmyodakapārśvayostasya prādakṣiṇyena vaṃśagān ||112 dakṣiṇasyāṃ na kurvīta tridaśānapyudaṅmukhān| caityaśānitsabhāyakṣamātṛprathamayānvitāḥ ||113 ityamī kathitāḥ samyagye yathādiṅmukhāḥ surāḥ| dikṣu dikṣu bahirye syustānidānīṃ pracakṣmahe ||114 viṣṇordinādhināthasya sahasranayanasya ca| dharmasya ca vidhātavyaṃ diśi prācyāṃ niketanam ||115 sanatkumārasāvitryormarutāṃ mārutasya ca| pūrvadakṣiṇadigbhāge vidadhīta niketanam ||116 gaṇeśamātṛbhūtānāṃ yāmye pretapatergṛham| bhadra kālyāḥ pitṝṇāṃ syādveśma caityaṃ ca nairṛte ||117 sāgarasya nadīnāṃ ca śilpibhartuḥ prajāpateḥ| nilayaṃ paścimāśāyāṃ vidadhyādvaruṇasya ca ||118 phaṇināṃ bhavanaṃ kāryamaparottaradiggatam| śanaiścarasya cātraiva kātyāyanyāśca mandiram ||119 viśākhaskandasomānāṃ tathā yakṣādhipasya ca| pṛthakpṛthagvidhātavyāḥ prāsādāḥ saumyadiggatāḥ ||120 jagadgurormaheśasya śriyo vahneśca mandiram| pūrvottarasyāṃ kakubhi pravidheyaṃ manoramam ||121 nadīnāmambudhīnāṃ ca samantānnagarasya ca| kāntāreṣvadri ṣu sthānaṃ sarvatreṣṭamumāpateḥ ||122 niveśyante svadigbhāgeṣvevaṃ yasmin surottamāḥ| samyaksamṛddhimāsādya ciraṃ nandati tatpuram ||123 nagarasya vidūre'pi kakupsu nikhilākhapi| bāhyato'bhimukhā devāḥ śasyante na parāṅmukhāḥ ||124 kriyate yadi bhūbhāge vaṃśena sa parāṅmukhaḥ| vidhimenaṃ tadā tasmiṃstajjñaḥ śāstroktamācaret ||125 tadveṣavarṇabhūṣāstravāhanairanvitaṃ suram| tadbhittau prakaṭākāraṃ nagarābhimukhaṃ likhet ||126 vaikaṅkataśamībilvaiḥ kṣīrakaṇṭakibhirdrumaiḥ| udapānāgnyagāreṣu syānna doṣo'ntarasthitaiḥ ||127 arcāśriteṣvayaṃ prokto vidhirnālegvyavartiṣu| kartavyāḥ sarvatovaktrāstasmāccitragatāḥ surāḥ ||128 vidhānaṃ yadyathā proktaṃ suradhāmnāṃ purādbahiḥ| tattathābhyantare'pi syātkāryaṃ svasvadigāśrayam ||129 madhye purasya kartavyaṃ gṛhamambhojajanmanaḥ| niveśanaṃ tathendra sya tathaiva halikṛṣṇayoḥ ||130 mātṛyakṣagaṇādhīśān śivakān bhūtasaṅghakān| vināpi veśmabhiḥ kuryātpure catvaramārgagān ||131 rājñā varṇāśramakalāpaṇyaśilpopajīvinaḥ| svadikpadasthāḥ kartavyāste devāścecchatā śriyam ||132 prāsāde sati bhaktīcchāśaktiyukto yadāparam| prāsādaṃ kārayetpūrvaṃ na tadā pīḍayet sudhīḥ ||133 prativeśma pratigrāmaṃ pratidevakulaṃ tathā| kuryātpratipuraṃ cāpi na prāṅmānaguṇādhikam ||134 pūrvaprāsādato rudra somayorbrahmaṇo'thavā| prāsāde vihite'nyasmin bhavet pīḍāgrajanmanām ||135 kṛte dhāmnyadhike'nyasmin vahnervācaspateruta| purodhasāṃ bhayaṃ vidyāddhruvaṃ jyotirvidāṃ tathā ||136 dhanādhipāmarādhīśayamānāṃ varuṇasya vā| adhikevihite dhāmni bhayaṃ vidyānmahīpateḥ ||137 skandadhāmno'dhike'nyasmin vihite tasya veśmani| senāpaterbalānāṃ ca pīḍā sañjāyate dhruvam ||138 prajāpaterabhyadhikaṃ harervānyat kṛtaṃ gṛham| kartuḥ kārayituśca syādbandhāya ca vinaṣṭaye ||139 gaṇeśayakṣaphaṇināmadhiko'nyaḥ kṛto yadi| prāsādaḥ syāttadā nityaṃ senāṅgānāṃ mahadbhayam ||140 strīnāmnyo devatāstāsāṃ pīḍyante yadi veśmabhiḥ| mukhyānāṃ puranārīṇāṃ tadā kurvantyupadra vam ||141 pūrvāmareṣu sarveṣu pīḍiteṣvamarālayaiḥ| anyaistalliṅgināṃ pīḍā caityairvā caityapīḍitaiḥ ||142 hīnādhikapramāṇeṣu durniviṣṭeṣu dhāmasu| kartuḥ kārayituḥ pīḍā syānna pūjā tathāsya ca ||143 naivātisaṃbhṛtaṃ kuryātsvalpamalpāmarālayam| puraṃ cānāśritaṃ kuryād vedhabhāgāśritaṃ na ca ||144 jyeṣṭhamadhyakaniṣṭhāni navaṣaṭtripadāntare| suraveśmāni kurvīta doṣāyāparathā punaḥ ||145 kathito'yaṃ vidhiḥ svaiḥ svaistridaśānāṃ niveśane| bahirniveśanātsvecchaṃ vidadhyādamarālayam ||146 nagareṣu samagreṣu grāmeṣu nikhileṣu ca| kheṭakeṣu ca sarveṣu sāmānyo'yaṃ vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||147 ityukta eṣa nagaropagataḥ surāṇāṃ| svasvaprabhāgavihitaḥ padasanniveśaḥ| brūmo vibhāgamadhunāṃ gṛhadevatānāṃ| samyakśubhāśubhaphalapravibhāgayuktam ||148 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre puraniveśo daśamo'dhyāyaḥ| <11> atha vāstutrayavibhāgo nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre vibhakte navadhā tataḥ| madhye mahādyutirbrahmā vidheyo navabhiḥ padaiḥ ||1 tasmādanantaraṃ prācyāṃ ṣaṭpadaḥ kīrtito'ryamā| āgneyakarṇe savitṛsāvitrau padikāvubhau ||2 brahmaṇo'nantaraṃ yāmye vivasvān ṣaṭpadāśritaḥ| nairṛte padikau karṇe jayendrau kathitāvubhau ||3 ṣaṭpadaḥ syāttato mitraḥ kāṣṭhāyāṃ patyurambhasaḥ| karṇe'parottare yakṣmā rudra śca padikāvubhau ||4 ṣaḍbhiḥ padaistataḥ saumye niścalaḥ pṛthivīdharaḥ| āpastathāpavatsaśca padikāvīśadiggatau ||5 ityantaḥsaṃśrayā devāḥ proktā brūmo bahiḥsthitān| jñeyaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ teṣāṃ sthānaṃ pūrvottarāditaḥ ||6 agnistadanu parjanyo jayantaścendra eva ca| raviḥ satyo bhṛśaśceti na bhastasmāttato'nilaḥ ||7 pūṣākhyo vitathākhyaśca gṛhakṣatayamāvatha| gandharvo bhṛṅgarājaśca mṛgaḥ pitṛgaṇastataḥ ||8 dauvāriko'tha sugrīvaḥ puṣpadanto jaleśvaraḥ| asuraḥ śoṣanāmā ca pāpayakṣmā tataḥ param ||9 rogo nāgaśca mukhyaśca bhallāṭaḥ soma eva ca| carako'thāditirdaityamāteti padadevatāḥ ||10 vahnervāyoḥ pitṝṇāṃ ca vyādheścaiva kramādbahiḥ| carakī ca vidārī ca pūtanā pāparākṣasī ||11 padabhogo'sti naitāsāṃ sthānameva hi kevalam| padabhogamatha brūmo bahiḥsthānāṃ nabhaḥsadām ||12 tatrāṣṭau dvipadādhīśā jayanto bhṛśa eva ca| vitatho bhṛṅgasugrīvaśoṣamukhyāstathāditiḥ ||13 ebhyaḥ śeṣā bahirye tu te syuḥ padabhujaḥ surāḥ| ekāśītipade prokto devatānāṃ padakramaḥ ||14 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre daśadhā pravibhājite| bhavecchatapado vāsturbrūmo'trāpyamarasthitim ||15 dviraṣṭaguṇitaṃ madhye padamekaṃ pitāmahaḥ| bhuṅkte śatapade vāstau caturguṇitamaryamā ||16 vivasvato'tha mitrasya tadvacca pṛthivībhṛtaḥ| bhogamicchanti vai teṣāmaryamṇa iva sūrayaḥ ||17 savitrādyāpavatsāntā ye ca noktāḥ surottamāḥ| yathaikāśītike tadvatteṣāṃ bhogaḥ padāṣṭakam ||18 agnyantarikṣapavanā mṛgaśca pitaro'pi ca| rogo'ditistathādhyardhapadabhājo bahiḥ sthitāḥ ||19 caturviṃśatiruktā ye parjanyādyāḥ surottamāḥ| adityantā dvipadikāste śeṣaṃ prākprasādhitam ||20 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre pūrvavadbhājite'ṣṭabhiḥ| catuḥṣaṣṭipado vāstuścatuḥṣaṣṭyā padairbhavet ||21 asminpadāni catvāri bhunaktyantaḥ pitāmahaḥ| aryamādyāḥ surāścātra dve dve madhyagatāḥ pade ||22 padhye'ṣṭau bāhyato'ṣṭau ye sthitāḥ karṇeṣu cāṣṭasu| ye devāḥ sarva evātra te padārdhabhujaḥ smṛtāḥ ||23 parjanyo'tha bhṛśaḥ pūṣā bhṛṅgadauvārikau tathā| śoṣanāgāditiprāntāḥ syuradhyardhapadaspṛśaḥ ||24 jayantādiṣu bāhyeṣu carakānteṣu kīrtitā| pratyekaṃ ṣoḍaśasvatra sureṣu dvipadasthitiḥ ||25 sirāṃ vahnipadādūrdhvaṃ nayetpitṛpadāntataḥ| bāhyāśānirgatāṃ caināṃ roganāmānamānayet ||26 dvināmnaḥ prāpayedbhṛṅgaṃ bhṛṅgātsugrīvamānayet| tato'ditiṃ tāṃ gamayeddvināmānaṃ praveśayet ||27 saurādyāmyaṃ padaṃ nītvā vāruṇaṃ prāpayettataḥ| nayetpadaṃ tataḥ saumyaṃ tata ādityamānayet ||28 bhṛśādānīya vitathaṃ śoṣākhyaṃ vitathādatha| śoṣānmukhyaṃ samānīya nayet tasmātpunarbhṛśam ||29 ye vibhāgāḥ samuddiṣṭā yathāsaṅkhyena tairiha| yajñāmaranṛṇāṃ vāstu samastaṃ vibhajetsudhīḥ ||30 devaiḥ sarvairapyamībhirviśokaḥ| prītyutkarṣāditthamālokyate'sau| kṛtsnāneṣo'pyabjapatrāyatākṣaḥ| paśyatyetān sphāritenekṣaṇena ||31 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre vāṣtutrayavibhāgo nāma ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ| <12> atha nāḍyādisirādivikalpo nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ| athābhidhīyate vāstuḥ kanīyān ṣoḍaśāspadaḥ| padaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ sa syāt tatra devān pracakṣmahe ||1 bhuṅkte madhye sthito mukhyaḥ padamekaṃ surottamaḥ| kḷptaṃ padacaturbhāgaiścaturbhiścaturānanaḥ ||2 padārdhabhāgabhoktāraścatvāro'mī surottamāḥ| aryamā ca vivasvāṃśca mitraśca kṣmādharo'pi ca ||3 savitrādyāpavatsāntā ye'ṣṭau koṇeṣu vedhasaḥ| caturbhāgabhujaste syustridaśāstapanatviṣaḥ ||4 caturthī śādikoṇeṣu ye sthitāḥ kramaśaḥ surāḥ| aṣṭabhāgabhujaste'ṣṭau vinirdiṣṭā manīṣibhiḥ ||5 ye tathāditiparyantāḥ parjanyādyāḥ surottamāḥ| te'ṣṭau caturbhāgabhujo vidvadbhiriha kīrtitāḥ ||6 carakāntā jayantādyā ye bāhyasthitayo'marāḥ| bhogo'rdhapadikasteṣāṃ ṣoḍaśānāmapi smṛtaḥ ||7 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre trayastriṃśadvibhājite| antyapaṅktidvayaṃ sādhaṃ carakyādyarthamutsṛjet ||8 antare vīthikāmardhapadikāmutsṛjettataḥ| madhye tu saptaviṃśatyā bhogairvāstu vibhājayet ||9 ekonatriṃśatā yuktaṃ padānāṃ śatasaptakam| yadbhavet tatra garbhe syādekāśītipadaḥ svabhūḥ ||10 aṣṭādaśapadāścāṣṭau capaprabhṛtayaḥ pṛthak| aryamādyaṃ catuḥpañcāśatpadaṃ syāccatuṣṭayam ||11 īśādayastvadityantā bāhyā navapadāḥ surāḥ| deśānāṃ sanniveśe'sau sāhasro vāsturucyate ||12 athocyate vṛttavāsturvṛttaprāsādahetave| ekaścatuḥṣaṣṭipadabhāgaḥ śatapado'paraḥ ||13 aṣṭadhā bhājite vṛttaviṣkambhe bhāgikāntarān| caturaḥ paridhīnkuryānmadhyavṛttaṃ dvibhāgikam ||14 syādbahirvṛttavalayamaṣṭāviṃśatibhāgikam| tadantarvṛttavalayamaṣṭāṣṭāṃśojjhitaṃ kramāt ||15 evaṃ kṛte bhavenmadhye brahmaṇastaccatuṣpadam| itthaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭipado vṛttavāsturudāhṛtaḥ ||16 daśadhā bhājite vṛttaviṣkambhe bhāgikāntarāḥ| kāryāḥ paridhayaḥ pañca madhye vṛttaṃ dvibhāgikam ||17 bahisthaṃ valayaṃ tasya bhajet ṣaṭtriṃśatā tataḥ| śeṣaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭipadasthityā syācchatavāstuni ||18 devatāpadasaṅkṣiptiranayoścaturaśravat| evaṃ kāryavaśātkāryā vāstavo'nye'pi dhīmatā ||19 tryaśre ṣaḍaśre cāṣṭāśre ṣoḍaśāśre ca vṛttavat| vṛttāyate'rdhacandre ca vāstau padavibhājanam ||20 eka eva pumāneṣu bahudhā parikalpitaḥ| sarvasminnapi saṃsthāne vibhakte lakṣayettataḥ ||21 śarīraṃ vāstupuṃso'sya guṇadoṣā bhavanti yat| mukhaṃ mūrdhā tataḥ śrotre dṛktālvoṣṭharadāḥ kramāt ||22 vakṣaḥ kaṇṭhaḥ stanau nābhirmeḍhramuṣkāvatho gudam| bāhū prabāhū pāṇī sphigūrujaṅghaṃ padadvayam ||23 kalpayedevametena sa bhavet puruṣākṛtiḥ| sirāvaṃśānuvaṃśāśca sandhayaḥ sānusandhayaḥ ||24 marmāṇyatha mahāvaṃśā lakṣyā vāstuśarīragāḥ| sirāḥ karṇagatā yāḥ syustā nāḍyaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||25 padasya ṣoḍaśo bhāgastatpramāṇaṃ prakīrtitam| mahāvaṃśau prākpratīcyau yāmyodīcyau ca madhyagau ||26 pramāṇaṃ pañcamo bhāgaḥ padasyodāhṛtaṃ tayoḥ| vaṃśāste'smin samuddiṣṭā rekhā yāḥ syurmukhāyatāḥ ||27 yāstiryagāyatā rekhāste'nuvaṃśāḥ prakīrtitāḥ| sampātā ye syureteṣām marma tatsaṃpracakṣate ||28 upamarmāṇi tānyāhuḥ padamadhyāni yāni hi| bhāgo'ṣṭamo'tha daśamo dvādaśaḥ ṣoḍaśo'pi ca ||29 padato mānamiṣṭaṃ syādvaṃśādīnāmanukramāt| vaṃśāṣṭakasya yaḥ sandhiḥ sa sandhiriti kīrtitaḥ ||30 ye punaḥ syustadaṅgānāṃ proktāste cānusandhayaḥ| vālāgratulyaṃ sandhīnāṃ pramāṇaṃ paricakṣate ||31 tadardhamanusandhīnāṃ pramāṇaṃ samudīritam| yatnenaitāni santyajya vāstuvidyāviśāradaḥ ||32 dra vyāṇi prayato nityaṃ sthapatirviniveśayet| mahāvaṃśasya nākrāntiṃ kuryāddravyeṇa kenacit ||33 itareṣu punardra vyaṃ madhyavaṃśeṣu santyajet| mahāvaṃśasamākrāntau bhavetsvāmivadho dhruvam ||34 varṣeṇa tapanādbhītiṃ vaṃśānāṃ pīḍanādviduḥ| upamarmāṇi rogāya marmāṇi kulahānaye ||35 udvegāyārthanāśāya sirāśca syuḥ prapīḍitāḥ| kaliḥ syātsandhividdheṣu pīḍiteṣvanusandhiṣu ||36 tasmādetāni sarvāṇi pīḍitānyupalakṣayet| jñātvā sirāḥ sānusirāśca nāḍīrvaṃśānuvaṃśānapi vāstudehe| yatnena marmāṇi phalāni caiṣāṃ vedhaṃ tyajedyastamupaiti nāpat ||37 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre nāḍīvaṃśānuvaṃśānāṃ sirānusirāmarmānumarmavedhavikalpo nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ| <13> atha marmavedhastrayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ| ekāśītipado yaḥ syāttathā śatapadaśca yaḥ| catuḥṣaṣṭipado yaśca vāsturatra tridhoditaḥ ||1 yadyena vibhajetteṣu tadidānīṃ pracakṣmahe| yāni marmāṇi caiteṣāṃ kathyanta iha tānyapi ||2 varṇināṃ bhavanādīni niveśā rājaveśmanām| ekāśītipadenendra sthānaṃ ca vibhajet sudhīḥ ||3 prāsādā vividhāstadvadvicitrāścātra maṇḍapāḥ| tān māpayecchatapadapravibhāgena buddhimān ||4 yaḥ punaḥ syāccatuḥṣaṣṭipadastena vibhājayet| narendra śibiragrāmakheṭādi nagarādi ca ||5 antastrayodaśa surā dvātriṃśadbāhyataśca ye| teṣāṃ sthānāni marmāṇi sirā vaṃśāśca teṣu tu ||6 mukhe hṛdi ca nābhau ca mūrdhni ca stanayostathā| marmāṇi vāstupuṃso'sya ṣaṇmahānti pracakṣate ||7 vaṃśānuvaṃśasampātāḥ padamadhyāni yāni ca| devasthānāni tānyādye padaṣoḍaśakānvite ||8 devasthānāni sampātāścatuḥṣaṣṭipade punaḥ| tathaikāśītipadike padāntaśatike'pi ca ||9 caturṣvapi vibhāgeṣu sirā yāḥ syuścaturdiśam| marmāṇi tāni coktāni dvāramadhyāni yāni ca ||10 bhittivistṛtamadhyena yadvā madhyena dāruṇaḥ| marma yatpīḍyate yena gṛhe tatrocyate phalam ||11 dvārairvā bhittibhirvāpi marmaṇāṃ paripīḍanāt| daurgatyaṃ gṛhiṇaḥ prāhuḥ kulahānimathāpi vā ||12 bhavetsvāmikṣayaḥ stambhaistulābhiḥ strīparikṣayaḥ| snuṣāvadho jayantībhirbandhunāśaśca saṅgrahaiḥ ||13 marmasthānagataiḥ kāyairbhartuḥ kāyo nipīḍyate| suhṛdviśleṣamicchanti sandhipālaiśca tadvidaḥ ||14 nāgapāśairdhanocchedo nāgadantaiḥ suhṛtkṣayaḥ| kapicchakaiśca marmasthaiḥ preṣyāṇāṃ kṣayamādiśet ||15 ṣaḍdārukāṇyanusirāgavākṣālokanāni ca| marmamadhyopagānyetānyāvahanti dhanakṣayam ||16 dvāradra vyatulāstambhanāgadantagavākṣakaiḥ| dvāramadhyārditai rogakulapīḍādhanakṣayān ||17 nṛpadaṇḍabhayaṃ patyuḥ pīḍanaṃ ca pracakṣate| dvāramadhyeṣu ṣaḍdārumadhyeṣvapi ca sūrayaḥ ||18 karṇadra vyādibhirviddheṣvetadeva phalaṃ viduḥ| śayyānuvaṃśavihitā gṛhiṇāṃ kulanāśinī ||19 kṣayāvahā nāgadantā bhartuḥ śayyāvitānagāḥ| vātāyanairatha stambhairye viddhā nāgadantakāḥ ||20 te śastrabhītidā bharturyadvā caurabhayapradāḥ| dra vyadhānyavināśāya śokāya kalahāya ca ||21 gṛhamadhyagataṃ dvāraṃ bhavetstrīdūṣaṇāya ca| dra vyeṇānyatareṇāpi mahāmarma nipīḍitam ||22 bhavetsarvasvanāśāya gṛhiṇo maraṇāya ca| aṃśukāścordhvavaṃśāśca tumbikāḥ sendra kīlakāḥ ||23 puraprāsādagehānāṃ vedhe'pyete na doṣadāḥ| itthaṃ surakṣitipavarṇagṛhāśrito'yaṃ| bhedaḥ padeṣvakhilamarmagato vyadhaśca| uktaḥ pṛthakpṛthagamuṣya phalaṃ ca samyag| brūmo'tha vāstupuruṣāṅgavibhāgamatra ||24 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstraṃ marmavedho nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ| <14> atha puruṣāṅgadevatānighaṇṭvādinirṇayaścaturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ| devatānāṃ padairitthaṃ saṃvibhaktaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ| sthapatiḥ prayataḥ kuryādvāstumitthaṃ pumākṛtim ||1 śirastasyāgniruddiṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭirdityambudādhipau| jayantaścāditiścāsya karṇau vāyurmukhe sthitaḥ ||2 arkaḥ syāddakṣiṇe vāme bhuje somaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ| mahendra carakau sāpavatsāvasyorasi sthitau ||3 stane'ryamā dakṣiṇe syādvāme ca pṛthivīdharaḥ| yakṣmā rogaśca nāgaśca mukhyo bhallāṭa ityamī ||4 dakṣiṇetarametasya bāhuṃ devāḥ samāśritāḥ| satyo bhṛśo nabho vāyuḥ pūṣā cetyatha dakṣiṇam ||5 pañcāpi bāhumetasya saṃśritāstridivaukasaḥ| sāvitrasavitārau ca rudra śaktidharāvapi ||6 catvāro'mī kalādhisthāḥ karayorhṛdi ca svabhūḥ| vitathaukaḥ kṣatau pārśve dakṣiṇe'sya vyavasthitau ||7 vāme punaḥ sthitāvasya devau śoṣāsurābhidhau| mitrābhidho vivasvāṃśca dvāvapyudaramāśritau ||8 meḍhramadhyasthitāvasya surāvindra jayābhidhau| yamaśca varuṇaścorvoḥ kramāddakṣiṇavāmayoḥ ||9 gandharvabhṛṅgau samṛgau jaṅghāṃ rājyāmathetarām| dvāsthasugrīvapuṣpākhyāḥ saṃśritāḥ pitaro'ṅghrigāḥ ||10 ekāśītipadasyeśadigvibhāgāśritaṃ śiraḥ| māhendrī saṃśritaṃ vidyāccatuḥṣaṣṭipadasya tu ||11 ekāśītipadājjāto vāstuḥ śatapadābhidhaḥ| yaḥ ṣoḍaśapadaḥ sa syāccatuṣṣaṣṭhipadodbhavaḥ ||12 madhye ya eva devānāṃ sthito brahmābjasaṃbhavaḥ| sa sahasrānano'cintyavibhavo jagatāṃ prabhuḥ ||13 yo'yaṃ vahnirihoktaḥ sa sarvabhūtaharo haraḥ| parjanyanāmā yaścāyaṃ vṛṣṭimānambudādhipaḥ ||14 jayantastu dvināmākhyaḥ kaśyapo bhagavānṛṣiḥ| mahendra stu surādhīśo danujānāṃ vimardanaḥ ||15 ādityaṃ punaricchanti vivasvantamahaskaram| satyo bhūtahito dharmo bhṛśaḥ kāmo'tha manmathaḥ ||16 yo'ntarikṣaḥ smṛto devastannabhaḥ samudāhṛtam| māruto vāyuruddiṣṭaḥ pūṣā mātṛgaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ||17 adharmo vitathākhyaḥ syātkalerapratimaḥ sutaḥ| gṛhakṣataḥ punaryotra sa candra tanayo budhaḥ ||18 pretādhipo mataḥ śrīmān yamo vaivasvataśca saḥ| gandharvo bhagavān devo nāradaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||19 bhṛṅgarājamihecchanti rākṣasaṃ nirṛteḥ sutam| yo mṛgo'sminnanantaḥ sa svayaṃbhūrdharma ityapi ||20 ādiḥ prajāpatiḥ sraṣṭā manuḥ sugrīva īritaḥ| puṣpadantastu vinatātanayaḥ syānmahājavaḥ ||21 varuṇaḥ pāthasāṃ nātho lokapālaḥ sa kīrtitaḥ| asuro rāhurarkendumardanaḥ siṃhikātmajaḥ ||22 śoṣastu bhagavāneṣa sūryaputraḥ śanaiścaraḥ| pāpayakṣmā kṣayaḥ prokto rogastu kathito jvaraḥ ||23 bhujaṅgamānāmadhipaḥ śrīmān nāgastu vāsukiḥ| tvaṣṭā syānmukhyasaṃjño'tra viśvakarmābhidhaśca saḥ ||24 candro bhalvāṭa ityuktaḥ kuberaḥ somasaṃjñitaḥ| carako vyavasāyākhyaḥ śrīrihāditisaṃjñikā ||25 ditiratrocyate śarvaḥ śūlabhṛdvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ| himavānāpa ityukta āpavatsa umā smṛtā ||26 ādityastvaryamā vedamātā sāvitra ucyate| devī gaṅgātra vidvadbhiḥ saviteti prakīrtitā ||27 mṛtyuḥ śarīrahartāsau vivasvāniti sa smṛtaḥ| jayābhidhastu vajrīti syādindro balavān hariḥ ||28 mitro haladharo mālī rudra stūkto maheśvaraḥ| rājayakṣmā guhaḥ proktaḥ kṣitidhro'nanta ucyate ||29 carakī ca vidārī ca pūtanā pāparākṣasī| rakṣoyonibhavā hyetā devatānucarīrviduḥ ||30 ityeṣa vāstudevānāṃ nighaṇṭuḥ parikīrtitaḥ| kṣo mūrdhni ho dṛśormadhye so ghrāṇe cibuke tu ṣaḥ ||31 śaḥ kaṇṭhe hṛdaye vaḥ syāllakāro nābhideśagaḥ| repho bastau yakārastu meḍhre maḥ puṣyakāvubhau ||32 nakāra ūrurṇo jānu ñakāraḥ piṇḍikāśritaḥ| ṅakāro gulpahyorante pakāro'ṅghritale smṛtaḥ ||33 uktāni vāstupuruṣasya yathāvaditthamaṅgāni vāstupadadaivatanāmabhedāḥ| vārṇāśca vāstvavayaveṣviha ṣoḍaśaiva brūmo'tha daivatavaśena pure niveśam ||34 iti mahārājādhīrājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre puruṣāṅgadevatānighaṇṭvakṣarāṅganirṇayo nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ| <15> atha rājaniveśo nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ| kṛte puraniveśe'tha catuḥṣaṣṭipadāśraye| niyuktaparikhāsālagopurāṭṭālake'pi ca ||1 vibhaktarathye paritaḥ pravibhājitacatvare| kramādantarbahiḥ kḷptadevatāyatanasthitau ||2 prāgudakpravaṇe deśe prāgdvārābhyunnate'thavā| yaśaḥ śrīvijayādhāyi maitraṃ padamadhiṣṭhitam ||3 yathāvarṇakramāyātaṃ caturaśraṃ samaṃ śubham| puramadhyādaparatodiksthaṃ kuryānnṛpālayam ||4 durgeṣu bhūvaśātkāryaṃ yadvā dikṣvaparāsvapi| vivasvadbhūdharāryamṇāṃ kāryamanyatame pade ||5 tricatvāriṃśatā yukte jyeṣṭhaṃ syāddve dhanuḥśate| madhyaṃ śataṃ tu dvāṣaṣṭiḥ śataṃ sāṣṭakamantimam ||6 jyeṣṭhe pure vidhātavyaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ rājaniveśanam| madhyame madhyamaṃ kāryaṃ kāniṣṭhaṃ ca kanīyasi ||7 prākāraparikhāguptaṃ cārukānti samantataḥ| tamaṅgabhramaniryūhasudṛḍhāṭṭālakānvitam ||8 ekāśītyā padairbhaktaṃ vidheyaṃ nṛpamandiram| rājamārgaṃ samāśritya vāstudvāramudaṅmukham ||9 yuktyānayaiva kartavyamanyadiksaṃśraye'pi ca| bhallāṭapadavartyasya gopuradvāramiṣyate ||10 tatpuradvāravistārocchrāyasammitamiṣṭadam| mahendraṃ dvāramicchanti niviṣṭasya mahīdhare ||11 vaivasvate puṣpadantamaryaṇi ca gṛhakṣatam| anyeṣveṣāmaparataḥ pradakṣiṇapadeṣvatha ||12 anyānyapi svāsu dikṣu dvārāṇyevaṃ prakalpayet| ābhimukhye ca sarveṣāṃ śasyante gopurāṇi ca ||13 tadīyanagaradvārādviṃśatyaṃśojjhitāni vā| pakṣadvārāṇi sugrīve jayante mukhyanāmni ca ||14 vitathe'tha bhramāṃstadvadvidadhīta pradakṣiṇān| vāstau vibhakte puravatkḷpte'marapadavrajaiḥ ||15 tatra maitrapadasthāne niveśāyāvanīpateḥ| prāsādaḥ prāṅmukhaḥ kāryo yathāvatpṛthivīñjayaḥ ||16 śrīvṛkṣaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ muktakoṇamathāparam| yamicchennṛpatiḥ kuryātprāsādaṃ śubhalakṣaṇam ||17 śālāparikramopetakarmāntairapi cānvitam| tatra prācyāṃ bhavedgehamādityapadasaṃśritam ||18 dharmādhikaraṇaṃ satye vyavahārekṣaṇāya ca| bhṛśe ca koṣṭhāgāraṃ syādambare mṛgapakṣiṇām ||19 agneḥ kakubhamāśritya kāryaṃ vāyormahānasam| sabhājanāśrayaṃ pūṣṇi vidadhyādbhojanāspadam ||20 sāvitre vādyaśālā syātsavitṛsthāśca vandinaḥ| carmāṇi vitathe kuryāttadyogyānyāyudhāni ca ||21 svarṇarūpyādikarmāntānvidadhīta gṛhakṣate| yāmye dakṣiṇato guptiṃ koṣṭhāgāraṃ ca kalpayet ||22 prekṣāsaṅgītakāni syurgandharve vāsaveśma ca| kāryā vaivasvate śālā rathānāṃ dantināṃ tathā ||23 paścimottarabhāgasthāṃ vāpīmapi ca kārayet| vāyau sugrīvapadayorgandharvasya ca bāhyataḥ ||24 kuryādantaḥpurasthānaṃ prākāravalayāvṛtam| kuryāttadgopuradvāramudagāsyaṃ jayābhidhe ||25 kāryaḥ sthapatinā caiva prāsādaścāparāṅmukhaḥ| krīḍādolālayānbhṛṅge kumārībhavanaṃ tathā ||26 nṛpāntaḥpuramicchanti mṛge pitrye tvavaskaram| nṛpastrīṇāmupasthānagṛhamindra pade viduḥ ||27 sugrīvapadasaṃsaktamariṣṭāramiṣṭadam| dvāsthasugrīvapitryaṃ śapaścādbhāge manoharā ||28 vigheyāśokavanikā snānadhārāgṛhāṇi ca| latāmaṇḍapasaṃyuktāḥ syuratraiva latāgṛhāḥ ||29 dāruśailāśca vāpyaśca puṣpavīthyaḥ sukalpitāḥ| puṣpadante bhavedyantrakarmāntaḥ puṣpaveśma ca ||30 varuṇasya pade kuryādvāpīpānagṛhāṇi ca| syātkoṣṭhāgāramasure śoṣe tvāyudhamandiram ||31 bhāṇḍāgāraṃ tu raudrā khye vidadhyātsthapatiḥ śriye| ulūkhalaśilāyantrabhavanaṃ pāpayakṣmaṇi ||32 dārukarmāntamapyāhuḥ śreyase rājayakṣmaṇi| syādoṣadheradhiṣṭhānaṃ roge diśi nabhasvataḥ ||33 nāgānāṃ śasyate sthānaṃ pade nāgasya sūribhiḥ| bhavanti mukhye vyāyāmanāṭyacitragṛhāṇi ca ||34 gavāṃ sthānaṃ tathā kṣīragṛhaṃ bhallāṭanāmani| udakpradeśe saumyasya purodhaḥsthānamiṣyate ||35 rājño'bhiṣecanaṃ cātra dānādhyayanaśāntayaḥ| cāmaracchatradhāma syānmantraveśma ca bhūdhare ||36 kāryiṇāṃ cātra kāryāṇi sthitaḥ paśyennarādhipaḥ| vidheyā mandurāśvānāmuttaraṃ pārśvamāśritā ||37 mahīdharapadasyaiva yathāvaddakṣiṇāmukhī| kāryā sarvatra cāśvānāṃ śālā rājño yathāgṛham ||38 viśato dakṣiṇena syādvāmena ca viṣāṇinām| veśmāni rājaputrāṇāṃ vidadhyāccarakābhidhe ||39 atraiva vidyādhigamaśālāścaiṣāṃ niveśayet| nṛpasya māturaditisthāne kuryānniveśanam ||40 pṛthagatraiva śibikāśayyāsanagṛhaṃ viduḥ| nṛpadvipānāṃ śastā syādāpe sadanakalpanā ||41 abhiṣecanakaṃ sthānamihaiva syādviṣāṇinām| āpavatsapade haṃsakrauñcasārasanāditāḥ ||42 syuḥ phullābjavanāḥ svacchasalilāḥ salilāśayāḥ| pitṛvyamātulādīnāṃ kāryaṃ ditipade gṛham ||43 anyeṣāmapi cātraiva sāmantānāṃ mahīpateḥ| aiśānyāmanalasthāne vocchritastambhavedikam ||44 kāryaṃ devakulaṃ cāru suśliṣṭamaṇikuṭṭimam| parjanyasya pade horājyotirvidgṛhamiṣyate ||45 jaye senāpaterveśma vidheyaṃ vijayapradam| dvāraṃ prākāramāśritya pade'ryamṇaḥ praśasyate ||46 prāgdakṣiṇāśritaṃ śastrakarmāntaṃ śastramatra ca| vibhuñcedbrahmaṇaḥ sthānamindra dhvajayutaṃ nṛṇām ||47 tatrāśubhāni veśmāni niveśāścāsukhāvahāḥ| gavākṣastambhaśobhinyo vidheyāścānukāmataḥ ||48 sabhā yathādikprabhavā nṛpaveśmābhiguptaye| sarvatra nṛpateḥ saudhānnṛpasaudhasya sammukhā ||49 paścādbhāgāśritā yadvā śālā kāryā viṣāṇinām| ityāspadaṃ surapadāspadakalpamādya-| metadyathāvadanutiṣṭhati yaḥ sadaiva| sa kṣmāmimāṃ bhujabalakṣapitāripakṣaḥ| saptāmburāśiraśanāṃ nṛpatiḥ praśāsti ||50 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre rājaniveśo nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ| <16> atha vanapraveśo nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ| prāgvodagvāpi gehārthe dra vyaṃ vidhivadānayet| gantavyameva dhiṣṇyeṣu mṛdukṣipracareṣu ca ||1 upavāsyaṃ ca teṣveva cchedyaṃ bhedyaṃ ca dāruṇaiḥ| praveśanaṃ sthiraiḥ kāryamārambhaḥ śasyate caraiḥ ||2 gatvā śubhe śucau deśe niveśaṃ kārayet tataḥ| tasminniveśya karmāntamannapānena tarpayet ||3 puṣṭatuṣṭaparīvāraḥ kṣapāyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ| gṛhayogyaṃ parīkṣeta nyastaśastrastato'ṅghripam ||4 puraśmaśānagrāmādhvahṛdacaityāśramodbhavān| kṣetropavanasīmāntarviṣamasthalanimnajān ||5 kaṭvamlatiktalavaṇāsvavanīṣu tathodgatām| śvabhrāvṛtān sthirorvīṣu sambhūtāṃśca tyajeddrumān ||6 samyak saṃlakṣya vṛkṣāṇāṃ varṇasnehatvagādikam| vijānīyādvayasteṣāṃ bālān vṛddhāṃśca santyajet ||7 śatāni trīṇi varṣāṇāṃ sāradrumavayaḥ smṛtam| gṛhṇīyāt ṣoḍaśādūrdhvaṃ sārdhavarṣaśatāvadheḥ ||8 vayasaḥ pariṇāmena nirvīryatvaṃ yathā nṛṇām| proktaṃ tadvaddrumāṇāṃ ca syāttathā chidra patratā ||9 bhaṅgurāḥ suṣirāste syuḥ sakolākṣāḥ kharatvacaḥ| tasmādimāṃstyajedvṛkṣāṃstathā caivordhvaśoṣiṇaḥ ||10 vakrān rūkṣānavapluṣṭān duḥsthitānapi ca drumān| varjayed bhagnaśākhāṃśca dvyekaśākhānvitāṃstathā ||11 anyairadhiṣṭhitān vidyutpātavātasaritkṣatān| granthiniryuktadānāṃśca bhramarāhikṛtāśrayān ||12 saṃsṛṣṭānekato bhraṣṭān madhubhirbalibhirvṛtān| māṃsāmedhyāśanaistadvaddūṣitānapi pakṣibhiḥ ||13 lūtātantvāvṛtānvanyasattvodghṛṣṭān gajakṣatān| budhnato'tibṛhatskandhāṃścihnabhūtāṃstathādhvanaḥ ||14 akāle puṣpaphalino rogairapi ca pīḍitān| vāsabhūtānulūkānāṃ tyajedanyānapīdṛśān ||15 khadiro bījakaḥ sālo madhūkaḥ śākaśiṃśape| sarjārjunāñjanāśokāḥ kadaro rohiṇītaruḥ ||16 vikaṅkato devadāruḥ śrīparṇīpādapastathā| kuṭumbināmamī proktāḥ puṣṭidā jīvadāstathā ||17 vṛkṣāṇāṃ lakṣyate yeṣāṃ bhāravārisahiṣṇutā| te yathāyogyamanye'pi śasyante gṛhakarmaṇi ||18 karṇikāradhavaplakṣakapitthaviṣamacchadāḥ| śirīṣodumbarāśvatthaśelunyagrodhacampakāḥ ||19 nimbāmrakovidārākṣavyādhighātāśca garhitāḥ| gṛhakarmaṇi neṣṭāste yataste'niṣṭadāyitaḥ ||20 neṣṭāḥ kaṇṭakinaḥ svāduphalāḥ kṣīradrumāśca ye| sugandhayaśca ye tadvaddhruvaṃ teṣu paśukṣayaḥ ||21 sattvapramāṇacchāyā tu niyataṃ dṛśyate yadā| drumacchāyā tadā grāhyā tatpramāṇastu sa drumaḥ ||22 nakṣatraṃ lakṣayedvṛkṣe pūrvasyāṃ diśi tatkṣiteḥ| syādbhasyādyakṣaraṃ yasya tatra jātaṃ tamādiśet ||23 kṣemyaṃ taṃ svāmino vṛkṣaṃ jñātvā sādhakameva ca| agranthikoṭaraṃ snigdhamṛju sārasamanvitam ||24 pīnaskandhaṃ haritpatraṃ vṛttaṃ cābhyarcya pādapam| dvijān santarpya ca svasti vācyaṃ ca sthapatistataḥ ||25 pakvāpakvāmiṣaistadvadbhūtabhaktaiḥ surāsavaiḥ| gandhaiśca dhūpamālyaiśca baliṃ dadyānniśāgame ||26 apakrāmantu bhūtāni yāni vṛkṣāśritāni hi| kalpanaṃ vartayiṣyāmi kriyatāṃ vāsaparyayaḥ ||27 dhanyaḥ śivaḥ puṣṭhikaraḥ prajāvṛddhikaro bhava| svasti candrā nilayamāḥ sūryarudrā nalāstathā ||28 diśo nadyastathā śailāḥ pāntu
