tvāmṛṣibhiḥ saha| jalpedyo mānuṣagirā kampate vābhimantritaḥ ||29 sa tyājyaḥ syāttathā mlānapravālakusumaśca yaḥ| tato bhāskaramālokya vṛkṣaṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam ||30 svastivākyena viprāṇāṃ chettā sthitvodagānanaḥ| prāṅmukho vā taruṃ chindyācchastraiḥ kṣaudrā rditānanaiḥ ||31 śākhinacchidyamānasya jāyate yadyasṛksrutiḥ| kampanaṃ vā dhvanirvā'pi mṛtyuḥ syādgṛhiṇastadā ||32 yadvā dadhimadhukṣīraghṛtāni sravati drumaḥ| chidyamānastadā vidyādbandhavyādhinkuṭumbinaḥ ||33 atīva yasya sravati śyāmaḥ snehānvito rasaḥ| sugandhiḥ svalpamadhuraḥ kaṣāyaḥ sa praśasyate ||34 prācyāṃ śubhastaroḥ pāta udīcyāṃ karmasādhakaḥ| yāmyapratyaṅnipāte tu śāntiṃ kṛtvā drumaṃ tyajet ||35 jñātitaḥ syāttadā bhītiryadānyaṃ mardayet patan| dūraṃ dalati yo mūlaṃ chinno vā dharaṇīruhaḥ ||36 kūjatyatīva vāyuśca smṛtaḥ so'tha śubhapradaḥ| kharoṣṭrayoḥ śṛgālānāṃ darśanaṃ bhujagasya vā ||37 chede syātkarmavighnāya nigaḍairbandhanāya vā| halacakrapatākābjadhvajacchatrādidarśanam ||38 śrīvṛkṣavardhamānādidarśanaṃ vā śubhapradam| utkṣipyate yadi cchedāttadarddhiḥ syātkuṭumbinaḥ ||39 sarvataḥ parihāniḥ syācchinnaścākṣipyate yadi| ekavṛkṣe yathoddiṣṭalakṣaṇotkṣepadarśane ||40 śeṣān doṣavinirmuktān pādapānupalakṣayet| dhīrastaṃ kalpayet samyaganulomārjavaṃ tarum ||41 chindyācca śubhabhāgārdhadaśabhāgādhikaṃ kṛtam| tuṅgīsādyavamadhyaśca sagarbho dharaṇīruhaḥ ||42 jñeyāni maṇḍalānyasya tatkṣaṇocchedane'pi ca| mañjiṣṭhābhe vidurbhekaṃ kapilābhe ca mūṣakam ||43 pītabhāsi tathā godhāṃ sarpaṃ dīrghasitāyate| guḍacchāye madhu bhavet kṛkalāsastathāruṇe ||44 gṛhagodhā kapotābhe gaudhero ghṛtamaṇḍabhe| rasāñjanābhe śastrābhe kamalotpalabhāsi ca ||45 dhautāsiyaṣṭivarne ca maṇḍale jalamādiśet| ākāro yasya sarpasya varṇo vā saṃpradṛśyate ||46 taṃ sarpagarbhitaṃ vṛkṣamādiśedavicārayan| taskarebhyo bhayaṃ kṣaudre salile salilādbhayam ||47 vidyātsarpe viṣādbhītiṃ pāṣāṇe bhayamagnitaḥ| ajāvigomahiṣyuṣṭrarāsabhādinipīḍitam ||48 godhāgaudheramaṇḍūkakṛkalāsaiśca garbhite| mūṣake punaricchanti maraṇaṃ vāstuvedinaḥ ||49 amunaiva vadantyanye gṛhapīḍāṃ manīṣiṇaḥ| kṣemeṇa yadyavighnaḥ syādasaṅgaścāgamo yadi ||50 vanāntare tadā kṣemaṃ subhikṣaṃ ca samādiśet| arghadānavidhinā vidhānaviddravyamāgatamihārcayedgṛhī| pratyupetakuliśāyudhadhvajaṃ dra vyamujjvalamutāvanīpatiḥ ||51 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre vanapraveśo nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ| <17> atha indra dhvajanirūpaṇaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ| surāṇāmarthasiddhyarthaṃ vadhāya ca suradruhām| yathā śakradhvajotthānaṃ prāha brahmā tathocyate ||1 bhagavantamathāmbhojasaṃbhava vacasāṃpatiḥ| provāca kathamindre ṇa jetavyāstridaśadviṣaḥ ||2 so'bravītsarvaratnānāṃ dhvajaṃ kuruta saṅgatāḥ| taṃ cābhicārikairmantrairudvahanto'bhimantritam ||3 sthitaṃ copari yantrasya samyak pakṣiśatānvitam| agrato devasainyasya nayanto jeṣyatha dviṣaḥ ||4 sahasradhāramapyekamanyaṃ ripukulāntakam| divyarūpamayaṃ prādāddhvajamindrā ya durdharam ||5 vīryapravardhanī ceṣṭiretadarthaṃ vidhīyate| karmaṇānena niḥśeṣāñśakraḥ śatrūñjayediti ||6 jayaiṣī tamatha kṣipramasṛjaccetasā dhvajam| yantrasthitaṃ sa yenājāvamohayadarīn hariḥ ||7 ādityā vasavo rudrā viśvedevāstathāśvinau| alañcakrustamālokya marutaśca vibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||8 tejo vīryaṃ vapuśceṣṭāṃ balamapyeṣa paśyatām| aharacchatrusainyānāṃ tejasvī tarasā dhvajaḥ ||9 tamabhyarcya surādhīśaḥ śatrūn balavato'pyasau| trirātreṇājayadyuddhe kuliśena balādbalī ||10 tataḥ prītastamṛkṣe'sau vaiṣṇave dvādaśe tithau| trailokyarājyaṃ prāpyābhyaṣiñcadbalaniṣūdanaḥ ||11 sa sarvalokamabhyarcya sarvalokābhipūjitaḥ| dhvajamabhyarcya tuṣṭāva vākyairvṛtraniṣūdanaḥ ||12 tatastamantike vīkṣya dhvajaṃ provāca vāsavaḥ| indra dhvajākṣayā lokāḥ kariṣyanti tavārcanam ||13 vīkṣamāṇā nimittāni bhūmipālāśca śāstrataḥ| tataḥ prabhṛtyasau loke sarvalakṣaṇasaṃbhṛtaḥ ||14 varapradānādindra sya nṛpaiḥ śakradhvajo'rcyate| durgamāyatanaṃ vahniśaraṇaṃ vedikāḥ kṛtāḥ ||15 vicitrāḥ sthālikāpākā bhakṣapānāni yāni ca| etānyāyatanāt prāksyuryadvānyāni prakalpayet ||16 vijetuṃ yadi vāñchāsti durdharṣān dveṣiṇo raṇe| tejo balaṃ yaśaścāptuṃ tadaindraṃ kārayeddhvajam ||17 senāyāṃ vā pure vāpi pratiṣṭhāpya purandaram| vijayārthaṃ mahīpālairabhipraśamanāya ca ||18 yathā śakradhvajotthānavidhānaṃ jagatībhujaḥ| kariṣyanti tathā samyak kārtsnyena pratipādyate ||19 vanādupāhṛtaṃ dra vyamatha prāgvidhinā sudhīḥ| pādyārghyādibhirabhyarcya gandhairmālyairalaṅkṛtam ||20 dvijān saṃpūjya ca śucau deśe samyaksamāhitaḥ| pūrvāgramuttarāgraṃ vā prayatnādavatārayet ||21 prāgudagvā purasyātha sthapatiḥ karmavānapi| kārayet sarvayantrāṇi dhvajapūrvāṇi śilpibhiḥ ||22 śreṣṭhaṃ dvātriṃśatā hastairviṃśatyā yutayāṣṭabhiḥ| mānaṃ syānmadhyamaṃ tasya caturanvitayādhamam ||23 mūlavistṛtirāyāmādaṅgulārdhaṃ kare kare| viṣkambho'gre ca mūlārdhāt tattryaṃśādvākhileṣvapi ||24 dhvajamūlāṣṭamāṃśonaṃ vistārātkuṣyamiṣyate| vistārārdhena ca sthūlaṃ sthūlatvatriguṇāyatam ||25 dhvajavistārabahalaṃ sāṅghribāhalyavistṛtam| bhramapīṭhaṃ vidhātavyaṃ sārdhāyāmaṃ śubhāvaham ||26 sammito dhvajakuṣyeṇa vedhaḥ syādbhramapīṭhagaḥ| kuṣyakoṭyadhikāvṛttāvakṣau koṭidvayāyatau ||27 kāryāvaṅghrī bhramasthūlau bhramavistṛtivistṛtau| tadyuktivedhe tāveta dvistṛterdviguṇocchritau ||28 dhvajāyaticaturbhāgātpīṭhamatra prakalpayet| mallapratiṣṭhitaṃ madhye prāntayoḥ stambhadhāritam ||29 tatpīṭhastambhanīyābhyāṃ dvārābhyāmanvitaṃ dṛḍham| yāmyottarapratikṣobhaṃ prāṅmukhaṃ sudṛḍhārgalam ||30 ketuvyāsārdhavistāraṃ taddairghyāṣṭāṃśakocchritam| vistārasadṛśāyāmaṃ madhye syādvajriṇo gṛham ||31 mallaśca pīṭhikāṅghrī ca bāhū stambhavinirgatau| śakramātā kumāryaśca dhvajavistṛtivistṛtāḥ ||32 nimnabhāgāśca sarveṣāṃ svavistṛticaturguṇāḥ| kāryā vā pañcaguṇitāḥ sapta mūladeśataḥ ||33 kanyānāmudayaḥ prokto yaḥ ṣaṣṭhāṃśastrisaṃguṇaḥ| indra mātā tu sarvābhyaḥ syāttadaṣṭāṃśato'dhikā ||34 vedhaḥ svavistaraiḥ saptabhāge syāt kanyakodayāt| nirvedhaścaturaśraḥ syāllakaṭasya samāhitaḥ ||35 nirvedhāvasya cordhvādhaḥ saptāṃśāntaravartinau| kāryau sūcīvyadhāvanyau sūcīmānapramāṇataḥ ||36 kanyāvyāsatribhāgena sūcī vistārato bhavet| pādonabahalā cārudārujā dṛḍhasaṃhitā ||37 kumārīvyāsasaṃyuktā dviguṇā kalaṭāyatiḥ| etadbāhyāntaraṃ jñātvā yantraṃ saṃyojayettataḥ ||38 tayoradhastadardhena mṛgālyau sūcivistṛtau| kṣetrasya lekhitaṃ kāryaṃ sambandhe sūcikanyayoḥ ||39 sāṅghriketanamūlārdhaṃ lakaṭe vistṛtāyatī| akṣābhyāṃ yojayet samyagdṛḍhaṃ bāhvakṣavedhayoḥ ||40 pañcānāmapi tulyaiva kanyānāṃ syātprakalpanā| kṛtvānupūrvyā yantrāṇi sthāpayedakhilānyapi ||41 āśvine māsi pakṣe ca dhavale pratipattithau| sthirodayairgrahaiḥ saumyairvīkṣite tvāṣṭrabhe'pi ca ||42 paurajānapadaiḥ sarvavāditradhvanitena ca| yantrāṇyutkṣipya yaṣṭiṃ ca karmasthānānnayejjalam ||43 citrapratisarākīrṇāṃ yaṣṭiṃ tatrājyalepitām| cūrṇaiḥ sarvauṣadhībhiśca sthapatiḥ snāpayet svayam ||44 jalāśayātsamuttārya nṝṇāṃ kalakalasvanaiḥ| prāgagrāṃ sthāpayeddāruhastinyoḥ prāksamunnatām ||45 ahatepsitavāsobhirācchādyārcya sragādibhiḥ| vikṣipya ca baliṃ dikṣu dvijātīn svasti vācayet ||46 trisadhyaṃ pūjitāṃ tatra sarvaprakṛtibhistataḥ| pañcāhaṃ vāsayedyaṣṭiṃ guptāṃ cāpadharairnaraiḥ ||47 tasminnevāhni yantrāṇi sarvāṇyapi ca yaṣṭivat| snātānyācchāditānīndra sthānadeśaṃ praveśayet ||48 sūtrite'tha dhvajasthāne yaṣṭeraṣṭāṃśadairghyataḥ| tadardhavistṛte diksthe same prāgāyate śubhe ||49 vibhakte'tra vibhāgānāmekāśītyā tataḥ kramāt| vinyastāsvatha sarvāsu devatāsu yathātatham ||50 prāci madhye maitrapade tanmadhyānmaruto diśi| mallaṃ nimnapramāṇena pādakoṇe niveśayet ||51 bhṛṅgamukhyapadadvandvamadhyayorvāyukoṇayoḥ| nyasyetstambhau tayoḥ pīṭhīṃ malle ca viniveśayet ||52 pīṭhikā nirgatā bāhuyugmāttatrāgrayogataḥ| stambhinyau ropayedbrāhmaṃ pṛthakpadayugaṃ śrite ||53 pratikṣobhāviha dvau dvau bāhudvitayamāśritau| bāhyataḥ prāntapadayormaitrayorviniveśayet ||54 prācyāṃ mallāgrato jñātvā śakrasyordhvagatiṃ kramāt| yojayedbhramaṇopetau bhramapādāvabhaṅgurau ||55 mallātpaścimadigbhāge varuṇasyāśritāṃ padam| bhadrāṃ niveśayennimnamānataḥ śakramātaram ||56 syuḥ parjanyāntarikṣadvāryakṣmaṇāṃ padamāśritāḥ| kramānnandopanandākhyajayākhyavijayābhidhāḥ ||57 vinyastāsvatha sarvāsu kumārīṣu vibhāgaśaḥ| trayastrayaḥ pratikṣobhā yojyā dārḍhyāya bāhyataḥ ||58 nikṣipannakhilaṃ dra vyaṃ bhāvayet padadevatāḥ| prāpnoti tattadākhyāṃ taddravyaṃ pūjāṃ ca tadgatām ||59 pīṭhīpṛṣṭhasamaṃ kanyāpārśvayorubhayorapi| kuryādanusaradvandvaṃ kīlakairbaddhamāyasaiḥ ||60 saṃśrityānusaradvandvaṃ pīṭhīṃ copari saṅgrahāt| badhnīyātkīlakairlauhairyantraniścalatākṛte ||61 yantrakarmaṇi nirvṛtta iti śāstravidhānataḥ| praveśayīta svasthāne tridaśādhipamaindra bhe ||62 snātasya vidhivadvastracchannasyālepitasya ca| śrīkhaṇḍādyaiḥ surabhibhiḥ kusumairarcitasya ca ||63 rauhiṇādimuhūrteṣu triṣu maitre'tha vajriṇaḥ| praveśamabhinandanti karaṇeṣvarciteṣu ca ||64 sthapatirvā purodhā vā śuciḥ snātaḥ samāhitaḥ| gandhamālyārcitān viprāṃstarpayeddakṣiṇādibhiḥ ||65 tato maṅgalaghoṣeṇa vāditraninadena ca| puṇyāhajayaśabdaistamutkṣipeyuḥ samāhitāḥ ||66 alaṅkārabhṛtaḥ paurāḥ prahṛṣṭamanaso'khilāḥ| nīrujo balinaḥ śaktāḥ prakṛtyabhimatāśca ye ||67 stuvīran puṇyamanasaḥ stutibhiḥ sūtamāgadhāḥ| vanderanvandinaścainaṃ severan gaṇikā api ||68 praviśantaṃ nijaṃ sthānamanugacchennarādhipaḥ| surādhipaṃ balāmātyapaurajānapadānvitaḥ ||69 prodyatkalakalārāvasusvarāḥ puruṣā yadi| utkṣipeyuḥ prahṛṣṭā vā vaheyurvā surādhipam ||70 tadā bhavati bhūpālo jayī nandanti ca prajāḥ| rāṣṭre sukhaṃ pure harṣo bhavennaśyanti cetayaḥ ||71 muñcatyutthāpitaḥ kṛcchrādyadi śayyāṃ sa gauravāt| tadā nṛpatirabhyeti mahatīṃ vimanaskatām ||72 skhalanto duḥkhitā dīnā niḥśvasantaḥ pade pade| vaicittyabhājo gaccheyurdeśahānistadā dhruvam ||73 bhūmau yadaikadeśena hrasitaḥ patati dhvajaḥ| na subhikṣaṃ na ca kṣemo na rājño vijayastadā ||74 dīrṇe bhagne'tha patite kṛtsne cāsmin samuddhṛte| syānnṛpasyāvanicchedaḥ sutadhvaṃso'thavā mṛtiḥ ||75 vastrālaṅkṛtimālyānāṃ haraṇāt patanāduta| tādṛśadra vyavidhvaṃsaḥ paurāṇāṃ bhavati dhruvam ||76 puraṃ bhavati niḥśabdaṃ niṣprabhaṃ vā praveśane| samucchraye vā śakrasya tadā tannāśamṛcchati ||77 śakraṃ svasthānamānītaṃ śīghraṃ sukhamavighnataḥ| prāgvatpradakṣiṇaṃ nyasyetprāgagraṃ śayane nije ||78 kuryāttatraiva nakṣatre śayyāsthasyāmareśituḥ| bhrame kuṣye ca saṃyogaṃ yathābhāgavikalpitam ||79 kuṣye saṃyojyamānaśceddhvajo nipatati kṣitau| tadā narapateḥ sthānabhraṃśo bhavati niścitaḥ ||80 kuṣyayoge yadā śakro vāmataḥ parivartate| tadā syātsthapatermṛtyurbhavedbhaṅgaśca dakṣiṇe ||81 svavedhaṃ pratipadyeta tadyaṣṭiryadi kṛcchrataḥ| pramādinastadā rājño jāyate vyasanaṃ mahat ||82 niṣkuṣya yojitaḥ śakradhvajo vighaṭate yadi| viśliṣyati tadā sandhiḥ sāmantaiḥ saha bhūpateḥ ||83 sphuṭedbhajyeta vā kuṣye yojyamāno'tha sarvataḥ| tadā bhaṅge nṛpavyādhiḥ sphuṭanādaṅganāvadhaḥ ||84 avidīrṇamaparyastamavyaṅgamavilambitam| yathāvannyāsamāyāti yogaṃ cedvāsavadhvajaḥ ||85 dhanabhṛtyāṅganāpatyaiḥ sāmantaiścānvito'nugaiḥ| nirātaṅko balāṅgaśca vṛddhimeti tadā nṛpaḥ ||86 yatnato rakṣyamāṇasya śayyāsthasyaiva vajriṇaḥ| tasyāṅgānyakhilānyeva kuṭanyādīni yojayet ||87 aindraṃ balākaṃ yakṣeśaṃ sarpamādaṃ digāhvayam| mayūraṃ cendra śīrṣaṃ ca piṭakāṣṭakamityadaḥ ||88 svapramāṇena kartavyaṃ spaṣṭarūpasamanvitam| tadākhyāścāntareṣveṣāṃ sandhayo vastranirmitāḥ ||89 mūlādanvagramāyātaiḥ svavaṃśairvidalairdṛḍhaiḥ| guṇaiśca varjayitvānyatsarvaṃ janapadaḥ smṛtaḥ| nagareṇa samaṃ kṛtsnaṃ rāṣṭraṃ deśo'tha maṇḍalam ||7 āvāsaḥ sadanaṃ sadma niketo mandiraṃ matam| saṃsthānaṃ nidhanaṃ dhiṣṇyaṃ bhavanaṃ vasatiḥ kṣayaḥ ||8 agāraṃ saṃśrayo nīḍaṃ gehaṃ śaraṇamālayaḥ| nilayo layanaṃ veśma gṛhamokaḥ pratiśrayaḥ ||9 gṛhasyoparibhūmiryā harmyaṃ tatparikīrtitam| tasyārohaṇamārgo yaḥ sopānaṃ tatpracakṣate ||10 kāṣṭhakairyatra racitaṃ sthūṇayoradhirohaṇam| sā niḥśreṇiriti proktā sopānairvipulaiḥ padaiḥ ||11 smṛtaḥ kāṣṭhaviṭaṅko'sau yatkāṣṭhaiḥ saṃvṛtaṃ gṛham| sudhāliptatalaṃ harmyaṃ saudhaṃ syātkuṭṭimaṃ ca tat ||12 varṣābhayena yā channa tālaśākadalādibhiḥ| smṛtābhiguptirantasthā sarvopari gṛhasya sā ||13 vātāyanaṃ tu bhittīnāmavalokanamucyate| laghurvātayano yaḥ syādavalokanakaṃ hi tat ||14 harmyasya madhye yacchidraṃ sa u loka iti smṛtaḥ| harmyaprākārakaḥ sa syātkaṇṭhā harmyatalasya yā ||15 vitardikāṣṭhamālā syātsarvataśchadamūlagā| tatstambheṣu mṛgā ye tu te syurīhāmṛgā iti ||16 niryūho harmyadeśādyaḥ kāṣṭhānāmupanirgamaḥ| valīkamiti vijñeyaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ chedādvinirgatam ||17 channaiścaturbhiḥ pārśvairyattaccatuśśālamucyate| tribhistriśālaṃ tatprāhurdvābhyāṃ tatsyāddviśālakam ||18 ekaśālakamekena cchannena gṛhamucyate| gṛhamekaṃ tu yacchannaṃ sarvaṃ śāleti sā smṛtā ||19 śālānāṃ yatpunarmadhyaṃ vāpī puṣkariṇī ca sā| saṃchannā cāpi yasya syāttadgarbhagṛhamucyate ||20 gṛhe mahājanasthānaṃ trikuḍyaṃ yatprakalpitam| upasthānaṃ tadatrāhuḥ syāccopasthānakaṃ laghu ||21 prāsādastu sa eva syādalpā prāsādikā smṛtā| dīrghaprāsādikā yāsau valabhītyabhidhīyate ||22 śālāgre valabhī yā syādalindeti vadanti tām| śālāṃ vinā tu valabhī valabheti nigadyate ||23 alpālpāstu catuṣkuḍyā ye te'pavarakā matāḥ| gṛhe cābhyantarasthānaṃ śuddhānta iti kīrtyate ||24 pratolīṃ tāṃ vidurlokaḥ suraṅgāmiva yāṃ vaset| sā kakṣetyuditā tajjñairyadavasthāntaraṃ gṛhe ||25 yadupasthānakaṃ nāma ye cāpavarakāstathā| te koṣṭhakā yā tu kaṇṭhā kuḍyaṃ bhittiścayaśca sā ||26 bhaktaśālā bhavedyā tu tanmahānasamucyate| yacchannaṃ dvāradeśe tu tamāhurdvārakoṣṭhakam ||27 praveśanamiti prāhurdvāranirgamanaṃ tathā| jalanirgamanasthānaṃ vijñeyamudakabhramaḥ ||28 bhavanasyāṅgaṇaṃ yattu tadāhurbhavanājiram| vanājiraṃ vanamahī tvāśramājiramāśrame ||29 uttarodumbarasyādhaḥ śliṣṭāṃ madhye ca kuḍyayoḥ| tajjñāstāṃ dehalītyāhuḥ kapāṭāśrayameva ca ||30 kapāṭaṃ dvārapakṣaḥ syātkapāṭapuṭameva ca| pakṣaḥ pidhānāvaraṇo dvārasaṃvaraṇaṃ tathā ||31 kapāṭaṃ saṃpuṭaste dve kapāṭayugalaṃ ca tat| kalikā dvārabandhārthā yā syāttāmargalāṃ viduḥ ||32 sā syādargalasūcīti yadi dīrghā pramāṇataḥ| purāṇāṃ sā tu parighaḥ phaliho gajavāraṇam ||33 chidrai rgavākṣapratimaiśchidri taṃ sarvatastu yat| phalakaṃ tadgavākṣaḥ syājjālamityapi kathyate ||34 harmyadvāre gṛhadvāre tathā harmyāvalokane| prākārāntarapṛṣṭhe tu yā ca prāsādikā bhavet ||35 pārśvayorubhayoreṣāṃ phalakadvayamucchritam| uparyupari saṃkṣiptamardhacandra dvayākṛti ||36 ānane dve yathā cāsmin śliṣṭairagryairmahādharaiḥ| tayorupari sandhau ca tārakākṛti maṇḍalam ||37 tattoraṇamiti proktaṃ yacca tena pariṣkṛtam| suvarṇatoraṇaṃ ca syānmaṇitoraṇameva ca ||38 puṣpatoraṇamapyetatkriyate puṣpakādibhiḥ| toraṇāgre ṭhakāro yaḥ siṃhakaṇaḥ sa ucyate ||39 nāmnā saṃyamanānīti gṛhasañcarabhūmayaḥ| gṛhasya pārśve yadyasmiṃstattatsaṃyamanaṃ viduḥ ||40 bhitteryadvātha dārūṇāṃ taraṅgāgravadānatam| marālapālī sā harmyātpraṇālī nirgamo'mbhasaḥ ||41 sa cā prākāra ityuktaḥ kaṇṭhaḥ syādaṅgaṇasya yaḥ| dvārasya tu samīpaṃ yatpradvāraṃ tadihocyate ||42 yadiṣṭakacitaṃ mūle dvārasya bhavati sthalam| dīrghaṃ vā hrasvamathavā tadāsthalakamiṣyate ||43 mūtrabhūmiramedhyeti varcasko'vaskarastathā| gṛhācca bhittisāmānyaṃ bāhyaṃ parisaro mataḥ ||44 vistīrṇamucchritaṃ yatsyādveśma so'ṭṭa udāhṛtaḥ| saṃkṣiptametadevoktaṃ tajjñairaṭṭālakākhyayā ||45 tadevātyantasaṃkṣiptamaṭṭālīti nigadyate| aṭṭālī yā tu nātyuccā tāmatrāṭṭālikāṃ viduḥ ||46 ekanāḍīgatacchidraiḥ kāṣṭhanālaiḥ pariśritam| yatra kāṣṭhapraṇālīti chadapṛṣṭhe'mbu dhāvati ||47 stambhaśīrṣakarūpāṇi kāṣṭhamūlāśritāni ca| suṣirāṇi prayatnena kāṣṭhanāḍīmukhāntaraiḥ ||48 rūpāṇāmatha teṣāṃ tu stananāsāmukhākṣibhiḥ| nānāsthānasthitānāṃ ca vṛṣavānaradaṃṣṭriṇām ||49 kṛtasūkṣmāntaracchidraiḥ pravarṣati samantataḥ| taddhārāgṛhamityuktaṃ dhārāgārādināmabhṛt ||50 kāṃsyairlohaistathā paṭṭairnirmṛṣṭādarśanirmalaiḥ| nicitā yasya bhittiḥ syāttaddarpaṇagṛhaṃ viduḥ ||51 pakṣadvāraṃ tadatrāhuryanmahādvārato'param| yatprākārāśritaṃ dvāraṃ pure tadgopuraṃ viduḥ ||52 nirgatāścocchritāścaiva prākārasyāntarāntarā| upakāryā iti proktāḥ kṣemāścāṭṭālakā matāḥ ||53 cayaprakāraśālāḥ syuḥ purīsaṃvaraṇābhidhāḥ| prākārādanupālāstu prākāra upaniṣkalāḥ ||54 krīḍāgṛhaṃ yadārāme tadudyānaṃ pracakṣate| tīre'mbhaso jalodyānaṃ jalaveśmāmbumadhyagam ||55 krīḍāgṛhaṃ yadatroktaṃ krīḍāgāraṃ taducyate| vihārabhūmirākrīḍabhūmirityabhidhīyate ||56 devadhiṣṇyaṃ surasthānaṃ caityamarcāgṛhaṃ ca tat| devatāyatanaṃ prāhurvibudhāgāramityapi ||57 channaṃ bhavedyattu mahājanasya sthānaṃ sabhā sā kathitā ca śālā| gavāṃ punarmandiramatra goṣṭhamācakṣate vāstuniveśavijñāḥ ||58 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre nagarakarvaṭagrāmagṛhāyatanasaṃjñā nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ| <19> atha catuḥśālavidhānaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| brūmo nṛpacamūnāthavarṇināṃ bhavanānyatha| praśastānyapraśastāni kṛtsnānyapi yathākramam ||1 veśmanāmekaśālānāṃ śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ smṛtam| dvāpañcāśaddviśālānāṃ triśālānāṃ dvisaptatiḥ ||2 catuḥśālāni veśmāni yāni teṣāṃ śatadvayam| pañcāśaccādhikā ṣaḍbhirvijñātavyā manīṣibhiḥ ||3 sahasraṃ pañcaśālānāṃ syāttathā pañcaviṃśatiḥ| ṣaṭśālānāṃ ṣaṇṇavatiḥ syātsahasracatuṣṭayam ||4 aṣṭāṅge tvekaśālasya bhedāḥ pañcāśadīritāḥ| dviśālānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ prabhedāḥ śatapañcakam ||5 śataṃ śataṃ ca pratyekaṃ triśālānāmudāhṛtam| dvicatvāriṃśadadhikaṃ catuḥśālaśatāṣṭakam ||6 dvinavatyuttarāṇyevaṃ śatāni daśa sapta ca| ṣoḍaśaiva sahasrāṇi ṣoḍaśonā catuḥśatī ||7 veśmāni saptaśālāni bhavanti parisaṅkhyayā| pañcaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi tathā pañcaśatāni ca ||8 gṛhāṇāmaṣṭaśālānāṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadaparā bhavet| lakṣadvayaṃ sahasrāṇi dviṣaṣṭiḥ śatameva ca ||9 gṛhāṇāṃ navaśālānāṃ catvāriṃśaccaturyutā| daśalakṣasahasrāṇi catvāriṃśattathāṣṭa ca ||10 śatāni daśaśālānāṃ pañca ṣaṭsaptatistathā| gṛhadvitayayogena saṃyuktākhyāni viṃśatiḥ ||11 gṛhadvitayayogena dvātriṃśadiha veśmanām| daśapañca tathānyāni bhavanti halakānyapi ||12 gṛhamālātha saṅghaṭṭo gṛhanābhirgṛhāṅgaṇam| udbhinnaṃ bhinnakakṣaṃ ca nilīnaṃ pratipāditam ||13 anyāni cāṣṭabhedāni bhavantyuttamavarṇinām| lakṣaṇaṃ nāma saṃsthānaṃ caiteṣāṃ pratipādyate ||14 varṇināṃ syāccatuḥśālaṃ mitaṃ dvātriṃśatā karaiḥ| senāpateścatuḥṣaṣṭistadvadeva purodhasaḥ ||15 śreṣṭhamaṣṭaśataṃ rājñāmetāni tu yathākramam| catuḥṣaḍaṣṭahānyā syuḥ pañcamaṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak ||16 viśodhayetkanīyobhirmadhyamāni yathākramam| narendra puruṣāṇāṃ syurveśmānyetāni vṛddhaye ||17 gṛhāṇi śodhayetprāgvajjyāyāṃsyapi ca madhyamaiḥ| bhavantyetāni bhūpānāṃ ratikośapratiśrayāḥ ||18 daśāṃśayukto vistārādāyāmo vipraveśmanām| aṣṭaṣaṭcaturaṃśāḍhyaḥ kṣatrāditrayaveśmanām ||19 yo vistāraḥ sa eva syādāyāmo'smin yathākramam| viṭśūdra yoḥ syādādhikyaṃ madhye jyeṣṭe ca sadmani ||20 karṇasūtrādbahiḥ stambhānnyaset sarvānprayatnataḥ| dhāmnāṃ ṣoḍaśahastānāṃ pañcānāṃ caturuttarā ||21 vṛddhiḥ śālāstu teṣāṃ syuścaturaṃśena vistṛtāḥ| śālāvyāsārdhato'lindaḥ sarveṣāmapi veśmanām ||22 tasyāḥ ṣoḍaśahaste syāt pañcamāṃśadvayena vā| saptamāṃśatrayeṇa syāddvayoraparaveśmanoḥ ||23 antyayorhastayoḥ sa syāccaturbhirnavamāṃśakaiḥ| pañcabhiḥ ṣaḍbhirebhiśca sārdhaiḥ sāṅghrinagaiḥ karaiḥ ||24 dairghyaṃ syāddaśabhiḥ sārdhaiḥ śālāyāḥ ṣoḍaśādiṣu| niveśadaśamāṃśo yaḥ sa yutaḥ saptabhiḥ karaiḥ ||25 śālāyā vistaraḥ proktaḥ śreṣṭhānāmiha veśmanām| alindamānaṃ prāgeva proktaṃ nikhilaveśmanām ||26 yacchālālindayoḥ śeṣaṃ bhavedgarbhagṛhaṃ hi tat| mūṣāvacchinnamicchanti śālādairdhyaṃ vipaścitaḥ ||27 śālāvyāsapramāṇā syātsarveṣāmavakosimā| diśāsu bhavane śālā vidiśākarṇasāmayaḥ ||28 karṇaśālā tu yā proktā sā ca jñeyāvakosimā| alindaśālayormadhye yā syānmūṣeti sā smṛtā ||29 pūrvadvāraṃ niyamyādāvādimūṣā taduttarā| mūṣā bhadrā iti prāhustatsaṃkhyāmavadhārayet ||30 yāvanmūṣaṃ bhavedveśma tāvadbhadraṃ taducyate| bhadrā bhadre śakradiksthe saumyāsaumye yamāśrite ||31 śāntāśānte pratīcīsthe saumyadiksthe śivāśive| alindā iti ke'pyāhurmūṣā ityapare viduḥ ||32 bhadrā iti jaguḥ kecidanye parisarā iti| ekadvitricatuḥpañcaṣaṭsaptāṣṭakrameṇa yāḥ ||33 mūṣāstāsāṃ pravahaṇāsaṃjñāḥ syurveśmanāmiha| tāsāmādyāḥ praśastāḥ syurapraśastāstataḥ parāḥ ||34 nāmato guṇataścaiva śubhāśubhaphalodayāt| aṣṭāvādau gurūnnyasyettataścādyaguroradhaḥ ||35 laghuṃ nyasyettataḥ śeṣān vidadhīta yathopari| gurubhiḥ pūrayedādiṃ yāvatsyurlaghavo'khilāḥ ||36 ādyapaṅktau guruścaiko laghuścaiko yathākramam| ataḥ paraṃ tu dviguṇāḥ pratipaṅkti bhavantyamī ||37 mūṣābhedāścatuḥśāle ṣaṭpañcāśacchatadvayam| alindavīthīpragrīvaniryūhakagavākṣakaiḥ ||38 tamaṅgabhadra vinyāsaracanābhiranekadhā| aparasparasaṃbādhātsaṃvṛtairvivṛtairapi ||39 gṛhabhedāḥ prasūyante yeṣāṃ saṃkhyā na vidyate| yatsaṃbaddhacatuśśālamamūṣālindakaṃ hi tat ||40 ekabhadrā digehānāṃ brūmo nāmānyataḥ param| yānyekalaghulakṣāṇi prastāre tāni tadvidaḥ ||41 kathayantyekabhadrā ṇi kramasaṃkhyāvibhāgataḥ| prāgāyataṃ prāgvilagnaṃ jayaṃ saṃyamanapriyam ||42 pratīcyaṃ prāsavinyāsaṃ subhadraṃ kalahottaram| aṣṭau tānyekabhadrā ṇi dvibhadrā ṇyabhidadhmahe ||43 pūrvottarottaraṃ pūrvādbhadrā diha vidhānataḥ| syātāṃ prāgmelakādyadvatpūrvādyā dakṣiṇā pare ||44 īraṃ sunīthamāgneyaṃ dvīpamāpyaṃ susaṃyamam| ardharcamaibhaṃ vyākośaṃ nairṛtaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ vinam ||45 kāvyaṃ vipāsamānīraṃ kāntaṃ saubhaṃ vipaścimam| gavayaṃ śrīvahaṃ śliṣṭaṃ gaṇaṃ bhīmamayogamam ||46 vartaṃ calaṃ śaṭhaṃ krāntamityaṣṭāviṃśako gaṇaḥ| dvibhadrā ṇāṃ samākhyātastribhadrā ṇāmataḥ param ||47 aindraṃ vilomamāyāmaṃ vadhamekākṣamantikam| prakāśaṃ paitramāyastaṃ bhadraṃ prāntaṃ prasādhakam ||48 kṣamaṃ vighātamāyātaṃ kāntaṃ citraṃ dvimandiram| sudakṣiṇaṃ bhayaṃ śliṣṭaṃ pramodaṃ vyāyataṃ viyat ||49 āpyaṃ sunāgaṃ nāgendra mīritaṃ śobhanaṃ ghanam| śastottaraṃ kaphaṃ karṇaṃ kruṣṭaṃ krāntaṃ kramāgatam ||50 dviśastaṃ dvibhayaṃ proktaṃ cakraṃ malayamāyatam| vanaṃ bhāraṃ sugārākhyamāgāraṃ vīrameva ca ||51 vyāyāmamāyutaṃ tadvadvyāhṛtaṃ ca tataḥ param| durgamaṃ kṣobhasaṃjñaṃ ca kṛtrimaṃ kṣobhaṇaṃ tathā ||52 cārurucyābhidhānaṃ ca dhruvaṃ kathamiti kramāt| ṣaṭpañcāśattribhadrā ṇi caturbhadrā ṇyataḥ param ||53 kṛtamarcāyanaṃ pauṣṇamudgataṃ miśramutsukam| vighnaṃ vipakṣamāhūtaṃ rucakaṃ vardhanaṃ pṛthu ||54 kalahaṃ chalamāyāsyaṃ trinābhaṃ svastikaṃ sthiram ||55 śaralaṃ dviguṇaṃ nādyaṃ citraṃ bhrāntaṃ vidhāraṇam| sādhāraṇaṃ nataṃ tryaṃśamṛṣaṃ rogaṃ viśeṣaṇam ||56 pratīcyaṃ trisamaṃ svairaṃ supratīkaṃ nalaṃ kṣapam| vyāptamākrīḍanaṃ vyarthamīśānaṃ sukhamavyayam ||57 magadhaṃ kṣipramāgastyamekojaṃ dvirgataṃ liham| parkaṃ vilomamuddaṇḍaṃ muṇḍaṃ mātaṅgamākhilam ||58 kharvaṃ pinākamudyantaṃ viśikhaṃ prasabhaṃ rajam| curukaṃ saphalaṃ vāmaṃ vardhanaṃ dhāvanaṃ saham ||59 cayaṃ sevyaṃ kalaṃ tīrṇaṃ caturbhadrā ṇi saptatiḥ| pañcabhadrā ṇyathocyante ṣaṭpañcāśadanukramāt ||60 kānalaṃ lolupaṃ jihmaṃ pragālaṃ sālinaṃ jinam| sujayaṃ vijayaṃ yāmaṃ jayaṃ jñātaṃ japaṃ tapam ||61 jamaṃ varaṃ caraṃ vairaṃ viśiṣaṃ suprabhaṃ prabham| pratīkṣaṃ kṣamiṇaṃ yuktaṃ śāntaṃ traitaṃ vinodanam ||62 sandohaṃ vipradohaṃ ca vidrutaṃ satataṃ tatam| vyākulaṃ līnamālīnaṃ vicitraṃ lambanaṃ kharam ||63 śekharaṃ vibudhaṃ caitraṃ vyāsaktaṃ saṃpadaṃ padam| triśikhaṃ caturaṃ prātaṃ susthitaṃ duḥsthitaṃ sthitam ||64 cakraṃ vakraṃ laghaṃ lābhaṃ saṃparkaṃ mūlamavyayam| aṣṭāviṃśatiranyāni ṣaḍbhadrā ṇi nibodhata ||65 kinnaraṃ kaustubhaṃ harmyaṃ dhārmikaṃ niṣadhaṃ vasu| sāṭikaṃ vāmanaṃ gauramasthiraṃ kramiṇaṃ khalam ||66 vivaraṃ vāliśaṃ dhaumaṃ tripuṣṭaṃ mandiraṃ bhavam| aśokaṃ bhāsvaraṃ cauṣyaṃ lātavyaṃ susvanaṃ makham ||67 vāji netraṃ bhramaṃ ghoṣaṃ saptabhadrā ṇyataḥ param| bhāṇḍīraṃ vaisahaṃ prasthaṃ pratānaṃ vāsulaṃ kaṭam ||68 lakṣmīvāsaṃ sugandhāntamaṣṭadhaitāni nāmataḥ | anyacca sarvatobhadra mekaṃ bhadrā bhiraṣṭabhiḥ ||69 saṃprakalpyaṃ catuḥśālaṃ brūmaścaiṣāṃ śubhāśubham| pradakṣiṇā śubhā mūṣā viparītā viparyaye ||70 samavāye yathā bhūyo jānīyātsādhvasādhu ca| tathāṣṭāvekabhadrā ṇi saptabhadrā ṇi ca kramāt ||71 dvibhadrā ṇyaṣṭabhiryuktā ṣaḍbhadrā ṇi ca viṃśatiḥ| ṣaṭpañcāśattribhadrā ṇi pañcabhadrā ṇi connayet ||72 saptatiśca caturbhadrā ṇyekaṃ bhadrā bhiraṣṭabhiḥ| evaṃ śatadvayaṃ piṇḍaḥ ṣaṭpañcāśacca veśmanām ||73 bhadraiḥ pūrvavidhānena catuḥśālākriyādiṣu| mūṣā syātkuḍyajaisteṣu catuśśāleṣu veśmasu ||74 anuvaṃśāśrite mūṣe svastike staḥparāṅmukhe| mukhāyate ca purato dve syātāmavakosime ||75 nodaṅmukhaḥ sa kartavyaḥ kāryaḥ prāgjīvasaṃyutaḥ| vardhamāne tathā kārye yathā prāggrīvasaṃyutaḥ ||76 vardhamāne tathā kārye dvāramūṣe mukhāyate| mūṣāyā dakṣiṇe syātāṃ dīrghavāme'vakosime ||77 nandyāvartagṛhe sarvā nandyāvartā bhavanti tāḥ| dve staru mūṣe rucake syātāmāyate tvavakosime ||78 sarvadvāravahā mūṣāḥ sarvatobhadra veśmani| ādimūṣā bhavedekā gṛhaṃ prāgāyataṃ hi tat ||79 dvitīyayā prāgvilagnamekayā tadanantaram| pradakṣiṇena veśmāni jayādīnyekayaikayā ||80 mūṣayā syuḥ kramādevaṃ kathyante tatphalānyatha| dhanamarthavināśaśca jayaścaivāśubhaṃ sadā ||81 prītiruddhegakalyāṇakalahāścāpyanukramāt| yatra pūrve ubhe mūṣe tadīraṃ parikīrtitam ||82 yatra pūrvā tṛtīyā ca tatsunītaṃ gṛhaṃ viduḥ| āgneye dvitṛtīye sto dvīpe cādyacaturthike ||83 dvicaturthyau tathā cāpye tricaturthyau susaṃyame| ardharce tvādyapañcamyau dvitīyaibhe sapañcamī ||84 vyākośe ca tripañcamyau nairṛte dviśarābhidhe| vṛṣabhe prathamāṣaṣṭhyau dviṣaṣṭhyau ca tathā vine ||85 kāvye tṛtīyā ṣaṣṭhī ca vipāse'bdhirasābhidhe| ānīre pañcamīṣaṣṭhyau sādyā kānte ca saptamī ||86 saubhe dvitīyāsaptamyau trisaptamyau vipaścime| gavaye saptamīturye śrīvahe pañcasaptamī ||87 saṣaṣṭhī saptamī śliṣṭe gaṇe pūrvāṣṭamī tathā| bhīme'ṣṭamī dvitīyā ca tryaṣṭamyau cāpyayogame ||88 varte caturthyaṣṭamī ca pañcamī cāṣṭamī cale| ṣaṣṭhyaṣṭamyau śaṭhe krānte saptamī cāṣṭamīti ca ||89 ityaṣṭāviṃśatiḥ proktā dvibhadrā ṇāmihaukasām| atha brūmastribhadrā ṇi tatraindraṃ puṣṭivardhanam ||90 syādyāmyapaścimadvāramādyamūṣātrayānvitam| ādyā dvitīyā turyā ca yasya dvāraṃ vipaścimam ||91 vilomaṃ nāma tadveśma śūdrā ṇāṃ puṣṭivardhanam| ādyā tṛtīyā turyā syādāyāme sarvatomukhe ||92 vadhe dvitricaturthyaḥ syurdvāraṃ ca syādudagdiśi| yatra sādye dvipañcamyāvekākṣaṃ tadudāhṛtam ||93 sādye yatra dvipañcamyau tatproktaṃ gṛhamantikam| yatra syurdvitripañcamyaḥ prakāśaṃ sarvavṛddhikṛt ||94 pūrvā caturthīpañcamyau yatra tatpaitramucyate| pañcamī dvicaturthyau ca yatrāyastaṃ tadīritam ||95 tricatuḥpañcamīyuktaṃ bhadra māhurmanīṣiṇaḥ| ādyā dvitīyā ṣaṣṭhī ca yatra tatprāntaśabditam ||96 ādyā tṛtīyā ṣaṣṭhī ca syātprasādhakaveśmani| tadbhavetsarvatodvāraṃ tathā sarvārthasādhakam ||97 dvitīyā ca tṛtīyā ca ṣaṣṭhī ca kṣamanāmani| tasya pratyagdiśi dvāraṃ śūdra vargasya ceṣṭadam ||98 ṣaṣṭhī caturthī cādyā ca syurvighātākhyaveśmani| ṣaṣṭhī dviturye yasmiṃstadāyātaṃ dakṣiṇāmukham ||99 ṣaṭcatustriyutaṃ kāntaṃ tatsyātsarvārthasādhakam| ṣaṭpañcādyānvitaṃ citraṃ tacca syādyāmyadiṅmukham ||100 dvitīyāpañcamīṣaṣṭhyo yasmin syustaddvimandiram| yatra tripañcamīṣaṣṭhyastadvadanti sudakṣiṇam ||101 caturthīpañcamīṣaṣṭhyo bhaye syustanna vṛddhikṛt| pūrvādvitīyāsaptamyo yatra tacchliṣṭasaṃjñitam ||102 yāmyāsyamidamicchanti śubhaṃ sarvārthadaṃ nṛṇām| sādye tṛtīyāsaptamyau pramode parikīrtite ||103 yatra syurdvitrisaptamyastadveśma vyāyataṃ smṛtam| yatrādyā ca caturthī ca saptamyapi ca tadviyat ||104 dvicatuḥsaptamīmūṣamāpyaṃ syāddakṣiṇāmukham| tricatussaptamībhistu sunāgaṃ veśma kīrtyate ||105 tacca yāmyāparamukhaṃ dhanadhānyasukhapradam| saptamī pañcamī pūrvā mūṣā nāgendra saṃjñite ||106 mūṣā dvipañcasaptamyo yāmyaṃ ca mukhamīrite| tripañcasaptamīmūṣāśobhitaṃ śobhanaṃ bhavet ||107 caturthī pañcamī yatra saptamyapi ca tadghanam| pūrvā ṣaṣṭhī saptamī ca smṛtā śastottare gṛhe ||108 dvitīyāsaptamīṣaṣṭhyo yamiṃstatkaphasaṃjñitam| dvāraṃ vāruṇametasya hitaṃ ca syāddvijanmanām ||109 karṇaṃ syātpaścimadvāraṃ triṣaṣṭhīsaptamīyutam| caturthīsaptamīṣaṣṭhyo mūṣāḥ syuḥ kruṣṭasaṃjñite ||110 saptamīpañcamīṣaṣṭhīyuktaṃ krāntaṃ yaśaskaram| ādyāṣṭamī dvitīyā ca mūṣā proktā kramāgate ||111 ādyāṣṭamī tṛtīyā ca dviśaste bhavane smṛtāḥ| yatrāṣṭamī tridvitīye dvibhayaṃ tadudāhṛtam ||112 ādyāṣṭamī caturthī ca yatra taccakrasaṃjñitaṃ| turyāṣṭamī dvitīyā ca yatra tanmalayaṃ viduḥ ||113 turyāṣṭamī tṛtīyā ca yatra tatproktamāyatam| ādyāṣṭamī pañcamī ca syādyasmiṃstadvanaṃ smṛtam ||114 dvitīyā pañcamī mūṣā yatra syādaṣṭamī tathā| tadbhārākhyamudagvaktraṃ śubhaṃ vighnakṛdanyathā ||115 tripañcamyaṣṭamībhistu sugāraṃ parikīrtitam| yatrāṣṭhamī tadāgāraṃ caturthī pañcamī tathā ||116 yasminnādyāṣṭamīṣaṣṭhyo vīraṃ tadiha kīrtitam| ṣaṣṭhyaṣṭamī dvitīyā ca gṛhe vyāyāmanāmani ||117 ṣaṣṭhyaṣṭamītṛtīyābhirmūṣābhiḥ proktamāyutam| ṣaṣṭhyaṣṭamīcaturthyaḥ syuryatra tadvyāhṛtaṃ viduḥ ||118 ṣaṣṭhyaṣṭamīpañcamībhirdurgamaṃ vyādhikṛnmatam| ādyāṣṭamīsaptamībhiḥ saṃyuktaṃ kṣobhamucyate ||119 dvisaptamyaṣṭamīyuktaṃ gṛhaṃ kṛtrimasaṃjñitam| trisaptamyaṣṭamībhistu mūṣābhiḥ kṣobhaṇaṃ bhavet ||120 cārurucyaṃ catuḥsaptamyaṣṭamībhiḥ samanvitam| saptapañcamyaṣṭamībhiryuktaṃ dhruvamiti smṛtam ||121 ṣaṭsaptamyaṣṭamīyuktaṃ kathaṃ sarvārthasiddhidam| ityuktāni tribhadrā ṇi śastānyeteṣu yāni ca ||122 tāni nityaṃ prayojyāni varṇānāṃ ca manīṣibhiḥ| ādyāścatasro mūṣāḥ syuryatra tatkṛtasaṃjñitam ||123 sarvadviguṇakṛtpūrvapratyagdvāraṃ nacānyathā| ādyāstisraḥ pañcamī ca yasminnarcāyanaṃ hi tat ||124 tadbhavetpaścimadvāraṃ gṛhaṃ sarvaguṇānvitam| yasminnādyā dvitīyā ca caturthī pañcamī tathā ||125 tatpauṣṇaṃ dakṣiṇadvāraṃ sarvavṛddhikaraṃ nṛṇām| ādyāstisrastathādyā ca yasmiṃstadgṛhamudgatam ||126 dvāreṇa paścimenaitacchasyate dakṣiṇena vā| dvyādyāścatasro yatra syustanmiśraṃ prītivardhanam ||127 praśastaṃ kṣatriyādīnāmasya dvāḥ prācyapāci vā| ādyāstisrastathā paṣṭhī yasmin mūṣāstadutsukam ||128 tacchastaṃ paścimadvāraṃ viprādīnāṃ jayāvaham| ādyā dvitīyā turyā ca mūṣā ṣaṣṭhī ca yatra tat ||129 yāmyāpratyaṅmukhaṃ śastaṃ vighnaṃ nāma kularddhitam| ādyā tṛtīyā turyā ca yasmin ṣaṣṭhī ca tacchubham ||130 vipakṣaṃ nāma dhāma syāddvāramasya ca paścimam| dvyādyāstisro gṛhe yasmin mūṣā ṣaṣṭhī ca tacchubham ||131 syādyāmyapaścimadvāramāhūtaṃ nāma tadgṛham| āyādvitīyāpañcamyo yatra ṣaṣṭhī ca tadbhavet ||132 rucakaṃ nāma yāmyaprāgadvāraṃ sakalakāmadam| ekatripañcaṣaṣṭhyaḥ syuryatra tadvardhamānakam ||133 prākpaścimottaradvāraṃ cātuvarṇyasya vṛddhidam| yatra syurdvitripañcamyo mūṣāḥ ṣaṣṭhī ca tadgṛham ||134 syātpūrvadakṣiṇadvāraṃ prathitaṃ pṛthusaṃjñayā| yasminnādyācatuḥpañcaṣaṣṭhyastat kalabhaṃ viduḥ ||135 guṇairupetaṃ sakalairudagdvāraṃ niketanam| dvicatuḥpañcamīṣaṣṭhyo yasmiṃstacchalamucyate ||136 dakṣiṇaṃ mukhametasya paścimaṃ vā praśasyate| catasarastryādayo yasminnāyāsyaṃ tadudīritam ||137 apraśastaṃ vadantyetat tadvido bhavanādhamam| ādyāstisraḥ saptamī ca mūṣāḥ syuryatra tadgṛham ||138 trinābhamuttaradvāraṃ śastaṃ sarvaguṇānvitam| ādyādvituryāsaptamyo yatra tatsvastikaṃ smṛtam ||139 prākpaścimottaradvāraṃ cāturvarṇye'pi śasyate| ādyācaturthīsaptamyo mūṣāḥ syuryatra veśmani ||140 tadiha sthiramityuktaṃ dvāraṃ caitasya dakṣiṇam| dvyādyāstisraḥ saptamī ca yatra tatsaralaṃ viduḥ ||141 tadbhavetpaścimadvāraṃ sarvadoṣojjhitaṃ gṛham| yatrādyā ca dvitīyā ca pañcamī saptamī tathā ||142 dviguṇaṃ nāma tadveśma dvāraṃ cāsya yathepsitam| ādyātṛtīyāpañcamyaḥ saptamyapi ca yatra tat ||143 nādyaṃ nāmātiśīlādyaṃ praśastaṃ sarvadehinām| dvitīyā ca tṛtīyā ca pañcamī saptamī gṛhe ||144 yatra taccitranāmeṣṭadvāraṃ citraguṇairvṛtam| ādyāvaturthīpañcamyo yatra syuḥ saptamī tathā ||145 tadbhrāntaṃ nāma pūrvodagdvāraṃ bhavanamṛddhikṛt| yatra dvitīyā turyā ca pañcamī saptamī tathā ||146 vidhāraṇaṃ gṛhaṃ tatsyātsarvakāmavivardhanam| tṛtīyā yatra turyā ca pañcamī saptamī tathā ||147 tatsādhāraṇamityāhuḥ sarvadvāraṃ sukhāvaham| ādyā dvitīyā ṣaṣṭhī ca saptamī yatra tannatam ||148 ādyā dvitīyā ṣaṣṭhī ca tryaṃśe syātsaptamī tathā| dvitīyā ca tṛtīyā ca ṛṣe ṣaṣṭhī ca saptamī ||149 ādyā turyā ca ṣaṣṭhī ca roge syātsaptamī tathā| yatra dvitīyā turyā ca syāt ṣaṣṭhī saptamī ca tat ||150 viśoṣaṇaṃ nāma gṛhaṃ dakṣiṇottaradiṅmukham| tṛtīyā yatra turyā ca syāt ṣaṣṭhī saptamī gṛhe ||151 pratīcyamīpsitadvāraṃ tadgṛhaṃ sarvakāmadam| yatrādyāpañcamīṣaṣṭhīsaptamyastrisamaṃ hi tat ||152 prabhūtavṛddhidaṃ veśma samastairanvitaṃ guṇaiḥ| dvitīyāpañcamīṣaṣṭhīsaptamyo yatra veśmani ||153 tadiha svairamityāhurdhanadhānyasukhāvaham| tṛtīyāpañcamīṣaṣṭhīsaptamyo dvāramuttaram ||154 paścimaṃ vā bhavedyatra supratīkaṃ ca vṛddhikṛt| turyādyābhiścatasṛbhirnalamuttaradiṅmukham ||155 ādyādvitryaṣṭamībhiḥ syātsarvarugbhītikṛt kṣayam| vyāpte pūrvā dvitīyā ca syāccaturthī tathāṣṭamī ||156 ādyātṛtīyāturyāḥ syurākrīḍe tadvadaṣṭamī| dvyādyāstisraḥ kramādvyarthe mūṣāḥ syādaṣṭamī tathā ||157 īśānākhye syurādyādvitripañcamyo'ṣṭamī tathā| pūrvāṣṭamītripañcamyo yasmiṃstat sukhasaṃjñitam ||158 tatpūrvodaṅmukhaṃ vṛddhyai jāyate hānaye'nyathā| yatra syuraṣṭamīdvitripañcamyastadihāvyayam ||159 dvāraṃ yatheṣṭametasya vāstuvidyāvido jaguḥ| yasmin pūrvāṣṭamīturyāpañcamyo magadhaṃ hi tat ||160 prāgudakpaścimadvāramidaṃ śaṃsanti sūrayaḥ| yatra dvituryāpañcamyo mūṣāḥ syustadvadaṣṭamī ||161 tatkṣiptaṃ nāma sukhakṛdyatheṣṭaṃ dvāramiṣyate| tripañcamyaṣṭamīturyā āgastye paścimāmukhe ||162 dvitīyādyāṣṭamīṣaṣṭhyo yatraikojaṃ taducyate| tṛtīyādyāṣṭamīṣaṣṭhyo yatra taddvirgataṃ gṛham ||163 dvitriṣaṣṭhyo'ṣṭamī cāpi yasmiṃstallihamucyate| ādyāturyāṣṭamīṣaṣṭhyo yatra tatparkamucyate ||164 ṣaṣṭhyaṣṭamīdvituryābhiḥ syādvilomābhidhaṃ gṛham| ṣaṣṭhyaṣṭamīdvituryābhiruddaṇḍamiti kīrtitam ||165 yasminnādyāṣṭamīṣaṣṭhīpañcamyo muṇḍameva tat| dvipañcamyaṣṭamīṣaṣṭhyo mūṣā mātaṅgasaṃjñite ||166 tripañcamyaṣṭamīṣaṣṭhyo bhavantyaskhalanāmani| tatkharvanāma turyādyāstisro yasmiṃstathāṣṭamī ||167 ādyādvitīyāsaptamyaḥ pināke syustathāṣṭamī| trisaptamyaṣṭamīpūrvā yatrodyantaṃ taducyate ||168 aṣṭamīdvitripañcamyo yasmiṃstadviśikhaṃ gṛham| ādyā caturthīsaptamyaḥ prasabhe syustathāṣṭamī ||169 raje dvituryāsaptamyo mūṣāḥ syustadvadaṣṭamī| trisaptamyaṣṭamīturyā yatra tadrucakaṃ viduḥ ||170 prākpratyagdvārametasya śūdrā ṇāmativṛddhidam| saptamyādyāṣṭamī mūṣā pañcamyapi ca saiphale ||171 vāme dvipañcasaptamyo mūṣā jñeyāstathāṣṭamī| tripañcasaptamyaṣṭamyo yasmiṃstadvardhamānakam ||172 viśeṣato vṛddhikaraṃ vaiśyānāmiti tadvidaḥ| catuḥpañcāṣṭasaptamyo yasmiṃstaddhāvanaṃ bhavet ||173 saptamyādyāṣṭamīṣaṣṭhyo yatra tatsahamucyate| dvisaptaṣaṣṭhyaṣṭamībhirmūṣābhiścayanaṃ bhavet ||174 ṣaṣṭhyaṣṭamīdvisaptamyo yasmiṃstat sevyamīritam| yatra turyāṣṭamī ṣaṣṭhī saptamī ceti tatkalam ||175 tīrṇe ṣaṣṭhyaṣṭamīpañcasaptamyaḥ sarvakāmade| yatrādyāḥ pañca tat proktaṃ kānalaṃ sarvakāmadam ||176 ekadvitricatuḥṣaṣṭhyo yatra tallolupaṃ smṛtam| ādyāstisraḥ pañcaṣaṣṭhyau yasmiṃstajjihmamucyate ||177 pragāle pañcamīṣaṣṭhīturyāpūrvādvitīyakāḥ| trituryāpañcamīṣaṣṭhyaḥ sādyāḥ syuḥ sālinābhidhe ||178 yatra dvitricatuḥpañcaṣaṣṭhyastajjinamucyate| ekadvitricaturthyaḥ syuḥ sujaye saptamīyutāḥ ||179 pañcamīsaptamīdvitripūrvāḥ syurvijayābhidhe| yatraikadvicatuḥpañcasaptamyo yāmanāma tat ||180 yatraikatricatuḥpañcasaptamyastajjayaṃ viduḥ| mūṣā dvitricatuḥpañcasaptamyo jñātasaṃjñite ||181 ādyāstisrastathā ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyau yatra tajjapam| ādyādvituryāṣaṣṭhībhiḥ saptamyā ca tapaṃ viduḥ ||182 ṣaṣṭhītrituryāsaptamyo jaye me pūrvānvitā matāḥ| dvitrituryāstathā ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyau varasaṃjñite ||183 caraṃ tadyatra pūrve dve pañcaṣaṭsaptamīyute| caitye syātsaptamī ṣaṣṭhī pañcamyādyā tṛtīyakā ||184 viśirave dvitripañcamyaḥ syāt ṣaṣṭhī saptamī tathā| caturthī pañcamī ṣaṣṭhī saptamyādyā ca suprabhe ||185 prabhākhye dvicatuḥpañcaṣaṣṭhyaḥ syuḥ saptamī tathā| tricatuḥpañcasaptamyaḥ ṣaṣṭhī ca syātpratīkṣake ||186 ādyāścatasro yatra syuḥ sāṣṭamyaḥ kṣamiṇaṃ hi tat| sapta pūrvā dvitripañcamyo yuktanāmni tathāṣṭamī ||187 śānte dvituryāpañcamyaḥ pūrvā syādaṣṭamī tathā| pūrvātrituryāpañcamyaḥ sāṣṭamyastraitasaṃjñite ||188 vinode dvitripañcamyaścaturthī cāṣṭamī tathā| sandohe tvaṣṭamiṣaṣṭhyau tisraḥ pūrvādikāstathā ||189 ādyādvituryāṣaṣṭhībhiraṣṭamyā vipradohakam| ṣaṣṭhyaṣṭamītrituryādyā yasmiṃstadvidrutaṃ viduḥ ||190 dvitrituryāṣṭamīṣaṣṭhyo yatra tatsatataṃ matam| ādyādvipañcamīṣaṣṭhyastatanāmni tathāṣṭamī ||191 ādyātripañcamīṣaṣṭhyo vyākule syustathāṣṭamī| dvitripañcacatuṣṣaṣṭhyo vijñeyā līnasaṃjñake ||192 turyādyāpañcamīṣaṣṭhya ālīne syustathāṣṭamī| dvituryāpañcamīṣaṣṭhyo vicitre tadvadaṣṭamī ||193 ādyāścatasro mūṣāḥ syuḥ sāṣṭamyo lambanāhvaye| ādyāstisro'ṣṭamī tadvatsaptamyapi bhavet khare ||194 śekhare saptamīturyādvitīyādyāstathāṣṭamī| vibudhe tvaṣṭamī turyā tṛtīyādyātha saptamī ||195 caitrākhye dvyaṣṭamīturyāsaptamyaḥ satṛtīyakāḥ| ādyādvipañcasaptamyo vyāsaktākhye tathāṣṭamī ||196 ādyātripañcasaptamyaḥ sāṣṭamyaḥ sampadābhidhe| yatra dvitryaṣṭamīpañcasaptamyastatpadaṃ viduḥ ||197 turyādyāpañcamī ṣaṣṭhī saptamyastriśikhe tathā| dvipañcamyaṣṭamīturyāsaptamyaścaturābhidhe ||198 trisaptamyaṣṭamīturyāpañcamyaḥ prāntanāmani| ādyādvitīyāsaptamyaḥ ṣaṣṭhyaṣṭamyau ca susthite ||199 duḥsthitaṃ yatra ṣaṣṭhyādyā caturthī saptamī tathā| sthite'ṣṭamīdvisaptamyastriṣaṣṭhyāvapi ca smṛte ||200 cakre ṣaṣṭhyaṣṭamīturyāsaptamyādyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ| vakre dvitīyāsaptamyau ṣaṣṭhyaṣṭamyau caturthikā ||201 ladhe'ṣṭamītrisaptamyasturyāṣaṣṭhyau ca kīrtite| pañcamīsaptamīṣaṣṭhyo lābhe pūrvāṣṭamī tathā ||202 dvipañcasaptamyaṣṭamyaḥ ṣaṣṭhī saṃparkasaṃjñite| tripañcaṣaṣṭhīsaptamyo mūlanāmni tathāṣṭamī ||203 syuraṣṭasaptaṣaṭpañcacaturthyastvavyayābhidhe| pūrvādyā yatra ṣaṇmūṣāḥ kinnaraṃ nāma tadgṛham ||204 yatrādyāpañcasaptamyo saha tatkaustubhaṃ viduḥ| pūrvādvitricatuḥṣaṣṭhīsaptamyo harmyasaṃjñite ||205 saptamī pañcamī ṣaṣṭhī dvitripūrvāśca dhārmike| niṣadhe dvicatuḥpañcaṣaṣṭhyādyāḥ saptamī tathā ||206 tricatuḥpañcaṣaṭsaptamyādyāḥ syuryatra tadvasu| sāṭīke tricatuḥpañcadviṣaṣṭhyaḥ syustathāṣṭamī ||207 yatrādyāpañcasaptamyo vāmanaṃ nāma tadviduḥ| ādyādvitricatuḥṣaṣṭhyaḥ sāṣṭamyo gauranāmani ||208 ādyādvitryaṣṭamīṣaṣṭhyaḥ pañcamī cāsthirābhidhe| kramiṇe tricatuḥpañcapūrvāḥ ṣaṣṭhyaṣṭamī tathā ||209 khale pūrvāṣṭamīṣaṣṭhītrituryāḥ pañcamīyutā| vivare tricatuḥpañcadviṣaṣṭhyaḥ syustathāṣṭamī ||210 ādyādvitricatuḥsaptamyaṣṭamyo bāliśābhidhe| pūrvāṣṭamīdvitrisaptapañcamyo dhaumanāmani ||211 tripuṣṭe dvicatuḥpañcasaptamyādyāstathāṣṭamī| mandire tricatuḥpañcasaptamyādyāsathāṣṭamī ||212 bhave dvitricatuḥpañcamyaṣṭamyaḥ saptamī tathā| aśoke dvitriṣaṭsaptamyaṣṭamyaḥ pūrvayā sahi ||213 bhāsvare dvicatuḥṣaṣṭhyaḥ saptamyādyāṣṭamīyutā| trisaptamyaṣṭamīṣaṣṭhīturyādyāścauṣyasaṃjñite ||214 dvitrituryāṣṭamiṣaṣṭhyo lātavye saptamī tathā| dvisaptamyaṣṭamīṣaṣṭhīpañcamyādyāśca susvane ||215 tripañcamyaṣṭamīṣaṣṭhīsaptamyādyāstathā makhe| dvitrisaptāṣṭamīṣaṣṭhīpañcamyo vājisaṃjñite ||216 netre pūrvācatuḥpañcaṣaṭsaptamyo'ṣṭamī tathā| bhrame syurdvicatuḥpañcaṣaṭsaptamyo'ṣṭamī tathā ||217 ghoṣe ca tricatuḥpañcaṣaṭsaptamyo'ṣṭamī tathā| ekadvitricatuḥpañcaṣaṭsaptamyo bhavanti cet ||218 mūṣāstadānīṃ bhāṇḍīramiti prāhurniveśanam| ekadvitricatuḥpañcaṣaṣṭhyo yatra tathāṣṭamī ||219 tadvaisanamiti prāhurvāstuvidyāvido gṛham| ekadvitricatuḥpañcasaptāṣṭamyo gṛhe yadi ||220 mūṣā bhavanti tadvidyātprasthamityabhidhānataḥ| ekadvitricaturthyaḥ syuḥ ṣaṣṭhī saptamyathāṣṭamī ||221 yasmin mūṣāstadatrāhuḥ pratānamiti mandiram| caturthīvarjitābhiḥ syānmūṣābhirveśma vāsulam ||222 kaṭaṃ tṛtīyāhīnābhirvijñātavyaṃ niveśanam| mūṣābhiradvitīyābhirlakṣmīvāsumudāhṛtam ||223 sugandhāntamanādyābhiraṣṭābhiḥ sarvabhadra kam| ityekabhadra prabhṛtīni veśmānyuktāni yāvadgṛhamaṣṭabhadra m| etāṃścatuśśālagṛhaprabhedān yo vetti pūjāṃ sa labheta loke ||224 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre catuśśālavidhānaṃ nāma ekonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <20> atha nimnoccādiphalāni nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| agrataḥpṛṣṭhataḥśabdau dvāreṇa niyatau gṛhe| yato dvāraṃ tadagraṃ syātpṛṣṭhaṃ pṛṣṭhamudāhṛtam ||1 dra vyāyāmodayavyāsaiḥ śālā yatrādhikā bhavet| vāmā vā dakṣiṇā vapi agrataḥ pṛṣṭhato'pi vā ||2 hanti dra vyādhikā dra vyamāyāmābhyadhikā kulam| ucchrāyābhyadhikā pūjāṃ santatiṃ vistarādhikā ||3 yasya nimnā bhavedbhūmirvāmā dakṣiṇakāsthalā| bahudoṣaṃ hi tadvāstu putrapautravināśakam ||4 yasya dakṣiṇakā nimnā bhūmirvāmāsthalā bhavet| yatnenāpi kṛtaṃ tatsyādbharturalpaphalodayam ||5 paścimena bhavennimnā bhūmiḥ sthūlatarāgrataḥ| yatra tatsarvavarṇeṣu sarvakāmapradaṃ gṛham ||6 agrataśca yadā hīnaṃ pṛṣṭhataścocchritaṃ bhavet| bhavanaṃ svāmino hyāśu virāgavyasanāya tat ||7 sacchatraṃ ca sakakṣaṃ ca tathaiva saparikramam| saprabhaṃ ca samākhyātaṃ gṛhamatra caturvidham ||8 bāhyodakaṃ ca sacchatraṃ sakakṣamubhayodakam| sāvaśyāyaṃ tu yadveśma tadvidyātsaparikramam ||9 ekenāpyatra mukhataḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ pārśvato'pi vā| saprabhaṃ syādalindena lakṣaṇaṃ tu pṛthakpṛthak ||10 eko'lindastu kartavyo mukhato dakṣiṇena vā| mukhe rājaprasādāya dakṣiṇe'rthavivardhanaḥ ||11 vāmatastu na kartavya eko'lindo na pṛṣṭhataḥ| vāmato'rthavināśāya pṛṣṭhato mriyate gṛhī ||12 yasya syātāmalindau dvau gṛhasyobhayapārśvayoḥ| dhanalābhaṃ vijānīyāttatpraveśe kuḍumbinaḥ ||13 yasya syātāmalindau dvāvagrataḥ pṛṣṭhatastathā| dhanadhānyamavāpnoti saubhāgyaṃ cāpi tadgṛhī ||14 yasya vā halakālindo mukhato dakṣiṇena vā| rājaprasādaistatsvāmī dhanadhānyaiśca vardhate ||15 vāmato halakālindo mukhataśca kṛto yadi| rājadaṇḍabhayaṃ vidyātpatnī cāsya vinaśyati ||16 dakṣiṇo halakālindaḥ paścimaśca kṛto yadi| tataḥ parāpi vṛddhiḥ syātsaubhāgyaṃ ca paraṃ bhavet ||17 pṛṣṭhato halakālindo vāmataśca kṛto yadi| kalatramaraṇaṃ tatra bhaveddurbhagatāpi ca ||18 pṛṣṭhato vāmataścaiva purato dakṣiṇena vā| alindasya kṛtasyātha vakṣyāmo'nukramātphalam ||19 pṛṣṭhato dāranāśāya dhanalābhāya dakṣiṇe| agre rājaprasādāya vāmato'rthavināśanaḥ ||20 samāpitaṃ tu yadvāstu sarvataḥ pariśodhitam| svāminastadbhaveddhanyaṃ sthapateśca yaśaskaram ||21 arjitaṃ vardhate tasya vṛddhiśca syānnṛpaśriyā| dharmakāmāśca vardhante kīrttirāyuryaśo balam ||22 nityaṃ prakrīḍitajanaṃ nityaṃ sannihitaśri tat| nṛtyavāditragītaiśca nityāmodaṃ nirāmayam ||23 tatra naikaprakārāṇi triśālānyupalakṣayet| prakāreṣu ca sarveṣu nindyau yāmyāparojjhitau ||24 ekasminsvāmino mṛtyuraparasmin dhanakṣayaḥ| pūrvottarojjhitau dhanyau saṃjñāścaiṣāṃ prakārataḥ ||25 syurudakpūrvayāmyāpyaśalāhīnānyanukramāt| hiraṇyanābhasukṣetracullīpakṣaghnanāmabhiḥ ||26 viniyogo yathālindamalindavyūḍhiricchayā| veśmānyatha dviśālāni kīrtyante ṣaḍ yathākramam ||27 dikkarṇesu dviśālāni tatkarṇānyeṣu nirdiśet| saṃmukhe dve sametāni ṣaḍetānyupalakṣayet ||28 siddharthaṃ dakṣiṇāpratyagbhavantyatrārthasiddhayaḥ| yamasūryamudakpratyaktatra mṛtyubhayaṃ sadā ||29 prāgudīcyostu daṇḍaḥ syāddaṇḍastatra sadā bhavet| prāgyāmyayostu vātākhyaṃ vāstu tatkalahottaram ||30 udagdakṣinasāmmukhye dviśālaṃ kācavāstviti| tatra jñātivirodhaḥ syānna tatkuryātkadācana ||31 prākpratīcyostu sāmmukhye cullīvāstu vinirdiśet| tatra vittakṣayo ghoraḥ kadāpyetanna kārayet ||32 catuśśālaṃ triśālena prāntaṃ prākāravartinā| pūrveṇa saptaśāleṣu maṇicchanda iti smṛtam ||33 anyāni caivaṃ trīṇyāhuḥ prāntameva pradakṣiṇam| aparaṃ paridhānaṃ ca sapakṣamiti tāni ca ||34 ekabhittī tu śāle dve gṛhasaṃghaṭṭa ucyate| na taṃ kuryātsa hi sadā bandhadoṣavadhapradaḥ ||35 ityuccanīcagṛhabhāgaphalaṃ pradiṣṭa-| masminnalindaphalamapyaśubhaṃ śubhaṃ ca| yaddvitriśālagṛhalakṣma tadapyamuṣmin| sāmānyato dvitayayogabhavaṃ ca samyak ||36 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre nimnoccalacchatrādisaṃjñālindaphalasadvāstuphaladviśālatriśālagṛha-saṅghaṭṭalakṣaṇaphalāni nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <21> atha dvāsaptatitriśālalakṣaṇaṃ nāmaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| atha dvāsaptaterbrūmastriśālānāṃ yathākramam| abhighānāni kārtsnyena lakṣaṇāni pṛthakpṛthak ||1 mukhyāni teṣu catvāri kathyante tāni nāmataḥ| hiraṇyanābhaṃ sukṣetraṃ cullī pakṣaghnameva ca ||2 hiraṇyanābhamutkṛṣṭaṃ hīnamuttaraśālayā| tatsyāddhanapradaṃ bhartuḥ sukṣetraṃ pūrvayā vinā ||3 sukṣetraṃ lakṣaṇopetamṛddhivṛddhipradaṃ vibhoḥ| cullī dakṣiṇayā hīnā śālayā vittanāśinī ||4 pakṣaghnaṃ paścimāhīnaṃ vairakṛtkulanāśanam| alindayogādeteṣāṃ laghuprastārayogataḥ ||5 mūṣāyogācca bhedāḥ syuraṣṭādaśa pṛthakpṛthak| jāmbūnadaṃ hiraṇyākhyaṃ rukmākhyaṃ hemasaṃjñitam ||6 kanakaṃ kāñcanaṃ svarṇaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca tataḥ param| santāpasaṃjñaṃ sāraṃ ca tathā cāmīkarāhvayam ||7 tapanaṃ tāpanīyaṃ ca śātakumbhamathāpi ca| hiraṇyanābhaṃ kalyāṇaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ bhūtibhūṣaṇam ||8 bhedā hiraṇyanābhasyetyaṣṭādaśa bhavantyamī| nāgaṃ sūryaprabhākhyaṃ ca mattavāraṇakaṃ tathā ||9 caturthaṃ kesarītyuktaṃ vāsavaṃ cendra meva ca| hariṃham̐ saṃ sārasāṇḍaṃ kuñjaraṃ toyadaṃ tathā ||10 meghamālābhidhānaṃ ca dhārāsāraṃ mahodaram| kardamaṃ nāmataścānyat sukṣetraṃ prakaraṃ tathā ||11 sukṣetrānugatānyāhustathānyaddhānyapūrakam| cullībhedānatha brūmasteṣāmādyaṃ bhujaṅgamam ||12 nirjīvākhyaṃ vihaṅgaṃ ca nakulaṃ pannagāhvayam| śatacchidraṃ ca sarpaṃ ca kopasaṃjñaṃ bhagandaram ||13 udvejanākhyaṃ sannyāsaṃ nistoṣaṃ karuṇānanam| vāraṇaṃ dāraṇaṃ cullī kakudaṃ kandaraṃ tathā ||14 iti cullīprabhedeṣu mandirāṇi daśāṣṭa ca| brūmaḥ pakṣaghnasaṃbaddhagṛhanāmāni samprati ||15 rākṣasaṃ dhvāntasaṃhāraṃ devāri suradāruṇam| ghoṣaṇaṃ vyāghraśārdūle śoṣaṇākhyaṃ viśoṣaṇam ||16 mattadaṃ ca nirānandaṃ śākunaṃ vighnanirghṛṇe| ripusaṃhadapakṣaghne sutaghna vairipūraṇam ||17 ityaṣṭādaśa pakṣaghnabhedāḥ proktā yathākramam| hiraṇyanābhabhedeṣu dhanyaṃ jāmbūnadaṃ gṛham ||18 ādyādyābhiścatasṛbhirmūṣābhirupalakṣitam| yatrādyādvitripañcamyo hiraṇyaṃ nāma tacchubham ||19 pañcamyādyādvituryābhiḥ syādrukmaṃ rukmadaṃ gṛham| ādyātrituryāpañcamyo yatra taddhemasaṃjñitam ||20 dvitrituryāpañcamībhiḥ kanakaṃ kanakāvaham| sādyābhirdvitriṣaṣṭhībhiḥ kāñcanaṃ kāñcanapradam ||21 ādyādvituryāṣaṣṭhībhiḥ svarṇaṃ svarṇavivṛddhaye| suvarṇamādyātricatuḥṣaṣṭhībhiḥ syātsuvarṇadam ||22 syāddvitrituryāṣaṣṭhībhiḥ santāpaṃ tāpaśāntikṛt| ādyādvipañcamīṣaṣṭhyo yatra tatsāramuttamam ||23 cāmīkaraṃ triṣaṣṭhyādyāpañcamībhirgṛhottamam| dvitriṣaṭpañcamībhiḥ syāttapanaṃ nāma mandiram ||24 ṣaṭturyādyāpañcamībhistāpanīyamudāhṛtam| śātakumbhaṃ dviṣaṭpañcacaturthībhirbhavedgṛham ||25 hiraṇyanābhaṃ tricatuḥpañcaṣaṣṭhībhirīritam| kalyāṇamādyātricatuḥpañcaṣaṣṭhībhirucyate ||26 ṣaṭpañcadvitrituryābhirbhaved bhūṣaṇasaṃjñitam| ādyādvitricatuḥpañcaṣaṣṭhībhirbhūtabhūṣaṇam ||27 atha sukṣetrabhedānāṃ lakṣaṇānyabhidadhmahe| yatrādyādvitrituryābhistannāgaṃ nāma mandiram ||28 yatrādyādvitripañcamyastatsūryaprabhamucyate| ādyādvituryāpañcamyo yatra tanmattavāraṇam ||29 ādyātrituryāpañcamyo yatra tatkesarīṃ viduḥ| vāsavaṃ pañcamīturyādvitīyābhistaducyate ||30 ṣaṣṭhyādyātridvitīyābhirindra mandiramīritam| ādyādvituryāṣaṣṭhībhirharisaṃjñamudāhṛtam ||31 ādyātrituryāṣaṣṭhībhirhaṃsasaṃjñaṃ niveśanam| ṣaṣṭhīdvitricaturthībhiḥ sārasaṃ nāmato bhavet ||32 ādyādvipañcaṣaṣṭhībhiḥ kathayantīha kuñjaram| ādyātripañcaṣaṣṭhībhirvijñeyaṃ toyadaṃ gṛham ||33 meghamālaṃ triṣaṭpañcadvitīyābhirudāhṛtam| dhārāsāraṃ catuḥpañcaṣaḍādyābhirbhavedgṛham ||34 dvicatuḥpañcaṣaṣṭhībhirmahodaramiti smṛtam| kardamaṃ nāma ṣaṭpañcatrituryābhirjayāvaham ||35 ṣaṭpañcaturyātryādyābhiḥ sukṣetraṃ syāddhanapradam| dvitriṣaṭpañcaturyābhirbhavetprakaramṛddhidam ||36 ādyābhiśca ṣaḍetābhirvijñeyaṃ dhānyapūrakam| aṣṭādaśaite sukṣetragṛhabhedāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||37 ādyādvitricaturthībhirmūṣābhiḥ syādbhujaṅgamam| nirjīvamādyāpañcatridvitīyābhirniveśanam ||38 ādyādvipañcaturyābhirvahantībhirvidantīha vihaṅgamam| pañcādyātricaturthībhirmūṣābhirnakulaṃ viduḥ ||39 pañcadvitricaturthībhiḥ pannagaṃ nāmato bhavet| śatacchidraṃ ṣaḍādyātridvitīyābhirbhavedgṛham ||40 ādyādvituryāṣaṣṭhībhiḥ sarpamityabhidhīyate| ādyātriṣaṭcaturthībhiḥ kopamityabhiśabditam ||41 ṣaṭcatustridvitīyābhirbhavedveśma bhagandaram| ādyādvipañcaṣaṣṭhībhirudvejanamudāhṛtam ||42 sannyāsamādyāpañcatriṣaṣṭhībhirbhavanādhamam| dvitriṣaṭpañcamībhistu nistoyamabhidhīyate ||43 turyādyāpañcaṣaṣṭhībhiḥ karuṇānanamucyate| dvicatuḥpañcaṣaṣṭhībhirvāraṇaṃ mukhavāraṇam ||44 tricatuḥpañcaṣaṣṭhībhirdāraṇaṃ śrīvidāraṇam| cullyādyātricatuḥpañcaṣaṣṭhībhirvittanāśanam ||45 ṣaṭpañcadvitrituryābhiḥ kakudaṃ nāma mandiram| kandaraṃ ṣaṭcatuḥpañcatridvyādyābhirgṛhādhamam ||46 athāṣṭādaśa kathyante bhedāḥ pakṣaghnasaṃśrayāḥ| teṣu rākṣasamādyādvitricaturthībhirucyate ||47 pañcādyādvitṛtīyābhirdhvāntasaṃghātamīritam| pañcādyādvicaturthībhirdevārīti nigadyate ||48 ādyātripañcaturyābhirvijñeyaṃ devadāruṇam| pañcatridvicaturthībhirghoṣaṇaṃ duḥkhaghoṣaṇam ||49 ṣaḍādyādvitṛtīyābhirvyāghramityabhidhīyate| ādyādvituryāṣaṣṭhībhiḥ śārdūlaṃ syānniveśanam ||50 ādyātrituryāṣaṣṭhībhiḥ śoṣaṇaṃ putraśoṣaṇam| ṣaṭturyādvitṛtīyābhirvijānīyādviśoṣaṇam ||51 ādyādvipañcaṣaṣṭhībhirmattadaṃ nāma mandiram| nirānandākhyamādyātripañcaṣaṣṭhībhirucyate ||52 pañcaṣaḍdvitṛtīyābhiḥ śākunaṃ nāmato bhavet| vighnamādyācatuḥpañcaṣaṣṭhībhirvighnavardhanam ||53 nirghṛṇaṃ ṣaṭcatuḥpañcadvitīyābhirasaukhyakṛt| tricatuḥpañcaṣaṣṭhībhirvadanti ripusaṃhadam ||54 ṣaṭpañcaturyātryābhiḥ pakṣaghnaṃ sutanāśanam| ṣaṭpañcadvitrituryābhiḥ sutaghnaṃ ssutasūdanam ||55 ṣaṭpañcadvitrituryādyā yatra tadvairipūraṇam| pakṣaghnasyānugānyevaṃ gṛhāṇyaṣṭādaśa kramāt ||56 caturādyāstriśāleṣu mūṣā bāhyā na cāntarā| syādvinādyāṃ dvitīyāṃ ca triśālaṃ pañcabhadra kam| bāhyataḥ kramamutsṛjya triśālavidhirīritaḥ ||57 hiraṇyanābhādiniketanānāṃ catuṣṭayasyaivamamī prakārāḥ| dvisaptatiḥ kṛtsnatayopadiṣṭāḥ pratyekamaṣṭādaśabhedakḷptāḥ ||58 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre dvāsaptatitriśālalakṣaṇaṃ nāmaikaviṃśodhyāyaḥ| <22> atha dviśālagṛhalakṣaṇaṃ nāma dvāviṃśodhyāyaḥ| dviśālāni dvipañcāśatsyuḥ śubhānyaśubhāni ca| lakṣaṇāni kramātteṣāmidānīṃ sampracakṣmahe ||1 siddhārthaṃ yamasūryaṃ ca daṇḍākhyaṃ vātasaṃjñitam| cullī kācaṃ ca mukhyāni dviśālāni ṣaḍeva hi ||2 anekabhedabhinnāni laghuprastārayogataḥ| mūṣābhedakrameṇa syurbhedābhedakrameṇa tu ||3 tathā nilīnakaraṇādvīthikālindamārgataḥ| prāggrīvādividhānena dvaiśālyādiviparyayāt ||4 yathāsambhavametāni kathayāmaḥ samāsataḥ| nirvāhataśca mūṣāṇāmanirvāhācca nāmataḥ ||5 chandato guṇato rūpādaśubhāni śubhāni ca| hitārthāya narendrā ṇāṃ varṇināṃ liṅgināmapi ||6 hastinī mahiṣī ceti dve śāle yatra veśmani| tatsiddhārthamiti jñeyaṃ vittasampattikārakam ||7 mṛtyudaṃ mahiṣīgāvībhyāṃ bhavedyamasūryakam| daṇḍaṃ syācchagalīgāvīśālābhyāṃ daṇḍabhītidam ||8 vātaṃ kareṇucchagalīyuktamudvegakārakam| mahiṣyajābhyāmudvegakarī cullī dhanāpahā ||9 kācaṃ kareṇugāvīmyāṃ suhṛtprītivināśanam| ekamūṣamamūṣaṃ ca na dviśāleṣu kārayet ||10 vyatyāsātkācacullyośca sarvābhistisṛbhistathā| catvāryādyāni bhidyante laghuprastārayogataḥ ||11 pratyekamekādaśadhā mandirāṇyabhidhānataḥ| anye caturdhā bhidyete pratyekaṃ dve niveśane ||12 eṣāṃ mūṣā bhidābhedāttadvāhyāvāhahetukāḥ| vasudhāraṃ bhavetteṣāmādyaṃ siddhārthakaṃ tataḥ ||13 kalyāṇakaṃ śāśvataṃ ca śivaṃ kāmapradaṃ tathā| strīdaṃ śāntaṃ niṣkalaṅkaṃ dhanādhīśaṃ kuberakam ||14 siddhārthamanujānyevametānyekādaśa kramāt| saṃhāraṃ yamasūryaṃ ca kālaṃ vaivasvataṃ yamam ||15 karālaṃ vikarālaṃ ca kabandhaṃ mṛtakaṃ śavam| yamasūryasya bhedāḥ syuḥ sadmano mahiṣaṃ tathā ||16 pracaṇḍacaṇḍe daṇḍākhyamuddaṇḍaṃ kāṇḍakoṭare| vigrahaṃ nigrahaṃ dhūmraṃ nirdhūmaṃ dantidāruṇaṃ ||17 ekādaśāmī daṇḍasya bhedā daṇḍabhayapradāḥ| marutpavanavātākhyānyanilaṃ saprabhañjanam ||18 ghanāryambudavidhvaṃsi pralayaṃ kalahaṃ kaliḥ| kalicullī ca vātasya bhedā udvegadāyakāḥ ||19 rogaṃ cullyanalaṃ bhasma cullyā bhedacatuṣṭayam| kācasya tu cchalaṃ kācaṃ kulaghnaṃ ca virodhi ca ||20 dvāpañcāśaddviśālānāmamī bhedāḥ prakīrtitāḥ| brūmaḥ sāmpratameteṣāṃ lakṣaṇāni pṛthakpṛthak ||21 ādyādvitīye vahato yatra mūṣe dhanaprade| vasudhārābhidhānaṃ tadgṛhaṃ sarvārthakānugam ||22 ādyātṛtīye vahato yatra siddhārthakaṃ hi tat| sarvopadra vanirmuktaṃ siddhikṛccintitārthakṛt ||23 dvitṛtīyaṃ vahanmūṣaṃ bhavet kalyāṇamṛddhikṛt| vahadādyacaturthīkaṃ śāśvataṃ gṛhamuttamam ||24 śivaṃ dvitīyāturyābhyāṃ vahantībhyāṃ sukhapradam| kāmadaṃ tricaturthībhyāṃ bhaveccintitakāmadam ||25 ādyādyābhistu tisṛbhiḥ strīpradaṃ saṃpradaṃ prabhoḥ| ādyādvitīyāturyābhiḥ śāntaṃ śāntipradāyakam ||26 ādyātṛtīyāturyābhirniṣkalaṅkaṃ samṛddhikṛt| dvitṛtīyācaturthībhirdhaneśaṃ dhanavarddhanam ||27 ādyādyābhiścatasṛbhiḥ kuberaṃ vittavṛddhikṛt| yamasūryaprabhedeṣu brūmo lakṣma phalāni ca ||28 ādyādvitīyāmūṣābhyāṃ saṃhāraṃ svāmināśanam | gṛhamādyātṛtīyābhyāṃ mṛtyudaṃ yamasūryakam ||29 dvitṛtīyaṃ vahanmūṣaṃ kālaṃ yoṣidvināśanam| vaivasvataṃ vahatturyaprathamaṃ rogakārakam ||30 yamālayaṃ dvituryābhyāṃ svāmino yamadarśanam| karālaṃ tricaturthībhyāṃ bhartuḥ prāṇavināśanam ||31 ādyābhistisṛbhiḥ svāmināśanaṃ vikarālakam| ādyādvitīyāturyābhiḥ kabandhaṃ bhartṛnāśanam ||32 ādyātṛtīyāturyābhirbhartṛghnaṃ mṛtakālayam| śabaṃ dvitricaturthībhiḥ svāmino maraṇapradam ||33 ādyādyābhiścatasṛbhiḥ svāmighnaṃ mahiṣaṃ viduḥ| pracaṇḍaṃ daṇḍabhedeṣu pūrvayā sadvitīyayā ||34 gṛhamādau vijānīyādbharturnṛpabhayapradam| caṇḍamādyātṛtīyābhyāṃ caṇḍadaṇḍabhayapradam ||35 daṇḍaṃ syāddvitṛtīyābhyāṃ rājadaṇḍāya dāruṇam| uddaṇḍamādyāturyābhyāṃ svāmino daṇḍabhītidam ||36 kāṇḍaṃ dvitīyāturyābhyāṃ kāṇḍavadbhedakārakam| koṭaraṃ tricaturthībhyāṃ svāmino vigrahāvaham ||37 prathamādvitṛtīyābhirvigrahaṃ vadhabandhakṛt| ādyādvitīyāturyābhirnigrahaṃ vigrahāvaham ||38 ādyātṛtīyāturyābhirdhūmraṃ sarvadhanāpaham| dvitṛtīyācaturthībhirnirdhūmaṃ dhananāśanam ||39 ādyādyābhiścatasṛbhirdantidāruṇamarthahṛt| ādyādvitīyāmūṣābhyāṃ vātabhedeṣu mandiram ||40 marutsaṃjñaṃ bhavet tatra vasatāṃ kalahaḥ sadā| udvegakāri pavanaṃ tṛtīyādyopalakṣitam ||41 vātākhyaṃ dvitṛtīyābhyāṃ sadā santāpakārakam| santāpodvāsakāryādyāturyābhyāmanilaṃ bhavet ||42 prabhañjanaṃ dvituryābhyāṃ śokasantāpakārakam| tṛtīyayā caturthyā ca ghanāryudvegakārakam ||43 ādyayā dvitṛtīyābhyāṃ rogaṃ kāryārthanāśanam| ādyādvitīyāturyābhiḥ pralayaṃ cittatāpakṛt ||44 ādyādvitīyāturyābhiḥ kalahaṃ kalahāvaham| dvitṛttīyācaturthībhiḥ kaliḥ santāpakārakam ||45 ādyādyābhiścatasṛbhiḥ kalicullī dhanāpahā| rogamādyādvitīyābhyāṃ cullībhedeṣu śokadam ||46 syāddvitīyātṛtīyābhyāṃ cullī vittavināśanī| vasughnamanalaṃ nāma trituryābhyāṃ niveśanam ||47 vittaghnamādyāturyābhyāṃ bhasmākhyaṃ svāminaḥ sadā| udaṅmukhābhyāṃ mūṣābhyāṃ kācabhedeṣu mandiram ||48 chalaṃ nāma bhavennityaṃ bandhuvargāpamānakṛt| dakṣiṇottaramūṣāṇāṃ paurastye vahato yadi ||49 kāñcaṃ nāma tadā veśma sajjanānandakārakam| mūṣābhyāṃ dakṣiṇābhyāṃ syātkulahaṃ trikulakṣayam ||50 dakṣiṇottaramūṣāṇāṃ pāścātye vahato yadi| virodhaṃ nāma tadveśma sarvalokavirodhakṛt ||51 uktānyevaṃ dvipañcāśaddviśālānāṃ samāsataḥ| enāni mūṣāvahanaprabhedātphalaprabhedācca nidarśitani| dviśālaveśmānyadhunaikaśālānyudāhriyante bhavanāni samyak ||52 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre dviśālagṛhalakṣaṇaṃ nāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <23> atha ekaśālālakṣaṇaphalādi nāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| gṛhāṇāmekaśālānāṃ vakṣyāmo lakṣaṇānyatha| śastānāṃ ninditānāṃ ca yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ ||1 vinyaseccaturaḥ pūrvaṃ gurūn varṇān yathāvidhi| ebhya eva prasūyante bhedāḥ ṣoḍaśa veśmanām ||2 guroradho laghuṃ nyasyetpūrvaṃ śeṣaṃ yathopari| gurubhiḥ pūrayetpaścādyāvatsyurlaghavo'khilāḥ ||3 vidyādalindānsarveṣu laghusthāneṣu paṇḍitaḥ| savyāvartaṃ gṛhamukhādetāṃśca viniyojayet ||4 eṣāmalindasaṃyogādbhavanānāṃ pṛthakpṛthak| nāmāni guṇadoṣāśca vakṣyante'nukramādataḥ ||5 dhruvaṃ dhanyaṃ jayaṃ nandaṃ kharaṃ kāntaṃ manoramam| sumukhaṃ durmukhaṃ krūraṃ supakṣaṃ dhanadaṃ kṣayam ||6 ākrandaṃ vipulaṃ caiva vijayaṃ gṛhamuttamam| dhruve jayamavāpnoti dhanye dhānyāgamo bhavet ||7 jaye sapatnāñjayati nande sarvāḥ samṛddhayaḥ| kharamāyāsadaṃ veśma kānte ca labhate śriyam ||8 āyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ tathā vittasya sampadaḥ| manorame manastuṣṭirgṛhabhartuḥ prakīrtitā ||9 sumukhe rājyasanmānaṃ durmukhe kalahaḥ sadā| krūravyādhibhayaṃ krūre supakṣaṃ gotravṛddhikṛt ||10 dhanade hemaratnādi gāścaiva labhate pumān| kṣayaṃ sarvakṣayaṃ gehamākrandaṃ jñātimṛtyudam ||11 ārogyaṃ vipule khyātirvijaye sarvasampadaḥ| yadi dhanye dvitīyo'pi mukhālindaḥ prayujyate ||12 tadgṛhaṃ ramyanāmeha bhartuḥ saubhāgyakārakam| mukhālindena nandākhyaṃ dvitīyena suyojitam ||13 tacchrīdharamiti khyātaṃ tasmin śrīrnityamāviśet| alindaśceddvitīyo'pi kāntasyāsye niveśyate ||14 muditaṃ tadbhavedbharturbhūtikṛdbhavanottamam| sumukhasya yadālindo vaktre'nyo viniveśyate ||15 vardhamānaṃ tadā tatsyātsvāmilakṣmīvivardhanam| krūraṃ yuktaṃ dvitīyena mukhālindena mandiram ||16 karālaṃ tadvijānīyādbhartā tasya vinaśyati| alindena dvitīyena dhanadaṃ yojitaṃ punaḥ ||17 sunābhaṃ tadbhavet tasmin paśūn putrānavāpnuyāt| ākrandasya purobhāge yadyalindaḥ kṛto'paraḥ ||18 dhvāṅkṣasaṃjñaṃ gṛhaṃ tajjñā ninditaṃ pravadanti tat | dvitīyālindaghaṭanā vijayasya mukhe yadi ||19 tatsamṛddhamiti khyātaṃ gṛhaṃ syātpuṇyakarmaṇām| yānyuktāni dhruvādīni pūrvaveśmāni ṣoḍaśa ||20 śālāvibhāgaṃ jñātvaiṣāṃ tiryakṣaḍdāru vinyaset| ṣoḍaśānye ca bhedāḥ syuḥ saṃjñāścaiṣāmanukramāt ||21 sundaraṃ varadaṃ bhadraṃ pramodaṃ vimukhaṃ śivam| sarvalābhaṃ viśālaṃ ca vilakṣamaśubhaṃ dhvajam ||22 uddyotaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ śūnyamajitaṃ kulanandanam| nāmabhirveśmanāmeṣāṃ guṇadoṣānprakalpayet ||23 yathārthanāmānyetāni yasmātproktānyavistarāt| ebhya evāparāṇi syurveśmānyanyāni ṣoḍaśa ||24 śālāpuroviniryuktatiryakṣaḍdārukāraṇāt| haṃsaṃ sulakṣaṇaṃ saumyaṃ jayantaṃ bhavyamuttamam ||25 ruciraṃ sambhṛtaṃ kṣemamākṣemaṃ sukṛtaṃ vṛṣam| ucchannaṃ vyayamānandaṃ sunandaṃ ceti kīrtitam ||26 eṣāmapi yathārthatvādguṇadoṣān nirūpayet| śālāmadhye ca tiryaksthaṃ ṣaḍdāru viniveśayet ||27 vihāya marmaṇāṃ vedhānamīṣāmeva veśmanām| ṣoḍaśaiva pare'pi syurbhedāstāṃśca yathākramam ||28 kathayāmaḥ samāsena yathārthaireva nāmabhiḥ| alaṅkṛtamalaṅkāraṃ ramaṇaṃ pūrṇamambaram ||29 puṇyaṃ sugarbhaṃ kalaśaṃ durgataṃ riktamīpsitam| subhadraṃ vanditaṃ dīnaṃ vibhavaṃ sarvakāmadam ||30 śālāntaḥ sthitaṣaḍdārupaścādapavaraiḥ kṛtaiḥ| ebhyo'pare'pi nirdiṣṭā bhedāḥ ṣoḍaśa veśmanām ||31 prabhavaṃ bhāvikaṃ krīḍaṃ tilakaṃ krīḍanaṃ sukham| yaśodaṃ kumudaṃ kālaṃ bhāsuraṃ sarvabhūṣaṇam ||32 vasudhāraṃ dhanaharaṃ kupitaṃ vittavṛddhidam| kulodayaṃ ca vijñeyaṃ guṇadoṣāstu pūrvavat ||33 anantaramihoktāni yāni veśmāni ṣoḍaśa| pratyekaṃ tānyalindena parikuryāccaturdiśam ||34 tadbhedebhyaḥ prasūtāni kathayāmo vidhānataḥ| cūḍāmaṇiṃ prabhadraṃ ca kṣemaṃ śekharamadbhutam ||35 vikāśaṃ bhūtidaṃ hṛṣṭaṃ virodhaṃ kālapāśakam| nirāmayaṃ suśālaṃ ca raudraṃ moghaṃ manoratham ||36 subhadraṃ ceti sadanaṃ saṃjñābhirupalakṣayet| veśmanāmekaśālānāṃ śataṃ syāccaturuttaram ||37 kathitaṃ tacca saṃsthānairnāmabhiśca yathākramam| hastinī mahiṣī gāvī chāgalī ca yathākramam ||38 taddvayena dvipūrvāṇi brūmo nāmāni veśmanām| dvihaṃsakaṃ dvicakrāhvaṃ dvisārasamathāparam ||39 dvikokilaṃ budhaiḥ khyātaṃ hastinyādeḥ kramādgṛham| trīṇyāyuḥ paśudhānyānāṃ kramādādyāni vṛddhaye ||40 eteṣāmeva nāśāya bhavedveśma dvikokilam| ityekaśālabhavanānyuditānyalinda| ṣaḍdārukāpavarakāvaraṇādibhedaiḥ| saṃjñā ca lakṣaṇaphalaiḥ kariṇīmukhābhiḥ| śālābhirevamaparāṇi ca yugmajāni ||41 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre ekaśālalakṣaṇaphaladvihaṃsakādilakṣaṇaphalāni nāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <24> atha dvārapīṭhabhittimānādikaṃ nāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| karṇaśālānibaddhāni maṇḍapairantarasthitaiḥ| asambādhājirāṇi syurhalāni daśa pañca ca ||1 īśvaraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ candraṃ rogaṃ pāpaṃ bhayapradam| nandanaṃ khādakaṃ dhvāṅkṣaṃ vikṛtaṃ vilayaṃ kṣayam ||2 yāmyaṃ ca viparītaṃ ca bhadra kaṃ ceti nāmataḥ| etāni halakākhyāni vidyādgehāni yatnataḥ ||3 agnirakṣonileśānakoṇagānāṃ yathākramam| ekadvitricaturthākhyā halakānāṃ prakalpayet ||4 anena kramayogena cchandobhedā bhavanti ca| tatrādyeneśvaraṃ nāma halakena gṛhaṃ bhavet ||5 sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sarvavṛddhiphalapradam| vṛṣabhaṃ tu dvitīyena putradāravivardhanam ||6 prathamaṃ ca dvitīyaṃ ca gṛhe tu halakaṃ yadi| candraṃ vṛddhikaraṃ nṛṇāṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam ||7 vāyavyaṃ halakaṃ yatra rogaṃ rogavivardhanam| prathamaṃ ca tṛtīyaṃ ca gṛhe tu halakaṃ yadi ||8 pāpaṃ tannāmato vāstu sarvapāpaprayojakam| pitṛrogoktakoṇābhyāṃ bhayadaṃ rogamṛtyave ||9 pitṛrogāgnikoṇeṣu nandanaṃ gṛhamādiśet| sukhamarthapradaṃ śāntaṃ halakaṃ parikīrtitam ||10 īśānyāṃ tu caturthena khādakaṃ khādakaṃ gṛham| lāṅgalādyā yadā śālā īśānyāṃ ca yadāparā ||11 dhvāṅkṣaṃ tannāmato vāstu daridrā ṇāṃ vidhīyate| dvitīyā ca caturthī ca śālā lāṅgalake yadi ||12 vikṛtaṃ vikṛtāvāsaṃ pravāso'tra kuṭumbinaḥ| ādyā śālā dvitīyā ca caturthī ca yadā punaḥ ||13 vilayaṃ hānidaṃ nityaṃ gṛhaṃ tadvittanāśanam| vāyavyaṃ halakaṃ yasminnaiśānyāṃ ca yadā punaḥ ||14 kṣayaṃ kṣayakaraṃ nityaṃ halakeṣu guhaṃ bhavet| agnivāyumaheśānāṃ śālā lāṅgalake yadi ||15 yāmyaṃ mṛtyukaraṃ nṝṇāṃ na tatkuryātkadācana| mārute nairṛtaiśānyoḥ śālākarṇeṣu lāṅgalam ||16 viparītaṃ vyādhikaraṃ nṝṇāṃ nāśakaraṃ tathā| catasro halake yatra prādakṣiṇyamukhāḥ sthitāḥ ||17 bhadra kaṃ nāma tadvāstu sarvabhadra prayojakam| dvārocchrāyaṃ savistāraṃ talocchrāyaṃ ca veśmanām ||18 pīṭhasya ca samutsedhaṃ bhittivistārameva ca| tathā dārukalāṃ caiva yā proktā gṛhakarmaṇi ||19 ekaśālāvidhānaṃ ca teṣāṃ nāmāni yāni ca| tat samprati pravakṣyāmo yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ ||20 ṣoḍaśānāṃ samudayo viṃśaterapi cāparaḥ| viṃśateḥ sacatuṣkāyāstathāṣṭāviṃśaterapi ||21 dvātriṃśato'paraśceti pañca vargādhipā matāḥ| śālācaturthabhāgena bhittivistāra iṣyate ||22 vargeṣu bhittilakṣmoktaṃ ṣoḍaśādiṣu pañcasu| marmapīḍā bhavedyatra bhittistambhatulādibhiḥ ||23 kurvīta hrāsaṃ vṛddhiṃ vā tatra marmavyathāṃ tyajan| atisaṃvṛtavistāraṃ kāryamuddiśya buddhimān ||24 śālāpraviṣṭaṃ kurvīta hīnavāstu ṣvalindakam| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre bhūmibhāge samīkṛte ||25 upariṣṭādbhavetpīṭhaṃ talādardhasamucchritam| niyukte tu tataḥ pīṭhe vāstuvistārato'ṅgulam ||26 pratihastaṃ samuddhṛtaya saptatyā saha yojayet| dvārocchrāyāḥ samākhyātā vargeṣūkteṣu pañcasu ||27 ucchrāyārdhena vaipulyamaṣṭāṃśena vivarjitam| dvāravistārapādāṃśe paṭṭavistāra iṣyate ||28 vistārārdhena bāhalyaṃ sārdhaṃ vedyā talopari| uttarottaravaipulyaṃ kuryācchākhāvaśādbudhaḥ ||29 vedyā vistārabāhalye vidheye śākhayorapi| dvāravistārapādena mūle stambhasya vistṛtiḥ ||30 daśabhāgavihīnāgre paṭṭaḥ stambhena sammitaḥ| stambhāgrasya tribhāgena paṭṭakoṭirvidhīyate ||31 hīragrahaṇamāyāme stambhāgrāttu caturguṇam| paṭṭānyānyudbhavettatra vyāsabāhalyayostathā ||32 paṭṭakoṭyardhamutsedhādutsedhārdhena nirgatam| tantrakasya pramāṇaṃ syāditi śāstravido viduḥ ||33 dra vyāṇyuparyuparyasya parāparavibhāgataḥ| paṭṭakoṭyāścaturthena pravibhāgena hrāsayet ||34 pūrvāmukhaṃ gṛhaṃ yattu dvāraṃ māhendra saṃyutam| hastinī ca bhavecchālā tadgṛhaṃ bhadra saṃjñitam ||35 bhadraṃ bhadra karaṃ bharturyaśobalavivardhanam| sidhyanti cāsya kāryāṇi bhadrā khye vasato gṛhe ||36 dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ veśma dvāraṃ cāsya gṛhakṣatam| mahiṣī ca bhavecchālā tadgṛhaṃ nandapīṭhakam ||37 nandapīṭhagṛhaṃ puṃsā nityānandakaraṃ smṛtam| sarvasampadguṇopetaṃ dhanadhānyavivardhanam ||38 vāruṇyabhimukhaṃ sadma dvāraṃ ca kusumāhvayam| gāvī caiva bhavecchālā saurabhaṃ tadvidurbudhāḥ ||39 saurabhe nityahṛṣṭatvaṃ vasatāṃ gṛhamedhinām| saphalaṃ kṛṣivāṇijyaṃ putrāśca vaśavartinaḥ ||40 uttarābhimukhaṃ dhiṣṇyaṃ dvāraṃ bhallāṭasaṃyutam| chāgalī ca bhavecchālā puṣkarākhyaṃ taducyate ||41 śīlavān nityasantuṣṭaḥ suhṛtsujanavatsalaḥ| subhagaḥ puṣkarākhye ca bahuputradhanānvitaḥ ||42 bhadraṃ ca nandapīṭhaṃ ca saurabhaṃ puṣkaraṃ tathā| prathamārdhe tu vargasya prathamasya prayojayet ||43 sarvabhadrā dikāḥ sarve niveśā ye prakīrtitāḥ| utpannāste vimānebhyaḥ pañcabhyaḥ pañcapañcake ||44 dvārasya pīṭhasya ca mandireṣu bhitteśca mānaṃ kathitaṃ krameṇa| tatho detā dārukalāstu samyakprahīṇavāstoḥ sakalaṃ ca lakṣma ||45 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre dvārapīṭhabhittimānadārukalāhīnavāstulakṣaṇaṃ nāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <25> atha samastagṛhāṇāṃ saṅkhyākathanaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| veśmanāṃ pañcaśālānāṃ kathyante lakṣaṇānyatha| caturviṃśatisaṃyuktaṃ sahasraṃ tāni saṅkhyayā ||1 gurūṇāṃ daśasaṅkhyānāṃ prastārasya ca kalpanāt| gṛhāṇāṃ pañcaśālānāṃ bhedā laghuvibhāgataḥ ||2 pañcaśālaṃ bhavedyogādgṛhayordvitriśālayoḥ| yadvā yogād bhavedetaccatuḥśālaikaśālayoḥ ||3 caturṇāmapi varṇānāmidaṃ sadma praśasyate| hiraṇyanābhaprabhṛti varṇānāmiha veśmanām ||4 siddhārthādisamāyogānniṣpadyeta gṛhāṣṭakam| yogāddhiraṇyanābhasya siddhārthena gṛhaṃ bhavet ||5 hemakūṭākhyamasyaiva vātena svarṇaśekharam| sukṣetrasya ca siddhārthasaṃyogena śriyāvaham ||6 tasyaiva yamasūryeṇa bhavedveśma mahānidhiḥ| cullyāstu yamasūryeṇa sadādīptaṃ prajāyate ||7 daṇḍasaṃyogatastasya citrabhānbabhidhaṃ bhavet| pakṣaghnasya tu daṇḍena sadādoṣaṃ vinirdiśet ||8 pakṣaghnasyaiva vātena yogānnirvighnamucyate| na kācacullīsaṃyogastriśālādiṣu śasyate ||9 anyonyavīkṣyamāṇānāṃ bhedāstenehe noditāḥ| ekaśālayutairbhedāḥ syuścatuśśālaveśmani ||10 catvāraḥ pañcaśālānāṃ brūmasteṣāṃ ca viṃśatiḥ| yadā bhavatyajā śālā sarvatobhadra veśmanā ||11 sudarśanamiti prāhuḥ pañcaśālaṃ tadā gṛham| tadeva kariṇīyogātsurūpamiti kathyate ||12 sundaraṃ mahiṣīyogādgāvīyogāttu śobhanam| vardhamānasya caitāsāṃ śālānāṃ yogataḥ kramāt ||13 sunābhaṃ suprabhaṃ yogyaṃ vinodaṃ ca bhavedgṛham| nandyāvarte'pyevameva śālāyogena jāyate ||14 sukhadaṃ nandanaṃ nandaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ ca mandiram| rucakasyāpyajādīnāṃ yogena syuranukramāt ||15 nāmato bhadra rucirarociṣṇūni praharṣaṇam| svastike'pyanayā yuktyā bhavedgṛhacatuṣṭayam ||16 ghoṣaṃ sughoṣaṇaṃ nandighoṣaṃ śrīpadmameva ca| viṃśatiḥ sarvatobhadra prabhṛtyālayayogataḥ ||17 jātāni pañcaśālāni yogyāni pṛthivībhujām| pūrvoktairaṣṭabhiḥ sārdhaṃ syādaṣṭāviṃśatirgṛhaiḥ ||18 kathyate pañcaśālānāṃ mūṣābhedakramo'dhunā| vibhadra mekaṃ tatraikabhadrā ṇi daśasaṅkhkyayā ||19 dvibhadrā ṇi punaḥ pañcacatvāriṃśatpracakṣate| tribhadrā ṇāṃ śataṃ viṃśatyuttaraṃ dve daśottare ||20 caturbhadra gṛhāṇāṃ tu dvipañcāśacchatadvayam| gṛhāṇāṃ pañcabhadrā ṇāṃ ṣaḍbhadrā ṇāṃ daśottare ||21 dve śate saptabhadrā ṇāṃ syādviṃśatyuttaraṃ śatam| gṛhāṇāmaṣṭabhadrā ṇāṃ catvāriṃśacca pañca ca ||22 daśa syurnavabhadrā ṇi tathaikaṃ daśabhadra kam| evaṃ sahasramekaṃ syādviṃśatiśca caturyutā ||23 gṛhāṇāṃ pañcaśālānāṃ mūṣāvahamasaṅkhyayā| atha lakṣma ca saṃkhyāṃ ca brūmaḥ ṣaṭśālaveśmanām ||24 ekadvitricatuśśālagṛhāṇāṃ yojanānmithaḥ| dviśālasyaikaśālasya triśālasya ca yogataḥ ||25 ṣaṭśālaṃ jāyate veśma bhedāstasya tu ṣoḍaśa| pakṣaghnavātayoryogādekaśālagṛhasya ca ||26 syātpaṅkajāṅkuraṃ nāma gṛhaṃ ṣaṭśālamuttamam| hiraṇyanābhaṃ siddhārthaṃ caikaśālena veśmanā ||27 saṃyojyaṃ tu yadā gehaṃ tadā syācchrīgṛhaṃ śubham| saṃyogādekaśālena sukṣetrayamasūryayoḥ ||28 dhaneśvaraṃ nāma gṛhaṃ jāyate dhanavṛddhaye| daṇḍākhyacullyoḥ saṃyogādekaśālagṛhasya ca ||29 prabhūtakāñcanakaraṃ gṛhaṃ syātkāñcanaprabham| dvādaśānyāni jānīyādbhavanānyanayā diśā ||30 eteṣāmeva bhedeṣu śubhānyakhilavarṇinām| tulyāttriśāladvitayātṣaṭśālakacatuṣṭayam ||31 syāddviśālacatuḥśālayogādanyaccatuṣṭayam| siddhārthena catuḥśālaṃ veśmanāṃ saṃyutiryadā ||32 gṛhaṃ tadā syāt ṣaṭśālaṃ trailokyānandakaṃ śubham| yamasūryeṇa saṃyuktaṃ vilāsacayamucyate ||33 daṇḍayuktaṃ catuḥśālaṃ sukhadaṃ nāmato bhavet| vātena ca catuḥśālaṃ saṃyuktaṃ śrīpadaṃ bhavet ||34 caturviṃśatiranyāni ṣaṭśālānyanyayogataḥ| pañca yāni catuśśālānyucitāni mahībhṛtām ||35 teṣāṃ dviśālayogena ṣaṭśālānyabhidadhmahe| siddhārthe sarvatobhadra yukte syācchrīpuraṃ gṛham ||36 śrīvāsaṃ sarvato bhadre yamasūryānvite bhavet| daṇḍākhye bhadra yukte śrībhūṣaṇaṃ jāyate gṛham ||37 vātākhyaṃ sarvatobhadra yogācchrībhājanaṃ viduḥ| siddhārthe vardhamānena yukte syādbhūtimaṇḍanam ||38 yamasūrye tu tenaiva saṃyukte bhūtibhājanam| bhūtimānaṃ tu daṇḍākhye vātākhye bhūtibhūṣaṇam ||39 nandyāvartasya yogena siddhārthādi catuṣṭayam| śrīmukhaṃ śrīdharaṃ śrīmṛcchrīdharaṃ ceti jāyate ||40 siddhārthādicatuṣkasya bhavedrucakayogataḥ| śriyākāraṃ śriyovāsaṃ śrīyānaṃ śrīmukhaṃ tathā ||41 siddhārthādicatuṣkasya bhavetsvastikayogataḥ| dhanapāladhanānantadhanapradadhanāhvayam ||42 bhavantyevaṃ rājaveśmayogato viṃśatirgṛhāḥ| prākcaturviṃśatiśceti catvāriṃśaccaturyutā ||43 mūṣāvyūḍhivaśādekabhadrā dīnyabhidadhmahe| bhidābhirekaṃ mūṣābhirabhadraṃ dvādaśaikayā ||44 dvābhyāṃ ṣaṭṣaṣṭiruddiṣṭā viṃśe dve tisṛbhiḥ śate| syādvyūḍhābhiścatasṛbhiḥ pañconaṃ śatapañcakam ||45 śatāni pañcabhadrā ṇāṃ sapta dvānavatistathā| caturviṃśā navaśatī ṣaḍbhadrā ṇāmudāhṛtā ||46 jānīyātsaptabhadrā ṇi saṃkhyayā pañcabhadra vat| gṛhāṇāmaṣṭabhadrā ṇāṃ pañconaṃ śatapañcakam ||47 dve viṃśe navabhadrā ṇāṃ bhavanānāṃ śate viduḥ| ṣaṭṣaṣṭirdaśabhadrā ṇi tathā dvādaśasaṅkhyayā ||48 syurekādaśabhadrā khyānyekaṃ dvādaśabhadra kam| evaṃ ṣaṭśālagehānāṃ syātsāhasracatuṣṭayam ||49 ṣaṇṇavatyadhikaṃ brūmaḥ saptaśālāni sāmpratam| tulyaṃ triśāladvitayamekaśālena yujyate ||50 yadā syuḥ saptaśālāni tadā dvādaśasaṅkhyayā| ekaśālaṃ dviśālaṃ ca catuḥśālena yujyate ||51 yadā tadā saptaśālamaparaṃ veśma jāyate| saikaśālaṃ catuḥśālaṃ yamasūryeṇa saṃyutam ||52 tadā bhavedvibhedaḥ syāttadgṛhaṃ śrīpradāyakam| vātena śrīpadaṃ tadvaddaṇḍena śrīpradaṃ bhavet ||53 siddhārthakena śrīmālaṃ tadvadeva prajāyate| pañcānāṃ rājayogyānāṃ syuścatuśśālaveśmanām ||54 saptaśālāni saṃyogādekaśāladviśālayoḥ| yujyate sarvatobhadraṃ siddhāthaṃ ca yadā gṛham ||55 ekaśālena jāyeta śrīpadaṃ śrīpadaṃ tathā| sarvatobhadra gehasya yamasūryaikaśālayoḥ ||56 yogena śrīphalaṃ nāma syādgṛhaṃ śrīphalāvaham| sarvatobhadra daṇḍābhyāmekaśālaṃ yutaṃ yadā ||57 śrīsthalaṃ nāma bhavanaṃ tadā syādāspadaṃ śriyaḥ| syādekaśāle milite sarvatobhadra vātayoḥ ||58 lakṣmīnivāsabhavanaṃ gṛhaṃ śrītanusaṃjñitam| yadaikaśālaṃ siddhārthaṃ vardhamānaṃ ca yujyate ||59 śrīparvatābhidhānaṃ syāttadānīṃ bhavanottamam| yamasūryasya yogena vardhamānaikaśālayoḥ ||60 śrīvardhanaṃ nāma gṛhaṃ śriyo vṛddhikaraṃ bhavet| daṇḍaṃ ca vardhamānaṃ ca saikaśālaṃ yadā bhavet ||61 tadā śrīsaṅgamaṃ nāma bhavedbhavanamuttamam| yadaikaśālaṃ vātākhyaṃ vardhamānaṃ ca yujyate ||62 bhavanaṃ śrīprsaṅgākhyaṃ nṛpayogyaṃ tadā bhavet| siddhārthamekaśālena nandyāvartena cānvitam ||63 śrībhāraṃ nāma bhavanaṃ bhavedbhūpālasevitam| nandyāvartasya yogena yamasūryaikaśālayoḥ ||64 rājñāṃ sukhāvahaṃ veśma śrībhāramiti ca smṛtam| śrīśailamekaśālena syānnandyāvartadaṇḍayoḥ ||65 yogādbhogāvahaṃ rājñāṃ saptaśālaṃ gṛhottamam| ekaśālasya yogena syānnandyāvartavātayoḥ ||66 śrīkhaṇḍaṃ nāma bhavanaṃ bhūbhṛtāṃ bhūtikṛdbhavet| siddhārthasyaikaśālena saṃyogādrucakasya ca ||67 śrīṣaṇḍaṃ nāmato veśma bhavedyogyaṃ mahībhṛtām| rucakasyaiva yogena yamasūryaikaśālayoḥ ||68 syācchrīnidhānaṃ śrīkuṇḍaṃ tasya daṇḍaikaśālayoḥ| vātaikaśālarucakairyuktaiḥ śrīnābhamucyate ||69 bhavanaṃ bhūmipālānāṃ tadbhavedbhūtidāyakam| ekaśālena yujyete siddhārthasvastike yadā ||70 śrīpriyaṃ syāttadā veśma santataṃ vallabhaṃ śriyaḥ| yamasūryaikaśālābhyāṃ svastikaṃ yujyate yadā ||71 tadā śrīkāntamityāhurbhavanaṃ bhūbhṛtāṃ hitam| ekaśālena saṃyogo daṇḍasvastikayoryadā ||72 śrīmataṃ nāmato veśma tadā syādvijayāvaham| vātasvastikasaṃyogamekaśālaṃ yadā vrajet ||73 śrīpradattamiti prāhustadā veśma mahībhṛtām| ekaikasya dvibhedatvāccatvāriṃśadiyaṃ bhavet ||74 evamatra prakārāḥ syuścatvāriṃśadyutāṣṭabhiḥ| yadā triśālaṃ bhavanaṃ catuśśālena yujyate ||75 tadāpi saptaśālaṃ syāccaturdhedaṃ samāsataḥ| pañcānāṃ rājagehānāṃ milatyekatamasya cet ||76 triśālaṃ syāttadā saptaśālaṃ viṃśatibhedavat| hiraṇyanābhabhogena sarvatobhadra mandiram ||77 śrīvatsaṃ janayedveśma narendrā ṇāṃ hitāvaham| śrīvṛkṣaṃ sarvatobhadre sukṣetre milite bhavet ||78 cullīyukte punastasmin śrīpālaṃ nāma jāyate| pakṣaghne sarvatobhadra yukte śrīkaṇṭhamucyate ||79 hiraṇyanābhe śrīvāsaṃ vardhamānayute bhavet| śrīnivāsaṃ tu sukṣetre vardhamānena miśrite ||80 vardhamānena cullyā ca gṛhaṃ śrībhūṣaṇaṃ viduḥ| pakṣaghnaṃ vardhamānena yadā saṃyogamṛcchati ||81 tadā śrīmaṇḍanaṃ nāma jāyate bhavanottamam| jāte hiraṇyanābhasya nandyāvartena saṅgame ||82 syādveśma śrīkulaṃ nāma śriyaḥ kulaniketanam| nandyāvartena sukṣetre yukte śrīgokulaṃ bhavet ||83 nandyāvartasya cullyāśca yoge śrīsthāvaraṃ gṛham| nandyāvartasya pakṣaghnayoge kumbhaṃ prajāyate ||84 hiraṇyanābharucakayoge syācchrīsamudgakam| śrīnandaṃ nāma sukṣetre rucakākhyena saṃyute ||85 cullyāṃ rucakayuktāyāṃ śrīhradaṃ nāma jāyate| śrīdharaṃ nāma pakṣaghne bhavedrucakasaṃyute ||86 hiraṇyanābhena yute svastike śrīkaraṇḍakam| sukṣetreṇa yute tasmin śrībhāṇḍāgārasaṃjñitam ||87 cullīyute śrīnilayaṃ bhavennarapatipriyam| svastikasya yadā yogaḥ pakṣaghnena prajāyate ||88 śrīniketanasaṃjñaṃ syāttadā nṛpatimandiram| uktāni saptaśālāni nāmalakṣaṇayogataḥ ||89 sarvāṇi sārvabhaumānāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ mantriṇāmapi| bhavanti ca satāṃ vittayaśovijayavṛddhaye ||90 ekādimūṣāvahanaprabhedādatha veśmanām| eteṣāṃ saptaśālānāṃ brūmaḥ saṃkhyāmanukramāt ||91 vahatyekāpi no yatra mūṣaikaṃ tadbhavedgṛham| vibhadra mekabhadrā ṇi vijānīyāccaturdaśa ||92 dvibhadra veśmanāṃ saikā navatiḥ parikīrtitā| bhavanānāṃ tribhadrā ṇāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ śatatrayam ||93 sahasramekābhyadhikaṃ syāccaturbhadra veśmanām| bhavataḥ pañcabhadrā ṇāṃ dve sahasre dvisaṃyute ||94 ṣaḍbhadrā ṇāṃ sahasrāṇi trīṇi trīṇi gṛhāṇi ca| dvātriṃśatā catustriṃśatsaptabhadra śatāni ca ||95 aṣṭabhadrā ṇi ṣaḍbhadra saṅkhyātulyāni jāyate| gṛhāṇāṃ navabhadrā ṇāṃ dve sahasre tathā dvayam ||96 sahasraṃ daśabhadrā ṇāmekottaramudāhṛtam| tathaikādaśabhadrā ṇāṃ catuṣṣaṣṭyā śatatrayam ||97 saikā dvādaśabhadrā ṇāṃ navatirveśmanāṃ bhavet| syustrayodaśabhadrā ṇi gṛhāṇīha caturdaśa ||98 yaccaturdaśabhirbhadrai rekameva hi veśma tat| ityeṣāṃ saptaśālānāṃ sahasrāṇyatra ṣoḍaśa ||99 ekonatriṃśatī tadvadaśītiścaturuttarā| idānīmaṣṭaśālāni bhavanānyabhidadhmahe ||100 bahirantaścatuḥśāladvayādekaṃ samāsataḥ| anyāni sarvabhadrā didvayasaṃyogato daśa ||101 ekonatriṃśatā kṣetraṃ caturaśraṃ vibhājayet| bhāgadvayena mūṣā syācchālā bhāgacatuṣṭayāt ||102 kurvīta pañcabhirbhāgaistanmadhye'ṅgaṇavāpikām| catasraśca pratidiśaṃ mūṣāḥ syustatra vāstuni ||103 śālayonaṃ saptaśālaṃ ṣaṭśālaṃ dvitayojjhitam| trihīnaṃ pañcaśālaṃ syādaṣṭaśālamidaṃ kvacit ||104 tulyatriśāladvitayaṃ dviśālena yutaṃ yadā| aṣṭau tadāṣṭaśālāni gṛhāṇyanyāni nirdiśet ||105 mūṣāvyūḍhivaśādaṣṭaśālānāmatha kathyate| saṅkhyā tatra vibhadraṃ syādavahanmūṣasaṃjñitam ||106 ṣoḍaśaivaikabhadrā ṇi dvibhadrā ṇāṃ śataṃ viduḥ| viṃśaṃ ṣaṣṭyā tribhadrā ṇāṃ vijñeyaṃ śatapañcakam ||107 aṣṭādaśāhurviṃśāni caturbhadra śatāni ca| pañcabhadra sahasrāṇi catvāri syuḥ śatatrayam ||108 aṣṭaṣaṣṭiśca gehāni tāni samyagvibhāvayet| sahasrāṣṭakamaṣṭau ca ṣaḍbhadrā ṇi pracakṣate ||109 ekādaśasahasrāṇi tathā śatacatuṣṭayam| jānīyātsaptabhadrā ṇi catvāriṃśadgṛhāṇi ca ||110 dvādaśaivāṣṭabhadrā ṇāṃ sahasrāṇi śatāṣṭakam| saptatyābhyadhikaṃ prāhurvāstuvidyāviśāradāḥ ||111 ekādaśasahasrāṇi tathā śatacatuṣṭayam| catvāriṃśacca gehāni navabhadrā ṇi saṅkhyayā ||112 aṣṭau syurdaśabhadrā ṇāṃ sahasrāṇyaṣṭabhiḥ saha| tathaikādaśabhadrā ṇāṃ saṅkhyā syātpañcabhadra vat ||113 aṣṭādaśaśatāni syurviṃśatirbhavanāni ca| iti dvādaśabhadrā ṇāṃ saṅkhyā bhavati veśmanām ||114 syāttrayodaśabhadrā ṇāṃ ṣaṣṭyagraṃ śatapañcakam| syāccaturdaśabhadrā ṇāṃ viṃśatyabhyadhikaṃ śatam ||115 veśmāni syustathā pañcadaśabhadrā ṇi ṣoḍaśa| ekameva hi vijñeyaṃ gṛhaṃ ṣoḍaśabhadra kam ||116 pañcaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi ṣaṭtriṃśaṃ śatapañcakam| gṛhāṇāmaṣṭaśālānāṃ bhavatyekatra saṅkhyayā ||117 syātsamānacatuśśāladvayayogātsamāsataḥ| ekaikaśālayoggācca navaśālacatuṣṭayam ||118 sarvatobhadra mukhyānāṃ mitho dvitayayogataḥ| ekaikaśālayogācca catvāriṃśattathāparā ||119 tulyatriśālatritayogena ca catuṣṭayam| gṛhāṇāṃ navaśālānāmanyaduktaṃ purātanaiḥ ||120 saṃsthānamuktaṃ gehānāṃ navaśālātmanāmidam| mūṣāvahanabhedena tatsaṅkhyā kathyate'dhunā ||121 avahanmūṣamekaṃ syādvahantyāṣṭādaśaikayā| dvābhyāṃ śataṃ tripañcāśadadhikaṃ veśmanāṃ bhavet ||122 tisṛbhiḥ syuḥ śatānyaṣṭau saha ṣoḍaśabhirgṛhaiḥ| ṣaṣṭyā sahasratritayaṃ tābhiścatasṛbhirbhavet ||123 pañcāśītiśatānyaṣṭaṣaṣṭiyuktāni pañcabhiḥ| vahantībhiḥ prajāyante mūṣābhiriha veśmanām ||124 aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi tathā pañcaśatāni ca| catuḥṣaṣṭiṃ ca gehāni mūṣābhiḥ ṣaḍbhirādiśet ||125 ekatriṃśatsahasrāṇi sahitānyaṣṭabhiḥ śataiḥ| caturviṃśatiyuktāni mūṣābhiḥ saptabhirviduḥ ||126 catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi trisahasrī ca veśmanām| śatāni cāṣṭapañcāśatsapta mūṣābhiraṣṭabhiḥ ||127 catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi sahasrāṇyaṣṭa ṣaṭśatī| viṃśatiṃ caiva mūṣābhirgṛhāṇāṃ navabhirviduḥ ||128 catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi sahasratrayamokasām| mūṣābhirdaśabhiḥ sāṣṭapañcāśacchatasaptakam ||129 ekatriṃśatsahasrāṇi caturviṃśacchatāṣṭakam| mūṣābhirekādaśabhirgṛhāṇāṃ munayo jaguḥ ||130 aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi tathā pañcaśatāni ca| dhāmnāṃ dvādaśamūṣāṇāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭiśca jāyate ||131 bhavantyaṣṭau sahasrāṇi tathā pañcaśatāni ca| syāttrayodaśamūṣāṇāmaṣṭaṣaṣṭiśca veśmanām ||132 syāccaturdaśamūṣāṇāṃ trisahasrī saṣaṣṭikā| mūṣābhiḥ pañcadaśabhiḥ ṣoḍaśāṣṭaśatī tathā ||133 dhāmnāṃ ṣoḍaśamūṣāṇāṃ tripañcāśacchataṃ bhavet| syuḥ saptadaśamūṣāṇi veśmānyaṣṭādaśa sphuṭam ||134 mūṣābhiraṣṭādaśabhirveśmaikaṃ tadvido viduḥ| lakṣadvayaṃ sahasrāṇi dvāṣaṣṭiśca śatānvitā ||135 veśmanāṃ navaśālānāṃ catvāriṃśaccaturyutā| syātsamānacatuḥśāladvayayogātsamāsataḥ ||136 ekena ca dviśālena daśaśālacatuṣṭayam| sarvatobhadra mukhyānāṃ mitho dvitayayogataḥ ||137 ekadviśālayogācca catvāriṃśattathāparā| tulyatriśālatritayamekaśālayutaṃ yadā ||138 sādhāraṇaṃ tadānyatsyāddaśaśālacatuṣṭayam| tulye triśāle yujyete sarvabhadrā dibhiryadā ||139 tadānyā daśaśālānāṃ samutpadyeta viṃśatiḥ| teṣvekamavahanmūṣaṃ viṃśatirmūṣayaikayā ||140 vahantyā syādubhābhyāṃ tu navatyabhyadhikaṃ śatam| catvāriṃśāni tisṛbhiḥ śatānyekādaśa dhruvam ||141 catvāri syuścatasṛbhiḥ sahasrāṇi śatāṣṭakam| catvāriṃśacca gehāni jāyante pañcabhiḥ saha ||142 pañcabhistu sahasrāṇi mūṣābhirdaśapañca ca| jāyante sacatuṣkāṇi tathā pañcaśatāni ca ||143 aṣṭātriṃśatsahasrāṇi ṣaḍbhiḥ sapta śatāni ca| ṣaṣṭyuttarāṇi jāyante veśmanāṃ parisaṅkhyayā ||144 gṛhāṇāṃ syuḥ sahasrāṇi saptabhiḥ saptasaptatiḥ| śatapañcakamanyacca bhavedviṃśatisaṃyutam ||145 lakṣamekaṃ sahasrāṇi pañcaviṃśatiraṣṭabhiḥ| śatāni nava jāyante saptatyabhyadhikāni ca ||146 lakṣamekaṃ sahasrāṇi saptaṣaṣṭiḥ śatāni ca| nava syuḥ ṣaṣṭiyuktāni navamūṣāpracārataḥ ||147 lakṣaṃ caturaśītiśca sahasrāṇi śatāni ca| sapta syurdaśabhistadvadpañcāśacca ṣaḍuttarā ||148 lakṣamekaṃ sahasrāṇi saptaṣaṣṭiśca veśmanām| śatāni caikādaśabhiḥ ṣaṣṭyāni nava nirdiśet ||149 lakṣaṃ tathā sahasrāṇi jāyante pañcaviṃśatiḥ| śatāni ca dvādaśabhirnava tadvacca saptatiḥ ||150 sahasrāṇi niketānāṃ saṅkhyayā saptasaptatiḥ| saviṃśatiḥ pañcaśatī trayodaśabhirīritā ||151 aṣṭātriṃśatsahasrāṇi tathā saptaśatāni ca| syuścaturdaśabhiḥ ṣaṣṭyā veśmanāmanvitāni ca ||152 syātpañcadaśasāhasrī śataiḥ pañcabhiranvitā| mūṣābhiḥ pañcadaśabhiścatvāri bhavanāni ca ||153 syuḥ sahasrāṇi catvāri tadvadaṣṭau śatāni ca| tathā ṣoḍaśamūṣāṇāṃ catvāriṃśacca pañca ca ||154 sahasraṃ saptadaśabhiḥ śatamekaṃ ca veśmanām| catvāriṃśacca veśmāni bhavanti parisaṅkhyayā ||155 śataṃ navatyabhyadhikamaṣṭādaśabhirucyate| bhavatyekonaviṃśatyā mūṣāṇāṃ veśmaviṃśatiḥ ||156 ekameva gṛhaṃ mūṣāviṃśatervahanādbhavet| saṅkhyeyaṃ daśaśālānāṃ mūṣābhedapracārataḥ ||157 prayutaṃ catvāryayutānyaṣṭasahasrāṇi pañca śatāni ca| ṣaṭsaptatirgṛhāṇi ca daśaśāleṣvekasaṅkhyeyam ||158 catuḥśālādigehāni yāvantyādaśaśālataḥ| caturguṇāni pratyāśaṃ tānyalindena nirdiśet ||159 ekadvitricatuḥśālaveśmanāṃ saṅgamānmithaḥ| gṛhāṇi daśaśālāntānyevamuktāni vistarāt ||160 samārabhya catuḥśālaṃ daśaśālāntaveśmanām| saṅkhyāmidānīmaikyena sarveṣāmabhidadhmahe ||161 mūṣābhedena lakṣāṇi syustrayodaśa veśmanām| sahasrāṇyaṣṭanavatistathā veśmāni ṣoḍaśa ||162 mūṣāsaṃsthānabhedena bhinnānāṃ veśmanāṃ punaḥ| jāyante koṭiśo bhedā yasmānnoktāni tānyataḥ ||163 itthaṃ catuḥśālamukhāni veśmānyuktāni yāvaddaśaśālamatra| śālāprabhedena mitho'bhiṣaṅgātsaṅkhyā ca teṣāmuditā yathāvat ||164 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre samastagṛhāṇāṃ saṅkhyākathanaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <26> atha āyādinirṇayo nāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| idānīmabhidhāsyāmaḥ sūtrapātavidheḥ kramam| śaste māsi site pakṣe vidadhyāttaṃ śubhe'hani ||1 caitre śokākulo bhartā vaiśākhe ca dhanānvitaḥ| jyeṣṭhe gṛhī vipadyeta naśyanti paśavaḥ śucau ||2 śrāvaṇe dhanavṛddhiḥ syānnabhasye na vasedgṛhe| kalahaścāśvine māsi bhṛtyā naśyanti kārttike ||3 mārgaśīrṣe dhanaprāptiḥ sahasye kāmasampadaḥ| māghe vahnibhayaṃ caiva phālgune śrīranuttamā ||4 dvitīyā pañcamī mukhyā saptamī navamī tathā| ekādaśītrayodaśyastithayaḥ syuḥ śubhāvahāḥ ||5 candra tārābalaṃ bharturanukūlaṃ ca śasyate| iyaṃ hi sūtrapātākhyā kriyā prāsādakarmaṇi ||6 kāryā puraniveśe ca prārambhe bhavanasya ca| śilāniveśane dvārastambhocchrāyādikeṣu ca ||7 ādri yeta site pakṣe śobhane lagna eva hi| ravau kanyātulālisthe gṛhaṃ varuṇadiṅmukham ||8 na kuryāttaddhi śūnyaṃ syānna ca vṛddhirbhavetprabhoḥ| na dakṣiṇamukhaṃ kumbhamṛgadhanvisthite ravau ||9 kurvīta niṣphalaṃ tatsyānnṛpadaṇḍavadhādikṛt| na mīnavṛṣameṣasthe kurvīta prāṅmukhaṃ ravau ||10 taddhanaghnaṃ kalikṣudra rājacaurārtikṛdyataḥ| ravau mithunasiṃhasthe na karkisthe'pyudaṅmukham ||11 kuryāttaddhi daridra tvaṃ dadyāccaraṇadāsatām| āyavyayāṃśakarkṣāṇi pravakṣyāmo'tha veśmanām ||12 gṛhamānavaśātsamyakkartuḥ sthānabalābalam| nagare vā purādau vā daṇḍairmānaṃ vidhīyate ||13 tadalābhe karaiḥ kāryaṃ samyagāyaviśuddhaye| yatra hastairmitiḥ kṣetre tatrāyo hastasaṃśritaḥ ||14 kṣetrālābhe tu tatraiva grāhyaḥ sa syādihāṅgulaiḥ| aṅgulaistu mite kṣetre so'ṅgulaistadalābhataḥ ||15 pādairvātha yavairvāpi grāhyaḥ kṣetrānusārataḥ| gṛheṣu karmahastena mānaṃ svāmikareṇa vā ||16 devatānāṃ tu dhiṣṇyeṣu karmahastena kevalam| dairghyaṃ hanyātpṛthutvena haredbhāgaṃ tato'ṣṭabhiḥ ||17 yaccheṣamāyaṃ taṃ vidyācchāstradṛṣṭaṃ dhvajādikam| dhvajo dhūmo'tha siṃhaśca śvā vṛṣaḥ kharakuñjarau ||18 dhvāṅkṣaśceti ta uddiṣṭāḥ prācyādyāsu pradakṣiṇam| anyonyābhhimukhāste ca kāmaṃ svacchandacāriṇaḥ ||19 pūrvācāryaiḥ samuddiṣṭā āyavṛddhividhāyakāḥ| vṛṣasiṃhagajāḥ śastāḥ prāsādapuraveśmasu ||20 dhvaje'rthalābhaḥ santāpo dhūme bhogo mṛgādhipe| kaliḥ śuni dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ vṛṣe strīdūṣaṇaṃ khare ||21 gaje bhadrā ṇi dṛśyante dhvāṅkṣe tu maraṇaṃ dhruvam| vṛṣasthāne gajaṃ kuryātsiṃhaṃ vṛṣabhahastinoḥ ||22 na kuryādvṛṣamanyatra śasyate sarvato dhvajaḥ| kalyāṇaṃ kurute siṃho brāhmaṇasya viśeṣataḥ ||23 kṣattriyasya gajaḥ śasto vṛṣabhaḥ śasyate viśaḥ| śūdra sya dhvaja
