evaikaḥ śasyate'rthapradaḥ sadā ||24 evamete gṛhādīnāmāyāḥ sarve prakīrtitāḥ| pradadyādāsane siṃhamātapatreṣu tu dhvajam ||25 cihneṣvapi ca sarveṣu cāmaravyajanādiṣu| siṃhaṃ gajaṃ vā śastreṣu ratheṣu kavaceṣu ca ||26 sāryaśvagajaparyāṇeṣvibhaṃ vṛṣabhameva ca| arthadhāraṇapātreṣu śayaneṣu mataṅgajam ||27 yāne ca vāhane caiva matimān yojayedgajam| prāsādapratimāliṅgapīṭhamaṇḍapavediṣu ||28 kuṇḍeṣu ca dhvajaṃ dadyāddevopakaraṇeṣu ca| āyo gṛhavadudvāhavedīmaṇḍapayorbhavet ||29 mahānase vṛṣaṃ dadyājjalādhāre jalāśaye| sthālyāṃ bhojanapātre ca koṣṭhāgāre'nnadhāraṇe ||30 etadgṛhe tathā dadyādgṛhopakaraṇeṣu ca| vṛṣabhaṃ gajaśālāyāṃ pradadyādgajameva vā ||31 vṛṣaṃ turagaśālāsu gośālāgokuleṣu ca| gajāśvavṛṣaśālāsu siṃhaṃ yatnena varjayet ||32 adhamānāṃ kharadhvāṅkṣadhūmaśvānaḥ śubhāvahāḥ| dhūmo'gnijīvināṃ śasto dhvāṅkṣaḥ sannyāsināṃ hitaḥ ||33 svagaṇānāṃ śvapākānāṃ svaveśmānāṃ kharaḥ śubhaḥ| naṭanartakaveśmeṣu paṇyastrīṇāṃ kharaḥ śubhaḥ ||34 kulālarajakādīnāṃ tathā gardabhajīvinām| gṛhādiṣu kṣetraphalaṃ gaṇayedaṣṭabhirbhajet ||35 trighanena bhajeccheṣaṃ nakṣatre'ṣṭahṛte vyayaḥ| piśāco rākṣaso yakṣa iti tredhā vyayo mataḥ ||36 sāmyādhikyanyūnatābhirāyataḥ syādyathākramam| vyayaṃ kṣetraphale kṣiptvā gṛhanāmākṣarāṇi ca ||37 bhāgaṃ tribhirharettatra yaccheṣaṃ saoṃ'śako bhavet| caturaṅgo yathā mantro mukhyo lagne navāṃśakaḥ ||38 tathā gṛhādiṣu proktaṃ mukhyatvenāṃśakatrayam| indro yamaśca rājā ca trayo nāmābhiraṃśakāḥ ||39 svanāmatulyaphaladā vijñātavyāstrayo'pi ca| gaṇayetsvāminakṣatrādyāvatsyādbhavanasya bham ||40 navabhirbhājite tasmiñśeṣaṃ tārā prakīrtitā| janmasampadvipatkṣemapāpasādhakanaidhanīḥ ||41 maitrīparamamaitryau ca prāhuḥ saṃjñāḥ samāḥ phale| trisaptapañcamīrbharturgṛhatārā vivarjayet ||42 ādyādvitīyāṣṭamyastu tārāḥ syuriha madhyamāḥ| tathā ṛkṣe'pi cāniṣṭe candre 'ṣṭamagate'pi ca ||43 nayate duritaṃ tārā catuḥṣaṇṇavatī nṛṇām| surarākṣasamartyākhyā ṛkṣāṇāṃ syurgaṇāstrayaḥ ||44 yadgaṇarkṣo bhavedbhartā tadgaṇarkṣaṃ gṛhaṃ śubham| mṛgāśvirevatīsvātyo maitraṃ puṣyapunarvasū ||45 hastaḥ śravaṇa ityeṣa devākhyo navako gaṇaḥ| viśākhā kṛttikāśleṣā naiṛtaṃ vāruṇaṃ maghā ||46 citrā jyeṣṭhā dhaniṣṭheti navako rākṣaso gaṇaḥ| ārdrābharaṇyau rohiṇyau tisraḥ pūrvāstathottarāḥ ||47 iti nakṣatranavakaṃ vijñeyaṃ mānuṣe gaṇe| gaṇasāmyaṃ śubhā tārā yasyāyātṛ vyayo'lpakaḥ ||48 hitaoṃ'śakaśca tadveśma bhartuḥ śubhaphalapradam| āyo vyayaśca yonitvaṃ tārāśca bhavanāṃśakāḥ ||49 gṛhanāmeti cintyāni karaṇāni gṛhasya ṣaṭ| tribhiḥ śubhaiḥ śubhaṃ veśma dvābhyāmekena cāśubham ||50 karaṇaiścaturādyaistu śubhairatiśubhaṃ bhavet| na samāyavyayaṃ veśma nāvyayaṃ nādhikavyayam ||51 na dvitīyāṃśamasadṛgyonibhaṃ ca na kārayet| bhartṛtulyābhidhānaṃ ca gṛhaṃ dūrātparityajet ||52 samasaptakamekarkṣaṃ tṛtīyaikādaśaṃ tathā| caturthadaśakaṃ ceti kartavyaṃ mandri raṃ sadā ||53 ṣaṭkoṣṭhakaṃ trikoṇaṃ ca varjyaṃ dvirdvādaśaṃ tathā| ṣaṭkoṣṭhake mṛtirdainyaṃ viyogaśca bhavedgṛhe ||54 trikoṇe vasatāṃ duḥkhaṃ vaidhavyaṃ ca prajāyate| dvirdvādaśe putrapautragurubandhudhanakṣayaḥ ||55 hṛte'ṣṭabhiḥ kṣetraphale khanetraśaśibhājite| śeṣaṃ jīvitametasmin pañcabhakte bhavenmṛtiḥ ||56 sabhujaṃ sahaṣaḍdāru mukhamaṇḍapasaṃyutam| āyāmataḥ pṛthutvācca mānaṃ kṛtvā vibhājayet ||57 sarvataḥ śodhitaṃ vāstu yacca samyaṅmitaṃ bhavet| svāminastadbhaveddhanyaṃ sthapateśca yaśaskaram ||58 arcitaṃ vardhate vāstu nārībhiḥ paśubhirnaraiḥ| kīrttyāyurdhanadhānyaiśca pramodaistu mahotsavaiḥ ||59 meruśca khaṇḍameruśca patākā sūcikā tathā| uddiṣṭaṃ naṣṭamiti ṣaṭ chandāṃsīha pracakṣate ||60 ekādyekottarān koṣṭhān vinyasedicchayātmanaḥ| ādyādārabhya tadvṛddhiryathā syātpārśvayoḥ samam ||61 merorekādhikā saṅkhayā śarāvasyeva cākṛtiḥ| prathame koṣṭhake rūpamantaṃ yāvacca pārśvayoḥ ||62 āsanordhvasthayornyasyenmadhye saṅkalitaṃ pṛthak| tasminniṣṭavikalpānāṃ saṅkhyā syādantyapaṅktigā ||63 khaṇḍameruṃ tu vinyasyettadvadevaikapārśvataḥ| pravṛddhaiḥ koṣṭakaistatrāpyaṅkāḥ prāgvatphalaṃ tathā ||64 athāparaḥ khaṇḍameruḥ koṣṭhāṃstatreṣṭasaṅkhyayā| kṛtvaikāpacitān vāmavibhāgāpacitānadhaḥ ||65 ekādyekottarānaṅkānādyapaṅktau niveśayet| anyāsu paṅktiṣvāprāntaṃ śūnyānyādyeṣu kalpayet ||66 dvitīyeṣu ca koṣṭheṣu tāsāmekaikamāvayet| dvitīyāyāṃ tṛtīyādikoṣṭhakeṣu yathākramam ||67 vikarṇayogajānanyānūrdhvādhoyogasaṃbhavān| phalaṃ vikarṇayogotthamekasmin parikalpayet ||68 ekādhikānabhīṣṭāyāḥ saṅkhyāyāstiryagālikhet| koṣṭhānekāṃca rūpādīṃstanmadhye dviguṇottarān ||69 ekonaṃ pṛṣṭhatasteṣāmekaṃ dviguṇamagrataḥ| nātikrāmetparāṃ saṅkhyāṃ patākāchanda ucyate ||70 tadvineṣṭādyagā saṅkhyetyekādyaistaistato gṛhe| nyastāṅkasaṅkhyāḥ saṅkhyāḥ syuralindādyaiḥ prakalpitāḥ ||71 ekaikamiṣṭasthāneṣu likhetsaikeśvataḥ param| antyādṛte pūrvapūrvayuktenāyojayetparam ||72 antyādārabhya tadvanāvekādyeṣu ca paryayāt| alindādiṣu yatra syātsaṅkhyā sūcīṃ tu tāṃ viduḥ ||73 uddiṣṭe sthāpayetsaṅkhyāmuddiṣṭāṃ sambhavecca tām| dalayedrū payuktāṃ tu dalayennāma sambhavet ||74 laghusvarūpadalane saikārdhe karaṇe guruḥ| yāvadiṣṭapadāpitaḥ syāllaghavo'lindakodayaḥ ||75 kṛtvā chandaḥ samuddiṣṭaṃ tadante laghuni dvikam| nyasedekaṃ gurūṇāṃ ca dviguṇaṃ dviguṇaṃ tataḥ ||76 vyatyayāllaghunaḥ sthāne dviguṇādekakaṃ guroḥ| kuryāttamādyasthānāṅkasaṅkhyaṃ naṣṭe gṛhaṃ bhavet ||77 prāptasyaikaṃ koṣṭhamekaikavṛddhyā nyasyedūrdhvaṃ paṅktayo yāvadiṣṭāḥ| iṣṭānekādīllikhedānupūrvyā karṇenādhaḥ śūnyarūpe ca dadyāt ||78 karṇasthāṅkaśleṣato'ṅke bhavedyastaṃ vinyasyetkoṣṭhakeṣu krameṇa| uddiṣṭāṅko bhadra saṅkhyāni madhye yābhyaḥ karṇaśleṣato mūṣikāstāḥ ||79 ekādiṣu dviguṇiteṣviha yāvadiṣṭamūṣākramavyupahiteṣvatha teṣu vidyāt| uddiṣṭaveśmakṛtanirgamamārgamūṣāsatkāṅkasaikayutinirmitasaṅkhyamokaḥ ||80 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre āyavyayanakṣatrarāśiphalatadyogatārāṅkayonitacchandoganirṇayo nāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <27> atha sabhāṣṭakaṃ nāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| nandā bhadrā jayā pūrṇā sabhā syādbhāvitā tathā| dakṣā ca pravarā tadvadvidurā cāṣṭamī matā ||1 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre tataḥ ṣoḍhā vibhājite| madhye padacatuṣkaṃ syātsīmālindastu bhāgikaḥ ||2 tadvādyo'lindakastadvadbhavetpratisarābhidhaḥ| prāggrīvākhyastṛtīyaśca bahiḥ kṣetrāccaturdiśam ||3 nisṛṣṭasaurdhayairvā syādekasyāṃ vā yadā diśi| nandā bhadrā jayā pūrṇā krameṇa syuḥ sabhāstadā ||4 ṣaḍbhāgabhājite kṣetre karṇabhittiṃ niveśayet| sabhā syādbhāvitā nāma saprāggrīvātra pañcamī ||5 stambhānṣaṭtriṃśadetāsu pañcasvapi niveśayet| stambhānprāggrīvasaṃbaddhānpṛthagebhyo vinirdiśet ||6 dakṣeti ṣaṣṭhī paritastṛtīyālindaveṣṭitā| pravarā saptamī dvārairyuktaiṣā parikīrtitā ||7 prāggrīvadvārasaṃyuktā viduretyaṣṭamī sabhā| sabhānāmidamaṣṭānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ samudāhṛtam ||8 ityaṣṭānāṃ lakṣma samyaksabhānā-| metatproktaṃ digbhavālindabhedāt| tadvaddvārālindasaṃyogaśca| jñāte'tra syādbhūbhṛtāṃ sthānayogaḥ ||9 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre sabhāṣṭakaṃ nāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <28> atha gṛhadra vyapramāṇāni nāmāṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| upādeyāni yānyatra parityājyāni yāni ca| gṛhadra vyapramāṇāni tānīdānīṃ pracakṣmahe ||1 dvārasya gṛhavistārairhastatulyāṅgulairbhavet| uchrāyaḥ saptabhiryuktairvistṛtistu tadardhataḥ ||2 prakalpayedgṛhadvāraṃ krameṇaiva kanīyasā| trairāśikena madhyānāṃ dvādaśāṃśaṃ parityajet ||3 ityucchritistadardhena sarveṣāmapi vistaraḥ| ucchrāyamuttamānāṃ tu kuryādaṣṭāṃśavarjitam ||4 vistārāṅgulasaṃyuktāṃ kuryādatikaniyasām| catuḥṣaṣṭigṛhadvāramudayenārdhavistṛtam ||5 vistārahastatulyāni ṣaṣṭyā pañcaśatāthavā| saṃyutānyaṅgulāni syāducchrāyo'rdhena vistṛtiḥ ||6 gṛhotsedhena vā tryaṃśahīnena syātsamucchritiḥ| tadardhena tu vistāro dvārasyetyaparo vidhiḥ ||7 dvārocchrāyakaraistulyeṣvaṅguleṣu vinikṣipet| catvāri pedyāpiṇḍaḥ syātsapādaṃ vidadhīta tam ||8 sārdhaṃ vā satribhāgaṃ vā dviguṇaṃ cādhikaṃ na tu| evaṃ kṛte bhavet dvārapedyāyā vistṛtiḥ sphuṭā ||9 sārdhena pedyāpiṇḍena piṇḍaṃ syādambaro bhavet| sārdhastu pedyāvistāraḥ syādudumbaravistṛtiḥ ||10 pedyāpiṇḍena tulyā syācchākhāyā vistṛtiḥ śubhā| sārdhayā vaitayā rūpaśākhāyā api vistṛtiḥ ||11 vistārārdhena pedyāyāḥ khalvaśākhā vidhīyate| rūpaśākhāsamā vā syātsārdhā vā bāhyamaṇḍalā ||12 pādonā tryaṃśahīnā vā vistārādardhameva vā| prāsādeṣu ca tulyaḥ syādbhāraśākhāvinirgamaḥ ||13 ādyā śākhā bhaveddevī dvitīyā nandinīti ca| tṛtīyā sundarī nāma caturthī syāt priyānanā ||14 bhadre ti pañcamī śākhā praśastāḥ pañca veśmani| ato'dhikāstu yāḥ śākhā gṛhadvāri na tāḥ śubhāḥ ||15 vistārāt ṣoḍaśo bhāgaścaturhastasamanvitaḥ| talocchrayaḥ praśasto'yaṃ bhavedviditaveśmanām ||16 saptahasto bhavejjyeṣṭhe madhyame ṣaṭkaronmitaḥ| pañcahastaḥ kaniṣṭhe tu vidhātavyastathodayaḥ ||17 jyeṣṭhe bhavetsaptadaśahastācchālā pravistṛtā| madhyame daśahastāttu pañcahastātkanīyasi ||18 udumbarārthe bāhulyaṃ talanyāsaṃ tu kārayet| talanyāsasamaṃ paṭṭamalindasya parigrahe ||19 dvāravistārapādena stambhakoṭirvidhīyate| sāṣṭāṃśenādhikenātha satribhāge vā punaḥ ||20 kuryādekādaśāṃśena tathāsyaiva prapālakam| stambhān kuryādṛte'ṣṭāṃśānnava dvādaśadhāthavā ||21 bhāgaistataḥ svārdhasamairardhabhāgasamanvitaiḥ| adhastāḍaṣṭabhāgā syātstambhasya pratipālanā ||22 stambhamūlasya vistārādardhena sthalanirgamaḥ| tadardhena vidhātavyo masūrakavinirgamaḥ ||23 utkālakasamuchrāyaḥ stambhapiṇḍasamaḥ śubhaḥ| kumbhikotkālavatpiṇḍe vistāre'ṣṭāṃśasammitā ||24 prāguktastambhabhāgena sapādena vidhīyate| dīrghatvamādyapatrāṇāṃ śeṣāṇāṃ pādahānitaḥ ||25 pādaḥ pādo bhavennyūnaḥ pātrāṇāṃ rasanocchrayāt| sārdhabhāgocchritā kāryā rasanā kaṇṭakopamā ||26 sārdhapādocchritā yadvā jaṅghā śeṣaṃ yathoditam| itthaṃ syātpadmakastambho yuktyā yuktasvarūpakaiḥ ||27 aṣṭāśro vā vidhātavyaḥ stambhasūtraparikramāt| tadvistārasamaṃ tyaktotsedhaṃ bhāgānvibhājayet ||28 aṣṭāśracchedamānena bāhyasūtrānupallavān| vidadhyānmadhyabhāge tu koṇāṃśca pallavikākulān ||29 ghaṭikā puṣpamālābhiḥ pallavaiścopaśobhitā| chedabhāgaḥ samaḥ kāryo bahirbhāgavivarjitaḥ ||30 ghaṭapallavako nāma stambho'yaṃ parikīritaḥ| vihito veśmanāmeṣa svāminaḥ śreyase bhavet ||31 kubero vā vidhātavyaḥ ṣoḍaśāśrakriyānvitaḥ| ūrdhvataḥ pallavākīrṇo jaṅghāsya caturaśrikā ||32 śrīdharaśca bhavedvṛttaḥ kalpanāsya kuberavat| evaṃ gṛhāṇāṃ catvāraḥ stambhā lakṣmabhirīritāḥ ||33 stambhamūlasya vistṛtyā talapadasya vistṛtiḥ| sapādayā vidhātavyā bāhulyaṃ pādahīnayā ||34 stambhena tulyaṃ vistāre bāhalye padasammitam| hīragrahaṇamāyāme stambhāgrāttriguṇaṃ bhavet ||35 hīragrahaṇavistāraṃ bhāgātsapta prakalpayet| tatsyātsṛṣṭottaraṃ bhāgaṃ bhāgeneṣṭaṃ praveśanam ||36 tasyādhastāttrikaṇṭena tribhāgaṃ lambitena ca| likhedubhāvardhacandrau pārśvayorubhayorapi ||37 khalvaṃ kṛtvā tato madhyaṃ bhāgadvayamadhogatam| kuryāttrikaṇṭakaṃ kāntaṃ tumbikāmatha lambikām ||38 dvayormadhye'paraṃ bhūyo dvibhāgasthaṃ ca kaṇṭakam| tumbikāṃ lambamānāṃ vā patrajātivibhūṣitām ||39 tasyāścāparatīraṃ syātpadmapatryā vibhūṣitam| talapaṭṭasamaḥ pedro vistārātpiṇḍato'pi ca ||40 paṭṭatryaṃśena tīre syātpaṭṭapiṇḍārdhanirgamaḥ| stambhāgreṇa samā kāryā vistārasthaulyatastulā ||41 tadardhena jayantīnāṃ kartavye piṇḍavistṛtī| tābhyo vidheyāḥ pādonāḥ sandhipālā yadṛcchayā ||42 niryūheṣu ca ye paṭṭāḥ pādonāṃstāṃstu kārayet| tulāpaṭṭāśca pādonāstadardhena jayantikāḥ ||43 tulārdhena vidhātavyā pratimokasya vistṛtiḥ| paṭṭasyopari kaṇṭhaḥ syādbhūṣito rūpakarmaṇā ||44 vedikājālarūpādyo niryūhaḥ saṃpraśasyate| vidhātavyā ca sacchatrā nibaddhāṅgaṇavāpikā ||45 stambhapaṭṭāṃśca vistīrṇān sapādāṃstatra kalpayet| tulāpiṇḍāḥ samāḥ kāryāḥ saṅgrahaiḥ sudṛḍhairyutāḥ ||46 vedikājālasampannaṃ talaṃ kāryaṃ manoramam| bhūmau bhūmau bhavettacca dvādaśāṃśavivarjitam ||47 praṇālyaḥ sarvataḥ kāryā mūlagrāhāgranirgamāḥ| daṇḍacchādyaṃ gṛheṣu syājjñeyaṃ tacca caturvidham ||48 bhūtākhyaṃ tilakaṃ tadvanmaṇḍalaṃ kumudaṃ tathā| gṛhacchādyeṣu teṣu syāduchrāyo'pi caturvidhaḥ ||49 kṣetraturyāṃśataḥ kāryo dairghyeṇacchādyadaṇḍakaḥ| tadardhaṃ muṣṭikāyāmo daṇḍatryaṃśena lambanā ||50 caturaśraṃ samaṃ kāntaṃ madhuraṃ sudṛḍhaṃ ghanam| veśmanāṃ chādyakaṃ kāryaṃ bhūtaṃ nāmnā supūjitam ||51 tasyaivāṣṭādaśo bhāgo yadā syāducchraye'dhikaḥ| udayastilako nāma śastaḥ sa gṛhakarmaṇi ||52 dvābhyāmuccataraḥ pūrvo maṇḍalaḥ kumudastribhiḥ| abhittisthe bhavecchādye candra rekhāvibhūṣitam ||53 guṇarāgānvitā bhittiryadvā ghanacayātmikā| tatracchādyaṃ bhaveccānyadavadhāraṇasaṃjñitam ||54 siṃhakarṇakapotālīghaṇṭākarṇārdhapakṣagāḥ| dhvajacchatrakumārāṃśca gṛheṣu parivarjayet ||55 na pakṣarājidhvajasiṃhakarṇakumāraghaṇṭāḥ samarālapallīḥ| na praskhalārdhāni nacaiva patrāṇyāyojayedveśmasu maṅgalārthī ||56 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre gṛhadra vyapramāṇāni nāmāṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <29> atha śayanāsanalakṣaṇaṃ nāma ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| idānīmabhidhāsyāmaḥ śayanāsanalakṣaṇam| śubhāśubhaparijñānaṃ yena samyakprajāyate ||1 mūtre muhūrte puṣyasthe śītaraśmau śubhe'hani| sampūjya devatāḥ samyakkarmārambhaṃ samācaret ||2 vṛkṣāstatra praśasyante candanastiniśo'rjunaḥ| tindukaḥ sālaśākau ca śirīṣāsanadhanvanāḥ ||3 haridrurdevadāruśca syandanokau sapadmakau| śrīparṇī dadhiparṇaśca śiṃśapānye'pi ye śubhāḥ ||4 gṛhakarmaṇi ye neṣṭā vṛkṣāste'trāpi ninditāḥ| hemnā rūyeṇa cānaddhā gajadantena vā śubhā ||5 ārakūṭena vā naddhā śayyā kāryā vicakṣaṇaiḥ| pūrvacchinnaṃ yadā dāru śayanāsanahetave ||6 ādīyate tadārambhe nimittānyupalakṣayet| dadhyakṣatān pūrṇakumbhaṃ ratnāni kusumāni vā ||7 sugandhadra vyavastrādyān matsyāśvayugalaṃ tathā| mattavāraṇamanyāṃśca śubhān vīkṣyādiśecchubham ||8 karmāṅgulaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ vituṣairaṣṭabhiryavaiḥ| aṣṭottaraśataṃ teṣāṃ śayyā jyeṣṭhā mahībhujām ||9 madhyā mahībhujāṃ śayyā śataṃ syāccaturuttaram| śataṃ kanīyasī proktā nṛpāṇāṃ vijayāvahā ||10 navatirnṛpaputrasya mantriṇaḥ sā ṣaḍujjhitā| dvādaśonā balapatestriṣaṭkonā purodhasaḥ ||11 āyāmārdhena vistāraṃ sarvaṃ śayyāsu kalpayet| yadvā nijāṣṭabhāgena ṣaḍbhāgenāthavādhikam ||12 viprāṇāṃ śasyate śayyā dairghyeṇāṅgulasaptatiḥ| dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāmaṅgulābhyāṃ hīnā syāccheṣavarṇinām ||13 bāhalyamutpalasya syāduttamasyāṅgulatrayam| aṅguladvitayaṃ sādhaṃ madhyasya dve kanīyasaḥ ||14 bāhalyamīśādaṇḍasya kuryādutpalasammitam| sārdhaṃ sapādaṃ satryaṃśaṃ tasya vistāramutpalāt ||15 vistārārdhena śayyāyāḥ sakuṣyasya vidhīyate| tatpādasyodayo madhyahīnau dvicaturujjhitau ||16 ardhena madhyavistārānmadhye bāhalyamiṣyate| tribhāgahīnamicchanti pādonamapi kecana ||17 sthaulyena pādo'dhaḥ śīrṣādutpalena samo bhavet| madhye sapādaḥ sārdhaśca tale vṛddhiḥ krameṇa sā ||18 ṣaḍbhāgo'syādhiko yadvā madhye tryaṃśādhikastale| tatkuṣyamutpalatryaṃśo mūle tasyārdhamagrataḥ ||19 utsedhatulyo vistāraḥ kāryo vā dvyaṅgulādhikaḥ| sapatrakalikāpatrapuṭagrāsavibhūṣitaḥ ||20 kuryātpradakṣiṇāgrāṇi śayyāṅgāni samantataḥ| ūrdhvāgrā nikhilāḥ pādāḥ svāmino vṛddhihetave ||21 śreṣṭhaikadra vyajā śayyā miśradra vyā na śasyate| ekadāruṃ praśaṃsanti dvidārurbhayamāvahet ||22 tridārughaṭitāyāṃ tu svāmino niyato vadhaḥ| śayyāyāṃ jāyate yasmāt tasmāttāṃ parivarjayet ||23 mūlamagreṇa saṃyuktamapasavyaṃ vigarhitam| mūlaṃ mūlena vā viddhamekāgre dve ca dāruṇī ||24 madhye vraṇo mṛtyukarastribhāge vyādhikārakaḥ| kleśāvahaścaturbhāge śirastho dra vyahānikṛt ||25 nirdoṣagātre paryaṅke pāpasvapno na dṛśyate| granthikoṭaravatkuryāttasmānna śayanāsanam ||26 āsanaṃ śayanīyaṃ ca granthikoṭaravarjitam| bahuputrakaraṃ prāhurdharmakāmārthasādhanam ||27 ārohaṇe pracalati śayane kampate tathā| videśayānakalahau te krameṇa prayacchataḥ ||28 suśliṣṭāṃ tāmataḥ kuryānnirdoṣāṃ varṇaśālinīm| dṛḍhāṃ sthirāṃ ca sthapatiḥ patyuḥ kāmavivṛddhaye ||29 niṣkuṭaṃ koladṛk kroḍanayanaṃ vatsanābhakam| kālakaṃ bandhakaṃ ceti chidra saṃkṣepa īritaḥ ||30 ghaṭavat suṣiraṃ madhye saṅkaṭāsyaṃ ca niṣkuṭam| kolākṣaṃ nīḍamicchanti māṣaniṣpāvamātrakam ||31 adhyardhaparvadīrghaṃ ca vivarṇaṃ viṣamaṃ tathā| tadiha kroḍanayanaṃ chidra māhurmaharṣayaḥ ||32 bhinnaṃ parvamitaṃ vāmāvartaṃ syādvatsanābhakam| kālakaṃ kṛṣṇakānti syādvinirbhinnaṃ tu bandhakam ||33 chidraṃ dārusavarṇaṃ yattanno śubhakaraṃ tathā| niṣkuṭe'rthakṣayaḥ kolalocane kulavidra vaḥ ||34 śastrādbhīḥ kroḍanayane vatsanābhe rujo bhayam| kālake bandhakākhye ca kīṭaviddhe ca no śubham ||35 sarvatra pracuragranthi dāru sarvamaniṣṭadam| śayyārthe kathitaiḥ kḷptaṃ dārubhiḥ śastamāsanam ||36 upaveśasukhaṃ mānaṃ praśastāya prakalpitam| puṣkaraḥ sūdahastaśca vṛtto'ṅgulacatuṣṭayāt ||37 ārabhya vistarātkāryastāvadyāvannavāṅgulam| puṣkaravyāsato daṇḍastasya kāryaścaturguṇaḥ ||38 phalakaḥ puṣkarārdhena tattulyaścāsya bhūlakaḥ| sthūlaḥ syāccaturaṃśena daṇḍapuṣkaravistarāt ||39 khātaṃ ca puṣkarasyāntastāvadgāmbhīryamiṣyate| praśastasāradārūtthaḥ kartavyo'sya prayojanam ||40 pariveṣaṇamanyacca pacyamānānaghaṭṭakam| kāryaḥ kaṅkatakaḥ ślakṣṇaḥ praśastamṛdudārujaḥ ||41 ārabhya dairghyeṇāṣṭabhyaḥ syādyāvaddvādaśāṅgulam| sārdhāṅgulaṃ caturbhāgaṃ vistāreṇa ca dairghyataḥ ||42 madhye ca tasya bāhalyaṃ vistārāṣṭāṃśato bhavet| ekataḥ sthūlavistārā bhaveyustasya dantakāḥ ||43 anyatastu ghanāḥ sūkṣmāstīkṣṇāḥ kāryāstathāgrataḥ| madhye tribhāgamutsujya dantakā bhāgayordvayoḥ ||44 tribhirbhāge hṛte teṣāṃ śeṣastān vivarjayet| gajadantamayaḥ śreṣṭhastathā śākhoṭavṛkṣajaḥ ||45 madhyamo dārubhiḥ śeṣairjaghanyo'sāradārujaḥ| rūpakaiḥ svastikādyairvā sa madhye syādalaṅkṛtaḥ ||46 yūkādyapanaye keśaviveke copayujyate| aṅgulenādhike pādātkārye dairghyeṇa pāduke ||47 kṛtāyāṃ pañcadhā tasyāṃ kuryādbhāgatrayaṃ puraḥ| pañcādbhāgadvayaṃ tatra saṅgraho'syā vidhīyate ||48 aṅgulatrayamutsedho vistāro'ṅghrayanusārataḥ| aṅgulyaṅguṣṭhayormadhyabhāge matsyādyalaṅkṛtau ||49 kartavyau kīlakau kāṣṭhadantaśṛṅgādisambhavau| gajendra dantaḥ śrīkhaṇḍaśrīparṇyau meṣaśṛṅgikā ||50 śastāḥ pādukayoḥ śākakṣīriṇīcirabilvikāḥ| idamiha śayanānāmāsanānāṃ ca lakṣma| prakaṭitamanu darvyāḥ kaṅkatasyāpi samyak| śubhamatha viparītaṃ pādukānāṃ ca vidvān| sakalamiti viditvā pūjyatāmeti loke ||51 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre śayanāsanalakṣāṇaṃ nāma ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <30> atha rājagṛhaṃ nāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| aṣṭottaraśataṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ madhyaṃ syānnavatiṃ karān| jaghanyaṃ saptatikarān rājaveśma praśasyate ||1 ato hīnaṃ na kartavyaṃ mahatīṃ śriyamicchatā| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre daśadhā pravibhājite ||2 bhāgārdhaṃ śasyate bhittirādikoṇasamāśritā| catuṣko bhāgiko madhye catuḥstambhasamanvitaḥ ||3 alindastadbahiḥ kāryaḥ stambhairdvādaśabhirvṛtaḥ| viṃśatyā syādvarairyukto dvitīyo'lindakastataḥ ||4 syādaṣṭāviṃśatistambhastṛtīyaścāpyalindakaḥ| ṣaṭtriṃśatā caturthaśca stambhānāṃ parikīrtitaḥ ||5 evaṃ stambhaśataṃ madhye proktaṃ pṛthvījaye budhaiḥ| dvārāṇi cāsya catvāri pañcaśākhāni jāyate ||6 catvāro nirgamāstasya proktāḥ sarve vibhāgikāḥ| dikṣu sarvāsu kartavyamevaṃ bhadra niveśanam ||7 ardhena madhyabhittestu bhittirbhadra straye bhavet| bhadre bhadre dharāṇāṃ syād viṃśatiścāṣṭabhiryutā ||8 mukhabhadraṃ bhavetyuktaṃ vedikāmattavāraṇaiḥ| kṣetrabhāgodayādyā bhūrābhūmiphalakāntaram ||9 ādibhūmyudayārdhena pīṭhaṃ cāsya prakalpayet| bhāgānnavodayaṃ kṛtvā bhāgenaikena kumbhikā ||10 kartavyāṣṭāṃśayuktena stambho bhāgacatuṣṭaye| pādayuktaṃ vidhātavyo bhāgenotkalakaṃ tathā ||11 hīragrahaṇakaṃ kāryaṃ bhāgaṃ pādavivarjitaḥ| sapādabhāgikaḥ paṭṭaḥ stambhakena samanvitaḥ ||12 paṭṭārdhena jayantyaḥ syurbhūmaubhūmāvayaṃ kramaḥ| kḷptabhāgodayādardhaṃ bhūmiṣvanyāsu hīyate ||13 pañcabhāgapramāṇaṃ tu sacchādyaṃ navamaṃ talam| vedikāyā adhaśchādyaṃ sārdhabhāgatrayonmitam ||14 kaṇṭhena yuktaṃ kartavyaṃ vedikā pihitā yathā| tasyāḥ kaṇṭhe vidhātavyastanmadhye sārdhabhāgikaḥ ||15 vedikāvistaraḥ kāryo bhāgāṃstatrārdhasaptamān| vedikopari ghaṇṭā ca sārdhabhāgāścaturdaśa ||16 bhāgadvayaṃ sapādaṃ tu kaṇṭhaḥ paṭṭaṃ tu pañcabhiḥ| caturbhiśca dvitīyaṃ ca tṛtīyaṃ ca tribhistataḥ ||17 sadmaśīrṣaśca dātavyo yathāśobhaṃ yathāruci| kṣetrabhāgasamaḥ kāryaḥ kalaśaścūlikāvadheḥ ||18 udayārdhena bhūmeḥ syurantarāṇi talāni ca| yathāśobhaṃ tu kartavyaṃ pīṭhaṃ tasya suśobhitam ||19 sārdhabhāgadvayaṃ cāsya kāryā khuragharaṇḍikā| jaṅghā bhāgacatuṣkaṃ ca tataśchādyaṃ prayojayet ||20 bhāgadvayaṃ ca pādonaṃ chādyapiṇḍaḥ prakīrtitaḥ| nirgamo'sya caturbhāgo haṃsākhyastasya copari ||21 pādonabhāgaṃ kartavyaṃ tataśchādyaṃ dvitīyakam| jaṅghā bhūmicatuṣkeṇa prāsādasya prakalpayet ||22 caturthabhūmikāmūrdhni tato muṇḍā niveśayet| kṣaṇakṣaṇapraveśena kāryāḥ śeṣāstu bhūmikāḥ ||23 vedikā ca yathoktā syātsaghaṇṭā kalaśānvitā| rekhāśuddhyā ca kartavyā muṇḍāḥ sarve yathāyatham ||24 ardhodayaṃ tridhā kṛtvā tṛtīyaṃ daśadhā bhajet| vāmanaścātapatraśca kubero bhramarāvalī ||25 haṃsapṛṣṭho mahābhogī nāradaḥ śambuko jayaḥ| ananto daśamasteṣāṃ vidhāyakavaśādamī ||26 vidhātavyāḥ sthapatibhirmuṇḍarekhāprasiddhaye| tamaṅgavedikājālamattavāraṇaśobhitam ||27 vitardiniryūhayutaṃ candra śālāvibhūṣitam| karmāḍhyaṃ bahucitraṃ ca kurvīta pṛthivījayam ||28 prāsādāśca mahānto ye vidheyāste samodayāḥ| ardhodayena laghavo hyavākoṇādayaṃ kramaḥ ||29 bhūmyaṣṭakādabhyudayaḥ kṣetravistārasammitaḥ| yatastava vadhe proktaḥ prāsādo'nyadvibhūṣaṇam ||30 bahavo nikarā yeṣu prāṅgaṇaṃ teṣu dīyate| rekhāyāṃ prathamāyāṃ vā dvitīyāyāmathāpi vā ||31 tṛtīyāyāṃ vā rekhāyāṃ tatra saṃvaraṇāḥ smṛtāḥ| ayaṃ bhūmyudayaḥ kāryaḥ kṣetre daśavibhāgike ||32 nyūnādhikavibhakte tu kāryaḥ syādanusārataḥ| muktakoṇasya lakṣmātha prakramāgatamucyate ||33 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre bhāgadvādaśakāṅkite| bhāgaścatuṣṭo madhye'sya caturdvāravibhūṣitaḥ ||34 bhāgena ca tato'lindo dharadvādaśakānvitaḥ| tadvad dvitīyālindo'pi viṃśatyā dhārito dharaiḥ ||35 tṛtīyaśca dharairaṣṭāviṃśatyālindako bhavet| ṣaṭtriṃśatā dharairyuktaḥ kāryo'lindaścaturthakaḥ ||36 catuścatvāriṃśatā syād dharairyuktaśca pañcamaḥ| bhāgārdhaṃ kārayed gittiṃ sārdhaṃ bhāgaṃ vimucya tu ||37 bhāgatrayaṃ tataḥ kuryātprāggrīvaṃ dairghyavistṛtau| vistṛtau nirgame caiṣāṃ bhadraṃ bhāgena kalpayet ||38 bhāgikaṃ nirgataṃ tasmānmadhye'nyadbhadra masya hi| bhāganirgamavistāraṃ dikṣu sarvāsvayaṃ vidhiḥ ||39 catuḥpañcāśatā stambhairekaikaṃ bhadra manvitam| madhye vāsya catuścatvāriṃśaṃ stambhaśataṃ bhavet ||40 ṣoḍaśābhyadhikā ca syādbhadra stambhaśatadvayī| evaṃ dharāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ bhavet ṣaṣṭhaṃ śatatrayam ||41 pṛthvījayavadatrāpi śeṣanirmāṇamiṣyate| tṛtīyabhūmikāmūrdhni nirgameṣvakhileṣvapi ||42 prāṅgaṇāni vidheyāni viśeṣo'traiṣa kīrtitaḥ| sarvatobhadra saṃjñe'tha śatrumardananāmapi ||43 ayameva vidhiḥ kāryo muṇḍarekhāprasiddhaye| śrīvatsasyāpi madhye syāt stambhādyaṃ muktakoṇavat ||44 sārdhaṃ bhāgaṃ parityajya bhāgatritayavistṛtam| karṇaprāggrīvametasya bhagena ca vinirgatam ||45 bhadraṃ tasyāpi kartavyaṃ bhāgavistāranirgamam| muktakoṇavadasyāpi madhyabhadraṃ vidhīyate ||46 ayaṃ vidhiḥ samagrāsu dikṣu śeṣaṃ tu pūrvavat| pratibhadraṃ dharāstriṃśadbhavantyasya dṛḍhāḥ śubhāḥ ||47 śataṃ viṃśamidaṃ sarvadharāṇāmiha kīrtitam| evaṃ samastastambhānāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭhaṃ śatadvayam ||48 sarvatodhadra saṃjñasya lakṣmedānīṃ pracakṣmahe| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre caturdaśavibhājite ||49 bhāgikaḥ syāccatuṣko'sya catuḥstambhavibhūṣitaḥ| stambhairdvāḍaśabhiryuktaḥ prathamaḥ syādalindakaḥ ||50 stambhaviṃśatisaṃyukto dvitīyaḥ syādalindakaḥ| syādaṣṭāviṃśatistambhastṛtīyaḥ syāpyalindakaḥ ||51 ṣaṭtriṃśatā caturthaḥ syādalindo bhūṣito dharaiḥ| pañcamaḥ syāccatuścatvāriṃśatā bhūṣito dharaiḥ ||52 dvāpañcāśaddharaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ sarve'pyete'sya bhāgikāḥ| bhāgārdhaṃ śasyate bhittiḥ sarvataḥ sudṛḍhā ghanā ||53 sārdhabhāgaṃ parityajya bhāgatritayavistṛtaḥ| karṇaprāggrīvakaśca syādbhāgamekaṃ ca nirgamaḥ ||54 bhadra masyāpi kartavyaṃ bhāganirgamavistṛtam| madhye bhadraṃ vidhātavyaṃ bhāgadvayavinirgatam ||55 asyāpi bhadraṃ madhye syādbhāgatritayavistṛtam| bhāgiko nirgamaścāsya tadantarbhāganirgatam ||56 bhāgavistārasaṃyuktaṃ bhadra manyatprakalpayet| dikṣu sarvāsvayaṃ prokto vidhirbhadra prakalpane ||57 stambhānāmasya kartavyaṃ madhye ṣaṇṇavataṃ śatam| bhadre ṣveṣu ca sarveṣu bhavet ṣaṣṭyadhikaṃ śatam ||58 samena pravibhāgena stambhānāmekasaṅkhyayā| itthaṃ samastastambhānāṃ ṣaṭpañcāśaṃ śatatrayam ||59 kintu jaṅghā bhavedasya bhūmikātritayonmitā| śatrumardanasaṃjñasya bhāmno lakṣmātha kathyate ||60 pṛthvījayasamaṃ madhye bhittiścāpi tathāvidhā| sārdhaṃ bhāgaṃ parityajya bhāgenāyatavistṛtam ||61 bhadraṃ vidadhyāttanmadhye bhagatritayavistṛtam| bhadra meva vidhātavyaṃ bhāgatritayanirgatam ||62 pārśvayorbhāgikaṃ bhadra māyatyāṃ vistareṇa ca| bhāgatritayavistāraṃ bhāgenaikena nirgamam ||63 madhyabhadraṃ tato'pi syādbhāgenāyatavistṛtam| kramo'yaṃ dikṣu sarvāsu vidhātavyo'sya siddhaye ||64 ūrdhvaṃpṛthvījayasyeva kāryamasyāparaṃ punaḥ| pratibhadraṃ catuścatvāriṃśatstambhasamanvitam ||65 madhye stambhaśataṃ cāsya vidheyaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ śubham| ṣaṭsaptatistambhaśatadvayamasya bhavediti ||66 pañcānāmapi caiteṣāṃ hastāṣṭaśatamuttamam| mānamutsedhavistārātkartavyaṃ śriyamicchatā ||67 madhyamādhamayormānaṃ kīrtitaṃ pṛthivījaye| rājñaḥ krīḍārthamanyacca kathyate gṛhapañcakam ||68 kṣoṇīvi bhūṣaṇaṃ tvādyaṃ pṛthivītilakaṃ param| pratāpavardhanaṃ cānyacchrīnivāsaṃ tato'pi ca ||69 lakṣmīvilāsasaṃjñaṃ ca pañcamaṃ parikīrtitam| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre daśabhāgairvibhājite ||70 catuṣko bhāgavistīrṇo madhye kāryaścaturdharaḥ| bahiśca bhāgiko'lindastadanteṃ'śatrayāyatāḥ ||71 karṇaprāsādakāḥ kāryā bhāgatritayavistṛtāḥ| teṣāṃ ṣaḍdārukaṃ madhye bhittirbhāgārdhasammitā ||72 tadbahirbhāganiṣkrānto bhadre bhāgaṃ ca vistṛtaḥ| prāggrīvatrayasaṃyukto bhāgikālindaveṣṭitaḥ ||73 ardha bhāgikabhittyā ca catuṣko veṣṭito bhavet| prāsādo'yaṃ manohārī bhavedavaniśekharaḥ ||74 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre bhāgadvādaśabhājite| catuṣko bhāgiko madhye bāhyālindau ca bhāgikau ||75 navakoṣṭhāṃśca karṇeṣu prāsādān viniveśayet| ṣaḍdārukaṃ ca kartavyaṃ teṣāmantarasaṃśrayam ||76 tato'rdhabhāgikī bhittiḥ kartavyā sarvato bahiḥ| bhadre bhāgāyato bhāgaviniṣkrāntaścaturdiśam ||77 catuṣko bhāgikā'lindaveṣṭitaśca vidhīyate| asya bhadra trayaṃ kāryaṃ bhāgavistāranirgamam ||78 ardhabhāgikabhittyā ca veṣṭitaṃ tadvidhīyate| karṇe karṇe'sya vistīrṇe dve bhadre bhāganirgate ||79 prāsādamevaṃ bhuvanatilakaṃ paricakṣate| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre bhāgadvādaśabhājite ||80 catuṣko bhāgiko madhye catuḥstambho vidhīyate| tadbahirbhāgiko'lindo dvitīyo'pi a bhāgikaḥ ||81 navakoṣṭhāṃśca karṇeṣu prāsādān viniveśayet| ṣaḍdārukaṃ ca kartavyaṃ teṣāmantarasaṃśrayam ||82 tato'rdhabhāgikī bhittiḥ kartavyā sarvato bahiḥ| bhadre bhāgāyato bhadra viniṣkrāntaścaturdharaḥ ||83 catuṣko bhāgikālindadvayena pariveṣṭitaḥ| tribhāgavistṛtaṃ bhadraṃ tadbahirbhāganirgatam ||84 bhāgikaṃ pratibhadraṃ ca kuryādubhayataḥ samam| bhāgārdhaṃ bāhyato bhittirbhadra sya parito bhavet ||85 vidhireṣa vidhātavyo dikṣvevaṃ catasṛṣvapi| vilāsastabako nāma prāsādo'yaṃ prakīrtitaḥ ||86 karṇaprāggrīvakau dvau dvau śālāprāggrīvakau yadā| syātāmasya tadā kīrttipatākaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||87 asyaiva pīṭhe nirmuktaśālābhiḥ parito'ṣṭabhiḥ| anyonyaśālāsaṃbaddhe yadāsābeva dīyate ||88 karṇaprāsādakopetaḥ koṇaiḥ śālojjhitairyutaḥ| prāsādasundaro jñeyastadā bhuvanamaṇḍanaḥ ||89 ete proktāstalacchandā jaṅghāsaṃvaraṇādikam| bhūmimānādikaṃ yacca tatpṛthvījayavadbhavet ||90 idānīṃ kathyate lakṣma kṣoṇībhūṣaṇaveśmanaḥ| pañcapañcāśatā hastaiḥ kalpite caturaśrake ||91 vibhakte cāṣṭabhirbhāgaiścatuṣko bhāgikaḥ smṛtaḥ| caturbhiranvitaḥ stambhairalindaścāsya bhāgikaḥ ||92 yukto dvādaśabhiḥ stambhairviṃśatyā ca dvitīyakaḥ| syādaṣṭāviṃśatidharastṛtīyaścāpyalindakaḥ ||93 bhitterapyardhabhāgena sārdhaṃ bhāgaṃ vimucyate| bhāgapañcakavistīrṇaṃ bhadraṃ bhāgena nirgatam ||94 tanmadhyabhadra manyacca bhāgatritayavistṛtam| bhāgena nirgataṃ kāryaṃ bhadra manyattato'pi ca ||95 bhāgena vistṛtaṃ kāryaṃ bhāgenāpi ca nirgatam| dikṣu sarvāsu kartavyo vidhireṣo'sya siddhaye ||96 madhyastambhaiścatuḥṣaṣṭyā saṃyuktaṃ sāradārujaiḥ| pratibhadraṃ dharaiḥ kāryamaṣṭādaśabhiranvitam ||97 ṣaṭtriṃśaṃ śatamevaṃ syātstambhānāmiha sarvataḥ| caturdvāramidaṃ kāryaṃ yaśaḥśrīkīrtivardhanam ||98 pṛthivītilakasyātha lakṣaṇaṃ parikīrtyate| catvāriṃśatkare kṣetre bhāgairbhakte'rdhaṣaṣṭhakaiḥ ||99 bhāgikaḥ syāccatuṣko'ntaścatuḥstambhavibhūṣitaḥ| alindo'pi ca bhāgena stambhairdvādaśabhiryutaḥ ||100 viṃśatyā ca dvitīyo'pi bhittiḥ syādasya pādikā| karṇe prāsādako bhāgaistribhiḥ syānnirgatāyataḥ ||101 asya bhadra dvayaṃ kāryaṃ bhāganirgatavistṛtam| karṇaprāsādayormadhye bhāgapañcakavistṛtam ||102 bhāgena nirgataṃ kāryaṃ bhadraṃ tasyāpi madhyataḥ| bhāgatritayavistīrṇaṃ bhāgenaikena nirgatam ||103 bhadra masyāpi madhye'nyadbhāgenāyatanirgatam| stambhāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadantaḥ syurbhadre ṣvaṣṭau śatadvayam ||104 athātaḥ śrīnivāsasya lakṣaṇaṃ sampracakṣmahe| pṛthvītilakabanmadhyametasya parikīrtyate ||105 sapādaṃ bhāgamutsṛjya bhāgatritayavistṛtam| bhāgena nirgataṃ cāsya bhadra mādyaṃ prakalpayet ||106 tasyāpi madhyavartanyadbhāganirgatavistṛtam| anvitaṃ daśabhiḥ stambhaiḥ sudṛḍhaistadvidhīyate ||107 sarvāsvapi ca dikṣvevaṃ vidheyā bhadra kalpanā| asya ṣaṭsaptatiḥ stambhāḥ bhavantyekatra saṅkhyayā ||108 pratāpavardhanasyātha lakṣma sāmpratamucyate| pañcaviṃśatihastāṅke sārdhabhāgatrayāṅkite ||109 madhye catuṣko bhāgena caturbhiḥ sambhṛto dharaiḥ| alindo bhāgikaścāsya stambhadvādaśakānvitaḥ ||110 pādikā bhittiretasya bhadraṃ cāsya prakalpayet| bhāganirgamavistāraṃ catuḥstambhavibhūṣitam ||111 vidhireṣa samagrāsu dikṣu kāryo'sya siddhaye| stambhairdvātriṃśatā yukto bahirantarayaṃ bhavet ||112 dharāṇāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ prakalpanā| atha lakṣmīvilāsasya samyaglakṣmādhunocyate ||113 pratāpavardhanasyeva madhyamasya prakalpayet| pratāpavardhanasamaṃ sarvato'pyetadīritam ||114 kintvasya pārśvabhadrā ṇi bhadrā ṇāmeva kārayet| koṇeṣvapi ca bhadrā ṇi pārśvayorubhayostathā ||115 bhāgasya nirgamo'pyeṣāṃ viśeṣo'smādayaṃ mataḥ| bhadra masya daśastambhairmadhyaṃ ṣoḍaśabhirdharaiḥ ||116 caturdvāraṃ bhavedetadicchayā kṣaṇamadhyagam| dvāramanyadvidhātavyaṃ svapade syātsuśobhitam ||117 bhūmibhiḥ sārdhaṣaṣṭhībhirvidheyaḥ kṣoṇibhūṣaṇaḥ| ardhāṣṭamībhiśca bhavetpṛthvītilakasaṃjñakaḥ ||118 syātsārdhapañcamībhistu śrīnivāso'tra bhūmibhiḥ| lakṣmīvilāsasaṃjño'rdhapañcamībhirvidhīyate ||119 pratāpavardhanākhyo'rdhacaturthībhirvidhīyate| rājñāṃ pṛthvījayādīni nivāsabhavanāni ca ||120 kṣoṇīvibhūṣaṇādīni vilāsabhavanāni ca| yānyuktāni nivāsāya vilāsāya ca bhūbhṛtām ||121 teṣāṃ pṛthvījayādīnāṃ dvāramānamathocyate| catuḥpañcāśadaṃśo yo vistṛtaḥ sakaratrayaḥ ||122 sa dvārasyodayaḥ proktastadardhenāsya vistṛtiḥ| svodayasya tribhāgena piṇḍaḥ stambheṣu śasyate ||123 syātsaptaviṃśatitamaḥ sapādaḥ sacatuṣkaraḥ| gṛhabhāgo bhavedbhūmiḥ prathamā rājaveśmanām ||124 bhūcchrāye navadhā bhakte tadaṃśakacatuṣṭayam| nirgamaśchādyakasyāṃśadvayaṃ pādonamucchrayaḥ ||125 tathāntarāvaṇī kāryā chādyakocchrāyanirgatā| hīragrahaṇapiṇḍārdhabāhalyā sā praśasyate ||126 tasyāḥ svameva bāhalyaṃ pādonaṃ vistṛtiḥ smṛtā| antarāvaṇikātulyo madalāyā vinirgamaḥ ||127 svanirgamāttathā cāsyāḥ sapādaḥ syātsamucchrayaḥ| bhūmyucchrayanavāṃśasya pādo'syāḥ piṇḍamiṣyate ||128 bhūnavāṃśastribhāgono madalāyāśca vistṛtiḥ| lumāmūlasya stambhārdhaṃ vistāraḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||129 tattryaṃśādagravistīrṇā mūle sāṣṭāṃśayugbhavet| tumbinī lambinī helā śāntā kolā manoramā ||130 ādhmātā cetyabhū proktā lumāḥ sapta manīṣibhiḥ| ṛjuḥ sā lambinī tāsāmādhmātā karṇagā smṛtā ||131 antarāle krameṇa syuḥ pañcānyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ| stambhe nidadhyānmadalāṃ chādyaṃ dhartuṃ dṛḍhāṃ śubhām ||132 stambhābhāve punarnyasyetkuḍyapaṭṭe'pi tāṃ sudhīḥ| sapta pañcāthavā tisro mallacchādye lumāḥ smṛtāḥ ||133 koṇeṣvetā imābhyo'nyāḥ kartavyāḥ prāñjalāḥ samāḥ| chādye karṇātkvacitkāryā makarānanabhūṣitāḥ ||134 te'pi vidyādharopetāḥ kvacitsagajatuṇḍikāḥ| sakubhbhikasya stambhasya pravibhajyodayaṃ tridhā ||135 tatra bhāgadvayaṃ kuryādbhāgānardhacaturthakān| tatra pādonabhāgena rājitāsanakaṃ bhavet ||136 tataḥ solkalakā vedī sāṅghribhāgā vidhīyate| kūṭāgārasamāṃśārdhaṃ kāryo'trāsanapaṭṭakaḥ ||137 sa syādabhīṣṭovistāro bhāgoccaṃ mattavāraṇam| svodayasya tribhāgena tiryak kāryo'sya nirgamaḥ ||138 rūpakaiḥ karaṇāyābhiḥ suputrairapi śobhitam| vedikādikamapyasya rūpapatrācitaṃ śubham ||139 āyasībhiḥ śalākābhiḥ kīlakaiśca dṛḍhīkṛtam| etāni apñcadaśarājaniveśanāni pṛthvījayaprabhṛti yāni nirūpitāni| yo lakṣaṇena sahitaṃ parimāṇameṣāṃ jānāti tasya nṛpatiḥ paritoṣameti ||140 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre rājagṛhaṃ nāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <31> atha yantravidhānaṃ nāmaikatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| bhrāmyaddineśaśaśimaṇḍalacakraśatsaṃ| metajjagattritayayantramalakṣyamadhyam || bhūtāni bījamakhilānyapi samprakalpya| yaḥ santataṃ bhramayati smarajitsa vo'vyāt ||1 yantrādhyāyamatha brūmo yathāvatprakramāgatam| dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ yadekamiha kāraṇam ||2 yadṛcchayā pravṛttāni bhūtāni svena vartmanā| niyamyāsmin nayati yattadyantramiti kīrtitam ||3 svarasena pravṛttāni bhūtāni svamanīṣayā| kṛtaṃ yasmādyamayati tadvā yantramiti smṛtam ||4 tasya bījaṃ caturdhā syāt kṣitirāpo'nalo'nilaḥ| āśrayatvena caiteṣāṃ vijayadapyupayujyate ||5 bhinnaḥ sūtaścakairuktaste ca samyaṅ na jānate| prakṛtyā pārthivaḥ sūtasnāyāt tatra kriyā bhavet ||6 pārthivatvādayamato na kadācidvibhidyate| dra vyatvādagnijatvaṃ hi yadyasya parikalpyate ||7 tadā virodho naivāsya pāvakenopapadyate| gandhād vahnervirodhācca sthitā pārthivatā balāt ||8 ātmaiva bījaṃ sarveṣāṃ pratyekamaparāṇyapi| evaṃ bhedā bhavantyeṣāṃ bhūyāṃsaḥ saṅkarānmithaḥ ||9 svayaṃvāhakamekaṃ syātsakṛtpreryaṃ tathāparam| anyadantarita vāhyaṃ vāhyamanyat tvadūrataḥ ||10 svayaṃbāhyamihotkṛṣṭaṃ hīnaṃ syāditarattrayam| teṣu śaṃsanti dūrasthamalakṣyaṃ nikaṭasthitam ||11 yadyutpannamalakṣyaṃ yadekaṃ bahuṣu sādhakam| tadanyadapi śaṃsanti yasmādvismayakṛnnṛṇām ||12 ekā svīyā gatiścitre vāhye'nyā vāhakāśritā| araghaṭṭāśrite kīṭe dṛśyate dvayamapyadaḥ ||13 itthaṃ gatidvayavaśādvaicitryaṃ kalpayetsvayam| alakṣatā vicitratvaṃ yasmādyantreṣu śasyate ||14 anyatsyādantarātpreryaṃ dvitīyaṃ madhyamaṃ tvidam| dvayatrayādiyogena caturṇāmapi yogataḥ ||15 aṃśāṃśibhāvādbhūtānāṃ saṅkhyaiṣāmatiricyate| yaḥ samyagetajjānāti sa pumānbhavati priyaḥ ||16 pramadānāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ ca prajñānāṃ ca matasya ca| lābhaṃ khyātiṃ ca pūjāṃ ca yaśo mānaṃ dhanāni ca ||17 prāpnoti kiṃ kiṃ na pumān ya idaṃ vetti tattvataḥ| gṛhamekaṃ vilāsānāmāścaryasya paraṃ padam ||18 raterāvāsabhavanaṃ vismayasyaikamāspadam| yathāvaddevatādīnāṃ rūpaceṣṭādidarśanāt ||19 tāstuṣyantyatha tattuṣṭiḥ pūrvairdharmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ| nṛpāditoṣādarthaḥ syādarthe kāmaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ||20 vittaikyādasya niṣpattirmokṣaścāsmānna durlabhaḥ| pārthivaṃ pārthivairbījaiḥ pārthivaṃ jalajanmabhiḥ ||21 tadeva tejojanitaistadeva marududbhavaiḥ| āpyamāpyaistathā bījairānalairānilairapi ||22 vahnijaiśca marujjātaiḥ pārthivairvāruṇairapi| mārutaṃ mārutairāpyaiḥ pārthivairānalaistathā ||23 vahnijāte'pi bījaṃ syātsūtaḥ so'pi ca vānale| pārthivānāṃ bhavedbījamāpyānāmapi vāraṇe ||24 iti bījāni sarveṣāṃ kīrtitānyakhilānyapi| kuḍyaṃkaraṇasūtrāṇi bhāragolakapīḍanam ||25 lambanaṃ lambakāre ca cakrāṇi vividhānyapi| ayastāmraṃ ca tāraṃ ca trapu saṃvitpramardane ||26 kāṣṭhaṃ ca carma vastraṃ ca svabījeṣu prayujyate| urdakaḥ kartaro yaṣṭiścakraṃ bhramarakastathā ||27 śṛṅgāvalī ca nārācaḥ svabījānyaurvare viduḥ| tāpa uttejanaṃ stobhaḥ kṣobhaśca jalasaṅgajaḥ ||28 evamādyagnibījāni pārthivasya pracakṣate| dhārā ca jalabhāraśca payaso bhramaṇaṃ tathā ||29 evamādīni bhūjasya jalajāni pracakṣate| yathocchrāyo yathādhikyaṃ yathā nīrandhratāpi ca ||30 atyantamūrdhvagāmitvaṃ svabījānyayasastathā| marutsvabhāvajo gāḍhairgrāhakaiśca pratīpsitaḥ ||31 dṛtyādyairvījanādyaiśca gajakarṇādibhiḥ kṛtaḥ| cāṇito gālitaścāyaṃ bījaṃ bhavati bhūbhave ||32 kāṣṭaṃbhṛttiśca lohaṃ ca jalaje pārthivaṃ bhavet| anyadambhastadapyastu tiryagūrdhvamadhastathā ||33 bījaṃ svakīyaṃ bhavati yantreṣu jalajanmasu| tāpādyaṃ pūrvakathitaṃ vahnijaṃ jalaje bhavet ||34 saṅgṛhītaśca dattaśca pūritaḥ pratinoditaḥ| marudbījatvamāyāti yantreṣu jalajanmasu ||35 vahnijāteṣu mṛttāmraloharukmādi tadgrahe| pārthivaṃ kathayantīha bījaṃ bījavicakṣaṇāḥ ||36 vahnervahnirbhavedbījamāpa āpastathā bhavet| ādyairdṛtyādibhiḥ proktairmarud gacchati bījatām ||37 pratyeṣakaṃ ca janakaṃ prerakaṃ grāhakaṃ tathā| saṅgrāhakaṃ ca bhūjātaṃ bījaṃ syādanilodbhavaiḥ ||38 preraṇaṃ cābhighāṭaśca vivarto bhramaṇaṃ tathā| jalajaṃ mārutottheṣu bījaṃ syāditi sammatam ||39 saṅgṛhītasya tāpādyairyāni pāvakajanmani| prakīrtitāni tānyeva bhavanti pavanodbhavaiḥ ||40 preritaḥ saṅgṛhītaśca janitaśca samīraṇaḥ| ātmano bījatāṃ gacchatyevamanyat prakalpayet ||41 bhūtamekamihodri ktamanyaddhīnaṃ tato'dhikam| anyaddhīnataraṃ cānyadevaṃprāyairvikalpitaiḥ ||42 nānā bhedā bhavantyeṣāṃ kastān kārtsnyena vakṣyati| niṣkriyā bhūḥ kriyā tvaṃśe śeṣeṣu sahajā triṣu ||43 ataḥ prāyeṇa sā janyā kṣitāveva jayatnataḥ| sādhyasya rūpavaśataḥ sanniveśo yatkṣe bhavet ||44 yantrāṇāmākṛtistena nirṇetuṃ naiva śakyate| yathāvadbījasaṃyogaḥ sauśliṣṭyaṃ ślakṣṇatāpi ca ||45 alakṣātā nirvahaṇaṃ laghutvaṃ śabdahīnatā| śabde sādhye tadādhikyamaśaithilyamagāḍhatā ||46 vahanīṣu samastāsu sauśliṣṭyaṃ cāskhaladgati| yathābhīṣṭārthakāritvaṃ layatālānugāmitā ||47 iṣṭakāle'rdhadarśitvaṃ punaḥ samyaktvasaṃvṛtiḥ| anulbaṇatvaṃ tādrū pyaṃ dārḍhye masṛṇatā tathā ||48 cirakālasahatvaṃ ca yantrasyaite guṇaḥ smṛtāḥ| ekaṃ bahūni calayedbahubhiścālyate'param ||49 suśliṣṭatvamalakṣatvaṃ yantrāṇāṃ paramo guṇaḥ| atha karmāṇi yantrāṇāṃ vicitrāṇi yathāvidhi ||50 na vistarānna saṅkṣepātsāmprataṃ saṃpracakṣmahe| kasyacitsā kriyā sādhyā kālaḥ kasyāpi kasyacit ||51 śabdaḥ kasyāpi cocchrāyo rūpasparśau ca kasyacit| kriyāstu kāryasya vaśādanantāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||52 tīryaṃgūrdhvamadhaḥ pṛṣṭhe purataḥ pārśvayorapi| gamanaṃ saraṇaṃ pāta iti bhedāḥ kriyodbhavāḥ ||53 kālo muhūrtakāṣṭhādyairbhinno bhedairanekadhā| śabdo vicitraḥ sukhado ratikṛdbhīṣaṇastathā ||54 ucchrāyastu jalasya syātkvacidbhūje'pi śasyate| gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ ca vādyaṃ ca paṭaho vaṃśa eva ca ||55 vīṇā ca kāṃsyatālaśca tṛmilā karaṭāpi ca| yatkiñcidanyadapyatra vāditrādi vibhāvyate ||56 samastamapi tadyantrājjāyate kalplanāvaśāt| nṛtye tu nāṭakaṃ cokṣastāṇḍavaṃ lāsyameva ca ||57 rājamārgaśca deśī ca yantrāt sarvaṃ prasidhyati| tathā jātyanugāśceṣṭā viruddhā yāstu jātitaḥ ||58 tāḥ sarvā api sidhyanti samyagyantrasya sādhanāt| bhūcarāṇāṃ gatirvyomni bhūmau vyomacarāgamaḥ ||59 ceṣṭitānyapi martyānāṃ tathā bhūmispṛśāmiva| jāyante yantranirmāṇādvividhānīpsitāni ca ||60 yathāsurā jitā devairyathā nirmathito'mbudhiḥ| hiraṇyakaśipurdaityo nṛsiṃhena hato yathā ||61 dhāvanaṃ hastiyuddhaṃ ca gajānāmagaḍo'pi ca| nānāprakāra yā ceṣṭā nānādhārāgṛhāṇi ca ||62 dolākelyo vicitrāśca tathā ratigṛhāṇi ca| citrā sena ca kuṭyaśca svayaṃvāhakasevakāḥ ||63 sabhāśca vividhākārāḥ satyā māyāḥ prakalpitāḥ| evaṃprāyāṇi cānyāni yantrātsidhyanti kalpanāt ||64 vidhāya bhūmikāḥ pañca śayyā tvādibhuvi sthitā| pratipraharamanyāsu sarpantī yāti pañcamīm ||65 evaṃprāyāṇi citrāṇi samyak sidhyanti yantrataḥ| krameṇa triśatāvartaṃ sthāle dantā bhramantyasau ||66 tanmadhye putrikā kḷptā prati nāḍiṃ prabodhayet| vahneśca darśanaṃ toye vahnimadhyājjalodgatiḥ ||67 avastuto'pi vastutvaṃ vastuto'pi tathānyathā| niḥśvāsena viyad yāti śvāsenāyāti medinīm ||68 kṣīrodamadhyagā śayyā pratīṣṭādhaḥ phaṇābhṛtā| golaśca sūtivihitaḥ sūryādīnāṃ pradakṣiṇam ||69 paribhrāmyatyahorātraṃ grahāṇāṃ darśayan gatim| gajādirūpe rathikarūpatāṃ gamitaḥ pumān ||70 bhrāntvā nādikayā tasyāḥ paryante hanti bhojanam| dīpikāputrikā kḷptā kṣīṇaṃ kṣīṇaṃ prayacchati ||71 dīpe tailaṃ pranṛtyantī tālagatyā pradakṣiṇam| yāvatpradīyate vāri tāvatpibati santatam ||72 yantreṇa kalpito hastī na tadgacchatpratīyate| śukādyāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ kḷptāstālasyānugamānmuhuḥ ||73 janasya vismayakṛto nṛtyanti ca paṭhanti ca| putrikā vā gajendro vā turago markaṭo'pi vā ||74 valanairvartanairnṛtyaṃstālena harate manaḥ| yenaiva vartmanā kṣetraṃ dhriyate tena tatpayaḥ ||75 yātyāyāti punastadvadgartātpuṣkariṇīṣvapi| phalake kāni tiṣṭhanti dhāvantyanumatāni ca ||76 dhātāṃ dadati yudhyante niryāntyaśramanāvṛtam| nṛtyanti gāyanti tathā vaṃśādīn vādayanti ca ||77 niruddhamuktasya vaśānmaruto yantrabhaṅgibhiḥ| yāśceṣṭā divyamānuṣyastā evātra na kevalam ||78 duṣkaraṃ yadyadanyacca tattadyantrātprasidhyati| yantrāṇāṃ ghaṭanā noktā guptyarthaṃ nājñatāvaśāt ||79 tatra heturayaṃ jñeyo vyaktā naite phalapradāḥ| kathitānyatra bījāni yantrāṇāṃ ghaṭanā na yat ||80 tasmādvyaktīkṛteṣveṣu na syātsvārtho na kautukam| vastutaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ bījānāmiha kīrtanāt ||81 abhyūhyaṃ svadhiyā prājñairyantrāṇāṃ karma yadyathā| yantrāṇi yāni dṛṣṭāni kīrtitānyatra tānyapi ||82 nandyāni yasmāttānyāto vijñeyānyupadeśataḥ| etatsvabuddhyaivāsmābhiḥ samagramapi kalpitam ||83 agrataśca punarbrūmaḥ kathitaṃ yatpurātanaiḥ| bījaṃ caturvidhamiha pravadanti yantre-| ṣvambhognibhūmipavanairnihitairyathāvat || pratyekato bahuvidhaṃ hi vibhāgataḥ syā-| nmiśrairguṇaiḥ punaridaṃ gaṇanāmapāsyet ||84 kimetasmādanyadbhavati bhuvane citramaparaṃ| kimanyadvā tuṣṭhyai bhavati kimu vā kautukakaram || kimanyad vā kīrtterbhavanamaparaṃ kāmasadanaṃ| kimasmātpuṇyaṃ vā kimiva ca parītāpaśamanam ||85 ete'tyarthaṃ prītidā bījayogāḥ saṃjāyante yojitāḥ sūtradhāraiḥ| bhrāntyā nānyaścitrakṛddārukḷptaṃ cakraṃ dolādyaṃ punaḥ pañcamaṃ tat ||86 pāramparyaṃ kauśalaṃ sopadeśaṃ śāstrābhyāso vāstukarmodyamo dhīḥ| sāmagrīyaṃ nirmalā yasya so'smiṃścitrāṇyevaṃ vetti yantrāṇi kartum ||87 citrairyuktaṃ ye guṇaiḥ pañcarūpaṃ jānantyenaṃ yantraśāstrādhikāram| ye vā kṛtsnaṃ yojayante'tra samyakteṣāṃ kīrttirdyāṃ bhuvaṃ cāvṛṇoti ||88 aṅgulena mitamaṅgulapādenocchritaṃ dvipuṭakaṃ tanuvṛttam| saṃvidheyamṛju madhyagarandhraṃ śliṣṭasandhi dṛḍhatāmramayaṃ tat ||89 dāraveṣu vihageṣu tadantaḥ kṣiptamudgatasamīravaśena| ātanoti vicalanmṛduśabdaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ bhavati citrakaraṃ ca ||90 suśliṣṭakhaṇḍadvitayena kṛtvā sarandhramantarmurajānukāram| grastaṃ tathā kuṇḍalayoryugena madhye puṭaṃ tasya mṛdu pradeyam ||91 pūrvoktayantre vidhinodare'sya kṣipte'tha śayyātalasaṃsthametat| dhvaniṃ tataḥ sañcalanādanaṅgakrīḍārasollāsakaraṃ karoti ||92 asmiñ śayyātalavinihite muñcati vyaktarāgaṃ| citrāñśabdān mṛgaśiśudṛśāṃ yānti bhītyeva mānaḥ || kiñcaitāsāṃ dayitamabhito nirbharapremabhājāṃ| prauḍhiṃ gacchantyadhikamadhikaṃ manmathakrīḍitāni ||93 paṭahamuraje veṇuḥ śaṅkho vipañcyatha kāhalā| ḍamaruṭivile vādyātodyānyamūnyakhilānyapi| madhuramadhikaṃ yaccitraṃ ca dhvaniṃ vidadhātyalaṃ| tadiha vidhinā ruddhonmuktānilasya vijṛmbhitam ||94 laghudārumayaṃ mahāvihaṅgaṃ dṛḍhasuśliṣṭatanuṃ vidhāya tasya| udare rasayantramādadhīta jvalanādhāramadho'sya cātipūrṇam ||95 tatrārūḍhaḥ pūruṣastasya pakṣadvandvoccālaprojjhitenānilena| suptasvāntaḥ pāradasyāsya śaktyā citraṃ kurvannambare yāti dūram ||96 itthameva suramandiratulyaṃ sañcalatyalaghu dāruvimānam| ādadhīta vidhinā caturo'ntastasya pāradabhṛtān dṛḍhakumbhān ||97 ayaḥkapālāhitamandavahniprataptatatkumbhabhuvā guṇena| vyomno jhagityābharaṇatvameti santaptagarjadra sarājaśaktyā ||98 vṛttasandhitamathāyasayantraṃ tadvidhāya rasapūritamantaḥ| uccadeśavinidhāpitataptaṃ siṃhanādamurajaṃ vidadhāti ||99 sa ko'pyasya sphāraḥ sphurati narasiṃhasya mahimā| purastādyasyaitā madajalamuco'pi dvipaghaṭāḥ| muhuḥ śrutvā śrutvā ninadamapi gambhīraviṣamaṃ| palāyante bhītāstvaritamavadhūyāṅkuśamapi ||100 dṛggrīvātalahastaprakoṣṭhabāhūruhastaśākhādi| sacchidraṃ vapurakhilaṃ tatsandhiṣu khaṇḍaśo ghaṭayet ||101 śliṣṭaṃ kīlakavidhinā dārumayaṃ sṛṣṭacarmaṇā guptam| puṃso'thavā yuvatyā rūpaṃ kṛtvātiramaṇīyam ||102 randhragataiḥ pratyaṅgaṃ vidhinā nārācasaṅgataiḥ sūtraiḥ| grīvācalanaprasaraṇavikuñcanādīni vidadhāti ||103 karagrahaṇatāmbūlapradānajalasecanapramāṇādi| ādarśapratilokanavīṇāvādyādi ca karoti ||104 evamanyadapi cedṛśametatkarma vismayavidhāyi vidhatte| jṛmbhitena vidhinā nijabuddheḥ kṛṣṭamuktaguṇacakravaśena ||105 puṃso dārujamūrdhvaṃ rūpaṃ kṛtvā niketanadvāri| tatkarayojitadaṇḍaṃ niruṇaddhi praviśatāṃ vartma ||106 khaḍgahastamatha mudgarahastaṃ kuntahastamathavā yadi tatsyāt| tannihanti viśato niśi caurān dvāri saṃvṛtamukhaṃ prasabhena ||107 ye cāpādyā ye śataghnyādayo'sminnuṣṭragrīvādyāśca durgasya guptyai| ye krīḍādyāḥ krīḍanārthaṃ ca rājñāṃ sarve'pi syuryogataste guṇānām ||108 idānīṃ prakramāyātaṃ vāriyantraṃ pracakṣmahe| krīḍārthaṃ kāryasiddhyai ca caturdhā tadgatiṃ viduḥ ||109 nimnagaṃ bhavati dro ṇīdeśādūrdhvasthitājjalam| yatra tatpātayantraḥ syādvāṭikādiprayojanam ||110 ucchrāyasamapātākhyaṃ yatrordhvā nāḍikā payaḥ| jalādhāraguṇānmuñcedadhastātsamanāḍikā ||111 yatra pātasamucchrāyaṃ patitvocchrāyato jalam| tiryaggatvā prayātyūrdhvaṃ sacchidra stambhayogataḥ ||112 patitvocchrāyatastoyaṃ tiryagūrdhvordhvametyatha| sacchidra stambhayogena tatsyātpātasamocchrayam ||113 vāpyāṃ vāpi ca kūpe vidhānato dīrghikādikā vihitā| yatrordhvamambu gamayati tadihocchrayasaṃjñitaṃ kathitam ||114 dārujamibhasya rūpaṃ yatsalilaṃ pātrasaṃsthitaṃ pibati| tanmāhātmyaṃ nigaditametasyocchrāyatulyasya ||115 salilaṃ suraṅgadeśānītaṃ nimnena vartmanā dūre| adbhutamambhasthānaṃ tadiha samocchrāyataḥ kurute ||116 dhārāgṛhamekaṃ syātpravarṣaṇākhyaṃ tato dvitīyaṃ ca| prāṇālaṃ jalamagnaṃ nandyāvartaṃ tathānyadapi ||117 prākṛtajanārthametanna vidheyaṃ yogyametadavanibhujām| maṅgalyānāṃ sadanaṃ divyamidaṃ tuṣṭipuṣṭikaram ||118 salilāśayasya savidhe kasyāpyāśritya śobhanaṃ deśam| yantrotsedhāddviguṇā triguṇā vā nāḍikā kāryā ||119 jalanirvāhasahāsāvantarmasṛṇā bahiśca nīrandhrā| nirvyūḍhāmbhasi tasyāṃ śubhe muhūrte gṛhaṃ kāryam ||120 sarvābhiroṣadhībhiryuktaṃ sahiraṇyapūrṇakumbhaiśca| suvicitragandhamālyaṃ vināditaṃ bhramaghoṣeṇa ||121 ratnodbhavairvicitraiḥ stambhairyuktaṃ hiraṇyaghaṭitairvā| rajatodbhavaiḥ kadācitsuradārusamudbhavairathavā ||122 śrīkhaṇḍotthairathavā sālakamukhyapraśastavṛkṣotthaiḥ| śatasaṅkhyairdvātriṃśatsaṅkhyairyadi vāpi ṣoḍaśabhiḥ ||123 athavā catussamanvitaviṃśatisaṅkhyairdineśasaṅkhyairvā| bhūṣitamatiramaṇīyaiścaturbhirapi vā vidhātavyam ||124 prāggrīvairaticitraiḥ śālairjālairvibhūṣitaṃ vividhaiḥ| vedībhiḥ parikaritaṃ kapotapālībhirabhirāmam ||125 ramaṇīyasālabhañjikamanekavidhayantraśakunikṛtaśobham| mithunaiśca vānarāṇāṃ jambhakanivahaiśca naikavidhaiḥ ||126 ||128 pravahatsakalasrotaḥsuśliṣṭaniviṣṭanāḍikaṃ madhye| sacchidra nāḍikayutaṃ nānāvidharūparamaṇīyam ||129 suśliṣṭanāḍikāgre stambhatulābhittisaṃśrite paritaḥ| samyakkṛtvā dṛḍhataravilepanaṃ vajralepādyaiḥ ||130 lākṣāsarjarasadṛṣanmeṣaviṣāṇotthacūrṇasaṃmiśram| atasīkarañjatailapravigāḍho vajralepaḥ syāt ||131 dṛḍhasandhibandhahetoḥ sa tatra deyo dviśaḥ kadācidvā| śaṇavalkaśleṣmātakasikthakatailaiḥ pralepaśca ||132 ucchrayayantreṇaitad bhrāntajalenātha tadabhitaḥ kṛtvā| citrānupātayuktaṃ pradarśayennṛpataye sthapatiḥ ||133 kāryāṇyasmin kariṇāṃ mithunānyabhito'mbukeliyuktāni| anyonyapuṣkaroñjhitasīkarabhayapihitanayanāni ||134 varṣānukṛtaṃ cāsmin prītimati pratimaṅgajo vīkṣya| dṛkkaṭamehanahastairmadamiva muñcañjalaṃ kāryaḥ ||135 stanayoryugena sṛjatī jaladhāre tatra kāpi kāryā strī| ānandāśrulavāniva salilakaṇān pakṣmabhiḥ kācit ||136 nābhihradanadikāmiva vinirgatāṃ kāpi bibhratī dhārām| kāpyaṅgulīnakhāṃśubhiriva yoṣitsiñcatī kāryā ||137 evamprāyāṃścitrān svabhāvaceṣṭān bahūṃśca ramaṇīyān| kṣobhān vidhāya kuryādāścaryaṃ narapateḥ sthapatiḥ ||138 madhye tasya vidheyaṃ siṃhāsanamamalahemamaṇighaṭitam| tatrāsīdennarapatiravanipatiḥ śrīpatirdevaḥ ||139 snāyātkadācidasmin maṅgalagītairvivardhitānandaḥ| vāditranāṭyanipuṇairniṣevyamāṇaḥ surendra iva ||140 ya etasmin gāḍhaglapitaghanagharmavyatikare| śucau dhārādhāmni sphuṭasaliladhāre narapatiḥ || sukhenāste paśyan vividhajalaśilpāni sa bhave-| nna martyaḥ kantveṣa kṣitikṛtanivāsaḥ surapatiḥ ||141 jaladakulāṣṭakayuktaṃ pūrvavadanyadgṛhaṃ samāracayet| varṣaddhārānikaraiḥ pravarṣaṇākhyāṃ tadāpnoti ||142 pratikulamasmin kāryā divyālaṅkāradhāriṇaḥ puruṣāḥ| vidhinā trayaḥ surūpāścatvāraḥ sapta vā sudṛḍhāḥ ||143 yantreṇa samocchrāyeṇa tāṃścaturthena vā tataḥ puruṣān| kṛtvā savakranālānambhobhiḥ pūrayed vimalaiḥ ||144 salilapraveśarandhrāṇyakhilāni pidhāya tatra puruṣāṇām| aṅgāni vārimokṣāṇyakhilānyatha mocayet teṣām ||145 salilaṃ savakranālaṃ dvārapratirodhamocanaiḥ puruṣāḥ| muñcanti svecchamamī vicitrapātena citrakaram ||146 itthamimān vāridharān sāmasyād dvyantareṇa vā salilam| tryantarato vā svecchaṃ pravarṣayedatimahaccitram ||147 idaṃ nānākāraṃ kulabhavanamādyaṃ ratipate-| rnivāsaścitrāṇāmanukaraṇamekaṃ jalamucām || payaḥpātairgrīṣme ravikaraparītāpaśamanaṃ| na keṣāmatyarthaṃ bhavati nayanānandajananam ||148 ekenātha caturbhiḥ stambhairaṣṭabhirathārkasaṅkhyairvā| ṣoḍaśabhirvā kuryānmanoharaṃ gṛhamiha dvitalam ||149 bhadrai ryutaṃ caturbhiścaturaśraṃ sarvabhittisaṃyuktam| īlītoraṇayuktaṃ kartavyaṃ puṣpakākāram ||150 tasyopari madhyagatā prāṅgaṇavāpī dṛḍhā vidhātavyā| śatapatravihitabhūṣā tanmadhye karṇikā kāryā ||151 tatkoṇeṣu caturṣvapi ramaṇīyā dārudārikāḥ kāryāḥ| madhyāmbujanihitadṛśaḥ sālaṅkārāḥ saśṛṅgārāḥ ||152 pūrvoktayantrayogātpadmāsīne vasundharādhipatau| bhṛṅgārāmalavāribhiraṅgaṇavāpīṃ bhriyācca tataḥ ||153 tāmiti bhṛtvā vāpīṃ tatsalilaṃ tadanupaṭṭagarbhagatam| chādyastu gandharodhreṣvati rohati sarvato niyatam ||154 mukhapaṭṭasamutkīrṇai rūpaiścitrairmanoramairakhilaiḥ| aṅgairvāri vimuñcati nāsāsyaśravaṇanetrādyaiḥ ||155 praṇālākhyaṃ dhārābhavanamidamatyadbhutataraṃ | sthitiṃ dhatte yasya kṣitipatilakasyāṅgaṇabhuvi | karotyetadvetthaṃ sthapatirapi buddhyā caturayā| jagatyetau dvāvapyadhikamahanīyau kṛtadhiyām ||156 caturaśrātigabhīrā vāpī kāryā manoramā sudṛḍhā| garbhagataṃ gṛhamasyāḥ kartavyaṃ liptasandhi tataḥ ||157 vihitapraveśanirgati suraṅgayādho niveśitadvāram| vidadhīta cārurūpaiḥ pravarṣakairvyāptamupariṣṭāt ||158 citrādhyāyoditavartmanā tato'laṅkṛtaṃ ca citreṇa| tasya vidheyaṃ madhyaṃ salilādhipavāsasaṅkāśam ||159 ūrdhvavinirgamitābjairnālaistatpaṭṭakandakodbhūtaiḥ| sacchidra karṇikāgatadinakarakaranirmitoddyotam ||160 āpūrayettato'nu ca pātāmbubhiramalakamalaparyantam| vidhināmunaiva samyak pravidhāya manoramaṃ bhavanam ||161 nānārūpakayuktyāuparacitatamaṅgatoraṇadvāram| śālābhirāyatābhiścatasṛṣvapi dikṣu kṛtaśobham ||162 kṛtrimaśapharīmakarīpakṣibhirapi cāmbusambhavairyuktām| kuryādambhojavatīṃ vāpīmāhāryayogena ||163 sāmantamukhyapuruṣā rājājñālabdhasaṃśrayāstatra| pararāṣṭrāgatadūtāstiṣṭeyurnihitamiha nibhṛtāḥ ||164 atha sa yathāvidhi salilakrīḍāṃ pūrvoktamārgarūpāṇām| dṛṣṭvā muditaḥ kuryātparyaṅkārohaṇaṃ nṛpatiḥ ||165 tatra sthitasya nṛpateḥ parivāritasya| vārāṅganābhirabhito jalamagnadhāmni || pātālasadmani yathā bhujageśvarasya| nissīmasambhṛtaratirbhavati pramodaḥ ||166 pūrvoktavāpikāyāṃ madhye stambhaiścaturbhirūparacitam| muktāpravālayuktaṃ puṣpakamatha kārayellaṭabham ||167 vāpīṃ paritaḥ puṣpakamāpūrya sunirgamābhiratha sudṛḍham| garbhasvastikabhittibhirūpahitaśobhaṃ samantataḥ kuryāt ||168 pūrvoktavāriyogātpūrṇāmākarṇato vidhāyaitām| jalakaliṣu sotkaṇṭho mahīpatiḥ puṣpakaṃ yāyāt ||169 kurvīta narmasacivairvilāsinībhiśca sārdhamavanipatiḥ| tadbhittyantaravartī nimajjanonmajjanaiḥ krīḍām ||170 ekatra magnairapatra dṛṣṭairanyatra hatvā salilena naṣṭaiḥ| krīḍatyalaṃ kelikaraiḥ sahāyainṛpaḥ sukhaṃ majjanapuṣkariṇyām ||171 vāpītalasthitamatha trapayāvanamra-| mācchāditastanabharaṃ karapallavena || gāḍhāvasaktavasanaṃ jalarodhamuktā-| vālokate praṇayinījanamatra dhanyaḥ ||172 rathadolādividhānaṃ dāravamabhidadhmahe vayaṃ samyak| yantrabhramaṇakakarma prakīrtitaṃ pañcamaṃ yattat ||173 tatra vasantaḥ prathamo madananivāso vasantatilakaśca| vibhramakastripurākhyaḥ pañcaite dolakāḥ kathitāḥ ||174 nikhaneccaturaḥ stambhān samaikasūtropagān ṛjūn sudṛḍhān| sadṛśāntarān dharitrīvaśataḥ suślikṣṇapīṭhagatān ||175 prāsādasyoktadiśi pravidadhyādviracitāṣṭakaradairghyam| bhūmigṛhaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ tadardhato vihitagāmbhīryam ||176 tadgarbhatale stambho lohamayādhārasaṃsthitaḥ kāryaḥ| bhramasahitaḥ pīṭhayuto grastaścacchādakatulābhiḥ ||177 saṃsthāpyopari pīṭhasya kumbhikāmatidṛḍhāṃ vibhaktāṃ ca| dhanurucchritaistato'mūmaṣṭabhirāvṛṣṭayed bhadraiḥ ||178 svecchamatha bhūmikocchrayamasyordhve kalplayennitāntamṛjum| nidadhīta veṣṭanordhve paṭṭayutaṃ stambhaśīrṣaṃ ca ||179 hīragrahaparyantaṃ madalā gajaśīrṣikā vidhātavyā| sudṛḍhā prayatnaracitā manobhirāmā yathāśobham ||180 paṭṭasyopari kāyā catuṣkikā kṣetramānato'bhīṣṭāt| tasyāmupari vidheyastalabandho dṛḍhataranyāsaḥ ||181 stambhairdvāḍaśabhiratha kṣetre yuktyā samucchritairbhavyaiḥ| rūpavatīkoṇasthitiradhikā bhūḥ prathamikā kāryā ||182 madhye bhramaśca tasyā garbhastambhapratiṣṭhitaḥ kāryaḥ| kṣetrapramāṇavaśatastāṃ paścācchādayetpaṭṭaiḥ ||183 rathikāśikhāgrakeṣu ca phalakāmaraṇasya tadvadupariṣṭāt| bhramacakrāṇi nyasyenmadhye stambhe ca pañcaiva ||184 ata upari yathāśobhaṃ hi bhūmikā puṣpakākṛtiḥ kāryā| madhyastambhādhārā kṛtakalaśavibhūṣaṇā śirasi ||185 stambhe'vastād bhrami te bhṛśaṃ bhramatyarthabhūmikā tatra| rathikābhramarakayuktā parasparaṃ cakrayantreṇa ||186 vasantarathikābhrame samadhirūḍhavārāṅganā-| paribhramaṇasambhṛtābhyadhikavibhramaṃ bhūpatiḥ| karoti nayanotsavastridaśadhāmni yatkīrtanaṃ| vasantasamaye bhavatyamalakīrttidhāmaiva saḥ ||187 āropya sthiramekaṃ stambhaṃ bhūmīgṛhādirahitamatha| hastacatuṣkocchrāyā kāryopari bhūmikā cāsya ||188 madhye bhramarakayuktaṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavadihācaredakhilam| puṣpakamapi ca stambhe śithilaṃ kalaśocchritaṃ kuryāt ||189 tasyopari ca grīvā caturāsanasaṃyutā vidhātavyā| ghaṇṭāstambhau kāryau stambhena mahābalau tatra ||190 evaṃ puṣpakabhūmikāntaralasthāyī nigūḍho jano| yāvad bhrāmakayantracakranikaraṃ samyak kramācālayet| tāvattā rathikāsanā mṛgadṛśastatra sthitāḥ puṣpake| kāmāvāsakutūhalārpitadṛśo bhrāmyanti sarvā api ||191 atha koṇagatān stambhāṃścaturo viniveśayad krajūn sudṛḍhān| suśliṣṭapīṭhasaṃsthān samāntarān medinīvaśataḥ ||192 teṣāmupari latāntarasaṃyuktā bhūmikā vidhātavyā| rathikāstatra catasro jāyante pūrvavaddiksthāḥ ||193 tadupari tathārdhabhūmiḥ kāryā suśliṣṭadārusandhānā| madhyabhramarakayuktā sarūpakā mattavāraṇayutā ca ||194 nānāvidhakarmavatī vasantato bāhyarekhā syāt| anyonyayantraparighaṭṭanadolyamāna-| niśśeṣacakrarathikābhramaṇābhirāmam| dṛṣṭvā vasantatilakaṃ suramandirāṇāṃ| bhūṣāyamāṇamupayāti na vismayatvaṃ ||195 pravidhāya raṅgabhūmiṃ prathamāṃ śāstrāntarādharasyārthe| caturaśrā rūpavatī sacaturbhadrā vidheyā bhūḥ ||196 pratikoṇamāgatasyā bhadre ṣu bhavanti saṃyatā bhramarāḥ| ata upariṣṭādbhūmyā bhramarāścāṣṭāsanāḥ kāryāḥ ||197 rekhāḥ śuddhāḥ kāryā bahirantaścitritāścānyāḥ| pīṭheṣu madhyagasthāstato'parā bhūmikāḥ kāryāḥ ||198 pīṭhasya madhyasaṃsthairanyonyārāliyojitaiścakraiḥ| sarve vegād bhrāmyanti sāntanā vibhrame bhramarāḥ ||199 dolāsano vihitavāravadhūkṛtāti-| citreṇa yastridaśadhāmasu vibhrameṇa || pṛthvīpatimudamupaiti samullasantī| kīrttirna māti bhuvanatritaye'pi tasya ||200 caturaśramatha kṣetraṃ kṛtvāṃśairbhājitaṃ tato'ṣṭābhiḥ| kāṇaiḥ śeṣaistasmiṃścaturaśraṃ kalpayedbhadra m ||201 taddviguṇamūrdhvametasya bhūmikābhāgasaṅkhyayā kāryam| tatrādyaṃśacatuṣkeṇa bhūmikā syātsamucchrayataḥ ||202 tatrāṣṭaṣaṭcaturbhāgavarjitā bhūmikā uparyupari| kramaśo bhavantyathaivaṃ tāḥ syustisro'rdhasaṃyuktāḥ ||203 śeṣāṃśocchrayayuktā ghaṇṭā caturaśrakāyatā kāryā| tricaturbhūmyau kārye saṣaṭcaturbhāgavistāre ||204 raṅgaḥ syādādyabhuvi dvitīyabhuvi koṇagāstathā rathikāḥ| syurbhadrā kṛtiyuktā dolā api tatra ramaṇīyāḥ ||205 rathikāstṛtīyabhūmau kāryā bhadre ṣu cātiramaṇīyāḥ| koṇeṣvathāsanānyardhavāstuke'pi bhramaḥ kāryaḥ ||206 dolārathike caturāsane bhramo'ṣṭāsano bhavet tatra| āsanamiha tatkathitaṃ yuvateḥ sthānaṃ yadekaṃ syāt ||207 nikhilānyapi bhramaṇasaṃmukhaṃ tāni bibhrati bhramaṇam| yatrāsanāni sa iha bhrama ityukto'parādhikā ||208 yaṣṭerūrdhvamadhastād bhramasya cakraṃ yojayedekam| laghucakrāṇi ca tadvanniyojayedāsaneṣvatra ||209 laghucakrārakavṛtte saṃlagnāḥ kīlakā dṛḍhāḥ kāryāḥ| tulyāntarāḥ samastāḥ pralaghucakrāravṛntagatāḥ ||210 rathikāśikhāgracakraṃ bhramacakrārakaniyojitaṃ kāryam| yaṣṭicatuṣṭayamasiṃstiryak cakradvayopetam ||211 ūrdhvaṃ dvitīyabhūmestṛtīyabhūmerathāntare kuryāt| niyataṃ rathikāyaṣṭibhramasaṃlagnāni yantrāṇi ||212 āsanādhārayaṣṭīnāṃ rathikācakrayojitān| adhaḥ samāntarānkuryāccaturaḥ parivartakān ||213 tad dvitīyabhūmīdolāgarbhe samāntare yaṣṭī| lagne tathaikacakre yāmyottaracakrayornyasyet ||214 tadvadadho bhūkoṇagarathikācūḍāgracakrasaṃsaktāḥ| yaṣṭīstataścatasro dvicakrakā itaracakrayornyasyet ||215 prāntacakradvaye koṇarathikācakrayojitā| dolāgarbhagatā yaṣṭistiryak kāryāparāparā ||216 pūrve bhadre dvāraṃ kuryātsopānarājitamadhastāt| garbhātpaścimabhāge niveśayeddevatādolām ||217 anyonyaṃ cakrabhramamicchāmuktiṃ vidhānataḥ samyak| jñātvā prayojanīyaṃ śīghravahaṃ mandavahanaṃ vā ||218 eṣa samāsena yathā bhramamāgaḥ kīrtitaḥ sphuṭo'smābhiḥ| anyeṣvapi kartavyaḥ samyag bhramahetave tadvat ||219 stambhādidra vyāṇāṃ vinyāsaiḥ kalpitaṃ dṛḍhaiḥ ślakṣṇaiḥ| suśliṣṭasandhibandhaṃ dhṛtaṃ tathā dīrghamukhyadharaiḥ ||220 parivāritamatha tilakaiḥ samantataḥ siṃhakarṇasamyuktam| tripuraṃ samyak kuryād vicitrarūpaṃ kaiścitraiḥ ||221 buddhyā kḷptaiḥ pūrvayantraiśca yuktaṃ yantrādhyāyaṃ vetti yaḥ samyagetam| prāpnotyarthān vāñchitān kīrttiyuktān sa kṣmāpālairanvahaṃ pūjyate ca ||222 etaddvāḍaśarājacakramakhilaṃ kṣmāpālacūḍāmaṇe-| rdoḥstambhapratibaddhavṛtti parito yasyecchayā bhrāmyati || sa śrīmān bhuvanaikarāmanṛpatirdevo vyadhatta drutaṃ| yantrādhyāyamimaṃ svabuddhiracitairyantraprapañcaiḥ saha ||223 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāsuśāstre yantradhighānaṃ nāmaikatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <32> atha gajaśālā nāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| lakṣaṇaṃ gajaśālānāmidānīmabhidadhmahe| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre bhāgairbhakte tato'ṣṭabhiḥ ||1 madhye dvibhāgavistāraṃ sthānaṃ kurvīta hastinaḥ| kalpyāḥ prāsādavadbhāgā jyeṣṭhamadhyādhamāḥ kramāt ||2 tadbahirbhāgiko'lindo bahistasyāpi cāparaḥ| bhāgenaikena bhittiḥ syād dvitīyālindakādbahiḥ ||3 tasyā dvārapradeśe tu kartavyau kūrparāvubhau| karṇaprāsādikā kāryā dvitīyālindasaṃśritā ||4 dve dve vātāyane kuryādbhittau dikṣu tisṛṣvapi| prāggrīvo'gre bhavecchālā subhadre yamudāhṛtā ||5 asyā eva yadā pakṣaprāggrīvau bhavato mukhe| nandinī nāmataḥ śālā tadā syādjagavṛddhaye ||6 asyā eva yadā syātāṃ prāggrīvau pārśvayordvayoḥ| tadā subhogadā nāma tṛtīyā parikīrtitā ||7 asyā eva yadā pṛṣṭhe prāggrīvaḥ kriyate'paraḥ| bhadri kā nāma śālā syāttadā dviradapuṣṭidā ||8 pañcamī caturaśrā syādvarṣaṇī nāma pūjitā| prāggrīvālindaniryūhahīnā ṣaṣṭhī tathāparā ||9 śālā pramārikā dhānyadhanajīvitahāriṇī| tadetāṃ varjayetkuryādanyāḥ sarvārthasiddhaye ||10 pramāriketi prathiteha śālā sā prāṇasasyadra viṇacchide syāt| kuryādatastāṃ na yathoditāstu kāryāḥ parā jīvitavittavṛddhyai ||11 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre gajaśālā nāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <33> athāśvaśālā nāma trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| atha lakṣmāśvaśālāyāḥ procyate vistarādiha| svaveśmavāstoḥ kartavyaṃ pade gandharvasaṃjñake ||1 athavā puṣpadantākhye sthānaṃ vāsāya vājinām| aratniśatamātraṃ yajjyeṣṭhaṃ tat parikīrtitam ||2 aśītyaratnikaṃ madhyaṃ ṣaṣṭhyaratnyadhamaṃ bhavet| sthalapradeśe vipule gupte ramye śucau tathā ||3 same ca caturaśre ca sthite maṅgalyameva ca| sthānaṃ hayānāṃ kartavyaṃ pradeśe suparikrame ||4 nimnagulmadrumasthāṇucaityāyatanaveśmabhiḥ| valmīkaśarkarābhiśca varjite tat samācaret ||5 niḥsaṅge śalyahīne ca prāgudakpravaṇe tathā| pradeśe tadvidhātavyamālokya susamāhitaiḥ ||6 brāhmaṇānumate śaste dine sthapatibhiḥ saha| bhūmervibhāgamālokya subhagānānayeddrumān ||7 na jātā ye śmaśāneṣu devatāyaneṣu vā| anyeṣvapi niṣiddheṣu jātān vṛkṣān vivarjayet ||8 vṛkṣān praśastānānīya samīpe bhartṛveśmanaḥ| tato bhūmiṃ parīkṣeta praśastāmatha nanditām ||9 citāyatanavalmīkagrāmadhānyakhaleṣu ca| vihāreṣu ca kartavyamaśvānāṃ na niveśanam ||10 bhavanti svāminaḥ pīḍā grāmadhānyakhaleṣu ca| śmaśāne veśmakaraṇānnarāṇāṃ mṛtyumādiśet ||11 sthānaṃ vihāravalmīkavihitaṃ syādanarthakam| tannityasantāpakaraṃ kṣayakṛcca tapasvinām ||12 daivopaghātajananaṃ strīṇāṃ ca kṣayakārakam| vihitaṃ pādapaiścaityairgṛhaṃ syādbhūtabhītidam ||13 bhavedro gakaraṃ bharturvihitaṃ kaṇṭakidrumaiḥ| dīrṇāyāmunnatāyāṃ ca kṛtaṃ bhūmau kṣayāvaham ||14 natāyāṃ kṣudbhayakaraṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati mandiram| tasmātkāryaṃ praśastāyāṃ bhūmau tadvājivṛddhaye ||15 maṅgalyaramaṇīye caturaśre manonuge| śubhe ca vihitaṃ sadma bhavetkalyāṇakārakam ||16 nirgacchato yathā vāme pārśve bhartṛsturaṅgamāḥ| bhavanti kuryātsthapatistathā vājiniveśanam ||17 antaḥpurapradeśasya kāryaṃ dakṣiṇataśca tat| praveśe dakṣiṇaṃ teṣāṃ heṣitaṃ jāyate yathā ||18 tathā bharturhitārthāya kartavyaṃ sadma vājinām| prāgudagvā mukhaṃ tasya vidhātavyaṃ satoraṇam ||19 prāggrīvakeṇa saṃyuktaṃ catuḥśālamasaṅkaṭam| daśāratnisamuchrāyamaṣṭāratnipravistṛtam ||20 nāgadantakasaṃśobhi puraḥ kuḍyārdhasaṃyutam| pṛṣṭhe samagrakuḍyaṃ vā tatra sthānāni kalpayet ||21 tāni tu prāṅmukhāni syustathaivodaṅmukhāni ca| āyāme kiṣkumātrāṇi trikiṣkūṇi ca vistarāt ||22 prāṃśūnnatordhvabhāgāni caturaśrāṇi kārayet| agroccāṃ sukhasañcārāṃ teṣu bhūmiṃ prakalpayet ||23 sthānaṃ sūtrasya madhye tu hastamātraṃ samantataḥ| āstīrṇaṃ ca samaślakṣṇanīrandhraiḥ phalakairdṛḍhaiḥ ||24 dhātakyarjunapunnāgakakubhādivinirmitaiḥ| aṣṭāṅgulasamucchrāyairadhyardhāratnivistṛtaiḥ ||25 acchidraiḥ saṃhatairbaddhairayasā pārśvayordvayoḥ| ajantusaṅkulaiḥ kāṣṭai rucakābhirbhiṣaṅmataiḥ ||26 yavasasya bhavetsthānaṃ niryūhaiḥ svāstṛtaṃ śubhaiḥ| kiṣkutrayocchritaṃ tatsyādekānte susamāhitam ||27 hastadvayapramāṇaṃ ca kuryāt khādanakoṣṭhakam| sūpaliptamadurgandhi vistārocchrāyayoḥ samam ||28 sthāne sthāne trayaḥ kīlāḥ sudṛḍhāḥ kapiśīrṣakāḥ| pañcāṅgīnigrahārthaṃ tau purataḥ kalpayedubhau ||29 paścādbandhārthamekaṃ ca suguptaṃ parikalpayet| caturhastāyataṃ tyaktvā śālākoṇacatuṣṭayam ||30 sthāneṣveteṣu guragān sarveṣvapi niveśayet| tatra kuryādbaliṃ homaṃ svastivācanakaṃ japam ||31 grīṣme kāryaṃ susaṃmṛṣṭaṃ siktaṃ tatra mahītalam| varṣāsvanambupaṅkaṃ ca śiśire saṃvṛtaṃ śubham ||32 tiṣṭheyustatra turagā nātisaṅkīrṇaśaṅkinaḥ| aspṛśanto mithaḥ kāryāḥ sarvābādhavivarjitāḥ ||33 sthānaṃ dakṣiṇapūrvasyāṃ diśi vahneḥ prakalpayet| nidadhyādudakumbhaṃ ca kiñcidaindrī samāśritam ||34 brāhmyāṃ diśi prakartavyaṃ sthānakaṃ yavasasya ca| vāyavyāṃ tu prakartavyaṃ sthānamaudūkhalaṃ diśi ||35 niḥśreṇayaḥ kuśāḥ kūpāḥ kāryāśca phalakāvṛtāḥ| kuddāloddālaguḍakāḥ śuktayogāḥ khurastathā ||36 kacagrahaṇyaḥ śṛṅgaṃ ca tathā paraśavo'pi ca| nādyāḥ pradīpāśca bhavantyaśvāgāropayoginaḥ ||37 saṅgrahaḥ sukhasañcāravastūnāṃ nairṛte bhavet| agnyupadra varakṣārthaṃ bandhacchedopayoginaḥ ||38 padārthān sannidhau kuryājjaladīpādikān budhaḥ| bhāṇḍāni kuryācca pṛthag jandrā panayanecchayā ||39 hastavāsīṃ śilāṃ dīpaṃ darvaoṃ phālamupānahau| piṭakāni vicitrāṇi vastīn nānāvidhānapi ||40 evaṃvidhāni cānyāni saṃnidadhyātprayatnataḥ| puraḥstambhāśritaṃ bhāṇḍaṃ sannāhādervidhīyate ||41 prāṅmukhe turagaṃ gehe vāruṇyāṃ sthāpayeddiśi| pūrvāmukhe pade vāpi mitrasya varuṇasya ca ||42 bhavanti tena bahavaḥ puṣṭiṃ ca prāpnuvanti te| sā hi dikpūjanīyā ca stotavyā ca prakīrtitā ||43 homaśāntikadāneṣu dharmyā yāśca parāḥ kriyāḥ| tāsu praśasyate pūrvā śakeṇādhiṣṭhitā svayam ||44 tasyāmudeti dinakṛdanulomaṃ tataḥ punaḥ| aśvānāṃ pṛṣṭhato yāti sa pratīcīmanukramāt ||45 snānādhivāsane pūjā māṅgalyāni parāṇi ca| prāṅmukhānāṃ turaṅgāṇāṃ kartavyāni śubhārthibhiḥ ||46 evaṃ kṛte bhūmibalamitrāṇāṃ yaśaso'pi ca| vṛddhirbhavati bhūpasya tasmātprācī praśasyate ||47 bhartṛvṛddhipradaṃ sthānamagragrāsasya tadbhavet| dakṣiṇābhimukhāyāṃ tu śālāyāṃ vāñchitāthadam ||48 sthānaṃ bhavati vāhānāṃ pade kḷptaṃ vibhāvasoḥ| vahninādhyāsitā sā digātmā vahniśca vājinām ||49 ajaro bahubhoktā ca tatra baddho bhaveddhayaḥ| udaṅmukhe'pi bhavane prāpnuvanti śubhaṃ hayāḥ ||50 tathāsthitānāmaśvānāṃ dakṣiṇena divākaraḥ| udetyanantaraṃ yāti tān vidhāya pradakṣiṇam ||51 prayāti vāmato'śvaṃ ca sthāpyāstenottarāmukhāḥ| candrā rkau pratiharṣante tathā badhnīta vājinaḥ ||52 nṛpatiśca jayaṃ siddhiṃ putrānāyuśca vindati| arogāśca bhavantyaśvā vardhayanti ca santatim ||53 dakṣiṇābhimukhānkuryānna sannāhyānna cāgragān| pitṛkāryādyato'nyatra dakṣiṇā varjitaiva dik ||54 asyāmeva diśi pretā yataḥ sarve pratiṣṭhitāḥ| udeti vāmato yāti cāstaṃ dakṣiṇato raviḥ ||55 somaśca pṛṣṭhe bhavati tenāśvā daivapīḍitāḥ| grahairvikārairvividhaiḥ pīḍyante'rātivihvalāḥ ||56 bhayena vyādhibhiścārtā grāsaṃ necchanti khāditum| parājayamatuṣṭiṃ ca svāmino'narthasaṅgatim ||57 kurvantyato na badhnīyātkathañcid dakṣiṇāmukhān| paścimābhimukhānāṃ ca baddhānāṃ vājināṃ sadā ||58 udeti pṛṣṭhato bhānuḥ purato'staṃ prayāti ca| na bhavedvijayastena bhartustatpṛṣṭhavartinaḥ ||59 śakrasya pṛṣṭhavartitvātprātilomyācca bhāsvataḥ| kupyanti vyādhayasteṣāṃ tūrṇaṃ dehavināśanāḥ ||60 taiste dhyāyanti vepante jale trāsaṃ prayānti ca| yavasaṃ nābhinandanti kṣamāṃ muñcanti sarvathā ||61 diśo'bhimukhamāgreyyā badhyante yadi vājinaḥ| vyathante raktapittotthaistadā rogairanekadhā ||62 jāyante svāmino bandhavadhahṛcchoṣādāyinaḥ| vājināṃ ca bhavettatra vahnidāhakṛtaṃ bhayam ||63 bhartuḥ parājayo vighnaḥ syācca dehasya saṃśayaḥ| nairṛtyāḥ kakubho vāhā badhyante saṃmukhaṃ yadi ||64 tadā na te'bhinandanti khādanaṃ pānabhojane| yathā yathā kṣitiṃ pādairdārayanti punaḥ punaḥ ||65 heṣante vīkṣya bahuśo manuṣyān pakṣiṇaḥ paśūn| bhramayanti ca gātrāṇi nairṛtīṃ cābhitaḥ sthitāḥ ||66 tathā tathaiṣāṃ kupitā nāśaṃ kurvanti rākṣasāḥ| badhyante yadi vājñānādvāyavyābhimukhaṃ hayāḥ ||67 tadā te vātikai rogaiḥ pīḍyante prativāsaram| calaḥ kāyo bhavedbhartuḥ kleśaścāśvopajīvinām ||68 narāṇāṃ ca bhavenmṛtyurdurbhikṣaprabhavaṃ bhayam| aiśānyabhimukhaṃ baddhāḥ praṇaśyanti turaṅgamāḥ ||69 sūryodayasyābhimukhaṃ baddhānāṃ cedamādiśet| nibadhyante yadā vāhā brāhmīṃ diśamupāśritāḥ ||70 badhyante te grahairdivyairvyādhibhiśca vicintanāḥ| kavyahavyakriyāstatra bharturna vijayāvahāḥ ||71 dvijānāmupatāpāya jāyante tatra vājinaḥ| anuvaṃśaṃ ca śālāyāṃ sthānamaśvasya neṣyate ||72 svāminastadajīrṇāya syānnāśāya ca vājinām| sthāne praśaste turagān sarvathā vāsayedataḥ ||73 na ca dhāryāḥ kṣaṇamapi rogiṇaḥ kalyasannidhau| kalyānāmapi rogāḥ syuryato rogisamāśrayāt ||74 hayāgārasya pūrveṇa kāryaṃ bheṣajamandiram| tasyaiva vāmataḥ sarvasaṃbhārān parikalpayet ||75 vājināṃ bheṣajārthāya bhāṇḍāni ca vinikṣipet| agadānoṣadhīḥ snehān vartīśca lavaṇāni ca ||76 bheṣajāgārasavidhe kuryāccāriṣṭamandiram| bhavanaṃ vyādhitānāṃ ca kāryaṃ vāsāya vājinām ||77 suguptaṃ tacca kartavyaṃ pūrvanirdiṣṭaveśmavat| saṃbaddhaṃ ca vidhātavyametadveśmacatuṣṭayam ||78 sudhābandhadṛḍhaiḥ kuḍyaiḥ saprāggrīvoccatoraṇam| catvāryapi viśālāni sugamāni ca kārayet| veśmasvevaṃvidheṣvaśvān sthāpitān paripālayet ||79 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre aśvaśālā nāma trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <34> athāprayojyaprayojyaṃ nāma catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| rājñāṃ senāpatīnāṃ ca varṇināmapi veśmasu| yadi vā vāstukakṣāsu sabhāḍevakuleṣu ca ||1 śayanāsanayāneṣu bhājanābharaṇeṣu ca| chatradhvajapatākāsu sarvopakaraṇeṣu ca ||2 aprayojyāni yāni syuḥ prayoktavyāni yāni ca| vistarāttāni kathyante hitārthamatha dehinām ||3 pūrvoktānāṃ nṛpādīnāṃ yāni veśmasu kevalam| aprayojyāni tānyeva pūrvamatrābhidadhmahe ||4 teṣu naiva prayoktavyāḥ samastā api devatāḥ| daityā grahāstathā tārā yakṣagandharvarākṣasāḥ ||5 piśācāḥ pitaraḥ pretāḥ siddhavidyādharoragāḥ| cāraṇā bhūtasaṅghāśca teṣāṃ yoṣāḥ sutāstathā ||6 pratīhārāḥ pratīhāryasteṣāmadhikṛtāśca ye| āyudhāni tadīyāni sarve cāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ ||7 dīkṣitavratipāṣaṇḍināstikāḥ kṣutprapīḍitāḥ| vyādhibandhanaśastrāgnitailāsṛkpaṅkapāṃsubhiḥ ||8 śūlajvarādibhiścārtā ye'nye'pyevaṃvidhā narāḥ| mattonmattajaḍaklībanagnāndhabadhirādayaḥ ||9 dolākrīḍāśca neṣyante grahaṇāni ca dantinām| devāsurādyāḥ saṅgrāmā vigrahāca mahīkṣitām ||10 prāṇiyuddhavimardāśca mṛgayā ca na śasyate| raudra dīnādbhutatrāsabībhatsakaruṇā rasāḥ ||11 na prāṇiṣu prayoktavyā hāsyaśṛṅgāravarjitāḥ| hastyaśvarathayānāni vimānāyatanāni ca ||12 caṇḍānalapradīptāni bhavanāni vanāni ca| vṛkṣāḥ puṣpaphalairhīnā vihaṅgāvāsadūṣitāḥ ||13 ekadviśākhā rūkṣāśca bhagnāḥ śuṣkāḥ sakoṭarāḥ| kadambaśālmalīśelutārakṣāralukādayaḥ ||14 bhūtālayatvānneṣyante kaṭukaṇṭakinaśca ye| gṛdhrolūkā vihaṅgeṣu kapotaśyenavāyasāḥ ||15 kaṅkaśceti na śasyante khagā rātricarāśca ye| gajāśvamahiṣāścoṣṭrā mārjārakharavānarāḥ ||16 siṃho vyāghrastarakṣuśca varāhamṛgajamvukāḥ| tathā vanacarā ye ca kravyādā mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ ||17 gṛheṣvete na kartavyāḥ śailāṭavyāśritāśca ye| amīṣāṃ karaṇādarthairācāryo vipramucyate ||18 vyādhiṃ ghoramavāpnoti vyasanaṃ bandhameva ca| yatra tatra gṛhasvāmī dhanahāniṃ parājayam ||19 pravāsaṃ bandhanaṃ nāśaṃ mṛtyuṃ vā kṣipramāpnuyāt| ityuktānyapraśastāni gṛheṣu gṛhamedhinām ||20 tatra yāni prayojyāni kathyante tānyataḥ param| yasya yatra bhavedbhaktiryā cāsya kuladevatā ||21 hastakḷptapramāṇena tān kurvan syānna doṣabhāk| taddvārapārśvayoḥ kāryau pratīhārau khalaṅkṛtau ||22 vetradaṇḍavyagrakarau khaḍgakośaparicchadau| rūpayauvanasampannau vicitrāmbarabhūṣaṇau ||23 dhātrī vāmanikā kubjā sakhībhiḥ parivāritā| vidūṣakaiḥ kañcukibhistuṣṭairanugatāstathā ||224 dvārasyobhayataḥ kāryāḥ pratīhāryo manoramāḥ| nidhayaścānurūpāśca śaṅkhābjojjvalalakṣāṇāḥ ||25 ratnadnīnārarāśīṃśca vahanto vadanodgatān| padmasthā pūrṇakumbhā vā ratnavastravibhūṣitā ||26 vakrairūrdhvasthitaiḥ puṣpaphalapallavasambhṛtaiḥ| pūrṇakumbhāṅkuśacchatraśrīvṛkṣādarśacāmaraiḥ ||27 kāryāṣṭamaṅgalā dvāre dāmabhiḥ śaṅkhamatsyayoḥ| dvāramaṇḍalamadhyasthā snāpyamānā gajottamaiḥ ||28 padmāsanā padmahastā śrīśca kāryā svalaṅkṛtā| vṛṣaḥ savatsā dhenurvā sacchatrasragvibhūṣaṇā ||29 phalabhaktairbahuvidhairāhārārthaṃ niveditaiḥ| nānāpuṣpaphalairnamraiḥ śālaistiryagavasthitaiḥ ||30 citrā patralatā lekhyā bāhyābhyantarabhittiṣu| haṃsakāraṇḍacakrāhvairbisinīpatravartibhiḥ ||31 kumārakaiśca krīḍadbhiryuktā lalitabāhubhiḥ| vāsadhāmni niveśyante vicitrābharaṇāmbarāḥ ||32 ratikrīḍāparā nāryo nāyakastu yadṛcchayā| āpāṇḍudehacchavayaḥ svalpacāruvibhūṣaṇāḥ ||33 kiñcitpratanubhirgātraiḥ kāryāḥ suratalālasāḥ| pravṛddhaśākhāviṭapaiḥ pracalāruṇapallavaiḥ ||34 campakāśokapunnāganānāmratilakādibhiḥ| chāyāpuṣpaphalopetaiḥ vṛkṣairanyaiśca bhūṣitāḥ ||35 udyānabhūmayaḥ kāryāḥ kūjatpikamadhuvratāḥ| ṛtavaḥ phalapuṣpādyaiḥ svaiḥ svaiścihnairalaṅkṛtāḥ ||36 manoramairviśeṣaiśca khagaiśca samayocitaiḥ| kādambakurarakrauñcahaṃsasārasamekhalāḥ ||37 tīrāntodgatavānīraketakīṣaṇḍamaṇḍitāḥ| jalāntalīnamatsyaiśca sañchannā nalinīvanaiḥ ||38 lekhyāśca gṛhabhittīnāmadhobhāgeṣu dīrghikāḥ| phalaiḥ samaṃ sabhakṣekṣumaṇikāñcanabhājanāḥ ||39 vinyastapadminīpatrāḥ sotpalāḥ pānabhūmayaḥ| vicitrātodyahastāśca nṛtyagītavicakṣaṇāḥ ||40 muditā lalanā lekhyāḥ prekṣāsaṅgītabhūmiṣu| prakalpyāḥ pañjarasthāśca cakoraśukasārikāḥ ||41 prahṛṣṭāḥ parapuṣṭāśca mayūrāśca sakukkuṭāḥ| iti yāni pradiṣṭāni prayoktavyāni veśmani ||42 tāni sarvāṇi śastāni sarvopakaraṇeṣvapi| devayonigaṇāstadvatpuruṣāśca vininditāḥ ||43 sākrandāśca na śasyante pīṭhaśayyāsanādiṣu| purastātkīrtitānyatra prayoktavyāni yāni ca ||44 tāni śastāni kakṣāsu sabhādevakuleṣu ca| divyamānuṣasambaddhānyākhyānākhyāyikādiṣu ||45 proktāni tāni tāvanti śubhānyālekhyakādiṣu| iti kathitamayojyaṃ yojanīyaṃ ca buddhyā| bhavanaśayanakakṣādevadhiṣṇyādikeṣu| viracayati yathoktaṃ ninditaṃ varjayedyaḥ| sa bhavati nṛpatīnāṃ śilpināṃ cārcanīyaḥ ||46 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre aprayojyaprayojyaṃ nāma catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <35> atha śilānyāsavidhirnāma pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| atha brūmaḥ śilānyāsavidhimatra yathāgamam| tatrodagayante puṇye śuklapakṣe śubhe'hani ||1 sthiragrahasya divase karaṇe ca guṇānvite| tiṣye'śvinīṣu rohiṇyāmuttareṣvapi ca triṣu ||2 revatyāṃ śravaṇe haste śilāvinyāsamācaret| sthirasya rāśerudaye saumyamitrāvalokite ||3 samyaṅnimittaśakunasvastipuṇyāhavācite| harṣodaye ca manasaḥ kuryādvāstorniveśanam ||4 bhadraḥ prakṛtyā śāstrajñaḥ śuciḥ snātaḥ samāhitaḥ| karmārabheta sthapatiḥ kṛtadevārcanakriyaḥ ||5 pūrṇāṃ samāmavikalāṃ caturaśrāmaninditām| śilāmādyāṃ caye sādhvīṃ parīkṣeta vicakṣaṇaḥ ||6 kumbhāṅkuśadhvajacchatramatsyacāmaratoraṇaiḥ| dūrvānāgaphaloṣṇīṣapuṣpasvastikavedibhiḥ ||7 nandyāvartaiḥ sacamaraiḥ kūrmapadmaniśākaraiḥ| vajraiḥ praśastaiḥ prākārairbhūṣitāḥ karmaṇo hitāḥ ||8 dīrghā hrasvālpaviṣamāchābhādhmātāparīkṣitā| diṅmūḍhā cāṅgahīnā ca sāsthyaṅgārā saśarkarā ||9 khaṇḍā duḥpakvanirbhinnā kṛṣṇā doṣabhayāvahā| nṛṇāṃ paśuturaṅgāṇāṃ padāṅkāḥ svastivṛddhaye ||10 kavyānmṛgavihaṅgānāṃ pādaiḥ spṛṣṭāstu varjayet| nandābhadrā jayāpūrṇāścatasraḥ syurimāḥ śilāḥ ||11 vāsiṣṭhī kāśyapī tadvadbhārgavyāṅgirasīti tāḥ| tatra prāguttare deśe saṃniveśasya vāstunaḥ ||12 nairṛtyāṃ vā sakusumāṃ samāṃ gocarmasammitām| vedīṃ sagandhakalaśāṃ caturaśrāṃ prakalpayet ||13 āgneyyāmādito nandāṃ sthāpayetkramaśaḥ śilām| akālamūlairavyaṅgaiḥ sapadmotpalapallavaiḥ ||14 sarvauṣadhihiraṇyādyairhemarājatamṛnmayaiḥ| kumbhaistāmramayaiścāpi mantraistāmabhiṣecayet ||15 tīrthaprasravaṇāmbhobhiḥ saratnākṣatapaṅkajaiḥ| sugandhibhiḥ sapuṇyāhamabhiṣekaṃ prayojayet ||16 jāhnavīyamunārevāsarasvatyādisambhavaiḥ| mahānadījalaṃ śastaṃ śubhatīrthabhavaṃ tathā ||17 tathādri vanaveśantadevāyatanajāni ca| abhiṣekāthamambhāṃsi yathālābhamupāharet ||18 mantreṇānena caitāsāmabhiṣekaṃ samācaret| hiraṇyavarṇāḥ pāvanyaḥ śucayo duritacchidaḥ ||19 punantu śāntāḥśrīmatya āpo yuṣmānmadhucyutaḥ| mantrapūtena payasā snāpayitvā tataḥ śilām ||20 sthapatirgandhakalkena maṅgalyenānulepayet| himacandanapūrṇena vyavakīrya sugandhinā ||21 tarasā chādayedenāṃ salājaiḥ puṣpadāmabhiḥ| dhūpamālyopahāraiśca dadhimāṃsākṣatādibhiḥ ||22 pūjayediṣṭakāṃ devīṃ vastrayugmaiśca puṣkalaiḥ| niveśanānte nairṛtyāṃ tadā viprānavasthitān ||23 samasaṅkhyāñśucīnprājñānarcayeddakṣiṇāphalaiḥ| oṅkārasvastipuṇyāhagītavāditranisvanaiḥ ||24 kartā janitaromāścastebhyaḥ kuryānnamaskriyām| nivedya vāstoṣpataye bhūtebhyaśca tato balim ||25 tāsāṃ catasṛṇāmanyāḥ kuryādupaśilāḥ pṛthak| prākārasvastikāṅke dve tathā śrīvatsalakṣaṇā ||26 nandyāvartastu pūrṇāyāṃ bhavedeko yathākramam| karṇe prāgdakṣiṇe nandāṃ vāstunaḥ sthāpayedadhaḥ ||27 anyāḥ krameṇa bhadrā dyāḥ koṇeṣvanyeṣu ca triṣu| pratiṣṭhāpanamantrāśca tāsāṃ catasṛṇāmapi ||28 catvāra ṛṣibhirgītāḥ śāśvatārambhadarśanāḥ| vīryeṇādivarāhasya vedāryaistvabhimantritāḥ ||29 vasiṣṭhanandinīṃ nandāṃ prāk pratiṣṭhāpayāmyaham| sumuhūrte sudivase sā tvaṃ nande niveśitā ||30 āyuḥ kārayiturdīrghaṃ śriyaṃ cāgryāmihāvaha| bhadrā si sarvatobhadrā bhadre bhadraṃ vidhīyatam ||31 kaśyapasya priyasute śrīrastu gṛhamedhinaḥ| jaye vijayatāṃ svāmī gṛhasyāsya mahātmanaḥ ||32 ācandrā rkaṃ yaśaścāsya bhūmyāmiha virohatu| tvayi sampūrṇacandrā bhe nyastāyāṃ vāstunastale ||33 bhavatyeṣa gṛhasvāmī pūrṇe pūrṇamanorathaḥ| iti mūlacayo mantraiḥ kuryātsvastikavācanaiḥ ||34 tābhirhiraṇyavarṇābhiḥ śilābhiḥ samamadbhutam| prāgudakplavanā dhanyā na pratyagdakṣiṇāplavā ||35 iṣṭakāścaityabhavanaprākārapurakarmasu| vitāne citivinyāse caturmukhaniketane ||36 purodhāḥ śāntivedīṣu pratimāsthāpaneṣu ca| yājñikena vidhānena kramaśaḥ sthāpayecchilāḥ ||37 traiśokaurṇāsabhāsaistāḥ sāmabhiḥ sa mahāvrataiḥ| gāyatryuṣṇiganuṣṭubbhirbṛhatyā ca yathākramam ||38 cayān samastāṃścinuyāccaturo viramet tataḥ| jñātvā bhittipramāṇaṃ ca citeścayacatuṣṭayam ||39 samāpyamādikarmaivaṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ ca yathottaram| pratiṣṭhitāstāḥ prathamaṃ bhūtale susthitāḥ samāḥ ||40 na cālayeccālane syādgṛhabharturmahad bhayam| kampane ca bhayaṃ vidyādetāsāṃ sthiratāṃ punaḥ ||41 sthapatergṛhabhartuśca maṅgalaṃ paramaṃ viduḥ| prāgdakṣiṇāyāṃ calane gṛhabharturmahadbhayam ||42 bhāryāvināśo nairṛtyāṃ śūnyaṃ bhītirmaruddiśi| gurośca bhayamaiśānyāmapacāre'pi tadbhavet ||43 prathamaṃ sthāpitenaivaṃ stambhānapi na cālayet| noddhareta praṇudyācca vidhistulyo yato'nayoḥ ||44 vinyāsaṃ prathamaṃ tasmātkuryāt samyak samāhitaḥ| śilānāṃ sthapatistadvatstambhānāmapi sarvathā ||45 dvāraprākāraśālānāṃ nagarāṇāṃ ca veśmanām| tatpramāṇo vidhiryasmāttasmāttatrādṛto bhavet ||46 evaṃ śilānyāsavidhānametadyathāvadasmābhirihopadiṣṭam| asmin kṛte veśmasurālayādi niṣpattimabhyeti vinaiva vighnam| iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre śilānyāsavidhirnāma pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <36> atha balidānavidhirnāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| idānīmabhidhāsyāmo balirūpavidheḥ kramam| yena yenārcitā devāstuṣyanti samaheśvarāḥ ||1 maṇḍalaṃ vāstuno madhye gomayena prakalpayet| kalaśaṃ tatra vinyasyet saprasūnaṃ sakāñcanam ||2 vāstudevāstataḥ kalpyā yathāsthānaniyogataḥ| sadhupervividhairmālyairarghyaṃ paścānnivedayet ||3 arcayedviśvakarmāṇaṃ mālyairdhūpairvilepanaiḥ| bhakṣaiḥ phalairbahuvidhaiḥ pūjayetsusamāhitaḥ ||4 ājyena payasā dadhnā pūjayecchikhinaṃ punaḥ| śāligodhūmamudgrādyairdhānyaiḥ parjjanyamarcayet ||5 jayantaṃ pūjayedāmradrā kṣākharjūrikādibhiḥ| mālatīmallikābhiśca pūjayettridaśādhipam ||6 puṣpai raktaistathā dhūpai raktacandanalepanaiḥ| tataḥ sūryaṃ jagannāthaṃ pūjayellokacakṣuṣam ||7 jambīrairbījapūraiśca nāraṅgaiḥ pītakaiḥ phalaiḥ| pūjayetsatyanāmānaṃ devaṃ tena sa tuṣyati ||8 matsyamāṃsaiśca tuṣyanti sarve rakṣaḥpurogamāḥ| sitaiḥ phalairnārikelairbhṛśaśca parituṣyati ||9 gandhadhūpaprayogaiśca nabhonāmānamarcayet| puṣpaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ śuklairmārutaḥ parituṣyati ||10 kṛsaraṃ madhusaṃyuktaṃ pūṣṇe bhaktyā nivedayet| vitathaṃ tu śubhairanyairmadyamāṃsavivarjitaiḥ ||11 pūjitastuṣṭimāyāti vivasvāṃśca mahāmuniḥ| puṣpaiḥ sapuṣpakaistuṣṭimavāpnoti gṛhakṣataḥ ||12 matsyamāṃsayutairbhavyairyamatuṣṭiḥ sadā bhavet| punnāgāgarudhūpena gandharvānarcayedbudhaḥ ||13 mṛgamāṃsayutairbhakṣairbhṛṅgarājaṃ ca tarpayet| rājajambūphalairbilvairdevamabhyarcayenmṛgam ||14 pāyasairmadhusaṃyuktairmāṃsairbhaktaiśca śobhanaiḥ| karpūrasurabhidra vyagarbhaiḥ saṃpūjayetpitṝn ||15 sapuṣpairmodakairlājaiḥ palalaiśca vimiśritaiḥ| dauvārikaṃ prayatnena pūjayedvighnakārakam ||16 apūrvaiḥ śobhanairgandhairdhūpairmālyairanuttamaiḥ| puṣpaiḥ kaṇṭakajātīnāṃ sugrīvaṃ pūjayetsadā ||17 sapuṣpairlāpakairbhakṣyairdadhiyuktānnapāyasaiḥ| arcayatpuṣpadantaṃ tu yaśovīryānvitaṃ suram ||18 māṃsaiśca sūkarādīnāṃ vainateyaṃ sadārcayet| varuṇaṃ ca mahāsattvaṃ pūjayeddhūpacandanaiḥ ||19 rāhuṃ ca māṃsasaṃyuktaistarpayedbhakṣyabhojanaiḥ| rudhireṇa pradattena tuṣṭimeti śanaiścaraḥ ||20 māṃsena tu kṣayastuṣṭiṃ rogāṇāmadhipo vrajet| medasā pūjayedro gaṃ sarvalokabhayaṅkaram ||21 vāsukiṃ kṣīradānena pūjayet satataṃ naraḥ| pūrvavatpūjayeddevaṃ viśvakarmāṇamīśvaram ||22 sitaprasūnavinyāsairbhallāṭaṃ pūjayedbudhaḥ| dadhiyuktena cānnena somaṃ sarvatra pūjayet ||23 kuberaṃ dhūpadānena pūjayet satataṃ naraḥ| aditiṃ ca suvarṇena padmairapi ca pūjayet ||24 arkamandāramālābhirvṛṣabhaṃ ca samarcayet| anyeṣāmapi devānāmarcanaṃ dhūpasāmprataiḥ ||25 sarvapuṣpaphalaiścaiṣāṃ kāryaṃ buddhimatā sadā| ityete balayaḥ sarve śāntyarthaṃ parikalpitāḥ ||26 śodhane karṣaṇe bhūmeḥ sādhane rūpakalpane| gṛhe praveśane ramye tithimabhyudayeṣu ca ||27 skandhāvāraniveśeṣu puragrāmaniveśane| devālayakṣitipaveśmaniveśaneṣu| proktān balīn pravitaretprayataḥ surebhyaḥ| prārambhamanyamapi vāstugataṃ cikīrṣuḥ| kurvannimaṃ vidhimabhīpsitabhājanaṃ syāt ||28 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre balidānavidhirnāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <37> atha kīlakasūtrapāto nāma saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| varṇānāṃ yāni dārūṇi kīlakāryaṃ niyojayet| idānīṃ tāni vakṣyāmi śreyaḥkīrttihitāya ca ||1 khadirodumbarāśvatthaśālaśākadhavārjunāḥ| añjanaḥ kadarāśokatiniśāruṇacandanāḥ ||2 śirīṣasarjanyagrodhaveṇavaḥ kīlakarmaṇi| punnāmāno drumāḥ śastāḥ strīnāmāno vigarhitāḥ ||3 aśvatthaḥ khadiraścaitau viprāṇāṃ vṛddhikārakau| raktacandanaveṇūtthakīlau kṣatrasya pūjitau ||4 śākaśca khadiraśceti sāmantānāṃ hitāvimau| kīlau śālaśirīṣotthau vaiśyānāṃ kīrtitau śubhau ||5 śūdra jāṭestu tiniśadhavārjunasamudbhavāḥ| vaiśyaveśmasu saubhāgyakārye ca syuraśokajāḥ ||6 nyagrodho vaṇijāṃ dhāmni bhūmikarmaṇyudumbaraḥ| mahāmātraśvavaidyānāṃ kīlāḥ sarjārjunā gṛhe ||7 viprāṇāṃ sarvavarṇotthāḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ trivarṇajāḥ| varṇadvayoktā vaiśyānāṃ śūdrā ṇāṃ svānulomataḥ ||8 pratilomā na kartavyāḥ kīlakā bhūtimicchatā| pramāṇānyatha kīlānāṃ nigadyante pṛthakpṛthak ||9 dvātriṃśadaṅgulāḥ kīlā viprāṇāṃ syuḥ śubhāvahāḥ| kṣatriyāṇāṃ punaścāṣṭāviṃśatyaṅgulasammitāḥ ||10 caturviṃśatyaṅgulāśca vaiśyānāṃ śubhadāyinaḥ| viṃśatyādyaṅgulaiḥ kīlāḥ śūdra jātestu te hitāḥ ||11 ṣaḍaṅgulaparīṇāhāḥ sarveṣvete śubhāvahāḥ| brāhmaṇakṣātriyaviśāṃ vedāṣṭāśraṣaḍaśrayaḥ ||12 ṣaḍaśrayastu śūdra sya prakṛtestu yadṛcchayā | dārbhamauñjaurṇakārpāsaṃ viprādīnāṃ yathākramam ||13 ardhaparvaparīṇāhaṃ dṛḍhaṃ sūtraṃ tu vartitam| alābhe svasya sūtrasya proktādanyatamaṃ budhaḥ ||14 gṛhṇīyātsūtramanye tu gṛhṇīyuḥ svecchayaiva te| itthaṃ saṃbhṛtya sambhārān gṛhabhartā śubhe'hani ||15 śuklapakṣe śuciḥ snātaḥ sthapatiśca sitāmbaraḥ| gṛhasthānanimittāttu devasthānāni lakṣayet ||16 kusumākṣatamayyaśca kartavyā gṛhadevatāḥ| ādau sthānāni śaṅkūnāṃ parīkṣeta samantataḥ ||17 teṣu sarveṣu kartavyamarcanaṃ tu yathāvidhi| gṛhasya madhye siktvā tu nirūpya brahmaṇaḥ pade ||18 gomayena samāliptāṃ kuryādvedīṃ sulakṣaṇām| caturaśrāṃ caturdvārāmakṣataiḥ supratiṣṭhitām ||19 tasyā madhye pratiṣṭhāpyaḥ kumbho haimo'tha rājataḥ| tāmrako mṛnmayo vāpi pūrvālābhe paraḥ paraḥ ||20 akālamūlaḥ so'vyaṅgo jalapūrṇaḥ svalaṅkṛtaḥ| maṇiratnapravālaiśca svarṇarūpyeṇa garbhitaḥ ||21 pratiṣṭhāpyākṣataiḥ puṣpaphalabījasamanvitaḥ| śvetena candanenainaṃ carcayitvā samantataḥ ||22 tasyopariṣṭād vinyasyet kṣīravṛkṣasya pallavam| sugandhinātha dhūpena dhūpayitvā caturdiśam ||23 veṣṭayedahatenainaṃ śuklavastreṇa sarvataḥ| vāsumadhye yato brahmā kumbharūpaṃ sa tiṣṭhati ||24 kumbhasyottarabhāge tu kīlakān sthāpayedbudhaḥ| kīlānaṣṭau parīkṣeta sthāpayecca yathāvidhi ||25 śvetacandanaliptāṃstāñśvetapuṣpairvibhūṣayet| sālaktakān surabhiṇā dhūpena ca sudhūpitān ||26 ūrṇāmayena sūtreṇa trivarṇenābhiveṣṭayet| madhusarpirdadhikṣīrairmūlabhāgeṣu lepayet ||27 arcayetparaśuṃ sūtramaṣṭhīlādīni sarvataḥ| athopakaraṇānyatra dhūpapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ ||28 tataḥ pūrvottare vāstorbhāge saptārciṣaḥ pade| gomayena
