samālipte kuśāstaraṇamāsthitaḥ ||29 agnikāryaṃ prakurvīta purodhāḥ śāntimeva ca| sāṃvatsaraḥ śuciḥ snātaḥ kṛtasnānaḥ samāhitaḥ ||30 śaṅkunā sādhayellagnaṃ samyak tadghaṭikāthavā| rātrilagnaṃ tu nakṣatrairmadhyāstodayasaṃśritaiḥ ||31 evaṃ saṃsādhayellagnaṃ yadīcchetsiddhimātmanaḥ| pūjayā tuṣṭikāriṇyā pūjayecca purohitam ||32 abhyarcite yatastasmin brahmā bhavati pūjitaḥ| sāṃvatsarasya kartavyā tataḥ pūjā yathāvidhi ||33 sāṃvatsare'rcite yasmātpūjitaḥ syādbṛhaspatiḥ| sthapatiṃ pūjayetpaścāttvaṣṭṝtuṣṭicikīrṣayā ||34 tadadhīnaṃ yataḥ karma śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham| śvetacandanadigdhāṃstāñśvetapuṣpaiśca pūjitān ||35 sadaśairahatairvastrairaṅgulīyaiḥ prapūjayet| parikarmakarā ye ca tān yathāśakti pūjayet ||36 hemnā vastrādidānaiśca vāgbhirvā paritoṣayet| yathā sumanasaste syustathā kartavyamādarāt ||37 tataḥ sthapatirācamya balikarma samācaret| sūtrapāte baliṃ dhīmān sārvabhautikamācaret ||38 tasyālābhe baliḥ kāryo yo bhavetso'bhidhīyate| vidadhīta carūñśvetaraktapītāsitānpṛthak ||39 pāyasaṃ kṛsaraṃ kṣīraṃ niṣpāvāñśvetamodanam| pāvikādadhirūpāṃśca palalollāpikāghṛtam ||40 dadhyodanaṃ ca saṃmiśraṃ devatābhyo nivedayet| tilairghṛtena sahitairdevamagniṃ ca pūjayet ||41 tataśca pāyasaṃ dadhnā brahmasthāne nivedayet| tataścānukrameṇaiva devatābhyo baliṃ haret ||42 balikarma yathānyāyaṃ kṛtvā ca dvijavācanam| svaśākhīyāñśucīn prājñān pūjayeddakṣiṇāphalaiḥ ||43 oṅkārasvastipuṇyāhairgītavāditranisvanaiḥ| tato vipraiḥ saha svāmī kuryāttasya pradakṣiṇam ||44 akṣatān prathamaṃ kumbhe dāpayitvā dvijottamaiḥ| tato dakṣiṇapūrveṇa gatvā puṇyāhavācakaiḥ ||45 ahatāmbarasaṃvītaḥ śuciḥ sthapatirāsane| niṣadya prāṅmukhaḥ śaṅkuṃ dhṛtvā dakṣiṇapāṇinā ||46 paścādādāya vāmena pratiṣṭhāpya ca bhūtale| mantrānabhūñjapan vīro hanyāt paraśunā tataḥ ||47 viśantu te talaṃ nāgā lokapālāstathaiva ca| pratiṣṭhantu gṛhaṃ cāsminnāyurbalakaraṃ bhavet ||48 prahārānsusthirānaṣṭau dadyātkīlasya mūrdhani| hanyamāne tataḥ kīle nimittānyupalakṣayet ||49 goviprarathanāgāḍhyāḥ kanyā nṛpavarastriyaḥ| śaṅkhadundubhivaṃśānāṃ tathā gītasya ca dhvaniḥ ||50 āvirbhavati yadyasmin hanyamāne prabhustadā| satataṃ sukhamāpnoti śāntyaiśvaryaiśca vardhate ||51 hataṃ kṣutaṃ vipannaṃ vā niṣedhaḥ sūtrakīlayoḥ| pāṣaṇḍināṃ ca sarveṣāṃ darśanaṃ na sukhāvaham ||52 dṛṣṭvā śubhanimittāni tataḥ śaṅkuṃ niveśayet| hanyamāno yadā kīlo viśedbhūmau śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||53 karmasiddhibhavet tatra gṛhaṃ ratnaparicchadam| hanyamāno'pi na viśeddharitrīṃ kīlako yadā ||54 na tatra karmasiddhiḥ syādanimittaṃ ca lakṣayet| ekenāpi prahāreṇa yatra kīlo viśenmahīm ||55 na siddhiṃ yāti tatraukaḥ kṛtaṃ vā nopabhujyate| āyasyāṣṭhīlayā hanyānna kāṣṭhena kathañcana ||56 kāṣṭhena tāḍitaḥ kīlo vahnidoṣakaro bhavet| aśmanā yadi tāḍyeta tadā vyādhiṃ prayacchati ||57 aindrīṃ prati nataḥ kīlo dhanasammānakārakaḥ| āgneyyāṃ praṇate kīle bhavatyagnibhayaṃ mahat ||58 yāmyāyāṃ maraṇaṃ rājñāṃ diśi rākṣasato bhayam| dhananāśastu vāruṇyāṃ vāyavyāṃ rogato bhayam ||59 saumyaṃ saumyānate rājaprasādāyeśato gataḥ| kīlake kūrcake jāte putrapautrānvayairgṛhe ||60 paramāmṛddhimāpnoti dhanadhānyaiśca vardhate| hanyamāno yadā yatnātkīlaḥ kaścidapi sphuṭet ||61 nāśaṃ vidyāt tasya patnyā jyeṣṭhasya tanayasya vā| yadi bhajyeta kīlaḥ svāt svāmino jāyate vadhaḥ ||72 yadā kīlaḥ pateddhastād bhraṃśaḥ syāt sthapatestadā| hastabhraṣṭaśca sa bhavedaṣṭhīle hastavicyute ||63 sukhena hanyamānaścetkīlaḥ svastho na jāyate| aṣṭau prahārānaparāṃstasya dadyāttadā punaḥ ||64 sraggandhadhūpopahāraiḥ kuryācca pariṣecanam| idaṃ sāma mahāpuṇyaṃ paricintya samāsataḥ ||65 traiśokaṃ tu japedvidvān yāvacchaṅkvabhiṣecanam| gatvātha nairṛtīmāśāṃ tataḥ śaṅkuṃ niveśayet ||66 ūrṇāyavena sāmnāsya samyak snapanamācaret| vāyordiśaṃ tato gatvā tatra śaṅkuṃ niveśayet ||67 abhiṣekaṃ mahāratnasāmnā tasya samācaret| athaiśānīṃ diśaṃ gatvā śaṅkuṃ tasyāṃ niveśayet ||68 bhāgreṇa sāmnā kurvīta prāgvattasyābhiṣecanam| tato'nu sūtraṃ badhnīyātsavyaṃ dviguṇaveṣṭitam ||69 pradakṣiṇaṃ prasāryaitaduktaḥ śaṅkukramo yathā| madhyamānaṃ yadā sūtraṃ śaṅkuḥ kimapi muñcati ||70 tadā putravadhaṃ vidyācchinnaṃ svasvāmimṛtyave| tasmādyatnaḥ prakartavyo yāvatsūtraṃ prasāryate ||71 caturṇāmapi bāhūnāṃ poṣaṃ chinnaṃ na duṣyati| sūtraṃ prasārya vitareccarūnpūrvaṃ prakalpitān ||72 sveṣu sveṣu tataḥ sthāneṣvanena vidhinā budhaḥ| śaṅkusthāneṣu dātavyāḥ sitādyāścaravaḥ kramāt ||73 prāgdakṣiṇasyā vidiśo mantraṃ cemaṃ hṛdā japet| mārutānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ mānavānāṃ tathaiva ca ||74 baliṃ teṣu prayacchāmi mantreṇa parimantritam| raktaṃ balimupādāya nairṛtyabhimukhastathā ||75 nairṛtyadhipatiścaiva nairṛtyāṃ ye ca rākṣasāḥ| baliṃ teṣu prayacchāmi raktamodanamuttamam ||76 kṛṣṇaṃ balimupādāya gatvā ca diśamānilīm| namaste nāgarājāya ye cānye taṃ samāśritāḥ ||77 baliṃ teṣu prayacchāmi kṛṣṇamodanamuttamam| balimuddhṛtya hāridra maiśānīmāśrayan diśam ||78 namo rudre ṣeu sarveṣu ye cānye tānsamāśritāḥ| prayacchāmi valiṃ teṣāṃ hāridrau danamuttamam ||79 evametānbalīn sarvān yathāvatpratipādayet| tataḥ kumbhodakaṃ puṇyaṃ sāmnā divyena mantrayet ||80 vāmadevyena kurvīta prokṣāṇaṃ tena vāstunaḥ| drumā viprādīnāmiti nigaditāḥ śaṅkughaṭane| phalaṃ yacchaṅkośca sphuṭamiha nimittāni bahuśaḥ| tathā sūtrātāne vidhiranu ca mantraiḥ pratidiśaṃ| baliḥ kīleṣūktastridaśaparitoṣāya vidhivat ||81 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre kīlakasūtrapāto nāma saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <38> atha vāstusaṃsthānamātṛkā nāmāṣṭātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| idānīmabhidhāsyāmo vāstusaṃsthānamātṛkām| nivāsahetave samyaksarvakarmopajīvinām ||1 caturaśraṃ samaṃ sāci dīrghaṃ vṛttaṃ ca śamvukam| śakaṭākṣabhagādarśavajrakanthākṛtīni ca ||2 chinnakarṇaṃ vikarṇaṃ ca śaṅkhābhaṃ kṣurasannibham| śaktyānanaṃ kūrmapṛṣṭhaṃ sadaṃśaṃ vyajanākṛti ||3 śarāvasvastikākāraṃ mṛdaṅgapaṇavopamam| viśarkaraṃ kabandhābhaṃ yavamadhyasamākṛti ||4 utsaṅgarājadantābhe tathā paraśusannibham| visrāvitaṃ ca śvabhraṃ ca pralambaṃ ca vivāhikam ||5 trikuṣṭaṃ pañcakuṣṭaṃ ca paricchinnaṃ tathāparam| diksvastikābhaṃ śrīvṛkṣaṃ vardhamānasamānanam ||6 eṇīpadaṃ narapadaṃ catvāriṃśatsamāsataḥ| kṣetrānyuktānyathāmīṣāṃ viniyogo vidhīyate ||7 caturaśre same rājā śayyākāre purohitāḥ| dīrghe kumārakāḥ senāpatirvṛttāyate vaset ||8 vaseyuḥ śambukākāre sarve vāhāḥ sukhārthinaḥ| antaḥpuraṃ sadma same vāṇijāḥ śakaṭākṛtau ||9 veśyāstu bhagasaṃsthāne darpaṇābhe suvarṇakṛt| saṃsthānato vajrasame janā nagaragoṣṭhikāḥ ||10 vaseyuḥ śaṅkhasaṃsthāne kṣetre putrābhilāṣiṇaḥ| chinnakarṇe mahāmātrā vikarṇe mṛgalabdhakāḥ ||11 śaṅkhābhe caikadṛśvāno gaṇācāryāḥ kṣuropame| vratādhyakṣaḥ śaktimukhe kūrmapṛṣṭhe tu mālikāḥ ||12 sadaṃśe saucikā vājipoṣikā vyajanopame| takṣāṇaśca śarāvābhe svastike vandimāgadhāḥ ||13 paṇavābhe mṛdaṅgābhe veṇutūryādivādakāḥ| viśarkare tu rathinaḥ kabandhapratime punaḥ ||14 nīcāḥ śvapākāśca yavapratime dhānyajīvinaḥ| utsaṅge śramaṇā hastyārohiṇo rājadantake ||15 paraśupratime kṣetre bandhanāgāriṇo janāḥ| visrāviṇi surākārāḥ śvabhrāme karmakāriṇaḥ ||16 yugale nāpitāḥ svāvivāhavye kośarakṣiṇaḥ| trikuṣṭe pañcakuṣṭe ca vaseyurvahnijīvinaḥ ||17 samantataḥ paricchanne sarve mānopajīvinaḥ| diksvastike tu caityāni kuryādvāsāṃśca sarvaśaḥ ||18 śrīvṛkṣapratime vṛkṣān yajñavāṭāṃśca kārayet| vardhamānākṛtimukhe'pyetāneva prakalpayet ||19 eṇīpade tu gaṇikāścaurān narapadopame| ityuktāḥ śubhadā vāsāḥ sarvakarmopajīvinām ||20 karmopajīvijanavāsanimittametāḥ| kṣetrākṛtīrabhihitāḥ pravimṛśya teṣām| veśmāni kārayati yaḥ sthapatiryathāva-| nmānyaḥ sa kasya na bhavediha bhūmipṛṣṭhe ||21 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre vāstusaṃsthānamātṛkānāmāṣṭātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <39> atha dvāraguṇadoṣo nāmaikonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| gṛhāṇyuktāni sarveṣāmevaṃ karmopajīvinām| varṇināṃ ca gṛhasthānāṃ kathyante'taḥ paraṃ yathā ||1 bhallāṭe dhanade yadvā carake pṛthivīdhare| brāhmaṇasya bhavedveśma māhendra dvāramuttamam ||2 māhendre 'rke'tha satye vā āryake vā niketanam| kāryaṃ gṛhakṣatadvāraṃ kṣatriyasya śubhāvaham ||3 yāmye vaivasvate vāpi gāndharve'tha gṛhakṣate| vaiśyasya bhavanaṃ kāryaṃ dvāraṃ puṣpāhvaye śubham ||4 vāruṇe pauṣpadante vā yadvā maitre'thavāsure| śūdra sya sadanaṃ kāryaṃ bhallāṭadvāramuttamam ||5 viprāṇāṃ prāṅmukhaṃ vāstu gṛhaṃ syāddakṣiṇāmukham| vardhate dhanadhānyena putrapautraiśca nityaśaḥ ||6 dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ vāstu bhavanaṃ paścimāmukham| kṣatriyasya dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ vikramaśceha vardhate ||7 vāstunaḥ paścimaṃ dvāraṃ bhavanasyottarāmukham| tatraidhate dhanairdhānyaiḥ putrapaśvādibhiśca viṭ ||8 vāstu syāduttaradvāraṃ gṛhaṃ pūrvāmukhaṃ tathā| śūdra sya karmavṛttistu dhanadhānyairvivardhate ||9 ekasyāmapi śālāyāṃ catvāraḥ saṃprakīrtitāḥ| niveśyadvārabhāgāśca kathyante ca śubhāśubhāḥ ||10 utsaṅgo hīnabāhuśca pūrṇabāhustathāparaḥ| pratyakṣāyaścaturthaśca niveśaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||11 utsaṅga evadīkṣābhyāṃ dvārāṇāṃ vāstuveśmanoḥ| sa saubhāgyaprajāvṛddhidhanadhānyajayapradaḥ ||12 yatra praveśato vāstu gṛhaṃ bhavati vāmataḥ| taddhīnabāhukaṃ vāstu ninditaṃ vāstucintakaiḥ ||13 tasmin vasannalpavittaḥ svalpamitro'lpabāndhavaḥ| strījitaśca bhavennityaṃ vividhavyādhipīḍitaḥ ||14 vāstupraveśato yattu gṛhaṃ dakṣiṇato bhavet| pradakṣiṇapraveśatvāttad vidyātpūrṇabāhukam ||15 tatra putrāṃśca pautrāṃśca dhanadhānyasukhāni ca| prāpnuvanti narā nityaṃ vasanto vāstuni dhruvam ||16 gṛhapṛṣṭaṃ samāśritya vāstudvāraṃ yadā bhavet| pratyakṣāyastvasau nindyo vāmāvartapraveśavat ||17 brāhmaṇo nivasenmukhye dvināmni kṣatriyo vaset| vitathe nivasedvaiśyaḥ śūdraḥ sugrīvanāmani ||18 ete vaiśeṣikāḥ sarve varṇānāmanupūrvaśaḥ| vāstudvāraniveśāśca vāsaiḥ saha nirūpitāḥ ||19 yathottaramathocyante varṇānāṃ gṛhakalpanāḥ| śūdra viṭkṣatriyāṇāṃ ca rājñāṃ ca jayakāṅkṣiṇām ||20 sārdhatribhūmi śūdrā ṇāṃ veśma kuryādvibhūtaye| ato'dhikataraṃ yat syāttat karoti kulakṣayam ||21 vaiśyasya vardhayedgehamardhapañcamabhūmikam| atipramāṇe tatrāsya dhanabandhuparikṣayaḥ ||22 kṣatriyasya gṛhaṃ kuryādardhaṣaṣṭhatalaṃ param| sampadbalasamṛddhyai tadatiriktaṃ tu tacchide ||23 paraṃ viprasya bhavanamardhasaptamabhūmikam| svādhyāyācārabhogārthamatyuccaṃ tu bhayāvaham ||24 yajante rājasūyādyaiḥ kratubhirye'vanīśvarāḥ| talairardhāṣṭamaisteṣāṃ kārayed bhavanottamam ||25 āhartānekayajñānāṃ rājā rājādhipaśca yaḥ| tasyāpyardhāṣṭāmatalaṃ bhavanaṃ sanniveśayet ||26 vājapeyena vā yaṣṭā yo dvijaḥ syātsamāhitaḥ| gavāṃ koṭiprado yo vā so'pi tasmin bhavedyubhīḥ ||27 yathāpramāṇanirdiṣṭe vasantaste nṛpādayaḥ| prāpnuvanti parāmṛddhimavṛddhiṃ tu viparyaye ||28 sapīṭhatalakaṃ veśma mānataḥ saṃprakīrtitam| sādhāraṇena hastena paraṃ śūdra sya viṃśatiḥ ||29 catvāriṃśadviśaḥ ṣaṣṭiḥ kṣatriyasya praśasyate| aśītirdvijamukhyasya śatahastā mahīpateḥ ||30 nātaḥ paraṃ nṛṇāmūrdhvapramāṇaṃ śastamucyate| devadānavadaityānāṃ piśācoragarakṣasām ||31 siddhagandharvayakṣāṇāṃ vidhātavyamato'dhikam| ekabhaumādadho naiva gṛhaṃ śūdra sya vidyate ||32 vaiśyasya bhavanaṃ kāryamadho nānyardhabhūmikāt| dvibhūmikādadhaḥ kāryaṃ kṣatriyasya na mandiram ||33 sārdhadvibhaumād viprasya tritalādapi bhūpateḥ| hīnapramāṇādamuto gṛhaṃ yatkuśilpinā syādvihitaṃ kathañcit| bharturbhiye siddhivināśanaṃ tatpraśastaśīlādiviparyayāya ||34 guṇadoṣān pravakṣyāmi dvārāṇāṃ sarvavāstuṣu| susthitaṃ caturaśraṃ ca kāntaṃ svadra vyayojitam ||35 ṛju svakīyadigbhāge na hrasvaṃ na tathoccakaiḥ| nālpaṃ na kubjaṃ nāpyani piṇḍitaṃ na bahirgatam ||36 nādhmātaṃ na kṛśaṃ madhye gataṃ nāntarakukṣiṣu| na vidrutaṃ na saṃkṣiptaṃ yattatsyāddvāramṛddhidam ||37 padasya dvādaśe bhāge padamadhyātpradakṣiṇam| sthāpitaṃ vṛddhimāyāti dvāraṃ puṣṭiṃ karoti ca ||38 rathyācatvaraśṛṅgāṭavāpīkūpāha kumbhakaiḥ| kuḍyakoṇatarustambhairbhavanasyandanādibhiḥ ||39 yadviddhaṃ bhavanadvāraṃ tacchubhāya na jāyate| dvāraṃ dvāre praviṣṭaṃ ca kartavyaṃ vitanetana ||40 pedyāṃ praveśayennaikāmanyadvāre kadācana| dvāraṃ praveśayet pedyāṃ nārohaṇagavākṣayoḥ ||41 pakṣadvārasya vā naikāṃ kathañcidapi buddhimān| na bāhyagāntare dvāre praviṣṭaṃ kārayet kvacit ||42 vihitaṃ hi tathā tatsyādbahudoṣakaraṃ sadā| toraṇaṃ gopuradvāramaṭṭo yeṣāṃ gṛhe bhavet ||43 gṛhāṇāṃ maulikadvāraṃ śrotre caitān praveśayet| dvāraṃ dvārasya kartavyamuparyupari bhūmiṣu ||44 pradakṣiṇena vā kāryaṃ kāryaṃ nāparathā punaḥ ||45 uparyupari bhūmīnāṃ mukhaṃ kuryātpradakṣiṇam| nāpasavyena kurvīta dvāramārohaṇāni ca ||46 yasyāṃ bhittau kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ tasyāmupari kārayet| tathānyabhittau taddvāraṃ vidhātavyaṃ pradakṣiṇam ||47 na madhye sadmano dvāraṃ kuryādeva padasya ca| na sthūle na pade nāpi sirāpāte tadiṣyate ||48 niraṃśāvasthitairdra vyaistiryakkāntaiśca mandire| marmavedho na doṣāya dvāravedho'thavā kvacit ||49 yavanāṭṭālakacchāyā puradaivakulasya ca| na praveśyā gṛhadvāre raśmayaḥ somasūryayoḥ ||50 na prākāreṇa kuḍyena na viṭaṅkena vā punaḥ| antarhitāni duṣyanti dvāramarmāṇī kutracit ||51 atyucce syādbhayaṃ rājño nimne taskarato bhayam| kulapīḍā bhavetkubje bahiryāte parābhavaḥ ||52 ādhmāte'tyantadāridrayaṃ kṛśamadhye kṣayo nṛṇām| rathyāviddhe bhavedro go maraṇaṃ catvareṇa ca ||53 śṛṅgāṭakena vaidhavyaṃ duhitṝṇāṃ prajāyate| vāpyā kūpena vā viddhe syādatīsārato bhayam ||54 koṇānmṛtyubhayaṃ dadyādvṛkṣai rogabhayaṃ bhavet| stambhena mriyate svāmī bhrameṇārtho na tiṣṭhati ||55 praṇālena mahadduḥkhaṃ mahābhītirmahākaliḥ| tasmātsarvaprayatnena dvāravedhaṃ vivarjayet ||56 yasyāgrataḥ pṛṣṭhataśca dvāre bhittyordvayorapi| anyonyaṃ bhidyate yasminnaikagatyāśrite ubhe ||57 vāstu tadbhinnadehākhyaṃ bhinnasvāmividhāyakam| na tatra jāyate vṛddhiḥ sthāpitasya na kasyacit ||58 gṛhakukṣau kṛtaṃ dvāraṃ sarvarogabhayaṅkaram| pūrvadvāraṃ tu māhendraṃ praśastaṃ sarvakāmadam ||59 gṛhakṣataṃ tu vihitaṃ dakṣiṇena śubhāvaham| gandharvamathavā tatra kartavyaṃ śreyase tadā ||60 paścamena praśastaṃ syātpuṣpadantaṃ jayāvaham| bhallāṭamuttare dvāraṃ praśastaṃ syādgṛheśituḥ ||61 ekāśītipade tasmiṃścaturaśrapade'pi vā| dvāro'pyadagāstāsāṃ brūmo vahnyāditaḥ phalam ||62 hutāśabhītiḥ strījanma bhūtyarthaḥ priyatā nṛpe| krodhe cānṛtatā puṃsaḥ krauryaṃ syātpūrvavatkramāt ||63 sutāpi praiṣyanīcatve bhakṣayānasutarddhikṛt| raudraṃ kṛtaghnamavasaṃ yāmyataḥ sutavīryahṛt ||64 sutopapīḍā ripuvṛddhirarthasutānavāptistanayārthasampat| svāptirnṛśaṃsādbhayamarthanāśa uktaḥ kramādityaparonmukheṣu ||65 bandhavyasatve ripuvṛddhirarthasutāptiragryā guṇasampadaśca| sutārthalabdhirdviṣayātmajena doṣāstriyā nairṛtadiṅmukheṣu ||66 guṇāśca doṣāścayathāvadete nirūpitā dvārasamāśritā ye| tāñśilpavicchāstravidāṃ variṣṭho vijñāya pūjyatvamupaiti loke ||67 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre dvāraguṇadoṣo nāma ekonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <40> atha pīṭhamānaṃ nāma catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| devānāṃ manujānāṃ ca pīṭhamānamathocyate| pīṭhaṃ kanīyo bhāgaṃ ca sārdhabhāgaṃ tu madhyamam ||1 dvibhāgamuttamaṃ tat syāḍeṣā pīṭhasamucchritiḥ| maheśvarasya viṣṇośca brahmaṇaścottamaṃ bhavet ||2 itareṣāṃ ca devānāṃ kartavyaṃ tanna dhīmatā| īśvarasya yathākāmaṃ pīṭhaṃ kāryaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||3 yasminsthāne vidhātavyo brahmā viṣṇustathaiva ca| īśvaraḥ sarvataḥ kāryo na doṣastatra vidyate ||4 itareṣāṃ tu devānāṃ pīṭhaṃ bhāgaṃ samucchritam| yasya yena vibhāgena vāstumānaṃ vidhīyate ||5 tasya tenaiva bhāgena pīṭhocchrāyo vidhīyate| manujānāṃ ca pīṭhāni veśmanāṃ devapīṭhakaiḥ ||6 tulyāni kuryādupari kṛtā vṛddhikarāḥ surāḥ| puramadhye tu kartavyaṃ brahmaṇo gṛhamuttamam ||7 caturmukhaṃ ca tatkāryaṃ yathā paśyati tatpuram| adhikaṃ sarvaveśmabhyastathā rājagṛhādapi ||8 rājaveśmādhikamapi śasyate'nyasurālayāt| pañcamo lokapālanāṃ rājā śreṣṭhatamo yataḥ ||9 evametāni devānāṃ pīṭhānyuktānyaśeṣataḥ| cāturvarṇyasya pīṭhāni brūmo viprādyanukramāt ||10 ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulotsedhaṃ pīṭhaṃ viprasya śasyate| itareṣāṃ tu varṇānāṃ hrasvaṃ syāccaturaṅgulam ||11 cāturvarṇyasya pīṭhāni bhuṅkte vipro gṛhāṇi ca| trayāṇāṃ kṣatriyo vaiśyo dvayoḥ śūdraḥ kramātsvakam ||12 evaṃ vibhāgaṃ pīṭhānāṃ sthapatiḥ parikalpayet| hitaṃ kārayiturvāñchan nṛpateśca samṛddhaye ||13 pramāṇe sthāpitā devāḥ pūjārhāśca bhavanti hi| pramāṇaṃ pīṭhānāmidamabhihitaṃ brahmamuraji-| tpurārīṇāmatrāparadiviṣadāṃ yacca niyatam || tato viprādīnāmapi nigaditaṃ yattadakhilaṃ| yathaucityāyojyaṃ śriyamabhilaṣadbhiḥ sthapatibhiḥ ||14 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre pīṭhamānaṃ nāma catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <41> atha cayavidhirnāmaikacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| idānīmabhidhīyante cayasyeha guṇāguṇāḥ| suvibhaktaḥ samaścāruścaturaśraścayaḥ śubhaḥ ||1 asaṃbhrāntamasandigdhamavināśyanyabarhitam| anuttamamanudvṛttamakubjaṃ na ca pīḍitam ||2 samānakhaṇḍamṛjvantamantaraṅgaṃ tathaiva ca| supārśvaṃ sandhisuśliṣṭaṃ supratiṣṭhaṃ susandhi ca ||3 ajihmaṃ ceti ceyasya guṇā viṃśatirityamī| eteṣāṃ vaiparītyena doṣāṇāmapi viṃśatiḥ ||4 dakṣiṇāṃ tu yadā kuḍyaṃ vicinoti bahirmukham| tadā vyādhibhayaṃ vidyānmṛtyudaṇḍaṃ ca nirdiśet ||5 paścimaṃ tu yadā kuḍyaṃ vicinvanti bahirmukham| dhanahāniṃ tadā vidyāddasyubhyaśca bhayaṃ bhavet ||6 uttaraṃ tu yadā kuḍyaṃ vicinoti bahirmukham| kartāraṃ svāminaṃ vāpi vyasanaṃ prāpayettadā ||7 prācyaṃ bahirmukhaṃ kuḍyaṃ cinoti sthapatiryadā| rājadaṇḍabhayaṃ tatra nirdeṣṭavyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||8 etadeva phalaṃ brūyātpatite dalite tathā| yasya prāgdakṣiṇaḥ karṇaḥ pravarteta bahirmukhaḥ ||9 syāttatrāgnibhayaṃ ghoraṃ gṛhabhartuśca saṃśayaḥ| gacchedbahirmukhaḥ karṇo yadā dakṣiṇapaścimaḥ ||10 kalahopadra vastatra syādbhāryāyāśca saṃśayaḥ| paścimottarakarṇe tu samprayāte bahirmukhe ||11 paśuvāhanaputrāṇāṃ saṃśayastatra jāyate| prāguttaro yadā karṇaḥ pracīyeta bahirmukhaḥ ||12 gurūṇāṃ saṃśayastatra govṛṣādeśca jāyate| viśālaṃ yadi jāyeta sarvabāhuṣu cinvataḥ ||13 karṇikāsamasaṃsthānaṃ tadbhavenmallikākṛti| na tādṛśo bhavedāyastatra yādṛgvyayo bhavet ||14 cayasya tasya doṣeṇa gṛhakṣīṇaḥ palāyate| cinvato yadi saṃkṣiptamatyarthaṃ tatra jāyate ||15 brahmasaṃjñaṃ taduddiṣṭaṃ tatra rājabhayaṃ bhavet| vistṛtaṃ yadi bāhyeṣu saṃkṣiptaṃ caiva madhyataḥ ||16 tanumadhyaṃ taduddiṣṭaṃ tatra vidyātkṣudho bhayam| ucchritaṃ yadi karṇeṣu parihīṇaṃ ca madhyataḥ ||17 nirṇataṃ nāma tadvidyāttatra caurabhayaṃ bhavet| karṇeṣu parihīṇaṃ ceducchritaṃ cāpi madhyataḥ ||18 kūrmonnatamiti jñeyaṃ sarvadoṣabhayāvaham| viṣamonnatakarṇeṣu nirdiśed dra viṇakṣayam ||19 prājyānnapānaṃ tadvidyātsameṣu vihiteṣu ca| ityete cīyamānasya guṇadoṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||20 tasmātsarvaprayatnena cayakarma prayojayet| udakena samaṃ nītvā samyaṅniścayakāraṇam ||21 tatrā dṛte na cānyat syānniścayārthaṃ cayasya ca| tasmājjalena valayaṃ gṛhṇīyātpūrvamādṛtaḥ ||22 tataḥ sutāḍite sūtre cayaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ| dviguṇāṃ kṣetramānasya rajjuṃ kṛtvā tadantayoḥ ||23 yo'sau kāryau tatastasyāṃ pādonakṣetramānataḥ| dadyānniñchinaṃ kīlau kṣetragarbhāntagāminau ||24 nidhāyāyāḥ sakau tasyāḥ prāntasthau yojayettayoḥ| nirañchanābhikṛṣṭāyāṃ pādonakṣetrasaṃmitam ||25 bhujagatyā bhavedra jjustasyāmiṣṭānumānataḥ| cihnaṃ dadyātsa karṇaḥ syādevaṃ doṣānprasādhayet ||26 bhūri nācchādanaṃ dadyānna bhindyāttatra ceṣṭakāḥ| viṣamasthāḥ kuṭhāreṇa cchittvā tāḥ kalpayetsamāḥ ||27 yathā na ca spṛśetsūtraṃ vicinvīta tathā budhaḥ| kuḍye ca sādimadhyānte dṛṣṭimekāṃ nipātayet ||28 yadā sarvaparikrāntaṃ talaṃ codghāṭitaṃ bhavet| tadā naikatra kurvīta paryāyeṇa vicakṣaṇaḥ ||29 udghāṭanaṃ starāṇāṃ tu yadīcchetsiddhimātmanaḥ| tatra tatra cayaṃ kuryādyadi saṃviddhakaṃ hitam ||30 durvahaṃ hi bhavettena tasmāttatparivarjayet| upariṣṭātsamaṃ pārśve bhujaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ ||31 samantādrucakacchinnaścayo bhittiṣu pūjitaḥ| tasmātprayatnaḥ kartavyaścayakarmaṇi nityaśaḥ ||32 iti bhāṣitarūpitamācarataścayakarma yathāvidhi śilpikṛtam| bhavatīha yaśo bhuvane vitataṃ gṛhabhartṛrapi pracuro vibhavaḥ ||33 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre cayavidhirnāmaikacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <42> atha śāntikarmavidhirnāma dvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| idānīmabhidhāsyāmo vidhānaṃ śāntikarmaṇaḥ| yathāvadiṣṭvā dikpālān hutvā śāntīryathākramam ||1 snapayetkarṇikāṃ kumbhaiḥ sahiraṇyairvicakṣaṇaḥ| sarvagandhānuliptāṃ ca mālyadāmavibhūṣitām ||2 kṛtamālyānivasitāṃ mūle ca madhulepitām| doṣapraśamanārthāya tāṃ mūleṣu nikhātayet ||3 madhukumbhamariṣṭaṃ ca śevālaṃ ca vidhānavit| vācayitvā tu viprendrā n kṛtapuṇyāhamaṅgalān ||4 sthāpayet karṇikāḥ sarvāḥ sthapatiḥ prayataḥ śuciḥ| etena vidhinā karma cāturvarṇyasya kārayet ||5 karṇikā ropitā yatra punarutpāṭya ropyate| na tanniṣpadyate veśma svāmī cātra vinaśyati ||6 nikhātaṃ tu yadā dāru cchidyate tāḍyate punaḥ| tannāśo dhanadhānyasya svāminaścātra sarvathā ||7 vallīnipīḍitaṃ dāru praveśe cennikhanyate| āśīviṣabhayaṃ ghoraṃ tasminnutpātalakṣaṇam ||8 utthāne karṇikā rakṣyā sarvasattvābhidharṣaṇāt| nave karmaṇyaśakunā mṛgavyālasarīsṛpāḥ ||9 karṇikāmadhirohanti doṣāṃstatra vadedamūn| kṛtāpīḍāṃ parihṛtāṃ yadyārohanti vāyasāḥ ||10 gṛhiṇastatpravāsaḥ syādannaṃ pānaṃ ca hīyate| mayūre tadgṛhaṃ rājā haretpañcābdataḥ param ||11 varāṅge jāyate vyādhiḥ kokilairdvyabdataḥ param| kākolaistrīṇi varṣāṇi jāyate sumahadbhayam ||12 śuke syuḥ kalahādyāni na ca niṣpadyate gṛham| kukkuṭe'gnibhayaṃ vidyādrā jato vā mahadbhayam ||13 sārikāyāṃ tu dauḥśīlyaṃ strīṇāṃ gṛhapatestathā| sarparūpeta vighnena gṛhaṃ niṣṭhāṃ na gacchati ||14 strīpuṃsayoḥ kuliṅge tu jāyate pāpakāritā| pārāvate tu jāyete strīpuṃsau gurutalpagau ||15 viḍāle tu kulaṃ dāsaiḥ saha rogairnipīḍyate| jvalano vā jalaṃ vāpi hastī vā hanti tadgṛham ||16 āraṇyaiḥ śakunairetatsyādvarṣāddharṣaṇe phalam| yūnāṃ ca jāyate mṛtyurmadhvāsaṅge dhanakṣayaḥ ||17 duḥkhapnadarśanaṃ ghūke bālānāṃ maraṇaṃ tathā| trastabhīte nilīne tu rājā śūnyaṃ haredgṛham ||18 yadā tvagre pradṛśyeta dhūmraḥ karṇagato'pi vā| agnirdahati tatkṣipraṃ vidyudvā hanti mandiram ||19 yatrārohati gṛdhrastaddvijāṅghrispṛṣṭamācaret| kṛtvā halaśataiḥ kṛṣṭaṃ tato bījāni vāpayet ||20 gāvaścātra praduhyerañśāntikāni ca kārayet| meghe'bhivṛṣṭe bhūyo'pi tatra kurvīt mandiram ||21 yeṣu yeṣu gṛhāṅgeṣu madhunaḥ sañcayo bhavet| tasyāṅgasya vadhaṃ brūyātpreṣiṇyāṃ cāpyupadra vam ||22 tasmāddhetoḥ śikhāgreṣu mukuṭān praṇidhāpayet| yāvanna ropayetsaumyaṃ tāvadra kṣetsamantataḥ ||23 abhilīnaṃ tu śakunairnahi kiñcitpraśasyate| tasmātprayatnato rakṣedutpātātprāgudīritāt ||24 bhaṅge gṛhāṇāṃ dārūṇāṃ śāntihomo'tha kathyate| indra kīlo mahākūṭaḥ pṛṣṭhavaṃśottarau dharau ||25 pragraho'lindapādau vā svāminaṃ ghnantyupadra vāḥ| tulāsthapatyaḥ kūṭaṃ vā vedikā karṇapālikā ||26 netraṃ kapotapāliśca hanapraviṣṭaṃ kuṭumbinī| amvagrāḥ pakṣivaṃśāśca mallakāḥ sakumārakāḥ ||27 gopānasyo mṛgālyaśca sthapitāḥ svakumārikāḥ| parighā dvārapakṣāśca bhrātaraṃ ghnantyupadra vāḥ ||28 saṃyuktaṃ saṅgraho hanti nikṛṣṭāṃścādharo dharaḥ| sthauṇyāni pratimoko vā hanyuriṣṭān paricchadān ||29 udadhirbhaginīṃ hanyādathavā paricārakān| puṃsāṃ punnāmabhirdra vyaiḥ strīṇāṃ strīnabhirbhavet ||30 upaghāto hatairnityaṃ dra vyāṇāṃ tu napuṃsakaiḥ| bhūlikā strīvināśāya gṛhanāśāya vedhanam ||31 kīlā vā sandhipālirvā mitranāśāya duṣyati| nave gṛhe navaṃ dāru kriyamāṇamatho kṛtam ||32 āyojyamānaṃ yuktaṃ vā nyūnasaṃvatsaraṃ sthitam| bhajyate dehanāśāya sphuṭatyatha vibhajyate ||33 gṛhaṃ brāhmaṇasātkṛtvā ratnairālikhya cāparam| navairvastraiḥ paricchādya punarbhidyāni kārayet ||34 dagdhe bhinne pracalite vinate vidyutā hate| virūḍhe dalite sanne sarvatrauṣadhibhiḥ smṛtāḥ ||35 śāntayo vividhaṃ hutvā brāhmaṇānsvasti vācya vā| sthūṇikā bhajyate yasya kīrttistasyopahanyate ||36 candra sūryau yajettatra tataḥ śāmyati pātakam| tadvidhaṃ vṛkṣamānīya punastāṃ prati kārayet ||37 evaṃ kṛte sukhī sa syātkīrttiścāyurdhruvā bhavet| mallako bhajyate yasya pauruṣaṃ tasya hanyate ||38 iṣṭānabhasanakṣatraṃ prāyaścittaṃ samācaret| tadvidhaṃ vṛkṣāmānīya prati kurvīta mallakam ||39 evaṃ kṛtvā sukhī sa syādbalaṃ cāsyābhivardhate| pṛṣṭhavaṃśasya bhaṅgena gṛhī bandhamavāpnuyāt ||40 rājarājaṃ yajettatra prāyaścittaṃ tathācaret| sukhī bhavati tatkṛtvā sarvataścābhivardhate ||41 sarveṣu svasti vācyāśca brāhmaṇā dakṣiṇākṣataiḥ| vāraṇo bhajyate yastu jyeṣṭhaṃ putraṃ sa vājyate ||42 pṛthvīdharaṃ yajettatra prāyaścittaṃ tathācaret| tadvidhaṃ vṛkṣamānīya punastaṃ prati kārayet ||43 sukhī bhavati kṛtvaivaṃ putraiścāpi vivardhate| saṃgraho bhajyate yastu kulajyeṣṭhaṃ sa vārdhate ||44 pitṝndevānyajettatra prāyaścittaṃ tathācaret| sukhī bhavati kṛtvaivaṃ prīyante pitarastathā ||45 sthūṇyaṃ tu bhajyate yasya tanayastasya bādhyate| devāneva yajettatra prāyaścittaṃ tathācaret ||46 tadvidhaṃ vṛkṣamānīya tatsthauṇyaṃ prati kārayet| sukhī bhavati kṛtvaivaṃ putraiścāpi vivardhane ||47 upadhī vyathate yatra tatrāmātyo vinaśyati| yajeta vāsavaṃ tatra prāyaścittaṃ tathācaret ||48 ānīya tadvidhaṃ vṛkṣamupadhiṃ prati kārayet| evaṃ kṛte bhavetsaukhyamamātyaiśca vivardhate ||49 kāyastu vyathate yasya preṣyastasyopahanyate| yakṣaṃ tatra yajeddevaṃ prāyaścittaṃ tathācaret ||50 tadvidhaṃ kāṣṭhamānīya kāyaṃ taṃ prati kārayet| evaṃ kṛte sukhī sa syātpreṣyairapi vivardhate ||51 tulā tu vyathate yasya vyathate'sya kuṭumbinī| yajeta medinīṃ tatra prāyaścittaṃ tathācaret ||52 tadvidhaṃ vṛkṣamānīya sthāpayet tāṃ svalaṅkṛtām| tatastvanyāḥ kriyāḥ paśyan kārayenmatimānnaraḥ ||53 vadhūmiva navairvastraiḥ praticchādya svalaṅkṛtām| brāhmaṇānvācayetsvasti tatastāṃ prati kārayet ||54 sukhī bhavati kṛtvaivaṃ dhanairnityaṃ vivardhate| karṇikāsvāntarasthūṇāmālāpādo'tha bhajyate ||55 tadgṛhī duḥkhamāpnoti tasminnutpātalakṣaṇe| ānīya sthapatiṃ tatra prajñāvantaṃ bahuśrutam ||56 tatra vāstuvibhāgena yo devaḥ syādviniścitaḥ| tasmai devāya juhuyātprāyaścittaṃ ca kārayet ||57 sukhī bhavati kṛtvaivaṃ sarvataścābhivardhate| yugaṃ tu vyathate yatra tatra syātpaśupīḍanam ||58 yajeta tasminnīśānaṃ prāyaścittaṃ ca kārayet| tadvidhaṃ vṛkṣamānīya yugaṃ tatprati kārayet ||59 evaṃ kṛte sukhaṃ tasya paśuvṛddhiśca jāyate| tulayo agayorvāpi pādo yasya prabhajyate ||60 āyurhānirbhavettatra baladevaṃ prapūjayet| prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā punastaṃ prati kārayet ||61 sukhī bhavati kṛtvaivaṃ kuṭumbī śāntikaṃ ca tat| dvārāṅgaṃ yasya māhendraṃ hiṃsyate navakarmaṇi ||62 indraṃ tatra yajeddevaṃ prāyaścittaṃ tathācaret| gṛhakṣatasya dvārāṅge pūjayedyamameva tat ||63 puṣpadantasya dvārāṅge varuṇaṃ tatra pūjayet| dvārāṅgaṃ yasya bhallāṭaṃ hiṃsyate navakarmaṇi ||64 somaṃ tatra yajeddevaṃ prāyaścittaṃ samācaret| sukhī bhavati kṛtvaivaṃ kuṭumbī śāntikaṃ ca tat ||65 sthūṇārājasya yasyāgraṃ vakraṃ dakṣiṇato bhavet| śarīraṃ vyathate tatra pratisaṃvatsaraṃ sthiram ||66 pṛṣṭhato dīrghaśokaḥ syāduttareṇa dhanakṣayaḥ| pūrvato rājadaṇḍaḥ syāttasmāttad ṛju śasyate ||67 catvāryaṅga hiṃsyante śarīrā ye ca veśmanaḥ| tulā vā pṛṣṭhavaṃśo vā dhāraṇyāṃ cottarāmbaraḥ ||68 uktāṃstatra balīnkuryātprāyaścittaṃ tathācaret| evaṃ dhanyaṃ śivaṃ puṣṭiprajāvṛddhikaraṃ bhavet ||69 itthaṃ nimittāni gṛhāśritāni| jñātvā pradṛṣṭāñśakunāṃśca sarvān| śāntiṃ prakurvanpṛthaguktarūpāṃ| prāpnoti kīrttiṃ sukhamarthamāyuḥ ||70 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre śāntikarmavidhirnāma dvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <43> atha dvārabhaṅgaphalaṃ nāma tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| yadatra navakarmoktaṃ tadyajñeṣu gṛheṣu ca| jñeyaṃ grāme pure vāpi nagare pattane tathā ||1 saṃsthānamākṛtirmānaṃ hrāsavṛddhī ca bāhuṣu| ekameva vijānīyātsarvatraiva vicakṣāṇaḥ ||2 yūpasyaiva nimittāni dārukarmaṇi nirdiśet| pātaṃ pate vijānīyāttakṣaṇaṃ takṣaṇena ca ||3 yūpocchrāyamiva brūyāddārūṇāmapi cocchrayam| bhaṅgena bhaṅgo nirdiśyaḥ samādhiśca samādhinā ||4 navakarmaṇi yatsnigdhaṃ sugandhi priyadarśanam| gamyeharaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ dhanyaṃ tadabhinirdiśet ||5 puraṃ vā yadi vā grāmo gṛhaṃ vā yadi niṣprabham| āyāsabahulaṃ taddhi tādṛśairlakṣaṇairbhavet ||6 paridhvastopamaṃ rūkṣaṃ navakarmaṇi yad bhavet| bhramaṃ rogaṃ ca śokaṃ ca tasmin veśmani nirdiśet ||7 janena ca yadākīrṇaṃ niśchāyamiva lakṣate| kuṭumbī tatra ṣaṇmāsānnātra jīvenna saṃśayaḥ ||8 yacchūnyamapyaśūnyābhaṃ veśma vā yadi vā puram| sarvakāmaguṇairyuktaṃ dhanaṃ tadabhinirdiśet ||9 pūrvo nagarabhāgaścedra myaḥ syāt priyadarśanaḥ| priyabhāryā manaḥsvāsthyaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ ca bhūpateḥ ||10 pūrvadakṣiṇabhāgaścetpurasya priyadarśanaḥ| mahad yaśastadāpnoti rājā hema ca puṣkalam ||11 purasya dakṣiṇo bhāgo yadā ramyastadā bhavet| rājñaḥ senāpatiprāptirdhanaṃ dhānyaṃ ca puṣkalam ||12 ramaṇīyo yadā bhāgaḥ puradakṣiṇapaścimaḥ| arthasaṃpattadā rājñaḥ prajāvṛddhiśca jāyate ||13 purapaścimabhāgena ramaṇīyena pārthivaḥ| putrabāndhavadhānyāḍhyaḥ saṃprāpnotyunnatiṃ parām ||14 paścimottarabhāge tu ramaṇīye narādhipaḥ| preṣyaiḥ putrairvāhanaiśca vṛddhimetyuttarottarām ||15 uttare ramaṇīye tu purabhāge nareśvaraḥ| śatrūn vijayate sarvān vardhate ca purohitaḥ ||16 yadi pūrvottaro bhāgaḥ purasya priyadarśanaḥ| yatrābhyuttaramānandaṃ kṣipraṃ rājño vinirdiśet ||17 niṣpannasya purāderyo bhāgo na syānmanoramaḥ| tasya tasyaiva bhāgasya parihāṇiṃ vinirdiśet ||18 nave yadi puradvāre kapāṭaṃ praviśīryate| strīnāmadheyamanyadvā strīnāśaṃ tadvinirdiśet ||19 devāgāre puradvāre prākārāṭṭālakeṣu ca| hastiśālāśvaśālāsu rathaśālāstathāpi vā ||20 koṣṭhāgārāyudhāgāre nimittaṃ tu śubhāśubham| yadi kiñcitpradṛśyeta rājñastadabhinirdiśet ||21 bhaṅgo yatrordhvavaṃśasya tatra rājā vinaśyati| argalāpīlikākuñcībhaṅge ca navakarmaṇi ||22 grāme naśyanti caitāni tadā grāmo vinaśyati| dvigutthitaṃ tu rāṣṭrāṇāṃ gṛhārtheṣu kuṭumbinām ||23 navakarmaṇi yatkiñcidbhajyate yadi vā namet| viste vā sphuṭe vāpi kuṭumbimaraṇaṃ dhruvam ||24 phalaṃ sarvanimitteṣu śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham| saṃvatsaraṃ paraṃ grāhyaṃ navakarmakṛte gṛhe ||25 parisaṃvatsarānte ca purāṇamiti nirdiśet| tumbikā bhajyate yatra navakarmaṇi niṣṭite ||26 śreṣṭhā tu mahilā tatra ṣaḍbhirmāsairvinaśyati| evameva navaṃ yasya sadanaṃ tu vinaśyati ||27 preṣyadāsādiviśvāsāttadvināśayati dhruvam| pṛṣṭhavaṃśo navo yasya navakarmaṇi bhidyate ||28 kuṭumbī mriyate tatra gṛhaṃ saṃvatsarātparam| preṣyāścātra vinaśyanti dīryamāṇe viśeṣataḥ ||29 lumāsu bhidyamānāsu kanyāmaraṇamādiśet| muṇḍakeṣu vinaṣṭeṣu suhṛdasya vinaśyati ||30 anupūrveṣu bhinneṣu putrāṇāṃ maraṇaṃ dhruvam| vipattau muṇḍagodhānāṃ mātā tasya vinaśyati ||31 nāgapāśakabhaṅge tu bhṛtyānāṃ maraṇaṃ bhavet| kapāṭe bhrātṛmaraṇamargalāyāṃ striyā vadhaḥ ||32 sutasya cārgalāpārśve vinaṣṭe maraṇaṃ bhavet| dvārabandhe vinaṣṭe tu śīghraṃ kuryātkulakṣayam ||33 indra kīlo dṛḍho yasya bhaṅgamāyāti mūlataḥ| saputrapaśuvargasya tasya brūyātkulakṣatim ||34 toraṇaṃ bhajyate yasya dra vyaṃ tasya vinaśyati| gṛhabhartuśca maraṇaṃ tridaśairavadhārayet ||35 vāstumadhye vinaṣṭe tu kuvṛddho vinaśyati| sopānaṃ bhidyate yatra navakarmaṇi niṣṭhite ||36 tasya preṣyāśca gāvaśca hiraṇyaṃ ca vinaśyati| vedikā bhajyate yasya bhāryā tasya vinaśyati ||37 gavākṣastu vinaśyeta paṭṭastambho'pi vā dṛḍhaḥ| gajaśuṇḍātha bhinno'śvaḥ kapotālyathavā navā ||38 sthapanīpaṭṭikāścaiva strīvināśaṃ tadādiśet| viṭaṅkasya tulāyā vā bhaṅge jāte kathañcana ||39 śālāstambhasya vā nāśe bhāryā tasya vinaśyati| stambhaśīrṣaṃ yadi bhraśyet sphuṭetstambho'pi vā dṛḍhaḥ ||40 bhajyate pratimoko vā svāminastu vadho bhavet| bhaṅge tu bhaṅgavāhinyāḥ kulavṛddhavadho bhavet ||41 ākāśatalake putrāḥ praticchinne kuṭumbinaḥ| vinaṣṭe ca vinaśyanti ṣaḍbhirmāsairna saṃśayaḥ ||42 prāsādamaṇḍale bhagne bhagnāsu valabhīṣu ca| bhāryā kuṭumbinastasya nāśamāyātyasaṃśayaḥ ||43 pralīno vā vilīno vā prāsādo yasya bhajyate| pralīne bhṛtyamṛtyuḥ syādvilīne tu dhanakṣayaḥ ||44 miśre vinaṣṭe prāsāde hīyante sarvavṛddhayaḥ| maraṇaṃ vā bhavettatra kuṣṭhavyādhiṃ ca nirdiśet ||45 yeṣu sthāneṣu bhaṅgo vā vinatirvā prakīrtitā| upadrutirvighāto vā teṣāṃ phalamapīritam ||46 snigdhāni aydi dṛśyante tāni dārḍhyānvitāni ca| dhanamāyuśca harṣaṃ ca pūrvoktānāṃ tadādiśet ||47 karṇikābhyantarī sthūṇā śālāpādo'tha hīyate| yadi tadduḥkhamāpnoti gṛhabhartā na saṃśayaḥ ||48 saṃpradhārya ca medhāvī balābalamatandri taḥ| nirdiśan balamāpnoti dhanamāyuryaśastathā ||49 evamādikanimittasūcitaṃ saṃpradhārya matimān balābalam| spaṣṭamādiśati yo'tra śāstravitkīrttivittadhanāni so'śnute| iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre dvārabhaṅgaphalaṃ nāma tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <44> atha sthapatilakṣaṇaṃ nāma catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| sthāpatyamucyate'smābhiridānīṃ prakramāgatam| jñātena yena jñāyante sthapatīnāṃ guṇāguṇāḥ ||1 śāstraṃ karma tathā prajñā śīlaṃ ca kriyayānvitam| lakṣyalakṣaṇayuktārthaśāstraniṣṭho naro bhavet ||2 sāmudraṃ gaṇitaṃ caiva jyotiṣaṃ chanda eva ca| sirājñānaṃ tathā śilpaṃ yantrakarmavidhistathā ||3 etānyaṅgāni jānīyādvāstuśāstrasya buddhimān| śāsrānusāreṇābhyudya lakṣaṇāni ca lakṣayet ||4 prasiddhaśāstradṛṣṭāntairvāstujñānaṃ prasādhayet| vāstunaḥ sasirāvaṃśairmarmavedhaiḥ suniścitaiḥ ||5 vāstudvārakṣaṇān bhūyaḥ sarvān jānāti śāstrataḥ| yastu śāstramavijñāya prayoktā sthapatirbhavet ||6 hantavyaḥ sa svayaṃ rājñā mṛtyuvadrā jahiṃsakaḥ| mithyājñānādahaṅkārī śāstre caivākṛtaśramaḥ ||7 akālamṛtyurlokasya vicaredvasudhātale| yastu kevalaśāstrajñaḥ karmasvapariniṣṭhitaḥ ||8 sa muhyati kriyākāle dṛṣṭvā bhīrurivāhavam| kevalaṃ karma yo vetti śāstrārthaṃ nādhigacchati ||9 so'cakṣuriva nīyeta vivaśo'nyena vartmasu| karma vāstuvidheḥ sthānaṃ mānamunmānameva ca ||10 kṣetrajāti ca karmāṇi lumālekhācaturdaśa| catvāro gaṇḍikācchedānvṛttacchedeṣu saptasu ||11 suśliṣṭaṃ sandhisandhānairadharottarasaṃyutam| bāhyarekhānvitaṃ śuddhaṃ yo jānāti sa karmavit ||12 śāstrakarmasamartho'pi sthapatiḥ prajñayā vinā| phaleyuḥ karmabhiranyābhiḥ syānnirmada iva dvipaḥ ||13 pratyutpannamatiryaḥ syādvāhataḥ sthapatistathā| karmakāle na muhyetsa prajñānenopabṛṃhitaḥ ||14 aprajñeyaṃ durālokaṃ gūḍhārthaṃ bahuvistaram| prajñāpotaṃ samāruhya prājño vāstuniraṃ taret ||15 jñānavāṃśca tathā vāgmī karmasvapi ca niṣṭhitaḥ| evaṃ yukto'pi na śreyān yadi śīlavivarjitaḥ ||16 roṣād dveṣāttathā lobhānmohādrā gāttathaiva ca| anyacintyatvamāyāti duḥśīlānāmavikṣayāt ||17 śīlavān pūjito loke śīlavān sādhusammataḥ| śīlavān sarvakarmārhaḥ śīlavān priyadarśanaḥ ||18 śīlādhāne paraṃ yatnamādhitiṣṭhetsthapatiḥ sadā| tataḥ karmāṇi sidhyanti janayanti śubhāni ca ||19 tathācāṣṭavidhaṃ karma jñeyaṃ sthapatinā sadā| ālekhyaṃ lekhyajātaṃ ca dārukarma cayastathā ||20 pāṣāṇasiddhahemnāṃ ca śilpaṃ karma tathaiva ca| ebhirguṇaiḥ samāyuktaḥ sthapatiryāti pūjyatām ||21 sthāpatyamaṅgairidamaṣṭabhiryaścaturvidhaṃ vetti viśuddhabuddhiḥ| sa śilpināṃ saṃsadi labdhapūjaḥ parāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ labhate cirāyuḥ ||22 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre sthapati lakṣaṇaṃ nāma catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <45> aṣṭaṅgalakṣaṇaṃ nāma pañcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| proktaṃ caturdhā sthāpatyaṃ vāstutattvasya siddhaye| brūmastadeva cedānīmaṅgaiḥ saṃyuktamaṣṭabhiḥ ||1 teṣvaṅgaṃ prathamaṃ proktaṃ vāstupuṃso vikalpanā| purasya viniveśastu dvitīyaṃ dvārakarma ca ||2 rathyāvibhāgaḥ prākāraniveśo'ṭṭālakasya ca| viniveśaḥ pratolīnāṃ vibhāgasthānakāni ca ||3 prāsādaśca tṛtīyaṃ syāccaturthaṃ tu dhvajocchritiḥ| pañcamaṃ nṛpaterveśma sthānāntaravibhakti ca ||4 cāturvarṇyavibhāgaśca gṛhabhāgaśca ṣaṣṭhakam| saptamaṃ yajamānasya śālāyāṃ mānamīritam ||5 yajñavedīpramāṇaṃ ca koṭihomavidhistathā| aṣṭamaṃ rājaśibiraniveśo durgakarma ca ||6 yo vettyaṅgānyamūnyaṣṭau so'tra sthapatisattamaḥ| yaśo mānaṃ sa labhate pūjyate ca narādhipaiḥ ||7 aśāstrajñamakarmajaṃ sthapatiṃ yaḥ prayojayet| na tasya vāstu sidhyeta siddhamapyasukhāvaham ||8 tasmātkarma ca śāstraṃ ca yo vetti dvitayaṃ naraḥ| aṣṭāṅgamapi yo vetti sa rājñaḥ sthapatirbhavet ||9 aṅgāni pūrvamuktāni vāstuśāstroktavistarāt| teṣu prāsādikaṃ yattadvakṣyāmo'gre savistaram ||10 athāṅgaṃ saptamaṃ brūmo yattadyajñeṣu yujyate| viniviṣṭhe pure pūrvaṃ kḷpteṣu suradhāmasu ||11 diśi dakṣiṇapūrvasyāṃ yajñārthaṃ māpayedbhuvam| niveśaṃ tatra kurvīta caturaśraṃ samantataḥ ||12 āyāmena vidhātavyo hastāṣṭādaśavistṛtaḥ | pūrvadvāraṃ vidhātavyamādityasya pade budhaiḥ ||13 tasya paścimabhāge tu yajamānakuṭī bhavet| ṣoḍaśāyāmavistārā prāṅmukhī sā praśasyate ||14 yajamānakuṭīdvāre devatā yā ca kīrtitā| tataḥ prabhṛti pūrveṇa prāgvaṃśaṃ parikalpayet ||15 vedimadhye sthitaṃ tatsyānmānaṃ vedyāśca śasyate| pūrvāpareṇa ṣaṭtriṃśatkartavyāḥ prakramā budhaiḥ ||16 ekatriṃśatkuṭībhāge madhye'ṣṭādaśa kalpayet| prakramāḥ syuḥ śirasthāne viṃśatiścaturuttarā ||17 puruṣasya śirastatra prāgvaṃśe tu pratiṣṭhitam| tasmātpūrvottaraṃ jñeyaṃ sarvayajñeṣu pūjitam ||18 vedyantaraṃ tu kartavyaṃ śakaṭaṃ yena gacchati| tasmāduttaravedī yā kāryā pratyuttareṇa tu ||19 dvihastāyāmavistāro homaceṣṭaḥ kṛto'tra hi| prāgdakṣiṇena saṃsthānaṃ yajamānasya śasyate ||20 kaṭimātraṃ sadā kāryaṃ nābhimātramathāpi vā| tato'dhikena durbhikṣamanāvṛṣṭiśca jāyate ||21 eṣā yajñakriyā proktā koṭihomo'tha vakṣyate| purasyābhyantare bhāge hutāśasya pade tathā ||22 tasminsthāne vidhātavyaḥ koṭihomaḥ sadā pure| lakṣahomaśca kartavyo nityo naimittiko'pi vā ||23 atha bhūmivaśātsthānaṃ kadācinnaiva labhyate| sarvato brahmaṇaḥ sthānāddhomasthānaṃ niveśayet ||24 aiśānīṃ diśamāśritya brāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ| puraścaraṇatattvajñaiḥ ṣaṭkarmanirataiḥ sadā ||25 nityaṃ śāntiparairviprai rājā tu vijayī bhavet| nopasargāstu jāyante na ca lakṣmīḥ puraṃ tyajet ||26 anāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ nāsti subhikṣaṃ jāyate sadā| uktaṃ yājñikamaṅgaṃ tu sarvāṅgebhyaḥ praśasyate ||27 sarvaṃ sthapatinā jñeyaṃ tattvajñairbrāhmaṇaiḥ saha| ekāśītipadenaiva yajñabhūmiṃ tu māpayet ||28 niveśaṃ śibirasyātha kathayāmo'ṅgamaṣṭamam| yadā tu nṛpatiḥ sthānātsvādyātrābhimukho bhavet ||29 śibirasya niveśaṃ ca tattvavettā parīkṣayet| arthaśāstravidhijño vā sthapatirvā prakalpayet ||30 śibiraṃ caturaśraṃ syādvṛttaṃ vṛttāyataṃ kvacit| caturaśrāyataṃ vāpi viṣamaṃ vā kvacidbhavet ||31 bhūmibhāgavaśātkalpaṃ mahārathyobhayānvitam| śibirasya tu catvāri kuryāddvārāṇi yatnataḥ ||32 rathyā sārdhā tu senāyāḥ purarathyāpramāṇataḥ| mitre sthānaṃ narapateḥ kāryaṃ pṛthvīdhare'pi vā ||33 āryamṇe vā vidhātavyaṃ pade vaivasvato'thavā| niveśo mantriṇāṃ kāryaḥ paścimo rājaveśmanaḥ ||34 purohitasyottarato balādhyakṣasya pūrvataḥ| antaḥpuraṃ dakṣiṇato bhāṇḍāgāraṃ tathaiva ca ||35 gṛhaṃ praviśato rājño nyasyeddakṣiṇato hayān| vāme ca dantino nyasyedevaṃ sainyaṃ niveśayet ||36 bāhyataḥ parikhāṃ tasya kārayedrā javeśmanaḥ| hastāṃstrīṃścaturo vāpi pañcahastānathāpi vā ||37 catuṣṣaṣṭipadākhyena vibhājyaṃ śibiraṃ budhaiḥ| niveśaḥ śibirasyokto durgakarmātha kathyate ||38 durgaṃ tu ṣaḍvidhaṃ proktaṃ rājñāṃ tu vijigīṣatām| abdurgaṃ paṅkadurgaṃ vā vanadurgairiṇe tathā ||39 pārvatīyaṃ mahādurgamiti kalpyāni pārthivaiḥ| sarveṣāmeva durgāṇāṃ pārvatīyaṃ praśasyate ||40 durgasthānavibhāgo'ḍo!śākhyena kīrtitaḥ| madhye tu brahmaṇaḥ sthānamasambādhaṃ vidhīyate ||41 brahmasthānaṃ samārabhya harmyaṃ pañcaśayāḥ smṛtāḥ| uparathyā trihastā tu śeṣāstu dviśayāḥ smṛtāḥ ||42 sannikṛṣṭā vidhātavyā durgārathyā samantataḥ| dvāraṃ rathyāpramāṇena kāryaṃ nātyantamucchritam ||43 paracakrasamaṃ bādhaṃ surakṣaṃ tatsadā bhavet| durgeśvaragṛhasthānaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parito bhavet ||44 vaivasvate'thavāryamṇe maitre pṛthvīdhare'pi vā| yathā pure purā proktaṃ sthānaṃ durge'pi tattathā ||45 vīrāḥ śubhā hyadoṣāśca bhūmipālasya saṃmatāḥ| dhanurvedavidhijñāśca kṛtāstrāḥ śāstrapāragāḥ ||46 durge sthāpyāḥ surūpāśca bahavaśca varastriyaḥ| antaḥpuraṃ ca kośaṃ ca kumārāṃścātra vāsayet ||47 evaṃ durgavidhānasya samāso'yamudāhṛtaḥ| ityaṣṭāṅgo vāstuśāstrasya sāraḥ saṃkṣepeṇa spaṣṭamasmābhiruktaḥ| yatra jñāte śilpivadvāstuvidyāpāthonāthaṃ santarantyaprayāsāt ||48 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre aṣṭāṅgalakṣaṇaṃ nāma pañcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <46> atha toraṇabhaṅgādiśāntiko nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| purātanaṃ navaṃ vāpi kṛtaṃ vāthārdhanirmitam| devatānāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ ca toraṇaṃ nipatedyadi ||1 bhajyate dahyate vātha namate sajjate'thavā| davavidyujjalādyairvā hanyate tatkadācana ||2 tatra doṣān pravakṣyāmo doṣapraśamanāni ca| toraṇaṃ nipatetsarvaṃ śiro vāsya kathañcana ||3 rājñāṃ senāpatīnāṃ ca pratīhārapurodhasām| pradhānāśvagajānāṃ ca viprapaurajanasya ca ||4 tatra mṛtyubhayaṃ vidyāddurbhikṣaṃ cāpi nirdiśet| tasmātpraśamahetvarthaṃ vidhiṃ kuryādimaṃ budhaḥ ||5 ṛtvigbhirbrāhmaṇairdhīraḥ sthapatiḥ sapurohitaiḥ| rātrau homabaliṃ kuryānnagare tu caturdiśam ||6 karṇacatvaraśṛṅgāṭeṣvavanīpālaveśmani| sthāneṣveteṣu viprādyairvediṃ niṣpādya sākṣatām ||7 kalaśairdra vyagandhaiśca śvetamālyāmbarairvṛtām| tatra homaṃ prakurvīta śāntikaṃ balimeva ca ||8 evaṃ praśamayetsarvaṃ yatkiñcidduritotthitam| toraṇaṃ bhajyate cettadrā ṣṭrabhaṅgaṃ vinirdiśet ||9 asya praśamahetvarthaṃ pūrvoktaṃ kārayedvidhim| tadevaikaṃ pradahyeta toraṇaṃ nagareryadi ||10 tadā vahnibhayaṃ brūyādrā ṣṭrasya nagarasya ca| sabāhyābhyantaraṃ viprairvidhimenaṃ prayojayet ||11 nate vā śīrṇabhagne vā vyādhipīḍāṃ vinirdiśet| homaṃ baliṃ ca kurvīta punaḥsaṃskāramasya ca ||12 vātena vidyutā vāpi toraṇaṃ yadi bhajyate| tasminrogāḥ pravartante kulapīḍādhanakṣayāḥ ||13 śāntikarma prakurvīta tataḥ śāntikaraṃ bhavet| evamādau kṛte paścātpunaḥ saṃskārayedbudhaḥ ||14 pūrvāvayavanirmāṇādviśiṣṭaṃ racayetpunaḥ| dṛḍhasandhinigūḍhaṃ ca dṛḍhadra vyasamanvitam ||15 vividhaṃ rūpakarmāḍhyaṃ susaṃsthānaṃ manoramam| akubjamanataṃ caiva pūrvotkṛṣṭataraṃ tathā ||16 niyukte tu punaḥ śāntiṃ brāhmaṇān vācayettataḥ| purāṇe vā nave vātha kṛte vārdhakṛte'thavā ||17 prāsāde vā gṛhe vāpi kapotaḥ praviśedyadi| tatra doṣāḥ prapadyante śāntikarma tathaiva ca ||18 kālamūrtiḥ kapotaśca pāpamūlakaraṇḍakam| vihaṅgāpaśado hīnaḥ kṛṣṇacārī vihiṅgamaḥ ||19 caturvidhaḥ samākhyāto munibhiḥ sa tapodhanaiḥ| śveto vicitrakaṇṭhaśca vicitro'nyo'tha kṛṣṇakaḥ ||20 kapoto bhavane yasya śvetavarṇo viśet kvacit| kīrttividyādhanaṃ puṇyaṃ śīghraṃ ca nayate kṣayam ||21 nityaṃ rogāḥ pravardhante śiśupīḍā ca jāyate| citrakaṇṭho harejjāyāṃ putrānsarvān vicitrakaḥ ||22 sarvāḥ siddhīśca kṛṣṇāṅgaḥ praduṣya ca kulaṃ haret| rogāḥ sarve'pi vardhante vipado vyasanāni ca ||23 bandhanāni ca jāyante praviṣṭe tu kapotake| tasmādyatnaparo bhūtvā prāyaścittaṃ samācaret ||24 snātastrikālaśuddhātmā sopavāso jitendri yaḥ| devapūjācanarato nityaṃ dānaparaḥ śuciḥ ||25 yavānnaprāyabhojī ca nityaṃ homaparāyaṇaḥ| guruviprarataścaiva śvetamālyāmbarastathā ||26 gṛhī sagṛhiṇīkastu vratametatsamācaret| śvetake pañcarātraṃ ca citrakaṇṭhe daśaiva tat ||27 citre pañcadaśāhāni kṛṣṇe divasaviṃśatiḥ| vratasthena tu kartavyamagnikāryaṃ manoramam ||28 yathālābhaṃ samādāya tasya dehaṃ sapicchakam| nikṛntet khaṇḍakhaṇḍāni vibhāgāṣṭaśatāni tam ||29 ghṛtaplutāni puṇyāni madhulājānvitāni ca| pañcavāruṇasaṃjñena vahnikārye kṛte'kṣataiḥ ||30 tataśca māṃsaṃ juhuyāddhavyamātreṇa mantravit| hute kravye tataḥ kṣīraṃ dadhimadhvājyameva ca ||31 saṃpūjayedgrahān sarvān brāhmaṇānvācayet tataḥ| svavittapādaṃ śvete tu viprebhyaḥ pratipādayet ||32 vittādhaṃ citrakaṇṭhe tu pādonaṃ sarvacitrake| kṛṣṇe sarvadhanatyāgaḥ kartavyo brāhmaṇātpunaḥ ||33 evaṃ śāntirbhavedgehe sarvadoṣakṣayāvahā| mahatīṃ śriyamāpnoti dhanalābhaśca jāyate ||34 putraiḥ pautrairvṛddhimāpnotyanantāmāyurdīrghaṃ prāpnuyātsaṃyatātmā| etatkṛtvā mucyate sarvapāpairmeghairyadvacchāradaḥ śītaraśmiḥ ||35 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre toraṇabhaṅgakapotapraveśaśāntikā nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <47> atha vedīlakṣaṇaṃ nāma saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| vedyaścatasro vijñeyā yā purā brahmaṇoditāḥ| vayaṃ tāḥ saṃpravakṣyāmo nāmasaṃsthānamānataḥ ||1 prathamā caturaśrā syātsabhadrā ca dvitīyakā| tṛtīyā śrīdharī nāma caturthī padminī smṛtā ||2 yajñakāle tathodvāhe devatāsthāpaneṣu ca| nīrājaneṣu sarveṣu vahnihome ca nityaśaḥ ||3 nṛpābhiṣecane caiva śakradhvajaniveśane| nṛpayogyā bhavantyetā varṇānāmanupūrvaśaḥ ||4 caturaśrā tu yā vedi navahastā samantataḥ| aṣṭahastā pramāṇena sarvabhadrā prakīrtitā ||5 śrīdharī sapta vijñeyā hastān mānena vedikā| ṣaḍḍhastā caiva śāstrajñairnalinīha vidhīyate ||6 caturaśrā tu kartavyā caturaśrā samantataḥ| bhadrai stu sarvatobhadrā bhūṣaṇīyā caturdiśam ||7 śrīdharī cāpi vijñeyā koṇaviṃśatisaṃyutā| nalinīti ca vijñeyā padmasaṃsthānadhāriṇī ||8 kartavyāḥ svasvavistārāducchrayeṇa tribhāgikāḥ| kuryānmantravatībhistā iṣṭakābhistu cāyatāḥ ||9 caturaśrā yajñakāle vivāhe śrīdharī smṛtā| devatāsthāpane vedīṃ sarvabhadrāṃ niveśayet ||10 nīrājane sāgnikārye tathā rājābhiṣecane| vedī padmāvatī yā ca tathā śakradhvajocchraye ||11 caturmukhā tu kartavyā sopānaiśca caturdiśam| pratīhārasamāyuktā cārdhacandro paśobhitā ||12 catuḥstambhasamāyuktā catuṣkumbhavirājitā| kāñcanai rājataistāmrairmṛnmayaiḥ kalaśaistathā ||13 koṇe koṇe tu vinyastairvalguvānarabhūṣitaiḥ| stambhapramāṇaṃ vedīnāṃ kāryaṃ chādyavaśena ca ||14 ekena dvitribhirvāpi cchādyaiḥ sāmalasārikaiḥ | stambhamūlāni cābhyajya guḍena madhusarpiṣā ||15 paramānnena vābhyajya tānvinyasyedyathātatham| devatāḥ pūjayitvā tu brāhmaṇānsvasti vācayet ||16 caturvidhamitīritaṃ yadiha vedikālakṣaṇaṃ| samagramapi vartate manasi yasya tacchilpinaḥ| sa yāti bhuvi pūjyatāmavanibhokturāpnoti ca| śriyaṃ sthapatisaṃsadi sphurati cāsya śubhraṃ yaśaḥ ||17 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre vedīlakṣaṇaṃ nāma saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <48> atha gṛhadoṣanirūpaṇaṃ nāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| ataḥ paraṃ gṛhādīnāmapraśastasamucchritam| kriyate kathitaṃ yasmādekatra susamaṃ bhavet ||1 rakṣombunāthakīnāśamaruddahanadikplavā| madhyaplavā ca bhūrvyādhidāridra ymarakāvahā ||2 vahniplavā vahnibhiye mṛtaye dakṣiṇaplavā| ruje rakṣaḥplavā pratyakplavā dhānyadhanacchide ||3 kalahāya pravāsāya rogāya ca marutplavā| madhyaplavā tu bhūmiryā sarvanāśāya sā bhavet ||4 tuṣāsthikeśakīṭatvaśaṅkhabhasmoṣarānvitām| karparāṅgāriṇīṃ duṣṭasattvānāryajanāṃ tyajet ||5 caitre śokakaraṃ veśma jyeṣṭhe mṛtyupradāyakam| paśunāśanamāṣāḍhe śūnyaṃ bhādra pade kṛtam ||6 āśvine kalahāya syātkārttike bhṛtyanāśanam| māghe cāgnibhayāya syānmāseṣveṣu na kārayet ||7 pāvakasya pade pṛṣṭhavaṃśasyāpi ca paścime| puraprāsādakarṇe ca kīlādi prāk prayojayet ||8 pūrvapaścimadiṅmūḍhaṃ vāstu strīnāśakṛdbhavet| udaṅmūḍhaṃ na niṣpattiṃ yāti sarvaṃ ca nāśayet ||9 yattu dakṣiṇadiṅmūḍhaṃ jāyate maraṇāya tat| prāgvāstuni kurvīta prāsādaṃ mandiraṃ pure ||10 valitaṃ calitaṃ bhrāntaṃ visūtraṃ ca samutsṛjet| yatsyānmukhaviniṣkrāntaṃ valitaṃ tatprakīrtitam ||11 calitaṃ pṛṣṭhaniṣkrāntaṃ diṅmūḍhaṃ bhrāntamucyate| visūtraṃ karṇahīnaṃ syātphalameṣāṃ pracakṣmahe ||12 valite calati sthānaṃ calite vigraho bhavet| bhrāntaṃ yoṣidvināśāya visūtraṃ bhūriśatrukṛt ||13 mūṣakotkaravalmīkaprāntā vakrā bhujaṅgavat| chinnā bhinnā vikarṇā ca na vāstuni śubhā kṣitiḥ ||14 mūṣakotkaravatyarthaṃ hanti valmīkinī sutam| vikarṇā kurute karṇarogaṃ chinnā vināśinī| bhinnā bhedaṃ karotyurvī kuṭilā mativakratām ||15 sapādaṃ satribhāgaṃ vā sārdhaṃ dviguṇameva ca| yatsyānmukhāyataṃ veśma tadaniṣṭaphalapradam ||16 yad dviśālaṃ triśālaṃ vā catuḥśālamathāpi vā| mūṣayā rahitaṃ veśma tadaniṣṭhaphalapradam ||17 purataḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ pārśve yadi vālindavarjitā| gṛhe na śasyate śālā devāgāre tu śasyate ||18 anyapṛṣṭhasthitadvāraṃ veśma khādakamucyate| parasparavirodhāya tadveśma gṛhiṇostayoḥ ||19 saśalyaṃ pādahīnaṃ ca samasandhi śiroguru| veśmanāmidamuddiṣṭaṃ marmadoṣacatuṣṭayam ||20 vāstukṣetrasya yatrāṅge yasya vartma pravartate| tadaṅgaṃ vāstunastasya cchinnaṃ teneti nirdiśet ||21 chinnāṅgaṃ vikalaṃ tatsyādbhītidaṃ sarvadoṣakṛt| tadbharturbhajyate'ṅgaṃ tadvedhastasyāphalo'nyathā ||22 svagṛhadvayamadhyena nirvāho yadi vartmanaḥ| dvāravedhoditāndoṣāṃstadā prāpnoti niścitam ||23 mārgaścaiko yadā gacchedubhayorgṛhapārśvayoḥ| mārgavedhastadā sa syācchokasantāpakārakaḥ ||24 utsaṅgaḥ pūrṇabāhuśca hīnabāhustathāparaḥ| pratyakṣāya iti proktaṃ praveśānāṃ catuṣṭayam ||25 gṛhasya sammukhaṃ yatra dvāraṃ bhavati vāstunaḥ| utasaṅga iti sa proktaḥ pūrṇabāhuḥ pradakṣiṇaḥ ||26 vāmato hīnabāhuḥ syātpratyakṣo vāstu pṛṣṭhataḥ| caturtho'yaṃ samuddiṣṭaḥ praveśo vāstuno budhaiḥ ||27 utsaṅgākhye praveśe syātprajāhāniḥ kuṭumbinaḥ| dhanadhānyakṣayo vāsya maraṇaṃ dhruvaṃ bhavet ||28 pūrṇabāhau putrapautrā dhanadhānyasukhāni ca| bhavanti vasato nityaṃ gṛhiṇastatra vāstuni ||29 alpamitro gṛhī hīnabāhāvatyalpabāndhavaḥ| syādvālpavitto jīyeta strībhiḥ pīḍyeta vāmayaiḥ ||30 pratyakṣāya praveśastu vihito yatra veśmani| tasminnivasatāṃ puṃsāṃ niścitaḥ syāddhanakṣayaḥ ||31 mūṣāsvasthānayuktāsu śālābheda iti smṛtaḥ| prāpnoti tatra nivasanmṛtyuṃ duḥkhaṃ sarogatām ||32 udagdakṣiṇaśālāsu pūrvāparagatāsu ca| anyathā vā sthitaṃ dvāraṃ vadhabandhanakārakam ||33 mūṣāgatān bhramānkuryānna śālāṃ pratibhedayet| bhramabhagnāsu śālāsu vipadyante kuṭumbinaḥ ||34 śālābhedo bhavedyatra pṛṣṭhataḥ pārśvato'pi vā| dhanadhānyakṣayastatra gṛhiṇo jāyate dhruvam ||35 yatra pratyaṅmukhe śāle gṛhaṃ tatsyādvikokilam| āyuścatuṣpadaṃ dhānyaṃ vasatāṃ tatra naśyati ||36 sīmāśālāprabhinnasya prāsādasya gṛhasya ca| asthirā jāyate ṛddhiḥ sthitiśca na bhavecciram ||37 sarvadoṣakari jñeyā garbhe candrā valokitā| mūṣāṃ vinā vināśāya kāmocchittyai gavākṣakaḥ ||38 yadā gaṇḍo'thavā kukṣiḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ kakṣātha bhidyate| dāyadrayaṃ jāyate bhartustadānīmadussaham ||39 garbhādubhayato gaṇḍau kakṣe staḥ karṇabhittige| dakṣiṇottarayoḥ kukṣī pṛṣṭhataḥ pṛṣṭhamādiśet ||40 sthāpitadvārasaṃrodhe gṛhiṇo jāyate'śmarī| dvāre tu vihite tasminnanarthastasya jāyate ||41 pūrvadvāranirodhaṃ tu navamāgaṃ kadācana| śrotrarodhe'śmarīdoṣaḥ kṛttaśrotrehyanamyatā ||42 kṛttāni yatra cīyante gavākṣālokanāni ca| tatra prasūtirna bhavenniṣpannāpi vinaśyati ||43 cīyamānā yadā bhittirdakṣiṇā syādbahirmukhī| tadā vyādhibhayaṃ vidyānnṛpadaṇḍabhayaṃ tathā ||44 yadā tu paścimaṃ kuḍyaṃ prayāti bahiragrataḥ| dhanahāniṃ vijānīyāccaurebhyaśca bhayaṃ tadā ||45 uttaraṃ tu yadā kuḍyaṃ cīyamānaṃ bahirvrajet| gṛhabhartuśca kartuśca vyasanaṃ syāttadā mahat ||46 yadāgraṃ cīyamānāyāḥ pūrvabhitterbahirvrajet| tadā gṛhapatestīvraṃ rājadaṇḍabhayaṃ bhavet ||47 prāgdakṣiṇo yadā karṇaścīyamāno bahirvrajet| tatrāgnibhītiratulā saṃśayaśca prabhorbhavet ||48 bahirmukho yadā gacchetkarṇau dakṣiṇapaścimaḥ| kalahopadra vastatra syād bhāryāyāśca saṃśayaḥ ||49 yatrottarāparaḥ karṇaścīyamāno vrajedbahiḥ| putravāhanabhṛtyānāṃ bhavettasminnupadra vaḥ ||50 yadā prāguttaraḥ karṇo bahirgacchati veśmanaḥ| tadā gavāṃ vṛṣāṇāṃ ca gurūṇāṃ ca kṣayo bhavet ||51 catasro bhittayo yasya bahirniryānti veśmanaḥ| cīyamānāstadatroktaṃ mandiraṃ mallikākṛti ||52 tādṛg gṛhe na tatrāyo vyayo bhavati yādṛśaḥ| karśito'syaiva doṣeṇa tasya bharttā palāyate ||53 saṃkṣipyate tu yadveśma cīyamānaṃ samantataḥ| saṃkṣiptamiti tajjñeyaṃ tatra rājabhayaṃ bhavet ||54 yatsyādanteṣu saṃkṣiptaṃ vistṛtaṃ cāpi madhyataḥ| mṛdaṅgākṛtisaṃsthānaṃ tatra vyādhibhayaṃ bhavet ||55 ādyantavistṛtaṃ yatsyātsaṃkṣiptaṃ cāpi madhyataḥ| mṛdumadhyaṃ taduddiṣṭaṃ kṣudbhayaṃ tatra jāyate ||56 viṣamairunnataiḥ karṇairdhanakṣayakaraṃ gṛham| bhittivaccāpi karṇeṣu prāguktaṃ phalamādiśet ||57 madhye dvāraṃ na kartavyaṃ manujānāṃ kathañcana| madhye dvāre kṛte tatra kulanāśaḥ prajāyate ||58 dvāraṃ dvāreṇa vā viddhamaśubhāyopapadyate| aniṣṭadra vyasaṃyuktaṃ dhanadhānyabināśanam ||59 navaṃ purāṇasaṃyuktamanyaṃ svāminamicchati| adhograṃ rājadaṇḍāya viddhaṃ dvāraṃ vigarhitam ||60 navaṃ purāṇasaṃyuktaṃ dra vyaṃ tu kalikārakam| na miśrajātidra vyotthaṃ dvāraṃ vā veśma vā śubham ||61 gṛhasthāneṣu yaddravyamadhivāsya pratiṣṭhitam| taccālanena calanaṃ gṛhabhartuḥ prajāyate ||62 anyavāstucyutaṃ dra vyamanyavāstau na yojayet| prāsāde na bhavetpūjā gṛhe ca na vasedgṛhī ||63 dra vyeṇa devadagdhena bhavanaṃ yadvidhīyate| na tatra vasati svāmī vasannapi vinaśyati ||64 sūryodbhavā drumacchāyā dhvajacchāyā ca garhitā| dvārātikramaṇādetāḥ kṣudvyādhikalikārakāḥ ||65 prāsādaśikharacchāyā dhvajacchāyeti kīrtitā| tripañcasaptamī bharturgṛhatārā na śobhanā ||66 nimnonnataṃ karālaṃ ca sammukhaṃ pṛṣṭhadeśagam| vāmāvartaṃ ca na śubhaṃ dvāramagrataraṃ gṛhe ||67 nimne syātstrījito bhartā durjanasthitirunnate| sammukhe sutapīḍā syātpṛṣṭhage capalāḥ striyaḥ ||68 vāme vittakṣayo dvāri bhavatyagratare prabhoḥ| dvāraṃ tasmānna kartavyamīdṛgrūpaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||69 nāgadantatulāstambhabhittimūṣāgavākṣakāḥ| dvāramadhye na dātavyā na caite viṣamasthitāḥ ||70 itihāsapurāṇoktaṃ vṛttāntapratirūpakam| ninditaṃ ca gṛhe neṣṭaṃ śastaṃ devakuleṣu tat ||71 yānīndra jālatulyāni yāni mithyākṛtāni ca| bhīṣaṇānī ca yāni syurna kuryāttāni veśmasu ||72 svayamuddhāṭitaṃ dvāramuccāṭanakaraṃ bhavet| dhanahṛd bandhuvairaṃ syādathavā kalikārakam ||73 svayaṃ yatpihitaṃ dvāraṃ tadbhavedbahuduḥkhadam| saśabdaṃ bhayakṛtpādaśītalaṃ garbhapātanam ||74 dra vyaṃ nādhomukhaṃ kāryaṃ pratyagyāmyānanaṃ na ca| paścimāgre parikleśo dakṣiṇāgre tu śūnyatā ||75 stambhadvāraṃ ca bhittiṃ ca viparītaṃ na kārayet| amīṣāṃ vaiparītyena doṣāḥ syurbahavo nṛṇām ||76 mūlasūtrānusāreṇa kartavyā bhūmikopari| uparyupari yadveśmasamaṃ saṃtāpakārakam ||77 adhobhūmau kṣaṇā ye syustatsamāṃścordhvabhūmiṣu| parityajannapahitā na kurvīta yathottaram ||78 śālā nimnā bhavedyasminnalindastvadhiko bhavet| nidhanaṃ jāyate tatra sadā śokabhayāni ca ||79 mūladvārānusāreṇa dvārāṇyuparibhūmiṣu| kuryādbhayapradāni syurvihitānyanyathā punaḥ ||80 kṣudbhayapradamādhmānaṃ kubjaṃ kulavināśanam| atyarthaṃ pīḍitaṃ pīḍāṃ karotyantanataṃ kṣayam ||81 pravāso bāhyavinate digbhrānte dasyuto bhayam| mūladvāraṃ kṣayaṃ kuryādviddhaṃ dvārāntareṇa yat ||82 pravāso bhṛtyajo dveṣo viddhe catvararathyayā| nāśaṃ dra vyaṃ dhvajāviddhaṃ vṛkṣeṇa śiśudūṣakam ||83 paṅkaviddhe bhavecchokaḥ salilasrāviṇi vyayaḥ| kūpena viddhe'pasmāro vināśo daivatena ca ||84 stambhena dūṣaṇaṃ strīṇāṃ brahmaṇā tu kulakṣayaḥ| mānādabhyadhike dvāre rājato jāyate bhayam ||85 vyasanaṃ mānato hīne caurebhyaśca bhayaṃ bhavet| vyādhayaḥ śvabhraviddhena dhanasya ca parikṣayaḥ ||86 devadhvajena bandhaḥ syātsabhayaiśvaryasaṃkṣayaḥ| sannipātabhayaṃ vāpyā tulyā dṛṣṭatvamākṛte ||87 hṛdrukkulālacakreṇa dāridrayaṃ vāriṇā bhavet| vyādhirukkacakūṭena āpākena sutakṣayaḥ ||88 niścatodūkhalena syācchilayā cāśmarī bhavet| toyabhāṇḍena durmantrī bhasmanā cārśaso gṛhī ||89 dāridrayaṃ chāyayā viddhe bhaveddvāre kuṭumbinaḥ| sthalasyandanavalmīkairvideśagamanaṃ bhavet ||90 kṛśaṃ vikṛtamatyuccaṃ karālaṃ śithilaṃ pṛthu| vakraṃ viśālamuttānaṃ śūlāgraṃ hrasvakukṣikam ||91 svapādacalitaṃ hrasvaṃ hīnakarṇaṃ mukhānatam| pārśvagaṃ sūtramārgācca bhraṣṭaṃ dvāraṃ na śobhanam ||92 tatkaroti kṣayaṃ ghoraṃ vināśaṃ svāmisampadaḥ| vasatāṃ kalahaṃ nityamatastatparivarjayet ||93 antardvārādbahirdvāraṃ noccaṃ kuryānna saṅkaṭam| uccaṃ visaṅkaṭaṃ vāpi tacchivāya na jāyate ||94 paṭṭasandhiryadā madhye dvārasya syātkathañcana| kartustadā vināśaḥ syātkulasya ca parikṣayaḥ ||95 tulā upatulā vā syurdvāri tiryagyadā kṛtāḥ| dāridra yvyādhisantāpā bhavanti svāminastadā ||96 anuvaṃśamanuprāptā jayantyo yadi mandire| vittāyuṣostadālpatvamanārogyaṃ ca jāyate ||97 udumbare nihitālalāṭī nāma sā tulā| dūṣaṇaṃ maraṇaṃ vāpi kanyānāṃ vidadhāti sā ||98 uttarāṅgodare nyastā lalāṭena samā yadi| tulā lalāṭikā sāpi kulakṣayakarī bhavet ||99 tulāpiṇḍena vinyastā jñeyā yajñopavītinī| vasato vyasanaṃ kuryātkuṭumbasyāsukhaṃ ca sā ||100 yadi bhāratulaikāpi madhye viddhā kathañcana| tadā varāṅgaṃ bhajyeta dhanaṃ ca parihīyate ||101 bhittibhedo na kartavyastulāgrairakhilairapi| kuryād brahmapadanyasto bhārapaṭṭaḥ kulakṣayam ||102 ayuktayoryuktayorvā sandhiścedbhārapaṭṭage| sandhau syāttatsuto jyeṣṭhaḥ kartuścāpi vinaśyati ||103 anuvaṃśaṃ na bhuñjīta na śayīta kadācana| bhuñjānasyārthanāśaḥ syācchayānasya mahārujaḥ ||104 nāśo'nuvaṃśaṃ rogāḥ syustiryaksthe rakṣaso bhayam| śayanāgāravinyaste maraṇaṃ nāgadantake ||105 karṇāvātpakṣirāṅghaṇṭādhvajacchatrakumārakān| siṃhakarṇakapotāliṃ gṛheṣu parivarjayet ||106 indra kīlaṃ śukraṃ tumbīmardhavaṃśaṃ ca veśmani| na kuryāttatra vihitāḥ sarvadoṣāvahā yataḥ ||107 atikṣipracirotpannaṃ kṛśadra vyamapāhitam| apratiṣṭhitasaṃsthānaṃ gṛhaṃ namati pañcadhā ||108 atisthūlena hasvena śarīreṇa yathā naraḥ| virūpo duvalaścava tathā dra vyeṇa mandiram ||109 jīrṇaṃ ghuṇakṛtaṃ miśraṃ hīnaṃ vakraṃ vidhicyutam| caṇḍaṃ tuṇḍaṃ vakrakoṇaṃ sandhividdhālpamūlake ||110 vajramadhyaṃ sthūlamūlaṃ kukṣibhinnaṃ ca dāru yat| bhinnamūlaṃ kūrmapṛṣṭhaṃ pakṣahīnaṃ ca varjayet ||111 pātitānvarjayedvṛkṣān dvipāśvāgnijalānilaiḥ| prabhūtapakṣinilayān kākakauśikasevitān ||112 madhugrahapiśācāhiduṣṭāṃścaityaśmaśānajān| catuṣpathatrikamahānadīsaṅgamamārgajān ||113 devatāyatanejātānūrdhvaśuṣkān kṣatacchadān| vallīpinaddhānsuṣirakoṭaragranthisaṅkulān ||114 yāmyāparāśāpatitāṃstyajetkaṇṭakino'pi ca| kapitthodumbarāśvatthaśirīṣavaṭacampakān ||115 kovidāradhavāriṣṭaśleṣmātakavibhītakān| kiñca saptacchadakṣīriphaladāṃśca drumāṃstyajet ||116 marmāṇi yatra pīḍyante dvārairbhittimireva vā| dāridrayaṃ kulahāniṃ vā gṛhiṇastatra nirdiśet ||117 stambhairvinaśyati svāmī tulābhiḥ strīvadho dhruvam| saṅgrahairbandhunāśaḥ syājjayantībhiḥ snuṣāvadhaḥ ||118 marmasthānasthitaiḥ kāyairbhartuḥ kāyo nipīḍyate| marmasthaiḥ sandhipālaistu suhṛdviśleṣamādiśet ||119 gṛhapīḍā nāgadantairnāgapāśairdhanakṣayaḥ| kāpicchakaistu preṣyāṇāṃ kṣayaṃ marmasthitairvadet ||120 ṣaḍdārukānyanusarāgavākṣālokanāni ca| marmasthānaniviṣṭāni janayanti mahābhayam ||121 stambhairvā dvāramadhyairvā tulābhirnāgapāśakaiḥ| vātāyanairnāgadantairdvāramadhye nipīḍite ||122 vyādhayaḥ saṃpravardhante dhananāśaḥ kulakṣayaḥ| rājadaṇḍabhayaṃ ca syādapatyānāṃ ca pīḍanam ||123 ṣaḍdārukāṇāṃ madhyeṣu dvāramadhyeṣu vā punaḥ| karṇadra vyādibhirviddheṣvetadevādiśet phalam ||124 saṃviddhā nāgadantairyā stambhairvātāyanaistathā| śayyā śastrādbhayaṃ bhartuḥ kuryāttaskarato'pi vā ||125 gṛhamadhye kṛta dvāraṃ dra vyakośavināśanam| āvahetkalahaṃ bharturbhāryāṃ vāsya pradūṣayet ||126 dra vyeṇaikottareṇāpi mahāmarmaṇi pīḍite| sarvasvanāśo gṛhiṇo maraṇaṃ vā dhruvaṃ bhavet ||127 dvārarāmbhatulālindaśca yadoṣaiḥ samīritaiḥ| visūtre nāgadante'pi tacchūnyaṃ jāyate gṛham ||128 vibhāgapadahīneṣu rūpasthāneṣu vāstuṣu| yakṣamātṛkriyādyeṣu rogānmṛtyurna saṃśayaḥ ||129 kaṭukaṇṭakidurgandhiguhyakādyāśrayān drumān| na dhārayet samīpasthān puraprāsādaveśmanām ||130 badarī kadalī caiva dāḍimī bījapūrikā| prarohanti gṛhe yatra tadgṛhaṃ na prarohati ||131 dra vyaṃ dra vyādhikaṃ hanti kulamāyāmato'dhikam| ucchrayābhyadhikaṃ pūjāṃ santatiṃ vistarādhikam ||132 stambhāṅgairbhittibhiḥ paṭṭaiḥ śīrṣakairbhavanaistathā| ālokanātoraṇādyaiśchādyakaiḥ kandakūṭakaiḥ ||133 hīraśākhottamāṅgaiśca tulābhiḥ sandhipālakaiḥ| argalāgrairvedikābhirvyālairjālaiśca nūtanaiḥ ||134 ghātitaiḥ pātitairnaṣṭairjāyate gṛhiṇo dhruvam| vyādhidāridra yduḥkhārtirnirdhanatvaṃ ca jāyate ||135 uccacchādyaṃ chidra garbhaṃ bhramitaṃ vamitaṃ mukhe| hīnamadhyaṃ naṣṭasūtraṃ śalyaviddhaṃ śiroguru ||136 bhraṣṭālindakaśobhaṃ ca viṣamasthaṃ tulātalam| anyonyadra vyaviddhaṃ ca kupadapravibhājitam ||137 hīnabhittyuttamāṅgaṃ ca vinaṣṭaṃ stambhabhittikam| bhinnaśālaṃ tyaktakaṇṭhaṃ niṣkandaṃ mānavarjitam ||138 vikṛtaṃ ca gṛhaṃ bharturaniṣṭaphaladāyakam| tasmāddoṣānimāṃstyaktvā gṛhaṃ kuryācchubhāvaham ||139 evaṃvidhaṃ doṣakaraṃ gṛhaṃ syādbhartuśca kartuśca yatastadete| jñeyāḥ sadā śilpibhirapramattaistyājyāśca doṣāḥ śubhakīrtikāmaiḥ ||140 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre gṛhadoṣanirūpaṇaṃ nāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| <49> atha
