vṛttāḥ samākhyātāḥ prāsādā nāmalakṣaṇaiḥ| caturaśrāyatān brūmaḥ prāsādāniha sāmpratam ||126 aṣṭabhāgāyate kṣetre caturaṃśakavistṛte| dvibhāgasārdhabhāgaikabhāgo'yaṃ pīṭha iṣyate ||127 paścimaṃ bhāgamutsṛjya devakoṣṭhaṃ dvibhāgikam| tasmin niveśayetsīmā syādasyāgre'ṣṭabhirdharaiḥ ||128 sasīmno devakoṣṭhasya bhāgikālindako bahiḥ| yukto dharāṇāṃ viṃśatyā vedikājālaveṣṭitaḥ ||129 prāgrīvakasya tasyāgre stambhadvitayabhūṣitaḥ| dvicchādyacchāditaḥ śrīmān siṃhakarṇairalaṅkṛtaḥ ||130 prāsādo'yaṃ bhavo nāma viśālaḥ kathyate'dhunā| yadāsyaiva saniṣkrānte sīmāyāme ca vardhate ||131 valabhyau pārśvayoḥ syātāṃ viśālākhyastadā bhavet| viśālasya yadā garbhe bhittirbhavati diktraye ||132 dvau dvau gavākṣakau cāpi sāmmukhyaḥ sa bhavettadā| prāgrīvāstridiśaṃ tasya garbhakoṣṭhāyatā yadā ||133 hitvā valabhyau prāgrīvau vidhīyete tathāparau| karṇeṣu bhāgamekaikaṃ tyaktvā syātprabhavastadā ||134 etasyaiva mukhe syātāṃ yadā prāgrīvakāvubhau| pārśvayoraparau dvau dvau prāgrīvau bhavato yadā ||135 karṇeṣu bhittayaśca syustadā syācchibirāgṛhaḥ | yadāsyaiva mukhe śālā bhāgadvitayavistṛtā ||136 āyāmena ca ṣaḍbhāgā prāgrīvau dvau tadagrataḥ| dvau dvau gavākṣakau syātāṃ tadbhittyorubhayorapi ||137 sīmāyāṃ dvādaśa stambhā mukhaśālastadā bhavet| alindo bhāgikaḥ kāryo viśālasyaiva bāhyataḥ ||138 prāgrīvabhūmiṣu vṛto bhittyā ca sagavākṣakaḥ| agrataḥ sahitaḥ stambhaiḥ ṣaḍbhiśca kriyate yadā ||139 dviśāla iti vikhyātaḥ prāsādo jāyate tadā| yadāsyaiva vidhīyante stambhāḥ sarve samantataḥ ||140 prāgrīvakau cobhayato gṛharājastadā bhavet| sarvasyaiva yadālindaḥ syādanyo bhāgavistṛtaḥ ||141 sīmāntavistṛte syātāṃ valabhyau bhāganissṛte| bhittirvidhīyate śeṣā gavākṣairupaśobhitā ||142 mukhe ṣaḍdārukaṃ ca syāttadā syādamalābhidhaḥ| ekādaśāyate kṣetre tathā ṣaḍbhāgavistṛte ||143 muktvā bhāgadvayaṃ paścāddevakoṣṭhaṃ niveśayet| bhāgaṃ muktvāgrataḥ kuryātsīmāṃ bhāgacatuṣṭayam ||144 aṣṭastambhāstato'lindaviṃśatistambhabhāgikāḥ| bhāgikaḥ parito'lindo'ṣṭāviṃśatidharo'paraḥ ||145 dvidvistambhayutāḥ kāryāḥ prāgrīvāḥ koṣṭhajāstrayaḥ| sīmāsame valabhyau ca prāgrīvau madhyatastayoḥ ||146 dvidvistambhau puraścānyau vedikājālaśobhitau| vedikājālarūpāḍhyaḥ siṃhakarṇopaśobhitaḥ ||147 prāsādo'yaṃ vibhurnāma kathito bhartṛnandanaḥ| evamete samākhyātāścaturaśrāyatā daśa ||148 caturaśrāyatāṃstiryagāyatyāthāparānapi| prāsādānabhidhāsyāmo navasaṃsthānalakṣaṇaiḥ ||149 dvau bhānau vistṛtirgarbhe dviguṇā tiryagāyatiḥ| madhye bhāgocchritaṃ dvāraṃ tadardhena tu vistṛtam ||150 stambhaścaturbhiḥ saṃyuktā sīmā dvārasya cāgrataḥ| dvibhāgāyāmavistārā tāvanmātrasamucchritiḥ ||151 tāṃ sīmāṃ garbhasahitāṃ bhāgenānyena veṣṭayet| bhittistatra vidhātavyā sagavākṣā caturdiśam ||152 ṣaḍdārukayuto hyeṣa prāsādo bhava ucyate| asyaiva bhāganiṣkāsā śālā mukhacatuṣṭaye ||153 yadā ṣaḍdārukopetā viśālaḥ sa tadocyate| stambhairmukhaimukhe ṣaḍbhirbahiḥ sāmmukhya ityasau ||154 asyaiva sa mā karṇasthā dvidvistambhayutā yadā| prāgrīvairbhāganiṣkrāntā bahisthā prabhavastadā ||155 sīmno'grato yadāsyaiva stambhadvayayuto bhavet| prāgrīvo bhāganiṣkrāntastadā syācchibirāgṛhaḥ ||156 viśālasanniveśasya mukhe śālā bhavedyadā| pārśvayoścobhayoḥ śāle prāgrīvāśca trayo yadā ||157 niṣkrāntabhāga ekaikaḥ stambhadvitayasaṃyutaḥ| prāsādaḥ sa tadā jñeyo mukhaśālo'bhidhānataḥ ||158 mukhaśālāgraśālāyā yadā stambhāścaturdaśa| prāgrīvo dvividhaścāgre dviśālaḥ sa tadā bhavet ||159 bhittistadānīṃ prāsādo gṛharājaḥ prajāyate| garbhāyāmasamāvagrapṛṣṭhayorbhāgavistṛtau ||160 catuścaturdharau yatra prāgrīvau dvau ca pārśvayoḥ| tau tu dvidvidharau garbhavistāreṇa tu sammitau ||161 amalo nāma sa proktaḥ prāsādaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ| asyaiva cāgre pṛṣṭhe ca dvidvistambhayutau yadā ||162 prāgrīvau sa tadā proktaḥ prāsādo daśamo vibhuḥ| prāsādān kathayāmo'nyān daśa vṛttāyatān punaḥ ||163 aṣṭabhāgamukhāyatyā vistṛtyā caturaśrakam| vṛttāyataṃ prakurvīta sabāhyābhyantaraṃ tataḥ ||164 garbhaṃ paścimabhāge'sya caturbhāgaṃ samantataḥ| kuryāttasyāgrataḥ sīmāṃ bhāgadvitayavistṛtām ||165 bhāgatrayamitāṃ bhāgenaikenāntaritāṃ ca tām| saṃyuktāmaṣṭabhiḥ stambhaiḥ sudṛḍhaiścārudarśanaiḥ ||166 alindena parikṣiptāṃ sasīmāṃ devakoṣṭhakam| ṣoḍaśastambhayuktena kuryāt prāgrīvamagrataḥ ||167 channāśchādyadvayenāyamāmoda iti kīrtitaḥ| vṛttāyateṣu prathamaḥ prāsādaḥ svāmino hitaḥ ||168 samāhitau yadāsyaiva prāgrīvau bhāgamiśritau| catuḥstambhai raitikastu vṛttābhyāṃ tuṅga ucyate ||169 yadā sīmāvadhirbhittirgavākṣairupaśobhitā| vṛttaprāgrīva eko'nye tadā cārurudāhṛtaḥ ||170 sīmāmadhye vidhātavyau prāgrīvau bhāgavistṛtau| vistārasadṛśāyāmau dakṣiṇeti triṣu trayaḥ ||171 kāryāḥ prāgrīvakāste ca garmakoṣṭhena sammitāḥ| bhūtirityeṣa proktaḥ prāsādaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ ||172 mukhāyatā syāccaturo bhāgānyattiryagāyatān| kṣetravṛttaṃ tataḥ kuryāttanmadhye garbhaveśma ca ||173 caturbhāgāyataṃ tat syādbhāgadvitayavistṛtam| alindo bāhyatastasya dvādaśastambhasaṃyutaḥ ||174 bhāgadvitayavistāraḥ prāgrīvaścāṃśanirgataḥ| niṣedha iti vikhyātaḥ prāsādo'yaṃ purātanaiḥ ||175 yadā niṣedhaḥ syādasya puraḥ prāgrīvako yadi| caturdvāraparikṣipto'lindenāṣṭadhareṇa vā ||176 ayamevāṃśakena syādyadālindena veṣṭitaḥ| mukhabhāgatrayaṃ muktvā bhittyā ca pariveṣṭitaḥ ||177 yadā ca karṇaprāgrīvau prāgrīvaścāgrato bhavet| viśeṣaracanā yā ca dvāviṃśatidharānvitau ||178 gavākṣaiḥ śobhanairyuktastadā siṃhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ| dvādaśāṃśāyate kṣetre tathā ṣaḍbhāgavistṛte ||179 paścādaṃśadvayaṃ tyaktvā dvibhāgāyāmavistṛtaḥ| devakoṣṭho vidhātavyastaddvāraṃ bhāgamucchritam ||180 sīmāgre sāntarā dvyaṃśavistṛtā caturāyatā| aṣṭastambho'sya garbho vai ṣoḍaśastambhako bahiḥ ||181 alindastasya purato vṛttaprāgrīvako'pi ca| sīmāprāgrīvakālindakoṣṭhān vṛttān prakalpayet ||182 prāgrīvau pārśvayoḥ sīmāsamau bhāgavinirgatau| dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ yutau jñeyau stambhābhyāṃ vartulākṛtī ||183 etatsarvaṃ vidhātavyamalindenābhiveṣṭitam| caturviṃśadharo'ya ca bhāgikosya praśasyate ||184 dvistambhayuktān prāgrīvān kuryādgarbhasya diktraye| evameṣa samākhyātaḥ prāsādaḥ suprabhaḥ śubhaḥ ||185 bhāgadvitayavistārāḥ prāgrīvā ye'sya kīrttitāḥ| caturaśrāsta eva syurdvidvistambhayutā yadi ||186 śeṣā bhavati bhittiśca gavākṣairupaśobhitā| prāsādoyaṃ tadā jñeyo daśamo locanotsavaḥ ||187 aṣṭāśrānatha vakṣyāmaḥ prāsādāṃ llakṣaṇaiḥ saha| caturbhāgānvite kṣetre tathāṣṭaśrīkṛte punaḥ ||188 dvau bhāgau garbhakoṣṭhaḥ syādalindo bhāgikastadā| stambhāṣṭakamalinde syātprāgrīvastasya cāgrataḥ ||189 dvicchādyaśchāditaḥ śrīmān prāsādo vajrako bhavet| asyaivāgre yadā sīmā caturaśrā caturdharā ||190 syāccaturviṃśatistambhaścālindo bhāgiko'paraḥ| nandano'yaṃ samākhyātaḥ śaṅkuḥ prāgrīvakaistribhiḥ ||191 tasya bhittirvidhātavyā kṣetre'ṣṭāśriyute budhaiḥ| vāmanaśca punardvaudvau gavākṣau diktraye matau ||192 asyaivāgre yadā sīmābhāgādbhāgatrayāyatā| dvibhāgaṃ vistṛtā dvyaṃśasamucchedāṣṭabhirdharaiḥ ||193 alindāveṣṭitā yuktā prāgrīvaimakhalā tadā| bhittikṣetre yadāsyaiva prāgrīvāḥ pariveṣṭitāḥ ||194 alindena dharaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ ṣaḍbhiryuktāstadā layaḥ| aṣṭabhāgamite kṣetre kṛte'ṣṭāśriṇi sarvataḥ ||195 bhāgadvayamitaṃ kuryāddevakoṣṭhaṃ manoramam| caturbhiḥ śobhitaṃ dvārairbhāgikā lindaveṣṭitam ||196 alindasya vidhāṭavyāḥ stambhāścāṣṭau tato'paraḥ| syāccaturviṃśatistambho bhāgiko'lindakaḥ punaḥ ||197 tathāvidhastṛtīyo'pi prāgrīvāśca caturdiśam| prāsādo'yaṃ mahāpadmo brahmaṇaḥ śaṅkarasya ca ||198 dvitīyo'lindake'syaiva prāgrīvāḥ syuścaturdiśam| alindena parikṣipto haṃsa eṣa prakīrtitaḥ ||199 prāgrīvo'sya mahāpadmasyālindenāvṛto yadā| karṇaprāgrīvakau dvau dvau vyomasaṃjñastadā bhavet ||200 haṃsasyaiva valabhyaḥ syuḥ prāgrīvāṇāṃ pade yadā| catuḥstambhāḥ parikṣiptā alindena caturdiśam ||201 tadā candro dayo nāma prāsādo jāyate śubhaḥ| evameṣāṃ catuṣṣaṣṭiḥ prāsādānāmudāhṛtā ||202 iti surabhavanānāṃ saptatirdāravāṇā-| miha sadanacatuṣkeṇānviteyaṃ pradiṣṭā || janamayamavakośānandaśubhrāṃśulekhā| bhavati suviditaiṣā śilpināṃ kāmadhenuḥ ||203 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre rucakādicatuṣṣaṣṭiprāsādalakṣaṇaṃ nāmaikonapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ| <50> atha prāsādaśubhāśubhalakṣaṇaṃ nāma pañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ| prāsādānāmatha brūmo lakṣaṇāni bhavanti ye| praśastāścāpraśastāśca tasminnavanimaṇḍale ||1 ye samāḥ samakarṇāśca samastambhāḥ samakṣaṇāḥ| naivoccā nātihrasvāśca karṇāyāmādavihvalāḥ ||2 asaṃmūḍhā vibhāgena pramāṇena susaṃsthitāḥ| ūrdhvādhaḥ karṇapādībhirupetāḥ salilāntaraiḥ ||3 asaṅkīrṇodayaiśchādyaiḥ svamānaparikalpitaiḥ| suvibhaktāḥ susaṃsthāśca ramyairavikalaiḥ kṛtāḥ ||4 samabhāgavibhaktaiśca yuktāścālindakaiḥ samaiḥ| svajātipariveṣādyā nānyajātipradūṣitāḥ ||5 asaṅkīrṇāḥ śarīreṇa saṃsthānena susaṃsthitāḥ| kevalā jātiśuddhāśca prāsādāḥ śubhadā nṛṇām ||6 sudṛḍhairmūlapādaiśca ddaḍhāścāmūlamastakam| nādharottarayuktāśca suśliṣṭadra vyasandhibhiḥ ||7 devajātiprasiddhaiśca bhūṣaṇaiḥ suvibhūṣitāḥ| prāsādāḥ śubhadā nityaṃ pūjāsaṃskāravardhanāḥ ||8 kartā kārayitā caiṣāṃ parāṃ vṛddhimavāpnuyāt| adhamānapi vakṣyāmaḥ prāsādānavalakṣaṇaiḥ ||9 viṣamāḥ karṇahīnāśca kleśabandhabhayāvahāḥ| stambhaiḥ kṣaṇaiśca viṣamaiḥ svāmino mṛtyuhetavaḥ ||10 atyuccaiḥ syādbhayaṃ rājño hrasvaiḥ senā ca mathyate| karṇāyāmena vikalāḥ prāsādāḥ syurbhayaṅkarāḥ ||11 vibhāgena vihīnāstu dāridra ybhayadāḥ smṛtāḥ| naṣṭābhiḥ karṇapādībhirudvegajananā nṛṇām ||12 chādyaiḥ saṅkīrṇakairhīnaiḥ kulakṣayakarāḥ smṛtāḥ| durvibhaktāḥ kusaṃsthāśca dra vyairvikalasaṃyutaiḥ ||13 rogaṃ kleśaṃ ca mṛtyuṃ ca kramaśo vitaranti te| viṣamairbhāgahīnaiścāpyalindairvyādhito bhayam ||14 parājayaṃ parivṛtairanyajātipradūṣitaiḥ| ye parāvṛtayo ye'nyasaṅkīrṇā ye'nyavigrahāḥ ||15 kartuḥ kārayiturnaite nandakā vāpi cātmanaḥ| durbalā mūlapādena viśliṣṭaiḥ pīṭhasandhibhiḥ ||16 alpāyuṣaste prāsādā bhavanti ca bhayāvahāḥ| adharottaragaiḥ śliṣṭairvijñeyā vyādhikāriṇaḥ ||17 ādeśairbhūṣaṇairyuktāḥ prāsādā na sukhāvahāḥ| ye kīrttimicchanti jayanti bhūtān kuryuḥ śubhairlakṣmabhiranvitāṃste| prāsādamukhyānitare tu varjyāstejoyaśaḥśrīvijayādikāmaiḥ ||18 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre prāsādaśubhāśubhalakṣaṇaṃ nāma pañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ| <51> athāyatananiveśo nāmaikapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ| evaṃ nṛpasya prāsāde kṛte kḷpta'thavā bhuvi| tasyānuśīvinaḥ kuryuḥ prāsādān paridhau yadi ||1 tadā digbhāgavinyāsasthānamānānyanukramāt| teṣāmihābhidhīyante sarveṣāṃ vṛddhihetave ||2 daśāṣṭau ṣaṭca dhanuṣāṃ śatāni kṣmābhṛtāṃ kramāt| mānamāyatanasyoktaṃ tredhā śreṣṭhādibhedataḥ ||3 kṣetramāyatanasyaivaṃ caturaśraṃ samantataḥ| tatra bhaktāḥ prakurvīraṃstridhā sve svāmivatsalāḥ ||4 ye cāsya sammatāḥ kecitkule jātā hitaiṣiṇaḥ| dvādaśāṃśena hīnāni kramāt tānyanujanmanām ||5 tasyaiva vāmataḥ kuryādutsedhāddviguṇāntare| kuryāddaśāṃśahīnāni nairṛtyāṃ diśi bhūpateḥ ||6 prāsādānnṛpapatnīnāṃ sarvāsāmapi śāstravit| aṣṭabhāgena hīnāni pratīcyāṃ diśi kārayet ||7 devadhiṣṇyāni tantraiḥ syāt svasurāṇāṃ vidhānataḥ| saumyāyāṃ mārutīṃ yāvannavāṃśāpacitāḥ kramāt ||8 prāsādā mantrisenānīpratīhārapurodhasām| eteṣāṃ pūrvabhāgasthaṃ rājamāturniveśanam ||9 hīnamekādaśāṃśena tatkāryaṃ rājakāritā| aiśīmāśritya devānāṃ tulyamaindra padāvadhi ||10 svasṝṇāṃ mātulānāṃ ca kumārāṇāṃ tathā kramāt| āgneyyāṃ dvijamukhyānāṃ vidhātavyaṃ niveśanam ||11 kāryaḥ purodhaḥprāsādaḥ tulyatatpunareva vā| yāmyāyāṃ kuryuraṣṭāṃśahīnānyurvīśamandirāt ||12 sāmantakuñjarārohabhaṭapaurajanāḥ kramāt| etānyāyatanānyeṣāṃ yathābhāgaṃ prakalpayet ||13 marmavedhapradeśasthān dvāravedhagatānapi| svasthānāntaritāṃścaitān na kuryāddhitakāmyayā ||14 alindairgarbhakoṣṭhaiśca sīmāstambhagavākṣakaiḥ| dvāradra vyatalocchrāyaiḥ prāggrīvaiḥ siṃhakarṇakaiḥ ||15 na kuryādbhūṣaṇaistulyaṃ samaṃ vāsthaṃdarūpataḥ| samarūpaṃ bhaveddharmyaṃ niryuktaṃ ca na nandati ||16 rājapīḍā bhavettasminnādhikye ca kulakṣayaḥ| prāsādādbhūmipālasya niveśaṃ paridhau sthitam ||17 dra vyeṇa katareṇāpi notkṛṣṭaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ| saṃsthānānmānataścāpi vistāreṇocchrayeṇa vā ||18 pūrvoktebhyo vibhāgebhyaḥ kiñciddhīnatamaḥ śubhaḥ| anyonyaṃ dviguṇacchādyairekaikasyāntaraṃ śubham ||19 subhogyaṃ taṃ ca kurvīta bahubhirbhavanāntaraiḥ| koṣṭhikābhojanāgārairbhāṇḍopaskaradhāmabhiḥ ||20 śilālūṣāta śālābhiḥ śeṣaṃ tu paripūrayet| praśastān kārayetsarvāñśubharūpān manoramān ||21 prāyaśaḥ svālayāṃścānyān sarvasyānyagṛhāṇi ca| narendrā yatanasyaiva niveśātparikalpayet ||22 anyathātve mahādoṣā vaiparītye kulakṣayaḥ| iti kathitadigādibhedayogaiḥ| surabhavanāni bhavanti yasya rājñaḥ || aviratamuditoditapratāpaḥ| svabhujajitāṃ sa ciraṃ praśāsti pṛthvīm ||23 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre āyatananiveśo nāmaikapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ| <52> atha prāsādajātirnāma dvipañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ| avatāro niveśānāṃ vidhānaṃ vāstuno yataḥ| kārtsnyena tamato brūmaḥ sabhyasya prasavottamaḥ ||1 kulajātikramāṇāṃ ca kramaṃ dīrghālpajīvinām| saṃsthānamabhidhāsyāmo lakṣyalakṣaṇameva ca ||2 śubhāśubhānāṃ vairājamādiṃ teṣāṃ pracakṣate| pūrvoktasya vimānasya tasyāto lakṣma kathyate ||3 vairājasya yathākāravyavasthānamaśeṣataḥ| caturaśraṃ samaṃ kṣetramaśītyaṃśairvibhājayet ||4 saṃyuktamaṣṭabhirbhāgaiḥ kuryādgarbhagṛhaṃ śubham| dvipañcāśaddharaiḥ sīmā garbhakoṣṭhasamanvitāḥ ||5 dvātriṃśatā devakoṣṭhaiḥ sarvairekāntaraiśca taiḥ| bāhyasthāne tataḥ sthānād dvādaśakṣobhaṇairdharaiḥ ||6 hemaratnamayaiḥ stambhaiḥ śuklapaṭṭaiśca bhūṣitaiḥ| śuklālaṅkārakhacitairvitānaiśca vibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||7 sphāṭikairvividhairjālaiḥ saharinmaṇivedikaiḥ| haṃsakarṇakapotālītiryaksthālyardhakarṇikaiḥ ||8 paryantadeśadhṛtayā garbhasyopari ghaṇṭayā| lokanāthena tatsṛṣṭamādyaṃ vairājasaṃjñitam ||9 tasmātsvastikasaṃjñaḥ prāggṛhacchando vijāyate| catuśśālastriśālaśca hiraṇyaukastvato'pi ca ||10 siddhārthako dviśālaḥ syādekaśālastu kumbhakaḥ| sṛṣṭamanyadvimānaṃ ca varaṃ vīraṃ caturmukham ||11 gaṇānāṃ devatānāṃ ca skandasya ca yathākramam| prāsādā dvādaśaite'nye jajñire śubhalakṣaṇāḥ ||12 svastikaḥ śrītaruścaiva tṛtīyaḥ kṣitibhūṣaṇaḥ| bhūjayo vijayo bhadraḥ śrīkūṭoṣṇīṣasaṃjñitau ||13 nandyāvarto vimānaśca sarvato bhadra eva ca| vimuktakoṇaprāsāda iti vairājasaṃbhavāḥ ||14 ekaikasmātkrameṇaivamekaikaḥ samajāyata| svastikād rucako jñeyaḥ śrītaroḥ hiṃpañjaraḥ ||15 kṣmābhūṣaṇāttaśālā syādbhūjayādgayūthapaḥ| vijayādavataṃsaśca bhadrā nnandī vinirgataḥ ||16 śrīkūṭāccitrakūṭākhya uṣṇīṣātpramadāpriyaḥ| vyāmiśro nandikāvartādvimānāddhastijāvakaḥ ||17 kuberaḥ sarvatobhadrā nmuktakoṇāddharādharaḥ| etebhyo'pi ca saṃbhūtāḥ kanīyāṃso'bhidhānataḥ ||18 tadbhedāste tadākārairlakṣyāḥ svaiḥ svaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ| bhāgaisteṣūttamaiḥ pūrvān madhyamānmadhyamaistathā ||19 kanīyasaḥ kanīyobhiḥ prāsādānupakalpayet| śikharairaparaiḥ śliṣṭāḥ prāsādā jajñire tataḥ ||20 prathamo rucakasteṣu dvitīyo vardhamānakāḥ| avataṃsastṛtīyastu caturtho bhadra ucyate ||21 pañcamaḥ sarvatobhadraḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ syānmuktakoṇakaḥ| merurmandara ityaṣṭau vijñeyāḥ śikharottamāḥ ||22 caturaśrāḥ samākhyātā devānāmālayāḥ śubhāḥ| ete te vaṃśajāḥ sarve niveśyā brahmajātayaḥ ||23 vairājakulasaṃbhūtāḥ prāsādāḥ paramottamāḥ| etebhyo'nye'pi saṃbhūtāḥ putrapautraprapautrayaḥ ||24 svavaṃśāḥ suparīvārāḥ paravaṃśavivarjitāḥ| kartavyā bhūtikāmena tejasā śubhalakṣaṇāḥ ||25 nandakā vardhanāścaiva sarvakāmaphalapradāḥ| hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanākīrṇāḥ pūjāsaṃskāravardhanāḥ ||26 yadi hīnā bhavantyete paravaṃśena dūṣitāḥ| tadudvegaṃ nṛṇāṃ nityamarthanāśaṃ kulakṣayam ||27 pīḍāṃ ca svāminaḥ kuryuryadanyadapi garhitam| tasmādete vidhātavyā dūṣitā nānyajātibhiḥ ||28 iti vairājajātānāmutpattiḥ prakīrtitā| vairājajanmasurasadmaparampareya- muktaivamatra śubhalakṣmavatī samāsāt ānandakīrttidhanadhānyakarī kṛtā syā- danyādṛśī punaranarthaphalaiva kartuḥ ||29 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre prāsādajātirnāma dvipañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ| <53> atha jaghanyavāstudvāraṃ nāma tripañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ| brūmo jaghanyavāstūnāṃ dvāramānamataḥ param| vistāraṃ satalocchrāyaṃ dra vyavyāsavidhiṃ tathā ||1 kathitā ye nirādhārāḥ prāsādāstiryagāyatāḥ| teṣāṃ bhāgacatuṣkeṇa garbhavāsaṃ vibhājayet ||2 dvāraṃ sārdhena bhāgena kurvīta svārdhavistṛtam| dvāravistārapādena pedyāyā vistṛtirbhavet ||3 vistārārdhena piṇḍaḥ syāttatsamaḥ syādudumbaraḥ| sārdhamūlādumbarakaḥ śākhā vyāsavaśādbhavet ||4 caturvidhaśca kartavyaḥ pedyāpiṇḍaḥ pramāṇataḥ| śākhā tu pedyāpiṇḍaśca vistāreṇa vidhīyate ||5 śākhāvistārato rūpaśākhā syātsārdhavistṛtiḥ| ardhena pedyāpiṇḍasya khalvaśākhā vidhīyate ||6 rūpaśākhāsamāḥ kāryā vistārāttuṅgaśākhikāḥ| tuṅgāyā bāhyataḥ śākhāḥ kriyante yāstu kāścana ||7 aṣṭāṃśābhyadhikāḥ sarvāḥ kartavyā vistareṇa tāḥ| dvārasyāyāmavistārayogāt saṅkhyā bhavettu yā ||8 talodayasya tanmānaṃ garbhamaṇḍapayoḥ samam| yadi bhinnatalaṃ kartuṃ maṇḍapaḥ kaści hīyate ||9 dvārocchrite tadguṇānāṃ maṇḍape syāttalocchritiḥ| prāsādeṣu kanīyassu talamānamudāhṛtam ||10 ṣaḍbhāgābhyadhikaṃ jyeṣṭhe madhye'ṣṭāṃśādhikaṃ tataḥ| balavidhiḥ samapadaḥ prāsādasya vidhīyate ||11 nādhastāt sa prayoktavyo nordhvataścāpyudumbarāt| kumbhikābharaṇapaṭṭajayantīśīrṣakāyaphalakeṣu tulā| uktamiha yatprathamaṃ tannādhikaṃ pravidadhīta na hīnam ||12 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre jaghanyavāstudvāraṃ nāma tripañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ| <54> atha prāsādadvāramānādi nāma catuṣpañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ| idānīmabhidhāsyāmaḥ prāsādānāṃ yathākramam| dra vyeṣūdayavistāraṃ bāhalyaṃ paridhiṃ tathā ||1 prāsādabhāgikotsedhaṃ prāsādadvāramiṣyate| satryaṃ śocchritaṃ vāpi sārdhāṃśocchrayameva vā ||2 svīyasvīyodayādardhavistāraṃ ca tadiṣyate| vistṛtirbhāgaturyāṃśāt pedyāyāḥ sthaulyamardhataḥ ||3 pedyābāhalyavistīrṇā śākhā bhavati mānataḥ| uttarāṅgāni kurvīta pedyāśākhāsamāni tu ||4 sapādapedyāvistārā rūpaśākhā vidhīyate| rūpaśākhānvitaḥ kāryaḥ pīṭhabandhastathopari ||5 vṛttaṃ kāryamadhovṛtte patrakaiśca nirantaram| stambhācca dviguṇavyāsaṃ bharaṇaṃ bhūṣaṇānvitam ||6 rūpaśākhāsamaṃ tacca kartavyamatisundaram| ūrdhve samantāccāṣṭāṃśamātre taccaturaśrakam ||7 tadūrdhvaṃ bharaṇocchrāyaḥ syātpādonasamucchritiḥ| kapotaścāpyadhaśśīrṣagarbhaḥ sa ca vidhīyate ||8 sarathālayapatro vā svodayārdhavinirgamaḥ| tasyopariṣṭātkartavyaṃ syāducchālayapatrakam ||9 rathikā vidhātavyā dvayorapyucchritistayoḥ| sārdhapramāṇabharaṇādbhūṣā syātpuṣpakādibhiḥ ||10 rūpakairvā yathāśobhaṃ stabhikābhiśca sarvataḥ| kaṇṭakoyatribhāgona kūṭākāraṃ bhavedataḥ ||11 vibhūṣitaṃ siṃhacakrairhastituṇḍairathāpi vā| kapotādi vidhātavyamantare rūpaśākhayoḥ ||12 kāryaṃ viṣamasaṃkhyaṃ ca sarvametadvicakṣaṇaiḥ| tasmādbahirvidhātavyā sarvataḥ parimaṇḍalī ||13 antyaśākhāsamā sā ca pramāṇena vidhīyate| tasyāṃ saadvāraśākhāyāṃ yaśaḥ padmapatrikāḥ ||14 kāryātrā vācaśākhāyāstadvistārasamucchritāḥ| bhavedadhastādardhena grīvāyā rasanā tathā ||15 grīvayā sārdhayā tulyamantaraṃ patrakāṇyadhaḥ| bhāgadvayaṃ prakurvīta jaṅghā tryaṃśā tato'pyadhaḥ ||16 pedyāpiṇḍapramāṇena khalvaśākhā vidhīyate| pedyāpiṇḍasamo bāhyaśākhānyāsaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||17 krameṇānena kartavyāḥ śākhāḥ svalpā yadṛcchayā| na navabhyaḥ paraṃ kāryā dvāraśākhāḥ kathañcana ||18 nirgamo vā praveśo vā vistāreṇa samanvitaḥ| pedyāyā yadi vārdhena śākhānāṃ sa vidhīyate ||19 sārdhapedyāpiṇḍasamaḥ piṇḍasyodumbaro bhavet| talanyāsastadardhena bhūmiraṅgā ca tatsamāḥ ||20 udumbarakapiṇḍasya mānātsiṃhamukhāni ca| udumbarātpādahīnastulyo vābhyadhiko'thavā ||21 paṭṭasya piṇḍastrividho vistārātstambhato'dhikaḥ| bhāgapādasamastambho dvādaśāṃśaṃ prapīḍitaḥ ||22 bhāgadvaye ca kartavyo rūpalakṣaṇasaṃyutaḥ| catuṣṣaṣṭiprakāro'yaṃ nānārūpaprapañcataḥ ||23 stambhavistāravistīrṇaṃ piṇḍe tatpādavarjitam| vistārāttriguṇaṃ dairghyāddhīragrahaṇamiṣyate ||24 praviṣṭau stambhamāne staḥ kumbhikotkālakau sadā| talapaṭṭasamaṃ paṭṭamuttaraṃ parikalpayet ||25 tīraṃ tasya tribhāgena samutsedhādvidhīyate| kiñcidvinirgataṃ paṭṭādyathāśobhaṃ prakalpayet ||26 ata ūrdhvaṃ yathāśobhaṃ kaṇṭhakenāsanena ca| rathakaiścitrarūpaiśca kūṭāgāraiḥ satoraṇaiḥ ||27 alinde maṇḍape vāpi catuṣke valabhīṣu vā| vitānāni vicitrāṇi samutkṣiptatalāni ca ||28 lakṣaṇena ca yuktāni vidadhīta yathocitam| lumāḥ phalakavartībhiḥ kṛtāḥ samabhidadhmahe ||29 utkṣiptānāṃ ca ye bhedā jāyante sarvavāstuṣu| tumbinī lambinī helā śāntā kolā manoramā ||30 ādhmātā ceti saptaitā nāmataḥ kathitā lumāḥ| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre kānte bhūmitale śubhe ||31 sūtraṃ kṣetrasamaṃ kṛtvā karṇātkarṇaṃ vibhājayet| vinyasyedgarbhasūtrāṇi tayormadhyagatāni ca ||32 bhūyaścānyāni madhyeṣu sūtrāṇi viniveśayet| madhye vṛttaṃ samālikhya tumbikā kamalopamā ||33 kāryā bhāgīkṛtaṃ tatra vṛttaṃ kṣetre pravartayet| sūtre sūtre tu piṇḍasthāṃ lumāṃ sūtreṇa vālikhet ||34 lumāntareṣu sarveṣu vaikaṭyena ghuṣīkṛtam| tayorantarayormadhye lumāmūle vikarkaram ||35 dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ vā syāttataśca valinīṃ likhet| vyāsārdhenodayaśceha kartavyastatra maṇḍale ||36 sampātāttalasūtrāṇāṃ tumbikā ccordhvasūtritā| udayastalasūtrasya tumbikāyāstathāntaram ||37 pūrvasūtre lumāgreṣu kaṇṭakān kalpayed ṛjūn| bahisthāneṣu cānteṣu lakṣaṃ kuryātsuniścitam ||38 lakṣaṃ gṛhītvādhaḥsūtra ūrdhvasūtrāṇi lakṣayet| udaye kaṇṭakasyānte tadvadevānusantatam ||39 dāpayeduttaraṃ sūtraṃ lumānāṃ khalvakāni ca| piṇḍavyāsaṃ valīnāṃ cāpyeṣu kṣobhaṇavistṛtī ||40 lumā karṇagatā yā syādādhmātā sā prakīrtitā| chede pravartitānyā syātkiñcidūnā manoramā ||41 kolā tṛtīyā śānteti caturthī parikīrtitā| helākhyā pañcamī ṣaṣṭhī lambinī nāmato lumā ||42 saptamī tumbinītyetā māgasūtravinirgatāḥ| etābhiḥ kārayetkolaṃ vitānaṃ nayanotsavam ||43 kolāvilaṃ hastitālu cāṣṭapatraṃ śarāvakam| nāgavīthīvitānaṃ ca puṣpakaṃ bhramarāvalī ||44 haṃsapakṣaṃ karālaṃ ca vikaṭaṃ śaṅkhakuṭṭimam| śaṅkhanābhiḥ sapuṣpaṃ ca śuktivṛttakameva ca ||45 mandāraṃ kumudaṃ padmaṃ vikāsaṃ garuḍaprabham| purohataṃ purārohaṃ vidyunmandārakaṃ tathā ||46 etānyevaṃ vitānāni saṅkhyayā pañcaviṃśatiḥ| eteṣāṃ rūpanirmāṇamadhunā saṃpracakṣmahe ||47 samantāccaturaśre ca caturaśrāyate'thavā| kṣetre vṛttīkṛte nābhyaikayā tatkolamucyate ||48 caturaśre yadā kṣetre karṇasthāneṣu kṛtsnaśaḥ| caturaśranibandhena caturaśranibandhane ||49 valinī vikaṭākārā pūrvaṃ vṛttānyadhastathā| bhramavṛttaṃ ca yanmadhye paraṃ tatrāparā lumāḥ ||50 kriyante tumbikāḥ pañca yatra susthāḥ susaṃvṛtāḥ| mārgra stale'dhaḥsūtrasya tadbhavennayanotsavam ||51 kolāvilaṃ same kṣetra bhāgāṣṭakavibhājite| madhye dvibhāge vilikhedvṛttaṃ tumbikayānvite ||52 tatra bhramānte ca sūtre bhramān ṣoḍaśa kārayet| ṛjūni yāni sūtrāṇi lumāstāḥ parikalpayet ||53 yāni śeṣāṇi sūtrāṇi valinīstāḥ prakalpayet| tumbinyāṃ kārayedvṛttaṃ gajatālukamucyate ||54 aṣṭapatre catuṣṣaṣṭibhāgaṃ kṣetraṃ prakalpayet| lumāsthāneṣu patrāṇi khaṇḍitānyantaraistathā ||55 sampāṭeṣu samasteṣu tumbikāḥ sanniveśayet| vṛttākāraṃ śarāvaṃ syādvinyāsaṃ ca dharaiśca tat ||56 caturaśre'thavā vṛtte bhāgatrayavibhājite| niveśayennāgabandhaṃ sampāte valisūtrayoḥ ||57 vitānametatkathitaṃ yaścikīrṣati mānavaḥ| ūrdhvatiryaggatairnālaiḥ kriyate yannirantaram ||58 puṣpamālākulaṃ śrīmatpuṣpakaṃ tadudāhṛtam| aśokapallavākīrṇalumābhramanibandhanam ||59 caturaśrakriyāyuktaṃ sā proktā bhramarāvalī| ādhmātā karṇamāyātā tumbikāsthānasaṃśrayā ||60 tumbinī yatra madhye tu haṃsapakṣaṃ taducyate| asyaiva pakṣe tu yadā sambadhyeta manoramā ||61 tumbinī ca vipakṣeṣu karālaṃ tadudāhṛtam| kolā lumā syādvikaṭe śaṅkhe śāntā prakīrtitā ||62 śaṅkhanābhisamaṃ sūtraṃ tumbikāyāḥ pravartate| sarveṣvapi lumāsthāneṣvekarekhānvitaṃ bhavet ||63 śaṅkhanābhiriti proktaṃ vitānamidamuttamam| etasyaiva lumāsthāne tumbikā padmakāvṛtā ||64 valayairbhūṣitā yatsyātsapuṣpamiti tadviduḥ| kṣetre vṛttāyatākāre kārayecchuktisaṃjñakam ||65 vṛttākāre bhavetkṣetre vṛttaṃ valayakarmaṇā| caturaśre same kṣetre yallumārdhalumardhate ||66 vṛttakṣobhaṇabhaṅgāni tanmandārakamucyate| kumudaṃ kumudasyeva lumākṣepādihārdhataḥ ||67 padmake syādadhaḥkṣiptā vikāse madhyamā lumā| garuḍe garuḍo madhye nāgābharaṇaśobhitaḥ ||68 purogataṃ tadyadadho gatvā syādūrdhvagaṃ punaḥ| adho gatvā purārohamūrdhvamūrdhvaṃ tatopyadhaḥ ||69 vicitrakṣobhaṇākīrṇamante vṛttaṃ muhurmuhuḥ| aṣṭabhiścāśribhirmadhye vidyunmandārakaṃ bhavet ||70 mānonmānamatha brūmaḥ prāsādacchādyasaṃśrayam| ardhenacchādyavistārasyordhve vaṃśaṃ prakalpayet ||71 ayamardhodayaḥ prokta āvantyo nāmataḥ paraḥ| tryaṃśenacchādyavistārasyodayo vāmano bhavet ||72 vāmanāvantyayormadhye navadhā pravibhājayet| bhāgottarodayātte'ṣṭau vāmanādudayāḥ smṛtāḥ ||73 vātapatro'tha kauberaḥ śamanākhyastathāvalī| haṃsapṛṣṭho mahābhogī nāradaḥ śambukastathā ||74 vāmanaḥ prathamasteṣāmāvantyote daśetyamī| chādyānāmatha vṛttānāmudayaḥ procyate'dhunā ||75 talasūtrasamaṃ kṛtvā kuryāddvādaśadhodayam| ṣaṣṭhādārabhya bhāgātsyuḥ sapta bhāgottarodayāḥ ||76 kuberaśekharī candrī nāgaścātu gaṇādhipaḥ| mukhyaścācchaḥ subhadra śca vṛtte saptodayāḥ smṛtāḥ ||77 kṛtvā trikarkarapadaṃ lumāpṛṣṭhaṃ likhettataḥ| bhāgārdhamadhikaṃ jñetre bhavecchādyakavartanā ||78 bhāgārdhavardhite kṣetre talasūtrakramānvite| lumāmādyāṃ likhedbhūyaḥ ṣaṭkrameṇātusantatam ||79 rikṣā yathādvihastāya lumāyāḥ syādanantaram| lumā tribhāgahīnena parivṛddhāṅgulena sā ||80 tasyāścānantarā lakṣmyā sādhaṃ vṛddhāṅgulatrayam| tryaṃśonaiḥ ṣaḍbhiraparā tryaṃśonairdaśabhiḥ parā ||81 caturdaśabhiranyā syātsārdhairvṛddhā tato'ṅgulaiḥ| viṃśatyaṅgulavṛddhā tu saptamī koṇasaṃśritā ||82 krameṇānena mānāni lumānāṃ vṛddhihrāsayoḥ| anupātena kāryāṇi cchādyakṣetrānusārataḥ ||83 kuberavallarīcandrī pannagā gaṇanāyakaḥ| mugdhā subhadre tyetāḥ syurlumākarmārdhamāditaḥ ||84 etāsāṃ gaṇḍikāchedāścatvāraḥ parikīrtitāḥ| ūrdhvastiryaggatistryaṃśastathārdhatryaṃśa eva ca ||85 chādyakodayavistāraṃ tannirgamasamāyati| kṛtvā ṣoḍhā bhajetkṣetraṃ vistārāyāmataḥ samam ||86 tatrordhvadra vyamānenacchindyātprāgeva gaṇḍikām| tasyāṃ chedānusāreṇa dāpayedeva lambakam ||87 adhastādgaṇḍikāyāśca kaṇṭakāni prakalpayet| avapātocchrayau jñātvā trīṇi sthānāni cihnayet ||88 garbhe tathordhve prānte ca tṛtīyaṃ madhyatastayoḥ| yatra sthāne sthitaṃ sūtraṃ spṛśati sthānakatraye ||89 tasmātprasārya tatsūtraṃ bhramayetkarkaṭaṃ tataḥ| lumārdhasyaivamupari saṃsthānamupajāyate ||90 upari sthitena sūtreṇa tattulyenaiva karkaṭam| prāntāvalambakasthāne bhramayetkhalvasiddhaye ||91 prāgakṣe bhāgayugalāvacchinnaṃ phalake punaḥ| kalpayetsamamevaiṣā lumāpārṣṇirnigadyate ||92 śeṣāṃ lumāṃ tu dīrghāṃśaiścaturbhiḥ pravibhājayet| caturdhātaḥ paraṃ tasyāḥ kartavyaṃ vṛttavartanam ||93 ardhodaye lumocchrāyo vistārāṃśadvayonmitaḥ| mūle'grataśca bhāgārdhamudayo'syā vidhīyate ||94 adhaḥkṣetre sa vistārātsūtramālambya tadyathā| vistārātsadṛśe kṣetre sārdhatadbhāgamāśritaḥ ||95 lumāgrabhāgatryaṃśaṃ ca tayormadhyaṃ ca yatsthitam| sūtraṃ spṛśettatra dhṛtvā karkaṭaṃ bhramayedbudhaḥ ||96 bhāgabhāgottarakṣetrāpekṣayā catasṛṣvapi| gaṇḍikāsu vidhātavyaṃ vidhivadvṛttavartanam ||97 mūlāllumāyāḥ kṣetrasya pañcamāṃśatraye'thavā| pṛthutvārdhe lumāpṛṣṭhalekhāvṛttadvayaṃ yathā ||98 saṃpatatyevamālikhya śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret| lumāyā mūlataḥ kṣetrasaptamāṃśacatuṣṭaye ||99 pṛthutvārdhe lumāpṛṣṭhalekhāvṛttadvayaṃ yathā| saṃpatatyevamālikhya ṣaḍbhāgaiḥ śeṣamācaret ||100 navāṃśapañcake yadvā kṣetrasyaiva lumāditaḥ| pṛthutvārdhe lumāpṛṣṭhadvayalekhāṃ niveśayet ||101 śeṣaiḥ ṣaḍbhistato bhāgairanyattu prāgvadācaret| bhāgārdhaṃ nirgamaḥ kāryaḥ prāsādānāṃ kanīyasām ||102 chādyakasyaiva bhāgaistu jyāyasāṃ nirgamo yataḥ| tadantare ye prāsādāsteṣāṃ kṣetrānusārataḥ ||103 chādyasya nirgamaḥ kāryo vidvadbhiranupātataḥ| nirgamasya tribhāgena kanīyāñchādyakodayaḥ ||104 ardhabhāgena paramo bhājyaṃ ṣaḍbhistadantaram| anye bhāgottarāḥ pañca saptaiva mudayā matāḥ ||105 idānīmabhidhāsyāmaḥ siṃhakarṇasya lakṣaṇam| chādyodayodayaḥ sa syāddaśabhistaṃ vibhājayet ||106 taiḥ syāt ṣoḍaśabhirbhāgaistasyaiva talavistṛtiḥ| ūrdhvataścaturo bhāgāṃstyaktvā śaṅkuṃ niveśayet ||107 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre karṇenārabhya śaṅkutaḥ| tato vṛttaṃ likhetpaścācchaṅkuṃ samadhiropayet ||108 ūrdhvadeśāttu bhāgena sa syādbhāgacatuṣṭaye| likhedvṛttaṃ tribhāgonadvyaṃśakarkaṭakodbhavam ||109 tasyopariṣṭāttadanu grīvā kāryaikabhāginī| garbhe śṛṅgāgrayormadhye tiryagbhāgadvayaṃ bhavet ||110 madhye karṇāgrayostiryakkāryaṃ bhāgatrayaṃ budhaiḥ| grīvāyā upariṣṭācca bhāgamekaṃ śikhā bhavet ||111 śikhāgramupariṣṭācca kartavyaṃ garbhasaṅgatam| śikhāgramūrdhvatastadvadardhabhāgāvalambitam ||112 bhāgāvalambi karṇāgraṃ skandhāgraṃ tāvadeva tu| syātkarṇakhaṇḍayormūlaṃ skandhadeśasya saṅgatam ||113 svastiko dvyaṃśavistārāyāmaḥ prāgvṛttamadhyataḥ| evaṃ śaṅkumadhaḥsūtrādūrdhvaṃ bhāgo niveśayet ||114 bhāge niveśitaṃ kuryātpūrvavṛttādyaśeṣataḥ| svastikāntaṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ pūrvavatsarvamācaret ||115 talasūtrāduparyaṃśaiścaturbhirgarbhataḥ samaḥ| dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāmubhayato bhāgābhyāṃ tiryageva ca ||116 bhāgena tadvadevādhaḥsūtrādupari garbhataḥ| caturbhiśca caturbhiśca bhāgairubhayataḥ samam ||117 vṛttārdhāni likhedekakarṇayuktāni pūrvavat| ekaśṛṅgāṇi ca grīvāsvastikārdhayutāni ca ||118 talasūtrabahirdeśādbāhyavṛttasamudbhavaḥ| padatrayapraviṣṭaḥ syātpārṣṇiratra parisphuṭaḥ ||119 trivalīlalito nāma siṃhakarṇo'yamīritaḥ| daśabhāgīkṛte prāgvadudaye tatpramāṇataḥ ||120 caturdaśāṃśavistīrṇe karṇe sārdhe valirbhavet| daśabhāgocchrite prāgvatsyāttrayodaśavistṛtaḥ ||121 kṣetra ekavalirnāma siṃhakarṇastathāparaḥ| ete śobhānvitāḥ kāryāstryaśrasaṃvaraṇāstrayaḥ ||122 prāsādānāmiti nigaditaṃ dvāramānaṃ niveśaḥ| stambhānāṃ ca sphuṭamiha vitānāni teṣāṃ lumāśca| vṛttacchādyocchritirabhihitā chādyasaṃsthā lumāśca| proktāḥ sapta prathitamaparaṃ siṃhakarṇapramāṇam ||123 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre prāsādadvārastambhaniveśavitānalumālakṣaṇavṛttacchādyalumā-siṃhaṃkarṇapramāṇaṃ nāma catuṣpañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ| <55> atha mervādiṣoḍaśaprāsādādilakṣaṇaṃ nāma pañcapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ| prāmādānāmato lakṣma ṣoḍaśānāṃ viśeṣataḥ| jyeṣṭhamadhyakaniṣṭhānāṃ yathāvadabhidadhmahe ||1 vibhajyate yathā yena prāgaścordhva vidhīyate| yāvadyasya pramāṇaṃ tu tathā tattasya kathyate ||2 meruḥ prāsādarājaśca kailāsaśca harapriyaḥ| sarvatobhadra kaścaiva vimānacchadanandanau ||3 svastiko muktakoṇaśca śrīvatso haṃsasaṃjñitaḥ| rucakro vardhamānaśca garuḍaśca gajastathā ||4 mṛgarājaśca padmaśca valabhī ceti te smṛtāḥ| na trayastriṃśato'dhastānnāpi pañcāśataḥ parā ||5 saṅkhyā bhavati hastānāṃ meroriti purāvidaḥ| vibhajya daśadhā kṣetraṃ śṛṅgaṃ kuryād dvibhāgikam ||6 kṛtvā ṣaḍbhāgikaṃ madhyaṃ nirgamastatra dīyate| bhāgasya ṣoḍaśāṃśena vidheyaṃ salilāntaram ||7 padaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirgarbhe vidheyā cāsya vistṛtiḥ| prāsādabhitti padikā padavistṛtamantaram ||8 padikā bāhyabhittiḥ syādityeṣa sa tadā smṛtaḥ| dvipado vedikābandho jaṅghā pañcapadodayā ||9 padārdhena padārdhena mekhalāntarapatrake| śṛṅgocchritistribhirbhāgairnavabhiḥ śikharocchritiḥ ||10 śikharasyāsya kartavyāstajjñaiḥ ṣoḍaśa bhūmikāḥ| skandhaoṃ'śairvistṛtaḥ ṣaḍbhiraṃśenocchritamaṇḍakam ||11 grīvā vaṃśocchritā kāryā śikharasyādivistṛtau| ṣaḍguṇenaiva sūtreṇa veṇukośaṃ samālikhet ||12 vistṛterapi bhadrā yāḥ kuryāddviguṇamucchrayam| kumbhaṃ bhāgena kurvīta prāsādeṣvakhileṣvapi ||13 evameṣa catuḥśṛṅgaścaturdvāropaśobhitaḥ| merurmerūpamaḥ kāryo vāñchatā śubhamātmanaḥ ||14 sarvasvarṇamayaṃ meruṃ yaddattvā puṇyamāpnuyāt| tamiṣṭakāśailamayaṃ kṛtvā tadadhikaṃ bhajet ||15 meruḥ| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre saptaviṃśatipāṇikam| daśadhā vibhajetsa syātkailāsaḥ puṇyavardhanaḥ ||16 brahmakoṣṭhagato garbhaḥ śeṣaṃ bhittyandhakārikā| caturbhāgaṃ bhavedbhadraṃ mūlakarṇau tribhāgikau ||17 saptabhāgocchritā jaṅghā mekhalā cārdhabhāgikā| bhāgenāntarapatraṃ syādbhāgenāṇḍakamucchritam ||18 grīvāgrabhāgamutsedhācchikharaṃ daśakocchritam| ardhaṣaṣṭhāṃśavistāraḥ skandhaḥ kailāsasaṃjñite ||19 asminnantarapatre tu sūtraṃ dattvā sutāḍitam| triguṇena likhettena veṇukośaṃ manoramam ||20 aṣṭabhūmyucchrayaḥ śrīmān mañjaryā ca virājitaḥ| ucchrayaścāsya kartavyo dviguṇaḥ śriyamicchatā ||21 kāryaṃ ṣaḍbhūmikaṃ cāsya bhadraṃ bhāgārdhanirgatam| pākaḥ siṃhakarṇasyuḥ samāptirnāyakena ca ||22 kailāsa eṣa kathito viśeṣeṇa harapriyaḥ| kailāsaḥ| idānīṃ sarvatobhadraḥ prāsādaḥ parikīrtyate ||23 sa syāt ṣaḍviṃśatiṃ hastān paramaḥ parimāṇataḥ| jaṭharaṃ bāhyasīmā ca bhittayo hyandhakārikāḥ ||24 jaṅghotsedhaśca karṇau ca yathā merostathā smṛtāḥ| tathaiva bhadra vistāraiḥ kāryo bhāgārdhanirgataḥ ||25 rathikaikā caturbhāgā tataḥ sārdhadvibhāgikā| tāsāṃ parasparaṃ jñeyo bhāgabhāgaṃ vidhīyate ||26 ṣaḍbhāgāt vistṛtaṃ kāryaṃ śikharaṃ saptamocchritam| ṣaḍbhirdaśabhirbhāgaiḥ syānmūlajā skandhavistṛtiḥ ||27 grīvārdhabhāgamutsedhādaṇḍakaṃ bhāgamucchritam| mūlasūtrānusāreṇa cchedaḥ saṃyujyate yathā ||28 asya rekhā tathā kāryā sarvaśreyaḥprasādhanī| merorasya ca śṛṅgāṇi siṃhakarṇairvibhūṣayet ||29 mañjarīṃ padmakośāgratulyāṃ sarvatra kārayet| jayaṃ lakṣmīṃ yaśaḥ kīrttiṃ sarvāṇīṣṭaphalāni ca ||30 karoti sarvato bhadraṃ sarvatobhadra kaḥ kṛtaḥ| sarvatobhadraḥ| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre vibhāgaśatabhājite ||31 vimānaṃ vibhajet prājñaḥ śreyaḥpuṣṭisukhāvaham| bhadrai ścaturbhistatkuryātkarṇaprāggrīvakaistathā ||32 pañcabhūmirbhavatyeṣa yadi vā trividhā bhavet| hastāstriṃśadbhavejjyeṣṭho madhyamaḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ ||33 syāḍekaviṃśatirhastātkanīyān ṣoḍaśāthavā| jātiśuddho bhavedeko mañjaryā vai paro bhavet ||34 miśrako'nyo vimānānāmiti saṃkhyā tridhoditā| jyeṣṭho miśrakanirmāṇaḥ sa ca kaulāśabhadra kṛt ||35 madhyamo jātiśuddhaḥ syātkanīyān mañjarīyutaḥ| pañcabhāgayutaṃ bhadraṃ vistareṇa prakīrtitam ||36 karṇaprāggrīvavistāraḥ kartavyo bhāgasaṃmitaḥ| bhāgārdhaṃ kṣobhaṇe kāryaṃ talipaṃ tajhalāntaraṃ ||37 guptakarṇaṃ tu kartavyaṃ yadicchellakṣaṇānvitam| tasmādbhadra sya niṣkaṃśaṃ bhāgenaikena kārayet ||38 miśrakasya caturbhāgaṃ bhadraṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ| pañcabhāgocchritā jaṅghā khurapiṇḍakayā saha ||39 dvibhā rathikā kāryā bhūmiḥ syāccaturaṃśakā| dvitīyārdhāṃśahīnā ca tṛtīyā bhūmiriṣyate ||40 caturthe tu tribhirbhāgairardhahīnā tu pañcamī| udayo bhūmikāyā yaḥ kūṭaṃ kuryāttadardhataḥ ||41 ardhena kumbhikāṃ kuryāducchālakasamanvitām| ūrdhvabhavastu pañcamyā vedikā bhāgamucchritā ||42 ghaṇṭā ṣaḍbhāgavistārā kāryā bhāgadvayocchritā| ghaṇṭotsedhaṃ tribhirbhāgairvibhajettadanantaram ||43 bhāgikāni prakurvīta kaṇṭhagrīvāṇḍakāni ca| bhāgaṃ kaṇṭhapradeśaḥ syāddaṇḍikāyāḥ samucchritiḥ ||44 ghaṇṭārdhena vidhātavyā dvibhāgā kalaśocchritiḥ| sūrasenādikaṃ sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ pūrvavattathā ||45 bhadraṃ manoramaiśceha siṃhakarṇairvibhūṣayet| pañcavyāsena sūtreṇa padmakośaṃ samālikhet ||46 latātayo bhavedeṣāṃ latābhistaṃ prakalpayet| miśrako miśritairaṅgaiḥ śuddha syādbhūmikānvitaḥ ||47 vimānaḥ| nandanasya bhavetsīmā dvātriṃśaddhastanirmitaḥ| aṣṭāṣṭakavibhāgena catuḥṣaṣṭipado hi saḥ ||48 bhāgaiścaturbhirgarbho'sya śeṣaṃ bhittyandhakārikā| bhadraṃ garbhasamaṃ kāryaṃ tadūrdhvenāsya nirgamaḥ ||49 dvau rathau pārśvato bhūyaḥ sarvataḥ karṇasūtrataḥ| pañcabhāgocchritā jaṅghā mekhalā bhāgasaṃmitā ||50 ṣaḍbhamireṣa bhūmiḥ syādekaikā dvādaśāṃśakā| rekhāskandhāṇḍakādīnāṃ kailāse samākṛtiḥ ||51 nandano nandayatyeṣa samṛddhā hanti cāpadaḥ| nandanaḥ| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre pañcaviṃśati hastake ||52 sūtrapātaṃ tataḥ kuryātkarmāyatamukhāyatam| tataḥ sīmārdhasūtreṇa samyagvṛttaṃ samālikhet ||53 tatastadaṣṭāviṃśatyā bhajedbhāgairyathāpadam| nirmāpaye śālārdhena diksūtrasaṃśritāḥ ||54 tāsāṃ tu madhyagāḥ kāryā ekaikasya rathāstrayaḥ| anye cārdharathāḥ kāryāḥ śālākarṇasamāśritāḥ ||55 bhāgaṣaṭkocchritā jaṅghā bhāgārdhena tu mekhalāḥ| bhāgenāntarapatraṃ syādbhāgaṃ codvṛttamaṇḍakam ||56 ardhabhāgocchritā jīvā viṣkambhena catuṣpadām| śikharasyocchrayo bhāgairekādaśabhiriṣyate ||57 sarveṣāmeva latinā mātridhā dviguṇo hi saḥ| vistārāddviguṇaṃ sūtraṃ skandhādyaṃ cāpi ṣaḍguṇam ||58 suttānitaṃ samākṛṣya padmakośaṃ samālikhet| sa pañcaviṃśatirhastā jyeṣṭhaḥ ṣoḍaśa madhyamaḥ ||59 kanīyān dvādaśakaracchasyo vijānatā| jyeṣṭhasya bhāgasaṃkhyeyametadardhena madhyamaḥ ||60 madhyamasya tathārdhena kanīyān bhāgasaṃkhyayā| bhāgaṣaṭkamitā jaṅghā jyeṣṭhasya parikīrtitā ||61 saptabhāgocchritā sā syānmadhyame sakanīyasi| sarveṣāṃ latināmeṣa kṣetreṇa vidhirīritaḥ ||62 svastiko'yaṃ samākhyātaḥ svastiśreyaskaro nṛṇām| svastikaḥ| idānīṃ muktākoṇasya sūkṣma brūmaḥ sa tu tridhā ||63 ṣoḍaśa dvādaśāṣṭau ca hastasaṃkhyā parasya ca| jyeṣṭhaḥ ṣoḍaśabhirbhāgairmadhyo dvādaśabhirbhavet ||64 kanīyānaṣṭabhiḥ proktaḥ prāsādo muktakoṇakaḥ| muktakoṇasvastikayoridamevāntaraṃ bhavet ||65 svastiko vartulastatra caturaśro'paraḥ smṛtaḥ| pañcabhāgonnatā jaṅghā dvau bhāgau rathikā bhavet ||66 bhāgaiścaturbhiḥ kartavyā dvitīyā tasya bhūmikā| yeṣāstvardhārdhabhāgena vidheyāstasya bhūmikāḥ ||67 vidhāya navadhā garbhestaistryodaśabhirbhavet| jaṅghāpādonapañcāśairādyaikaḥṣpaṇikā bhavet ||68 muktakoṇaḥ| vistāraṃ daśadhā kṛtvā ṣaḍbhāgaṃ madhyamālikhet| karṇā dvirbhāgiko madhyaṃ caturdhā vibhajetpunaḥ ||69 tadvanmadhye kṛtau dvyaṃśau bhāgikau vāmadakṣiṇau| aṅgulīkarasaṃkhyātairvidheyo rathanirgamaḥ ||70 prāggrīvairvikaṭaiḥ svaṣṭaiḥ stambhaiḥ sadbhūpakarmabhiḥ| evaṃ guṇasamāyuktaḥ śrīvatsaḥ sukhado bhavet ||71 dvyaṅgulaṃ tryaṅgulaṃ vāpi caturaṅgulameva ca| udakāntarakaṃ kāryaṃ śrīvatso nandanopi ca ||72 śrīvatsaḥ| vistārairdaśadhā bhaktaiḥ ṣaḍbhāmañjarī bhavet| sarvatobhadra vanmūlakarṇāvasya dvibhāgikau ||73 udakāntaramanyasya śrīvatsasyeva kalpayet| haṃso'yaṃ kīrtitaḥ samyak śubhado lakṣaṇānvitaḥ ||74 haṃsaḥ| rucako'pyevameva syādudakāntaravarjitām| bhittayaścaturaṃśena garbho vyāsārdhasaṃmataḥ ||75 rucakaḥ| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre vibhajeddaśabhiḥ padaiḥ | vidadhyādardhamānākhyaṃ tatra bhrāntamanukramāt ||76 bhadra sya ca bhavedbhāgaiścaturbhiḥ parivistṛtam| ekenaikena bhāgena dvau rathau vāmadakṣiṇau ||77 dvibhāgavistṛtau karṇau nirgamaḥ syātkarāṅgulaiḥ| vardhamānaḥ kriyāyukto yaśolakṣmīṃ vivardhayet ||78 racako vardhamāno vā śrīvatso haṃsa eva ca| ya eko rocate teṣu nyasettaṃ garuḍe sudhīḥ ||79 pakṣāvetasya kartavyau prāsādārdhavinirgamau| nāsikāṃ vainateyasya trigarbhāṃ kārayedapi ||80 garuḍaḥ| catuḥṣaṣṭipade kṣetre prāsādaṃ vibhajecchubham| kṣetrārdhena ca sūtreṇa pṛṣṭhato vṛttamālikhet ||81 bhāgaiścaturbhirjaṃṅghāsya mekhalācārdhabhāgikā| purataḥ sūrasoyaṃ pṛṣṭhataśca gajākṛtiḥ ||82 gajaḥ| catuḥṣaṣṭipadaḥ siṃho bhadraṃ bhāgacatuṣṭayam| dvyaṃśakau mūlakarṇau ca garbhaḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ padaiḥ ||83 vistārārdhe bhavejjaṅghā mekhalā padikā bhavet| ekaikā rathikā cāsya bhavedbhāgatrayocchritā ||84 sarvatobhadra vaccāsyā rekhāgrīvāṇḍakādikam| siṃhākrāntaistathā bhadraiḥ prāsādaḥ siṃha ucyate ||85 vikramārjavaśīlānāṃ prāsādo'yaṃ śubhāvahaḥ| siṃhaḥ| padmasya hastasaṃkhyā syāt ṣoḍaśa dvādaśāthavā ||86 vartulaḥ sa ca kartavyaḥ sūtraṃ tu svastike yathā| sarve rathāḥ smṛtāḥ padmapatrākṛtimanoramāḥ ||87 udakāntarakaṃ kuryācchreyase nandane yathā| padmakaḥ| svastikasya yathā pūrvaṃ kathitaṃ mānalakṣaṇam ||88 tenaiva lakṣalitaḥ sarvo vidadhīta vicakṣaṇaḥ| yathāmūlavibhaktastu latiṣu svastikādiṣu ||89 yathāskandhavibhāgo'pi rekhāmadhyavibhāgataḥ| svastikāṅko vidhātavyaḥ śukanāśocchayācchubhaḥ ||90 prāsādānāṃ sa bhāgaiḥ syātsaptabhirvihitaḥ śriye| vimāne sa dharātryaṃśanyūnaḥ kāryo vipaścitā ||91 kailāso ca turaṃśonā vidhenā śukanāsikā| sarvatobhadra siṃhākhyau merūṇāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ ||92 ṣaḍbhirbhāgairvinā kāryā śukanāsā vijānatā| prāsādoccena sandhāro vimānādyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||93 vistārārdhena tadgarbho yaccheṣaṃ tena bhittayaḥ| prāsādajaṅghocchreyeṇa tulyo garbhatulodayaḥ ||94 sabhittirgarbhatulyaḥ syātsandhāreṣu tulodayaḥ| sa vidheyaḥ punarvyāsādyadi vā kiñcidunnataḥ ||95 mūlasūtraṃ tu daśadhā --- samālikhet| garbhasūtraṃ pratiṣṭāpya siṃhakarṇaṃ prakalpayet ||96 sārdhabhāgena sūtreṇa madhyamasya samālikhet| uro dvibhāgatulyaṃ tu mastakaṃ bhāgamucchritam ||97 ardhena vocchrayastasyāḥ pakṣocchrāyā dvibhāgikāḥ| uro ca sīmānte sūtreṇacchandamādiśet ||98 navadhā daśadhā caiva siṃhakarmāvubhau smṛtau| ekaṣaḍvistṛto bhāgā udayāt pañcabhāgikaḥ ||99 sūraseno dvitīyastu svātsamodayavistṛtiḥ| udayātsārdhavistīrṇaṃ siṃhakarṇastrisaṃkulā ||100 kāmalān mallakāṃścānyān siṃhakarṇāt pralopayet| prāsādānāṃ hi sarveṣāṃ sarvametadvibhūṣaṇam ||101 yasya yatrocitaṃ sthānaṃ tattatra viniveśayet| nirmitau valabhestiryaksūtraṃ kurvīta saptadhā ||102 pañcabhāgāṃśca mukhatastenaivāṃśena kalpayet| mekhalāntarapatre ca jambhākumbhakameva ca ||103 pañcabhāgocchritaṃ kuryāttadvacchikharamucchritam| kīrtitāni vimānāniyānyeva suravartmani ||104 tānyeva sthāvaratvena prāsādā iti viśrutāḥ| maheśvarasya kailāso viṣṇostu garuḍābhidhaḥ ||105 kāryaḥ prajāpateḥ padmo gaṇanāthasya ca dvipaḥ| na khalvete'nyadevānāṃ vidhātumucitāḥ smṛtāḥ ||106 yastu triviṣṭapaḥ sa syātsarvadevaniketanaḥ| asmāttu ye'nye prāsādāḥ smṛtāste'nekarūpiṇaḥ ||107 sarveṣāmeva devānāmabhedena bhavanti te| jagatyāṃ vistaraḥ kāryaḥ prāsādocchrayasaṃmitaḥ ||108 garbhordhenocchrayastasyāḥ śubhadaḥ parikīrtitaḥ| maṇḍapasya ṣaḍaṃśārdho pañcamāṃśādatha smṛtaḥ ||109 karṇaprāsādakāḥ kāryāḥ prāsādasya tribhāgataḥ| pūrvāparamukhāḥ kāryā ete yāmyottarānanāḥ ||110 aindre yāmye vāruṇe ca kaubere ca yathākramam| digbhāgeṣu caturṣveṣu valabhīṃ viniveśayet ||111 garbhavistāravistīrṇāṃ dvau tribhāgau mukhāyatām| iti bāhyaparīvāre jaṅghā prāsādamānataḥ ||112 tīryaṃgāyatamāropya sūtraṃ garbheṇa maṇḍape| gurukakṣo'tha kartavyā gavākṣastambhasaṃyutāḥ ||113 prāsādavistarātkāryo dviguṇo maṇḍapaḥ sadā| maṇḍapasyasavistārājagatī dviguṇā bahiḥ ||114 karṇaprāsādakāḥ kāryāḥ prāsādasyārdhato'pi vā| teṣāmadhyardhataḥ kuryādvalabhīnāṃ niveśanam ||115 anena kramayogena bāhyādbāhyaṃ susaṃvṛtam| yadā hi śobhate rājā keyūrāṅgadakuṇḍalaiḥ ||116 tathā prāsādarājo'yaṃ śobhate bhūṣaṇairnijaiḥ| dhvāsyārhāsyātisaumyasya śrīkīrtivijayāvahaḥ ||117 anena vidhinā nyastaḥ prāsādaḥ syātsadā nṛṇām| ādityaṃ pūrvato nyasyetkumāraṃ pūrvadakṣiṇe ||118 dakṣiṇe mātṛdevaistu gajāsyaṃ dakṣiṇopari| vinyasedvāruṇe gaurī vāyavye'pi ca caṇḍikām ||119 viṣṇuṃ kuberadigbhāge tathaiśānyāṃ maheśvaram| anyeṣāmapi devānāṃ kathyate tu kramo'dhunā ||120 tatraiśānyāṃ diśi nyasyedīśānaṃ lokanāyakam| dānavānāṃ nihantāraṃ pūrvasyāmapi vāsavam ||121 vaiśvānaraṃ tathāgneyyāṃ dharmarājaṃ ca dakṣiṇe| nairṛtyāṃ nirṛtiṃ nyasyetpratīcyāṃ tu pracetasam ||122 vāyuṃ vāyavyadigbhāge kuberamapi cottare| aṣṭhau hyete mahātmāno lokapālāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||123 pālayanti jagatsarvaṃ svasvasthāne pratiṣṭhitāḥ| purakarkaṭadurgeṣu grāmeṣu nagareṣu ca ||124 krameṇānena vinyastāḥ syuḥ prajānāṃ sukhāvahāḥ| na yatra devatābādhastatra dvāraṃ prakalpayet ||125 prāsādasyānusāreṇa bhaved dvāraṃ śubhāvaham| athātaḥ procyate samyagdvāramānamanukramāt ||126 jyeṣṭhamadhyakaniṣṭhānāṃ dra vyaṃ stambhānusaṅgatam| bhaveddvārāṃ prāsāde ṣoḍaśāṅgulam ||127 dvikare dviguṇaṃ tat syāttrikare dvikaraṃ śubham| catuṣkare catuḥṣaṣṭiraṅgulāni praśasyate ||128 ata ūrdhvaṃ pratikaraṃ tryaṅgulā vṛddhiriṣyate| dvārodayakaraistulyānyaṅgulāni niyojayet ||129 ṣohyājayavānyālardha dhruvake caturaṅgule| vistāro dviguṇastasya stambhapiṇḍaṃ sa eva hi ||130 ekadvitricatuṣpañcaṣaṭsaptakakarāvadhi| dvāravistārabhāgena stambhaḥ samyagvidhīyate ||131 caturbhāgena kartavyā sīmāstambhaḥ pramāṇataḥ| tathā stambhasya bāhulyāccaturbhāgavirbhāgavinā ||132 bhāgau tatra kartavyau hīragrahaṇamucchritam| bhāgatrayeṇa kartavyaḥ paṭṭasya ca samucchrayaḥ ||133 bhāgenaikena nīsyātavyavistāraṃ bhatribhāgaracyakim| paṭṭahaste vidhātavyamaṅguladvayanirgamam ||134 ---ḍa---stāraḥ stambhatulyaḥ praśasyate| ekaikamaṅgulaṃ paṭṭapārśvayoradhikastataḥ ||135 paṭṭadasya vistāraḥ kāryañcaturbhāgavibhājitaḥ| bhāgenaihkena cotsedhastulādhāraṇamiṣyate ||136 tulādhāraṇakotsedhāccaturbhāgavibhājitāt| bhāgamekaṃ parityajya piṇḍastasya vidhīyate ||137 mātrāhīnā bhavenmeḍhyāṃ tāvannyasyecchalāntale| dvau bhāgau mūlabhāgena jayantīpiṇḍavistarau ||138 iti hīragrahādīnāṃ samāsāllakṣmakīrtanam| pañcāṃśābhyadhikaṃ stambhavistārasthena kumbhikā ||139 kurvīta stambhataḥ sārdhā garga kumbhasya vistṛtīḥ| athavā stambhakarṇena stambhāgradviguṇā kvacit ||140 pādonastambhavistārādagrakumbhe samucchritiḥ| stambhavistārakarṇādvā yadvā piṇḍo'grakumbhake ||141 tasya bhāgān pravakṣyāmo yathākumbhaṃ sa yujyate| vibhakto'tra tridhā piṇḍo bhāgenaikena puttalī ||142 caturbhistasya madhyasya padmaṃ samālikhet| ucchāle pañcadhā bhakte tribhirāvartanaṃ --- ||143 vartanaṃ yoṣavyetkiñcinna ca khalvaṃ samācaret| vartane kumbhakumbhau tu sūtraṃ dattvā sutānitam ||144 padmānālāsamā sa syānna bhavetpaṅkivarjitā| navādhoccāhā lake bhakte vīragaṇḍastu bhāgikaḥ ||145 ekenaikena bhāgena vidheyā paṭṭikaṭṭikā| dhvasaṃchākāla kartavyaṃ bhāgadvitayasaṃmitam ||146 talakumbhakapiṇḍaṃ tu pañcadhā pravibhājayet| bhāgenaikena padmaṃ syādbhāgena kalaśaṃ likhet ||147 dvābhyāṃ samālikhet kumbhaṃ bhāgenaikena paṭṭikām| vartamānā catrā kāryā śobhā syādasya yāvataḥ ||148 eṣa kumbhakramaḥ proktaḥ stambhapāde vyavasthitaḥ| talapaṭṭasya piṇḍastu bhāgapaṭṭasamo bhavet ||149 dra vyeṣvatra hi sarveṣu samyakśobhā vivakṣitā| nyūnātiriktamapyasmānmāneṣvaṅgulamācaret ||150 dvārāmudayavistāro dra vyasaṃsthānameva ca| pūrvameva yathoddiṣṭaṃ tathā sarvamanusmaret ||151 piṇḍena ta mūlaśākhāyā dvitīyā pa vidhīyate| sapāyate sapādana pratyayadenātha sārdhanarūpaśākhā praśasyate ||152 ardhena mūlaśākhāḥ samā caiva bāhyaśākhā śākhāṃ prakalpayet| ūrdhvapañcamaśākhāyā saptamī navamī ca sā ||153 rūpaśā --- syānna nyūnā nādhikāpi ca| vistarārdhaṃ tu kartavyaḥ sarvāsāmeva nirgamaḥ ||154 śākhāvistāravistīrṇāttaraṅgāni kārayet| sārdhena dhruvaśākhānāṃ piṇḍenodumbarodayaḥ ||155 udumbarasya piṇḍena siṃhavakrāṇi kārayet| tadardhaṃ vilasandhiḥ syāttatsamā bhūmiraṅgikā ||156 talanyāsasamaḥ paṭṭaḥ piṇḍapūrvavyavasthitaḥ| kūṭākārairvicitraiśca śobhanai rūpakarmabhiḥ ||157 patrajātairanekaiśca kaṇṭhaṃ kuryādyathepsitam| pācakaḥ kaṭutīkṣṇādyairanusārarasairyathā ||158 anvīkṣya vipacettadvatsthapatiḥ sarvamācaret| yaduktaṃ yadanuktaṃ ca tatsamagramapi sphuṭam ||159 yuktaṃ samālocya yathāśobhaṃ samācaret| ārabhya meroriti ṣoḍaśaite prāsādamukhyāḥ kathitā yathāvat| saṃkṣepato lakṣma tathā jagatyāṃ dvārādisambandhi ca dārumānam ||160 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre mervādiṣoḍaśaprāsādalakṣaṇa jagatīlakṣaṇa dvārādikalā nāma pañcapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ| <56> atha rucakādicatuṣṣaṣṭiprāsādakaḥ ṣaṭpañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ| athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi prāsādāñśikharānvitān| rucakādīṃścatuḥṣaṣṭiṃ nāmalakṣaṇataḥ kramāt ||1 pūrvaṃ yāni vimānāni pañcoktānyabhavaṃstataḥ| tadākārabhṛtaḥ sarve prāsādāḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ ||2 śikharairvividhākārairekenāṇḍena bhūṣitāḥ| kecidaṇḍatrayopetāḥ kecitpañcāṇḍakānvitāḥ ||3 īṣadbhedena te jñeyāḥ prāsādāḥ sarvakāmadāḥ| sauvarṇā rājatāścai va devānāṃ satataṃ priyāḥ ||4 maṇimuktāpravālādyairbhūṣaṇaiḥ suvibhūṣitāḥ| rītikātāmrabhoṣādyaiḥ piśācoragarakṣasām ||5 devalokā bhavantyete kāmasvacchandacāriṇaḥ| pātāle cāpi nirdiṣṭāḥ pāṣāṇaiḥ sphaṭikaistathā ||6 iṣṭakākāṣṭhapāṣāṇairmartyaloke'pi nandakāḥ| sukhadāśca bhavantyete kartuḥ kārayitustathā ||7 lakṣaṇenānvitānetān kathayāmo yathāvidhi| purāṇāṃ bhūṣaṇārthāya bhuktimuktipradā nṛṇām ||8 rucako bhadra kaścaiva haṃso haṃsodbhavastathā| pratihaṃsastathā nando nandyāvarto dharādharaḥ ||9 vardhamāno'dri kūṭaśca śrīvatso'tha trikūṭakaḥ| muktakoṇo gajaścaiva garuḍaḥ siṃha eva ca ||10 bhavaśca vibhavaścaiva padmo mālādharastathā| vajrakaḥ svastikaḥ śaṅkurmalayo makaradhvajaḥ ||11 ityete nāmataḥ proktāḥ prāsādāḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ| eteṣāṃ rūpanirmāṇaṃ kathayāmo yathāvidhi ||12 rucakāṣṭādaśaiṣāṃ caturaśrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ| bhavaśca vibhavaścaiva caturaśrāyato'thavā ||13 padmo mālādharaścaiva vṛttāvetāvudāhṛtau| malayo makarākhyo'tha dvau tu vṛttāyatāvimau ||14 vajrakaḥ svastikaḥ śaṅkuritthamaṣṭāśrayastrayaḥ| lalitāḥ kathitā hyete brūmo'nyānmiśrakānatha ||15 subhadro yokiṭaśca sarvatobhadra eva ca| siṃhakesarisaṃjño'nyaścitrakūṭo dharādharaḥ ||16 tilakākhyaḥ svatilakastathā sarvāṅgasundaraḥ| navāmī miśrakāḥ proktāḥ kathyante sādhakārikāḥ ||17 kesarī sarvatobhadro nandano nandiśālakaḥ| nandīśo mandirākhyaśca śrīvṛkṣaścāmṛtodbhavaḥ ||18 himavān hemakūṭaśca kailāsaḥ pṛthivījayaḥ| indra nīlo mahānīlo bhūdharo ratnakūṭakaḥ ||19 vaiḍūryaḥ padmarāgaśca vajrako mukuṭotkaṭaḥ| airāvato rājahaṃso garuḍo vṛṣabhastathā ||20 meruḥ prāsādarājaśca devānāmālayo hi saḥ| saṃyoge tu saṃdhārān kathayāmo yathāvidhi ||21 latātripuṣkarākhyau ca pañcavaktraścaturmukhaḥ| navātmakaśca nirgūḍhaḥ prāsādāḥ pañca saṃjñitāḥ ||22 ādyaḥ pañcāṇḍakaḥ kāryaḥ prāsādaḥ kesarīti yaḥ| sarvatobhadra ko yastu vidheyaḥ sa navāṇḍakaḥ ||23 trayodaśāṇḍakastu syānnandano nāma yo bhavet| nandiśālastu yaḥ proktaḥ sa syātsaptadaśāṇḍakaḥ ||24 aṇḍakairekaviṃśatyā nandīśaḥ parivāritaḥ| pañcaviṃśāṇḍakopetaṃ mandaraṃ kārayedbudhaḥ ||25 śrīvṛkṣaḥ śasyate caiteṣvekonatriṃśatāṇḍakaiḥ| syāttrayastriṃśatāṇḍaistu prāsādo hyamṛtodbhavaḥ ||26 aṇḍakaiḥ kriyate saptatriṃśatā himavānapi| saikayā hemakūṭastu syāccatvāriṃśatāṇḍakaiḥ ||27 pañcacatvāriṃśatāṇḍaiḥ kailāso nāma nāmataḥ| bhavatyekonapañcāśadaṇḍakaḥ pṛthivījayaḥ ||28 indra nīlaśca yaḥ prokāraḥ pañcaśatāṇḍakaiḥ| saptapañcāśatā yukto mahānīlastathāṇḍakaiḥ ||29 ekaṣaṣṭyaṇḍakopetaḥ prāsādo bhūdharo bhavet| pañcaṣaṣṭyaṇḍakairyukto ratnakūṭaḥ praśasyate ||30 navaṣaṣṭyaṇḍakaḥ kāryo vaidūryaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ| trisaptatyaṇḍakayutaḥ padmarāgo vidhīyate ||31 aṇḍakaiḥ saptasaptatyā prāsādo vijayābhidhaḥ| ekāśītyaṇḍakopeto vidheyo mukuṭotkaṭaḥ ||32 airāvatastu pañcāśītyaṇḍakaḥ parikīrtitaḥ| navāśītyaṇḍakairyukto rājahaṃsaḥ praśasyate ||33 navatyā saptayutayā prāsādo vṛṣabho'ṇḍakaiḥ| śatenaikottareṇāṇḍairmeruḥ prāsādarāṭsmṛtaḥ ||34 harerhiraṇyagarbhasya --- bhāskarasya ca| merureṣa vidhātavyo nānyasya tridivaukasaḥ ||35 meroḥ prāsādarājasya devānāmālayasya ca| kartā kṣatriya evāsya vaiśyasya sthapatirbhavet ||36 evaṃ vidhīyamāne'smin merau dvāvapi nandataḥ| vāstuśāstravidhijño'pi kṣatriyaḥ sthapatiryadi ||37 tadāsya satyaṃ śaucaṃ ca vikramaśca vinaśyati| īśvaro'pi yadā vipro meruprāsādakṛdbhavat ||38 kartuḥ kārayituḥ pīḍā pūjā cāsya na tādṛśī| brāhmaṇaḥ sthapatiścāsya vāstuśāstre viśāradaḥ ||39 vaṇikkarmaṇi varteta dhanavānapi yadyasau| sarvavipreṣu nirdiṣṭaḥ kartā sthapatireva saḥ ||40 tatrasthā devatāḥ sarvāstasya vṛddhiḥ kathañcana| vāstuśāstravidhijño'pi tattatkārayitā yadi ||41 rājāpi kṣatriyaḥ kartā merurbhavet tadā| rāṣṭrabhaṅgo bhavettasya prajā yānti diśo daśa ||42 kṣatriyeṇa narendre ṇa kartā sthapatinā yadi| meroḥ pūjā bhavettatra kṣatriyo'pyakṣayaṃ padam ||43 ekaikasya ca yanmānaṃ sakarṇasya ca yadvaśam| prāsādānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ tatsamyagabhidhīyate ||44 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre caturbhāgavivarjite| bhāgikā sarvato bhittiḥ śeṣaṃ garbhagṛhaṃ bhavet ||45 tasyāgrataḥ punaḥ kāryo bhāgadvayavinirgataḥ| vistāreṇa tribhāgaśca prāggrīvaḥ stambhabhūṣitaḥ ||46 pīṭhotsedhasya bhāgena bhavejjaṅghā dvibhāgikā| bhāgārdha---taraṃ patraṃ pādena syādvaraṇḍikā ||47 sapādāṃścaturo bhāgān śikharasyocchrayaḥ smṛtaḥ| triguṇena ca sūtreṇa padmakośaṃ samālikhet ||48 skandhakośāntaraṃ cāsya bhāgaiḥ pravibhajettribhiḥ| bhavedgrīvārdhabhāgena bhāgenāmalasārakam ||49 padmaśīrṣaṃ ca bhāgārdhādbhāgena smṛtaḥ| ityukto rucakākhyo'yaṃ| rucakaḥ || bhadra kākhyo'tha kathyate ||50 ---||51 bhadra ka || bhadraṃ tu karṇayormadhye kārayedudakāntaram| tadā haṃso vijānīyātprāsādo devatālayaḥ ||52 haṃsaḥ| haṃsasyeva yadā kuryādbhadra syānte jalāntaram| tadā haṃsodbhavo nāma prāsādaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||53 haṃsodbhavaḥ| rathāntakarṇayoścaivaṃ yadā syādudakāntaram| pratihaṃsastadā proktaḥ prāsādo'yaṃ manoramaḥ ||54 pratihaṃsaḥ| prāggrīvā rucakasyaiva sīmāvistāravistṛtāḥ| nirgatā bhadra mānena tadā nandaḥ sa ucyate ||55 nandaḥ| prāggrīvairbhadra mānena nando yadi vibhūṣyate| nirgatairbhāgamānena caturaśraiḥ samantataḥ ||56 prāggrīvaḥ purataḥ kāryaḥ stambhadvayavibhūṣitaḥ| nandyāvartastadā proktaḥ prāsādo vijayāvahaḥ ||57 nandyāvartaḥ| nandyāvarte yadā kuryādbhadrā nte jalanirgamam| dharādharastadā jñeyaḥ prāsādo bhuvanottamaḥ ||58 dharādharaḥ| daśadhā bhājite kṣetre caturaśre samantataḥ| bhāgadvayena karṇaḥ syādbhajeccheṣaṃ ca saptadhā ||59 bhāgatrayeṇa rathako madhyamo'sya vidhīyate| dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ tu bhāgābhyāṃ rathakau vāmadakṣiṇau ||60 bhāgasyaiva tribhāgena bhavedasya vinirgamaḥ| kathito vardhamāno'yaṃ | vardhamānaḥ| girikūṭo'tha kathyate ||61 vardhamānasya bhadra sthamadhyasūtreṇa yojayet| karṇisūtraṃ tadagrābhyāṃ nyasyetsūtracatuṣṭayam ||62 tadutpannaistu bhadra sthakarṇaiḥ syāccitrakūṭakaḥ | girikūṭaḥ || karṇānte ca rathānte ca yadi syātsalilāntaram ||63 vardhamānasya bhavati śrīvatsaḥ syāttadā śubhaḥ| śrīvatsaḥ || girikūṭasya saṃsthāne tadrū pe viniveśite ||64 karṇā pratiratheṣvasya nikhileṣvapi yojayet| prāgvatpratirathodbhūtasūtrābhyāṃ karṇavartmanā ||65 trikūṭākhyastadaiva syātprāsādo devatālayaḥ| trikūṭaḥ| trikūṭasyaiva saṃsthāne bhadra karṇaparicyute ||66 svarūpabhadra saṃsthāne muktakoṇaḥ prajāyate | muktakoṇaḥ| caturbhistṛtairbhāgaiḥ kṣetre pañcabhirāyate ||67 bhāgena bhittiḥ kartavyā śeṣaṃ garbhagṛhaṃ bhavet| asya kṣetrārdhasūtreṇa pṛṣṭhato vṛttamālikhet ||68 purataḥ śūraseno'sya pṛṣṭhato'pi gajākṛtiḥ| prāsādo'yaṃ gajo nāma gaṇeśasya vidhīyate ||69 gajaḥ| vardhamānasya saṃsthāne garuḍaṃ viniveśayet| tasya pakṣau vidhātavyau prāsādārdhena nirgatau ||70 pakṣayostu daśastasya vardhamānaṃ vibhājayet| jātiśuddhā rathāḥ kāryāḥ pārśvayorgaruḍo bhavet ||71 garuḍaḥ| vardhamānasya saṃsthāne prāgvatkarṇau niyojayet| dvibhāgā rathikā kāryā śeṣaṃ bhadraṃ prakalpayet ||72 jaṅghāsya pañcabhirbhāgaiḥ pīṭhaṃ cāsya tadardhataḥ| viraṇḍyardhāṃśikādbhiśca bhāgaścāntarapatrayoḥ ||73 tathotsedhatribhāgaiśca navabhiḥ śikharocchritaḥ| kumbhaścāmalasāraśca siṃhe'smidrā gamāgataḥ ||74 siṃhaḥ || caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre caturbhirbhājitaiḥ padaiḥ| sīmāvistāramānena rathāṃstasya prakalpayet ||75 pādenaikena niryātān dikṣu sarvāsvanukramāt| prāggrīvān punarasyaiva bhāgadvitayavistṛtān ||76 tathā bhavet ||84 bhālādhāraḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sabaḥhyabhyantaraḥ samaḥ| mālādharaḥ || mālādharasya saṃsthāne yatkṣetraṃ pūrvavatsthitam ||85 udakāntaravicchinnaṃ padmaṃ tatra niveśayet| tathāgre garbhavyāsamitaṃ sūtraṃ padapādasamanvitam ||88 vṛttārdhaṃ bhramayettena dakṣiṇenottareṇa ca| sīmāvistārasūtreṇa padapādayutena ca ||89 purataḥ pṛṣṭhataścāpi tadvṛttamanuvartayet| vṛttakṣetramidaṃ saptadaśabhiḥ padmaghaṇṭāmalaiḥ saha| sa ca trikūṭa ityukto vicitraśikharānvitaḥ ||108 karṇe bhadre pratisthāne pūrṇe śṛṅge yadā bhavet| aṇḍakaiḥ saptadaśabhistadā syātsa dharādharaḥ ||109 śrīvatsasyaiva saṃsthāne karṇe kūṭaṃ niveśayet| śṛṅgaṃ bhadro bhadre ca tadā tilaka ucyate ||110 yathā karṇe tathā bhadre yo bhaveccitrakūṭavat| uttamāṅge ca yastadvatsa syātsarvāṅgasundaraḥ ||111 navānāṃ miśrāṇāmiha lakṣaṇamīritam| sādhāraṇamataḥ spaṣṭaṃ brūmaḥ samprati lakṣaṇam ||114 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre bhāgāṣṭakavibhājite| tasya madhye bhavedgarbho dvibhāgo devatālayaḥ ||115 bhāge kuryādbhāgena bhāgena kumbhaṃ cāmalasārakam| bhāgārdhena prakurvīta tadūrdhvaṃ bījapūrakam ||122 prāsādaḥ kaisarī nāma sarvataḥ santatipriyaḥ| kaisarī || caturaśraṃ samaṃ kṛtvā bhūmibhāgaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ||123 prāsādo vyāsataḥ kuryājjagatīṃ dviguṇāmiha| vidadhyājjāgatīpīṭhaṃ prāsādārdhasamucchritam ||124 pīṭhasyopari saṃsthāpya prāsādaṃ vibhajettataḥ| sarvatobhadra saṃsthānaṃ hastasaṃkhyā yadā bhavet ||125 hastaiḥ saptatriṃśatā tu jyeṣṭhaḥ sārdhe udāhṛtaḥ| madhyamaḥ saptaviṃśatyā prāsādaḥ syātkalādhikaiḥ ||126 kanīyānpañcadaśabhiḥ prāsādaḥ samudīritaḥ| talacchando yadā hyeṣāṃ tathā caivordhvato gatim ||127 jyeṣṭhamadhyakaniṣṭhānāṃ tathā samyaṅnigadyate| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre śatamūlavibhājite ||128 nyasettanmadhyato garbhaṃ caturvargapadānvitam| garbhapādena bhittiḥ syāttadvadevāndhakārikā ||129 bāhyabhittistathavā thaiva syāddaśaśāsyurdvibhāgikā| prativarṇapadāṃśena ṣoḍaśena jalāntaram ||130 śeṣaṃ bhadraṃ prakartavyaṃ garbhārdhena vinirgatam| bhāgārdhaṃ kṣobhayetpārśve nirgamaṃ ca bhāgenāntapatrakam ||133 prathamā rathikā tatra kāryā bhāgatrayocchritā| dvitīyā rathikā yā sā sārdhabhāgena cocchritā ||134 bhāge bhāge'ntaraṃ kāryamuparyupari cobhayoḥ| ṣaḍbhāgānvistṛtaṃ kuryācchikharaṃ saptamocchritam ||135 evaṃ bhūmibhiraṣṭābhiḥ kuryādenaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ| jalanirgamavicchinnā rathāḥ pratirathāstathā ||136 caturguṇaiḥ pṛthaksūtraṃ padmakośaṃ samālikhet| mañjarī lalitā kāryā nīlotpaladalākṛtiḥ ||137 grīvā caikārdhabhāgena malasārakam| padmaśīrṣaṃ ca kartavyaṃ grīvāmānena dhīmatā ||138 sārdhabhāgena soṣṇīṣaḥ padyasyoparikumbhakaḥ| sarvatobhadra ityukto reṣānānāmeṣa śekharaḥ ||139 vidhāya sarvatobhadraṃ devānāmālayaṃ śubham| labhate paramaṃ lokaṃ divi svacchandabhāṣitam ||140 sarvatobhadraḥ || caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre daśadhā pravibhājite| vyāsapādena garbhastadardhādandhakārikā ||141 jaṅghā skandhaśca taṃ karṇaṃ bhadraṃ cāpyasya yadbhavet| sarvatobhadra vatsarvaṃ tadvidheyaṃ caturdiśam ||142 tasya bhadrā ṇi sarvāṇi bhittibhiḥ pariveṣṭayet| bhadre bhadre punaścāsya vardhamānaṃ niveśayet ||143 pañcabhāgāstathā sārdhāḥ śikharasyodayo bhavet| sarvatobhadra kākārā rathikāścātra kārayet ||144 kuryātṣaḍaṃśā vistīrṇaśikharaṃ pradhocchritam| sarvatobhadra saṃsthānādeṣāṃ cāsvatra yojayet ||145 grīvā cāmalasāraṃ ca kumbhaścāpi tathā bhavet| prāsādo nandano nāma kartavyo devatālayaḥ ||146 kṛte'smin nandati svāmī duritāni ca nirdahet| nandanaḥ || bhakte dvādaśadhā kṣetre caturaśrīkṛte tataḥ ||147 saptavargapado garbho bhittyā saha vidhīyate| sapādapādikā bhittigarbhe kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ ||148 bāhyabhittiśca rathikāstisra ucchrāyeṇa prakīrtitāḥ| sarvatobhadra kākāro nandiśālaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||155 nandiśālaḥ| nandiśālasya saṃsthāne tadrū pe samavasthite| tasya bhadrā ṇi sarvāṇi bhittibhiḥ pariveṣṭayet ||156 ||158 kāryo'yaṃ sarvadevānāṃ prāsādo nandivardhanaḥ| nandivardhanaḥ || nandivardhanasaṃsthānaṃ pūrvavatparikalpayet ||159 ubhayoḥ karṇayormadhye ye tatra rathike sthite| tayoścopari kartavyaṃ śikharaṃ kalaśaścātra yo bhavet ||166 sarvatobhadra vatsa syācchrīvṛkṣo'yamudāhṛtaḥ| śrīvṛkṣaḥ || caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre caturdaśavibhājite ||167 dvibhāgavistṛtāḥ karṇā rathikāsteṣu kārayet| udakāntaravicchinnā bhāgenaikena kārayet ||172 rathikādvādaśavistārānuparyupari yojitā| tisrastisro niveśāḥ syuḥ karṇe karṇetathākramam ||173 prathamā rathikāstasya kuryādbhāgatrayocchritāḥ| kuryāduparyanyāḥ dvisaptāyāmavistāraṃ himavantaṃ vibhājayet ||176 caturdhā rathikāstatra karṇe karṇe niveśayet| dvibhāgavistṛtāḥ sarvā uparyupari kārayet ||177 prathamā bhūmikā tasya syācca bhāgatrayocchritā| dvitīyabhūmirathikā bhūmyuśayeṇa kārayet ||180 śikharasyocchrayaḥ kāryaḥ sapādavyāsasaṃmitaḥ| amṛtodbhavavajjaṅghā pīṭhaṃ cātra tathā bhavet ||181 jātiśuddho bhavatyeṣa himavān bhuvanottamaḥ| himavān || himācalasya saṃsthāne tadrū pe samavasthite ||182 tasya bhadre ṣu sarveṣu vardhamānaṃ ca yojayet| bhāgaṣaṭkapravistāraṃ tadardhena vinirgatam ||183 bhāgaiḥ saptabhirapyasya sārdhaiḥ syācchikharocchrayaḥ| śikharasyāgrataḥ stambhaḥ siṃhakarṇe vibhūṣayet ||184 diksūtrairasya sarveṣu kriyāṃ prāgvatprakalpayet| jaṅghotsedhaśca karṇaśca śikharaṃ cāsya yadbhavet ||185 himavatsadṛśaṃ sarvaṃ vidheyaṃ tadvijānatā| hemakūṭa iti khyātaḥ prāsādo'yaṃ jagattraye ||186 eṣa trimūrtinilayaḥ kāryo nānyasya kasyacit| hemakūṭaḥ || himavattulyasaṃsthānaṃ prāsādaṃ parikalpayet ||187 tasya madhye vidhātavyaḥ sarvatobhadra saṃjñitaḥ| varjanīyaṃ tu tanmadhye vardhamānaniveśanam ||188 tataḥ sthāneṣu sarveṣu khaṇḍarekhā niveśayet| vyāsocchritaistataḥ siṃhakarṇairbhadraṃ vibhūṣayet ||189 ūrdhvaṃ ca ||193 dve dve ca rathike tatra dīyate sumanorame| śeṣaḥ śikharavistāraḥ pañcabhāgasamucchritaḥ ||194 prāggrīvakāśca bhadre ṣu bhāgabhāgavinirgatāḥ| vistāreṇa caturbhāgā dikṣu sarvāsvayaṃ vidhiḥ ||195 vimānasadṛśī cāsya bāhyalekhā vidhīyate| guṇairebhistadā yuktaḥ prāsādaḥ pṛthivījayaḥ ||196 pṛthivījayaḥ| bhakte ṣoḍaśabhiḥ kṣetre caturaśre samantataḥ| garbho'ṣṭavargaḥ syāttasya madhye bhittirdvibhāgikā ||197 bhramaṇaṃ bāhyabhittiśca tatsame eva kīrtite| karṇeṣu rathikā kāryā salilāntarabhūṣitā ||198 tattulyāyāmavistārā rathikāḥ syustathāparāḥ| tadvattṛtīyarathikā bhadraṃ vidheyamucchrayeṇaitattribhāgān saptāthavādhikān ||203 pakṣayorubhayostasya rathike tadūrdhvataḥ| siṃhaṃ niveśayeddikṣu nikhilāsvapyayaṃ vidhiḥ ||204 mūlakarṇe tataścārdhaṃ śikharaṃ daśavistṛtam| ekādaśocchritaṃ kāryaṃ kramavṛttyā manoramam ||205 caturguṇena sūtreṇa veṇukośaṃ tato likhet| pūrvoktā sātaraṃbhāgeramuṣyā vibhajettribhiḥ ||206 grīvārdhabhāgamutsedhādaṇḍakaṃ bhāgamucchritam|
