syāddvipadotsedhastripadaśchādyavistaraḥ ||31 lambanaṃ tu tadardhena yathāśobhamathāpi vā| ūrdhvanānataraḥ patrasya kakpyate'pyayathākramam| koṇeṣu kūṭaḥ kartavyo vividhaiḥ karmasambhramaiḥ| vistāraḥ syāccaturbhāgasteṣāṃ ṣaḍbhāga ucchrayaḥ ||33 karṇā ghaṇṭāsamāyuktāḥ kūṭamānaṃ vidhīyate| tatra mṛtyukramāt kuryādekaikaṃ tadūrdhvataḥ ||34 teṣāṃ ca tulyatā kāryā vistārāducchrayādapi| catvāra ekakarṇe syurevaṃ sarveṣu ṣoḍaśa ||35 siṃhakarṇasya vistārāmānaṃ syādaṣṭabhāgikam| ṣaḍbhāgastu tathotsedho rathikaiśca vibhūṣaṇam ||36 guṇadvārasamāyuktaḥ śūrasenābhidhānakaḥ| siṃhakarṇo vidhātavyaḥ sarvakarmasamākulaḥ ||37 siṃhakarṇodayādūrdhvamuromañjarikā bhavet| vistārādaṣṭabhāgāsāvucchrāyānnavabhāgikā ||38 latāpañcakasaṃyuktā mañjarī syātsuśobhitā| grīvā pādonabhāgā syādaṇḍakaṃ bhāgamucchritam ||39 candri kā cārdhabhāgena kalaśaścaiva bhāgikaḥ| kūṭamūrdhve dvitīyā syāduromañjarikā tathā ||40 bhāgāttadvādaśavistīrṇā tu sārdhā na tridaśāvācchritā| bhāgamekaṃ bhavedgrīvā sārdhabhāgena cāṇḍakam ||41 kapariṃ cārdhabhāgena kalaśaśca dvibhāgikaḥ| uraḥśikharakānyaṣṭau bhavantyevaṃ caturdaśam ||42 dvitīyakūṭakasyordhve kartavyā mūlamañjarī| bhāgaṣoḍaśavistārā padāṣṭādaśakodayaḥ ||43 skandhamānaṃ hi sarveṣāṃ yathoktaṃ śatavāstuni| grīvā sārdhapadāṃśā syādaṇḍakaṃ dvipadānvitam ||44 kaṅkatīphalatulyāni kuryāt sarvāṇḍakāni ca| dvipadaṃ caṇḍikāyugmaṃ kāryaṃ sāmalasārakam ||45 tasyopari syātkalaśo vartulastripadocchritaḥ| toraṇairmakaraiḥ patraiḥ sāgraiśca savarālakaiḥ ||46 hastimuṇḍaiḥ samākīrṇamadharogaṇabhūṣitam| īdṛśaṃ śrīdharaṃ kuryātsarvālaṅkārabhūṣitam ||47 śrīdharaṃ kārayedyastu kirttyarthamapi mānavaḥ| ihaiva labhate saukhyamamutrendra tvamāpnuyāt ||48 bhogān bhuktvā pumān svargaṃ nīyate ca pare pade| sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śāntaśca syānna saṃśayaḥ ||49 śrīdharaḥ || hemakūṭamatha brūmaḥ śubhalakṣaṇasaṃyutam| sarvavidyādharasthānamāśrayaḥ sa pinākinaḥ ||50 caturaśrakṛte kṣetre ṣaḍviṃśatyaṃśabhājite| tatra syuḥ ṣaḍpadāḥ karṇāḥ śālā dvādaśabhāgikāḥ ||51 nirgatāśca tribhirbhāgairbhavantyetāścaturdiśam| aṣṭabhāgāyatā bhūyo nirgamaśca tribhiḥ padaiḥ ||52 catuḥstambhāścatuṣpārśvā dikṣu sarvāsvayaṃ vidhiḥ| karṇaśālāntaraṃ kāryaṃ padenaikena vistṛtam ||53 praviṣṭaṃ tatpadenaikaṃ tadevātra jalāntaram| padena karṇe koṇaḥ syātpratyaṅge padavistṛte ||54 nirgate cārdhabhāgena samamāne manorame| dvipadā rathikā bhadre nirgatārdhapadena sā ||55 catukarṇeṣu kartavyaṃ mānaṣemevaṃdhunu dhīmatā| bāhyabhittestu vistārastripadaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||56 catuḥṣaṣṭipado garbhastadbhittistripadā bhavet| tripadaṃ karṇamānaṃ syādvārimārgeṇa samyutam ||57 padārdhaṃ vārimārgaḥ syātpadamasya praveśakaḥ| śālāṣṭapadavistīrṇā bhāgārdhena vinirgatā ||58 caturbhāgāyatā bhadraṃ punarbhāgārdhanirgatam| talanyāsau hemakūṭe vibhaktapadaniścayāt ||59 asyāgre maṇḍapaṃ kuryānmahāntaṃ guṇapūjitam| ūrdhvaṃ hemakūṭasya dviguṇaṃ syātkalādhikam ||60 adhastādāsanaṃ tasya saptabhāgasamucchritam| bhāgenaikena khurake na madhye pūrvamānayoḥ ||61 ata ūrdhvaṃ punarbrūmaḥ pādamānamanukramāt| saptabhāgonnataṃ kuryādvedībandhe suśobhanam ||62 tasyārdhaṃ kummakasyārdhaṃ bhāgena kalaśonnatiḥ| padādhenāntaraṃ patraṃ yathāśobhaṃ vidhīyate ||63 sārdhaṃ padaṃ punaḥ proktā kapotālī suśobhanā| daśabhāgocchritā jaṅghā kartavyātisulakṣaṇā ||64 asyopari vidhātavyaṃ bharaṇai dvipadocchritam| mekhalāntarapatre tu vidhīyete padatraye ||65 adhastānmekhalāyāstu khurakasya tathopari| ekonaviṃśatiṃ bhāgānantaraṃ saṃpracakṣate ||66 karmapramāṇametasya pṛthaṅmadhye'bhidhīyate| dvipadaṃ rājāsenaṃ syādvedā---catuṣpadā ||67 bhavatyāsanapaṭṭasya kalpanā bhāgamānataḥ| sārdhaṃ bhāgadvayaṃ kāryamūrdhvaṃ candrā valokanam ||68 stambhānāsanapaṭṭārdhena yuñjyādaṣṭabhāgikān| bharaṇastambhaśīrṣe ca pratyekaṃ padake smṛte ||69 dvipadaścārdhapaṭṭaḥ syācchādyakena suśobhitaḥ| tripadaṃ chādyakaṃ tatra vistāreṇa prakīrtitam ||70 etanmānaṃ samākhyātamalindeṣu caturdiśam| ūrdhvamantarapatrasya kathayāmo yathākramam ||71 ṣaṭpade karṇavistārā saptāṃśā karṇamañjarī| grīvāmardhapadaṃ kuryātpadamekaṃ tathāṇḍakam ||72 ardhāṃśā candri kā ca syādekāṃśaḥ kalaśocchrayaḥ| asyoromañjarī kāryā vistāreṇa catuṣpadā ||73 grīvāṇḍake vidhātavyaṃ bhāgenārdhena kumbhakaḥ| siṃhakarṇastu kartavyo dvipado'syaiva madhyataḥ ||74 itthaṃ pañcāṇḍakāḥ karṇe hemakūṭeṣu kīritāḥ| aṣṭāṃśavistṛtaṃ kuryādudayena ca ṣaṭpadam ||75 alindasyordhvabhāgastaṃ siṃhakarṇaṃ manoramam| siṃhakarṇe dvibhāgstho dvādaśāṃśakavistṛtām ||76 uromañjarikāṃ kuryāt trayodaśapadocchritām| saptāṃśavistṛtaḥ skandho grīvā ca padamucchritā ||77 aṇḍakaṃ sārdhabhāgena candri kādhapadā smṛtā| ākāśaliṅgaṃ kurvīta dvipadaṃ sumanoramam ||78 vistāro mūlamañjaryā bhāgaviṃśatisaṃmitaḥ| ucchāyo'syaikaviṃśatyā skandho dvādaśabhāgikaḥ ||79 pañcabhaumastu kartavyo yathā cāruḥ sa jāyate| prathamā bhūmikā tatra pañcabhāgā vidhīyate ||80 parā parārdhabhāgena nyūnā nyūnā vidhīyate| skandhamānaṃ vidhātavyaṃ padenaikena connatam ||81 vibhajya daśadhā kuryāllatāḥ pañcātisundarīḥ| hemakūṭasya karṇeṣu pratyaṅge narakinnarāḥ ||82 manye tilakakūṭāśca kartavyāstu nirantarāḥ| īdṛśī mañjarīheme vidheyā kūṭanirgatā ||83 grīvā sārdhapadā prokto vistārādaṣṭabhāgikā| aṇḍakaṃ dvipadotsedhamekādaśapadāyatam ||84 daṇḍikā sādhabhāgo ccāvistārā navabhāgikā| tripadaḥ kalaśaḥ kāryo vistāreṇocchrayeṇa ca ||85 evaṃvidhaṃ vidhatte yo hemakūṭaṃ manoramam| sa krīḍati pumānsvarge yāvatkrīḍā pinākinaḥ ||86 hemakūṭaḥ| subhadrā khyamatha brūmaḥ prāsādaṃ bhadra bhadra kam| subhadro 'yamataḥ prokto bhadre bhadre yato'nvitaḥ ||87 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre caturdaśavibhājite| garbhaḥ ṣoḍaśabhirbhāgaiḥ skandaḥ ṣaṭpadavistṛtaḥ ||88 bhittiḥ syātpadaviṃśatyā tatra kandasamāḥ sṛtāḥ| karṇāḥ pratyaṅgakonyeṣāṃ pratyekaṃ padavistarāt ||89 dvyaṃśo madhyagavistāra ubhayornirgataḥ padam| dvyaṃśaḥ sarasi vistāra ākrāntapadanirgamaiḥ ||90 dvipadā bāhyabhittiḥ syādvistāreṇa suśobhitā| catuṣpadāyataḥ karṇo bhadraṃ tasya dvibhāgikam ||91 nirgamo'syārdhabhāgena syādevaṃ sundaraṃ kṛm| karṇe koṇāsu padikā dikṣu sarvāsu śobhanāḥ ||92 nigūḍhavistaraḥ kāryaḥ sārdhaṃ pañcapadonmitaḥ| dvipado nirgamastatra sarvadikṣu vidhīyate ||93 salilāntarakaṃ kuryādantare karṇabhadra yoḥ| praviṣṭaṃ padamānena padapādena vistṛtam ||94 ūrdhvamānamathaitasya yathāvadabhidhīyate| rājapīṭhaṃ vidhātavyaṃ bhāgārdhenātisundaram ||95 ūrdhvabhāgena khurakapīṭhaṃ syāccaturaṃśakam| dvipadaḥ kumbhakotsedhaḥ pādonaṃ somasūrakam ||96 bhāgārdhenāntaraṃ patraṃ pādonāṃśena mekhalāḥ| ṣaḍbhāgamucchritā jaṅghā bhāgena grāsapaṭṭikāḥ ||97 mekhalāntarapatre ca pratyekaṃ padake smṛte| paṭṭādadharakhurādūrdhvaṃ bhāgā saikāṃ daśāntaram ||98 rājāsanaṃ padaṃ proktamutsedhaṃ nātiśobhanam| ardhenātyadhike kārye dve pade vedikocchrayaḥ ||99 padārdhamāsanaṃ kāryaṃ dvyaṃśaṃ candrā valokanam| ūrdhvamāsanapaṭṭasya stambhaḥ pañcapadānvitaḥ ||100 pañcapadānvitaḥ || bharaṇaṃ stambhaśīrṣaṃ ca padena syātsamucchritam| chādyakenāvṛtaṃ kuryātpadenaikena paṭṭakam ||101 dvipadasthaḥ praśchādya vistāraḥ padenaikena lambanam| ūrdhvamantarapatrasya kathāyāmo yathāsthitam ||102 catuṣpadeṣu karṇeṣu ye karṇāḥ padikāḥ sthitāḥ| teṣu ṣikharakāḥ kāryā vistārocchrāyataḥ padam ||103 kalaśonaṃ tathā grīvā padārdhena samucchritā| dvipadaḥ siṃhakarṇastu vistārocchrāyataḥ samaḥ ||104 śikhiro'dha vidhātavyā tripadī karṇamañjarī| ūrdhvaṃ ca tripadā sa syāddvipadā skandhavistṛtiḥ ||105 sārchabhāgena kartavyaṃ sagrīvaṃ kalaśāṇḍakam| siṃhaprāsādavatkarṇā vidheyāḥ śubhalakṣaṇāḥ ||106 mūlamānena vistīrṇā nirgūḍhasyopari sthitāḥ| dvitīyaśca tṛtīyaśca tadūrdhvaṃ ca samucchritaḥ ||107 karṇasthakalaśādūrdhvaṃ kartavyā mūlamañjarī| vistāro daśabhāgāṃśānucchrāyo dvādaśāṃśakaḥ ||108 latābhiḥ pañcabhiryuktā vicitraiścāpi karmabhiḥ| ṣaṭpado'sya smṛtaḥ skandho grīvā cāsya catuṣpadā ||109 vistāreṇa samākhyātā pādonaṃ padamucchritā| aṇḍakāṃ sāṅghribhāgena ṣaḍbhāgavistṛtam ||110 pādonaṃ candri kābhāgaṃ kalaśaśca dvibhāgikaḥ| prāsādaṃ ye subhadrā khyaṃ kārayanti sulakṣaṇam ||111 kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi bhadraṃ teṣāṃ śivāgrataḥ| subhadraḥ || sarvapāpakṣayakarastriṣu lokeṣu kīrtitaḥ ||112 ripukesarisaṃjño'yaṃ prāsādaḥ parikīrtyate| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre bhāgaviṃśatibhājite ||113 dvipadā bāhyabhittiḥ syānmadhyabhittiśca tāvatā| bhramaṇī dvipadā kāryā vistārātsarvadigratāḥ ||114 garbho'ṣṭavistṛtaḥ karṇaḥ kandasārdhabhāgikaḥ| caturbhāgāyataṃ bhadraṃ kuryādbhāgena nirgatam ||115 rathako'sau samuddiṣṭo vidhātavyaścaturdiśam| pārśvayośca pratirathau kāryau sārdhapadāyatau ||116 padārdhena viniṣkrāntau --- vividheṣvapi| karṇāyāmaścaturbhāgo dvipadaṃ karṇabhadra kam ||117 padārdhena viniṣkrāntaṃ bāhyakarṇe vyavasthitam| pada pādena vistīrṇaṃ praviṣṭaṃ padamātrakam ||118 kāryaṃ jalāntaraṃ madhye karṇasya tilakasya ca| dvyaṃśastilakavistāraḥ padenaikena nirgamaḥ ||119 suvarṇitāḥ syustilakā bhadra koṇavyavasthitāḥ| aṣṭabhāgaṃ bhavedbhadraṃ padatrayavinirgatam ||120 catasṛṣvapi taddikṣu kartavyaṃ stambhabhūṣitam| ūrdhvamānamatha brūmaḥ pratipatraṃ sukhāvaham ||121 ūrdhvapramāṇaṃ dviguṇaṃ kartavyaṃ dvikalādhikam| bhāgairekonaviṃśatyā madhye kāryastalodayaḥ ||122 ebhyo madhyādvidhātavyā vedībandhāḥ suśobhanāḥ| dvipadaḥ kumbhakaḥ sārdhaṃ padaṃ tu kalaśo bhavet ||123 mekhalāntarapatre tu kārye sārdhapadonnate| navabhāgonnatā jaṅghā dvipadā rūpapaṭṭikā ||124 mekhalāntarapatre tu vidadhīta padadvayam| madhyaṃ syāt ṣoḍaśapadaṃ khurake'sya ca ||125 rājasenā tathā vedī tadvadāsanapaṭṭakam| padaiḥ pañcabhiretānin vidadhyādūrdhvamānataḥ ||126 candrā valokanaṃ kuryāddvipadaṃ bhāgamānataḥ| uparyāsanapaṭṭasya stambhaḥ syātsaptabhāgikaḥ ||127 bharaṇaṃ stambhaśīrṣaṃ ca dvipadaṃ cordhvamānataḥ| dvipadaḥ paṭṭapiṇḍaḥ syāttripadaśchādyavistaraḥ ||128 ūrdhvamantarapatrasya sāmprataṃ parikīrtyate| catuṣpadaḥ karṇaśṛṅgamāyāmocchrāyataḥ --- ||129 grīvāṇḍakaṃ ca bhāgena candri kārdhapadena ca| kalaśaścārdhabhāgena kartavyo'tra na saṃśayaḥ ||130 asyordhvataḥ prakartavyā dvitīyā karṇamañjarī| tripadāyāmavistārā grīvāṇḍakalaśā padam ||131 bhadra karṇāśrite dvyaṃśo vistārastilake smṛtaḥ| ucchrayastripadastasya dvitīyaḥ syāttadūrdhvataḥ ||132 sārdhadvipada ucchrāyo vistāro dvipadaḥ smṛtaḥ| saptabhāgonnataṃ tadvadvistārādaṣṭabhāgikam ||133 siṃhakarṇau prakurvīta susūtramānapūrvakam| uromañjarikā kāryā dvitīyā tilakordhvataḥ ||134 ardhabhāgāyatā mūle navabhāgamitocchrayā| tasyāstu skandhavistāro bhāgaiḥ syādardhapañcamaiḥ ||135 grīvārdhabhāgamutsedhādbhāgenāmūlasārakam| candri kā cārdhabhāgena kalaśo bhāgamucchritaḥ ||136 dvitīyā karṇaśṛṅgasya syādūrdhve mūlamañjarī| bhāgādvādaśavistārā kalayābhyadhikordhvataḥ ||137 skandhaḥsaptapadaśa prokto grīvā bhāgasamuchitā| aṇḍasya dvyaṃśa utsedho vistāraḥ saptabhāgikaḥ ||138 candri kaikena bhāgena kalaśastu dvibhāgikaḥ| talānāgarikā kāryānātyantaktanānyat karmātra yojayet| jesmin vijayamicchanti bhogān suvipulānapi| sarvapāpapraṇāśaṃ ca kāryo vā ripukesarī ||140 ripukesarī| idānīṃ preṣakaṃ nāma prāsādamabhidadhmahe| nirmitaṃ dhanadasyārthe pūrvaṃ viśvakarmaṇā ||141 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre caturdaśavibhājite| vibhajyastripadākīrṇaṃ catvāro'pi vidigratāḥ ||142 karṇamakarṇagarbhādya sūtraṃ tena samāni ca| raktāni dattvā sūtrāṇi tadagradvitayaḥ smṛtāḥ ||143 sūtreṇa caturaḥ karṇān diksthānutpātayet tataḥ| catvāro'nye punaḥ karṇāḥ saṃsiddhāḥ sarvameva hi ||144 evamaṣṭadalā karṇān vṛttānevaṃ prakalpayet| bhāgapraveśavistāraṃ karṇānte ca jalāntaram ||145 śālā syāt ṣaḍpadāyāmā tripado'syāśca nirgamaḥ| dvipadā bāhyabhittiḥ syāt ṣaḍpadā kandavistṛtiḥ ||146 kandagarbhasthitaṃ tantraṃ bhrāmayetkarṇakaṃvata| utpadyate tato vṛttaṃ samasūtraṃ suśobhanam ||147 kurvīta tasya madhye tu kandaṃ ṣoḍaśapatrakam| bhittikandāntarāle yaccheṣaṃ syāddhamantikā ||148 puṣpakasya talanyāsaḥ pañcapuṣpākṛtirbhavat| idānīmūrdhvamasyaiva kathyate mānapūrvakam ||149 ekonatriṃśadanyūrdhvaṃ sā syuḥ padān pūrvaṃ yathākramam| ato bahirvidhātavyaḥ pīṭhabandhaḥ padatrayam ||150 jayo kumbhaḥ sapādāṃśaḥ pādonaḥ syānmasūrakaḥ| ardhenāntarapatraṃ syātkapotālī ca tatsamā ||151 mālā vidyādharī kāyā puṣpahastairalaṅkṛtā| padadvādaśakotsedhaḥ syāttulodayaḥ ||152 asya madhye vidhātavyo vedībandhastribhāgikaḥ| padādhaṃ khurakaṃ kuryādbhāgenaikena kumbhakam ||153 masūrakaṃ padārdhena mekhalā padamānataḥ| ṣaḍbhāgamucchritā jaṅghā puṣpake parikīrtitā ||154 varālagrāsamakaraiḥ puṣpavidyādharairapi| sūkṣmakarṇasamā karṇā cāsya jaṅghā vidhīyate ||155 bhāgenaikena bharaṇaṃ bhāgenaikena paṭṭikā| mekhalāntarapatraṃ ca bhāgenaikena cocchritam ||156 ūrdhvatastalapaṭṭasya paṭṭasyordhvasya mastakam| bhāgaikādaśakā tāvadvidheyā karṇacarcitā ||157 bhāgena rājasenaṃ syāddvibhāgo vedikocchritāḥ| bhavedāsanapaṭṭaśca bhāgārdhena samunnataḥ ||158 candrā valokanaṃ kuryādbhāgikaṃ tryaṃśalambitam| āsanasyordhvataḥ kuryātstambhaṃ pañcapadaṃ śubham ||159 hīragrahaṇakaṃ śīrṣaṃ dvayaṃ sārdhaikabhāgataḥ| gulāpaṭṭaśca bhāgena mallakādyaṃ dvibhāgikam ||160 bhāgena lambitaṃ tatsyātsusṛṣṭaṃ sumanoramam| etasyoparibhāgena kartavyā chedapaṭṭikā ||161 padenaikena cāsyordhvaṃ kapotālyantaracchade| bhāgaṣaṭkena vistīrṇe pañcabhāgasamunnataṃ ||162 śūrasenaṃ prakurvīta madhyavartālitoraṇam| varālagrāsamakarairvarāhagajasuṇḍakaiḥ ||163 evamādibhirākīrṇamalidasyoparisthitam| koṇaṃ kuryātpuṣpakūṭaṃ puṣpakarmanirantaram ||164 catasro bhūmayo'sya syutāśca nyūnāḥ puraḥ puraḥ| prathamā bhūmikā --- syātparā parā ||165 ādyasya koṇakūṭasya vistārastripadaḥ smṛtaḥ| pareṣāṃ punareṣaṃ syātkramādūno'ṅghriṇāṅghriṇā ||166 bāhyātparasparaṃ kṣepamaṃśenāṃśena yojayet| madhye latāsya kartavyā bhāgaṣaṭkena vistṛtā ||167 skandhe dvipadavistārāṃ vidadhyānmadhyamañjarīm| ṣaḍguṇaṃ sūtramādāya latārekhāṃ samālikhet ||168 ālekhaṃ ca tataḥ kuryātsuśuddhaṃ bhāgasundaram| bhāgena vedikotsedhaḥ ṣaḍbhāgaḥ skandhavistaraiḥ ||169 bhāgenaikena ca grīvā dvābhyāṃ sāmalasārakam| viśālapadmasadṛśaṃ vidheyaṃ padmaśīrṣakam ||170 candri kā padmapatrābhā dvayametatpadocchritam| tryaṃśaḥ syātkalaśormṛtyā janakairavakuḍmalaḥ ||171 evaṃvidhaṃ vidhatte yaḥ puṣpakaṃ sumanoramam| tuṣyettasya dhanādhīśaḥ śubhairyāti vrajecca saḥ ||172 puṣpakaḥ || brūmo vijayabhadra sya subhadra sya ca lakṣaṇam| vallabhaḥ ṣaṇmukhasyāyaṃ bahupuṇyavidhāyakaḥ ||173 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre sāṣṭaviṃśatibhājite| kuryādaṣṭapadaṃ karṇabhadraṃ vāsya catuṣpadam ||174 padenaikena niryātaṃ sarvakoṇeṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ| udakāntarakaṃ kāryaṃ padakḷptaṃ padāyatam ||175 daśabhāgāyataṃ bhadraṃ kāryaṃ tripadanirgatam| dikṣu vidheyaḥ syānmukhato mukhamaṇḍapaḥ ||176 tripadā bāhyato bhittistripadā cāndhakārikā| madhye prāsādamānaṃ tu kartavyaṃ ṣoḍaśāṃśakam ||177 karṇā catuṣpadā kande bhadrā ṇyeṣāṃ padadvayam| niṣkrāntāni padena syuḥ kandakarṇāśritāni hi ||178 ṣaṭpadaṃ madhyamaṅgaṃ syāddvipadaścāsya nirgamaḥ| karṇaśālāntaraṃ yatsyāt vidhīyate ||179 dvipadā kandabhittiḥ syādgarbho dvādaśabhāgikaḥ| ūrdhvamānamiha proktaṃ dviguṇaṃ dvikalādhikam ||180 caturviṃśatibhāgānte tulocchrāyasya madhyataḥ| ūrdhvamānaṃ tu yatproktaṃ grīvāṇḍādyaṃ tato bahiḥ ||181 kāryaṃ tulodayaṃ syāṃca vedībandhaoṃ'śasaptakam| tribhāgaṃ kumbhakaḥ sūtraṃ sārdhabhāgo masūrakaḥ ||182 bhāgenāntarapatraṃ syātsārdhabhāgena mekhalā| jaṅghā dvādaśabhirbhāgairdvyaṃśā vā galapaṭṭikā ||183 andhārikā ca bhāgārdhaṃ sārdhabhāgā varaṇḍikā| bhāgenāntarapatraṃ syādrū pakarmasamākulam ||184 ūrdhvādhaḥpaṭṭayormadhye bhāgo bhāgaikaviṃśatiḥ| ato madhyādvidhātavyaṃ dvipadaṃ rājasenakam ||185 vedī catuṣpadā proktā bhāgenāsanapaṭṭakaḥ| padadvayena sārdhena kāryaṃ candrā valokanam ||186 navabhāgochritaḥ stambhaḥ patrakarmasamākulaḥ| bhāgenaikena bharaṇaṃ śīrṣakaṃ ca dvibhāgikam ||187 ucchālakamubhau bhāgau hāragrahaṇamāsikam| dvyaṃśā paṭṭocchritirbhāgacatuṣkā bāhyavistṛtiḥ ||188 dvyaṃśāsyālambanordhve tu rūpakaṃ caka paṭṭikāḥ| sā ca bhāgatrayeṇa syātsuśliṣṭā sādhucitritā ||189 karṇakarṇeṣu śṛṅgāṇāṃ vistṛtirdvipadā bhavet| ūrdhvamānaṃ tribhāgaṃ syādgrīvāṇḍakalaśaiḥ sahaḥ ||190 madhye catuṣpadā karmāduromañjarikā bhavet| ucchrāyaḥ ṣaṭpadastasyā grīvāṇḍaṃ dvipadocchritam ||191 bhāgena kalaśotsedhaḥ syādevaṃ karṇanirmitaḥ| karṇā --- piṇḍikā kāryā bhadra deśe tathocchritaḥ ||192 kartavyaḥ saptabhirbhāgaiḥ siṃhakarṇaḥ sucarcitaḥ| karṇadvaye tathā śṛṅge tayorūrdhvaṃ caturdiśam ||193 uromañjarikāyāmādudayā daśa pañca ca| tasyāścāṣṭapadaḥ kando grīvā bhāgasamunnatā ||194 dvibhāgamaṇḍakaṃ kāryaṃ candri kā padamucchritā| tripadāḥ kalaśāsteṣāṃ madhyagāntaramañjarī ||195 talā pañcakasaṃyuktā caraṭakriyayānvitā| bhāgaviṃśativistīrṇā kartavyā mūlamañjarī ||196 dvāviṃśatisamutsedhā skandho dvādaśabhāgikaḥ| madhyā latā sū rasenakarmarūpasamākulā ||197 grīvā sārdhapadotsedhā kāryā dvipadamaṇḍakam| bhāgena caṇḍikāṃ kuryātkalaśaṃ tu catuṣpadam ||198 ekonatriṃśadaṇḍo'yaṃ prāsādaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ| ṣaṭpadaṃ pīṭhamākhyātaṃ caritaṃ pūrvakarmavat ||199 ārogyaṃ putralābhaśca bhavedvijayakāriṇām| teṣāṃ tuṣyati ṣaḍvakro bhaktyā ye vidadhatyamum ||200 vijayabhadraḥ || adhunā śrīnivāsākhyaḥ prāsādaḥ samyagucyate| tṛptyarthameva kriyate jayaśrīstatra tiṣṭhati ||201 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre bhakte'ṣṭādaśabhiḥ padaiḥ| andhārikā ca bhitteśca pade dve dve yathākramam ||202 garbhaśca ṣaṭpadaḥ kāryaḥ śrīnivāsasya sundaraḥ| kande syurdvipadāḥ karṇā bhāgena salilāntaram ||203 bhadraṃ catuṣpadaṃ kāryaṃ padenaikena nirgatam| bāhyāḥ syustripadāḥ karṇā bhadrai śca dvipadairyutāḥ ||204 bhadraṃ caturthakarṇeṣu padenaikena nirgatam| koṇakoṇāśca kartavyāḥ padasyārdhaṃ samāyatāḥ ||205 padenāmbudharaḥ kāryaḥ praveśādvistṛterapi| vistārāt ṣaṭpadaṃ bhadraṃ padadvitayanirgamam ||206 nīrasyālāntare kāryā tilakā dvyaṃśavistṛtāḥ| padenaikena niṣkrāntāḥ śobhitāścārukarmaṇā ||207 ūrdhvamānamatha brūmaḥ śrīnivāse yathākramam| khurakasyocchritiḥ pīṭhe pādonaṃ padamiṣyate ||208 kuryātsapādonāṃśena jāḍyakumbha samucchritam| bhāgenāntarapatre tu bhāgenaikena mekhalām ||209 pīṭhotsedhaścaturbhāgaḥ śrīnivāse bhavediti| vedībandhasya khurako bhāgārdhena samunnataḥ ||210 kumbhakaḥ sārdhabhāgena tadardhena ma---| ---pañjarāt| tribhāgena tu bhāgasya aṣṭaśṛṅgasya pakṣakaḥ| naṣṭaśṛṅgasya śṛṅgasya cāntare salilāntaram ||| anyonyaṃ śṛṅganiṣkāso bhāgenaikena śasyate| daśabhāgāyataṃ bhadraṃ caturthāṃśena nirgama ||| evameṣa talacchandaḥ kathitaḥ surasundare| ūrvamānamatha brūmo bhāgaśuddhyā yathākramam ||| pīṭhādārabhya vistāro dviguṇā syātsamunnatiḥ| upapīṭhe'pyalaṃkuryādbhāgamekaṃ samunnatam ||| padena pādahīnena dvārasamunnatiḥ| ucchritirjāḍyakumbhasya sārdhabhāgā vidhīyate ||| kalaśottarapatre ca pādahīnapadonnate| asyādūrdhvaṃ tu kartavyā padārdhaṃ grāsapaṭṭikā ||| āyapīṭhocchadā proktā mūlabhūtobhivāstunaḥ| khurakaśca padārdhena sārdhabhāge kumbhapūrakaḥ ||| bhāgenaikena kalaśaḥ samavṛtto'tisundaraḥ| bhāgaṃ sapādaṃ kurvīta mekhalāntarapatrake ||| ṣaḍbhāgenu cchritā jaṅghā bhāgārdhaṃ grāsapaṭṭikā| karṇe caikena bhāgena bhāgārdhaṃ kuṇapo bhavet| bhāgena hīrakaṃ kuryādyathā śobhā prajāyate| mekhalāntarapatre ca sārdhabhāgena kārayet| ūrdhvataḥ padayormadhye syātsārdhadvādaśāṃśakam| tanmadhye sārdhabhāgaṃ tu rājasenaṃ sapaṭṭakam ||| dvau bhāgau vedikā bhāgasyārdhamāsanapaṭṭakaḥ| bhāgaṃ candrā valokaṃ syāt stambhamāsanamūrdhani ||| niveśayetpañcabhāgaṃ bharaṇaṃ bhāgikaṃ tataḥ| bhāgamekaṃ samucchrāyāṃ śīrṣakaṃ dviguṇāyatam ||| paṭṭasya kuryādutsedhaṃ bhāgamardhasamanvitam| sārdhabhāgadvayaṃ bāhyaṃ tadrū paṃ dūtāvalaṃ chivitam ||| dvau bhāgau chādyakasyordhve kāryā vāsanapaṭṭikā| virājamānā sā kāryā rūpagrāsavarālakaiḥ ||| mekhalāntarapatreṣu tu bhāgādrū pasamanvite| bhāgadvayena kartavyā dvitīyā mekhalā budhaiḥ ||| kūṭānyataḥ paraṃ kuryātkarmayuktāni sarvataḥ| kūṭeṣu kuryātpratyekaṃ siṃhakumbhasamanvitam ||| uromañjarikā tāni bhavatyeva yathākramam| aṣṭāṇḍakatrayānteṣu ṣaḍaṇḍaṃ syāccatuṣṭayam| caturaṇḍaṃ dvayaṃ kṛtvā tvevaṃ karṇe vidurbudhāḥ| nava kuṇḍāni tulyāni vistāreṇa padadvayam| sādhaṃ bhavati pratyekaṃ sārdhamuccaiḥ padadvayam| evaṃ nikarta ekaikaṃ syāttatpadaṃ vāṃśadaṇḍakam ||| siṃhakarṇaḥ ṣaḍucchrāyo bhadre syātplavavistṛtiḥ| dvitīyaścānudantaścā śobhitaścārukarmaṇā ||| tṛtīyo dvipadaḥ kāryaḥ siṃhakarṇo manoramaḥ| vistāro mūlamañjaryāścaturdaśapado bhavet| bhāgasaptadaśocce tu mātṛbhiḥ padmakośavat| skandhaścāṣṭapadaḥ prokto grīvā sārdhapadocchritā ||| dvipadaścāṇḍakotsedhaścandri kārdhapadonnataḥ | kalaśaṃ tripadaṃ prāhurmātuliṅgasya mudbhavam ||| madhye tu mūlamañjaryāḥ kurvīta śikharatrayam| surekhaṃ suprasannaṃ ca sarvadeśivibhūṣitam ||| ṣaṭpañcāśaṃ bhavedasminnaṇḍakānāṃ śatadvayam| evaṃ śreṣṭho'yamākhyātaḥ prāsādo'ṇḍakamānataḥ ||| saptaśatamekānnasaptatyā yutaṃ syānmadhyame punaḥ| ekottaraṃ śataṃ prāhuraṇḍakānāṃ kanīyasām ||| mandārakusumākārāṇyāni surasundare| kuryādenaṃ prāsādamīdṛśaṃ surasundaram ||| sa vairiñcaṃ yugaśataṃ sūryaloke mahīyate| surasundaraḥ || nandyāvartamatha brūmaḥ prāsādaṃ nṛpavṛddhidam ||| bhūṣitaṃ manānāgakanyābhirvallabhaṃ pṛthivībhujām| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre daśadhā pravibhājite ||| padadvayamidaṃ yatra nādāya brahmaṇaḥ padāt| vṛttaṃ samālikhedgarbhā vasmailaṃ ca tulaṃ bhavet ||| bhāgena ca tulo bhittirbhāgena syādbhramantikā| bhāgena bāhyabhittiḥ syātpadapañcakavarjitā ||| kande vibhāgaṃ kurvīta puṣpaśekharakaṃ tataḥ| dvipadā bāhyataḥ karṇā vidhātavyāstu vartulāḥ ||| yathāgātraṃ vidhātavyāḥ svastikākṛtayaśca te| catvāro rathikākando koṇe karṇe catuṣṭayam ||| pañcabhāgāyataṃ bhadraṃ sārdhabhāgavinirgamam| bhadrā ntapātinī kuryātpa---ṅge padasaṃmite ||| śeṣaṃ bhadraṃ tu kartavyaṃ vistāreṇa tribhāgikam| bhāgasyārdhena vistīrṇaṃ tathā bhāgapraveśakam ||| etatpramāṇaṃ kartavyamiha prājñairjalāntaram| talacchandānugaṃ bhadraṃ nandyāvarttaṃ yathākramam ||| ūrdhvamānamatha brūmo nandyāvartaṃ yathākramam| sārdhabhāgadvayocchrāyāmāsanaṃ tasya ūrdhvataḥ ||| kāryatulodayasya madhye bhāgaistathāṣṭabhiḥ | tulodayasya madhye syādvedībandho dvibhāgike ||| bhāgikaḥ kumbhakosena mekhalākalaśānvitaḥ| caturbhāgā bhavejjaṅghā bhāgikaṃ bharaṇaṃ bhavet ||| mekhalāntarapatre tu bhāgenaikena kalpayet| pādena rājasenaṃ syādvadvattaca paṭṭataḥ ||| vedī sāṣṭapadotsedhā bhāgapādena cāsanam| bhāgārdhena nataṃ kuryādbhāgaṃ pañcavalokata ||| pādonatripadaḥ stambhaḥ pallavairupaśobhitaḥ| hīragrahaṇaśīrṣaṃ ca kuryādbhāgasamuchriti ||| paṭṭamekapadotsedhaṃ chādyakaṃdvipadāyatam| bhāgena kuryādupari paṭṭikāṃ cārukarmaṇām ||| aṃśāṃstrīnucchritaḥ siṃhakarṇaḥ syāccaturāyataḥ| bhūṣitaḥ svarase --- na sa ca kāryo'tiśobhanaḥ ||| vistārāddvipade śṛṅge sārdhaṃbhāgadvayocchrite| asyordhvamanyaśṛṅgaṃ syātsadṛśocchaparistṛti| pratyaṅgastu vaṅgeṣu ca kūṭāni sārdhāṃśocchrāyavanti ca| dvitīyaḥ siṃhakarṇaḥ syātsiṃhakarṇasya mastake ||| tato śṛṅgaṃ tṛtīyaḥ syāccaturthastasya copari| ṣaḍabhāgavistṛtā karṇa kūṭasthā mūlamañjarī ||| saptabhāgocchritā ca syāṭskandhasyacca śocchritiḥ| syāduromañjarī mūlamañjaryā madhyasaṃśrayā ||| bhāgaiścaturbhirvistāraḥ ṣaḍbhiścāsyāḥ samucchritiḥ| kalaśāṇḍakasaṃyuktā karṇābhyantaramañjarī ||| syādaṇḍakaikaviṃśatyā nandyāvartaḥ sulakṣaṇaḥ| bhaktyā ye kārayantyenaṃ nadyāvartamanuttamam ||| vimānaṃ śubhamāruhya śakralokaṃ vrajanti te | nandyāvartaḥ || prāsādamatha vakṣyāmaḥ pūrṇaṃ pūritavāñchitam ||| vanditaiḥ kinnarairyakṣairmanuṣyapitṛvallabham| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre daśabhāgavibhājite ||| vistāra dvipado garbhaḥ kāryā bhittistu bhāgikaḥ| dvipadaṃ kandabhadraṃ ca nirgamo'syārdhabhāgikaḥ ||| śobhanā diṣu sarvāsu dvipadā ca bhramantikā| padikā bāhyabhittistu dvipadā karṇavistṛtiḥ ||| āyatyā caturo bhāgāvaṇḍabhittervinirgamā| bhadraṃ suśobhanaṃ tasyā dvidhātavyaṃ dvibhāgikam ||| parṇastu padikā pakṣabhadraṃ bhāgārdhanirgatam| jalāntaraṃ tu bhāgārdhamāyāmakṣepayoḥ samam ||| caturbhāgo valasyāsya garbho bhittistu bhāgikī| yāmāyurvittagostrīṇāṃ valabhī kīrtikārayet ||| pūrvataḥ kārayeddvāraṃ caturgarbhe'tra mandire| ūrdhvamānaṃ tu vakṣyāmaḥ prāsādasyāsya samprati ||| pīṭhaṃ dvibhāgikaṃ kāryaṃ vedībandho dvibhāgikaḥ| jaṅghā padacatuṣkaṃ ca śobhitā rūpakarmaṇā ||| padadvayaṃ tu kartavyaṃ sātapatrakam| kalaśāṇḍakayuktānāmucchrāyastripado budhaiḥ ||| kartavyaḥ karṇaśṛṅgāṇāṃ sarveṣāmapi mānataḥ| catuṣpadoccā valabhī ghaṇṭākalaśasaṃyutā ||| mallacchādyatrayaṃ kuryātkarṇaśṛṅgasya copari| yuktamantarapatreṇa bhāgocchrāyaṃ pṛthakpṛthak ||| bhāgenaikena ghaṇṭā syādbhadrā bhyāṃ kalaśāṇḍake| samūlakalaśe karṇe sūtraṃ sampātayedbudhaḥ ||| mallacchādyaṃ vidhātavyaṃ sūtreṇaikena lāñchitam| prāsādamevaṃ pūrṇāyuryaḥ kuryādbhaktimānimam ||| saptakāmaḥ --- puruṣaḥ sarvaloke mahīyate| pūrṇaḥ || siddhārthamatha vakṣyāmaḥ sarvakāmārthasiddhikam ||| kāmāḥ sidhyanti yatkarturihaloke paratra ca| caturaśre same kṣetre vibhakte daśabhiḥ padaiḥ ||| kurvīta ṣaṭpadaṃ garbhaṃ --- cāsya catuṣpadam| bhāgenaikena ramaṇīṃ bāhyabhittiṃ ca bhāgikīm ||| kurvīta dvipadān karṇāñśālāṃ ṣaḍbhiḥ padairbudhaiḥ| tadūrdhvaṃ karṇaśṛṅgāśca yathāśobhaṃ prakalpayet ||| tripadaṃ nirgamaṃ tasyāścatuṣkīśca caturdiśam| madhye bahiśca kurvīta tasyā dvāracatuṣṭayam ||| unnataṃ bhāgaviṃśatyā mānamasyordhvato bhavet| tripadaḥ pīṭhabandhaḥ syād dviguṇocchrāyabāhyataḥ ||| sārdhaṃ bhāgadvayaṃ kāryo vedibandhastu śobhanaḥ| ardhakumbhekamarde ca mekhalāṃ samasūrakaḥ ||| jaṅghā sārdhacaturbhāgā kāryocchrāyeṇa śobhanā| mekhalāntarapatre ca bhāgenaikena kārayet ||| khurakā mekhalā yāvatsaptabhāgāntaraṃ bhavet| bhāgābhyāṃ rājasenaṃ ca kuryādvedīṃ ca sāsanām ||| tribhāgaṃ stambhamutsedhādbhāgasyārdhena hīrakam| bhāgārdhaṃ stambhaśīrṣaṃ syādbhāgaḥ paṭṭasya connatiḥ ||| sūryacchādyo dvibhāgaḥ syādbhāgenaikena lambanā| śṛṅgotsedhastribhāgaśca kalaśāṇḍakasaṃyutam ||| caturbhāgonnataḥ siṃhakarṇaḥ ṣaḍbhāgavistṛtaḥ| kurvīta śṛṅgayorūrdhvaṃ śobhanāṃ mūlamañjarīm ||| aṣṭabhāgapravistīrṇāṃ navabhāgasamucchrita| skandhaḥ pañcapado jñeyo grīvā cārdhapadocchritā ||| aṇḍakaṃ bhāgamātraṃ syādūrdhvaṃ bhāgena candri kā| vartulaḥ samavistāraḥ kalaśastu dvibhāgikaḥ ||| bhadre varāṭakāśceha kartavyā hemakūṭavat| yaḥ kuryātkārayedyastu siddhāthaṃ sarvakāmadam ||| sa bhavetsarvakāmāptiḥ śivaloke ca śāśvataḥ| siddhārthaḥ || athābhidhīyate sarvapāpaghnaḥ śaṅkhavardhanaḥ ||| ālayaḥ sarvadevānāṃ prāsādo bhūbhṛtāṃ priyaḥ| caturaśre same kṣetre garbhākarṇe viśodhitam ||| kārayetpaścātsarvakoṇeṣu lāñchitam| vistārārdhe bhavedgarbho yaccheṣaṃ tena bhartivaḥ ||| dviguṇaṃ kārayedūrdhvaṃ bhāgaviṃśatibhājite| tulodayo'ṣṭabhāgaḥ syāddvādaśāṃśā ca mañjarī ||| kumbhakaṃ kalaśaṃ dvābhyāṃ kapotālīṃ ca kalpayet| pañcabhāgocchritā jaṅghā madhye'syā grāsapaṭṭikā ||| kramo'yaṃ sarvāsu tyaktvā mārgacatuṣṭayam ||| vistārasadṛśocchrāyā kartavyā pūrvabhūmikā| vakṣyamāṇairvibhāgaiśca viprabhajyāsaṇāḥ --- ||| bhāgena rājasenaṃ syādvedirbhāgadvayena ca| bhāgena candrā lokaḥ syādardhenāsanapaṭṭakaḥ ||| stambhocchrāyastribhirbhāgaistato bhāgena śīrṣakam| paṭṭocchrāyo bhāgamekaṃ syāccaturviṃśatirdharāḥ ||| nānāsaṅghaiḥ pallavaiśca cārukarmakarānanaiḥ| dvitīyā bhūmikā kāryā stambhaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiryutā ||| evaṃ bhūmau dvitīyāyāmapi karma vidhīyate| stambhaiścaturbhiḥ saṃyuktā tṛtīyāyāṃ caturthikā ||| nandighoṣaḥ kṛto yena mūyaṃ tejo sa jāyate| karmakṣayāttanuṃ tyaktvā prāpnoti paramaṃ padam ||| nandighoṣaḥ || prāsādamabhidhāsyāmo manūtkīrṇaṃ mahādrutam| vimṛśya buddhyā nipuṇaṃ nirmitaṃ prāksvayambhuvā ||| kṣetre ṣaḍbhāgavistāre garbhe bhāgacatuṣṭaye| kurvīta vṛttaṃ madhye ca navabhirvṛttimālikā ||| aṣṭau rathikāḥ kāryāḥ kṣetre dikṣu vidikṣu vā| ūrdhvamānamatha brūmo dviguṇaṃ dvipadānvitam ||| chādyayāvadvidhātavyā tatsārdhāṅgaikapañcakam| bhāgānaṣṭārdhasahitān kuryādūrdhvaṃ tulodayāt ||| sārdhabhāgena kartavyo vedībandhaśca śobhanaḥ| bhāgadvayaṃ tataḥ sārdhaṃ kāryā jaṅghāsamucchritiḥ ||| bhāgārdhaṃ hīrakaṃ kuryānmanojñaṃ kartikānvitam| mekhalāntarapatre ca bhāgenaikena kārayet ||| śṛṅgocchrāyastataḥ kāryaḥ sārdhabhāgadvayonmitaḥ| madhyena sarvaśṛṅgāṇāṃ mastake vṛttamālikhet ||| ṣaḍbhāgavistṛtaṃ tasya ṣaḍbhāgasamucchritam| yāvanmātrācaretproktā tāvatkāryā ca mañjarī ||| tribhaumaṃ pañcabhaumaṃ vicitraṃ kārayedimam| grīvā syādbhāgapādena vistārāddvipadāyatā ||| pādahīnaṃ padaṃ kuryādaṇḍakaṃ manusaṃbhavet| candri kā bhāgapādena pādonaṃ kuśalaḥ padam ||| prāsādaṃ manasāpyevaṃ manukīrtaṇaṃ karoti yaḥ| sa gaṃdhyā bhavanaṃ śambhorgāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt ||| mānakīrṇaḥ || atha suprabhanāmānaṃ prāsādamabhidadhmahe| yaṃ kṛtvā prabhayānyeṣāṃ prabhā hanti raviryathā ||| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre dvādaśāṃśavibhājite| kuryāccatuṣpadaṃ garbhaṃ vistāro yāmataḥ samaḥ ||| prāsādārdhaṃ bhavetkandaḥ kandabhadraṃ padadvayam| bhramantī dvipadā dikṣu catasṛṣvapi śobhanā ||| padikā bāhyabhittistu dvipadā karṇavistṛtiḥ| catuṣpadaṃ madhyabhadraṃ viniṣkrāntaṃ tribhiḥ padaiḥ ||| asyairvāta punaḥ kāryā dvipadā tu catuṣkikā| solāyāḥ pārśvataḥ kuryādatibhadra dvayaṃ budhaḥ ||| tayoḥ pādena niṣkāsaṃ pārśvayorubhayorapi| pārśvabhadra sya karṇasya cāntaraṃ padike nayet ||| jālairvicitritaṃ kuryānmadhye jyotiryathā bhavet| evaṃ dikṣu samastāsu kurvītainamanukramāt ||| prāsādabhāgavidhinā puraḥ kurvīta maṇḍapam| catasṛṣvapi mañjaryo dikṣu kāryā yathākramam ||| līyamūlasajaṅghātrā svasārdhā ca yathādimam| ucchrāyo mūlavistārāddviguṇo dvikalādhikaḥ ||| tulodayo daśapado mañjarī ṣoḍaśāṃśikā| vedībandhasamutsedhaḥ sārdhabhāgadvayonmitaḥ ||| pañcabhāgocchritā jaṅghā hīraṃ bhāgasamunnatam| sārdhabhāgena kartavye mekhalāntarapatrake ||| karṇaśṛṅgasamutsedhaḥ kalaśāntastribhāgikaḥ| diṅmañjarī tu kartavyā vistāreṇa catuṣpadā ||| udayena vidhātavyā pañcabhāgā pramāṇataḥ| grīvā padasya pādena kalaśo'rdhapadaṃ bhavet ||| vistāro mūlamañjaryāḥ kartavyo daśabhāgikaḥ| ---bhāgatrayotsedho grīvā pādena bhāgikā ||| aṇḍakaṃ sārdhabhāgena dvipadā kalaśocchritiḥ| deśāṃśaṣaṭkato mūlāskandhoreṣo'ntako bhavet ||| vistāro mūlamañjaryāḥ kartavyo daśabhāgikaḥ| navāṇḍako'yaṃ kartavyaḥ prāsādaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ ||| yaḥ prāsādamimaṃ kuryātsuprabhaṃ bhaktimānnaraḥ| divyate jāravahasyāsya dehānte muktimāpnuyāt ||| śubhalakṣaṇaḥ || surānandamatha brūmaḥ prāsādamatisundaram| caturaśraṃ samaṃ kṣetre daśadhā pravibhājayet ||| ṣaḍbhāgo garbhavistāro dvau bhāgau bhittivistṛtiḥ| kartavyā sārdhabhāgena bhāgārdhena jalāśrayaḥ ||| pratyaṅgasthānakaṃ kuryātsaprasaṃ vṛttabhāgikam| śālāstribhiḥ padaiḥ kāryāḥ śubharūpāścaturdiśam ||| śālāyāḥ pārśvayoḥ kāryo vārimārgaḥ padārdhakaḥ| parasparaṃ tu niṣkāso bhāgaṃ bhāgaṃ vidhīyate ||| ūrdhvamānaṃ vidhātavyaṃ vistārāddviguṇo budhaiḥ| garbhacchādyaṃ padānyaṣṭau bhāgā dvādaśa mañjarī ||| vāstuvistārapādena vedībandho vidhīyate| catuṣpadordhvato jaṅghā bhāgārdhaṃ grāsapaṭṭikā ||| mekhalāntarapatre ca vidhātavye padocchrite| koṇā dra viḍakūṭasya vṛttastambhā varāṭakā ||| madhyāṅgatoraṇānāṃ syudviśatiścaturo bhavet| ṣaṭpadaḥ skandhavistāro grīvā bhavati bhāgikī ||| śiraḥ sārdhaṃ padaṃ jñeyaṃ bhāgamekaṃ ca candri kā| kalaśaoṃ'śadvayocchrāyaḥ kāryaḥ pallavabhūṣitaḥ ||| yaḥ karoti surānandaṃ varadāstasya mātaraḥ| surāstasya hyanistāryamapamṛtyuṃ haranti ca ||| surānandaḥ || atha harṣaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvalokapraharṣaṇam| nityaṃ vasati yatra śrīḥ sthānaṃ yadviśvakarmaṇaḥ ||| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre bhakte'ṣṭādaśabhiḥ padaiḥ| pratikoṇaṃ vidhātavyāḥ karṇabhāgau stribhistribhiḥ ||| dvipadaṃ karṇabhadraṃ ca bhāgenaikena nirgatam| vārimārgaṃ padaṃ kuryātpraveśyayāmataḥ samam ||| tribhāgamasya pratyaṅgaṃ padadvitayanirgamam| vedicandrā valokābhyāṃ pratyaṅge karma kalpayet ||| catuṣpadaṃ madhyabhāgaṃ dvipadaṃ cāsya bhadra kam| vinirgataṃ ca bhāgena vidadhīta vicakṣaṇaḥ ||| valabhyaśca dvibhāgāḥ syuḥ khānurūpāścaturdiśam| garbho bhāgaiścaturbhistu valabhīnāṃ vidhīyate ||| dvipadā bāhyato bhittirdvipadā ca bhramantikā| skandhaḥ syāddaśabhirbhāgairgarbhaḥ ṣaṭ triṃśatā padaiḥ ||| ūrdhvapramāṇametasya syāccatvāriṃśatā padaiḥ| bhāgaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiścāsya vidadhyācchādanaṃ śubham ||| vedībandhaḥ pañcapado jaṅghā cāṣṭapadā bhavet| śālā cāntarapatraṃ ca kuryādbhāgatrayādbudhaḥ ||| ūrdhvamantarapatraṃ syādvidhātavyaṃ yathākramam| valabhīsaṃvṛtiḥ prājñairucchrāyātpañcabhāgikī ||| sā śṛṅgaiḥ siṃhakarṇaiśca kāryo bhāgasamucchritiḥ| vardhamānena kartavyā tripadā karṇamañjarī ||| ūrdhvaṃ padebhyastribhyaḥ syādbhāgena kalaśāṇḍakam| vistārāt ṣoḍaśapadā kartavyā mūlamañjarī ||| ūrdhvaṃ viṃśatibhāgāsya skandho navapadāyataḥ| grīvā sārdhapadaṃ kāryā tato dvipadamaṇḍakam ||| candri kaikena bhāgena kalaśastripadāttataḥ| harṣaṇaḥ kriyate yatra sa deśaḥ sukhamedhate ||| kṣemaṃ gobrāhmaṇānāṃ syātpūrṇakāmaśca pārthivaḥ | harṣaṇaḥ || idānīṃ durdharaṃ brūmaḥ prāsādaṃ śubhalakṣaṇam ||| caturaśre same kṣetre caturviṃśatibhājite| karṇāḥ ṣaḍāpadāḥ kāryā pratirathaṃ ca dva bhavet ||| kartavyāṣṭapadā śālā nirgamo'sya catuṣpadaḥ| padadvayaṃ viniṣkrāntā sarvataḥ karṇaśobhitā ||| dvipadā bāhyabhittiḥ syāccaturbhāgāndhakārikā| dvipadā kandabhittistu garbhaścāṣṭapadāyataḥ ||| ṣaṭpadā kandaśālā ca kandakarṇāḥ padatrayam| ūrdhvapramāṇaṃ vistārāddviguṇaṃ dvipadādhikam ||| viṃśatyama tulocchrāyāḥ śikharaṃ triṃśatā padaiḥ| kumbhaḥ sārdhadvibhāgaśca kalaśo bhāgamucchritiḥ ||| bhāgārdhenāntaraṃ patraṃ bhāgenaikena mekhalā| daśabhāgocchritā jaṅghā hīrakaṃ bhāgikaṃ bhavet ||| bhāgaiścaturbhiḥ kartavyaṃ mekhalādvitayaṃ tataḥ| adhastādūrdhvapaṭṭasya talapaṭṭhasya copari ||| bhavet ṣoḍaśabhirbhāgairanayorantaraṃ dvayoḥ| dvipado vedikābandho vedī kāyā catuṣpadā ||| āsanaṃ caiva bhāgena stambhaḥ pañcapadairbhavet| bhāgenaikena bharaṇaṃ śīrṣakaṃ bhāgamunnatam ||| paṭṭo bhāgadvayotsedhaśchādyaṃ ca tripadāyatam| mūlabharaṇāni catvāri koṇabhadrā ṇikaṃ bhavet ||| karṇaśṛṅgāṇi daśa ca dvayamathasmiṃścaturdiśam| grīvāṃ bhagasantānāṃ śṛṅgāṇāṃ tripadocchritiḥ ||| ṣaṭpadāḥ karṇamañjaryaḥ saptabhāgasamucchritāḥ| grīvārdhabhāgikī bhāgaḥ syāducchrāyo'ṇḍakasya tat ||| padatrayonnatā kāryā siṃhakarṇaścatuṣpadā| madhye bhadre tadutsedho vistārādardhabhāgikaḥ ||| vistāro mūlamañjaryāḥ padaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirbhavet| aṣṭādaśabhirucchrāyo grīvā sārdhapadocchritā ||| aṇḍakaṃ dvipadaṃ kāryaṃ candri kā padamucchritā| kalaśaṃ tripadaṃ vidyātsarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam ||| aṇḍakaiḥ saptadaśabhiḥ prāsādo durdharo bhavet| durdharaṃ yaḥ karotīha bhāgācchaktiṃ samāpnuyāt ||| kālena śivasāyujyaṃ nigadhiśca pradyate| durdharaḥ || idānīṃ durjayaṃ brūmaḥ prāsādaṃ śatrumardanam ||| yaṃ kṛtvā durjayaṃ loke bhavetkrīḍati ca kṣitau | caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre pañcabhāgavibhājite ||| garbhaṃ navapadaṃ kuryādbhittiḥ ṣoḍaśabhāgikī| bhāgena karṇarathikā bhāgābhyāṃ madhyame rathaḥ ||| bhāgena nirgamaṃstasya vidhireṣa caturdiśam| bhadra karṇāntare kuryādvārimārgaṃ padādhikam ||| ūrdhvamānaṃ vidhātavyaṃ tvamasmi daśabhāgikam| vedibandhaḥ sapādāṃśau jaṅghāṃsau pādasaṃyutau ||| mekhalāntarapatre tu padārdhena prakalpayet| śikharaḥ sārdhaṃ bhāgaṣaṭkochrito bhavet ||| tripadaḥ skandhavistāro rekhā padmadalākṛtiḥ| bhūmayaḥ pañca kartavyā nyūnamānā yathākramam ||| prathamā sādhabhāgānyā padapādonitā kramāt| skandha pādonabhāgena syād grīvārdhaṃ padena ca ||| aṇḍakaṃ tvekabhāgena karparaṃ cārdhabhāgikam| bhāgotsedhastu kalaśaḥ samavṛttaḥ suśobhanaḥ ||| durjayaḥ kriyate yatra pure vā nagare'thavā| na bhavet tatra durbhikṣaṃ na ca vyādhikṛtaṃ bhayam ||| durjayaḥ || brūmastrikūṭaṃ brahmādyaiḥ sevitaṃ tridaśaistribhiḥ| phalaṃ kratusahasrasya yena mokṣaṃ ca vindati ||| sasādhyatulyannibhajaṃ kṣetramiṣṭapramāṇataḥ| tato'sya bāhumekaikaṃ caturbhirvibhajetpadaiḥ ||| dvibhāgaṃ madhyamaṃ bhadraṃ bhāgikīṃ karṇapakṣikām| ardhena garbhamardhena kuryādbhittitrayaṃ budhaḥ ||| vistāraṃ paścadhā bhaktā kuryād dviguṇamucchrayam| vedibandho vidhātavyaḥ sapādaṃ bhāgamucchritaḥ ||| jaṅghā sapādau bhāgau dvau kāryā tasya samucchritiḥ| mekhalāntarapatre ca bhāgasyārdhena kārayet ||| mañjarī bhāgaṣaṭkena pañcabhāgavibhājitā| āsaprantātstambhaskandhaḥ kāryaḥ pūrvoktavartmanā ||| pādabhāgena tu grīvāmardhabhāgena cāṇḍakam| candri kā bhāgapādena kalaśaṃ bhāgamucchritam ||| trikūṭaṃ kārayedyastu brahmeśānaharipriyam| siddhā bhūtvā purīṃ teṣāṃ yātyasau nātra saṃśayaḥ ||| trikūṭaḥ || idānīmabhidhāsyāmaḥ prāsādaṃ navaśekharam| caturaśraṃ bhajetkṣetraṃ viṃśatyakonayā padaiḥ ||| karṇāścatuṣpadā kāryāsteṣāṃ bhadraṃ dvibhāgikam| vinirgataṃ padārdhena jalamārgasta--- ||| ---bhāgāyatā kāryā sā bhavehi vicakṣaṇaiḥ| śālā karṇapadādvatu pratyaṅgaṃ bhāgamānataḥ ||| tripado rathakaḥ kāryo mañjarīṇāṃ catuṣṭayam| catuṣpadā bhavedbhittirgarbhaścaikādaśāṃśakaḥ ||| catvāriṃśatpadādūrdhvaṃ yāvatskandhaṃ samastakam| tulodayaḥ ṣoḍaśabhirmañjarī cāṣṭakaistribhiḥ ||| catuṣpado vedibandho jaṅghā sāṣṭapadā bhavet| bhāgena bharaṇe tryaṃśaṃ mekhalāntarapatrakam ||| ucchrāyataḥ pañcapadā kartavyā karṇamañjarī| grīvādhabhāgena bhavedaṇḍakaṃ caiva bhāgikam ||| bhāgena candri kāmūrdhvaṃ bhāgena kalaśaṃ tathā| sapādamudayaṃ śālā mañjaryā vistṛte viduḥ ||| grīvā pādena bhāgena sapādāsamatāṇḍakam| bhāgāddhi candri kā bhāgadvayena kalaśodayaḥ ||| vistāro mūlamañjaryāḥ kāryaḥ pañcadaśāṃśakaḥ| tathā saptadaśocchrāyaḥ skandhāyāmo navāṃśakaḥ ||| grīvā cāsyārdhabhāgena sārdhadvipadamaṇḍakam| vaṇḍikā sārdhabhāgena tripadaḥ kalaśodayaḥ ||| evaṃ yaḥ kārayatyenaṃ prāsādaṃ navaśekharam| navabhiḥ sahitāṃ khaṇḍaiḥ sa bhunakti vasundarām ||| navaśekharaḥ || puṇḍarīkamatha brūmo yaśaso vardhanaṃ param| yasmin kṛte sthirā kīrtirbhavedyāvadvasundharā ||| caturaśraṃ samaṃ kṣetraṃ vibhajetpañcabhiḥ padaiḥ| tripadaṃ kalpayedgarbhaṃ tasya bhittiṃ ca bhāgikām ||| tripadaṃ tasya bhadraṃ syātsādhabhāgavinirgamam| bhadre ṣu vartulaṃ dikṣu rathikānāṃ catuṣṭayam ||| bhāgenaikena rathikā mūlacchando'yamīritaḥ| ūrdhvamānaṃ bhavedyasya dviguṇo daśabhāgikam ||| bhāgenocchālakaṃ vidyādbhāgārdhena tu mekhalā| vedibandhaṃ na kurvīta jaṅghā sārdhadvibhāgikā ||| mekhalā cārdhabhāgena bhavetsāntarapatrakā| padāni pañca sārdhāni mañjaryāḥ syātsamucchritiḥ ||| tripadaḥ skandhavistāro grīvā vā padasādikāḥ| aṇḍakaṃ syātpadārdhena bhāgapādena candri kā ||| bhāgocchrāyastu kalaśaḥ kartavyaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ| madhyena mūlamañjaryāstripadā bhadra mañjarī ||| sārdhā tripadocchrāyā grīvā bhāgasamucchritā| aṇḍakaṃ ca tribhāgena kalaśo bhāgamucchritiḥ ||| pañcāṇḍaḥ puṇḍarīko'yaṃ kartavyaḥ śubhavardhanaḥ| puṇḍarīkaḥ || sunābhamatha brūmo vandito devadānavaiḥ ||| vallabhaṃ lokapālānāṃ pṛṇyamutkṛṣṭalakṣaṇam| vibhajet saptadaśabhiḥ samakṣetraṃ caturbhujam ||| pañcabhāgāyatāḥ koṇā garbhaḥ kāryastribhiḥ padaiḥ| ubhayoḥ koṇayormadhye saptabhāgikamantaram ||| vyakṣepātkarṇayormadhye prāñchayet padamantaram| bhāgapraveśaṃ bhāgārdhe vistāramudakāntaram ||| dvipadā bāhyabhittiḥ syāttripadātha bhramantikā| pañcabhāgāyato madhye bhavetprāsādanāyakaḥ ||| tripadastasya garbhastu bhittirbhāgaṃ vidhīyate| tripadaṃ karṇabhadraṃ ca bhāgenaikena nirgatam ||| padapramāṇakoṇāṃstu catvāropaniveśayet| yathā kandastathā koṇo vibhāgaiḥ sa vidhīyate ||| pañca garbhāstu kartavyāḥ samamānaprakalpitāḥ| dviguṇaṃ cordhvamānaṃ syād grīvāṇḍakavivarjitam ||| tribhiḥ padairvedibandho jaṅghā saptapadā bhavet| padatrayeṇa kartavyaṃ mekhalādvitayaṃ budhaiḥ ||| ūrdhvato bāhyacchandasyā kartavyā karṇamañjarī| ṣaṭpadāḥ karṇamañjaryo dvipadaṃ kalaśāṇḍakam ||| dvādaśā saptavistārā kartavyā mūlamañjarī| trayodaśapadocchrāyā grīvāsyā bhāgamucchritā ||| aṇḍakaṃ dvipadotsedhaṃ bhāgotsedhā tu candri kā| kalaśastripadotsedho vartulaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ ||| yāvat kṣitiryāvadabdhiryāvacchaśidivākarau| kartāsya tāvaddivyāste yāvatsuraguruḥ surāḥ ||| sunābhāḥ || māhendra matha vakṣyāmaḥ prāsādaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ kṣiteḥ| sevitaṃ yakṣagandharvaiḥ phaṇīndrai śca mahāprabhaiḥ ||| māhendraṃ pañcadaśabhirbhāgaiḥ prājño vibhājayet| navabhāgāyataṃ garbhaṃ kuryādbhittiṃ tribhāgikīm ||| vistāreṇāsya vikhyātā tajjñaiḥ śālā padatrayam| śālāyāḥ pārśvayoḥ kāryau rathau sārdhapadau budhaiḥ ||| rathaśālāntareṇaiva kartavyamudakāntaram| rathasyāprātaḥ pañcāri gṛhakāryaṃ padārdhakam ||| pratyaṅgāni padaṃ sādhaṃ --- jalāntaram| dvipadaṃ karṇamānaṃ ca kāryaṃ koṇacatuṣṭaye ||| bhāgenānyonyameteṣāṃ vidhātavyo vinirgamaḥ| ūrdhvamānaṃ tu kartavyaṃ dviguṇaṃ sīmavistṛteḥ ||| tulodayo daśāṃśaḥ syādviṃśatyaṃśā ca mañjarī| vedibandhaṃ prakurvīta sādhabhāgadvayaṃ budhaḥ ||| jaṅghayostu samucchrāyamardhapañcamabhāgikam| bhāgena bharaṇaṃ kurgāllāñchitaṃ patrabhaṅgibhiḥ ||| tadūrdhvaṃ mekhalā kāryā bhāgadvitayamucchritā| ūrdhvato mañjarī kāryā krameṇaiva manoharā ||| kīrtimārogyameva ca| bhuktvā bhogāṃśca kailāse kalpānte yāvadīpsitam ||| śārvaṃ padamavāpnoti śāntaṃ dhruvamanāmayam| kailāsaḥ || triviṣṭapamatha brūmaḥ prāsādamamarapriyam ||| sevitaṃ yakṣagandharvasiddhavidyādharādibhiḥ| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre viṃśatyaṃśavibhājite ||| ṣaḍbhāgavistṛtā śālā syāccaturbhāganirgamā| caturaṃśatī koṣṭhakānāṃ dvāsaptatyadhikā bhavet ||| āśātrayasthitairbhadraiḥ sārdhamevaṃ prajāyate| kuryādgarbhagṛhāṇyaṣṭau dikṣuṣvāsvapi tāni tu ||| koṇe tu ṣoḍaśāṃśāni tanmadhye caturaoṃ'śakān| bhittirdvādaśabhirbhāgairgarbhāṇāmiti nirṇayaḥ ||| catuḥṣaṣṭipadaḥ kāryo madhye prāsādanāyakaḥ| padaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhistasya madhye garbhaṃ prakalpayet ||| dvibhāgavistṛtā bhittiḥ kartavyā tasya bāhyataḥ| catudviśatiṃ bhramantī sya --- pañcapadāyatā ||| valabhīḥ kārayettadvaddvibhāgeṣu caturṣvapi| pratyaṅgaṃ dvipadaṃ karṇaśālāvalabhikāntare ||| tacca dvipadamuddiṣṭaṃ jalamārge padārdhike| padairdvādaśabhirdikṣu catasṛṣvapi maṇḍapān ||| prāsādasya prakurvīta karmaśobhāvibhūṣitān| mūlāprāsādagarbhasya kuryāddvāracatuṣṭayam ||| vijñeye tacca digbhadre sūtramārgānusārataḥ| jalāntarāṇi kurvīta pratyaṅge pārśvayorapi ||| bāhyabhittiṃ tu kurvīta bhāgenaikena saṃmitām| evaṃ vibhajya kurvīta purato mukhamaṇḍapam ||| ūrdhvamānamathastriṃśā tatra pīṭhaṃ catuṣpadam| madhyaprāsādajaṅghā ca tadvadeva samucchritā ||| ataḥ padaiḥ syādvistārāddviguṇā śikharonnatiḥ| tasyāśca madhye kurvīta ṣoḍaśāṃśaṃ tulodayam ||| tulodayasya madhye dve vedībandhaṃ sapañcakām| jaṅghā cāṣṭapadā kāryā madhye cāsanapaṭṭikā ||| eṣāmantarapatraṃ ca kartavyaṃ tripadocchritam| tulodayasyopariṣṭāt pramāṇamatha kathyate ||| catuṣpadeṣu karṇeṣu kūṭaṃ pañcapadodayam| grīvā padasya pādonatribhiḥ pādaistathāṇḍakam ||| candri kākalaśotsedhaṃ pāḍenaikena kalpayet| pratyaṅge tilakāstryaṃśā ghaṇṭākalaśasaṃyutāḥ ||| madhye tu valabhīśṛṅgamunnataṃ saptabhiḥ padaiḥ| ūrdhvatastilakānāṃ syāduromañjarikā daśa ||| vistāreṇa padānyūrdhvaṃ bhaveddvādaśabhāgikā| skandhapaṭṭādivistāro grīvā pādonabhāgikā ||| aṇḍakaṃ sārdhabhāgena candri kā bhāgamucchritā| dvipadaḥ kalaśocchrāyastadvadbījapūrakam ||| vistāro mūlamañjaryāḥ kāryaḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ padaiḥ| ucchrāyaḥ saptadaśabhiḥ skandho navapadaḥ smṛtaḥ ||| kāryā saptalatopetā praśastā mūlamañjarī| grīvāsya bhāgikā bhāgadvayamāmalasārakam ||| candri kā bhāgamekaṃ syāttripadā kalaśocchritiḥ| uktā yā mūlamañjaryaḥ prākprāsādeṣu tāsviyam ||| kārye māhāmākārā cārukarmopaśobhitā| bāhyabhittisamāyuktaṃ prāsādasya caturdiśam ||| mallacchādyaṃ prakurvīta yathāśobhaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ| sarvataścārurūpādyairvicitraiḥ śubhalakṣaṇaiḥ ||| vibhūṣayetsiṃhakarṇairmallacchādyaṃ manoharaiḥ| valabhītrayasaṃyuktaṃ karṇakūṭacatuṣṭayam ||| yathāśobhaṃ vidhātavyaṃ prāsāde'smiṃstriviṣṭape| vāstau śatapade yāni marmāṇyuktāni sarvataḥ ||| utsṛjya tāni yatnena parikarmātra kārayet| prāsādaṃ kārayitvainamuktarūpaṃ triviṣṭapam ||| labheteha yaśo rājyaṃ paratrānantyameva ca| kṛtvā triviṣṭapaṃ divyaṃ prāsādaṃ purabhūṣaṇam ||| vasettriviṣṭape tāvadyāvadābhūtasaṃplavam| tasyānte tu pare tattve layamāpnoti mānavaḥ ||| triviṣṭapaḥ || athābhidhīyate samyakprāsādaḥ pṛthivījayaḥ| kinnarāsurayakṣādyairvanditaḥ surasattamaiḥ ||| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre vibhāgāṣva vibhājite| caturbhāgā bhavecchālā sapādāṃśavinirgatā ||| karṇaśṛṅgadvayaṃ kāryaṃ pratyekaṃ bhāgavistṛtam| pādonapadaniṣkrāntaṃ --- ||| bhāgaiścaturbhirgarbhaḥ syādbhittiḥ kāryā tu bhāgikā| bhramantikāpi bhāgena bāhyabhittiśca bhāgikī ||| bhāgadvayena kurvīta diktraye'sya catuṣkikām| purato maṇḍapaṃ kuryādupetaṃ karmaśobhayā ||| evaṃ vibhāgān saṃkalpya yathoddeśaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ| mandarasyeva kurvīta karmaśobhāṃ samantataḥ ||| ūrdhvato yatpramāṇaṃ syāttadasyehābhidhīyate| adhastānnāgapīṭhaḥ syātpramāṇena padadvayam ||| hīrakaṃ bhāgapādena tasya madhye niveśayet| vistārāddviguṇaṃ cordhvamānaṃ bhāgārdhasaṃyutam ||| ūrdhvamānasya madhye syātṣaṭpadānibarhaṇādayaḥ| vedībandhaśca tanmadhye kartavyaḥ sārdhabhāgikaḥ ||| tato hīrakasaṃyuktā jaṅghā padacatuṣṭayā| mekhalāntarapatraṃ ca kāryaṃ bhāgārdhasaṃmitam ||| bhāgadvayena kartavyaṃ vedikā rājaserakā| candrā valokaṃ bhāgena vidadhīta vicakṣaṇaḥ ||| kuryātpadasya pādena tatraivāsanapaṭṭakam| padadvayena sāṃśena stambhamūrdhvaṃ niveśayet ||| ardhabhāgena kurvīta bharaṇaṃ stambhaśīrṣake| ardhabhāgena paṭṭaṃ ca chādyaṃ sārdhapadāyatam ||| dve santa paṭhikā kāryā tato bhāgārdhasaṃmitā| ūrdhvamantarapatrasya kathamotha yathākramam ||| kuryād grīvāṇḍakalaśaṃ candri kābhiḥ samaṃ budhaḥ| ucchrāyaṃ karṇaśṛṅgāṇāṃ sārdhabhāgaṃ pramāṇataḥ ||| stambhasūtreṇa kartavyaṃ naṣṭaśṛṅgaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ| kūṭāni pañca kurvīta yathāvatprathamakṣitau ||| prā trīṇi bhūmau dvitīyāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ tu kūṭakam| kuryāttulyasamucchrāyavistāraṃ tacca mānataḥ ||| karṇe karṇe tu kūṭāni bhavantyevaṃ pṛthaṅnava| śukanāsonnatiḥ kāryā sārdhabhāgadvayaṃ budhaiḥ ||| syāduromañjarī pūrvā naṣṭaśṛṅgasya copari| vistārāttripadā sā syātsārdhabhāgatrayonnatā ||| bhāgaṃ sapādaṃ kurvīta grīvāṃ sakalaśāṇḍakam| dvitīyaśṛṅgasyordhvaṃ syāduromañjarikāparā ||| vistīrṇā caturo bhāgānkāryā pañcapadocchritā| skandhāvarohaṇagrīvācandri kākalaśaiḥ saha ||| eteṣāṃ tu samucchrāyaḥ sādhabhāgaṃ vidhīyate| uraḥśikharakāṇyaṣṭāvevaṃ kuryāccaturdiśam ||| tṛtīyakarṇaśṛṅgasya syādūrdhvaṃ mūlamañjarī| sā bhavetṣaṭpadocchrāyā padapañcakavistṛtā ||| tripadaḥ skandhavistāro dikṣu syāccatasṛṣvapi| kūṭaiśca vividhanyāsairalaṅkurvīta mañjarīm ||| ardhabhāgocchritā grīvā sārdhāṃśadvayavistṛtā| aṇḍakasya samucchrāyastribhāgonapadaṃ bhavet ||| karparaṃ cārdhabhāgena kalaśaḥ padamucchritaḥ| navabhiḥ śikharairyuktaḥ kartavyo'yaṃ samantataḥ ||| vedībandhastu sarvatra kartavyaḥ śatavāstuvat| kuryāttena vibhāgena kalaśānapi śobhanān ||| mañjarīḥ padmapatrāgratulyāḥ sarvatra kārayet| aṇḍakāni bhavantyatra catvāriṃśacca pañca ca ||| evaṃvidhaṃ vidhatte yaḥ prāsādaṃ pṛthivījayam| pṛthvīṃ vijayate kṛtsnāṃ nirgitāriḥ sa pārthivaḥ ||| anyo'pi kaścidyaḥ kuryādvarṇācchatabhaktimānimam| so'pi saukhyamavāpnoti paścādante paraṃ padam ||| pṛthivījayaḥ || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi prāsādaṃ kṣitibhūṣaṇam| amarairvanditaṃ sarvaistathā cāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ ||| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre dvādaśāṃśavibhājite| bhadre pañca padāni syuḥ koṇe kāryaṃ padatrayam ||| garbhaṃ ṣodaśabhirbhāgaistasya kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ| kartavyā padaviṃśatyā kandabhittiḥ samantataḥ ||| prāsādasyāsya kartavyā ramaṇī tu padadvayam| paṭṭikā bāhyabhittiḥ syāddvipado bhadra nirgamaḥ ||| jalāntaraṃ tu bhāgastu---gavākṣakāḥ| bhadrā ṇāṃ madhyataḥ pañca prakāśāḥ sumanoramāḥ ||| bāhyālindaṃ prakurvīta vedījālavibhūṣitam| tasyopariṣṭātkurvīta mālyucchrāyaṃ suśobhanam ||| ūrdhvamānamatha brūmaḥ prāsāde kṣitibhūṣaṇe| kṣurakaṃ tasya kurvīta tripadaṃ pīṭhasaṃyutam ||| asyocchrāyastataḥ sārdhapadāḥ syāt pañcaviṃśatiḥ| etanmadhye tu daśabhiḥ padaiḥ kāryastulodayaḥ ||| rekhā pañcadaśāṃśā syātskandhaśīrṣaṃ padārdhakam| vedībandhastu kartavyaḥ sādhabhāgadvayaṃ budhaiḥ ||| jaṅghā ṣaḍbhāgikocchrāyā bhāgārdhe ṣecarāḥ śubhāḥ| mekhalāntarapatraṃ ca padenaikena kārayet ||| kāryā catuṣkikā pañcavistārā tripadocchritā| tadūrdhvataḥ kramaḥ kāryo dvipado'nyo'dhikaṃ padam ||| bhūmayaḥ pañca kartavyā nyūnā ca yathottaram| prathamā bhūmikā kāryā sārdha dvibhāgāstu gavākṣa bhāgatrayaṃ budhaiḥ ||| sapādāstu trayo bhāgā dvitīyāyā samudāhṛtā| tṛtīyā tripadā--- parā ||| --- pañcamī bhūmiriṣyate| pādahīnapadaṃ grīvā sapādapadamaṇḍakam ||| candri kā bhāgamekaṃ syātpadmapatranibhā śubhā| tripadaṃ kalaśaṃ vidyānmātuliṅgasamanvitam ||| drā viḍaṃ nāgaraṃ vāpi vārāṭaṃ vāstu śobhanam| yadekaṃ tevate kartuṃ tadrū paṃ taṃ prakalpayet ||| nānāprakāraiḥ stambhaiśca nānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitaiḥ| kalaśaiḥ padmapatraiśca hīrakaiścopaśobhitam ||| kṛtrimagrāsayuktābhiścandra śālābhiranvitam| makaragrāsasaṃyuktaistoraṇairlakṣaṇānvitaiḥ ||| koṇotkaṇṭhairvicitraiśca rūpaiścitraiśca śobhitam| karma ramyaṃ prakurvīta yathāvadvittavistṛtam ||| guṇavān nṛpatiryadvadbhūṣayatyakhilāṃ mahīm| kṣitiṃ vibhūṣayatyevaṃ prāsādaḥ kṣitibhūṣaṇaḥ ||| dra vyeṣu reṇusaṃkhyā yā sudhāyāmapi yāvatī| tāvadyugasahasrāṇi kartā śivapade vaset ||| kṣitibhūṣaṇaḥ || saṃsthānaṃ sarvatobhadra syādhunā parikīrtyate| caturaśrīkṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ vibhajeddaśabhiḥ padaiḥ ||| tatra garbho bhavettāvān yāvatsyādbrahmaṇaḥ padam| --- bhittiśceti padaṃ padam ||| bhāgaṣaṭkena bhadraṃ syātsārdhabhāgavinirgatam| karṇaṃ dvibhāgikaṃ kuryāt---lamāgrasamanvitam ||| padapādasya pādena vistāro jalavartmanaḥ| yatraikameva bhadraṃ syāccārustambhairalaṅkṛtam ||| saṃmodadaṃ syāṭtadvastu dhanadhānyasukhāvaham| caturbhirvistṛtaṃ bhāgaiḥ sārdhabhāgavinirgatam ||| bhadra syaivāgrato bhadraṃ tacchā bāhyodaraṃ viduḥ| vistārāddviguṇaścāsya samucchrāyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||| kumbhakaṃ bhāgikaṃ kuryādbhāgārdhena masūrakam| bhāgapādena kurvīta tataścāntarapatrakam ||| mekhalāyāḥ samucchrāyamardhabhāgena kārayet| caturbhāgonnatā jaṅghā prāsakiṅkiṇikānvitā ||| padaṃ pādavihīnaṃ syātsthāneṣu hīrakam| mekhalāntarapatraṃ ca padādhena samughṛcchritam ||| tribhāgavinataṃ kuryādbhāge candrā valokanam| ūrdhvamāsanapaṭṭasya stambhaṃ kuryātpadadvayam ||| hīragrahaṇaśīrṣāṃ ca padenaikena kārayet| bhāgenaikena kurvīta paṭṭapiṇḍaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ||| dvipadaṃ chādyavistāraṃ tadardhena tulasvanamaḥ| jaṭharaṃ bāhyasīmā ca bhittayaścāndhakārikā ||| jaṅghotsedhaśca karṇaśca---yathā bhavet| koṇeṣu rathikāḥ kāryāḥ kalaśāntāḥ padatrayam ||| dvitīyā dvipadocchrāyā rathikā parikīrtitā| ucchrāyaḥ siṃhakarṇasya prathamasya padatrayam ||| padadvayaṃ dvitīyasya tata eva samunnatiḥ| śṛṅgāṇāṃ syānmithaḥ kṣepo bhāgaṃ pa--- yathottaram ||| bhāgānsaptocchritaṃ kuryācchikharaṃ vistṛtaṃ ṣaṭ| ardhabhāgocchritā grīvā syādekaṃ bhāgamaṇḍakam ||| candri kārdhapadena syātsārdhaṃ tu kalaśaḥ padam| mañjarīḥ padmapatrāgre tulyāḥ sarvatra kārayet ||| adhastādbhadra pīṭhaṃ tu vāstupādena śobhanam| yaḥ kuryātsarvatobhadraṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam ||| jayaśrīrjāyate tasya ---| sarvatobhadraḥ || brūto vimānaṃ dasyā sādasyātha lakṣaṇam ||| gaṇagandharvajuṣṭasya vallabhasya divaspateḥ| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre śatadhā pravibhājite ||| vimānaṃ vibhajet prājñaḥ śreyaḥpuṣṭisukhāvaham| bhadaiścaturbhistaṃ kuryātkarṇaprāggrīvakaistathā ||| vistārādhaṃ bhavedgarbho yaccheṣaṃ tena bhittayaḥ| triṃśadvā mato jyeṣṭho madhyamaḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ ||| kanīyāṃstu vidhātavyaḥ ṣoḍaśāpyekaviṃśatiḥ| jātiśuddho bhavedeko mañjarībhistathāparaḥ ||| miśrakasya vimānasya traividhyamiti kīrtitam| jyeṣṭho miśrako nirmāgeḥ sarvaḥ kailāsa dra vān ||| madhyamo jātiśuddhastu mañjarībhirvivarjitaḥ| kanīyāṃśca vidhātavyo mañjarībhiralaṅkṛtaḥ ||| karṇaprāggrīvavistāraḥ kartavyo bhāgasammitaḥ| bhāgārdhaṃ kṣobhaṇā kāryā yaccheṣaṃ tacca karṇavat ||| bhāgasyārdhena kurvīta tasmādbhadra sya nirgamam| miśrakasya caturbhāgaḥ prāggrīvo vistareṇa tu ||| mūlasūtrānusāreṇa pārśvayoḥ padikau rathau| ūrdhvamānaṃ vimānasya yathāvadatha kathyate ||| dvipadaṃ pīṭhamākhyātaṃ kinnarairupaśobhitam| skandhaṃ yāvacca bhāgānāṃ dvāviṃśatirudāhṛā! ||| vedībandho tu --- sārdhabhāgadva --- bhavet| caturbhāgo'tra --- chādyā bhāgārdhena --- kinnarāḥ ||| mekhalāntarapatraṃ ca padamekaṃ samunnatam| rūpāṇi jaṅghāgātre syurvā cāriṇāṃ rathake ||| starasekā tasya madhye syānmakaragrāsabhūṣitā| bhallikātoraṇaiścārughaṇṭācamarakinnaraiḥ ||| ūrdhvaṃ tulāpramāṇasya caturbhomaṃ tu prathama| --- bhūmikāyāṃ caturbhāgasamunnatā ||| sordhabhāgā tvaparā vistārā sārdhabhāgikī| saṃkṣepaḥ prathamo'syāḥ kalaśānte padaṃ bhavet ||| tṛtīyā tripadā kāryā sapādapadavistṛtā| padārdhena tu saṃkṣepastasyāḥ kāryo vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||| caturthī tripadā kāryā bhūmirmekhalayā saha| lalitā mañjarībhiśca nīlotpaladalākṛtiḥ ||| sīmnaḥ pañcaguṇaṃ sūtraṃ rekhāntaṃ tatra vartayet| vyāsahavasamamātrā praveśaḥ prathamo bhuvaḥ ||| tato'rdhavṛddhivṛddhau dvāvanyasturyastu tatsamaḥ| padārdhaṃ vedikotsedha vistārātpañcabhāgikī ||| grīvā pādonabhāgaṃ syātsapādaṃ bhagamaṇḍakam| kaṅkatīphalarūpaṃ ca mandārakusumākṛti ||| candri kā grīvayā tulyā kalaśo dvipadonnataḥ| vimānaṃ chandakaṃ kuryātsarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam ||| aśvamedhapradhānairyadiṣṭaiḥ kratuśatairbhavet| tadekena vibhānena phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ ||| vimānam || nandanasyātha vakṣyāmaḥ prāsādasyeha lakṣaṇam| dvāviṃśatikaraṃ kṣetramaṣṭadhā pravibhājayet ||| caturbhāgapravistāraṃ tasya bhadraṃ prakalpayet| bhāgenaikena niṣkrāntaṃ prāgrīvaṃ cāsya śobhanam ||| mūlakarṇasya padikau kartavyau pārśvagau rathau| ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ tryaṅgulaṃ vā caturaṅgulameva ca ||| jalāntaraṃ prakurvīta dīyate tatra mañjarī| gabhaścaturbhirbhāgaiḥ syāccheṣaṃ bhittyandhakārikā ||| dvipadaṃ kandabhadraṃ syātpadapādena nirgatam| purato maṇḍapaṃ cāsya sugrīvaṃ nāma kārayet ||| dvaiguṇyaṃ mūrdhavistārārdhe bha---vedikā| rekhāmasya tathā kuryātkailāsasya yathoditā ||| bhūmayaḥ ṣaḍ vidhātavyā dvādaśāṇḍāḥ pṛthakpṛthak| nandayatyeṣa kartāramiha loke pare ca yat ||| nandano nāma tenoktaḥ prājñaiḥ prāsādasattamaḥ| nandanaḥ || abhidadhmaḥ prāsādaṃ svastikaṃ svastidāyakam ||| devāsuragaṇairvandya pakṣasiddhamahoragaiḥ| jyeṣṭhamadhyakaniṣṭhasya talacchando'sya yadeśaḥ ||| yādṛgūrdhvapramāṇaṃ ca tatsamyagihakathyate| caturaśre same kṣetre pañcaviṃśatihastake ||| sūtrapātaṃ prakurvīta karṇatiryaṅmukhāyatam| tataḥ sīmārdhasūtreṇa vṛttamālikhya niścitam ||| dvātriṃśatā samantādre khābhirvibhajettataḥ| vṛttaṃ tathomughātākṣirdirvidasthābhiraṅkayet ||| dikkarṇasūtrayormadhyaṃ tato sevatrayaṃ budhaḥ| kuryāddvātriṃśadevaṃ syurbhāgāstulyapramāṇakāḥ ||| aindra yā!diṣvīśaparyantāsvaṣṭau śālāḥ prakalpayet| śālāntareṣu kurvīta koṇānaṣṭau yathākramam ||| koṇātkoṇaṃ nayetsūtraṃ tyaktvā śālādvayaṃ muhuḥ| vidikṣvaṣṭasu sūtrāgraṃ padmapatravadānayet ||| koṇāśca rathikāścaiva bhavantyevaṃ sulakṣaṇāḥ| caturaśrā bhavantyaṣṭau śālā bhāgadvayāyatāḥ ||| dvyaṃśāni karṇabhadrā ṇi padmapatranibhāni ca| ūrdhvamānaṃ bhavatyasya dviguṇaṃ hyūrdhvamā---nāt ||| viṃśatyā vibhajedūrdhvaṃ tatrāṣṭa ṣṭāṃśastulodayaḥ| śeṣāṃ tu mañjarīṃ kuryādāskandhāvadhi buddhimān ||| vistārapañcamāṃśena pīṭhocchrāyaṃ prakalpayet| tripadaṃ vedikābandhaṃ suekeṇa samanvitam ||| jaṅghāṃśalaṃbanāṃ kuryāccaturbhāgasamucchritām| mekhalāntarapatraṃ ca bhāgenaikena kārayet ||| dvādaśāṃśocchritā rekhā kāryā sapta ca bhūmayaḥ| ardhabhāgocchritā grīvā vistāreṇa catuṣpadā ||| skandhaḥ ṣaḍbhāgavistāraḥ kāryo vṛttaḥ suśobhanaḥ| samālikhedeṣu kośaṃ vistārāttriguṇātmanā ||| sūtreṇa yena vā skandho bhavet ṣaḍbhāgavistṛtaḥ| hastaiḥ syātpañcaviṃśatyā jyeṣṭhaḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ paraḥ ||| kanīyān svastiko jñeyaḥ karairdvādaśabhiḥ punaḥ| bhāgaṣaṭkasamucchrāyā jaṅghā jyeṣṭhasya kīrtitā ||| madhyamādhamayoḥ pañcacaturbhāgocchritā kramāt| svastike kārite svasti sarvalokasya jāyate ||| viśeṣataśca bhūpānāṃ kartuśca syāt samīhitam| svastikam || muktakoṇamatha brūmaḥ prāsādaṃ syātsa ca tridhā ||| hastaiḥ krameṇa jyeṣṭhādiḥ ṣoḍaśadvādaśāṣṭabhiḥ| jyeṣṭho daśa bhāgānsyānmadhyamastu caturdaśa ||| kanīyān daśa bhāgānsyātsadastasyābhidhīyate| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre bhakte'ṣṭādaśabhiḥ padaiḥ ||| koṣṭhakānāṃ vidhātavyaṃ caturviṃśaṃ śatatrayam| bhāgaṣaṭtriṃśatā kuryānmadhye garbhagṛhaṃ śubham ||| bāhyabhittistathāndhārī madhyabhittiriti trayam| pṛthakpṛthak syāddvipadavistāraṃ parimāṇataḥ ||| caturbhāgāyatā śālā bhāgenaikena nirgatā| śālāyā bhūṣaṇaṃ bhadraṃ vidhāyaitatpadadvayam ||| tatpārśvadvitaye kuryāttvadhike bhāgike budhaḥ| vāryantarāṇi kurvīta dikṣvaṣṭacatasṛṣvapi ||| vāryantarānantaraṃ tu bhāgadvitayasaṃmitān| aṣṭau kurvīta rathikāṃścaturdiśamanuttamān ||| koṇe dvibhāgikaiḥ kuryādra thānāmāṃsasaṃmitā| koṇe rathānparityajya śeṣaṃ kuryādyathoditam ||| madhyamo'yaṃ samākhyātaḥ kanīyān kathyate'dhunā| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre daśabhāgavibhājite ||| caturbhāgā bhavecchālā bhāgenaikena nirgatā| ekabhāgapramāṇāni pārśve vāryantarāṇi ca ||| teṣāṃ madhye prakurvīta sarojadalasaṃnibham| rathakarṇonyarṇe yathāvacca salilāntarabhūṣaṇam ||| bhāgārdhaṃ kṣobhaṇā kāryā catuṣkoṇe vyavasthitā| sādhabhāgonmitānkuryātkarṇaprāggrīvakānśubhān ||| vāryantarāṇāṃ proktā bhūṣaśrobhikanīyasi| prāsāde madhyame'pyeṣā jyāyasyapi ca kalpyavai ||| trividho'yaṃ samākhyāto muktakoṇaḥ samāsataḥ| ūrdhvamānaṃ bhavedasya vistārāddviguṇocchrayam ||| asistu paścadaśabhistanmadhyaṃ syāttulodayaḥ| catuṣpado vedibandho jaṅghā sārdhaiśca saptabhiḥ ||| mekhalāntarapatraṃ cārdhahīrakaṃ padam| tripadā karṇaśṛṅgāsya kalaśāntasamucchrayān ||| siṃhakarṇaśca kartavyaḥ sva---bhāge samunnataḥ| ūrdhvataḥ karṇaśṛṅga vidheyā mūlamañjarī ||| sāvaṣo vistaro---padānyaṣṭādaśocchritāḥ| caturdiśaṃ samāyāmaḥ skandhaḥ syānnavabhāgikaḥ ||| mañjaryāstryaṃśapuremanaḥ śukanāsasamucchritiḥ| grīvā--mena bhāgena kuryāddvipadamaṇḍakam ||| caṇḍikāṃ sārdhabhāgena tripadaṃ kalaśocchrayam| --- yannaraḥ kaścinmuktakoṇaṃ mahāyaśāḥ ||| saṃprāpno te mahāsaukhyaṃ vimuktaḥ sarvapātakaiḥ| sarvadvandvavinirmuktaḥ sarvakilbiṣavarjitaḥ ||| sarvapāpavinirmukto bhogaṃ mokṣaṃ ca vindati| muktakoṇaḥ || śrīvatsamatha vakṣyāmaḥ prāsādaṃ surapūjitam ||| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre daśadhā pravibhājite| ṣaḍbhirbhāgairbhavedgarbho bhittiḥ kāryā dvibhāgikī ||| rathakaṃ tripadaṃ kuryātpratyaṅgātsārdhabhāgikāt| dvipadaṃ karṇamasyāhurvidikṣu catasṛṣvapi ||| bhāgārdhaṃ kṣobhaṇā kṣepāttadardhārdhaṃ jalāntaram| prakṣepaḥ syātpadārdhena padamānasya bāhyataḥ ||| dve pade nirgataṃ cāsya śukanāsaṃ niveśayet| vāstuvistārapādena kartavyā dvāravistṛtiḥ ||| dvārocchrāya vistārātkartavyo dviguṇo budhaiḥ| ūrdhvamānamatha brūmaḥ śrīvatsasya yathoditam ||| pīṭhaṃ prāsādapādena khurakaśca padārdhakaḥ| vistārāddviguṇaṃ kartavyaṃ kumbhakāditaḥ ||| aṃśairdvādaśabhisteṣu kuryācchikharamāyatam| aṣṭabhāgaṃ tulocchrāyaṃ vedī sārdhadvibhāgikī ||| kumbhakaṃ padikaṃ kuryātpādonāṃśaṃ masūrakam| pādonaṃ pādena syāt mekhalāntarapatrakam ||| caturbhāgocchritā jaṅghā bhāgārdhaṃ hīrakaṃ bhavet| mekhalāntarapatraṃ tu bhāgenaikena kārayet ||| ṣaḍbhāgavistṛtaṃ skandhaṃ bhājayeddaśabhiḥ padaiḥ| yathā mūle tathā skandhe'pyaṅgapratyaṅgakalpanā ||| skandhapārśve tu yā rekhā vyaktāśca skandhabāhyataḥ| bhajettā daśabhirbhāgai rūḍhamevaṃ vibhājayet ||| ūrdhvādhaḥ pratibhāgastatrāsyātpatrasaṃhatiḥ| tadākṛtiṃ bāhyarekhāṃ gātre gātre prakalpayet ||| anumātraguṇaṃ sūtraṃ tribhāgena samanvitam| bhramayetkoṇarekhā syātpratyaṅgestatrapañcakān ||| ṣaḍguṇena tu sūtreṇa ratharekhāṃ samālikhet| atra syurbhūmayaḥ sapta prathamāṃśadvayocchritā ||| dvitīyā padapādārdhahīnā bhūmistato bhavet| pādadvayaṃ bhāgahīnaṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ bhavedbhuvi ||| sārdhabhāgavihīnaṃ ca caturthī syātpadadvayam| pañcamā sārdhabhāgena padaṃ syātskandhaśīrṣakam ||| evaṃ parasparaṃ bhāgaṃ pādārdhena jitā bhuvaḥ| tribhāgīkṛtya śikharaṃ tatraikaṃ bhāgamutsṛjet ||| śukanāsocchritiḥ śeṣaṃ siṃhenādhiṣṭhitā bhavet| pādonabhāgā grīvāṇḍaṃ sapādaṃ padamucchritam ||| rekhā --- vidhātavyaṃ --- nyūnādhikamaṇḍakam| sapādabhāgamānena kartavyaṃ candri kādvayam ||| padmapatrākṛtiṃ kuryānmadhye cāmalasārikām| dvipadaṃ kalaśaṃ kuryādbījapūrakavarjitam ||| śrīvatsaṃ kārayedyastu prāsādamatisundaram| kulānāṃ śatamuddhṛtya sa vrajatyamarāvatīm ||| śrīvatsaḥ || atha haṃsasya vakṣyāmaḥ prāsādasyeha lakṣaṇam| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre caturbhirvibhajet padaiḥ ||| bhāgaiścaturbhirgarbhaḥ syādbhittirdvādaśabhāgikī| bhāgadvayena bhadrā ṇi tataśca parikalpayet ||| caturbhāgena niṣkrāmasteṣāṃ garbhasya śasyate| bhāgasya ṣoḍaśāṃśena kuryād nīrantarāṇi ca ||| pīṭhikā vedikābandho jaṅghā mekhalayā saha| ūrdhvamānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ svastikasya yathoditam ||| madhye kinnararūpāṇi padmapatrāṇi cāpyadhaḥ| upari vyālahārāśca pīṭhamevaṃ vibhūṣayet ||| tribhaumaṃ pañcabhaumaṃ vā kuryādenaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ| nāgaraṃ drā viḍeśceti karṇe karṇe niveśayet ||| bhūmikābhāñji kūṭāni kuryādekāntarāṇi ca| rathike rathikā kuryād vinyanāgarakarmaṇā ||| vistārārdhena vedī syād grīvā cāsya padārdhikā| aṇḍakaṃ padikaṃ kāryaṃ kaṅkatīphalasannibham ||| --- caṇḍikā kalaśaḥ syātpadocchritaḥ| yathā virājate haṃsomāśirasi sthitaḥ ||| prāsādo'pi tathā haṃsaḥ puramadhye virājate| haṃsākhyamenaṃ prāsādaṃ kārayedyo bharottamā ||| tāvatsvarge vasecchrīmān yāvadindrā ścaturdaśa| haṃsaḥ || rucakākhyamatha brūmaḥ prāsādaṃ purabhūṣaṇam ||| ādau samastavastūnāṃ kalpitaṃ padmajanmanā| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre caturbhirbhājite padaiḥ ||| bhāgamekaṃ bhavedbhittistasya garbhaḥ padadvayam| vedībandhaṃ tathā jaṅghāṃ mekhalāmūrdhvamekhalām ||| mānamūrdhvamadhaścāsya śrīvatsasyeva kārayet| koṇeṣu stambhakāḥ kāryā hāi hīisārṣasamanvitā ||| madhye tu rathikā kāryā cārakarmavibhūṣitā| caturbhaumamidaṃ kāryaṃstavaivasaṭa karmaṇā ||| yuktaṃ madhye tu rathikā pratibhūmi vidhīyate| rucakaḥ kārito yena prāsādaḥ śubhavāstuni ||| kulānāṃ tāritaṃ tena śatamātmā tathoddhṛtaḥ| rucakaḥ || vardhamānamatha brūmo dharmārogyayaśaskaram ||| tasyāṣṭhaguṇamaiśvaryaṃ bhavedyaḥ kārayedyadi| caturaśraṃ samaṃ kṣetraṃ bhājayeddaśabhiḥ padaiḥ ||| tato bhāgacatuṣkeṇa kartavyo madhyamo rathaḥ| ekaikena vibhāgena dvau rathau vāmadakṣiṇau ||| karṇāstu padā kāryā varjaṃ cāridharmabhiḥ| bhadra sya nirgamaṃ tatra bhāgenaikena kārayet ||| bhāgasyārdhena pārśvastharathakānāṃ vinirgatam| vistārārdhena garbhaḥ syādyaccheṣaṃ tena bhittayaḥ ||| ūrdhvamānaṃ bhavedasya svastikasya yathoditam| vardhamāno'yamākhyāto yaśolakṣmīvivardhanaḥ ||| vardhamānaḥ || garuḍasyādhunā brūmaḥ prāsādasyeha lakṣaṇam| prāsādaḥ sarvadaivāyaṃ garuḍadhvajavallabhaḥ ||| dvāviṃśatipadaṃ kṣetraṃ bhaktālyā samāyatam| pūrvāpareṇa daśabhirbhāgairbhūyo vibhājitam ||| kurvīta madhye prāsādaṃ tasmiñśatapadaṃ budhaḥ| dvipadaṃ bhittivistāraṃ karṇāṃścāpi dvibhāgikān ||| utsṛṣṭamūlaprāsādamubhayorapi pakṣayoḥ| agrataḥ pṛṣṭhataścāpi dvau dvau bhāgau parityajet ||| śeṣeṇa ṣaṭpadau --- sahasāyāmavistṛtī| garbhaḥ ṣoḍaśabhirbhāgairbhittiḥ syātpadametayoḥ ||| rīvatsahaṃsarucakavardhamāneṣu ko'pi yaḥ| rocate garuḍaṃ kuryāttamekaṃ svecchayā budhaḥ ||| tasya pakṣau vidhātavyau nirgatau vāmadakṣiṇam| evamete trayo garbhā garuḍe parikīrtitāḥ ||| garuḍaḥ || prāsādasya gajasyātha lakṣaṇaṃ sampracakṣmahe| catuḥṣaṣṭipadaṃ kṣetraṃ vidhāya vibhajedgajam ||| tataḥ sīmādhasūtreṇa pṛṣṭhato vṛttamālikhet| garbhaṃ kuryāttadardhena --- rekhākṛtiṃ ta --- ||| ūrdhvapramāṇamadhunā gajasya spaṣṭamucyate| stambhāścatuṣpadocchrāyāḥ kāryāḥ koṇacatuṣṭaye ||| jaṅgheyamasya nirdiṣṭā khallastambhāntaraṃ bhavet| paṭṭikāntarapatrābhyāṃ samabhāgena mekhalā ||| agrataḥ śūrasenaṃ syātpṛṣṭhatastu gajākṛtiḥ| gajaḥ || prāsādasyādhunā lakṣma siṃhasaṃjñasya kathyate ||| caturaśraṃ samaṃ kṣetraṃ vibhajennandane yathā| garbho bhāgaiścaturbhiḥ syātkañcabhittistu bhāgikī ||| bhāgenāndhārikā kāryā bāhyabhittiśca bhāgikī| bhadraṃ bhāgaiścaturbhiḥ syādbhāgenaikena nirgatam ||| karṇastu dvipadaḥ kāryo jalamārgasamanvitaḥ| dvipadaṃ pīṭhamutsedhātsiṃharūpairadhiṣṭitam ||| khurakaṃ ca padārdhena kuryātpīṭhasya madhyataḥ| kuryādūrdhvaṃ ---vistārāddviguṇaṃ kalayādhikam ||| dvipadaṃ vedikābandhaṃ jaṅghā cāsya catuṣpadam| mekhalāntarapatraṃ ca vidadhyādbhāgikodayam ||| tryaṃśāni karṇaśṛṅgāṇi grīvāṇḍakalaśaiḥ saha| siṃhakarṇastu kartavyaḥ samucchrāyāccatuṣpadaḥ ||| siṃharūpasamākrānte prāsāde siṃhasaṃjñite| ūrdhvataḥ karṇaśṛṅgasya ṣaṭpadā mūlamañjarī ||| saptabhāgasamutsedhā latābhiḥ pañcabhiryutā| grīvocchrāyastu kartavyaḥ padaṃ pādena varjitam ||| aṇḍakaṃ tu padotsedhaṃ rekhāyāṃ ca dvinissṛtam| pādonabhāgamucchrāyaścandri kāyāḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||| dvipadaṃ kalaśaṃ kuryādbījapūrakasaṃyutam| yadāmaṃ kārayetsa syādajeyaḥ puruṣo dhruvam ||| vyavahāre nṛpakule saṅgrāme śakrasaṃsadi| siṃhaḥ || idānīṃ padmakaṃ brūmaḥ prāsādaṃ padamasannibham ||| yaḥ kasān kārayatyenaṃ sa kāmāllam̐ bhate'khilān| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre --- dikṣu vidikṣu vā ||| nyasyetpṛthakpṛthaksūtrāṇyatha vṛttaṃ prasādhayet| didhisūtrayormadhye caturaśraṃ tu romakam ||| tulyaprāmāṇyavinyasyetsyurdvātriṃśadamīritaḥ| vistṛtānyatha bhāgau dvau karṇapatrāṇi ṣoḍaśa ||| padmapatrasamānāni vārimārgānvitāni ca| garbhaḥ syādbāhya saṃmohā sīmādhaṃ yaccheṣaṃ tena bhittayaḥ ||| ṣaḍaṣṭadvādaśakaraḥ padmo jyeṣṭhādikaḥ kramāt| dvātriṃśat ṣoḍaśāṣṭau ca tasya syū rathakāḥ kramāt ||| jalāntarāṇi caitasya śrīvatsasyeva kārayet| pīṭhakaṃ vedikābandhaṃ jaṅghāśekharacandri kāḥ ||| aṇḍakaṃ kalaśaṃ grīvāmetasyocchrayamānataḥ| kurvīta svastikasyeva svavistārānusārataḥ ||| padmaḥ || athābhidhīyate samyak prāsādo nandivardhanaḥ| nandayatyeṣa kartāraṃ putradāradhanādibhiḥ ||| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre bhajet ṣoḍaśabhiḥ padaiḥ| śatadvayaṃ vibhāgāḥ syuḥ ṣaṭpañcāśattathā paraiḥ ||| garbhaḥ śatapadaḥ kāryo bhittiśca tripadāyatā| karṇapramāṇaṃ tripadaṃ vavabandhasamanvitam ||| bhāgāyataṃ bhāgapadaṃ vistīrṇaṃ vārivartma ca| vibhajetpañcadhā karṇaṃ tasya bhadraṃ tribhiḥ padaiḥ ||| bhāgaṃ bhāgaṃ bhavetkarṇe bhāgārdhaṃ bhadra nirgamaḥ| pratyaṅgaṃ dvipadaṃ kuryādvārimārgeṇa saṃyutam ||| nirgamāṃ sārdhabhāgena pārśvayorubhayorapi| śālāṣaṭpadavistārā pratyaṅgā bhāganirgatam ||| bhadraṃ tadagrataḥ kuryādvistāreṇa catuṣpadam| bhāgārdhanirgamaṃ samyagdikṣu sarvāsvayaṃ vidhiḥ ||| karṇasyārdhe nayedgarbhādvṛttaṃ tatpūrvamālikhet| anusāreṇa vitaredaṅgapratyaṅganirgamam ||| sārdhabhāgaṃ gajādhāraṃ sābjapatraṃ samekhalam| kuryātpadaṃ pādahīnaṃ jaṅghākumbhasamucchritam ||| bhāgapādena kaṇakaṃ pādonāntarapatrakam| tadardhaṃ grāsahāraṃ ca bhāgārdhaṃ khurakaṃ tathā ||| khurakeṇa samaṃ proktā pīṭhasyaiṣā samucchritiḥ| vistārāddviguṇaścāyaṃ syādūrdhvakalpayādhakaḥ| tulodayo vidhātavyastrayodaśabhiraṃśakaiḥ| viṃśatyaṃśaṃ tu śikharaṃ --- ścatuṣpadam ||| pādonabhāgadvitayaṃ kumbhakaṃ teṣu kārayet| bhāgenaikena kalaśamardhenāntarapatrakam ||| pādahīnapadaṃ kāryā mekhalāsya suśobhanā| jaṅghā ṣaḍbhāgikocchrāyā bhāgārdhaṃ grāsapaṭṭikā ||| hīrakaṃ caikabhāgena karṇasthaṃ parikīrtitam| mekhalāntarapatraṃ ca sādhabhāgasamunnatam ||| jaṅghāmadhye tu kartavyā rathakā rathakāstathā| vṛttastambhaiḥ samakarairgrāsairmuktāvarālakaiḥ ||| jaṅghā tu saṃvṛtā kāryā mallacchādyairvibhūṣitā| jalāntareṣu rūpāṇi kuryātsaṅghāṭakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||| kuryāttulodayasyordhvamimi bhūmibhiraṣṭabhiḥ| skandhāṣṭāṃśo'sya dūrādyā---sapadatrayam ||| dvitīyā tripadā proktā tṛtīyā pādavarjitā| sārdhadvyaṃśā caturthī ca pādonā pañcamī tataḥ ||| ṣaṣṭhī tu dvipadā kāryā pādonā saptamī tataḥ| aṣṭamī tu kṛtiḥ kāryā sārdhabhāgena saṃmitā ||| ekaikasyāḥ padārdhena prakṣepaḥ syātparasparam| koṇe kūṭāni kurvīta pratyaṅge tikā lakāni ca ||| bhadre kurvīta rathikā vividhāḥ karmasaṅkulāḥ| rathasya pārśvayorlekhāḥ kartavyāścobhayorapi ||| vedikāsya vidhātavyā bhāgamekaṃ samunnatā| grīvā tāvadbhāgamekamaṇḍakaṃ dvipadodayam ||| kuryātsāmalasāriṃ ca candri kāṃ sārdhabhāgikām| kalaśastripadaḥ kāryo bījapūraṃ bahistataḥ ||| purataḥ śūrasenaṃ syānmadhye rūpasamākulam| miśrakasya vimānasya sadṛśaṃ kārayedamum ||| bhūṣaṇaṃ bhavanasyāsya prāsādaṃ nandivardhanam| prāsādaviṃśatiriyaṃ parikīrtiteha| mervādikā sakalanākasadāmabhīṣṭā || tattvena vetti ya imāṃ sa samagraśilpi-| vargāgraṇīrbahumataśca bhavennṛpāṇām ||| iti mahārājādhirājaparameśvaraśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhārāparanāmni vāstuśāstre mervādiviṃśikā nāma saptapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ| <58> atha prāsādastavanaṃ nāma aṣṭapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ| prāsādānāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭiridānīmabhidhīyate| yā pūrvaṃ brahmaṇā dattā prāsādā viśvakarmaṇe ||1 marmavedhasthitā vāstudevāḥ pūjyā yathocitam| pūjyatā ca smṛtā teṣāṃ prāsāde maṇḍape dhvaje ||2 āsane vāhane tadvatsarvopakaraṇeṣvapi| prāsāde yādṛśaśchūndastādṛṅmandapīṭhayoḥ ||3 tathā vāstuviruddhaṃ syātprāsādāṅge hite viduḥ| aṣṭāvaṣṭau smṛtāsteṣu tridaśānāṃ pṛthakpṛthak ||4 śambhorharerviriñcasya grahāṇāmadhipasya ca| caṇḍikāyā gaṇeśasya śriyāḥ sarvadivaukasām ||5 vimānaḥ sarvatobhadro gajapṛṣṭho'tha padmakaḥ| pṛṣabho muktakoṇaśca nalino drā viḍastathā ||6 ityete'ṣṭau samuddiṣṭāḥ prāsādāstripuradruhaḥ| garuḍo vardhamānaśca śaṅkhāvarto'tha puṣpakaḥ ||7 gṛharasvastikaścaiva rucakaḥ puṇḍravardhanaḥ| kāryā janārdanasyāṣṭau prāsādāḥ purabhūṣaṇāḥ ||8 merumandarakailāsā haṃsākhyo bhadra eva ca| uttuṅgo miśrakaścaiva tathā mālādharo'ṣṭamaḥ ||9 ityaṣṭau brahmaṇaḥ proktāḥ prāsādāḥ puramadhyagāḥ| gavayaścitrakūṭaśca kiraṇaḥ sarvasundaraḥ ||10 | śrīvatsaḥ padmanābhaśca vairājo vṛtta eva ca| ete kāryā raveraṣṭau prāsādāḥ śubhalakṣaṇāḥ ||11 nandyāvartaścaiva calabhaścarṇadikhyaḥ siṃha eva ca| vicitro yogapīṭhaśca ghaṇṭānādapatākinau ||12 aṣṭāvete vidhātavyāścaṇḍikāyāḥ surālayāḥ| guhārasalokaśca veṇubhadro 'tha kuñjaraḥ ||13 tathā ca harṣavijayāvudakumbho'tha modakaḥ| etān vināyakasyāṣṭau prāsādān kārayecchubhān ||14 mahāpadma harmyananalamujjayantastathā paraḥ| gandhamādanasaṃjñaṃ ca śataśṛṅgānavaṣkakau ||15 suvibhrānto hārītyaṣṭau lakṣmyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ| vṛtto vṛttāyataścaityaḥ kiṅkiṇīlayanābhidhaḥ ||16 paṭṭiśo vibhavākhyaśca tataścārāgaṇāṣṭamaḥ| kurvīta sarvadevānāṃ prāsādān vāstuśāstravit ||17 iti prāsādastavanaṃ nāmāṣṭapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ| <59> vimānādicatuṣṣaṣṭiprāsādalakṣaṇaṃ nāmaikonaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ| vimānamatha vakṣyāmaḥ prāsādaṃ śambhuvallabham| svargapātālamartyānāṃ trayāṇāmapi bhūṣaṇam ||1 sarveṣāṃ gṛhavāstūnāṃ prāsādānāṃ ca sarvataḥ| prāsādo mūlabhūto'yaṃ tathā ca parikarmaṇām ||2 ekāśītipade vāstu vimāne pañcabhūmike| karṇāntayoḥ śatapadaṃ prāsādeṣvapareṣu tu ||3 brahmāsṛjatpañcabhaumavimānāni purā raveḥ| mūlakarṇānugairbhadrai rdviguṇocchrāyavanti ca ||4 śeṣabhadra sya niṣkāso bhadra devacatuṣṭayam| ākāśadevatādhāracatryathā vidikṣu ca ||5 daśadhā kṛtavistāro vimāne samprakīrtitaḥ| pañcabhāgyapramāṇaśca garbhe bhittistadardhataḥ ||6 prāggrīvaṃ bhittivistāraṃ garbhāyāmattathāgrataḥ| tataḥ prāggrīvavistāraḥ kṣobhaṇīyaḥ karāṅgulaiḥ ||7 bhāgiko rathavistāraḥ karṇikā cārdhabhāgikī| bhāgapañcakavistāraṃ bhadraṃ yattatprakīrtitam ||8 bhūṇastovahestasya nirgamo bhāgikaḥ smṛtaḥ| bhāgārdhena vidhātavyaḥ kṣobhaṇo jalavartmanaḥ ||9 karṇikāṃ jalamāgaṃ ca samasūtreṇa māpayet| athocyate bhūmikānāṃ stambhānāṃ ceha lakṣaṇam ||10 vistārāddviguṇaḥ skandhaḥ sarvasmin buddhanāgare| ---pañcabhāgā syājjaṅghāsvasamucchritiḥ ||11 tilakānāṃ tathocchrāyo vidhātavyo dvibhāgikaḥ| tilakasya śiroghaṇṭāṃ caikasūtreṇa māpayet ||12 jaṅghāmānatribhāgena khurapiṇḍīṃ prakalpayet| khurakaṃ vedibandhaṃ ca samasūtreṇa māpayet ||13 jaṅghāmānatribhāgena khurapiṇḍīṃ prakalpayet| khurakaṃ vedibandhaṃ ca samasūtreṇa sūtrayet ||14 dvitīyabhūmikotsedhaṃ siṃhakarṇaṃ vibhūṣayet| mastake ghaṇṭayā yuktā caturbhāgocchritā ca sā ||15 tatastṛtīyabhūtsedhaḥ padatulyāṃśavarjitaḥ| caturthī bhūmikā kāryā sārdhabhāgatrayocchritā ||16 mañjarīstambhayormadhye savātāyanamekhalā| dvitīyā bhūmikā yā sā siṃhakarṇairalaṅkṛtā ||17 tasyā dvāraṃ vidhātavyaṃ kapāṭadvayasaṃyutam| syāvarddhātpāṭitaṃ dvāraṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ sadā bhuvi ||18 pādena dvipadotsedhā tadūrdhvaṃ vedimekhalā| kairavāṇāṃ daleryuktā kartavyā dṛṣṭihāribhiḥ ||19 vedikā pañcavistārā kāryā bhāgasamucchritā| grīvārdhabhāgikotsedhā ghaṇṭaikaṃ bhāgamucchritā ||20 pañcabhāga---vistārā ghaṇṭākoṭirvidhīyate| kumāndaṃ vedibandhaṃ ca ghaṇṭāgraṃ mastakodayam ||21 māpayetsamasūtreṇa samantādbhūmipañcake| vyāsārdhahastasaṅkhayāni praveśā prathamaṃ kṣiteḥ ||22 aṅgulāni tadā dvyardho dvitīyāyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ| saṃyogādanayoryaḥ syāttṛtīyāyāstamādiśet ||23 tadardhyardhaścaturthyāstu pañcamyāḥ śeṣa īritaḥ| svamūlavistṛterbhāgastṛtīyo vedikordhvataḥ ||24 latayā vistṛtirbhadre yuktāyā jālavartamanaḥ| vedidogravidhātavyo sārdhasavistṛtau ||25 mañjaryāḥ stambhasīmānāṃ kṣobhayetpuṣṭimānataḥ| vedyāṃ bhāge śālāyāṃ niṣkrāmo mūlakoṇataḥ ||26 sthānairvicitrarūpaiḥ syātsiṃhakarṇaiśca bhūṣitaḥ| pañcavyāsena sūtreṇa rekhāmasya samālikhet ||27 etadvimānaṃ lalitaṃ devadevasya kārayet| vimānam || saṃsthānaṃ sarvatobhadra syedānīmabhidhīyate ||28 jaṭharaṃ bāhyasīmā ca tathā bhittyandhakārikā| jaṅghotsedhaśca karṇau ca yathā merostathā bhavet ||29 tathaiva bhadra vistāraḥ ṣaḍbhāgena samantataḥ| rathike ca dvibhāge staḥ koṇasaṃjñe ca pārśvayoḥ ||30 muṣṭipramāṇaṃ vistāraṃ kartavyamudakāntaram| vistārāddviguṇaḥ skandhasyocchrāyo bhāgaviṃśatiḥ ||31 pañcabhāgasamutsedhā jaṅghā kāryā sadā budhaiḥ| mekhalāntarapatraṃ ca sārdhabhāgasamucchritam ||32 śṛṅgaṃ bhāgatrayotsedhaṃ sagrīvāmalasārakam| mūlaśṛṅgasya garbheṇa nyasyeduparibhūmikām ||33 dvitīyabhūmivistāraṃ daśadhā pravibhājayet| dvau bhāgau śṛṅgavistārau vidheyaḥ pārśvayordvayoḥ ||34 sagrīvāmalasārasya taiḥ śṛṅgasyodayasthitiḥ| tasya śṛṅgasya garbheṇa kartavyoparibhūmikā ||35 tasyā bhūmestu vistāraṃ daśadhā bhājayetpunaḥ| yaḥ śeṣaḥ śikharāyāmo tadviṃtinaṃte vinirdiśet ||36 vibhajedvardhamānaṃ vā rucakaṃ vāstuśobhanam| karṇāntare bhadra madhye vallabhālabhīṃ tatra kārayet ||37 bhūmikāśikhareṇordhvaṃ navabhūmiṃ vibhedayet| vedikāmadhyasūtrasya karṇatordhvabhuvastathā ||38 bhūmikordhvabhuvaścaiva vistāraṃ daśadhā bhavet| mūlasīmānusāreṇa syācchedāvadhi saṃhṛtiḥ ||39 grīvā mūlārdhabhāge --- nāmalasārakam| candri kā cārdhabhāgena --- kalaśo bhavet ||40 sarvatobhadraḥ || gajasya saṃsthānamatha prāsādasyābhidhīyate| catuḥṣaṣṭipadaṃ vāstu prāsādasya vibhājayet ||41 tataḥ sīmārdhasūtreṇa pṛṣṭhato vṛttamālikhet| pañcabhāgamitā jaṅghā mekhalā sārdhabhāgikī ||42 agrataḥ sūrasenaḥ syātpṛṣṭhataḥ kuñjarākṛtiḥ| sīmānamaṣṭadhā kṛtvā vibhajennandane yathā ||43 dvau dvau ca karṇayorbhāgau bhadre ṣu caturo viduḥ| vistārārdhena jaṅghā syādra thikāyāḥ pṛthakpṛthak ||44 bhāgatrayocchritaṃ śṛṅgaṃ karṇadeśe vidhīyate| saptabhāgasamutsedhā valabhī madhyasaṃśritā ||45 samantādbhadra saṃsthānā rekhāgrīvāṇḍakādibhiḥ| siṃhakarṇaiśca bhadre ṣu prāsādo garbha ucyate ||46 vittasādhyavihīnena kartavyaḥ svastike yathā| sarvavattasya syuḥ patranibhāḥ ||47 vistāro' ---tha jaṅghā ca latini svastike yathā| udakāntara --- śrīvatse nandane yathā ||48 padmaḥ || brūmo'tha vṛṣabhaṃ sa syātpūrvokai rūpakarmabhiḥ| caturbhadra ścaturdvāro vimāno satrisākṛti ||49 tevṛddhistatpramāṇāśca sīmāśikharakodayaiḥ| karṇavedakapotālī jaṅghāgre mastakena ca ||50 sārdhadvibhāgavistāraurakairvāmadakṣiṇau| kāryau bhadraṃ caturbhāgaṃ bhāgārdhaṃ salilāntaram ||51 stambhadvayaṃ bhavettasya sarvabhūmyantareṣu ca| ekaḥ stambho vimāne syāddvau stambhau vṛṣabhe punaḥ ||52 eṣa bhedaḥ samākhyāto vimānasya vṛṣasya ca| vṛṣabhaḥ || muktakoṇamatha brūmastaṃ bhāgairaṣṭabhirbhajet ||53 mūlakarṇāvubhau bhāgau bhavato vāmadakṣiṇau| madhyaśṛṅgaṃ caturbhāgaṃ pramāṇaṃ jaṭharasya ca ||54 karṇaśṛṅgāntayormadhye kurvīta salilāntaram| rathakau pārśvayoḥ pūrṇau bhadra deśe jalāntaram ||55 vistārotsedhajaṅghāśca sagrīvāmalasārakaḥ| latināmiva kartavyāḥ pramāṇena samantataḥ ||56 muktakoṇaḥ || brūmo'tha nalinīṃ tasyāḥ pramāṇaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam| tasyāṃ tu mārgasyaśca devagarbhaḥ surālayaḥ ||57 bhittivistṛtirāyāmo muktakoṇe yathā tathā| madhyadeśe tu yacchṛṅgaṃ --- karṇāntare ca yat ||58 muktakoṇe yathā tacca bhedaḥ karmavibhedanāt| caturaśre smṛto madhye karṇaśṛṅge vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||59 nalinaḥ| bramo'tha maṇikaṃ tasya śālāliṅgasamudgatā| alindakārdhasīmāyāṃ sarvataḥ syāccatuṣkikā ||60 śreyaḥ puṣṭisukhārtho'yaṃ maṇiko'tra vimānavat| daśadhā kṣetrasīmnaḥ syādvibhāgaḥ sarvatodiśam ||61 ratha --- karṇikārdhaṃ ca jalavartmātha bhadra kam| mūlagarbhastathotsedho ghaṇṭā stambhāntavistṛtā ||62 bhūmijaṅghāsamutsedhaḥ kapotāddvāranirgamaḥ| siṃhakarṇā vimānāni stambhacitrādikāstathā ||63 toraṇānyatha mālyāni tasyālaṅkaraṇāni ca| nīlotpaladalākārā mañjaryaḥ sarvaśobhanāḥ ||64 vimānamaparaṃ hyetadyonirekastayordvayoḥ| kevalaṃ bhadra bhedena maṇiko drā viḍo'pyayam ||65 maṇikaḥ || prāsādamatha vakṣyāmo garuḍaṃ sarvasundaram| daśadhā kṣetravistāraṃ tasya pūrvaṃ vibhājayet ||66 dvau bhāgau rathikāḥ kāryā mūlakarṇādvinissṛtāḥ| bhadraṃ ṣaḍbhāgavistāraṃ pakṣavaṃśādibheditam ||67 alindanirgamaḥ kāryaḥ sīmārdhena caturdiśam| mūlasīmā tu kartavyā salilāntaravarjitā ||68 syānmūlasīmavistārātskandhaḥ syāddviguṇocchritiḥ| prāsādasya samucchrāyāttribhāgena samekhalām ||69 jaṅghāmantarapatreṇa kuṃ yuktaṃ kurvastasā| jīrakaṃ vedibandhaṃ ca bhāgatrayasamucchritam ||70 alimbānāṃ samutsedhaṃ śekharārdhena kārayet| ṣaḍbhāgaṃ skandhavistāraṃ vidadhīta vicakṣaṇaḥ ||71 grīvārdhabhāgamutsedhādbhāgamāmalasārakam| kumudaṃ cārdhabhāgena kumbhaḥ syādekabhāgikaḥ ||72 garuḍaḥ || athocyate vardhamāno daśadhā taṃ vibhājayet| pādonāṃśadvayaṃ kuryātpārśvayoḥ karṇavistṛtim ||73 sapādapadavistārau rathakau vāmadakṣiṇau| caturbhāgonmitaṃ bhadraṃ vistāreṇa prakīrtitam ||74 vistāro dviguṇocchrāyaṃ skandhaṃ yāvatprakalpayet| khurakasyātha jaṅghāyā mañjarīskandhayorapi ||75 grīvāmalasārakādeḥ pramāṇaṃ garuḍe yathā| vardhamānaḥ || dvāviṃśatikarāyāmaḥ śaṅkhāvarto'tha kathyate ||76 mūlasīmāvṛttanāhastasya syātpadmake yathā| bhittigarbhasya vistāraḥ pādenārdhanavakamāt ||77 alindamagrataḥ kuryātsiṃhakarṇavibhūṣitam| utsedhatryaṃśato jaṅghā vedyaṃ tatra vibhāgataḥ ||78 āskandhaṃ vedikābandhādvistṛterdviguṇocchritiḥ| mekhalāntarapatraṃ ca jaṅghāmadhye vidhīyate ||79 bhramayetkarṇasūtreṇa bahirvṛttaṃ samantataḥ| karṇadikpālayormadhyaṃ vṛttasūtreṇa vartayan ||80 avaśiṣṭaṃ talacchandaṃ svastikasyeva kārayet| grīvāmamalasāraṃ ca kalaśaṃ vārinirgamam ||81 kurvīta svastikasyeva vistārotsedhamānataḥ| śūlasīmānusāreṇa cchede saṃvaraṇaṃ bhavet ||82 tadrū pameva latinaṃ vartayedvalanākṛtim| śaṅkhāvartaḥ || brūmo'tha puṣpakaṃ sa syādvimānasadṛśākṛtiḥ ||83 tāvatpramāṇastadvṛddhiḥ pañcabhūścaturaśrakaḥ| vimānena mānayukta yanmañjaryā yacca lakṣaṇam ||84 tatkāryamatra mañjaryā natu kāryaṃ jalānataram| puṣpakaḥ || gṛharājamatha brūmaḥ sa syātkailāsasannibhaḥ ||85 viṭaṅkanirgamādhāraniryūhaiḥ sarvato vṛtaḥ| valabhyā bhūṣito madhye gavākṣadvārasaṃyutaḥ ||86 kapotastambhaparyantaḥ śālābhañjīvirājitaḥ| vedikākhaṇḍaśālādyaṃ ka---parito bhavet ||87 kuvītya mallakacchādyaiḥ siṃhakarṇaiśca bhūṣitaḥ| alindabhedataḥ prāhurgṛharājamitaṃ budhāḥ ||88 kailāsasyeva saṃsthānaṃ syādasyordhvamadho'pi ca| gṛharājaḥ || brūmo'tha svastikaṃ tasya pūrvavanmānalakṣaṇam ||89 tenaiva latinaṃ sarvaṃ kurvītainaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ| yathā mūle vibhaktāḥ syurlatinasvastikādayaḥ ||90 tathaiṣāṃ skandhabhaktānāṃ madhye rekhāṃ prakalpayet| prāsādaḥ svastiko nāma syādevaṃ lakṣaṇānvitaḥ ||91 sudhānāsodayaḥ svasya kartavyaḥ sa---bhāgikaḥ| skandhaṃ yāvatsamutsedho vistārāddviguṇo bhavet ||92 tyavṛdbhāgocchritā jaṅghā mekhalā cā---bhāgikī| madhyaśālā dvibhāgāśca mūlasūtravibhāgataḥ ||93 karṇā dvibhāgikāścaivaṃ jalamārgastu ṣoḍaśa| aṣṭau śālā bhavantyasmin karṇāścāṣṭau samantataḥ ||94 prāggrīvaṃ bāhyataḥ kuryātsukhabhāgavicakṣaṇaḥ| kalaśaścaṇḍikā grīvā tadvadāmalasārakaḥ ||95 ūrdhva ūrdhvapramāṇaṃ ca yathaivādya tathā bhavet| svastikaḥ || rucakaṃ brūmahe tasya vibhāgo daśadhā bhavet ||96 bhāgadvayamitau karṇau bhadraṃ ṣaḍbhāgasammitam| teṣāṃ vinirgamaṃ vidyāddhastāmātrā pramāṇataḥ ||97 kuryādudakamārgāṃśca prāsāde rucake kvacit| skandhāvaśiṣṭamutsedho vistārāddviguṇo bhavet ||98 vedikāyāstu vistāraḥ skandhe ṣaḍbhāgikaḥ smṛtaḥ| tṛtīyāṃśena kurvīta jaṅghāmūrdhvaṃ surodayān ||99 jaṅghāyāśca tribhāgena kāryā khurakharaṇḍikā| mekhalāntarapatraṃ ca kuryādadhyardhabhāgikam ||100 sārdhatriguṇasūtreṇa pūrvā karkaṭanā bhavet| caturguṇaṃ mūlasūtreṇa madhye karkaṭanā smṛtau ||101 vibhajya daśadhā skandhavistāraṃ taiḥ prakalpayet| bhadraṃ caturbhiḥ karṇāśurṇāṃstu kuryādbhastribhistribhiḥ ||102 svacchāyā bhūmikāḥ kāryā yā vā mūlārdhabhāgikīḥ| bhāgenāmalasāraṃ ca kumudaṃ cārdhabhāgikam ||103 kumbhaṃ bhāgena kurvīta prāsāde rucake budhaḥ| sādhāraṇo'yaṃ sarveṣāṃ prāsādastu divaukasām ||104 rucakaḥ || puṇḍravardhanakaṃ brūmaḥ prāsādaṃ vallabhaṃ hareḥ| bhramayenmūlasīmāspṛgvṛttamādau samantataḥ ||105 tacchālākarṇasaṃyuktaṃ kartavyaṃ sarvatodiśam| yaśchandaḥ svastike'sya syāddviguṇaḥ puṇḍravardhane ||106 jaṅghodakāntabhadrā ṇāmucchrāyo vistṛtiśca yā| svastike kathitā saiva vijñeyā puṇḍravardhane ||107 puṇḍravardhanaḥ || athābhidhīyate merurdaśadhā tatra bhājayet| sīmānaṃ tasya kurvīta śṛṅgaṃ cāpi vibhāgikam ||108 śeṣaṃ bhāgikaṃ bhadra māyamāne vidhīyate| padasya ṣoḍaśausenaṃ kartavyamudakāntaram ||109 padaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirgarbho vidhātavyaḥ padaṃ padam| bhittirandhārikā bāhyabhittiścāsya vidhīyate ||110 bhāgaṣaṭkocchritā jaṅghā mekhalā caikabhāgikī| śṛṅgaṃ ca tripadotsedhaṃ śikharaṃ syāddaśocchritam ||111 kartavyaṃ vāstuśāstrajñaistasyaikādaśabhūmikam| ardhapañcamavistāraḥ skandho grīvārdhabhāgikā ||112 ucchrāyeṇa vidhātavyā bhāgikotsedhamaṇḍakam| bhāgādhikaṃ ca kumudaṃ bhāgikā kalaśocchritiḥ ||113 ṣaḍguṇenaiva sūtreṇa rekhā tasya prakīrtitā| meruṃ merugiriprakhyamevaṃ yaḥ kārayedimam ||114 śilābhiriṣṭakābhirvā sa mahatpuṇyamāpnuyāt| meruḥ || lakṣaṇaṃ mandarasyātha prāsādasyābhidhīyate ||115
