rasanāpaṭṭāśchādastu paṭṭiko bhavet ||24 iti pratikramaṃ pīṭhaṃ kṣurabandho'dhunocyate| vibhajedbhāgaviṃśatyā pīṭhocchrāyaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ||25 nīravartiścaturbhāgā --- padmapatrikā| kaṇikā bhāgamekaṃ syāddvibhāgaṃ kumudaṃ tataḥ ||26 bhāgaṃ meḍathākṣepo makaro bhāgikastathā| bhāgamekaṃ vidhātavyā tato makarapaṭṭikā ||27 chedā makarapadaṃ kuryātkaṇṭhamekaṃ padaṃ tataḥ| paṭṭikāṃ bhāgikīṃ vidyādbhāgikī padmapatrikā ||28 kapotaṃ tripadaṃ kuryāttato nāsikayā saha| chedaśca bhāgikaḥ kāryaḥ kṣurabandho'yamīritaḥ ||29 pīṭhapañcakamityuktaṃ sūtritaṃ pūrvameva yat| pīṭhādūrdhvaṃ tu vijñeyā prājñaiḥ khuravaraṇḍikā ||30 santi cānyāni pīṭhāni lakṣmabhedādanekadhā| teṣāṃ madhye prakṛṣṭatvādetatpañcakamīritam ||31 prāsādānatha vakṣyāmastalacchandādanantaram| tatra padmo mahāpadmo vardhamānastathāparaḥ ||32 svastikaḥ sarvatobhadraḥ prāsādāḥ pañca kīrtitāḥ| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre karṇasūtraṃ prasārayet ||33 karṇasyārdhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā garbhādṛk bahirnayet| tadagrayoḥ sūtrapātāt syādanyacaturaśrakam ||34 kūṭaṃ kuryād dvibhāgena samastatrādvicakṣāṇaḥ| sūkarānanasaṃsthānaṃ kurvīta salilāntaram ||35 evaṃ sarveṣu kūṭeṣu salilāntaramiṣyate| yadāyataṃ bhavetsūtracaturbhāgavibhājite ||36 garbho dvibhāgikastena bhāgikā bhittirucyate| garbhakarṇārdhamādāya koṇāstaṃ lāñchayetpunaḥ ||37 aṣṭasṛ---madhye syādevaṃ --- bahiḥ| evaṃ padmatalacchando vidhāṭavyo vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||38 mahāpadmatalacchandamadhunā sampracakṣmahe| pūrvaṃ yaḥ kīrtitaśchandaḥ sampātā sūtrayekṛtāḥ ||39 teṣu saṃpādayed --- digvidigantare| karṇārdhaṃ dāpayettatra bāhyabhāgavinirmitārgatam ||40 ---ṇḍīgreyyordiśormadhye lāñchanaṃ yadvyavasthitam| nairṛtīyāmyayormadhye tasmāttatra prasārayet ||41 nairṛtīyāmyayormadhyādvāyvambupadigantarau| cāyvambupadiśormadhyādīśasomadigantare ||42 tṛtīyāṃ --- kūṭasya jalāntaram| kūṭayorubhayormadhye sūkarānanasannibham ||43 mahāpadmatalacchandaḥ prokto'yaṃ rājapūjitaḥ| idānīṃ vardhamānasya talacchando'bhidhīyate ||44 caturaśraṃ bhajetpañcadaśadhā kṣetramāditaḥ| kūṭaṃ dvibhāgikaṃ --- salilāntaram ||45 pañjaraṃ sādha --- bhāgikaṃ salilāntaram| caturbhāgā bhavecchālā dvividadhyā ca pañjare maḥ ||46 ardhabhāgaṃ praveśastu śālāsvatra jalādhvanaḥ| aṣṭāṅgulaviniṣkrānte bāhyataḥ śubhadarśane ||47 bhāgapādaṃ praveśaḥ syātpañjarāntajalādhvanaḥ| ardhabhāgaṃ praveśastu --- ||48 jalāntaraṃ tṛtīyaṃ ca kartavyaṃ bhāgasammitam| anantaraṃ prakurvīta pañjaraṃ sādhabhāgikam ||49 bhāgamekaṃ talacchando yathāvadabhidhīyate| caturaśraṃ samaṃ kṣetramaṣṭāviṃśatidhā bhajet ||50 kuryātkūṭaṃ caturbhāgaṃ --- salilāntaram| tribhāgaṃ pañjaraṃ tadvaddvibhāgaṃ salilāntaram ||51 śālāṃ ṣaḍbhāgikīṃ kuryājjalamārgaṃ dvibhāgikam| tribhāgaṃ pañjaraṃ bhūyaścandra śālāvibhūṣitam ||52 punardvibhāgikaṃ kuryāccaturthaṃ salilāntaram| vidadhīta caturbhāgaṃ rathakaṃ ca suśobhanam ||53 evaṃ dikṣu samastāsu samairbhāgaiḥ prakalpayet| caturbhāge tataḥ kṣetre garbhaṃ kuryāddvibhāgikam ||54 svastike vardhamāne ca bhāgikyo bhittayaḥ smṛtāḥ| svastiko'yaṃ talacchandaḥ kathito'timanoharaḥ ||55 idānīṃ sarvatobhadra talacchando'bhidhīyate| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre garbhaṃ kuryāddvibhāgikam ||56 kuryāttribhāgikaṃ kūṭaṃ jalamārgaṃ dvibhāgikam| tribhāgikaṃ tataḥ kūṭaṃ toyamārgaṃ dvibhāgikam ||57 śālāṣṭabhāgikī kuryājjalavartmadvibhāgikam| bhūyastribhāgikaṃ kūṭaṃ dvibhāgaṃ salilāntaram ||58 tribhāgikī ca rathikā bhaveddikṣu caturdaśa| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre aṣṭāviṃśatidhā bhajet ||59 kuryāttribhāgikaṃ kūṭaṃ caturdhā pravibhājite| bhāgikyo bhittayaḥ kāryāstathā garbho dvibhāgikaḥ ||60 ityeṣa sarvatobhadra stalacchando vidhīyate| ete proktā nirandhārāḥ sāndhārāṃstu pracakṣmahe ||61 caturaśrīkṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ bhajeddvādaśabhiḥ padaiḥ| caturbhāgo bhavedgarbho bhāgikyo bhittayaḥ smṛtāḥ ||62 bhāgikāndhārikā tadvaddvibhāgā bāhyabhittayaḥ| evamete talacchandāḥ padmādyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||63 pīṭhānyuktānyevametāni pañca| prāsādānāṃ nāmabhirlakṣaṇaiśca || pañcaproktā ye talacchandabhedā- stairvijñātaiḥ pūjyatāmeti loke ||64 iti mahārājādhirājaparameśvaraśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhāranāmni vāstuśāstre pīṭhapañcakādhyāyo nāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ| <62> atha drā viḍaprāsādalakṣaṇaṃ nāma dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ| ūrdhvamānamatha brūmo ghaṇṭāntapurapāditaḥ| pramāṇaṃ karṇamānena sarveṣāmeva dhārayet ||1 tatraikabhūmikaḥ kāryo hastapañcakavistṛtaḥ| aṅguladvitayopetaḥ saptahastasamucchritaḥ ||2 pādo dvihasta utsedhātsarvālaṅkārabhūṣitaḥ| sārdhahastasamutsedhastāvanmānaḥ starāvadhi ||3 mālā tu dvistarā proktā staro laśunakaṃ bhavet| bharaṇaṃ staramekaṃ syādbharaṇārdhaṃ staradvayam ||4 kalaśādyutaraṃ jñeyo vārarādyāsamanvitaḥ| dvistaraṃ kulakaṃ kuryātpadmapatrasamanvitam ||5 vīragandrā punaḥ kuryātstaramekaṃ tadūrdhvataḥ| dvistaraṃ hīrakaṃ proktaṃ paṭṭaścaiva tathāvidhaḥ ||6 paṭṭikā staramekaṃ syādvasantaṃ dvistaraṃ viduḥ| vasantapaṭṭikā cordhvaṃ staramekaṃ vidhīyate ||7 kapotaṃ nāsikāyuktaṃ vidadhīta staratrayam| --- dantaraṃ prakurvīta meṭamekastavaṃstata ||8 starapramāṇaṃ makaraṃ tadvanmakarapaṭṭikām| punaśchedaṃ staraṃ kuryādvedībandhastataḥ staram ||9 chedaḥ starapramāṇaśca kaṇṭhaḥ syātdvistaraṃ tataḥ| paṭṭikā staramekaṃ tu tadvaccāmbujapaṭṭikā ||10 mālādipadmapatrāntaṃ dvihastotsedhamīritam| sārdhahastaḥ samutsedhaḥ kūṭasya parikīrtitaḥ ||11 nāsikāpadmasaṃyuktaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ kalaśo bhavet| ekabhūmeridaṃ mānaṃ prāsādasya prakīrtitam ||12 ekabhūmikaḥ || dvibhūmikasya lakṣmātha prāsādasyābhidhīyate| saptahastasavistā --- samucchritaḥ ||13 karṇamānādbhavedasya vibhāgo'thanigadyate| dvihastaṃ kalpayedbījaṃ jaṅghā sārdhadvihastakam ||14 kūṭasya sanniveśo'yaṃ vijñātavyaḥ sabhāgikaḥ| jaṅghā dvitīyā tu punaḥ kartavyā tasya bhāgikā ||15 sanniveśo dvitīyasya syātkūṭasyārdhabhāgikaḥ| didikravyaspṛ kartavyā saha kaṇṭhena bhāgikaḥ ||16 tasyopariṣṭād ghaṇṭā ca sārdhabhāgasamucchritā| nāsikāpadmasaṃyuktā vidhātavyā vipaścitā ||17 pīṭhānāṃ pūrvamuktānāṃ pādabandhādināmabhiḥ| pañcānāṃ kalpayedevaṃ --- bhūmyāditaḥ kramāt ||18 teṣāṃ śobhāvahaṃ yatsyāttatkartavyaṃ vipaścitā| tasyopari bhavejjaṅghā mālāla---saṃyutā ||19 bharaṇaṃ kalaśastadvaddvāragaṇḍasamanvitam| ucchālaṃ pūrvamānena padmapatrāyutaṃ tataḥ ||20 vīragaṇḍaḥ punaḥ kāryo hīraṃ pūrvakrameṇa ca| tasyopariṣṭātpaṭṭaśca bhavetpaṭṭikayā saha ||21 vasantavedūrdhva tatastasyaivopari paṭṭikā| tataḥ kapotacchedaśca meḍhakara eva ca ||22 paṭṭikā makaroṣyā ca bhedakaṇṭho'tha paṭṭikā| vedīcchedaśca kaṇṭhaśca paṭṭikā padmapaṭṭikā ||23 kūṭaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ kurvīta vicitraṃ nāsikānvitam| chedāntaṃ pūrvamānena sarvametadvidhīyate ||24 tasyopari punarjaṅghā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā| tato mālātha laśunaṃ toraṇaṃ kalaśastataḥ ||25 vīragaṇḍastathocchālaṃ patrakaṃ vīragaṇḍakaḥ| hīrakaṃ paṭṭikā tadvadvasantapaṭṭikā punaḥ ||26 kapotacchedameḍhāśca makaro'sya ca paṭṭikā| chedaḥ karapaṭṭikā ca vedīcchedo'tha kaṇṭhakaḥ ||27 paṭṭikā padmapūrvā ca kartavyā paṭṭikā ---| tataśchedo vidhātavyaḥ sarvairābharaṇairyutaḥ ||28 tataśchittvā tathā kāryaṃ yathā śobhā prajāyate| punaḥ kaṇṭhyaṃ pradātavyaḥ paṭṭikā padmapaṭṭikā ||29 tataḥ kaṇṭhaṃ vidhātavyaṃ candra mālāvibhūṣitam| prakurvīta tataśchedamupariṣṭādvicakṣaṇaḥ ||30 kaṇṭhapaṭṭikayā yuktaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ kaṇṭhapaṭṭikām| saptāṅgulāni kartavyastato ghaṇṭāvinirgamaḥ ||31 bhāgārdhaṃ vistṛtistasyā vistārārdhaṃ samucchritiḥ| evaṃ dvibhūmikaṃ prājñaḥ prāsādaṃ parikalpayet ||32 dvibhūmikaḥ || tribhūmikastṛtīyo'tha prāsādo'smābhirucyate| tasyaikādaśa vistāro hastāḥ pañcadaśocchrayaḥ ||33 caturdaśāṅgulānyeṣāṃ bhavedasyādhikāni ca| ---bhūmikasyaitatkarṇamānamasaṃśayam ||34 pīṭhaṃ dvihastaṃ kurvīta tatrādau pūrvasūcitam| jaṅghāṃ tribhāgikotsedhāṃ kūṭocchrāyaṃ tu bhāgikam ||35 bhavejjaṅghā tṛtīyā ca sārdhabhāgadvayaṃ tataḥ| bhāgaṃ ca kūṭaprasaraśca ndra śālāvibhūṣitaḥ ||36 punastṛtīyā jaṅghā syādbhāgadvayasamucchritā| tataścākūṭaprastāro bhāgiko bhūṣaṇānvitaḥ ||37 bhāgaṃ syādvedibandhaḥ --- saguṇadvārakaṇṭhakaḥ| caturdaśamasau kāryo bhūṣāyukto yathocitam ||38 ghaṇṭācchedastu bhāgau dvau dvyaṅguladvayasaṃyutau| ekādaśastarā kurustasyopari vidhīyate ||39 idānīṃ pravibhāgo'sya pīṭhādūrdhvaṃ vidhīyate| hastamekaṃ bhavejjaṅghādyaṃyapi ca tayā samā ||40 mālā tu dvistarā proktā laśunaṃ bhāgikaṃ tataḥ| bharaṇaṃ staramekaṃ syātkalaśo'pi ca tatsamaḥ ||41 vīragaṇḍasamāyuktamucchālaṃ dvistaraṃ tataḥ| tatastaraṃ vīragaṇḍo --- ||42 hīrakaṃ dvistaraṃ vidyātsastaraṃ vāsantapaṭṭikā| kapotaṃ nāsikāyuktaṃ tristaraṃ kārayettataḥ ||43 chedaṃ prastapramāṇaṃ ca meḍhaṃ ca tatsammitam| staraṃ kurvīta makaraṃ tadardhenāsya paṭṭikā ||44 chedaṃ tathaiva kurvīta kaṇṭhamekastaraṃ tataḥ| paṭtikā vedikā caiva staramekaṃ vidhīyate ||45 chedamardhastaraṃ vidyātkaṇṭhaṃ sārdhastaraṃ tataḥ| paṭṭikā syātstaraṃ padmaṃ staramekaṃ tato bhavet ||46 śeṣe ca sundaraṃ kaṇṭhaṃ vidhātavyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ| anantaraṃ dvitīyā ca jaṅghā kāryā navastarā ||47 madhye ca sā prakartavyā tadūrdhvaṃ tāṃ vibhājayet| tatastaraṃ bhavecchālā starārdhaṃ laśunaṃ tataḥ ||48 tathaiva bharaṇaṃ jñeyaṃ pūrvanirdiṣṭalakṣaṇam| vīragaṇḍena sahitaḥ kalaśo'pi tathā bhavet ||49 padmapatrakayā yuktaṃ staramucchālakaṃ viduḥ| vīragaṇḍaṃ staraṃ vidyādardhabhāgaṃ ca hīrakam ||50 paṭṭaṃ tathaiva kurvīta starasyārdhena paṭṭikā| vasantaḥ staramekaṃ syād staraṃ vāsantapaṭṭikā ||51 kapotaṃ tristaraṃ kuryānnāsikāsahitaṃ budhaḥ| chedamardhastaraṃ vidyānmeḍhaṃ tattulyameva ca ||52 makaraṃ staramekaṃ ca bhāgārdhaṃ paṭṭikā tataḥ| bhāgamekaṃ bhavecchedaḥ staraṃ kaṇṭhastadūrdhvataḥ ||53 paṭṭikā vedikā caiva staramekaṃ vidhīyate| chedaṃ bhāgārdhikaṃ kuryātkaṇṭhakaṃ sārdhabhāgikam ||54 bhāgena paṭṭikāṃ kuryāttathā kamalapatrikām| kūṭaṃ tataḥ paraṃ kuryānnāsikā ca vibhūṣitam ||55 tṛtīyajaṅghāmadvā syāccaturbhiḥ kalpitā staraiḥ| staramekaṃ bhavenmālā staraṃ ca laśunaṃ viduḥ ||56 bharaṇaṃ staramekaṃ ca kumbhamekastaraṃ tathā| vīragaṇḍasamopetamucchālaṃ syāttadūrdhvataḥ ||57 staramekaṃ prakurvīta vīragaṇḍasamucchritam| tataśca hīrakaṃ kuryādbhāgenaikena buddhimān ||58 sārdhabhāgena paṭṭiḥ syātpaṭṭikārdhaṃ staraṃ tathā| staramekaṃ vasantaṃ syātstaraṃ vāsantapaṭṭikā ||59 kapoto dvistaraśchedo'rdhastaro meṇḍhakaḥ staraḥ| bhāgiko makaraḥ kāryaḥ paṭṭikā cārdhabhāgikā ||60 bhedo'rdhabhāgiko bhāgamekaṃ kaṇṭhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ| paṭṭikovedikāstrayo'pyardhastaraṃ pṛthak ||61 kaṇṭhaścārdhastaraḥ kāryaḥ pīṭhikā cārdhabhāgikā| ardhabhāgena kartavyā tadūrdhvaṃ padmapatrikā ||62 vicitralakṣaṇopetaṃ tataḥ kūṭaṃ vidhīyate| staramekaṃ bhavecchedaḥ syātkaṇṭho'pyevameva hi ||63 paṭṭikā staramekaṃ syāttato vedī staradvayam| chedaḥ staraṃ bhavedbhūyaḥ kaṇṭhaḥ syāddvistaraṃ tataḥ ||64 kartavye staramekaikaṃ paṭṭikā padmapatrikā| ghaṇṭā tataḥparaṃ kāryā mānato viṃśatistarā ||65 ekādaśastaraḥ kumbhaḥ sarveṣāṃ sarvato bhavet| tribhūmiko'yamākhyātaścaturbhūmirathocyate ||66 tribhūmikaḥ || hastānpañcadaśa kṣetraṃ vistārāttu prakalpayet| ucchrāyeṇa tu hastānāṃ syātpādaikaviṃśatiḥ ||67 dvihastaṃ kārayetpīṭhaṃ jaṅghāṃ hastatrayocchritām| sārdhahastaṃ bhavetkūṭaṃ sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitam ||68 dvitīyajaṅghā kartavyā pādahīnaṃ karatrayam| sapādahastaṃ kurvīta kūṭamanyattadūrdhvataḥ ||69 tṛtīyajaṅghā kartavyā sārdhaṃ hastadvayaṃ tataḥ| tataśca kūṭaprastāro hastamekaṃ vidhīyate ||70 jaṅghā caturthī kartavyā sārdhahastadvayaṃ tataḥ| tataśca kūṭaprastāro hastamekaṃ vidhīyate ||71 jaṅghā caturthī kartavyā sapādadvikarocchritā| hastaṃ ca kūṭaprastāro vedībandhastathāvidhaḥ ||72 garbhārdhavistṛtā ghaṇṭā kāryā hastatrayocchritā| caturdaśastaraḥ kumbhaḥ sarveṣāmupari sthitaḥ ||73 sūcikāhastasaṅkhyaiṣā vibhāgaḥ kathyate'dhunā| pīṭhaṃ hastadvayotsedhaṃ jaṅghālaṅkṛtirucyate ||74 daśabhāgo bhavedekamucchālaṃ dvistaraṃ tataḥ| vīragaṇḍaṃ staraṃ vidyāddvistaraṃ hīrakaṃ bhavet ||75 paṭṭastathaiva vijñeyotsedhakī paṭṭikā tataḥ| vasantaṃ dvistaraṃ --- vāsantapaṭṭivā ||76 kapotastristaraḥ kāryo bhāgaṃ chedo vidhīyate| meḍhaṃ staraṃ prakurvīta staraṃ kaṇṭhasya paṭṭikā ||77 kurvīta bhāgikīṃ devā tatacchede ca bhāgikam| punaḥ kaṇṭhaṃ prakurvīta dvistaraṃ paṭṭikāṃ tataḥ ||78 syātpadmapatrikāpyevaṃ ghaṇṭā pañcastarā tataḥ| vocotraṃ lakṣaṇopetaṃ tataḥ kumbhaṃ niveśayet ||79 jaṅghāstambhaṃ dvitīyā vidadhyādaṣṭabhāgikam| mālāṃ --- dvistaraṃ kuryādbhāgikaṃ laśunaṃ tataḥ ||80 bharaṇaṃ staramekaṃ ca kalaśaṃ tatpramāṇataḥ| vīragaṇḍena saṃyuktaṃ tāvāṃścocchālakaṃ bhavet ||81 dvistaraṃ tattu vijñeyaṃ vīragaṇḍaḥ staraṃ bhavet| hīrakaṃ dvistaraṃ vidyātpadmaṃ caiva tathāvidham ||82 paṭṭikā staramekaṃ syādvasantaṃ dvistaraṃ tataḥ| vasantapaṭṭikāṃ bhāgaṃ kapotaṃ tristarocchritam ||83 kurvīta bhāgikaṃ bhedaṃ staramekaṃ ca meḍhakam| makaraṃ staramekaṃ ca tathā makarapaṭṭikām ||84 bhedaḥ staraṃ bhavetkaṇṭhaḥ staraṃ bhāgaṃ ca paṭṭikā| vedikā staramekaṃ ca cchedamardhena kārayet ||85 kaṇṭhaṃ sārdhastaraṃ kuryātstaramekaṃ ca paṭṭikām| ābhājapatrikāṃ bhāgaṃ kuryādghaṇṭāṃ catuḥstarām ||86 prāggrīvabhūṣitā sā syātkumbhaṃ kuryāttadūrdhvataḥ| jaṅghāstambhastṛtīyāyāṃ saptāṃśaścatura --- kaḥ ||87 tato mālātha laśunaṃ bharaṇaṃ kumbhakāṇḍakau| ucchālaṃ gaṇḍako hīraṃ pratyekaṃ syuḥ staraṃ staram ||88 padmaṃ sārdhastaraṃ vidyādbhāge'rdhe paṭṭikāṃ tathā| bhāgamekaṃ vasantaḥ syādbhāgaṃ vāsantapaṭṭikā ||89 kapotaṃ tristaraṃ kuryācchedamekastaraṃ tataḥ| tataśca meḍhakaṃ maraṃ vidadhīta staraṃ staram ||90 tatpaṭṭikā tu bhāgārdhaṃ bhedaṃ bhāgārdhameva ca| kaṇṭho vedi paṭṭikā ca trīṇyetāni staraṃ staram ||91 starasyārdhaṃ bhavecchedaḥ kaṇṭhaḥ sārdhastaraṃ tataḥ| bhāgārdhaṃ paṭṭikā kāryā tāvatī padmapatrikā ||92 ||96 kapotaṃ dvistaraṃ vidyācchedaṃ cārdhastaraṃ tataḥ| meḍhaṃ tathaiva kurvīta makaraṃ ca staraṃ budhaḥ ||97 paṭṭikāṃ makarākhyāṃ ca cchedamekastaraṃ viduḥ| staramekaṃ bhavetkaṇṭhaḥ starasyārdhaṃ ca ||100 kumbhaṃ vidadhyādupari dvistaraṃ paṅkajānanam| bhāgamekaṃ bhavecchedastataḥ kaṇṭhaḥ staradvayam ||101 paṭṭikā staramekaṃ tu vedikā tu starāvubhau| punaśchedo bhavedbhāgaṃ --- kaṇṭho vidhīyate tathaiva sarvatobhadre kuryādghaṇṭāmimāṃ vudhaḥ| kumbhaṃ tu pañcadaśabhiḥ staraiḥ kuryātsamunnatam ||105 syāccaturbhūmiko hyevaṃ talacchandastu kāmataḥ| caturbhūmikaḥ || pañcabhaumamatha brūmaḥ aṅguladvayaniṣkrāntā vidheyā kaṇṭhapaṭṭikā| padmākhyānirgamaṃ kuryādaṅgulatritayaṃ tataḥ ||131 aṅgulāni tataḥ pañca yoni --- nirgamo bhavet| ghaṇṭā tviha vidhātavyā sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitā ||132 bhedastataḥ syādbhavati bhūmikā tasya copari| dvitīyābhūmikājaṅghā sadyaḥ syādaṣṭābhiḥ staraiḥ ||133 mālādyairlaśunaṃ caikaṃ bharaṇaṃ kalaśastathā| yathā mālā tathocchālaṃ vīragaṇḍaṃ staraṃ bhavet tataśchedaṃ ca kaṇṭhaṃ ca --- paṭṭikāṃ tathā| mālārdhena prakurvīta cchedameva tato budhaḥ ||137 punaḥ kaṇṭhaṃ prakurvīta hīrakeṇa samanvitam| paṭṭikā padmapūrvā ca tribhāgena kapotake ||138 kuryānnāsāyuktaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ||148 chedamaṃśena kurvīta maṇḍamaṃśena kārayet| makare paṭṭikāṃ chedaṃ vidadhīta staraṃ staram ||149 kurvīta bhāgikaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ paṭṭikāṃ vedikāmapi| bhāgaṃ kuryātpunaśchedaṃ tataḥ kaṇṭhaṃ dvibhāgikam ||150 paṭṭikā padmapūrvā ca vidhātavyā staraṃ staram| kurvīta ghaṇṭāmupari caturbhāgāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ||151 tadardhamūrdhvataḥ kumbhaṃ chedamardhena tasya ca| jaṅghā ṣaḍbhāgikā kāryā māttā gena suna kārayena ||152 laśunaṃ bharaṇaṃ kumbhaṃ gaṇḍamucchālavāḍake| hīrakaṃ ceti kurvīta bhāgikāni pṛthakpṛthak ||153 sārdhabhāgaṃ bhavetpaṭṭaḥ paṭṭikārdhastarocchritā| vasantaṃ bhāgamekaṃ syādvasantākhyā ca paṭṭikā ||154 kapotaṃ tristaraṃ kuryācchedaṃ tryaṃśonaśaṃsakām| maṇḍako makaraścaiva paṭṭikā chedakaṇṭhakau ||155 kaṇṭhaṃ paṭṭī ca vedī ca cchedaśca syātstaraṃ staram| dvitīyo dvistaraḥ kaṇṭho bhāgikī paṭṭikā bhavet ||156 tathaiva padmaṃjñā ca syāducchrāyeṇa paṭṭikā| ghaṇṭāṃ kuryāccaturbhāgāṃ kumbhamardhena tasya ca ||157 chedamekena bhāgena jaṅghāma --- rdhabhāgikīm| mālāmekena bhāgena laśunaṃ sārdhabhāgikam ||158 tathaiva bharaṇaṃ kuryātkumbhocchāle staraṃ staram| hīrakaṃ bhāgikaṃ kuryātpaṭṭaṃ sārdhastaraṃ tataḥ ||159 paṭṭikārdhastaraṃ kāryā ||1 vimānacchandasaṃjñaśca caturaśrastathāparaḥ| aṣṭāśriḥ ṣoḍaśāśriśca vartulaḥ sarvatodakaḥ ||2 siṃhāsyo nandano nandivardhano haṃsako vṛṣaḥ| garuḍaḥ padmakākhyaśca samudra iti viṃśatiḥ ||3 nāgarāṇāmiti proktā prāsādānāṃ samāsataḥ| śatamudra ścaturdvāraḥ ṣoḍaśakṣitirūrdhvataḥ ||4 vicitraśikharākīrṇo meruḥ prāsāda ucyate| mandaro dvādaśatalaḥ kailāso navabhūmikaḥ ||5 anekaśikharaścitraścaturdvāro mahocchritiḥ| vimānacchandakastvaṣṭabhūmikaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||6 viṃśatyaṇḍakasaṃyuktaḥ saptabhūrnandivardhanaḥ| ṣaḍbhūmirnandanaḥ kāryaḥ prāsādaḥ ṣoḍaśāṇḍakaḥ ||7 pañcabhūḥ sarvatobhadro bhadra śālāvibhūṣitaḥ| anekaśikharākīrṇaḥ kartavyaḥ pracurāṇḍakaḥ ||8 valabhicchandakaḥ kāryo devatānāṃ vṛṣaḥ sadā| vṛṣastu svocchritestulyaḥ sarvataḥ svasti vartitaḥ ||9 maṇḍalaṃ sa tu vijñeya ekāṇḍakavibhūṣitaḥ| siṃhaḥ siṃhākṛtirjñeyo gajo gajasamākṛtiḥ ||10 kumbhaḥ kumbhākṛtistadvadbhūmikānavakocchritaḥ| añjalīpuṭasaṃsthānaḥ pañcāṇḍakavibhūṣitaḥ ||11 ṣoḍaśāśriḥ samantācca vijñeyaḥ sa samudra kaḥ| pārśvayoścandra śālā ca ucchrāyātsa dvibhūmikaḥ ||12 tathāṣṭāśriḥ padmanibho bhūmikātrayamucchritaḥ| ṣoḍaśāśriḥ sa vijñeyo vicitraśikharaḥ śubhaḥ ||13 mṛgarājastu vikhyātaścandra śālāvibhūṣitaḥ| prāggrīveṇa viśālena bhūmikāsa yaducchritaḥ ||14 anekacandra śālastu gajaḥ prāsāda ucyate| paryasto mṛgarājastu garuḍo nāma nāmataḥ ||15 saptabhūmyucchritastadvaccandra śālātrayānvitaḥ| aśribhirviharaṃ tasya ṣaḍbhiryuktaḥ samantataḥ ||16 syādanyo garuḍastadvaducchrāye daśabhūmikaḥ| padmakaḥ ṣoḍaśāśriḥ syādbhūmikādvitayādhikaḥ ||17 padmatulyaprāṇana vāvṛkṣaścaturaśrakaḥ| pañcāṇḍame ekabhūmistu garbhaṃ hastacatuṣṭayam ||18 vṛṣo bhavati nātrāyaṃ prāsādaḥ sarvakāmikaḥ| saptakāpañcakābhūmiprāsādo ya ihoditāḥ ||19 hiṃsyate samā jñeyā ye cānye tatpramāṇakāḥ| vicitraśikharāḥ kāryāścandra śālāvibhūṣitāḥ ||20 sarve prāggrīvasaṃyuktāḥ kartavyāstoraṇānvitāḥ| aiṣṭikā dāravā yadvā śailajā vājanākulāḥ ||21 syātpañcāśatkarānmerusūtraliṅgaṃ navodayān| garbhāstu dviguṇā liṅgādbhittayaḥ syuścatuṣkarāḥ ||22 andhārikā hastaṣaṭkaṃ vidhātavyā samantataḥ| andhārikāṃ ca kurvīta bāhābhittiṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ||23 ayaṃ sādhārakaḥ prokto meruḥ sarvaguṇānvitaḥ| prāsādānāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ garbho liṅgadiśaṃguṇaḥ ||24 prāsādagarbhamutsṛṣṭaṃ yaccheṣaṃ tena kalpayet| sahāndhārikayā sarvāṃ samabhāgena pūrvavat ||25 mervādyā ye vimānāntāḥ saṃ--- pūrvaṃ prakīrtitāḥ| śastāste mṛjya liṅgānāmanyeṣāṃ tu bhayāvaham ||26 vāvṛkṣamukhyā ye tūktā nandivardhanapaścimāḥ| te'ṣṭau śubhā madhyamānāmanyeṣāṃ duḥkhadāḥ smṛtāḥ ||27 haṃsādayaḥ samudrā ntāḥ pañca ye samudāhṛtāḥ| praśastāste samuddiṣṭā liṅgānāṃ vidhīyasā ||28 mandarastu karātkāyaścatvāriṃśattu ---| --- lāso vimānoṣaroṣṭitāḥ ||29 hastadvātriṃśatā kāryaḥ prāsādo nandivardhanaḥ| hastāṃstu nandanastriṃśatsarvatobhadra eva ca ||30 aṣṭāviṃśatimaṣṭābhiḥ śriḥ ṣoḍaśā śri stribhirvinā| vartulaḥ padmakaḥ śveto vimānacchanda eva ca ||31 ete dvādaśahastāḥ --- kāryā viṃśatihastakau| gajaḥ siṃhaśca kumbhaśca valabhīchandakastathā ||32 catvāra ete tulyāḥ syurhastonmeḍasamānataḥ| vāvṛkṣo mṛgarājaśca vimānacchanda eva ca ||33 ete dvādaśahastāḥ syuḥ pramāṇena pṛthakpṛthak| daśahasto bhavedvā sa garuḍo'ṣṭakaraḥ smṛtaḥ ||34 etaiḥ pramāṇaiḥ prāsādān kuryādityapare sthitāḥ| ekahastā dvihastāśca trihastā ye ca kīrtitāḥ ||35 yakṣanāgagrahādīnāṃ vidheyā rakṣasāṃ ca te| vidhireṣa samuddiṣṭaḥ prāsādānāṃ samāsataḥ ||36 viśeṣeṇa punarbrūmo vimānaṃ śuddhapuṣpakam| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre pañcātriṃśadvibhājite ||37 rathikā pañcabhāgā syāddvibhāgaṃ salilāntaram| kūṭa tribhāgaṃ pañjaraṃ kuryātprāggrīvakavibhūṣitam ||38 jalāntaraṃ dvitīyaṃ tu tadapi syāddvibhāgikam| śālaikādaśabhāgā tu pūrvavatsalilāntaram ||39 tribhāgaṃ pañjaraṃ kuryād dvibhāgaṃ salilāntaram| kūṭaṃ pañcakaraṃ prānte dikṣu sarvāsvayaṃ vidhiḥ ||40 nāgaro'yaṃ talacchandaḥ prāsāde śuddhapuṣpake| jaṅghā sapīṭhā kṣetrārdhavistārasadṛśodayā ||41 sārdhairdvitīyā daśabhistṛtīyā navabhiḥ karaiḥ| aṣṭahastā caturthī syātsaptahastā tu pañcamī ||42 ṣaṣṭhī tu bhūmikā kāryā pramāṇenāsya ṣaṭkarā| saptamī pañcahastā tu caturhastā tato'ṣṭamī ||43 trihastaṃ vedikābandhaṃ vicitraṃ kārayedbudhaḥ| vistārād dviguṇocchrāyaḥ skandho'yaṃ vedikābandha ||44 skandhādūrdhvaṃ bhavedghaṇṭā yadi vāmalasārakam| tad vartulaṃ śubhaṃ kāryaṃ ghaṇṭā skandhārdhamucchritā ||45 ghaṇṭāvistārataḥ kumbhaṃ caturthāṃśena kārayet| pramāṇaṃ samudāyena bhūmikānāmudāhṛtā ||46 ekaikasyā viśeṣeṇa pravivicyādhunocyate| pramāṇena vidhātavyā khakārā bhūmiraṅgikā ||47 yaṃ hastaṃ tu khurakaṃ dvibhāgā padmapatrikā| bhāgikā kaṇakayāyastryaṃśaṃ kumudaṃ cheda eva ca ||48 tryaṃśastaddviguṇaḥ kaṇṭhaḥ kiṅkiṇīpallavānvitaḥ| tasyārdhaṃ paṭṭikā kāryā tatsamā giripatrikā ||49 bhātryaṃśāvaraṇḍītamadhye pacchītalārdhabhāgikī| pūrvaproktena kaṇṭhena samasūtrā ca sā bhavet ||50 chedaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ kurvīta staramekaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ| punaḥ kaṇṭhaḥh pradātavyo bhāgadvitayasammitaḥ ||51 paṭtikā staramekaṃ tu tatsamā giripatrikā| caturguṇātha triguṇā kāryāvilakanāsikā ||52 stambhadvitayamadhye tu pañcayaṃ karma kārayet| śobhanaṃ tattu kartavyaṃ yuktaṃ tilakanāmayā ||53 punaśchedaḥ pradātavyaḥ pūrvamānena dhīmatā| jaṅghā saptastarā meṭhā varaṇḍī tristarordhvataḥ ||54 bhavedadhastājjaṅghāyāstristaralakumbhakaḥ| ghaṇṭāpamaṇṭapasaṃyuktā mālā syāt ṣadyarāttataḥ ||55 ardhena tasyā laśunaṃ stareṇa bharaṇaṃ bhavet| kurvīta dvistaraṃ kumbhaṃ gaṇḍamekastaraṃ tataḥ ||56 ucchālaṃ dvistaraṃ kuryādvīragaṇḍaṃ tataḥ staram| dvistaraḥ syāttataḥ paṭṭasyārdhena paṭṭikā ||57 tatsamā giripatrī ca varaṇḍī tristarā tataḥ| stambhasyordhvaṃ vidhātavyā manojñā tryardhapādikā ||58 staramekaṃ tataśchedastataḥ kaṇṭhaḥ staratrayam| paṭṭikā staramekaṃ syāttatsamā giripatrikā ||59 varaṇḍīṃ tristarāṃ kuryādardhaprastarasaṃyutam| punaśchedaḥ staraṃ kāryaḥ kaṇṭhastena samastataḥ ||60 tatsamā giripatrī ca tryaṃśamāmalasārakam| tataśchedaṃ ca kaṇṭhaṃ ca giripatrīṃ varaṇḍikām ||61 pūrvamānena kurvīta cchedakampe tathā punaḥ| giripatrīṃ staraṃ kuryāt tryaṃśaktakharaṃkatataḥ ||62 chedaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ patrikāṃ ca prāstaramekaṃ tataśchedakaṃ kuryātpunarbudhaḥ| varaṇḍīṃ tristarāṃ kuryādardhaprastarasaṃyutam ||63 chedaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ ca pīṭhaṃ ca prāgvavāmalasārakaṇṭhaṃ kuryāttathāparam| pūrvavadgiripatrīṃ ca dvistarāṃ vedikāṃ tataḥ ||64 chedaṃ kuryāttadardhaṃ ca tataḥ kaṇṭhaṃ staradvayam| giripatrīṃ tataḥ kuryātstaramekaṃ suśobhanām ||65 caturaśrapramāṇaṃ ca kuryādāmalasārakam| padmapatraṃ tu tasyārdhamupariṣṭātprakalpayet ||66 catuḥstaro bhavetkumbhaḥ staraṃ kaṇṭhastato bhavet| staramekaṃ tataḥ karṇo dvistaraṃ bījapūrakam ||67 caturbhiḥ kūṭavistāraṃ tato bhāge virājayet| dvibhāgaṃ mañjarī kāryā starasenairalaṅkṛtā ||68 varaṇḍikākhyo bandhaśca bhāgaṃ bhāgaṃ bhavettataḥ| vistāraṃ mūlamañjaryāḥ śukanāsāṃ prakalpayet ||69 atha nirṇīyate dvyardhapādākhyaṃ tatra vistṛtiḥ| ucchrāyāddviguṇā kāryā pañcabhāgakramo'thavā ||70 śūraseno'thavā kāryaḥ śukanāsāstrivetyasau | kṛtvā tribhāgamucchrāyaṃ makaraṃ cordhvabhāgikam ||71 stambhayuktaṃ guṇadvāraṃ syotasyodhiḥ saṃpratām| ardhaprastarasaṃyuktaṃ kuryātpārśvayordvayoḥ ||72 kartavyaṃ garbhakūṭaṃ vā śubhaṃ tatra vipaścitā| dvitīyabhūmikāyāṃ tu pīṭhaṃ sāstadaśastaram ||73 melāntatovatī jaṅghā mālā kāryā catuḥstarā| laśunaṃ dvistaraṃ proktaṃ staraṃ bharaṇamiṣyate ||74 kumbhaṃ tadvatprakartavyamucchālaṃ dviguṇānvitaḥ| gaṇḍakaḥ staramekaṃ syāttataḥ paṭṭaḥ staradvayam ||75 ardhena paṭṭikā kāryā tathaiva giripatrikā| sūratrayaṃ varaṇḍī syācchūrasenairalaṅkṛtā ||76 staramekaṃ bhavecchedastataḥ kaṇṭhaḥ staradvayam| paṭṭikā bhāgamekaṃ ca tatsamaṃ giripatrikā ||77 tribhāgaṃ śikharaṃ kuryācchedaṃ me tu bhāgikam| ekaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ prakurvīta pathikāṃ vistaraṃ viduḥ ||78 staramekaṃ bhavet kaṇṭhaḥ paṭṭikāpi ca tatsamā| giripatrīṃ ca kurvīta bhāgārdhena vicakṣaṇaḥ ||79 dvārdhapādikayā yuktā tristarā syādvaraṇḍikā| chedaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ ca kurvīta pūrvamānena buddhimān ||80 paṭṭikā giripatrī ca bhāgaṃ bhāgaṃ vidhīyate| dvistaraṃ śikharaṃ kuryāttathā chedaṃ tu bhāgikām ||81 evaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ prakurvīta --- paṭṭikām| varaṇḍikā dvibhāsyodṛkāreṇa samanvitā ||82 chedaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ ca patrī ca girivartī tribhāgikā| prāgvadvirihira kuryād yathāśobhaṃ pra --- ||83 caturthī bhūmikā cordhvaṃ kartavyā lakṣaṇānvitā| trayodaśastaraṃ pīṭhaṃ madhyajaṅghā ca tatsamā ||84 catuḥstarā bhavenmālā tadardhaṃ laśunaṃ tataḥ| kumbhaṃ tena samaṃ kāryamucchālaṃ dvistaraṃ bhavet ||85 tasyārdhe gaṇḍakaṃ kuryāt paṭṭaṃ taddviguṇaṃ tataḥ| paṭṭikā giripatrī ca vidhātavye staraṃ staram ||86 varaṇḍī tristarā kāryā chedamekastaraṃ viduḥ| kurvīta dvistaraṃ kaṇṭhaṃ tadardhena tu paṭṭikām ||87 tatsamāṃ giripatrīṃ dvau starau khirihiraṃ tataḥ| chedaḥ kaṇṭhaḥ paṭṭikā ca giripatrīti bhāgikāḥ ||88 varaṇḍī dvistarā kāryā tataśchedaḥ staraṃ bhavet| kaṇṭhaśca patrikā ceti giripatrīti bhāgikāḥ ||89 prāgvakāśikhirihiraṃ kuryācchedaṃ pūrvakrameṇa ca| dvistarā tilanāsā tu vidhātavyā vipaścitā ||90 kurvīta bhāgikaṃ chedaṃ tataḥ kaṇṭhā dvibhāgikī| paṭṭikāṃ bhāgamekaṃ ca tatsamāṃ gii!trikām ||91 ghaṇṭā saptastarā proktā padmaṃ dvistaramucyate| dviguṇaḥ kalaśastasyāṃ chedaṃ pūrvavadācaret ||92 ūrdhvaṃ syātpañcamī bhūmiḥ pīṭhamekādaśastaram| tadvanmaṭṭā bhavejjaṅghā mālā ca tristarā tataḥ ||93 sādhastaraṃ syāllaśunaṃ stareṇa bharaṇaṃ bhavet| kumbhaṃ gaṇḍakasaṃyuktaṃ kuryāt sārdhastaraṃ budhaḥ ||94 ucchālaṃ dvistaraṃ proktaṃ staraṃ gaṇḍo vidhīyate| dvistaraḥ syāttaraḥ paṭṭaḥ paṭṭasyārdhena paṭṭikā ||95 tatsamā giripatrī ca tristarā tu varaṇḍikā| staramekaṃ bhavecchedaḥ kaṇṭhastaddviguṇastataḥ ||96 tadardhaṃ paṭṭikā kāryā tathaiva giripatrikā| starakaṃ dvayaṃ virihiraṃ tadardhaṃ chedamācaret ||97 evaṃ kaṇṭhaḥ paṭṭikā ca syāttathā giripatrikā| dvau starau tilanāsā syācchedaḥ sārdhakarāyataḥ ||98 kaṇṭhaṃ taddviguṇaṃ kuryādbhāgenaikena paṭṭikām| tatsamā giripatrī syādghaṇṭā pañcastarā bhavet ||99 kurvīta dvistaraṃ padmaṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvakramāttataḥ| tato bhūmirbhavetṣaṣṭhī pīṭhaṃ tatrābhidhīyate ||100 dvistarā bhūmiraṅgā syātulaḥ khurakastataḥ| chedo bhavettadardhena tataḥ kaṇṭhaḥ staradvayam ||101 paṭṭikā bhāgamekaṃ syādbhāgaṃ ca giripatrikā| varaṇḍīṃ dvistarāṃ kuryāttadardhaṃ chedamādiśet ||102 dvādaśāṃśamidaṃ pīṭhaṃ jaṅghā māṭṭā tadardhataḥ| mālā tu dvistarā proktā laśunaṃ tatsamaṃ bhavet ||103 bharaṇaṃ staramekaṃ tu dvibhāgaḥ kalaśo bhavet| ucchālakaṃ ca tattulyaṃ gaṇḍo bhāgaṃ vidhīyate ||104 kurvīta dvistaraṃ paṭṭaṃ bhāgenaikena paṭṭikām| pūrvavadgiripatrīṃ --- starāṃ tu varaṇḍikām ||105 staramekaṃ bhavecchedaḥ kaṇṭhastaddviguṇastataḥ| pūrvavatpatrike dve tu dvyaṃśaṃ khirihiraṃ bhavet ||106 chedaḥ kaṇṭhaḥ paṭṭikā ca giripatrīti bhāgikāḥ| dvistarā tilanāsā syācchedaḥ kāryastu bhāgikaḥ ||107 dvistaraḥ syāttataḥ kaṇṭho bhāgikā kaṇṭhapaṭṭikā| bhāgikī giripatrī ca vidhātavyā tataḥ param ||108 pañcastarān tribhāgonān kuryādāmalasārakam| tristaraṃ syāttataḥ --- śeṣaṃ pūrvakramādbhavet ||109 pañcamyāṃ bhūmikāyāṃ tu pīṭhaṃ syāddvādaśastaram| jaṅghā pañcastarā meṭhā mālā ca syāddvibhāgikī ||110 ardhastareṇa laśunaṃ stareṇa bharaṇaṃ bhavet| kumbhaṃ gaṇḍena sahitaṃ staraṃ kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ ||111 ucchālaṃ dvistaraṃ kuryādgaṇḍo bhāgaṃ vidhīyate| paṭṭaḥ sārdhastaraḥ kāryaḥ paṭṭikā tu staraṃ bhavet ||112 tatsamā giripatrī ca tristarā tu varaṇḍikā| chedo bhāgatribhogaṃ kaṇṭhasyārdhe guṇastataḥ ||113 patrike dve tu bhāgikyau --- starā tilanāsikā| ardhaprastārayuktāsau kāryātha prastarānvitā ||114 chedaṃ bhāgena kurvīta kaṇṭhaṃ taddviguṇaṃ tataḥ| ardhaprastaraṃ pūrvavatpatrike dve tu ghaṇṭā staracatuṣṭāyam ||115 kurvīta dvistaraṃ padmaṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvakrameṇa tu| aṣṭamī bhūmikā yā tu sā kāryā śubhalakṣaṇā ||116 mervādayo viṃśatirevamuktāḥ| prāsādamukhyāḥ --- bhūmyaṣṭakāntāstadimān vidadhyāt| syācchilpināṃ saṃsadi pūjanīyaḥ ||117 iti mahārājādhirājaparameśvaraśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhāranāmni vāstuśāstre mervādiviṃśikānāgaraprāsādabhūmijā nāmādhyāyastriṣaṣṭitamaḥ| <64> atha digbhadrā diprāsādalakṣaṇaṃ nāma catuṣṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ| prāsādamatha vāroyaṃ vakṣyāmo nāmalakṣaṇaiḥ| lakṣaṇaisteṣu digbhadraḥ śrīvatso vardhamānakaḥ ||1 nandyāvartaścaturthaḥ syātpañcamo nandivardhanaḥ| vimānaśca tathā padmo mahābhadrā khya eva ca ||2 śrīvardhamānakākhyaśca mahāpadmato'pi vā| ekādaśaḥ pañcaśālo dvādaśaḥ pṛthivījayaḥ ||3 tatra prāgeva digbhadraḥ śrāvaṇaṃ pratipādyate| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre navabhāgavibhājite ||4 koṇo dvibhāgavistāraḥ pratyaṅgau bhāgikau smṛtau| śālā bhāgatrayā kāryā nāsikātrayaśobhitā ||5 parasparaṃ viniṣkāsamardhabhāgena kārayet| koṇapratyaṅgayorantaḥ śālāpratyaṅgayostathā ||6 ṣoḍaśāṃśena kurvīta---salilāntaram| sīmāsyād daśabhirbhāgaiḥ pravibhajya vidhīyate ||7 ---kā garbhapādaiḥ ṣaḍ bhittayaḥ syurdvibhāgikāḥ| vardhamānenamatha brūmo vistārād dviguṇaṃ hi tat ||8 dvau bhāgau vedikābandho jaṅghā jñeyā catuṣpadā| śāntāpatrā kapotālī sārdhabhāgaṃ samucchritā ||9 sārdhabhāgasamucchrāyā kāryā prathamabhūmikā| dvitīyā bhūmikā jñeyā sārdhabhāgatrayodayā ||10 tṛtīyā ca vidheyā syātsārdhabhāgadvacchritā| uchālakaṃ ca jaṅghā ca bhūmikāryaṃ vidhīyate ||11 kūṭaṃ cārdhato deyaṃ karmaśobhāsamanvitam| ghaṇṭā bhāgatrayotsedhā bahubhiścāśribhiryutā ||12 kalaśaṃ sthāpayedūrdhvaṃ bhāgadvayasamucchritam| bījapūrakasaṃyuktaṃ vartulaṃ pallavāvṛtam ||13 śikharārdhasya kurvīta sapādamudayaṃ tathā| imaṃ digbhadra saṃjñaṃ yaḥ prāsādaṃ kārayetpumān ||14 śatakratuphalaṃ so'pi labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ| lakṣma śrīvatsasaṃjñasya prāsādasyābhidhīyate ||15 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre bhakte pañcadaśāṃśakaiḥ| asyocchrāyo sakāstryaṃśastraṃ kṣoṇasyādaṃśakaistribhiḥ ||16 karṇaśālāntare kāryau dvyaṃśau pratirathāvubhau| tayorubhayoḥ sārdhaṃ sādaṃ tu mārgro niveśayet ||17 bhāgamekaṃ praviṣṭau ca śālā bhāgatrayātmikā| nirgamaḥ syātpadārdhena garbhastu navabhāgikaḥ ||18 tripadā ca bhaved bhittirūrdhvamasyātha kathyate| śrīvatsaḥ kīrtitaḥ sampratyucyate vardhamānakaḥ ||19 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre --- bhāgakalpitam| chedādi giripatryantaṃ dadyātpūrvakrameṇa tu ||20 dvistarā tristarā cāpi kartavyā vedikā matā| staramekaṃ bhavecchedaḥ kaṇṭhastaddviguṇo bhavet ||21 paṭṭikāṃ giripatrīṃ ca tasyaivārdhena kārayet| daśastarā tato ghaṇṭā yadi vāmalasārakam ||22 dvistaraṃ syāttataḥ padmaṃ dviguṇaḥ kalaśastataḥ| tadūrdhvaṃ bhūmikā kāryā sapīṭhā lakṣaṇānvitā ||23 staraiḥ syātpañcadaśabhiḥ pīṭhaṃ jaṅghāpi tāvatā| catuḥstarā bhavenmālā laśunaṃ tu staradvayam ||24 tasyārdhena bharaṇaṃ kumbhaṃ kurvīta tatsamam| tasya dviguṇamucchālaṃ gaṇḍamekastaraṃ bhavet ||25 paṭṭaṃ dviguṇametasmātkuryādardhena paṭṭikām| paṭṭikāyāḥ pramāṇena kartavyā giripatrikā ||26 varaṇḍī tristarā kāryā śūrasenairalaṅkṛtā| ekastarastataśchedaḥ kaṇṭhastu dviguṇastataḥ ||27 paṭṭikā giripatrī ca vidhātavye staraṃ staram| ubhau starau khirihiraṃ bhavecchedaḥ staraṃ tataḥ ||28 tathaiva kaṇṭhastadvacca paṭṭikāgiripatrike| varaṇḍikā dvistarā syāccheṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret ||29 ubhau starau khirihiraṃ chedaṃ kurvīta bhāgikam| kaṇṭhaśca patrikā caiva giripatrī ca pūrvavat ||30 dvistarā vedikā kāryā dyavapādikayā yutā| chedamekaṃ staraṃ kuryātkaṇṭhaṃ taddviguṇaṃ tataḥ ||31 patrikāṃ giripatrīṃ ca tasyaivārdhena kārayet| starāṣṭakena ghaṇṭā syādyadivāmalasārakam ||32 bhavetyamaṃ --- kalaśo dviguṇastataḥ| staramekaṃ bhavedgrīvā karṇaṃ kurvīta tatsamam ||33 dviguṇaṃ bījapūraṃ tu pūrvatrāpyevamācaret| --tkṛṣṭā saptadaśāṃśakairbhāgestribhirbhavet ||34 dvibhāgikaḥ pratirathaḥ śālā syātpañcabhāgikā| śālāpratyaṅgayorantarbhāgārdhenodakāntaram ||35 parasparaṃ viniṣkāsaḥ pādahīnaṃ padaṃ bhavet| garbhaḥ syāddaśabhirbhāgairbhittiḥ sārdhapadatrayāt ||36 caturbhirvedikābandho jaṅghā syādaṣṭabhiḥ padaiḥ| sārdhaiḥ pañcabhirādyā bhūḥ kapotālīsamanvitā ||37 tṛtīyā bhūmikā cāsya kartavyā pañcabhiḥ padaiḥ| sārdhairbhavettṛtīyāpi caturbhirbhūmikā padaiḥ ||38 caturthī bhūmikā bhāgaiścaturbhiḥ kīrtitā padaiḥ| ghaṇṭā ca tripadā kāryā kūṭabhaktyādi pūrvavat ||39 śukanāsādi kumbhādi pūrvavatsamudāhṛtam| ukto'yaṃ vardhamānākhyaḥ prāsādaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ ||40 nandyāvartamatha brūmaḥ kṣetre saptadaśāṃśake| koṇāṃścatuṣpadān kuryātpañjaraṃ sārdhabhāgikam ||41 ṣaḍbhirbhāgairbhavecchālā garbhastu daśabhāgikaḥ| sādhatribhāgikā bhittirūrdhvamānadvibhāṃguṇam ||42 vedī catuṣpadotsedhā jaṅghā bhāgāṣṭakocchritā| ṣaṭpadā bhūmikā --- pañcapadāyatā ||43 syātsampade caturbhāgā tṛtīyānyā padocchritā| sāṃdbhivāṃsevaghaṭā syātpūrvavatkalaśādikāḥ ||44 nandyāvarto'yamākhyātaḥ prāsādaḥ sarvakāmadaḥ| athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmaḥ prāsādaṃ nandivardhanam ||45 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre padāṣṭadaśakāṅkite| koṇastripadavistāraḥ pratyaṅgaṃ syātpadadvayam ||46 śālā catuṣpadā proktā citrakarmopaśobhitā| pādonabhāgamānena nirgamaḥ syātparasparam ||47 koṇapratyaṅgayormadhye śālāpratyaṅgayostathā| bhāgena vistṛtaṃ kāryaṃ sarvatra salilāntaram ||48 garbhaḥ syāddaśabhirbhāgairbhittirbhāgacatuṣṭayāt| ūrdhvamānamatha brūmo dviguṇaṃ tatprakīrtitam ||49 vedībandhaoṃ'śakāḥ pañca jaṅghā syādaṣṭabhāgikā| prathamā bhūmikā kāryā kapotālīsamanvitā ||50 sapādaiḥ pañcabhirbhāgairdvitīyā tadvadeva hi| tṛtīyā tu bhavatyasya bhūmikā pañcabhāgikā ||51 caturthī bhūmikā jñeyā sārdhabhāgacatuṣṭayā| ghaṇṭā tasyordhvataḥ kāryā padatrayasamucchritā ||52 śukāghrā śūrasenaśca stambhikākūṭabhaktayaḥ| kalaśasyodayastasya vidheyāścāsya pūrvavat ||53 amuṃ yaḥ kārayedanyaḥ prāsādaṃ nandivardhanam| sa nandigaṇasāmānyo jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||54 ataḥ paramatha brūmo vimānaṃ śubhalakṣaṇam| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre viṃśatyā bhājite padaiḥ ||55 koṇāḥ pañcapadāḥ kāryā madhye ca salilāntaram| karṇikā sārdhabhāgena bhāgārdhamudakāntaram ||56 sālopadyadavistīrṇā sārdhabhāgena nirgatā| koṇasya cārdhabhāgena karṇikānirgamaḥ smṛtaḥ ||57 garbhaścāsya vidhātavyo dvādaśāṃśakavistṛtaḥ| bhittiścatuṣpadā kāryā dikṣu sarvāsvavasthitā ||58 ūrdhvamānamathaitasya brūmastad dviguṇaṃ bhavet| vedībandhaoṃ'śakāḥ pañca jaṅghā navapadocchritā ||59 prathamā bhūmikā kāryā bhāgaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ samucchritā| śatapatrāṃ kapotālīṃ madhye cāsyāḥ prakalpayet ||60 dvitīyā bhūmikā cāsya vidheyā pañcabhiḥ padaiḥ| ardhe'syāḥ stambhakocchālaṃ kūṭaṃ cārdhavyavasthitam ||61 parasparapādhena hamāstistro'nyabhūmikāḥ| stambhikākūṭabharaṇaśūrasenāḥ saghaṇṭakāḥ ||62 kalaśasyodayaścātra prāgvatkāryā vipaścitā| ya imaṃ kārayedbhaktyā vimānākhyaṃ nṛpuṅgavaḥ ||63 iha bhogān sa labhate tathā satkāyadaṃvidhe| atha padmāpriyaprītijananaḥ padma ucyate ||64 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre bhakte ṣoḍaśabhiḥ padaiḥ| koṇāścatuṣpadāḥ kāryāḥ salilāntarabhūṣitāḥ ||65 dvipadaḥ pañjaro jñeyo garbhe koṇāścatuṣpadāḥ| bhāgaḥsyāt ṣoḍaśāṃśena tadante salilāntaram ||66 garbhaḥ syānnavabhirbhāgairbhittiḥ sārdhapadatrayam| ūrdhvamānamatha brūmastathāsya dviguṇaṃ bhavet ||67 dvitīyā bhūmikā jñeyā bhāgaiḥ pañcabhirucchritā| anyonyaṃ tu padārdhena hīnaṃ syādbhūmikādvayam ||68 stambhikākūṭabharaṇaśukāghrāśūrasenakāḥ| ghaṇṭā kārasavistārā bhavantyetasya pūrvavat ||69 padmaprāsādamenaṃ yaḥ kārayedbhaktisaṃyutaḥ| sa śrīpatiriva śrīśo bhavatyavanimaṇḍanaḥ ||70 mahābhadra matha brūmaḥ prāsādamatisundaram| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre viṃśatyā saikayāṅkite ||71 koṇāścatuṣpadāḥ sārdhadvyaṃśāḥ pratyaṅgakāḥ smṛtāḥ| śālā pañcapadā kāryā dikṣu sarvāsvavasthitā ||72 pādonabhāgavistāraṃ kartavyaṃ salilāntaram| garbhastrayodaśapado bhittayaśca catuṣpadāḥ ||73 ūrdhvamānamathaitasya brūmastaddviguṇaṃ bhavet| vedī catuṣpadotsedhā jaṅghā syādaṣṭabhāgikā ||74 saptabhāgasamutsedhā vidheyā cādibhūmikā| madhye sāntarapatrāsyāḥ kapotālī padatrayam ||75 dvitīyabhūmikā cāsya sārdhaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ padaiḥ smṛtā| bhāgabhāgavihīnāstu tisro'nyā bhūmikāstataḥ ||76 ghaṇṭā bhāgatrayotsedhā padmapatrikayā saha| stambhikākūṭabharaṇaśukāghrāśūrasenakāḥ ||77 kalaśaḥ kumbhaṃ naghāḥ prāgvattasya bhavantyamī| mahābhadra mimaṃ yo'tra kārayedbhaktimān naraḥ ||78 sa svarge suranārībhiḥ sevyate madanājñayā| atha śrīvardhamānasya lakṣma sāmpratamucyate ||79 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre caturviṃśatibhājite| koṇāḥ ṣaḍbhāgikāḥ kāryāḥ śālāḥ syurnavabhāgikāḥ ||80 sādhaṃ padadvayaṃ kāryaḥ śālānāmatra nirgamaḥ| kuryājjalāntaraṃ tatra madhyataḥ koṇaśālayoḥ ||81 vistṛtaṃ sādhabhāgena praviṣṭamapi bhāgataḥ| koṇe madhyaṃ vidhātavyaṃ bhāgenaivodakāntaram ||82 navāṃśakḷptaśālāyāḥ pratyaṅgau dvāvudāhṛtau| bhāgadvitayavistārau bhāgenaikena nirgatau ||83 caturdaśapado garbho bhittiḥ pañcapadā smṛtā| ūrdhvamānamatha brūmastadasya dviguṇaṃ bhavet ||84 vedikā ṣaṭpadotsedhā jaṅghaikādaśabhiḥ padaiḥ| prathamā bhūmikā cāsya kāryā saptāṃśakocchritā ||85 pādonaiḥ saptabhirbhāgairdvitīyā bhūmikeṣyate| tṛtīyā bhūmikā ṣaḍbhiḥ sapādairjāyate padaiḥ ||86 pādena ṣaṭakā bhāgena caturthī bhūmikā smṛtā| bhāgaṃ bhāgaṃ vidhātavyaḥ praveśaḥ pratibhūmikam ||87 sapādaiḥ pañcabhirbhāgaiḥ kāryau ghaṇṭāsamucchrayaḥ| bhāgatrayasamutsedhastadūrdhve kalaśo bhavet ||88 sukāghrāsūrasenaśca stambhikākūṭabhaktayaḥ| kāryā pūrvoktamārgeṇa vicitrakarmopaśobhitāḥ ||89 śrīvarddhamānaṃ ya imaṃ prāsādaṃ kārayennṛpaḥ| yaśaḥ śrīśreyasāṃgasya vṛddhi syāduttarottarā ||90 padmayonipṛthaḥ sadmadmatha kīrttyate| caturasrīkṛte kṣetre viṃśatyekonayāntike ||91 koṇāścatuṣpadāḥ kāryā pratyaṅgā api tatsamāḥ| rivarttanakarttavyā parasparasamī śubhāḥ ||92 śālā navāṃśavistīrṇā syātpadatrayanirgamā| śālālastāśca karttavyā dvibhāgā bālamañjarī ||93 karṇapratyaṅgayormadhye bālapratyaṅgayostathā| jalāntarāṇi kāryāṇi tatpramāṇasya madhyataḥ ||94 garbhaḥ saptadaśāṃsaḥ syādbhittayaḥ ṣaḍbhiraṃśakaiḥ| ūrdhvamānamathaitasya brūmastaddviguṇaṃ bhavet ||95 vedī ṣaḍbhāgikotsedhā jaṅghābhāgāstrayodaśa| saptabhāgasamutsedhā karttavyā cādibhūmikā ||96 ṣaḍbhiḥ sārdhaiḥ dvitīyā syādbhāgabhāgojjhite pare| pañcamī syāccaturbhāgā bhāgārddhena paretpṛthak ||97 praveśaḥ kūṭadarbheṇa bhūmīnāṃ syātparasparam| bhūmikārddhaṃ vidhātavyaṃ stambhikābharaṇānvitam ||98 aparaṃ kūṭaśobhātirarddhamasyāvibhūṣayet| ghaṇṭāpañcapadotsedhā vistṛtā garbhamānasaḥ ||99 sukāghrāya paraṃ yattu pūrvavattatprakalpayet| mahāpadmābhidhayotra prāsādaṃ kārayetsudhīḥ ||100 ihāmutra ca nirdvadvaḥ sa paraṃ sukhamaśnute| lakṣyātha pañcaśālā prāsādasyābhidhīyate ||101 caturasrīkṛte kṣetre aṣṭāviṃśatipadāntike| tasyārjanaphalāḥ kārāḥ koṇā pañcapadāḥ smṛtāḥ ||102 pratyaṅgāstripadāḥ kāryā bhāgadvitayanirgatā| śālāṣṭapadavistārā padatritayanirgamā ||103 koṇapratyaṅgayormadhye śālāpratyaṅgayostathā| bhāgena vistṛtaṃ kāryaṃ praviṣṭaṃ ca jalāntaram ||104 garbhaḥ ṣoḍaśabhirbhāgaiḥ bhittayo'pi ca ṣaṭpadāḥ| ūrddhvamānamathaitasya brūmastaddviguṇaṃ bhavet ||105 vidheyo vedikābandhaḥ sārdhapañcapadocchrayam| jaṅghā cāsya bhavetkāryā tatraikādaśabhāgikā ||106 sārddhasaptapadotsedhā vidhātavyā ca bhūmikā| kapotapālī kāryāsya madhye bhāgatrayocchritā ||107 ayaṃ bhūmipramāṇena syādvitīyā'pi bhūmikā| tṛtīyā saptabhirbhāgaiścaturthī sārthaṣaṭpadā ||108 pañcaṛmī ṣaṭpadā kāryā ghaṇṭā pañcapadocchritā| śālāsthāneṣu sarveṣu karttavyaṃ pañcaghaṇṭākam ||109 kumāraiḥ pañcabhiryuktaṃ pañcaśāloyamucyate| śukāghrāsūrasenādi yaccānyat kalaśādikam ||110 tadasya pūrvavatkārya pañcaśālasya dhīmatā| pañcaśālamimaṃ yastu prāsādaṃ kārayedbhuvi ||111 tasya dhanyasya santāne'pyatulā jāyate sukhaṃ| athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmaḥ prāsādaṃ pṛthivījayam ||112 catustrīkṛte kṣetre'ṣṭāviṃśatipadāṅkite| --- padāḥ smṛtāḥ| bhāgadvitayavistārāḥ kartavyā bālapañjarāḥ ||113 śālā ṣaḍbhāgavistīrṇā bhāgatritayamucchritā| koṇapratyaṅgayormadhye śālāpratyaṅgayostathā ||114 kakṣāntare vidhātavyaṃ bhāgikaṃ salilāntaram| garbhaḥ syāddaśabhirbhāgairbhittiḥ kāryāsya ṣaṭpadā ||115 ṣaṭpadā syāttṛtīyātra --- bhāgocchritāḥ parāḥ| karṇa --- stisro ghaṇṭā cāṣṭapadocchritāḥ ||116 kūṭairalaṅkṛtā kāryā śukāghrādi ca pūrvavat| sa --- pi caiteṣāṃ prāsādārdhena kārayet ||117 ghaṇṭāṃ tu saṃhatāṃ ślakṣṇāṃ bandhanairupaśobhitām| yādṛśī kama --- ne kūṭeṣveṣāṃ vidhīyate ||118 bhadre ṣu tādṛśī kāryā kṛtsnaprāsādasiddhaye| ya imaṃ kārayedrā jā prāsādaṃ pṛthivījayam| bhunakti nikhilāṃ pṛthvīṃ sa saptāmbhodhimālinīm ||119 itīritā dvādaśa syagarte| prāsādamukhyāḥ śubhalakṣmayuktāḥ| vāvāṭasaṃjñāstadamūn viditvā| labhetpūjyasthayate nṛpebhyaḥ ||120 iti mahārājādhirājaparameśvaraśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhāranāmni vāstuśāstre vaṭokaprāsādo nāma catuḥṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ| <65> atha bhūmijaprāsādalakṣaṇaṃ nāma pañcaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ| bhūmijānāṃ vimānānāṃ brūmo lakṣma kramāgatam| caturaśrīkṛtānāṃ ca vṛttānāṃ vṛta pūrvaśaḥ ||1 keṣāñcinnirgamastatra jāyate bhāgasaṃkhyayā| keṣāñcitpunareṣa syādvṛttamadhyamadhiṣṭhitaḥ ||2 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre daśabhāgavibhājite| caturbhūmiyutasyātha lakṣma tsaṃśasya kathyate ||3 catvāraścaturaśrāḥ syurniṣadho malayācalaḥ| mālyavān navamālī ca niṣadhasteṣu kathyate ||4 koṇā śaṃbhotaro dvyaṃśaṃ bhārdaśaṃbhordhabhāgikaḥ| vistārāyāmataḥ prokto bhadraṃ pañcāṃśavistṛtam ||5 kāryā pādonabhāgena bhadra syaitasya nirgamāḥ| kāryā pallambikā tasya pādabhāgena vistṛtā ||6 bhāgena karṇikā kāryā vistṛtyā nirgameṇa ca| pratibhadraṃ ca bhāgārdhanirgataṃ tatra kalpayet ||7 pādonabhāgadvitayaṃ pratibhadra sya vistṛtiḥ| ṣaḍbhirbhāgairbhavedgarbho bhittirasya dvibhāgikā ||8 talacchandasya lakṣmoktamūrdhvamānamathocyate| vistṛterdviguṇaṃ tacca caturbhāgādhikaṃ bhavet ||9 vedībandho bhavedasya sārdhabhāgadvayocchritaḥ| tattu bhāgadvayaṃ sārdhaṃ vibhajedardhapañcamaiḥ ||10 bhāgadvayena kumbhaḥ syātkalaśo bhāgikaḥ smṛtaḥ| bhāgārdhenāntaraṃ patraṃ kapotalī tu bhāgikī ||11 ukto'yaṃ vedikābandho bhāgairityardhapañcamaiḥ| ardhapañcamabhāgaiḥ syājjaṅghocchālakasaṃyutā ||12 tribhi --- bhūtsedhaḥ savaraṇḍikaḥ| dvitīyāsya bhavedbhūmirardhapañcamabhāgikā ||13 kumbhaḥ socchālakā --- yāpi tāvatā| tṛtīyā syādbhūrvidheyā syāsādā caturaṅgikā ||14 caturthī caturo bhāgāccaḥ samu---| kumbhaḥ socchālakaḥ kūṭasyocchrāyo'pi ca pūrvavat ||15 vedī syātsāṃśakā sārdhapañcāṃśā skandhavistṛtiḥ| --- khetsārdha caturguṇitavistarāt ||16 tale yā kathitā śālā bhāgapañcakavistṛtā| skandhasthānaṃ -- bhāgadvistayavistṛtā ||17 rekhāvaśena kartavyāḥ praveśāśca kramādbhuvām| mūlataḥ skandhaparyantaṃ ghaṇṭāyāḥ pu--- yāḥ ||18 bhavetprāsādavistāraḥ pañcamaṇaiva sundaraḥ| vedako'rdhetaraṃ yatsyācchālāyāstatpramāṇataḥ ||19 --- ye vistaraḥ proktastaṃ --- ṣaḍbhirvibhājayet| bhāgenaikena kaṇṭhasya praveśaḥ parito bhavet ||20 kaṇṭhavṛttaṃ caturbhāgavistṛtaṃ parikalpayet| ghaṇṭotsedhaṃ tribhirbhāgairvibhajet tatra bhāgikāt ||21 ghaṇṭotsedhādataḥ kāryaṃ padmaśīrṣaṃ vipaścitā| utsedhātkalaśo dvyaṃśaḥ sārdhabhāgena vistṛtaḥ ||22 śikharāttryaṃśahīnā syātsarvatra dyutāśikā| iti tryaṃśaścaturbhūmiḥ prāsādo niṣadho mataḥ ||23 sarvāsāmeva kartavyo devatānāṃ vibhūṣayet| niṣadhaprāsādaḥ || malayādre ridānīṃ tu lakṣaṇaṃ sampracakṣmahe ||24 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre dvādaśāṃśavibhājite| karṇā dvibhāgikāḥ kāryāḥ samaṃ salilavartmabhiḥ ||25 śālā syātpañcabhirbhāgaiḥ sārdhāṃśastu pratīrathaḥ| sa śālākarṇayormadhye kartavyaḥ sodakāntaraḥ ||26 pratīrathasya --- ścārdhabhāgaṃ vinirgamaḥ| bhavet pathavikānyaḥ sa vibhāgo'nya --- pūrvavat ||27 te ca dvādaśabhāgā ye daśabhistān vibhājayet| garbhabhittiṃ tathotsedhaṃ jaṅghāyāḥ prathamakṣiteḥ ||28 vedībandhasya cotsedhaṃ pūrvamānena kārayet| madhyaṃ pallavikāntaṃ tu śālayordaśabhirbhajet ||29 kṣiterārabhya pūrvasyāḥ skandhaṃ yāvatsamucchritā| kāryā dvādaśabhirbhāgairanantaranirūpitaiḥ ||30 sārdhayaikonaviṃśatyā bhājayedbhūya eva tām| dvitīyabhūmikotsedhastairbhavasyatha bhāgikā ||31 trisro'nyāḥ padapādena hīnāḥ kāryā yathākramam| bhāgena vedikotsedhaḥ śālā kāryā ca nāgaraḥ ||32 ūrdhvamādyaṃ kṣiteḥ kāryā mālāyāḥ śūrasenakāḥ| koṇapratirathā ye tu pañcabhāgasamucchritāḥ ||33 stambhocchālakamadhyena teṣu kūṭocchritāstathā| ardhena pravidhātavyā bhūṣvanyāsvapyayaṃ vidhiḥ ||34 skandhavistārarekhā bhūpraveśo ghaṇṭayā saha| kalaśaḥ śukanāsasya cocchritiḥ pūrvavadbhavet ||35 malayādri rayaṃ proktaḥ prāsādaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ| ya enaṃ kārayettasya tuṣyanti sakalāḥ surāḥ ||36 varṣakoṭisahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate| malayādri prāsādaḥ || atha mālyavato lakṣma yathāvadabhidhīyate ||37 bhajedardhayutaiḥ pañcadaśabhiścatura --- | karṇā dvibhāgikāḥ kāryā śālā pañcāṃśavistṛtā ||38 karṇābhyarṇai'śayugalaṃ pādonāḥ syuḥ pratīrathāḥ| śālāyāḥ pārśvayoḥ kāryau pañjarau sārdhabhāgikau ||39 pṛthakpañjaraśālāyā --- rdhabhāgikā| śālāyāḥ pallavī yā ca nirgamaścārdhabhāgikaḥ ||40 sārdhapañcadaśoktā ye bhāgāstā ---| garbho'tha bhittivistārastathā khuravaraṇḍikā ||41 jaṅghādhaḥ kṣitirādyā ca rekhocchrāyaśca pūrvavat| --- bhājyaṃ pādahīnāṣṭayuktayā ||42 pañcabhāgasamutsedhā dvitīyā bhūmikā bhavet| padapādavihīnāḥsyustisro'nyābhūmayaḥ kramāt ||43 sārdhāṃśo vedikocchrāyaḥ kartavyo vāstuvedibhiḥ| skandhasya vistṛtī rekhā ghaṇṭā ca kalaśastathā ||44 --- yāṃstarāsamāśca stambhakūṭādikalpanā| śukanāsocchratiśceti iti etāni pūrvavat ||45 ityevaṃ mālyavān nāma prāsādaḥ parikīrtitaḥ| ya enaṃ kārayettasya jāyante sarvasiddhayaḥ ||46 śivaloke nivāso'sya bhavetkalpāyurapyayam| mālyavān || navamālikasaṃjñasya lakṣaṇaṃ kathyate'dhunā ||47 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre bhakte'ṣṭādaśabhiḥ padaiḥ| karṇā dvibhāgikāḥ kāryāḥ samaṃ salilavartmabhiḥ ||48 śālā syātpañcabhirbhāgaiḥ pārśvayorbālapañjarau| sapādabhāgikau tau ca kāryau sa salilāntarau ||49 karṇābhyarṇe pratirathau pādau nāladvayonmitau| tau sodakāntarau kāryau pañjarau sārdhabhāgikau ||50 dvau bālapañjarakasyaitau madhye pratirathasya ca| pratīrathaḥ pañjo vā bālapañjarakastathā ||51 śālāpallavikāṃ yāvadetāni tu pṛthakpṛthak| bhāgārdhanirgamāni syurbhāgā ye'ṣṭādaśoditāḥ ||52 vibhājayettān daśabhirvibhāgairvāstutattvavit| garbho bhittiḥ samucchrāyo vedikājaṅghayorapi ||53 ādyabhūmyucchritistadvaducchrāyaḥ śikharasya ca| prāsāde'sminnidaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvavat kathitaṃ budhaiḥ ||54 tatpañcatriṃśatā bhāgaiḥ pādonaiḥ śikharaṃ bhavet| dvitīyā bhūmikā kāryā tataḥ pañcapadocchritā ||55 padapādavihīnāstu śeṣāḥ syuḥ sapta bhūmayaḥ| pādonabhāgadvitayaṃ vedikāyāḥ samucchritiḥ ||56 skandhasya vistṛtī rekhā ghaṇṭātha kalaśastathā| śālāyāṃ śūrasenāśca stambhakūṭādikalpanā ||57 śukanāsocchritirbhūmipraveśaśceha pūrvavat| ya imaṃ kārayedbhaktyā prāsādaṃ navamālikam ||58 tuṣyanti devatāstasya bhavanti ca samṛddhayaḥ| navamālikaḥ || idānīmabhidhīyante prāsādā vṛkṣajātayaḥ ||59 vallabhāḥ sarvadevānāṃ bhūmijāḥ purabhūṣaṇam| āśrayaḥ śreyasāmeko yaśasāmapi rāśayaḥ ||60 bhuktimuktipradātāraḥ samāgate kṛtā nṛṇām| tatrādyaḥ kumudo nāma kamalaḥ kamalodbhavaḥ ||61 kiraṇaḥ śataśṛṅgaśca niravadyastathāparaḥ| sarvāṅgasundaraśceti prāsādā vṛkṣajātayaḥ ||62 na vistarānna saṃkṣepāllakṣmaiṣāmatha kīrtyate| tatrādyaḥ kumudo nāma sarvānandakṛducyate ||63 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre vistārāyāmataḥ same| vibhakte daśabhirbhāgairbhavedgarbhastriṣaṭpadaḥ ||64 tatra śeṣeṇa kurvīta --- catuṣṭayam| --- tataḥ karṇasūtreṇa tatra vṛttaṃ samālikhet ||65 digvidikṣvaṣṭa karṇāḥ syuḥ salilāntarabhūṣitāḥ| samanta bhūmiparyantaṃ daśabhiḥ syādayaṃ padaiḥ ||66 vedībandho vidhātavyaḥ sārdhāṃśasya padadvayam| --- sārdhacaturbhirvibhajetpadaiḥ ||67 kumbhakaṃ dvi ---| bhāgārdhenāntaraṃ patraṃ kapotālī ca bhāgikā ||68 vedībandho'yamityukto jaṅghotsedha ---| syādardhapañcamairbhāgaiḥ socchālastalakumbhakaḥ ||69 ādyabhūmau bhavetkūṭaṃ bhāgatritayalakṣitam| prāsāde pañcadaśabhirvibhajeta samucchrayam ||70 dvitīyā bhūmikā tatra kāryā pañcāṃśakocchritāḥ| ardhenocchālakastambhaiḥ kūṭocchrāyastathordhvataḥ ||71 pādonaiḥ pañcabhirbhūmiṃ tṛtīyāṃ parikalpayet| caturthīṃ racayedbhāgairbhūmikāmardhapañcamaiḥ ||72 dvitīyabhūmikāvatsyātkūṭastambhādikalpanā| vedikābhāgocchritā kāryā ṣaṭpadā skandhavistṛtiḥ ||73 ṣaḍguṇena ca sūtreṇa veṇukośaṃ samālikhet| prāsādapañcamāṃśena kāryā ghaṇṭāsamucchritiḥ ||74 ghaṇṭotsedhaṃ tatastasya tribhirbhāgairvibhājayet| kaṇṭhagrīvāṇḍakānyasya bhāgena naikena kārayet ||75 ṣaḍbhāgabhaktaghaṇṭāyāḥ samantādbhāgavicyuteḥ| bhāgaiścaturbhiḥ kartavye ghaṇṭe kaṇṭhasya vistaram ||76 ghaṇṭotsedhārdhataḥ kuryādghaṇṭārdhe padmaśīrṣakam| ghaṇṭotsedhasamā kumbhe bījapūravito samucchritiḥ ||77 caturaśrāṃjitocchrāyo vistāraḥ kalaśaḥ smṛtāḥ| ya imaṃ kārayetprītyā prāsādaṃ kumudābhidham ||78 sa modate jagadbhartuḥ śivasya bhavane śubhe| kumudaprāsādaḥ || athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmaḥ prāsādaṃ kamalābhidham ||79 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre daśabhāgavibhājite| tataḥ karṇārdhasūtreṇa vṛttaṃ tatra samālikhet ||80 vistīrṇaṃ pañcabhirbhāgaiḥ kuryādbhadra catuṣṭayam| surendra samatāyasakuberāśāsvanukramāt ||81 bhavetpallavikāyāstu vistāro bhāgapādikaḥ| bhāgena kāryā bhadrā ṇāṃ nirgamā vṛttabāhyataḥ ||82 śālāyāḥ pratibhadraṃ syātkarṇikādhena nirgatā| pādonabhāgatritayātkāryā vṛttasya vistṛtiḥ ||83 dvibhāgavistarāyāmau raśukaṃ dvayamatodhyagau| parivartanayā kāryau dvau koṇau sodakāntarau ||84 pūrvaprāsādavadgarbho vidheyo bhittayo'pi ca| vedībandhādikumbhāntaṃ sarvametasya pūrvavat ||85 dvitīyabhūmiparyantamūrdhvaṃ prathamabhūmitaḥ| śūrasenaṃ vidhātavyaṃ śālāsu śliṣṭamuttamam ||86 kūṭastambhādikanyāsāḥ koṇapratirathādiṣu| śālā syāmrāgarāstale pañcāṃśā dvyaṃśakopari ||87 śikharasya tribhāgonā śukāghrāyāḥ samucchritiḥ| ya enaṃ kamalaṃ nāma prāsādaṃ kārayennṛpaḥ ||88 trailokye kamalādhīśavijaye sa bhavennṛpaḥ| kamalaprāsādaḥ || athātaḥ kathyate samyakprāsādaḥ kamalodbhavaḥ ||89 sadā lakṣmīpatiryatra devo viśrāmyati svayam| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre caturdaśabhiraṃśite ||90 ---stāro bhadraṃ pañcapadaṃ bhavet| dvibhāgāyāmavistārau kāryāḥ pratirathāstathā ||91 koṇa ---| kāryā pallavikāyāśca nirgamo vṛttamadhyataḥ ||92 śālāvibhaktiścaitasya karta ---| --- ntareṣu syājjalāntaram ||93 dvyaṅgulaṃ tryaṅgulaṃ vāpi tadvidheyaṃ vipaścitā| bhāgā --- lpayet ||94 prāsādasyāsya --- bhājayeddaśabhiḥ padaiḥ| garbhaśca pūrvavatkāryaḥ pūrvavadbhittayo'pi ca ||95 prāgvatkhuravaraṇḍī syājjaṅghākūṭādyabhūmikā| śikharasyocchritiḥ prāgvattāṃ sārdhaikānuviṃśatim ||96 bhāgānkuryāttataḥ kāryā bhūrdvitīyāṃśapañcakam| kāryāstisro bhuvaḥ śeṣāḥ pādapādaparicyutāḥ ||97 bhāgaṃ vedī bhūpraveśaḥ kāryo rekhāvaśāditaḥ| pūrvavaccārtha vistāraḥ syādghaṇṭākalaśādi vā ||98 kūṭastambhādikaṃ prāgvacchukanāsocchrayo'pi ca| ya imaṃ kārayetkāntaṃ prāsādaṃ kamalodbhavam ||99 sa samastajagannāthaḥ pratijanma prajāyate| kamalodbhavaprāsādaḥ || lakṣaṇaṃ kiraṇasyātha brūmaḥ samyakkramāgatam ||100 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre bhakte ---| --- pañcadaśāṃśā ye tān bhajeddaśabhiḥ punaḥ ||101 garbho'tra pūrvavatkāryaḥ pūrvavadbhittayo'pi ca| prāgvatkhuravaraṇḍī syājjaṅghākūṭocchritistathā ||102 pūrvavacchikharotsedhastaṃ bhajetpādahīnayā| caturuttaraviṃśatyā bhāgānāṃ tatra bhūmikā ||103 dvitīyā pañcabhirbhāgaiścatasrastvaparāḥ punaḥ| pādonapadahīnāḥ syuḥ kramaśaścāsya bhūmikāḥ ||104 vedikā cāsya kartavyā sapādāṃśasamucchritā| śukanāsocchritiḥ śālāstambhakūṭavibhaktayaḥ ||105 rekhā stambhasya vistāro ghaṇṭākumbhādi pūrvavat| kūṭā drā viḍakāḥ kāryāḥ pratibhūmyatha bhaumaja ||106 haro hiraṇyagarbhaśca harirdinakarastathā| eṣāmeva vidheyo'sau nānyeṣāṃ tu kadācana ||107 amuṃ yaḥ kārayedrā jā prāsādaṃ kiraṇābhidham| sa duḥsahapratāpaḥ syātsahasrakaravadbhuvi ||108 kiraṇaprāsādaḥ || kathyate śaśaśṛṅgo'tha prāsādaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ| vallabhaḥ sarvadevānāṃ śivasya tu viśeṣataḥ ||109 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre viṃśatyaikona yāntibhe| karṇārdhasūtreṇa tato vṛttamatra prakalpayet ||110 karṇā dvibhāgikāḥ kāryāḥ śālā syātpañcabhāgikā| śālāpallavikā cāsya nirgatā vṛttamadhyataḥ ||111 dvau dvau pratirathau kāryau dvibhāgāyāmavistṛtau| paraṃ vartanato vṛttamadhyatā koṇaśālayoḥ ||112 śālākoṇapratirathāntareṣu syājjalāntaram| ekonaviṃśatiṃ bhāgāṃstān bhajeddaśabhiḥ punaḥ ||113 garbhaḥ prāgvattathā bhittiḥ prāgvatkhuravaraṇḍikā| jaṅghotsedho bhūtsedhaḥ pūrvavacchikharocchritiḥ ||114 athābhiste merārabhya paṭṭyantaṃ śikharocchritiḥ| bhāgānāmaṣṭaviṃśatyā vibhajetpādahīnayā ||115 dvitīyabhūmikā tasya kāryā pañcapadocchritā| rekhāstu pañca kartavyāḥ padapādocchritā bhuvaḥ ||116 sārdhabhāgocchritā vedī pravidheyāsya tadvidā| śālāsyastambhaktayadivibhaktayadivibhaktiḥ śukanāsikā ||117 rekhādyaṃ cakaṃbhasya prāgvatsyātsarvamapyadaḥ| śataśṛṅgamimaṃ kuryādyaḥ prāsādaṃ manoramam ||118 tasyaikaviṃśatikulā ---| kartā kārayitā ceti dvāvetau jagatāṃ prabhoḥ ||119 tripuradveṣiṇaḥ syātāṃ niyataṃ gaṇanāyakau| śataśṛṅgaprāsādaḥ || --- yāmo niravadyasya lakṣaṇam ||120 sa syājjyeṣṭho'tha madhyaśca kanīyāniti ca tridhā| catvāriṃśatkaro jyeṣṭho'pi madhyaḥ triṃśatkaro bhavet ||121 viṃśatyā ca karaireṣa kanīyān samudāhṛtaḥ| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre viṃśatyā bhājite padaiḥ ||122 tataḥ karṇadvisūtreṇa vṛttamatra prakalpayet| kāryā taiḥ pañcabhiḥ śālāpallavī vṛttadhyataḥ ||123 śālāvibhaktiḥ prāgvatsyācchālayoretayoḥ punaḥ| koṇe koṇe ca ṣaṭkarṇā --- bhāgāyāmavistṛtāḥ ||124 parivartanayā kāryā vṛttāntaḥ sodakāntarāḥ| tā tāgā tribhāgairvibhajeddaśabhistataḥ ||125 vimucya bhūmikābhāgāñcheṣaṃ garbhagṛhādi yat| tatpūrvavadvidhātavyaṃ tadvacca śikharocchritiḥ ||126 tāmekatriṃśatā bhāgaiḥ sārdhaiśca vibhajetpunaḥ| dvitīyabhūmikā kāryā padaiḥ pañcabhirucchritā ||127 padapādena hīnāḥ syuḥ śeṣā ṣaḍbhāsabhūmikāḥ| vedī paścayaṃ kāryā pādonamiha śilpinā ||128 stambhakūṭādi śālānāṃ vinyāsaḥ śūrasenakāḥ| śukanāsocchritirghaṇṭā kalaśādi ca pūrvavat ||129 ya imaṃ niravadyākhyaṃ prāsādaṃ kārayetsudhīḥ| sa prāpnoti paraṃ sthānaṃ brahmādīnāṃ sudurlabham ||130 niravadyaprāsādaḥ || sarvāṅgasundaraṃ brūmaḥ prāsādamatha sundaram| bhuktimuktipradātāraṃ varavālaya maṇḍanam ||131 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre caturviṃśatibhājite| karṇā dvibhāgavistārāḥ śālā syātpañcabhāgikā ||132 vṛttāntaḥ pallavī kāryā śeṣāḥ śālāsu pūrvavat| trayastrayaḥ pratirathā madhye syuḥ karṇaśālayoḥ ||133 parivṛtyaṃ vṛttamadhye dvibhāgāyāmavistṛtāḥ| śālākarṇapratirathaprānteṣu syājjalāntare ||134 tricaturviṃśatirbhāgā v ibhājyāḥ śilpibhiḥ punaḥ| vidheyaṃ garbhabhittyādi prāgvatsyācca varaṇḍikā ||135 jaṅghādibhūmikocchrāyaḥ prāgvadvā śikharocchritiḥ| taṃ pañcatriṃśatā bhāgairvibhajecchrikharocchrayam ||136 dvitīyā bhūmikā cāsya kāryā pañcapadocchritā| padapādavihīnāḥ syuḥ śeṣāḥ saptāsya bhūmikāḥ ||137 dvibhāgo vedikocchrāyo bhūmikānāṃ praveśanam| rekhāvaśena kartavyaṃ śeṣametasya yatpunaḥ ||138 tatpūrvavadvidhāṭavyaṃ stambhakūṭādi tadvidā| sarvāṅgasundaraṃ yo'tra prāsādaṃ kārayedamum ||139 sa svargasundarībhogānāpnoti vipulān divi| sarvāṅgasundaraḥ prāsādaḥ || athāṣṭaśālānvakṣyāmo --- bhūmijātiṣu ||140 teṣvādyaḥ svastiko'nyaśca vajrasvaritakasaṃjñitaḥ| tṛtīyo harmyatalakaścaturtha udayācalaḥ ||141 gandhamādanasaṃjñaśca pañcamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ| athābhidhīyate teṣu --- svalakṣaṇaḥ ||142 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre vistārāyāmataḥ same| karṇārdhasūtrapātena vṛttamasya samaṃ likhet ||143 vartulaṃ bhājayetkṣetraṃ ṣaḍguṇairaṣṭabhiḥ padaiḥ| aṣṭau śālā vidhātavyā vistāreṇa catuṣpadāḥ ||144 pallavī vṛttasūtreṇa ---| --- karṇikā jñeyā mānamūrdhvamathocyate ||145 vedibandho vidhātavyo bhāgadvitayamucchritaḥ| taṃ bhajetpañcabhirbhāgaiḥ --- tatra kumbhakaḥ ||146 pādayuktena bhāgena kartavyastu masūrakaḥ| ardhāṃśenottaraṃ patraṃ kapotālī tato bhavet ||147 sapādenāsya bhāgena jaṅghāṃ bhāgacatuṣṭayāt| talakumbhocchālakābhyāṃ saṃyuktā śubhalakṣaṇā ||148 bhāgadvitayamādya bhūḥ kartavyā savaraṇḍika| vyāsaṃ daśapadaṃ kṛtvā tairdvādaśabhirucchritiḥ ||149 skandhaśca ṣaṭpadastatra vidhātavyo vijānatā| ṣaḍguṇenaiva sūtreṇa veṇukośaṃ samālikhet ||150 dvādaśāṃśo ya utsedho bhāgānāṃ sama ---| taṃ kṛtvā pañcabhirbhāgaiste dvistairdvitīyā bhavenmahī ||151 padapādocchritāḥ kāryāstatastisro'parā bhuvaḥ| garbhā garbhaṃ vidhātavyaṃ bhūmikānāṃ praveśanam ||152 vedikā ca tataḥ kāryā sārdhabhāgasamucchitā| pādonadvipadā ghaṇṭā vibhajettāṃ tribhiḥ padaiḥ ||153 padaṃ syātkaṇṭhakotsedho grīvā bhāgasamucchritā| aṇḍakaṃ bhāgikaṃ tasyāṃ kartavyaṃ sumanoramam ||154 karparaṃ sārdhabhāgena kuryātsāmalasārakam| sīstana cābhāgāyāḥ sārdhabhāgacatuṣṭayāt ||155 ghaṇṭāyā corjitāḥ ||21 dvistambhaśukanāsāgre vijñeyaḥ pādamaṇḍapaḥ| prāsādabhittimānena maṇḍape bhittayaḥ smṛtāḥ ||22 sapādasatribhāgā vā vī syu ---| kvacidbhittivihīnāṃśca kuryādākāśamaṇḍapān ||23 latiṣveṣa vidhiḥ proktaḥ sāndhāreṣu svamānataḥ| prāsādo yādṛśastādṛṅ maṇḍapo'pi tadagrataḥ ||24 yāni prāsādanāmāni tāni syurmaṇḍapeṣvapi| vāstubhedena bhedo'yaṃ maṇḍapānāṃ vidhīyate ||25 śatārdhamaṇḍapasthānaṃ nīlādhaṃ bhojanāya ca| yajñārtho yatimukhyārthā vihārārthā nṛpālado ||26 kāryo daśabhya vistāro --- nu śatāvadheḥ| hastānāṃ saṃkhyayā mānaṃ hastena syādgṛheśituḥ ||27 upayogānusāreṇa svadhiyā parikalpitaḥ| āyataścaturaśro vā kartavyo nādyamaṇḍapaḥ ||28 śatamaṣṭottaraṃ jyeṣṭhaścatuḥṣaṣṭikaro'varaḥ| kaniṣṭho maṇḍapaḥ kāryo dvātriṃśatkarasaṃmitaḥ ||29 advivistāro'sya syānnepathyagṛhakādi tu| paricchedānusāreṇa svadhiyā parikalpayet ||30 dvāradvayaṃ ca kartavyaṃ tatpramāṇānusārataḥ| nepathyagṛhake cānyattṛtīyaṃ raṅgasammukham ||31 samaiḥ kṣaṇaiḥ samaiḥ stambhairalindaiśca samairyutāḥ| samakarṇāḥ samā dra vyavidheyā maṇḍapāḥ śubhāḥ ||32 bhittimāṃ catusrasyātkāryaḥ kāmaṃ sanirgamaḥ| stambhakoṇāśritaṃ mānaṃ bhittiḥ syānmānabāhyataḥ ||33 vedirmaṇḍapabhūṣādyaiḥ syānmadhye bāhyato'pi vā| kṣetralobhe tu kartavyā bhittimānasya madhyataḥ ||34 catuḥṣaṣṭipadaṃ jyeṣṭhe bhadraṃ kuryāccatuṣpadam| ekāśītipadaṃ madhye bhadraṃ syātpañcabhāgikam ||35 satatāgā vibhakte tu khaṇḍaśaḥ syātkanīyasi| karṇā dvibhāgikāḥ kāryā bhittiyuktaśca maṇḍapaḥ ||36 bhadra prāsādasadṛśau karṇabhadraṃ ca bhājayet| kṣobhaṇaṃ bāhyato rakṣet pāḍanaṃ syād viparyaye ||37 kṣarakaṃ kumbhakalāśā kapotaṃ jaṅghayā saha| prāsādasyānurūpeṇa --- ||38 rucakaścaturaśraḥ syādaṣṭāśrirvajra ucyate| dvivajraḥ ṣoḍaśāśriśca pratīto dviguṇastataḥ ||39 madhyapradeśe'yaṃ stambho vṛtto vṛttaḥ prakīrtitaḥ| athānyena prakāreṇa ṣoḍha kurvīta maṇḍapān ||40 tripañcasaptanavabhiścatekṣaṇaiḥ ubhayasamaḥ| sādra madhyakṣaṇo'nyebhyaḥ satryaṃśaḥ sārdha eva vā ||41 evameva prakartavyaḥ ṣaḍprakāre'pi maṇḍape| prāsādagarbhasyāntena syustadbhittirathāpi vā ||42 stambhasūtrasya mārgeṇa kṣaṇe maṇḍapamadhyage| mūlaprāsādagarbheṇa kāryā vā bhadra vistṛtiḥ ||43 śeṣāḥ kṣaṇā vidhātavyā samasaṃkhyākṣatairdharaiḥ| prāsādacchādanāsādbhiḥ satryaṃśāvāpi maṇḍape ||44 sadṛśāṃ sa samañcaśad dvā--- samatale bhavet| ucchrāyaṃ maṇḍape brūmaḥ prakāreṇāpareṇa ca ||45 talārdhaṃ padamadhyeyā --- yasya vihitaḥ śubhaḥ| prāsāde daśadhā bhakte catuḥpañcakare samā ||46 navyaṃśa maṇḍapaṃsyāduttarapaṭṭayordvayoḥ| ṣaḍyuṭsūhastetvaṣṭāṃśaṃ saptabhāge na vāstake ||47 daśaikādaśake ṣaṭsyuḥ sārdhabhāgāsu saṃkhyayā| trayodaśaka --- hastayoḥ sārdhapañcakam ||48 sapādāḥ pañcabhāgāḥ syuścaturdaśa kare punaḥ| tadūrdhvaṃ viṃśatiṃ yāvaducchritiḥ pañcabhāgikī ||49 saṃsṛtā vyatiriktavyā ta yathā vāpi prakalpayet| śukanāsasya yaḥ stambhaḥ stambho yo maṇḍapasya ca ||50 mithaḥ śliṣṭāvapi vyaktau yatra tau saṃśritau hasaḥ| prāsādakoṇastambho ya grastāste grastamaṇḍapā ||51 nirgatā vyatiriktāḥ syuścaturbhadra vibhūṣitāḥ| talapaṭṭāñchaukanāsāvyātale bhūmiraṅgikā ||52 talapaṭṭamadhastasyā maṇḍapānāṃ niyojayet| evaṃ paraṃ paraṃ kuryānnimnānnimnataraṃ budhaḥ ||53 samamevāthavā kuryāt prāsādatalamānataḥ| dhruvādināmnāṃ śrīkūṭaḥ pravṛttānāṃ tathaiva ca ||54 rucakaprabhṛtīnāṃ ca yā saṃjñā yā vibhaktayaḥ| maṇḍapeṣvapi tā jñeyā tatsambandheṣu nānyathā ||55 devālayotsavārthāya vimānāni pṛthakpṛthak| maṇḍapādi samākhyātādūrdhvaṃ syuḥ saptaviṃśateḥ ||56 devayātrānimittāni tathaiva parikalpayet| catuḥṣaṣṭerapyadhikāḥ stambhāḥ syuḥ padasaṃkhyayā ||57 prāsādāṅgāni --- syustatkṣaṇānmaṇḍapena ca| saṃvāstupadaṃ saṃbuddhyā kartavyo viṣamaiḥ kṣaṇaiḥ ||58 na doṣo jāyate tatra śilpīcchate'tra kāraṇam| atha dārukalāṃ brūmaḥ --- maṇḍapasaṃśrayām ||59 yādṛk samatalaṃ tatra vibhāgastādṛgucyate| prāsādasya vibhāgena rājasenaṃ tu bhāgikam ||60 vedī bhāgadvayaṃ jñeyā dvau bhāgau mattavāraṇam| candrā valokanaṃ tadvadvidhātavyaṃ dvibhāgikām ||61 paṭṭo bhavati bhāgārdhamardhabhāgikamāsanam| kūṭastambhaṃ tu bhāgena sapādena prakalpayet ||62 śīrṣakaṃ bharaṇaṃ caiva sapāda bhāgamiṣyate| etatsamatale kāryaṃ viṣamo'pi kvacidbhavet ||63 paṭṭirbhāgikī vidhātavyā prakāreṇāpareṇa ca| adhastādūrdhvapaṭṭasya talapaṭṭasya cordhvataḥ ||64 pade tribhāgamadhye vā kāryā candrā valokane| tadadhastādvidhātavyo vibhāgaḥ pañcabhiḥ padaiḥ ||65 bhāgikaṃ rājasenaṃ syādvedikāpi dvibhāgikī| mattavāraṇakaṃ kāryaṃ bhāgadvitayasaṃmitam ||66 daśabhakte'thavā kāryā caturbhiścandra lokanā| bhāgadvayena vedī ca tatsamaṃ mattavāraṇam ||67 bhāgena rūpahārastu bhāgenaikena kaṇṭhikā| mattavāraṇapātaśca tryaṃśahīnaikabhāgikaḥ ||68 bhāgārdhenāthavā pātastayormadhye ca madhyamaḥ| kūṭāgāreṣvidaṃ mānamidaṃ cāsanapaṭṭake ||69 bhāgadvitayavistāramāsanaṃ parikalpayet| piṇḍo bhāgadvikaṃ tasya tryaṃśonā mattavāraṇā ||70 vedyāṃ piṇḍaḥ sapaṭṭaḥ syātkūṭāgāre tathaiva ca| rājasenasya piṇḍastu kūṭāgārasamo bhavet ||71 kumbhikāpi ca tatpiṇḍā codarūrdhvatayāsanam| vidyātsaśiraḥstambhaḥ kūṭakaṃ --- ||72 rājasenasamā kumbhī jaṅghā vedisamā bhavet| evametattridhā proktaṃ sūrpacchādyamathocyate ||73 adhaḥpaṭṭordhvapaṭṭāntaṃ pañcadhā pravibhājayet| ubhābhyāṃ vā tribhirvāpi bhaje nigatistu sāyate ||74 --- paṭṭasamo'tha trayodaśavibhājite| śūrpabhāgaṃ tyajedūrdhvaṃ ghaṭanā dvādaśāṃśikā ||75 kuryānnipātaṃ śūrpasya pañcabhāgamathāpi vā| daṇḍakairbhūṣayecchūrpaṃ madhye daṇḍaṃ vivarjayet ||76 madhye ca stambhikā vedyā mattavāraṇakasya ca| bhāgena paṭṭapiṇḍastu sapādenāthavā bhavet ||77 pṛthutvaṃ syātsa ṣaḍbhāgapiṇḍatulyaṃ tu paṭṭake| stambhaḥ paṭṭasamaḥ kāryaḥ śīrṣakaṃ triguṇaṃ tataḥ ||78 stambhādapyadhikā kūṭī hīrakādapi paṭṭakaḥ| bāhāpaṭṭavaducchrāyaḥ śukanāsasya paṭṭake ||79 paṭṭapiṇḍocchritā vedī yadvā paṭṭādhikā bhavet| maṇḍape syāttulocchrāyo vibhāgaiḥ pramito'ṣṭabhiḥ ||80 sthalaprāsādatulyo vā pātasya ca sato'pi vā| nimnonnataṃ chādayecca chedikāyogato budhaḥ ||81 kaṇṭhakaśce --- kārthena vidhātavyo vicakṣaṇaiḥ| chedikāyogato madhye stambhāḥ syurbāhyato'dhikāḥ ||82 pañcāśenāṣṭaṣaṣṭhena keśāntātsālabhañjikāḥ| rathikāśālabhañjībhiḥ sthitābhiḥ paṭṭikordhvataḥ ||83 madhye karāṭakaṃ kāryaṃ manojñaṃ vā saroruham| chādayedvāsa---malaṃ vimānairbahubhedavat ||84 kṣaṇāntareṣu racayeddīptikātoraṇāni ca| anyathā vā bhavedvṛttaṃ caturaśro yathā kvacit ||85 gajatāluyutaḥ paṭṭasyordhvamaṣṭāśrireva vā| kurvīta madhye cāṣṭāśribāhyataḥ paṅktayastathā ||86 viśeṣaṃ chādaye brūmaḥ stambhikāsūtradbhāsayet| ṣoḍaśa dvādaśāṣṭau bā---caturocchrāyāḥ ||87 pādānyadūṣaryat śilpībhavekṣaṇavaśāt sadā| trayoviṃśatidhā bhājyamantaraṃ paṭṭaghaṇṭayoḥ ||88 ghaṇṭādūrdhvaṃ padmapatrī sārdhabhāgasamucchritā| ucchritā sārdhabhāgena tadūrdhvaṃ dṛṭṭarī bhavet ||89 kapotā grāsasaṃyuktāḥ sārdhabhāgasamucchritāḥ| kaṇṭhakastu dvibhāgaḥ syādamarastu dvibhāgikā ||90 bhāgadvayaṃ viniṣkrāntaṃ tribhāge gajatāluke| dattābhāgānucchitakosalaṃ bhāgaṃ ca dhālikā bhavet ||91 bhāgadvayaṃ dvitīyaṃ ca tṛtīyaṃ ca dvibhāgikam| tasyopariṣṭātkartavyā valinyārdhabhāgikā ||92 nirgamaḥ sūtramārgeṇa ekaikasya svamānataḥ| --- garbhakoṇaḥ syātpakṣmapatryāśca mastame ||93 vimṛśya sūtradhāro vā nirgamaṃ kalpayet svayam| samairbhāgaiśca patraiśca vikaṭaiḥ padmapatrakaiḥ ||94 hastituṇḍairvarālaiśca śālabhañjībhiraṇḍakaiḥ| bhallikātoraṇaiścaiva bhūṣaṇīyā catuṣkikā ||95 khecarairmālyabandhaiśca nānākarmavitānibhiḥ| mandārakaiḥ śuktibhirvā padmairvā nāgapāśakaiḥ ||96 maṇḍapaṃ chādayetprājño bāhyatastvabhidhīyate| dviguṇā maulikadvārātpādonadviguṇaṃ kvacit ||97 sārdhabhāgamitaṃ yadvā tryaṃśonaṃ dviguṇaṃ kvacit| kvāpi tryaṃśādhikaṃ kāryaṃ caturdvāraṃ maṇḍape ||98 dvāre kāryau pratīhārau bhallikā toraṇāstathā| stambhayośca varālau dvau śālabhañjikayā saha ||99 prāggrīvaṃ bhadra bhadraṃ ca rathikā vedikā bahiḥ| maṇḍape varakasyordhvamadhastācchikharasya ca ||100 bhāgārdhaāṃ chedapaṭṭaḥ syāccheṣaṃ kurvīta saṃvṛti| śikharā tryaṃśayugmena pādona vā kārayet ||101 prāsāde śukanāsaṃ tu santu sambhrame'thavā| maṇḍapasyodayaḥ svasmādadhastādathavā bhavet ||102 vāmanādyā anantāntāḥ prākproktā ye daśopayeḥ| kartavyo madhyatasteṣāmudayaḥ kopi maṇḍape ||103 pravibhajyodayaṃ tredhā ghaṇṭāṃ bhāgena kārayet| tattribhāgena tilakastilakārdhena phaṃsanā ||104 kramaistribhiḥ pañcabhirvā śūrpairnirmāṇamiṣyate| skandhachādyavāsane vāmeṣā savaṇoditā ||105 śobhāṃ bhadre ṣu karṇeṣu yathāyogaṃ prakalpayet| vīthībhiścandra śālābhiḥ siṃhakarṇaiśca śobhanaiḥ ||106 rathikābhirvarālaiśca tilakaiścārudarśanaiḥ| śukanāsairgajaiḥ siṃhairanyairityevamādibhiḥ ||107 karmaprakāraiḥ kartavyā maṇḍape bhūṣaṇakriyā| trividhairathavā kūṭaiḥ saṅghaṭaiḥ kakṣakūṭakaiḥ ||108 tilakairvā tamaṅgairvā khuracchādyaiḥ saghaṭṭakaiḥ| śṛṅgādiiḥ! prabhedaiśca kāryā maṇḍapasaṃvṛtiḥ ||109 śukanāsocchriterūrdhvaṃ na kāryā maṇḍapocchritiḥ| adhastādyatra yā proktā kartavyā sā tvaśaṅkitaiḥ ||110 valabhyāṃ śukanāsāntā kartavyā maṇḍapocchritiḥ| maṇḍapaḥ śukanāsāntaṃ yogrāsakulam ||111 na ca tatpuramadhye tu yatra sā maṇḍapocchritiḥ| sa putrayastabandhavatasya tayaḥ kartakārakai ||112 hīnādhikapramāṇeṣu dūviṣṭheṣu vāstuṣu| dra vyairvādhikapramāṇeṣu syuranarthāḥ pade pade| ṛddhiḥ purasya na bhavetsyātpurādhipaterbhayam ||113 kḷptairevaṃ maṇḍapaiḥ supramāṇairlakṣmopetaiḥ sadvidhānena kartuḥ| ṛddhiḥ siddhiḥ kārakasyāpi loke kṣemaṃ ca syādbhūmibharturjayaśca ||114 iti mahārājādhirājaparameśvaraśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhāranāmni vāstuśāstre saptaviṃśatimaṇḍapādhyāyo nāma saptaṣaṣṭitamaḥ| <68> atha jagatyaṅgasamudāyādhikāro nāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ| tridaśāgārabhūtyarthaṃ bhūṣāhetoḥ purasya tu| bhuktaye muktaye puṃsāṃ sarvakālaṃ ca śāntaye ||1 nivāsahetordevānāṃ caturvargasya siddhaye| manasvināṃ ca kīrtyāyuryaśassamprāptaye nṛṇām ||2 jagatīnāmatha brūmo lakṣaṇaṃ vistarādiha| prāsādaṃ liṅgamityāhustrigallayanādyataḥ ||3 tatastadādhāratayā jagatī pīṭhikā matā| ākāravistṛtāyāmānucchrāyaṃ te kriyā ||4 vinā tamaṅgapratyaṅgā kalpanā nāpi --- kramam| vibhaktiṃ tilakandānāṃ bhadra vistāranirgamam ||5 jalādhārapradośca praveśaṃ nirgamodgamam| mānasaṃkhyāṃ ca śālānāṃ saṃsthānonmānalakṣaṇam ||6 parikramaṃ tamevāsāṃ saṃjñāṃ ca trividhāmapi| ṣaṭprakāratvame vāsāṃ sambhavasya ca kāraṇam ||7 mūlaśālāparicchittiṃ parikramavinirgamam| sañcayadvārasopānamuṇḍikāmaṇḍasambhavān ||8 dvitryādidevatādhiṣṇyājjagatīstoraṇāni ca| yuktāni lakṣaṇaiḥ sarvairyathāvatsampracakṣmahe ||9 caturaśrā samā śastā manojñā sarvataḥplavā| aṃśapragūḍhadigbhāgā prāsādānugatā śubhā ||10 caturaśrāyatā yadvā vṛttā vṛttāyatā tathā| aṣṭāśrirvā vidhātavyā sā saṃśodhyāditaḥ kṣitim ||11 nirūpya tridaśāgāraṃ saṃsthānonmānalakṣaṇaiḥ| tadākāravatīṃ pārśve jagatīṃ tasya yojayet ||12 kanīyasī madhyamā ca jyeṣṭhā ceti tridhaiva sā| kanīyaḥ prabhṛtiṣvetāḥ prāsādeṣu niyojayet ||13 jagatyo bhraramaṇībhiḥ sphāraukadvitristribhiḥ kramāt| nānāśātiśāntinyakaniṣṭhādyā manoramāḥ ||14 prāsādasyānurūpeṇa sāṅgopāṅgādisaṃkhyayā| śālāstāsāṃ matāḥ karma procyate sāmudāyikam ||15 śrī ā dvādaśakarādūrdhvamordhvā viṃśatihastataḥ| śālātribhāgaṃ turyāṃśaḥ syādvā dvātriṃśataḥ punaḥ ||16 āsanārdhāttu pañcāśacchālā prāsādato bhavet| bahudevakulā yā tu prāsādasyānusārataḥ ||17 brūmaḥ prakārāñśālānāṃ yathāyogamihādhunā| karṇodbhavā bhramocchā ca bhadra jā garbhasambhavā ||18 madhyajā pārśvajā ceti bhedāstāsāṃ bhavanti ṣaṭ| vistārāyāmatosyabhiḥ karṇajā pūrvamāriṇā ||19 bhramajā tatpramāṇena --- pādena veṣṭitā| bhadra jā karṇajātīyā sārdhāyāmā prakīrtitā ||20 garbhajā madhyajā ceti karṇajāyatasammite| pārśvajā bhramajāyāmā sthānaṃ tāsāmathocyate ||21 karṇeṣu karṇajā khyātā bhramajā ca paribhrame| bhadre ṣu bhadra jā jñeyā trayamadhye ca garbhajā ||22 madhye vyavasthitā yā tu pañcānāṃ madhyajā tu sā| pārśvasaṃsthānaścatasro yāstāsāṃ śāntāḥ pārśvadvaye smṛtāḥ ||23 pārśvadvayaṃ syuḥ karṇānāṃ --- stā api ca pārśvajāḥ| prāsādavistṛterardhaṃ vidhātavyā bhramantikā ||24 padavṛddhatibāhyasyāḥ kandā dikṣu --- ca| surasadmānusāreṇa kuryādaṣṭau vicakṣaṇaḥ ||25 ārabhya bhadra mālatyā yuāvattriṃśamatrikām| navāṇḍakāyā yāvatsyādekatriṃśattame kramāt ||26 śālākandāḥ smṛtāstāsāṃ caturvargavibhājitāḥ| catuṣpadā tatra sāsyā syāddvādaśapado bhramaḥ ||27 krameṇānena kartavyaṃ śālākandaniveśataḥ| tadūrdhvaṃ tu bhramo nāsti śālāgaṇavibhājane ||28 rudrā d bhramo'yaṃ na punaḥ karṇanirgamadhāriṇām| rucakasyeva kartavyaḥ karṇadeśātparikramaḥ ||29 śālānusārato bhadre vistāraiḥ kandakādbahiḥ| kartavyo nirgamastatra budhaiḥ padacatuṣṭayam ||30 udakāntaravistāro bhāgenārdhena vā kvacit| prajāṅgasya vidhātavyaṃ kṣobhaṇaṃ ca padadvayam ||31 prāsādasya ca vistāraṃ dattvāgre salilāntaram| gaṇḍau tatsūtragau kāryau bhramāddvipadanirgatau ||32 prāsādānāṃ tu vistṛtyā syurekadvitrinighnayā| karṇādvinissṛtau gaṇḍau jyeṣṭhamadhyakanīyasā ||33 bhavagre suṇḍikāḥ kāryāḥ karṇaśālāvinirgamaḥ| mālāsopānasaṃyutta pratīhārasamākulāḥ ||34 pratolī cāgrataḥ kāryā sapaṭo --rgalā dṛḍhā| brūmo'tha jagatīpīṭhaṃ tatkuryādekahastake ||35 prāsāde vistṛtestulyasamutsedhe vicakṣaṇaḥ| dvihastake tu pādonaṃ tryaṃśahīnaṃ trihastakam ||36 caturhaste tu kartavye sārdhahastadvayocchritam| caturiṣṭā trayā ca --- dvādaśahastakam ||37 kanīyomadhyamajyeṣṭhānudayān kalpayet kramāt| ardhaṃ vā karṇaśālāyāḥ pādonaṃ vātha tatsamam ||38 anena ca prakāreṇa jyeṣṭhamadhyamayorapi| prāsādayorjagatyuccā karṇaprāsādamānataḥ ||39 pīṭhasya yaḥ samutsedhā --- taṃ vibhājayet| bhāgena khurakaṃ kuryādbhāgenaikena vartmanā ||40 kumbhasya khurakā bhāgaṃ dvibhāgaṃ kumbhakaṃ tathā| kalaśaṃ bhāgikotsedhaṃ tathaivāntarapatrakam ||41 varaṇḍīṃ bhāgikīṃ kuryāttathā paṭṭaṃ ca bhāgikam| jagatyāḥ khurakādbhāgaṃ praciśokodbhakaḥ suraḥ ||42 paṭṭo bhāgena sārdhena pratiṣṭhājagatīkhurān| khurakārakumbhakākiñcitkumbhakā kṣaṇakastathā ||43 kaṇakādanterapatra kapotālīṃ tathaiva ca| paṭṭikānāṃ praveśāṃśca nāsikāvartanāstathā ||44 nimnonnatapraveśāṃśca vidadhīta manoharān| --- dhikābhirvicitrābhiḥ kūṭaiścānekaśekharaiḥ ||45 suvibhaktā vidhātavyāḥ śālānāṃ kandakāmūle| karmāṇyativicitrāṇi sthānasthānocitāni tu ||46 kuryātpīṭheṣu śobhārthaṃ prāsādānāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ| yathā siṃhāsanaṃ rājñāṃ śobhate maṇidīptibhiḥ ||47 tathā prāsādarājasya pīṭhaṃ karmabhiruttamaiḥ| paṭṭasyordhvaṃ vidhātavyamutkṛṣṭaṃ rājasenakam ||48 puṣpitaiḥ kamalairyuktaṃ śobhitaṃ bhāraputrakaiḥ| tadardhaṃ vedikā deyā nānāpatrasamākulā ||49 rūpaṃ saṃghaṭakopetā tataścāsamaghaṭṭakaḥ| stambhikābhiranekābhirdhārayettaṃ samanvitaḥ ||50 tasyopari vidhātavyaṃ karavyāsanasamuttamam| antaraṃ karṇaśālānāṃ talapādārdhapaṭṭayoḥ ||51 rājasenayutāṃ vedīṃ tattribhāgena kārayet| vedikārdhaṃ tribhāgaṃ vā tale syādrā jasenakam ||52 kūṭāraṃ --- tribhāgena vederūrdhvaṃ manoharam| karamātrasamutsedhaṃ kartavyaṃ mattavāraṇam ||53 sukhalīlāśanārthaṃ tatsapraveśaṃ sanirgamam| gandrā gre sukāgre ca pratolyagre tathaiva ca| toraṇaṃ trividhaṃ jñeyaṃ kanīyomadhyamottamam ||54 itthaṃ jagatyāyatanasya samyak| prāsādapīṭhasya ca sampradiṣṭam| vidhānametajjagatīṣu nārta- manyathābhidadhāḥ saha lakṣaṇānām ||55 iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhāranāmni vāstuśāstre jagatyaṅgasamudāyādhikāro nāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ| <69> atha jagatīlakṣaṇaṃ nāmaikonasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ| vasudhā vasudhārā ca vahantī ca tathāpare| śrīdharā bhadri kā caiva ekabhadrā dvibhadri kā ||1 tribhadri kā bhadra mālā vaimānī bhramarāvalī| svastikā haramālā ca kulaśīlā mahīdharī ||2 mandāramālikānaṅgalekhāthotsavamālikā| nāgārāmā mārabhavyā tathā ca makaradhvajā ||3 nandyāvartā ca bhūpālā pārijātakamañjarī| cūḍāmaṇiprabhā caiva tathā śravaṇamañjarī ||4 viśvarūpādikamalā tathā trailokyasundarī| gandharvabālikā cānyā vidyādharakumārikā ||5 subhadrā ca samākhyātā tathānyā siṃhapañjarā| vajjapakuravādyāḥ gandharvanagarī tathā ||6 tathāmarāvatī jñeyā ratnadhūmā ca nāmataḥ| tridaśendra sabhā caiva tathānyā devayantrikā ||7 catvāriṃśaddvitīyaṃ syādekonā nāmasaṃkhyayā| yamalāmbaradharā netrā dadyuḍāḥ khaṇḍilā sitā ||8 athātaḥ kathyate tāsāṃ pravibhāgo yathā yathā| jagatīnāṃ krameṇaiva śālānāṃ ca yathoditaḥ ||9 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre ṣaḍete sa vibhājite| samaṃ vā cārdhayukte vā guṇo'tha mukhāyatām ||10 maṇḍapenojjhite kuryājjagatīmanusārataḥ| dvau bhāgau madhyadeśe syātprāsādo bhāgiko bhramaḥ ||11 karṇādṛśāṃ samujya pārśvayorubhayoḥ puraḥ| śrīkhaṇḍikā vidhātavyāḥ prāsādamaṃ --- mimām ||12 mattavāraṇasaṃyuktā pratolyādivibhūṣitā| prathame ca samākhyātā jagatī vasudhābhidhā ||13 vasudhā vasudhārā syātsamāyuktāgraśālayā| nirgamaḥ purataḥ kāryaḥ prāsādasya pramāṇataḥ ||14 --- vistārastathā kāryastaṃ caturdhā vibhājayet| bhāgikā śramaṇī kāryā śeṣaśālā dvibhāgikā ||15 suṇḍikā cāpi pūrvoktamānenaivāyatā bhavet| vasudhā ca punaḥ karṇaśālābhyāṃ rājasiṃhikā ||16 prāsādārdhena te kāryaṃ karṇayorubhayorapi| svamānārdhena ca tayorbhramaṇīṃ parikalpayet ||17 mūlaprāsādavistārā kartavyā suṇḍikā purā| śālā syādvasudhā rājahaṃsāḥ puro yadā ||18 śrīdharī sā tadā tasyāḥ suroyadyandra pūrvavat | yadā tu haṃsikāsthāne śāle sto'parakarṇayoḥ ||19 tadrū pe tatpramāṇe ca tadā sā bhadri kā bhavet| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre ṣoḍaśāṃśavibhājite ||20 pūrvoktakramasampanne yathākāmaṃ mukhāyate| maṇḍapāyāmasaṃyogādyathābhāgaṃ vibhājite ||21 madhye devālayaḥ kāryaścaturvargapadānvitaḥ| bahirdvipadavistāro bhramastasya samantataḥ ||22 karṇe karṇe ca kartavyā dvipadāyāmavistṛtā| caturdiśaṃ karṇaśālā yā padibhramaṇānvitā ||23 padadvitayavistārā tripadāyāmasaṃyutā| padikā ca bhramaṇā kāryā bhadra śālāśca sundarāḥ ||24 vāryantarāṇi paritaḥ kuryānmadhyeṣu śālayoḥ| padamekaṃ praviṣṭāni tadardhaṃ vistṛtāni ca ||25 śālāyāḥ pṛṣṭhabhadre syādekabhadra dvibhadri kā| kapokṛtābhyāṃ tribhadrā ṇi pṛṣṭhakukṣiṣu ||26 śālābhiḥ syāścātha tisṛbhirjagatī bhadra mālinī| ekabhadrā dicatuṣṭayam || caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre caturviṃśatibhājite ||27 ṣaḍvargalakṣaṇopeto madhye kāryaḥ surālayaḥ| devālayaparitastripadaḥ syātparibhramaḥ ||28 tataḥ śālāvibhaktiśca kartavyā proktalakṣaṇā| pañcabhāgāyatā madhye bhūcatuvistṛtā padaiḥ ||29 bhadra śālāśca kartavyāstanmadhye bhāgikabhramaḥ| bhadra sya pārśvadvitaye dvipadāyāmavistṛtam ||30 śālādvayaṃ vidhātavyaṃ dvādaśī śata --- bhramam| bhāgamekaṃ praveśastu tayoḥ karṇadvayorbhavet ||31 tisrastisro bhavatyevaṃ śālādikṣu tisṛṣvapi| ṣaḍevodakamārgāśca kāryā bhāgārdhanissṛtāḥ ||32 bhāgamekaṃ praviṣṭāśca bhaveyurdiktraye'pi te| karṇau ca purataḥ kāryau bhāgadvitayasammitau ||33 sasuṇḍikā vimāno'yaṃ surāsuranarārcitā| suṇḍikāgre yadetasyāṃ śālāprāsādasaṃmukham ||34 saṃstutā kinnaraiḥ siddhaistadā syādbhramarāvaliḥ| vaktraśālāvihīnā tu pārśvaśālādvayānvitā ||35 tadrū pā tatpramāṇā yā svastikī sā prakīrtitā| prāsādābhimukhī śālā svastikyāmeva cedbhavet ||36 tadānīṃ haṃsamālati vikhyātā jagatī bhuvi| mukhyasya pārśvadvitaye bhāgaṃ vāryantaraṃ yadā ||37 kṛtvā prāsādayadrugre bhadra mānena nirgamam| prāsādasaṃmitaṃ sūtraṃ śālāstu galabhūṣitāḥ ||38 śuṇḍikā tadavasthe ca mukhe syācchālayā vinā| kulaśailā tadā jñeyā haṃsamālāgamāśrayā ||39 sadā maheśvarasyeṣṭā skandasya tu viśeṣataḥ| asyā eva yadā śālā purobhadre vidhīyate ||40 tadā mahīdharī proktā mahīdharamanaḥpriyā| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre sāṣṭāviṃśatibhājite ||41 catuḥṣaṣṭipadaṃ madhye kuryāddevālayaṃ budhaḥ| catuṣpado bhramaḥ kāryo devāgārasya sarvataḥ ||42 bhramasūtrasya karṇasthā dvipadāyatavistṛtāḥ| śālāścatustasraḥ kartavyā bhāgikabhramaveṣṭitāḥ ||43 tāsāṃ pārśveṣu santyajya bhramādbhāgacatuṣṭayam| śālāṃ kaṃ --- prakurvīta --- bhāgāyatavistṛtam ||44 ekabhāgikavistāraḥ karṇaḥ syātpārśvaśālayoḥ| madhye bhāge jalādhvā syādvihāya tridaśaṃ vahiḥ ||45 dvibhāgavistṛtāṃ tāṃ ca kuryādbhāgatrayāyatām| antareṇa jalādhvā syādbhadra pārśvajalālayoḥ ||46 sa ca bhāgārdhamāyāmāt praviṣṭastāvadeva ca| kṛtvā tisṛṣu dikṣvevaṃ suṇḍikākandamadhyataḥ ||47 prāsādārdhasamāyāmau samyaktuṇḍau niveśayet| tayorapi ca śāle dve bhramakramavibhūṣite ||48 kārye mandāraśālā syādevaṃ haramanaḥpriyā| suṇḍikāyāṃ yadā tasyāḥ śālā sampadyate tadā ||49 anaṅgalekhā bhavati jagatī pārvatīpriyā| yatrāsminneva vinyāse mukhaśāle vinā kṛte ||50 śuṇḍikāgaṇḍa---nyau śālā sopānamālikāḥ| mukhaśālānvitā saiva yadā nāgāṅganā tadā ||51 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre dvātriṃśadbhāgavibhājite| catuḥṣaṣṭipadaṃ madhye kartavyaṃ suramandiram ||52 kāryastasya bhramaḥ samyaksamantācca catuṣpadaḥ| bhramantī dvipadāyāme śāle tu bhramasaṃyutau ||53 svapramāṇādvidhātavye madhyage bhadra karṇayoḥ| syuḥ ṣoḍaśapadraḥ kandāsteṣu śālāścatuṣpadāḥ ||54 caturṣvapi ca karṇeṣu praviṣṭā bhramajāḥ padam| kartavyaṃ dvipadāyāmaṃ bhadra śālāyugaṃ tathā ||55 vistārāt pra --- pādonamanyonyābhimikhaṃ bhavet| āyatād dvyaṃśavistārā padenaikena veṣṭitā ||56 bhadra śālā vidhātavyā sārdhatripadanirgamā| saumyānilīvāruṇīṣu nairṛtīyāmyayorapi ||57 śālāstisraḥ pratidiśamaśālāgneyyāyadinā muravidviṣaḥ| asyā eva mukhe śālā yadi tanmakaradhvajā ||58 amarāṇāṃ kṛtānandā kṛtvaināṃ mokṣamāpnuyāt| mukhaśālāṃ parityajya yadaikaikāgrakarṇayoḥ ||59 śālā pradīyate sā syānnandyāvartayatyaharpateḥ| vikarṇakandadhorāgre yadāsyāḥ pṛṣṭhavaṃśagā ||60 dvibhāgāyāmavistārā śālā bhavati śobhanā| caturṣsaṃsthitā śālā śālāyāḥ saṃmukhī bhavet ||61 tāmramūlā tadā jñeyāḥ brahmaviṣṇuharipriyā| yadāsyāḥ pṛṣṭhavaṃśasthā hastāyāmyottarāttathā ||62 śāle kriyete tadā jñeyā pārijātakamañjarī| vāraṇīcatuṣṭaḥsthitā śālāyāḥ sammukhī bhavet ||63 tāmrayāmyāsaumyāsu śālāḥ syuryadi vaṃśagāḥ| priyā syātsarvadevānāṃ tadā cūḍāmaṇiḥ prabhoḥ ||64 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre caturaśraḥ samantataḥ| daśāṃśaḥ syādubhāyāntā madhye prāsādanāyakaḥ ||65 ---purataścaivaṃ pārśvayorubhayorapi| bhramāstasyā vidhātavyāḥ --- pañcabhiḥ padaiḥ ||66 karṇakandāśca kartavyā bhramasūtrādbahiḥ sthitāḥ| dvibhāgāyāmavistārāścatuḥśālopaśobhitāḥ ||67 amunaiva krameṇa syurbhadra kandāḥ padādhikāḥ| mūlaprāsādamālāyāṃ mālātritayadhāriṇām ||68 karṇe karṇe tu yāḥ śālāstā dvyaṃśāyāmavistṛtāḥ| dvibhāgikajalādhārāstathā bhāgaparibhramāḥ ||69 padapraviṣṭāmbupadā bhramapaddhatisaṃyutāḥ| tulyāścaturṣu karṇeṣu tulyā bhadra traye'pi ca ||70 bhāgadvitayavistīrṇā bhāgatritayamāyatāḥ| sṛga bhramāśca kartavyā bhramaśālādiśāntayoḥ ||71 śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavatkāryaṃ śuṇḍikāgaṇḍamaṇḍanam| syātkarṇamañjarītyeṣā trilokyānandadāyinī ||72 karṇamañjarikābhadre vibhakte daśabhiḥ padaiḥ| dvibhāgāyāmavistārāṃ turyāṃ śālāṃ niveśayet ||73 udaka kṣaṇapūrvāṇi mukhānyāsāṃ prakalpayet| parikramastristu sarvāsāṃ bhāgaikaḥ sarvato bhavet ||74 dvau bhāgau bhadra karṇābhyāṃ saṃkṣepobhyābhayapārśvayo| bhāgikobhayavistārā bhadre 'nyā karṇikā bhavet ||75 padaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiryuktā vicitrabhramavibhramaṃ| bhadrā syā ca catuṣkī syātpurataḥ saṃvṛtāntaraḥ ||76 śrīmaṇḍapaṃ prakurvīta prabhūtastambhamaṇḍitam| ditāmetānena parikṣiptaṃ chādyakāle hasaṃyuta ||77 eśvāsyādviśvarūpe ca kasyāyāstu puraskarā| catuṣkikābhistisṛbhirbhavettrailokyasundarī ||78 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre bhakte dvādaśabhiḥ padaiḥ| tribhāgāyāmavistārā madhye śālā caturmukhī ||79 sarvataḥ sārdhabhāgāśca kartavyā padapaddhatiḥ| tasyāḥ prāgudaka --- śālācatuṣṭayam ||80 dvibhāgāyāmavistāraṃ vidhātavyaṃ suśobhanam| bhāgikālindakenaitatsyātprākse --- na veṣṭitam ||81 kakṣyāsthābhirdvibhāgābhiḥ karṇikābhiralaṅkṛtam| evaitat karṇamañjaryāḥ karṇe --- vidhīyate ||82 jagatī syācchivasyeṣṭā tadā gandharvamālikā| iyave vāpare bhāge caturthyā śālayānvitaṃ ||83 vijñeyā jagatī nāmnā vidyādharakumārikā| aparasyāṃ caturthīṃ tu hitvā śālāṃ vinīyate ||84 te dve --- kudyo kurvīta subhadrāṃ tridaśapriyām| catasṛṣu bhadre ṣu pratyekaṃ mpañca karṇigā ||85 śālāḥ syuryadiścandrā ṣṭā tadā syātsiṃhapañjarā| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre caturdaśavibhājite ||86 tribhāgāyāmavistīrṇaṃ madhye devakulaṃ bhavet| bhāgenaikena kartavyo bhramo dikṣu tisṛṣvatha ||87 prāsādāyāmavistīrṇe tasyāgre mukhamaṇḍapaḥ| bhadra sya pārśvadvitaye bāhyato bhadra vistṛtam ||88 śālāyugmaṃ vidhātavyaṃ tripadāyāmavistṛti| bhāgikabhadra māṇopetaṃ yadikācca payāsvita ||89 dvibhāgāyāmavistāre bhāgikabhramaṇānvite| śāle dve purataḥ kārye sāmmukhyācca parasparam ||90 pañcasvalaṃ bhavedevaṃ pṛṣṭhabhadraṃ yadā śubham| yāmyottare catuḥśāle bhadra dvayapañcakañjarā ||91 pṛṣṭhabhadraṃ yadaitasyā--- nmadhyaśālayā| kakṣābhadre tathā syāyute gandharvanagarī tadā ||92 pañca trīṇyeva bhadrā ṇi pañcaśālānvitāni ca| śiśutatṣaṭtriṃśattamā jñeyā sā jagatyamarāvatī ||93 śuṇḍikāgre yadaitasyāḥ śālā sampadyate kvacit| tadā syāddantacūḍeti jagatī jagataḥ priyā ||94 iyani śuṇḍikāśālā gaṇḍaśālādvayānvitāḥ| tridaśendra sabhā jñeyā sasuṇḍī devayantrikā ||95 iti caturastrāṇāṃ kīrtyateṣāyatāḥ kāsānakāmā| saptabhāgāyate kṣetre bhāgapañcakavistṛte ||96 dvibhāgāyatavistāre staḥ śāle vāmadakṣiṇe| catuṣkikaikabhāgena tayorevāgrato bhavet ||97 bhramaśca bhāgiko madhye samantācca vidhīyate| pratolyā bhūṣitā khaṇḍaśuṇḍikābhiralaṅkṛtā ||98 mattavāraṇaśobhāḍhyā yamālekhā prakīrtitā| yadā syātpṛṣṭhataḥ kando bhāgatritayavistṛtaḥ ||99 bhāgatritayaniṣkrāmaścaturdhā bhājitaḥ punaḥ| dvibhāgāyāmavistārā śālā bhāgadvayaṃ bhramaḥ ||100 tadā payodharā netrā śālābhyāmagrapṛṣṭhayoḥ| netrādyāścetyaraśālāsyātāṃ tu kāyā ||101 paurastyayorubhayoḥ sāmnamūtkando bhāganirgataḥ| bhāgamantaḥ praviṣṭaśca vibhājyaḥ so'pi pūrvavat ||102 śālayoḥ syāṃtamomānabhramayorapi pūrvavat| pārśvayorbhrāmaṇyaṃ cāgau dve ca cenmūlaśālāyāḥ ||103 śeṣaṃ tu pūrvavatsarvadordaṇḍā prāsādāḥ prakīrtitāḥ| dordaṇḍayostu pārśve'pi śālāsuśliṣṭakarṇayoḥ ||104 rākṣasānilayoḥ śāle kuryādākhaṇḍalā bhavet| akhaṇḍālāyāstu yadā paścācchālā vidhīyate ||105 payo yaṃ sarayoni iva vacchideti jagatī bhavet| śivāyaṃ vāruṇī yadvā śālātrayavibhūṣitā ||106 śuṇḍikārālaya macenmāhendrī vaṃpakā tadā| kokaiṇeṣu yamelāyāsādyadā śālācatuṣṭaya ||107 bhadra trayo'pi tisrastāḥ pūrvabhadra mamālakam| ye karṇa va---kandāḥ syuḥ sārdhadvyaṃśavinirgataḥ ||108 caturbhisteṣu bhakteṣu śālā bhāgadvayaṃ bhavet| bhāgaṃ bhāgaṃ bhramaṇyaḥ syuḥ karṇaśālā imā bahiḥ ||109 triniṣkrāntā sṛvistīrṇā bhadra kandāsthite bahiḥ| caturbhittyeṣutaiḥ śālā syurārdho bhramastathā ||110 padārdhasaṃmitaḥ kuṣṭau jalamārgo vidhīyate| pṛṣṭhasādhosikāstasyā dvai kulāmodikāṣṭamā ||111 bhāgārdhayalamālā--dvitayaśālinā| pṛṣṭhabhadre ṇa jagatītilakāle kecistutā ||112 etasyāṃ śuṇḍikāyāṃ syācchālā cenmukhabhūṣaṇam| asau --- pallavā nāma jagatī jāyate tadā ||113 tilakā gaṇḍakaṇḍeṣu śāle dve bhavato yadā| tedā siddhārthasaṃmukhāṃ tadā vidyādharī bhavet ||114 trivistṛtaṃ dviniṣkrāntaṃ pṛṣṭhaśālātalaṃ yadi| vidyādharyāḥ pṛṣṭhabhadre tadā yakṣaṃ vinirdiśet ||115 ṣaḍbhāgavistṛte kṣetre daśabhāgakṛtāyate| dvibhāgāyāmavistāraṃ kuryācchālātrayaṃ budhaḥ ||116 tadagre tatsamaṃ kuryānmaṇḍapā adhivādhikāt| yathākāmaṃ prakurvīta karmaśobhāvibhūtaye ||117 ---bhāgaṃ bhramaṃ kuryāttāsāṃ pārśvacatuṣṭaye| viśeṣakaraṇāyaṃca śālānāṃ madhyamairapi ||118 mattavāraṇasaṃyuktāḥ
