suṇḍikāgaṇḍamaṇḍitāḥ| iyaṃ trikūṭā jagatī khyātā tṛpuṣapūryā ||119 trikūṭā pūrvavaṃśasthā tribhāgāyāmavistṛtā| vidadhyātsavamāṃ śālāṃ prāgvatsyāccitrakūṭikā ||120 yathā pṛṣṭhe tathāgre'pi yadi śālā vidhīyate| tadā saranikūṭīti vijñeyā jagatī budhaiḥ ||121 yuktā prāṇāsya lābhyāmagraśālāvivarjitā| upamevājottamā sā jagatī viśrutā bhuvi ||122 nairṛtānalavāyvīśakarṇaprāsādakairyutā| trikūṭairbhavennandai vibhaktaṣaḍalā yathā ||123 citrakūṭā kramānaryāṃ dvibhajanaṃ pūrvivikūṭavad vicakṣaṇaḥ| trikūṭāyāmato rūpe siddhidvyāyāmavistṛtam ||124 karṇe karṇe kṛtaṃ kandaṃ caturdhā pravibhājayet| bhāgadvayena śālā syādbhāgena bhramaṇaṃ tathā ||125 mūlatārdhavistāraṃ bhavatacceha mānataḥ| yāmyottare caturbhāgavistāra bhāgaṃ nirgatām ||126 --- bhadraṃ bhāgikadvayānvitam| śeṣaṃ tu bhramaṇaṃ tatra madhyapārśveṣu kārayet ||127 evamagre'pi śāle dve dvārasyobhayapārśvayoḥ| kartavye bhāganiṣkrānte bhāgikāyāmavistṛtī ||128 pṛṣṭhabhadraṃ ca kartavyaṃ sārdhāṃśadvayavistṛtam| dvibhāganirgamaṃ yuktaṃ śālayā sārdhabhāgayā ||129 yāmyottareṇa cāsyaiva kāryaṃ śālādvayaṃ tataḥ| pramāṇe pasannakārye bhāge praveśanam ||130 śeṣo bhramaḥ syācchālānāṃ saptānāṃ madhyagastataḥ| syācchaivī śrayaṇī tveṣā sarvāmaragaṇapriyā ||131 asyā eva mukhe śālā yadā sañjāyate tadā| trivikrameti vikhyātā jagatī jāyate śubhā ||132 yadā sārdhaviniṣkrānte sārdhāṃśadvayavistṛte| pārśvabhadra dvaye śāle bhavetāṃ bhāgavistṛte ||133 --- sādhabhāgikaṃ bhramaṇānvite| lipyate cāpi mā śālā kramāyātā tadā bhavet ||134 śālāyāḥ śuṇḍikāgre tu tripathā saiva jāyate| caturyāto proktā kathyante vṛttajātayaḥ ||135 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre caturbhāgavibhājite| madhye devagṛhaṃ vṛttaṃ sārdhāṃśāyāmavistṛti ||136 bhramayejjagatīvṛttaṃ samagāṃ bhāgikaṃ tataḥ| pūrvoktavidhinā kāryaṃ pārśvato mattavāraṇam ||137 gopuradvāraśobhāḍhyā jagatī valayā bhavet| valayāpṛṣṭhataḥ kandaṃ mūlaśālāsamāyatam ||138 pūrvoktavidhinā bhaktāṃ śālāṃ kuryāttadardhataḥ| kalaśeyaṃ samākhyātā jagatī kalaśākṛtiḥ ||139 karṇasthaṃ dvipadāyāmaṃ karṇaśālācatuṣṭayam| caturaśraṃ bhavedyatra śātārmye--- bhidhīyate ||140 saptabhāgāyate kṣetre caturaśre samantataḥ| bhāgāṃstrīnvarjayedagre caturaḥ pṛvyantaraścatān ||141 sārdhāṃstrīnpārśvayorbhāgāṃstyaktvā garbhatatokayet| dvibhāgāyāmavistāraṃ vṛttaṃ syāddevamandiram ||142 bhāgamekaṃ bhramastasya vidhātavyaḥ samantataḥ| bhramaṇyāḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ kando bhāgāyāmavibhūṣitaḥ ||143 tasyārdhena bhavecchālā tadardhena parikramaḥ| garbhādbhāgadvayasyānta īśānānalayordiśoḥ ||144 dvibhāgau bhavataḥ kandāvardhabhāgapraveśitau| pṛṣṭhaśālordhvage tiryaksūtreṇa datte bhramāntike ||145 karṇikādvitayaṃ kāryaṃ rākṣasānilayordiśoḥ| vyayaśālāṃ ca kurvīta pṛṣṭhaśālāsamāṃ tataḥ ||146 prākpaścāt kandagarbhasthā sūtradvitayayogataḥ| kurvīta karṇikāṃ tīkṣṇāṃ pārśvayorubhayorapi ||147 śeṣā bha pūrvavat sarvā śuṇḍikādikriyā bhavet| yadāgabhī karavīreyamīśāditridaśapriyā ||148 etasyā eva pṛṣṭhasthā yadā santyaṣṭa karṇikāḥ| vāmaśāle vidhīyete nalinīti tadā bhavet ||149 dattaṃśasya sālikhyāttadyau dṛśabhiḥ padaiḥ| sūtrāṇi pātayettasya tato dikṣu vidikṣu ca ||150 prāsādabhramaṇasyānte dvipadāyāmavistṛtīn| kurvītāṣṭasu sampāteṣvaṣṭau kandān samantataḥ ||151 vidhāya tāṃ caturbhaktāṃ kuryād jrāmāṃstathā| antareṇa ca kandānāṃ kartavyaṃ karṇikāṣṭākam ||152 deśātsārdhaṃ yadā sūtre yathā sampatsyate mithaḥ| pārśvadvayāt karṇikānāṃ saṃsthānaṃ syāttathāvidham ||153 bhaktvaivaṃ sarvabhadrā ṇi tripado'ntaḥ surālayaḥ| pārśvabhramo vyardhapādo daśadhā bhājite bhavet ||154 kandāśca dvipadāḥ kāryā bahirdikṣu vidikṣu ca| anyonyābhimukhāsteṣu śālāḥ kāryā yathoditāḥ ||155 śaktiyastā samīkṣate viṣṇorapratimaujasaḥ| kāryeyaṃ tasya tānyesyuḥ puṇḍarīkavināmataḥ ||156 etasyāḥ karṇikāsthāne yadā vṛttaṃ prakalpyate| tadānīmātapatraṃ syātkartavyā brahmaṇaśca sā ||157 kṛtvā vṛttāyataṃ kṣetraṃ vibhajeddaśabhiḥ padaiḥ| tasya madhye vidhātavyaṃ devāgāraṃ padaistribhiḥ ||158 tasya pārśveṣu kartavyo bhramaḥ sārdhadvibhāgikaḥ| dvibhāgaṃ bāhyavṛttaṃ syāttatra kuryādimāṃ kriyām ||159 bhāgairdvādaśabhistacca tulyamānairvibhājayet| ekaikaṃ ca punarbhāgaṃ caturdhā teṣu bhājayet ||160 dvibhāgāyāmavistārā śālā madhye vidhīyate| bhāgikaścaturaśraśca dichā lānṛtritaye bhramaḥ ||161 vāmadakṣiṇataḥ śāle tāṃ ye bhavataḥ śubhe| te vṛtte saṃvidhātavye saṃmukhe ca parasparam ||162 śālā tu khumāgaṃsyācchālārdhabhāgārdhavistṛtaḥ| kalpyastenaiva mānena saccāvā bhramaṇaṃ bhavet ||163 jagatyeṣāṃ samākhyātā cakravāleti nāmataḥ| divākarāya kartavyā sagrahāyāthavendave ||164 samakṣavāyabhadrā yāmātriṣuktāyaṃ vā puna| caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre daśabhāgavibhājite ||165 garbhāṭkoṇagasūtreṇa sarvato vṛttamālikhet| bahistripadavistāraṃ kandaṃ kuryāccatuṣpadam ||166 śālāyāṃ ca dvipadāyāmāṃ vistārātsārdhabhāgikām | śeṣaṃ tu bhadra śālāyāḥ samantād bhramaṇaṃ bhavet ||167 bhadra syobhayato vṛtte dvibhāgāyatavistṛte| śāle ca vṛttayorantarbhāgikāyāmavistṛtī ||168 yāmyasaumyāparāsvevaṃ dikṣu bhadra trayaṃ bhavet| sādhamāyāmavistārāstadardhabhramaṇānvitāḥ ||169 śālā vidikṣu kartavyāḥ śobhanāścatasṛṣvapi| bhadra madhye sthitāṃ śālāṃ hitvā prācyā tu sā bhavet ||170 sārdhamāyāmavistārāstattadardhabhramaṇānvitā| sanakṣatrāya somāya kartavyā puṣṭihetave ||171 caturaśrīkṛte kṣetre daśabhāgavibhājite| pañcabhāgāyatāṃ madhye śālāṃ vṛttāṃ prakalpayet ||172 sādhabhāgadvayastamitā devāgārasya bāhyataḥ| amaṇa saṃvidyātavya karṇaśālāśca karṇagāḥ ||173 karṇamānaṃ bahirvṛttaṃ bhramayitvāsārandataḥ| bhadro pabhadra karṇeṣu vṛttāḥ śālāḥ prakalpayet ||174 padadvayasamāyāmā padatritayavistṛtā| bhāgikābhramaṇopetā śālāḥ kurvīta bhadra jāḥ ||175 dve bhadrā tpārśvayoḥ śāle dve ca pratirathāśraye| bhāgikāyāmavistārā kuryādardhaparibhrame ||176 vau halyāyāmataḥ sādhabhāgā śālārdhakarṇagā| tāsāṃ tadardhamānena vidhātavyaḥ parikramaḥ ||177 praviṣṭau tu padādhena bhadrā n pratirathāvubhau| ityeṣā jagatī proktā mānataścandra maṇḍalā ||178 atha vṛttā --- brūmo jagatīḥ ṣaḍyathākramam| pañcabhāgāyatāḥ kṣetrā vistareṇa catuṣpadāḥ ||179 viddhyādāyataṃ vṛttaṃ camasyāṃ bhavabhāgikaḥ| madhye syāt tripadāstāmā sadvipadavistṛtāḥ ||180 mattavāraṇasaṃyuktā pratolyālaṅkṛtā śubhā| sopānaśuṇḍikāprāntaṃ --- gaṇḍitamaṇḍitā ||181 ukteyaṃ mātuliṅgīti jagatyamaravallabhā| asyā eva yadā pṛṣṭhe dvibhāgāyāmavistṛtiḥ ||182 śālā pūrvakrameṇa syāttadā jñeyā ghaṭīti sā| tadrū pe tadyatālālaṃ dve śāle vāmadakṣiṇe ||183 yadi paścimaśālā ca tatresyāyamatī jagatī tadā| ghaṭīkarṇeṣu sarveṣu dvibhāgāyāmavistṛtī ||184 yadi syurbhramasaṃyuktā śālā prāgvada vibhājitā| kuruyerdhāyaṃtarikṣe dve ca pṛṣṭe vārtantadūrya ||185 kāliṅgīyaṃ bhavedevaṃ pārśvayo aṃyurlamadātreṣu| etasyāṃ tu yadā śālā śuṇḍikānanasaṃsthitā| vṛttāyatavinirmāṇā jagatī syāt ---| etā vṛttāyatāḥ || brūmo'thāṣṭāśrisaṃsthānā jagatīḥ śubhalakṣaṇāḥ ||187 caturaśrīkṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ sapādairdaśabhirbhajet| parityajettataḥ sūtraṃ karṇe karṇe padatrayam ||188 sapādāṃścaturo bhāgān madhyabhāge'vaśeṣayet| saṃsidhyate ca sāṣṭāśri tasyārdhe syātsurālayaḥ ||189 aṣṭāśrimadhyabhāgasthaḥ --- śeṣaṃ bhramaṇaṃ bhavet| prāsādaśca caturdvāraśca caturbhirmaṇḍapairyutaḥ ||190 prāsādasākasūtra mukhaliṅgaṃ niveśayet| mūlakandārdhataḥ kandā kramādikṣu ca ||191 tulyapramāṇakānaṣṭau caturbhāgavibhājitā| bhramaśālāśca pūrvoktakrameṇa parikalpayet ||192 sopānaśuṇḍikāgaṇḍastā gopurādyairalaṅkṛtāḥ| karavyāsāmerupetā vavā sarvāyamudāhṛtā ||193 kṛtvā pūrvavadaṣṭāśri kṣetraṃ bhadraṃ dvidhā bhajet| kuryādbhāgārdhakaṃ bhadre pakṣayośca vinirgatam ||194 tadvistāraṃ bhajet ṣaḍbhirnirgamastaistribhiḥ padaiḥ| parikramo bhavet -- pārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhato'grataḥ ||195 śeṣaṃ śālā yugaṃ kāryaṃ bhāgadvitayamāyatam| sādhabhāgikavistāraṃ saṃghacesyarasyaṃ ca ||196 anenaiva prakāreṇa bhadre bhadre bhavedgatiḥ| karṇabhadraṃ vidhātavyaṃ tripadāyāmavistṛti ||197 caturdhā bhājite tasmin bhāgena bhramaṇaṃ bhavet| śeṣaṃ tu śālā vijñeyā dvipadāyāmavistṛtā ||198 vidiganteṣu sarveṣu nyāso'yamatisundaraḥ| mūlaśālā tu kandārdhe bhramaścādhībhramaṃ tataḥ ||199 mātṛkeyaṃ samākhyātā jagatupasaracanditakinnarośapraditi| bhadraṃ --- padebhyaḥ syādbhāgatritayanirgatam ||200 caturbhāgikavistāraṃ tripadāyāmakandakam| tadā syācchekharā nāma bhadra tritayabhūṣitā ||201 nityapramuditānekadevavṛttadakṛtāspadā| prāgaṣṭya śrīkṛte kṣetre caturbhāgavibhājite ||202 dvibhāgāyāmavistāre prāsāde daśame bhrame| aśribhiḥ samavistārādāsaṣṭau--- prakalpayet ||203 sadā bhāgapravistārān tāṃśca kuryātpṛthakpṛthak| nirgameṇa caturbhāgān bhāgika bhramaṇānvitān ||204 dvibhāgāyāmavistāraṃ madhye śālādvayaṃ bhavet| padmagarbheyamityuktā prajāpatimanaḥpriyā ||205 bhavedāryādidevīnāṃ sadā cittaprasādinī| vidhāya kṣetramaṣṭāsṛtavadardhāyāmavistṛtau ||206 madhye devagṛhaṃ kāryaṃ tadardhena bhramo bahiḥ| bhadraṃ bhaved dvādaśabhistaiścaturbhirvinirgamaḥ ||207 tasya bhadrā ṇāṃ nirgamo'pi catuṣpadaḥ| vistāraḥ ṣaṭpadasteṣāṃ caturbhistaṃ vibhājayet ||208 bhāgārdhena śālā syādbhāgatritayasamāyatā| bhramaśca syāttu kartavyo bhāgaṃ tatpārśvayoḥ rudrā yā ||209 dvibhāgāyāmavistāre śāle syātāṃ padabhrame| iyamaṃśumatī proktā jagatī śubhalakṣaṇā ||210 vidhāya kṣetramaṣṭāśri tadardhāyāmavistṛti| madhye devagṛhaṃ kāryaṃ tadardhena bhramo bahiḥ ||211 prāsādasamavistāraṃ bhadraṃ kṛtvā tato bhajet| caturdaśabhirasya syānnitiryamo daśabhiśca taiḥ ||212 maulikabhramaṇasyānte tripadāyatavistṛtā| śālātiśobhanā kāryā sādhabhāgabhramānvitā ||213 dvipadāyāmavistāre bhāgikabhramaṇānvite| kartavye pārśvayostasyāḥ śāle dve cārudarśane ||214 pratibhadraṃ vidhātavyaṃ bhāgapañcakavistṛtam| bhāgatrayaṃ praviṣṭaṃ ca tatra śālā tribhāgikī ||215 bhāgadvitayavistārā bhāgikabhramaṇānvitā| pārśvayoḥ pratibhadra sya karṇike bhāganirgame ||216 sārdhabhāgāyate syātāṃ karṇāḥ śālāyugānvitāḥ| pūrvavacchuṇḍikādyaṃ ca kamaleyamudāhṛtā ||217 caturdaśavibhaktāsu saptasvastiṣu kalpayet| nirgamāyāmatulyāsu śālāḥ pañca pṛthakpṛthak ||218 agrabhadre tu kartavyaṃ śālātritayamuttamam| iti vijñeya samākhyātā śālā vajradharapriyā ||219 itthaṃ jagatyaścaturaśrasaṃsthāḥ| spadāyatāṃ vartulasanniveśāḥ| vṛttāyatā thastiyutāścayaḥ samyag| jaṅghāḥ sadā śilpibhirapramattaiḥ ||220 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhāranāmni vāstuśāstre jagatīlakṣaṇādhyāyo nāmaikonasaptatitamaḥ| <70> atha liṅgapīṭhapratimālakṣaṇaṃ nāma saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ| atha pramāṇaṃ liṅgānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ cābhidhīyate| lohaṃ hastatribhāgena kanīyasam ||1 vyaṃśavṛddhānāvevaṃ syurāhastātratavāvidhe| hrasvamadhyottamākhyāni trīṇi trīṇyakalpakādibhiḥ ||2 liṅganāmabhiḥ prāsād syānusārataḥ| ataśca dviguṇāni syuvāruṇājāni pramāṇataḥ ||3 triguṇānyasmājjātāni mṛttikāprabhavāni ca| svasya kaniṣṭhasya padena parivartanāt ||4 kaniṣṭhāyāne hīnaṃ ca kartavyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ budhaiḥ| saptame yadi vā tiryagrajjalodhasanibhām ||5 stambhadrā tau daitakaivaleṣā viṣṇuvāritā| pakṣarekhā vidhātavyā lakṣaṇoddharaṇārdhanī ||6 pakṣakṣetre kṛte ṣoḍhā tyaktārdhāṃśakarairvṛtā| putrārthināṃ pakṣalekhā hitā rādyapirthinānāmapi ||7 aṣṭabhirnavabhirvāsmin bhakte tyaktvāṃśakāvadhaḥ| syātpakṣalekhā ṣaḍbhiśca saptabhiśceṣṭakāmadā ||8 yathā ṣoḍaśabhirbhakte vihāyādhaoṃ'śakadvayam| paśurekhāsarairnandaiḥ staryaiḥ śakraiśca śasyate ||9 liṅge'ṅgulāni yāvanti yavatryaṃśaistadunmitaiḥ| lakṣaṇādvāraṇā kāryamantaraṃ lakṣyarekhayoḥ ||10 rekhāntareṣu māṃśasya narthāśe pūrvakasammitam| khātaṃ kurvīta rekhāyāṃ vistāraṃ ca vicakṣaṇaḥ ||11 kuryānna lakṣaṇe dvāraṃ liṅge loheccaratraje| bāṇaliṅge cale cāpi tathātojāhilakṣaṇam ||12 pūjāṃśamekādaśadhā bhaktvordhvaṃ sarvataḥ samām| tiryak tathaikanavatiṃ bhāgānāṃ śiraso bhajet ||13 bhavetsahasraṃ liṅgānāṃ saikamityasamaiḥ padaiḥ| sahasraliṅgamityuktaṃ pañcāṅkavyaṅkamevatā ||14 arthā vibhāgaṃ vavadhā liṅge sarvame bhāvayet| ūrdhvaṃ bhāgatrayaṃ tyaktvā bhāgabhāgena kalpayet ||15 bhāgena śakāsya grīvāḥ kuryāttataḥ param| bhāgadvayena skandhāṃśapaṇai yugmapaṭāni ca ||16 puṣpasaṃsthe ca māśāsu vihite catasṛṣvapi| caturmukhaṃ bhavelliṅgamarcitaṃ sarvakāmadam ||17 trimukhaṃ tu lalāṭānāṅgānyaṃśena sāṅghriṇā| pṛthakpṛthak vidheyāni śeṣāṃśātskandhakalpanā ||18 ekacakre tu sādhena lalāṭādīni kalpayet| navabhakte tyajed dvau dvau vibhāgau pārśvayordvayoḥ ||19 vidhireṣa caturvaktre vibhakte pārśvayordvayoḥ| sādhaṃ sārdhaṃ tyajed bhūṣāmekavaktrerdhaśasya ca ||20 candrā rdhālaṅkṛtaṃ kāryaṃ kūṭākūṭadharaṃ śiraḥ| śiraso vartate kāryā pūrvaproktena vartmanā ||21 ekatra cāturo syātāṃ visṛte mukhanirgamaḥ| syādvā vibhāgai rākendri kārākhyairyathākramam ||22 mukhaliṅgaṃ na kartavyaṃ liṅgātsarvasamādṛte| sarveṣāṃ mukhaliṅgānāṃ dvidalaṃ pīṭhamiṣyate ||23 taija dairghya jāyante trayastriṃśat sahoditaiḥ| lauhāni tadvaddārūtthānyaśmamṛtprabhavāni ca| teṣāṃ yavanavālyāyānyāntarāṇi ca tato'pi ṣaṭ| caturādyāścaturvṛddhā hastaiḥ sahastapaddhataḥ ||25 ye prāsādā nirandhārā navaliṅgāni teṣviha| pañca --- dvādaśādyeṣu sādhāreṣvā śatārdhataḥ ||26 ekādyekottaraihastaiḥ śailajāni pracakṣate| prāsādagarbhamānādvā pañcadaśaistribhiruttamam ||27 navāṃśaiḥ pañcabhirmadhyaṃ kanīyo'rdhena tadbhavet| prabhedairantarasteṣāṃ yathāyogaṃ tribhistribhiḥ ||28 ṣaḍanyāni bhavantyevaṃ navaliṅgāni pūrvavat| tebhyo'pyavāntarairbhedaiḥ prāgvat satrividhairyutā ||29 diśānayā dārujāni --- yallohajāni ca| dairghye ṣoḍaśadhā bhakte caturbhiḥ surapūjitam ||30 liṅgaṃ viṣkambhato nādyaṃ bhūtaiḥ sa aṃśataiḥ śubhaiḥ| bhavet sarvasamaṃ ṣaḍbhirādyākhyaṃ caturaśrakam ||31 koṇe karṇārdhasūtreṇa lāñchite śeṣalopamāt| aṣṭāśri syāt saptabhakte hānātuṇeśayorantha ||32 garbhasīmārdhasūtreṇa vartanād vṛttanirmitā| adhomadhyordhvabhāgāḥ syuścaturaśrādikāḥ kramāt ||33 brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ dairghyālliṅge samottamāḥ| namasteṣvapi liṅgānāṃ thuthubhāgataḥ ||34 pūnādhevai vidhātavyau bhāgau brahmaśivāśrayau| liṅgasya dairghyajaṃ pīṭhe vistāro'sau vidhīyate ||35 liṅgavistārataścānyat pārśvapīṭhe viśiṣyate| tatsamo brahmaṇo bhāgāt saṃpradāyāpahṛtya vā ||36 rudra bhāgo vidhātavyo brahmabhāge'pi tadvaśāt| evaṃ kṛte parihṛtastvāya doṣo bhavediha ||37 kartuḥ kareṣṭetuśca syāt tasmin parihṛte śubham| ūrdhvaṃ tryaṃśasya dānena vartanādbālacandra māḥ ||38 kukkuṭāṇḍacaturyasya trapusambhave tu| aṣṭamāṃsyā sa tucchatraṃ dānādardhasya vartanāt ||39 kṛte'ṣṭāṃśe caturdhāsmin bhāgavṛddhyā taducyate| puṇḍarīkaṃ viśālākhyaṃ śrīvatsaṃ śakrasarvanam ||40 liṅgeṣu lakṣaṇairdvāra kartavyaḥ sa ca kathyate| rudra bhāgaṃ tridhā bhaktyā dvābhyāṃ lakṣaṇamuddharet ||41 śirordhāyato liṅge lakṣaṇāpi tadiṣyate| yadvāyatānanaṃ ṣaṣṭhe kartavyaṃ navamāṃśake ||42 --- vāyaṃ --- vākārapakṣare vivarjitam| pārśvarekhātribhāgena vistṛtaṃ caturaśrakam ||43 prāgvadaṣṭāsti vṛttaṃ ca ṣaḍaśricchatramastakam| śatrumardanasaṃjñena cchatreṇa samalaṅkṛtam ||44 liṅgamindrā rcitaṃ śastamaindra digvijayārthinām| pratiṣṭhāpyamidaṃ śatroryadvā stambhanamicchatā ||45 lokapālaiśceti kuryāt --- tryaṃśārdhārdhalakṣaṇam| aindre vajrābhamadhye'sya pakṣarekhā vidhīyate ||46 svadairghyadalarudrā śaiṃḥ! pañcabhiścitrabhāvanām| vistṛtaṃ caturaśraṃ syānmadhye vṛtte ca pūrvavat ||47 aśribhiḥ saptabhiryuktaṃ vṛttaṃ svāstravivarjitam| prāgvistārārdhavistāri lakṣmasyotamastakam ||48 yadvaikādaśabhirbhakte pakṣayośca chibhistribhiḥ| luptairaṃśaistadevāṃśenocchritaṃ chatramiṣyate ||49 idamagnyārcitaṃ liṅgaṃ kṛtvāgneryojayeddiśam| cikīrṣuṇārisantāpaṃ pratiṣṭhāpyamidaṃ sadā ||50 svadairghyārdhanavāṃśānāṃ pañcakena prastṛtam| kuryātkuṇḍaṃ ca ṣṭāṣṭaṃ ca pārśvayugaṃ tribhistribhiḥ ||51 navadhā sarvataḥ kṛtvā trīṃstrīnutsujya koṇagān| kurvītāpyastramevaṃ syātkramādvṛttaṃ vināśribhiḥ ||52 mūrdhānaṃ daśabhirbhaktvā bhāgatritayalopane| pakṣayorvihite kuryāducchritiṃ daśamāṃśataḥ ||53 lakṣaṇaṃ pūrvavatkāryaṃ daṇḍāgrakoramagrataḥ| kathaṃ yānyādiṣvi --- liṅgametajjigīṣubhiḥ ||54 vadhārthaṃ vā vipakṣāṇāṃ sarvairvaivasvatārcitam| āgnayavatkaviṣṇosāḥ kintvartusyadaśāpika ||55 svarāśirmastakerukte sārdhabhāgaparikṣate| pārśvayoḥ syādabhirlābha khaḍgāgrābhaṃ ca śasyate ||56 khaḍgā bhidhamidaṃ liṅgaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya tu nirṛtiḥ| athāpaśyandirāsatva tattvavyogaṃ ca śāṅkaram ||57 sārvasaptāṃśakaliṃviṃṣvāsyāruṇānvito| caturbhirlakṣma caitasya pāśāgrābhaṃ katāsicat ||58 liṅgametatpratiṣṭhāpya varuṇāsvādigāsatam| yogaṃ tathāptavānaiśaṃ kintvetacchāntipuṣṭikṛt ||59 svardhe dvādaśabhāgāṃśaiḥ saptabhiḥ puvatenile| veṣṇāsāṃkaṃ śokaiḥ bhakte dvitrilopane paraścatam ||60 vidheyaṃ pūrvavadvṛttaṃ śaracchatraṃ vināṃparam| lakṣma dhvajāgravaccāsya tvaitasṛṣatāṃpariḥ ||61 athāpa sudirgasetthaṃ tathā yogaṃ ca śāmbhavam| dviṣaduccāṭaviśleṣa paraukṣakaṃpānvidheśvābhiḥ ||62 pratiṣṭhāpyamidaṃ liṅgaṃ vyadhīyāṃ --- manīṣibhiḥ| kāryavāruṇaḥ savyākṣaṃ kintvāccose gurudaśām ||63 pattāṃśemūrdvi pārśvastha---pādāṃśaparicyuteḥ| chatraṃ syāt lakṣma caitasya gadāgrasadṛśaṃ bhavet ||64 etannaneśvaraḥ kṛtvā svadirgāsatvasādmavān| yogaṃ ca śivadhāmāptyai vibhūtiṃ prāptavānataḥ ||65 svadve rudrā śaṃ!kaiḥ ṣaḍbhirvistṛtaṃ caturaśrakam| bhavabhakte trayaṃ tyāgād bhavatyathāśri pārśvayoḥ ||66 vṛttaṃ tu pūrvavat kāryaṃ kukkuṭāṇḍanibhaṃ śiraḥ| tryaṃśavasayairnavabhiḥ kukkuṭāṇḍamidaṃ bhavet ||67 mūṣanavabhiḥ pārśvayostristriśātanāḥ kukkuṭāṇḍakam| aśritrayaṃ ca kartavyaṃ pūjābhāgasamāśrayam ||68 śūlāgrapratimaṃ lakṣma liṅge kartavyamaiśvare| syādidaṃ yogasāmrājyajñānasamprāptikārakam ||69 brāhme syād raudra vatsarve padmakuḍmalavacchiraḥ| lakṣmāsmin kamalākāraṃ liṅge kamalajanmanaḥ ||70 liṅgametatpratiṣṭhāpya prājāpatyaṃ prajāpatiḥ| lebhe padamataḥ sthāsidaṃ vyeṣūpadesyatiḥ ||71 vaiṣṇave raudra vat sarvaṃ śiro'smin kuntasannibham| bhaktā bhavajatulyaṃ vā kartavyaṃ lakṣma vaiṣṇave ||72 puṇyakṣetrodbhavamidaṃ dvijādīnāṃ sitādyayā| saṃgrāhayecchilādra vyaṃ guktayoṣitayānvirām ||73 idaṃ pakvamapakvaṃ vā lohatū bhayagarbhitam| apakvaṃ vajralepādyaṃ kartavyaṃ siddhibhiḥ ||74 bhūtaye lohajaṃ liṅgaṃ sīsakatrapuvarjitam| kāñcanaśatrucchedakāyayi saṃcitam ||75 yāsya liṅgoktalakṣmaitattrāpuṃsāṃnāgākunmacātryādi| lohodbhavaṃ vā yanmātṛ---guhyakasiddhikṛt ||76 bhikṣūṇāṃ calametatsyānmumuṣūṇāṃ ca veśmaśu| śreṣṭhaṃ samasta rāntāchraṃ vajjajjaṃ jrajaṃ tadaricchide ||77 padmarāgaṃ mahābhṛtyau saubhāgyā mauktikam| puṣparāgamahānīlau---yātīrasamudbhavam ||78 yaśase kulasantatyai tejase sūryakāntaram| tā---cchaṃ sphāṭikaṃ sarvakāmada śūlārasro ||79 maṇijaṃ --- śatrukṣayāya pulakā tathā| sasyakaṃ sasyaniṣpattyai bhojagaṃ divyasiddhidam ||80 śreṣṭhaṃ sārakta--- liṅgamārogyāhitacetasām| vaikṛntakasahāvartarākāyaskāntajaṃ hitam ||81 kṣudra sistriṣu tanmantra---jātisaṃskṛtam| phalaṃ samyagguṇādūhyamanyāsu maṇijātiṣu ||82 varṇābhidhānasaṃsthānaviśeṣābhya --- tadvidā| pṛthiyāṃ sapīṭhaṃ vā tasyānnordhvaṃ navāṅgulāt ||83 siddhaye caradārāntāvaśvanakādvā praśasyate| susaṃsthānaṃ sudītaṃ cedavākyaṃ pinayaṃ doṣakṛt ||84 sūkṣmopakoguṇopeta balīyān sarvadoṣakṛt| sānnidhyakāraṇaṃ dīptiḥ samastamaṇijanmanām ||85 mānonmānapramāṇādityeṣu grāhyaṃ navā budhaiḥ| śailaṃ hastādadhaḥ stheyaḥ prāsādeṣu ca śasyate ||86 tataścalamapi prāhurhīṇāśrayasistriyo| itaścedakṛtye suyavāṃkaṃ piṇḍikādhiyāṅkam ||87 arthā bhāgadvaye tā--- bhāgapiṇḍikāvaṭe| vṛttā bhāgāstrayo'pyasya pratiṣṭhā syādguhāsu ca ||88 kṣetre parigṛhīte'sau deśe deśādhipakṣayaḥ| niṣpannarūpapraguptaṃ maṇḍalāṃ bhāvyasākayā ||89 siddharālāptadhautesminabhiḥ siddharasaṃ gatam| yatroktaḥ garbhastaṃkāsyāttatrālekhātsamā bhavet ||90 karakhīijaṭākāṅkā haritālaviṣṭedhibhiḥ| sarveṣābhiḥ praviṣṭābhiranāliṃ ne lekhanīkṛtam ||91 pradeśo yānityāṃ vibhrānti vyaktikṛdbhavet| viṣarudra jaṭāpathyā cabrūkandavibhītakaiḥ ||92 sudarśanāśvamārābhyāmavidugdhena saṃyutaḥ| pralepo yadi vā pārśve cihnābhivyaktihetave ||93 idānīmiha pīṭhānāṃ stathāva kathyate| mānato nāmatorghāca viśeṣetarasiddhaye ||94 devyādi bhedavatīṭhaṃ tu padeko garbhamānataḥ| tatsiddhirmukhataḥ prokta śunaṃ ṣaṃge muktayo ||95 kārādiliṅgamānena yāmitaṃnyamukhaṃ tataḥ| bhuktaye muktaye caitānyupadiṣṭāni mukhyataḥ ||96 liṅgavadgarbhamānena samyagvā tāni kalpayet| liṅgadairghyapramāṇāni māneṣu veśmasā ||97 avyaktamuktaliṅgānāṃ samaṃ viṣpataḥ| kārādiliṅgamānena yāmitānyanuṣaṅgataḥ ||98 bhaktaye muktaye tenātphapadivyabhānāṃ tadardāghravistṛtiḥ| nṛpārkaviktajāyāmāstadardhocchrāyavistṛtiḥ ||99 uttamādi sahārghānāṃ siddhyai kurvīta pīṭhikām| vṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā sarvaprāsādaliṅgagagam ||100 vṛttaṃ vyakteṣu na hitaṃ vināśādi ---| vidhinā pṛthivī --- povakī pūrṇasaṃjñitā ||101 bhābhāvatī trapākṣī ca gaṇyante tāśca nāmataḥ| indrā dilokapālānāṃ kāryā liṅge vyacasu kramāt ||102 aiśānaliṅge raudrā nti---yā pīṭhikā bhavet| te caitāsu traye'nyāstu bhuktimuktiphalapradā ||103 papāpapāvarāvāpī vajja candra kalā smṛtā| saṃvartā nandikāvarte caitāḥ sādhāraṇā matāḥ ||104 atha lakṣaṇameteṣāṃ tāsāṃ sarvāsāmabhidhīyate| aindra liṅgā vṛttā pṛthvī stambhādau caturaśrikā ||105 caturaśrasya yaḥ karṇastaccaturthāṃśamaṣṭadhā| kṛtvāṃśasaptakenāsya turyāttargatsakalpanāt ||106 pāścātyabhāgayoḥ pārśve bahiḥ sūtrasthitāvathe| vṛttadvayasya bhramaṇaṃ vidadhīta vicakṣaṇaḥ ||107 caturaśre purogarbhasūtrāṣṭasyāsavardhanāt| kṛtapatrabhamuddeśaṃ pārśvābhyāṃ sūtramātrayet ||108 lopanāt tyaktabhāgasyā hotāsi pīṭhikā bhavet| āgneyaliṅgaṃ syācchatrunāśasantāpadāhakṛt ||109 kṣetre---caturaśre'sya dvādaśāṃśaṃ parityajet| pāmado garbhanastena vṛttasyārdhaṃ samālikhet ||110 ityardhacandrā kāro'yaṃ sāmī bhavati pīṭhikā| yāmyaliṅgasya nagarādikṣiṇāsthā rināśanī ||111 caturaśre vibhāgārdhavardhanātpārśvayordvayoḥ| parisvī bhāgavṛddhyā ca sūtradvayanipātanāt ||112 rautsaṃttatyā nairṛtī strīmaraṇadveṣarogakṛt| pūrvacandra mākṛtirṇā vāruṇī parimekhalā ||113 śāntike pauṣṭike cātha mṛtyunāśene ca pīṭhikā| pratīcyo ṣaḍaṃśasya vṛddhiṃ kṛtvā --- taḥ ||114 garbhāva vṛttalekhena yatsampātacatuṣṭayam| karṇābhyakarṇaṃ bhavettena vṛttasthānadvayena ca ||115 ṣaḍaśraṃ samamālekhyaṃ yadvā vajrasamākṛti| nābhasvatī pīṭhikā syāt parṇenirmaruto diśi ||116 karmasūccāṭanādyeṣu viniyojyā jigīṣubhiḥ| yākṣī trimekhalā vṛttā vittāptyai dhanadārcite ||117 gaṇādvimakhalāṣpaśritaḥ| kurvītaikena khurakaṃ caturbhirjāḍyakumbhakam ||118 dvābhyāmañjaṃ tathaikena praveśo'tra jāḍyakumbhasya śasyate| añjūyasya caturbhistaiḥ karṇikāyā dvaye narāḥ ||119 ekena kaṇṭhakaścāto niryātyekena karṇikā| vibhājairaṃ puśaṃ ṣaḍbhistataścaikena mekhalāḥ ||120 padmayaṃ pīṭhikā khyātā sarvakāmapradāyinī| kṣetre ṣoḍaśadhā bhakte bhāgena khurako bhavet ||121 caturbhirjarātāṃ kumbhastribhirekena karṇikā| tribhiḥ kaṇṭhaścaturbhiśca pūrvavannirgamo bhavet ||122 iyaṃ --- vyaktaliṅgeṣu pīṭhakā syātpayodharā| evaṃvidhaiva cāpīṭha syātkiṃmucyakto lakṣaṇe ||123 bhakte dvādaśabhiḥ pīṭhamānaṃ dvirbhāgiko bhavet| jagatīti tribhiḥ kuse dvābhyāmekena vedikā ||124 kaṇṭho dvābhyāmathaikena vedikā punaruttarā| ekaikena tu bhāgena tataḥ syātpīṭhikādvayam ||125 evaṃ ṣaḍaśrā kartavyā vajrākṣā pīṭhikā budhaiḥ| pīṭhikā kṣetreṇa nirbhaktaṣo bhāgena khurako bhavet ||126 dvābhyāṃ jaṅghātha bhāgena vedī dvābhyāṃ tu kaṇṭhakaḥ| ubhayābhyāṃ nirgamaḥ sā strīcchi candra kalā bhavet ||127 āpāyanāyayudyau ca padārekhaiva cāmṛtā| bhavet ṣaṇmekhalādardhādūrdhvakaṇṭho'tha bhāgikaḥ ||128 paṭṭikātritayaṃ śeṣe kṣetre syānnirgamāntaram| rudrā rcitā pīṭhikeyaṃ saṃvartetyabhidhānataḥ ||129 yāṃ kṛtvā prakṛterūrdhvaṃ gatāḥ saṃvartakādayaḥ| rudrā vothastarākhyaṃ te bhejire padamavyayam ||130 ṣoḍhā pīṭhodaye bhakte bhāgaṃ syātpaṭṭikātrayam| ekena kaṇṭho bhāgena paṭṭikānyāpi bhāgikā ||131 nandyāvartāṅkitā seyaṃ nandyāvarteti kīrtitā| sādhāraṇīyaṃ sarveṣāṃ liṅgānāṃ sarvasiddhidā ||132 bhavākaṇṭhasuvāsadhyānāmiyaṃ siddhakhurā| doderanyonamithai bhavantyanyāśca pīṭhikāḥ ||133 mānasaṃsthā na kathitāstāsāmānantyakāraṇāt| tryaṃśena gartaḥ syādāsāṃ ṣoḍaśāṃśena mekhalā ||134 khātaśca neyaḥ śvabhrāntaṃ mekhalāmadhyato hyasau| prāṇālārghāsamā dairghyavistārābhyāmudadgiśi ||135 pañcāśadviśayaṃstāla sadvayaṃmantarā| sadāṃsadvibhayaṃ prānte khāto'gre dviguṇāmukhān ||136 sārdhābhamekhalā kāryāḥ prāṇālaḥ svasṛtaṃ bhāgataḥ| guṇāguṇāstrayo liṅge tānyāpatreva bhāvayet ||137 āvartāḥ śobhanākārāḥ śubhāḥ syu --- dhaḥ| natu pīṭhabrahmaśile śaste liṅgajātyanuge sadā ||138 garbhakarṇacaturthāṃśamānā syādbrahmaṇaḥ śilā| --- gasya karṇena yadvā brahmaśilā bhavet ||139 yātābhidheka brahmaśilā brahmāṃśato bhavet| tāvatābhyadhikā kāryā tasyāḥ karmaśilā budhaiḥ ||140 sthāpayetpuruṣatrayā śivaṃ madhye niveśayet| brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇenāsya vāmataḥ puruṣottamam ||141 anyathāsthāpanādeṣāṃ pratyavāyo mahān bhavet| tribhāgaunā śacā syātāṃ kośāntaścakriṇo bhavet ||142 tribhāgonastivāsātāṃ kośāntaścakriṇo bhavet| tribhāgonnatasyādāntaḥ kokasyāntaḥ padmajanmanaḥ ||143 brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ --- niveśane| pramāṇameteṣu dviśca pṛthaksthānāṃ yadṛcchayā ||144 umāmaheśvarau yatra tatromā brahmaviṣṇuvat| ākāśe pratimā yeṣṭā catvāriṃśacca pañca ca ||145 hastān kāryā tribhāgonā madhyā hīnā tadardhataḥ| yātrāthā pratimā dvārapramāṇena vidhīyate ||146 tacca dvāraṃ tridhā bhaktvā pīṭhaṃ bhāgena kalpayet| dvābhyāṃ tu pratimā kāryā jyeṣṭhāyāṃ mānamīdṛśam| madhyāyāṃ navadhā dvāraṃ kṛtvaikaṃ bhāgamutsṛjet| śeṣān bhāgān tridhā kṛtvā pīṭhaṃ bhāgena kalpayet ||148 arcāmubhābhyāṃ hīnāyāṃ vidadhyād dvāramaṣṭadhā| ekamutsṛjya śeṣeṇa --- ||149 pīṭhāt tat tritayenārcāmupaviṣṭāṃ prakalpayet| dvārasyārdhaṃ tridhā kṛtvā dvābhyāṃ pīṭhaṃ vidhīyate ||150 cākḷptiruktavatayadvā dvedhā caturdhā vā dvāraṃ kṛtvaikamutsṛjet| śeṣaṃ bhāgatrayaṃ kṛtvā pīṭhamarcāṃ ca pūrvavat ||151 dvārocchriteḥ pañcadaśabhāgaṃ kṛ tyaktvā vidhīyate| bhāgatrayaṃ tadekena pīṭhamarcāṃ tu taddvayāt ||152 bhāgān pañca vidhīyeta yadi vā bhāgayugmataḥ| pīṭhaṃ tat tritayenārcāmupaviṣṭāṃ prakalpayet ||153 dvārasyārdhaṃ tridhā kṛtvā dvābhyāṃ pīṭhaṃ vidhīyate| bhāgenārcāśayānāgārdhe'rcāṃ veśmānusārataḥ ||154 bhakte prāsādagarbhārdhe daśadhā pṛṣṭhabhāgataḥ| piśācarakṣodanujāḥ sthāpyā gandharvaguhyakāḥ ||155 ādityacandri kāviṣṇubrahmeśānāntā padakramāt| garbhe ṣaḍbhāgabhakte vā tyaktvaikaṃ pṛthatā śata| sthāpanaṃ sarvadevānāṃ pañcameṃ'śe praśasyate ||156 yadaṅgapratyaṅgapraharaṇagataṃ lakṣma vitataṃ| tadarthānāṃ citrakanāvadho vācyamakṣya| sapīṭhārcā liṅgonmapi viditvā vahumato| bhavedbhūpālānāṃ kṛtibhirapi pūjyeta sakalaiḥ ||157 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhāranāmni vāstuśāstre ṅgipīṭhapratimālakṣaṇaṃ nāma saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ| <71> atha citroddeśo nāmaikasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ| atha priyaṃ vite'smābhirvinyāsaścitrakarmaṇaḥ| citraṃ hi sarvaśilpānāṃ mukhaṃ lokasya ca priyam ||1 pade pade vā kuḍye vā yathā citraṃ saṃ vacane| vartayaḥ kṛtabandhāśca lekhāmānaṃ yathā bhavet ||2 varṇagavyaktiyā yādṛgyādṛśo vartanākramaḥ| nānonmānavidhiścaiva navasthāne vidhistathā ||3 hastānāṃ yaśca vinyāso lakṣaṇanātrasaṃśaya| divyānāṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ ca divyā sā mukhajanmanā ||4 gaṇarakṣaḥkinnarāṇāṃ kubjavāmanayasteṣām| vikalpākṛtimānāni rūpasaṃsthānameva ca ||5 vṛkṣagulmalatāvallīvīrudhāṃ pāpakarmaṇām| śūrāṇāṃ durvidhānāṃ ca dhanināṃ pṛthivībhṛtām ||6 brāhmaṇānāṃ visāsoḍajātana krūrakarmaṇām| mānināmatha raṅgopajīvināṃ cehraṅgakathyate ||7 rūpalakṣaṇanaipathyaṃ satīnāṃ rājayoṣitām| dāsīpravrajitāraṇḍāyativallīṣu lakṣaṇā ||8 kanyānāmasaṃkāraṇāṃ ca vidhyānā gajavājinām| makaravyālasiṃhānāṃ tathā yajñopayoginām ||9 vinā rātrivibhāgasya ṛtūnāṃ cāpi lakṣaṇam| atra yojyaṃ yāpyaṃbhra kathaṃ bhavati ||10 pravibhāgasya devānāṃ rekhāṇāṃ cāpi lakṣaṇam| lakṣaṇaṃ pañcabhūtānāṃ teṣāmārambha eva ca ||11 vṛkādīnāṃ vihaṅgānāṃ sarveṣāṃ jalavāsinām| citranyāsavidhānasya brūmaḥ samprati lakṣaṇam ||12 karmaṇa karmā karame yasmāccitrakarmaṇi vartate| tasyāṅgānyabhidhīyante tena sarvāni vistarāt ||13 vartikā prathamaṃ teṣāṃ dvitīyaṃ bhūmibandhanam| lekhyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ syād rekhākarmāṇi vartatemiha lakṣaṇam ||14 pañcamaṃ karṣakarmacca ṣāṣṭhaṃ syād vartanākramaḥ| saptamaṃ lekhanaṃ lekhakaraṇaṃ dvicakarma tathāṣṭamam ||15 saṅgraho'yamiti caiva karmaṇaḥ| sūtriti tadanukrameṇā thaḥ| bhāvayenna khalu mohametyasau| citrakarmaṇi kṛtī ca jāyate ||16 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhāranāmni vāstuśāstre citroddeśādhyāyo nāma ekasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ| <72> atha bhūmibandho nāma dvisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ| idānīṃ vartikālakṣma bhūmibandhaśca kathyate| gulmāntare śubhe kṣetre padminyāṃ saritastaṭe ||1 pārvatānāṃ ca kakṣeṣu vāpikānanāntare| bhaumā lavaṇapiṇḍāḥ syurmūleṣu ca mahīruhām ||2 kṣetreṣveteṣu yā jātāḥ sthirāḥ ślakṣṇāśca pāṇḍarāḥ| grāhyā mṛdvāvasāseṣvā vijñeyā kaṭuśarkarā ||3 kṣetrāṇāmānupūrvyeṇa mṛttikā kathitā śubhā| peṣayetkuṭṭayitvā tāṃ tataḥ kalkaṃ samācaret ||4 śālibhaktasya dātavyastatra bhāgo yathoditaḥ| grīṣmartau saptamaṃ bhāgaṃ śītakāle ca pañcamam ||5 ṣaṣṭhaṃ śaradi varṣāsu caturthaṃ bhāgamānayet| vartikābandhanārthāmāyānti tena tā ||6 agrāyā śālivakkrābhā yavaṃ yavyāṃ sukhagṛham| kurkuṭārāgrasadṛśī karmabhāgavikalpataḥ ||7 śikṣākāle'ṅguladvandvaṃ pramāṇena vidhīyate| kutharekhāsu śasyante vartikāḥ tryaṅgulonmitāḥ ||8 paṭā rekhāsu kurvīta mānena caturaṅgulāḥ| idānīmabhidhāsyāmo vasudhābandhanakriyām ||9 pakṣikā caiva kūṭāśca --- paṭa eva ca| tasya tasya kibhāna bhūmibandho nigadyate ||10 puṇyanakṣatravāreṣu māṅgalyadivaseṣu ca| kṣato vāso bhuktā ca kartā bhartātha śikṣakaḥ ||11 anekavarṇaiḥ kusumairgandhaiḥ na kṛpāpāḥ| nānādhūpaiḥ surabhibhirarcayitvārabheta tām ||12 navasūtrāttulamṛdvastitajalena samaṃ samam| navatvāmātsadṛśaṃ vṛktanabhavidvātyaparākriyaḥ ||13 liṅgasūtravinīkṣetānikaṭaṃ sahataṃ navaḥ| anuttatamanismaṃ ca kuryādyāvatkṣitau samam ||14 susthitaṃ jalavakṣāyaṃ samyagālokya dhīmatā| kṛtvā bhūmikriyāmetāṃ paścādbandhanamācaret ||15 lucimalāṃstisva vrīhitaṇḍulasannibhām| saṃgṛhya tīrthamathavā piṣṭvā kalkaṃ samācaret ||16 tena piṇḍaṃ prakurvīta śoṣeyecatamāttayo| śavayet kalkayedyena vyāsādvyaṣavyastuyā ||17 evameva catuṣkontā sapta vārān pragharṣayet| hastena saṃmṛśet paścādyathā lonaṃ ca jāyate ||18 athavā śikṣikābhūmau kharavandhanamācaret| pūrvoditasya kalkasya niryāse bandhanaṃ kṣipet ||19 pañcabhāgapramāṇena grīṣmakāleṣu śasyate| śaradyaṃśatrayaṃ sādhaṃ trīnaṃśā samāgamam ||20 varṣākāle hi bhāgena pradadyāditi niścayaḥ| pañcabhāgapramāṇena grīṣmasaṃ --- ||21 bandhānayaṃ prakurvītāpapūrvakaṃ dhinākṣito| lepayed romakūrceṇa śuṣkāṃ śuṣkāmanukramāt ||22 toyena hastaktavaci pradātavyo vicakṣaṇaiḥ| vidhinaivaṃ kṛtaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śikṣikābhūmibandhanam ||23 bandhanaṃ kuḍyabhūmeśca yathāvatkathyate'dhunā| snuhīvāstukakūśmāṇḍakuddālīnāmupāharet ||24 kṣīramanyatamasyāpāmāmīsyekṣarukasya ca| teṣāṃṇāṃ vāgasūtre saptarātraṃ nidhāpayet ||25 siṃhapāsananimbānāṃ triphalavyādherdyātayo| samāharedyathālābhaṃ kathayā kuṭajasya ca ||26 kaṣāyakṣārayuktena sāmudra lavaṇena ca| pūrvā kuḍhyaṃ rāmaṃ kṛtvā kaṣāyaiḥ pariṣe pariṣebhayatu ||27 cikkaṇāṃ mṛdamādāya sthūlapāṣāṇavarjitām| mānuṣāṃstāddviguṇān syavālukāmṛdām| kakubhasya skandadyādhānmāṣāṇāṃ śālamalerapi| śrīphalānāṃ rasaṃ tadvad dadyātkālānurūpataḥ ||29 pūrvakālānusāreṇa yatproktaṃ bandhanaṃ kṣiteḥ| tatsarvaṃ sikatāyuktaṃ kṛtvaikatra navaṃ budhaḥ ||30 kumādyamālayāpātaṃ ma hasticarmapramāṇataḥ| viśeṣāṃ ṣyātha pratikṣipettoyaṃ kuryādaśasannibhām ||31 viśuddha vimalaṃ snigdhaṃ pāṇḍuraṃ mṛdulaṃ sphuṭam| pūrvoditāṃ samādāya vidhivatkaṇṭakarkarīm ||32 tāṃ kuṭṭayitvā ghṛṣṭvā ca kalkaṃ kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ| pūrvoktabhaktabhāgaṃ ca niryāsāṃśca pradāpayet ||33 viṣvaṅka yadi vā dadyāt kūṭasarkarayā samam| trīn vārān lepayetkuḍyaṃ pūrvoktena vicakṣaṇaḥ ||34 halena hastamālipya pradadyāt kūṭakūrtakām| jāyate vidhinānena kuḍyabandhanamuttamam ||35 sāmprataṃ kathayiṣyāmaḥ paṭṭabhūminibandhanam| bimbābījāni saṃgṛhya tyaktvā teṣāṃ malaṃ budhaḥ ||36 evaṃ viśodhya niṣpāvān yadi vā śālitaṇḍulān| teṣāmanyatamaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ piṣṭvā pātre vipācayet ||37 paṭṭamālipya bandhena pūrvoktamivā vidhimā caret| pūrvoktaniryāsā punā vidhāttayaḥ kaṭaśarkarām ||38 toyena tāṃ pracāṃkṛtya paṭamālekhayettayā| anena vidhinā bandhaścitrakarmaṇi śasyate ||39 vidhinānyena vā kuryāt sādānāṃ bhūmibandhanam| prādyadyāmikatālapaṅkaniryāsa samanvitām ||40 niryāsasaṃyutāṃ dadyāttristataḥ kaṭaśarkarām| pāṭāyanāṃ bhūmibandho'yaṃ vikṣeptavyaḥ prayatnataḥ ||41 gomayena kaṭaṃpene śaistadanantaram| kaṭaśarkarayuktivārāstrāktarcakena ca| yathā panyattāsvāṃ paścād bhūmibandhaḥ kaṭepihaḥ ||42 iti nigaditamevaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vartikānā- mihakapadakuḍyakṣmānivivividheśca || idamakhilamavaiti granthato yo'rthataśca| prativati sa vidhāturvibhramasyāsya yogāt ||43 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhāranāmni vāstuśāstre bhūmibandho nāma dvisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ| <73> atha lepyakarmādikaṃ nāma trisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ| lepyakarma samṛllakṣma lakṣā lakṣma ca kathyate| vāpīkūpataṭākāni padminyo dīrghikāstathā ||1 vṛkṣamūlaṃ nadītīraṃ padminyo dīrghikāstathā ||1 vṛkṣamūlaṃ nadītīraṃ gulmamadhyaṃ tathaiva ca| mṛttikānāmiti kṣetrāṇyuktānyetāni tattvataḥ ||2 tāsāṃ varṇaḥ sitākṣaudra sannibho gaura eva ca| kapilaśceti te snigdhāḥ śastā viprādiṣu kramāt ||3 indrā śīṃ! mṛttikā grāhyā sthūlapāṣāṇavarjitā| śālmalīmāṣakakubhaṃ madhūkatriphalodbhavam ||4 rasaṃ vinikṣipettasyāṃ paprekṣasyasikathitāṃ cāpi| kramukaṃ canakā bilve saṭālomāli vājinaḥ ||5 gavāṃ romāṇi vā dadyānnālikerasya valkalam| mṛdāṃ saṃyojya mṛdgīyāddadyādvā dviguṇāṃstuṣān ||6 vālukātīvatī cāpi ttapāsāṃyogayenmṛdam| bhāgadvayaṃ mṛttikāyai kārpāsāṃśena miśrayet ||7 tadekīkṛtya mṛdbhāgaṃ tṛtīyamupari kṣipet| pūrvoditāṃ sannidhāya tataśca kaṭaśarkarām ||8 kalkaṃ vidhāya cīreṇa rūpaṃ tatpariveṣṭitam| tena niryāsayuktena kuryādākāramādṛtaḥ ||9 kaṭaśarkarayā limpet kūrcakena vicakṣaṇaḥ| mṛttikākvāthasaṅghātāllepakarma praśasyate ||10 ravayellohasaṅghātaṃ lasaṃkāryasudhāmadhyaye| yuktaṃ pakṣeta saṃyojya momamāna yojayet ||11 anepakaṃ samāyuktaṃ kartuḥ sthānavināśanam| lepakarmamṛttikānirṇayaḥ || vilekhālakṣaṇaṃ samyagidānīmabhidhīyate ||12 kūrcanaṃ kūrcakenātha dvitīyaṃ hastakūrcakam| tṛtīyaṃ bhāsakūrcākhyaṃ caturthaṃ callakūrcanam ||13 vartanaṃ pañcamaṃ vartanyakūrcamānyakūrcanamiṣyate| lepyakarmaṇi tacchastamanāmaṇavaḥ ||14 jalacūrṇakamānītamiha satsantito ---| kūrcakaṃ dhārayed dhīmān vṛṣaśravaṇaromabhiḥ ||15 --- tatkṛtakūrcakaiḥ| valkalairvā vidhātavyaḥ kharakeśairathāpi vā ||16 kūrcako yematiryāpi vihito'tra praśasyate| kūrcakaṃ dhārayeddhīmān vṛṣaśravaṇaromabhiḥ ||17 tantūtaḥ kūrcakaḥ śreṣṭho vilekhākarmaṇi svataḥ| ādyo vadāṅkurākārastato svacchāṅkurākṛtiḥ ||18 plakṣasūcīnibhaścānyastṛtīyaḥ kūrcako bhavet| udumbarāṅkurākāraścaturthaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||19 sthūlā lekhā na kurvīta vaṭāṅkuranibhāditaḥ| nyūnalekhā na kurvīta plakṣāṅkurasamena ca ||20 aśvatthāṅkurarūpeṇa yatra vidvatasahīkarāt| udumbarāṅkurākāro lepyakarmaṇi śasyate| jyeṣṭhaḥ syādāyato daṇḍo vaiṇavo --- ṅgulaḥ ||21 lepyakarma --- samāsataḥ| saṃskṛteḥ vidhiranantaraṃ mṛdaḥ| atra samyaguditā vilekhanī| kūrcakasya racanā ca pañcadhā ||22 iti mahārājādhirājaparameśvaraśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhāranāmni vāstuśāstre lepyakarmavilekhākūrcakādhyāyo nāma trisaptatitamaḥ| <74> athāṇḍakapramāṇaṃ nāma catuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ| athātra prakramāyātā kathyate'ṇḍakavartanā| kāyapramāṇāmapi ca jātibhāvādisaṃśrayam ||1 atha madhotirālikhya torakā sanniveśayet| tārakā trayamālekhya tatrānanasamāyati ||2 tāvatpramāṇamāyāmaṃ golakasyottamaṃ viduḥ| tena golakatvena mānonmāne tu kārayet ||3 mukhāṇḍakasya vistāro lepaṣaṭkena sammitaḥ| dvidairghyaṃ tu golakāḥ sapta vāpīsaṃsthānameva ca ||4 mukhāṇḍakamidaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kartavyaṃ citrakarmaṇi| trikoṭi vṛttimālekhyaṃ vṛttāṇḍakamiti kramāt ||5 bhāvāṇḍakānyatha brūmaḥ sohasyābhiprastaveḍakam| golārdhābhyadhikaṃ kāryaṃ pūrvestottadvicakṣaṇaiḥ ||6 ardhagolakamāyāmādalasāṇḍakamucyate| navagolakadairghyaṃ tadadvahāsamukhaṃ bhavet ||7 puṃsāṃ ṣaḍādāttaṃ mānaṃ vistārātpañcagolakam| vanitāṇḍakamālekhyaṃ nālikeraphalopamam ||8 caturgolakavistīrṇamāyataṃ pañcagolakān| śiśūnāmaṇḍakaṃ tāvatkartavyaṃ citrakarmaṇi ||9 hāsyobhiḥ prasravet tasya golakārdhān viśeṣayet| ālasyāṇḍakamapyevaṃ rodanaṃ tadvadeva tu ||10 ṣaḍgolakapravistāramāyataṃ saptagolakam| rākṣasasyāṇḍakaṃ kuryāccandra maṇḍalasannibham ||11 hāsyobhiprastave tasya golakārdhān viśeṣayet| devāṇḍakaṃ pramāṇena tadālasye'tra kīrtitaḥ ||12 ṣaḍgolakapravistāraṃ golakāṣṭakamāyatam| vṛttāṃ yā samālekhyaṃ divyāṇḍakamiti smṛtam ||13 athābhidhīyate divyamānuṣāṇḍaka lakṣaṇam| golakārdhādhikaṃ bhe tacca kāryaṃ mānuṣamānataḥ ||14 paścagolakavistīrṇaṃ ṣaḍgolasekamāyutam| mukhāṇḍaṃ mānuṣaṃ kṛtvā kettarasya vidhīyate ||15 śiśukāṇḍakamānena pramathānāṃ mukhāṇḍakam| rākṣasāṇḍakamānena yātudhānāṇḍakaṃ bhavet ||16 dānavasyāṇḍakaṃ kuryāddevānāṃ vadanopamam| gandharvanāgayakṣāṇāṃ tadvadevāṇḍakaṃ bhavet ||17 vidyādharāṇāṃ vijñeyaṃ divyamānuṣamaṇḍakam| budhyante ke'pi śāstrārthaṃ kecitkarmāṇi kurvate ||18 karāmalakavatyāsyaṃ para dvayamapyadaḥ| na vetti śāstravitkarma na śāstramapi karmavit| yo vetti dvayamapyetatsa hi citrakaro varaḥ ||19 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhāranāmni vāstuśāstre aṇḍakapramāṇaṃ nāma catuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ| <75> atha mānotpattirnāma pañcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ| brūmo'tha mātamaṅgaṇāṃ paramāṇvādi tadbhavet ||1 paramāṇū rajo roma likṣā prarikā yavo'ṅgulam| kramaśo'ṣṭaguṇā vṛddhirevaṃ mānāṅgulaṃ bhavet ||2 dvyaṅgulo golako jñeyaḥ kalāṃ vā tāṃ pracakṣate| dve kale golakau bāhau bhāgo mānena tena tu ||3 āyāmād vistṛteścitramanyūnādhikamācaret| devādīnāṃ śarīraṃ syādvistāreṇāṣṭabhāgikam ||4 tridaśadgāyataṃ caitad vidadhyāccitraśāstravit| asurāṇāṃ saraṃ syādbhāgān samārdhasaṃyutān ||5 vistāreṇa tadāyāmādekānnatriṃśadiṣyate| saptabhāgaṃ rākṣasānāṃ vistāreṇāyataṃ punaḥ ||6 saptaviṃśatibhāgaṃ syādyat punardivyamānuṣam| sārdhā tu ṣaḍaṃśāsta kuryātyādvaśatyāyatam ||7 ṣaḍbhāgavistṛtaṃ kāryaṃ śarīraṃ martyajanmani| caturviṃśatibhāgān --- sārdhān kurvīta dairghyataḥ ||8 puruṣasyottamasyaitanmānamasmābhirīritam| madhyamasya tu sārdhaṃ syādvistārādbhāgapañcamam ||9 āyāmastasya tu prokto viṃśatiṃsviti ranvitā| kanīyasānāṃ kubjānāṃ vistārān pañcabhāgikā ||10 dairghyamasya vidhātavyastathā śarīrasya vistarā pañcabhāgikā| dairghyaṃ dvāviṃśatirbhāgā vapuṣo'sya praśasyate ||11 kāryāṃ śarīrasya kubjānāṃ vistārātpañcabhāgikam| dairghyamasya vidhātavyaṃ tathā bhāgaṃ śubhadaśa ||12 bhāgapañcakavistāraṃ vāmanānāṃ vapurbhavet| kurvīta sārdhān saptaiva bhāgān dairghyeṇa tadvatpunaḥ ||13 kiṃvāṃrāṇi proktaṃ pramāṇamidamedameva hi| prathamānaṃ tu vistāro vapuṣaoṃ'śacatuṣṭayam ||14 dairghyaido punamūsye bhāgaṣaṭkapramāṇataḥ| uktaṃ dehapramāṇasya bhāgasūtramidaṃ pṛthak ||15 devānāmasurāṇāṃ ca rākṣasānāṃ tathaiva ca| divyamānuṣamartyānāṃ kubjavāmanayorapi| kinnarāṇāṃ sabhūtānāṃ krameṇāsminnudāhṛtam ||16 itthamaṇḍaka vele ca vanaṃ kramaṃ| kāyamānamapi jātibhedataḥ || bhāvataśca kathitaṃ vibhājanmanā vayan| yalityākhyā stakhalu citravittamaḥ ||17 atha mānasamutpattiryathāvadabhidhīyate ||18 devānāṃ trīṇi rūpāṇi surajo --- kumbhakau| syāddivyamānuṣasyaikaṃ śarīraṃ divyamānuṣam ||19 asurāṇāṃ tridhā rūpaṃ cakramuttīrṇakaṃ tathā| durdaraḥ śakaṭaḥ kūrmatridivau iti dve rakṣasāṃ punaḥ ||20 puṃsāṃ rūpāṇi pañca syustānyucyante yathākramam| haṃsaḥ sāmāprarūcako bhaktāmālāvya eva ca ||21 kuyasvavidvidhau jñeyo meṣo vṛttakarastathā| vāmanāstrividhā jñeyāḥ sapiṇḍāsthānapadmakāḥ ||22 kūṣmāṇḍakarvaṭastiryak--- prathamataḥ| mayūraḥ kurvaṭaḥ kāśaḥ kinnarastrividho bhavet ||23 vālakāpauruṣī vṛttā --- daṇḍakā tathā| trayaḥ pañcadhā proktāḥ samastāścitravedibhiḥ ||24 bhadro mando mṛgo miśra iti hastī caturvidhaḥ| janmatastrividhaṃ prāhu gnidhirna rgirinadyūrukhāṃśrayam ||25 vividhā vājino rathya pārasāduttarāntataḥ| siṃhāścaturdhā śikharabiladgamatṛṇāravyayā ||26 vyālāḥ ṣoḍaśa nirdiṣṭā hariṇo gṛdhrakaḥ śukaḥ| kukkuṭaḥ siṃhaśārdūlavṛkājāgaṇḍakīgajāḥ ||27 kraḍāśvamahiṣaśvāno markaṭaḥ khara ityamī| esāmindamāsaṃ yaṃ yāmyanairṛtavāruṇai ||28 vāyavyāṃ saumyamityuktaṃ jajñipātamihavyadhāru| natastamiharbhāmaḥ śiṣadyā sūkaro'pi ca ||29 paśurgoḥ susumāruśca gajameṣaścaturmukha| turaṅgasiṃhaśārdūlameṣāścetyatra ṣoḍaśa ||30 jātasaṃstṛtiḥ || śuklavāsāḥ śucirdakṣaḥ strīśūdrā nabhilāṣukaḥ| sthāne karmārabhetaitadvibhakte saṃvṛte'pi ca ||31 ārambho devatārcānāṃ rohiṇyāmuttareṣu ca| sādhakaṃ vā bhavetyastu bhavārambho vidhīyate ||32 mukhaṃ bhāgena kurvīta grīvā vaktrāt tribhāgikā| oyamatanmukhaṃ jñeyaṃ keśāntaṃ dvādaśāṅgulam ||33 dvādaśaivāṅgulānyetadvistāreṇa punarbhavet| pravimānaṃ tribhāgena nāsikā ca tribhāgataḥ ||34 tribhāgena lalāṭaṃ syādutsedhāttrisamaṃ mukham| akṣiṇī dvyaṅgulāyāme tadardhādhyapi vistṛte ||35 tārakākṣitribhāgena kartavyā supratiṣṭhitā| tārakāyāstato madhye jyotistryaṃśena kalpayet ||36 bhravau vyakṣirāme kuryādakṣimāṃsayo| maṃkārāṇā syuruccātā samyagālikhet| evaṃ vidhānato yojyaṃ rūpajātamaśeṣataḥ ||37 jātīnāṃ vaśata iti pramāṇamuktaṃ| divādiṣvakhilamuktaṃ devāmidaṃ sphuṭaṃ viditvā| yaścitraṃ likhati bahuprakāramasmai| prādhānyaṃ vitarati citrakṛtsamūhaḥ ||38 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhāranāmni vāstuśāstre mānotpattirnāma pañcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ| <76> atha pratimālakṣaṇaṃ nāma ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ| pratimānāmatha brūmo lakṣaṇaṃ dra vyameva ca| suvarṇarūpyatāmrāḥ syurdārulekhāni śaktitaḥ ||1 citraṃ ceti vinirdiṣṭaṃ dra vyamarcāsu saptadhā| suvarṇaṃ puṣṭikṛdvidyādra jataṃ kīrtivardhanam ||2 prajāvivṛddhijaṃ tāmraṃ śaileyaṃ bhūjayāvaham| āyuṣyaṃ dāvaravaṃ dra vyaṃ lekhyacitre dhanāvahe ||3 prārabhed vidhinā prājño brahmacārī jitendri yaḥ| haviṣyaniyatāhāro japahomaparāyaṇaḥ ||4 śayāno dharaṇīpṛṣṭhe kuśāstaraṇe tadantaram| aprāptāyā dvayormadhyaṃ bhavetpañcākṣisammitam ||5 netraśravaṇayormadhyaṃ bhavedaṅgulapañcakam| karṇau cākṣisamau jñeyāvutsedhāddviguṇāyatau ||6 sākarṇapālī syānmadhyaṃ patpiṣyalyakṛkūṭayoḥ| dvibhāgolakāyatā piṣpalyāśritāṅgulavistṛtā ||7 aromaprabhavā jñeyā vyākṛṣṭadhanurākṛtiḥ| evampramāṇaṃ syādeṣāṃ karṇapṛṣṭhāśrayo'pi ca ||8 ūrdhvabandhādadhobandhaḥ karṇamūlasamāśritaḥ| adhyardhaṃ golakaṃ jñeyaḥ pṛṣṭhataścaivameva saḥ ||9 niṣpāvasadṛśākārā kartavyā karṇapippalī| āyāmenāṅgulaṃ sā syādvistāreṇa caturyavā ||10 pippalyādhātayormadhye lakāra iti saṃjñitaḥ| syādadhyardhāṅgulāyāmo vistāreṇa ca so'ṅgulam ||11 madhye lakāro nimnaḥ syānmānādyavacatuṣṭayam| mūle pippalikāyāḥ syācchrotracchidraṃ caturyavam ||12 yā golakārapīgūṣmo stūtiketi prakīrtitā| ardhāṅgulāyatā sā syādyavadvitayavistṛtā ||13 lakārāvartayormadhye pīyuṣī sā prakīrtitā| aṅguladvitayāyāmā vistṛtā sādhamaṅgulam ||14 karṇasya bāhyā rekhā yā tāmāvartaṃ pracakṣate| ṣaḍaṅgulapramāṇaḥ syādvakro vṛttāyataśca saḥ ||15 mūlāṃśo'rdhāṅgulaḥ kāryaḥ kramānmadhye yavadvayam| agre yavapramāṇaśca vistāreṇa vidhīyate ||16 lakārāvartayormadhyamuddhāta iti kīrtitam| adhobhāge --- pīyūṣyā vistāreṇa yavatrayam ||17 ūrdhvataḥ karṇavistāro golakād dviyavānvitaḥ| madhye ca dviguṇaṃ nālaṃ mūle mātrā saṣaḍyavā ||18 samudāyapramāṇe ṇolakadvitayāyataḥ| karṇaprasaptaḥ kartavyo nimnoccūmatavibhāgavān ||19 aṅgulaṃ paścimaṃ nālaṃ pūrvamardhāṅgulaṃ bhavet| kurvīta komale nāle kalā dvitayamāyate ||20 śravaṇasya vibhāgo'yaṃ parvāyathāvat parikīrtitaḥ| anyūnādhikamānaḥ syātpraśasto dūṣito'nyathā ||21 cibukaṃ dvyaṅgulāyāmaṃ tasyārdhamadharaṃ viduḥ| tadardhamuttaroṣṭhaḥ syādbhājī cārdhāṅgulocchrayā ||22 nāsāpuṭau tu vijñeyau caturthaṃ bhāgamoṣṭhayoḥ| tayoḥ prāntau tu kartavyau karavīrasamau śubhau ||23 tārakāntaḥsame caiva sṛkvaṇī paricakṣate| nāsikā syātpramāṇena caturaṅgulamāyatā ||24 puṭaprānte ca vistāro nāsāgrasyāṅguladvayam| vistāreṇāṅgulānyaṣṭau tadarthamapi cāyatam ||25 pramāṇaguṇasaṃyuktaṃ lalāṭaṃ parikīrtitam| ārabhya cibūkādyāvat keśāntaṃ paścimāttathā ||26 gaṇikantaṃ śiraso mānaṃ bhaveddvātriṃśadaṅgulam| --- karṇayormadhye maṣṭako'ṣṭādaśāṅgulaḥ ||27 --- grīvayoḥ parīṇāho viṃśatiścaturanvitā| grīvātaḥ syādurobhāga uraso nābhireva ca ||28 nāmendraṃ bhavedbhāgau dvāvubhayameva ca| ūrvoḥ same mate jaṅghe jānunī caturaṅgule ||29 caturdaśāṅgulau pādau smṛtāvāyāmamānataḥ| ṣaḍaṅgulau tu vistārādutsedhāccaturaṅgulau ||30 pañcāṅgulaparīṇāha aṅgulau tryaṅgulāyataḥ| aṅguṣṭhakasamā caiva syādāyāmātpradeśinī ||31 tasyāḥ ṣoḍaśabhāgena hīnā syānmadhyamāṅguliḥ| aṣṭabhāgena madhyāyā hīnāṃ vidyādanāmikām ||32 tasyāścaivāṣṭabhāgena hīnā jñeyā kaniṣṭhikā| pādonamaṅgulaṃ kuryādaṅguṣṭhasya nakhaṃ budhaḥ ||33 aṅgulīnāṃ nakhān kuryāt khaṃ pañcatryaṃśasaṃmitān| kurvītāṅgulakotsedhaṃ tribhyanvittamaṅgulām ||34 pradeśinyaṅgulotsedhā hīnā śeṣā yathākramam| jaṅghāmadhye parīṇāho bhavedaṣṭādaśāṅgulaḥ ||35 jānumadhye parīṇāhastvaṅgulānyekaviṃśatiḥ| tasyaiva saptamaṃ bhāgaṃ vidyājjānukapālakam ||36 ūrumadhye parīṇāho bhaveddvātriṃśadaṅgulaḥ| bhāgārdhamāśai vṛṣaṇau meḍhraṃ vṛṣaṇasaṃsthitam ||37 ṣaḍaṅgulaparīṇāhaṃ kośastu caturaṅgulaḥ| aṣṭādaśāṅgulamitā vistāreṇa kaṭirbhavet ||38 aṅgulārdhaṃ bhavennārīrodhovaśvāṅgulaṃ bhavet| nābhimadhye parīṇāhaḥ ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadaṅgulaḥ ||39 dvādaśāṅgulamātraṃ tu stanayorantaraṃ viduḥ| stanayorupariṣṭāttu kakṣaprāntau ṣaḍaṅgulau ||40 utsedhātpṛṣṭhavistāro viṃśatiścaturanvitā| urasaḥ saha pṛṣṭhena parīṇāhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||41 ṣaḍaṅgātparīmāṇādaṅgulānīti niścayaḥ| parīṇāhāccaturviṃśatyaṅgulāṣṭau ca vistṛtā ||42 grīvā kāryā bhujāyāmaḥ ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadaṅgulaḥ| parvoparitanaṃ bāhoḥ kāryamaṣṭādaśāṅgulam ||43 ṣoḍaśāṅgulamātraṃ tu dvitīyaṃ parva kathyate| bāhumadhye parīṇāho bhavedaṣṭādaśāṅgulaḥ ||44 pravāhostu parīṇāho bhavati dvādaśāṅgulaḥ| āyāmena talatvāpi kīrtito dvādaśāṅgulaḥ ||45 aṅgulīrahitaḥ prājñaiḥ saptāṅgula udāhṛtaḥ| pañcāṅgulāni vistīrṇo lekhālakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ ||46 pañcāṅgulāni mānena kartavyā madhyamāṅguliḥ| parvaṇo'rdhaṃ tu madhyāyā hīnāṃ vidyātpradeśinīm ||47 pradeśinīsamā caiva syādāyāmādanāmikā| parvārdhamānahīnā ca pramāṇena kaniṣṭhikā ||48 aṅgulīnāṃ nakhāḥ kāryāḥ sarve parvārdhasaṃmitāḥ| āyāmamātrametāsāṃ parīṇāhaṃ pracakṣate ||49 aṅguṣṭhakasya dairghyaṃ syādaṅgulānāṃ catuṣṭayam| pañcāṅgulaṃ parīṇāhaṃ spaṣṭacāruyavāṅkitaṃ ||50 tuṅgāsthamānaparyantāt kiñciddhīnā nakhā matāḥ| aṅguṣṭhakapradeśinyorantaraṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ bhavet ||51 strīṇāmapyevametatsyātstanorujaghanādhikam| trīṇi catvāri catvāri trīṇi catvāryathāpi ca ||52 ekādaśaikāḍaśa vā daśadhā viṃśatistrayam| viṃśatistrīṇi ca strīṇāṃ mānametat prakīrtitam ||53 kaniṣṭhaṃ mānametatsyānmadhyaṃ satryaṃśamaṣṭakam| palānāṣṭamakaṃ sārdhamuttamaṃ parikīrtitam ||54 urasaśca bhavettāsāṃ vistāro'ṣṭādaśāṅgulaḥ| kartavyaḥ kaṭivistāro viṃśati caturutāḥ| etatpramāṇamuddiṣṭaṃ pratimānāṃ samāsataḥ ||55 pramāṇametat sakalāśarāṇāmardhāstu nirdiṣṭamanukrameṇa | kāryaṃ sadā śilpibhiraṃśumatairyathocitadra vyasamudbhavāsu ||56 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhāranāmni vāstuśāstre pratimālakṣaṇaṃ nāma ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ| <77> atha devādirūpapraharaṇasaṃyogalakṣaṇaṃ nāma saptasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ| tridaśānāmathākārān brūmaḥ praharaṇāni ca| daityānāmatha yakṣāṇāṃ gandharvoragarakṣasām ||1 vidyādharapiśācānāṃ --- yathāyatham| brahmānalārciḥpratimaḥ kartavyaḥ sumahādyutiḥ ||2 sthūlāṅgaḥ śvetaṣuṣpaśca śvetaveṣṭanaveṣṭitaḥ| kṛṣṇājinottarīyaśca śvetavāsāścaturmukhaḥ ||3 daṇḍaḥ kamaṇḍaluścāsya kartavyo vāmahastayoḥ| akṣasūtradharastadvad mauñjyā mekhalayā vṛtaḥ ||4 kāryo vardhayamānastu jagad dakṣiṇapāṇinā| evaṃ kṛte tu loke kṣemaṃ bhavati sarvataḥ ||5 brāhmaṇārthavardhante sarvakāmairna saṃśayaḥ| yadā virūpādīnāṃ vā kṛrasodarī ||6 brāhmaṇairvā bhavedvarṇā sā neṣṭā bhayadāyinī| nihanti kārakaṃ raudrā dīnarūpā ca śilpinam ||7 kṛśā vyādhiṃ vināśaṃ ca kuryātkārayituḥ sadā| kṛśodarī tu durbhikṣaṃ virūpā cānapatyatām ||8 etān doṣān parityajya kartavyā sā suśobhanā| brahmaṇovārcā vidhānajñaiḥ prathame yauvane sthitā ||9 candrā ṅkitajaṭaḥ śrīmān nīlakaṇṭhaḥ susaṃyataḥ| vicitramukuṭaḥ śambhurniśākarasamaprabhaḥ ||10 dorbhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ caturbhivā vadhā yukto vā dorbhiraṣṭabhiḥ| paṭṭiśavyagrahastaśca pannagājinasaṃyutaḥ ||11 sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇo netratritayabhūṣaṇaḥ| evaṃvidhaguṇairyukto yatra lokeśvaro haraḥ ||12 parā tatra bhaved vṛddhirdeśasya ca nṛpasya ca| yadāraṇye samāne vā vidhīyeta maheśvaraḥ ||13 evaṃ rūpastadā kāryaḥ kārakasya śubhāvahaḥ| aṣṭādaśabhujo doṣṇāṃ viṃśatyā vā samanvitaḥ ||14 śatabāhuḥ kadācidvā sahasrabhuja eva ca| raudra rūpo gaṇavṛtaḥ siṃhacarmottarīyakaḥ ||15 tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrāgradaśanaḥ śiromālāvibhūṣitaḥ| candrā ṅkitaśirāḥ śrīmān pīnoraskogradarśanaḥ ||16 bhadra mū kartavyaḥ śmaśānastho maheśvaraḥ| dvibhujo rājadhānyāṃ tu pattane syāccaturbhujaḥ ||17 kartavyo viṃśatibhujaḥ śmaśānāraṇyamadhyagaḥ| eko'pi bhagavān bhadra sthānabhedavikalpitaḥ ||18 raudra saumyasvabhāvaśca kriyamāṇo bhavedbudhaiḥ| udyādyathā bhāvadbhāgabhagavān saumyadarśanaḥ ||19 sa eva tīkṣṇatāmeti madhyandinagataḥ punaḥ| tathāraṇyasthito nityaṃ raudro bhavati śaṅkaraḥ ||20 sa yeda saumyāvati sthāne saumyo vyavasthitaḥ| sthānānyetāni sarvāṇi jñātvā kimpuruṣādibhiḥ ||21 pramathaiḥ sahitaḥ kāryaḥ śaṅkaro lokaśaṅkaraḥ| etadyathāvatkathitaṃ saṃsthānaṃ tripuradruhaḥ ||22 kārttikeyasya saṃsthānamidānīmabhidhīyate| taruṇārkanibho raktavāsāḥ pāvakasaprabhaḥ ||23 īṣadbālākṛtiḥ kānto maṅgalyaḥ priyadarśanaḥ| prasannavadanaḥ śrīmānojastejonvitaḥ śubhaḥ ||24 viśeṣānmuṭukaiścitri muktāmaṇi bhūṣitaḥ| ṣaṇmukho vaikavaktro vā śaktiṃ rociṣmatīṃ dadhat ||25 nagare dvādaśabhujaḥ kheṭake ṣaḍbhujo bhavet| grāme bhujadvayopetaḥ kartavyaḥ śubhamicchatā ||26 śaktiḥ śarastathā khaḍgo musṛṇṭī mudgaro'pi ca| hasteṣu dakṣiṇeṣvetānyāyudhānyasya darśayet ||27 ekaḥ prasāritaścānyaḥ ṣaṣṭho hastaḥ prakīrtitaḥ| catuḥ patākā ghaṇṭā ca kheṭaḥ kukkuṭastathā ||28 vāmahasteṣu ṣaṣṭhastu tatra śojarjana karaḥ| evamāyudhasampannaḥ saṃgrāmastho vidhīyate ||29 avyayā tu vidhātavyaḥ krīḍālīlānvitaśca saḥ| chāgakukkuṭasaṃyuktaḥ śikhiyukto manoramaḥ ||30 nagareṣu sadā kāryaḥ skandaḥ parajayaiṣibhiḥ| kheṭake tu vidhātavyaḥ ṣaṇmukho jvalanaprabhaḥ ||31 tathā tīkṣṇāyudhopetaḥ sradgāmabhiralaṅkṛtaḥ| grāme'pi dvibhujaḥ kāryaḥ kāntidyutisamanvitaḥ ||32 dakṣiṇā ca bhavedbhaktirnāma haste tu kukkuṭaḥ| vicitrapakṣaḥ sumahān kartavyo'timanoharaḥ ||33 evaṃ pure kheṭake ca grāme vābhilaṃ śubham| kārttikeyaṃ --- kuryādācāryaḥ śāstrakovidaḥ ||34 aviruddheṣu kāryeṣu kheṭe yāgrāme purottame| kārttikeyasya saṃsthānametad yatnena kārayet ||35 bālastu subhujaḥ śrīmān sthale ketu mahādyutiḥ| vanamālākulorasko niśākarasamaprabhaḥ ||36 gṛhītasīramusalaḥ kāryo divyamadotkaṭaḥ| caturbhujaḥ saumyavakro nīlāmbarasamāvṛtaḥ ||37 mukuṭālaṅkṛtaśiroroho rāgavibhūṣitaḥ| revatīsahitaḥ kāryo vanadevaḥ pratāpavān ||38 viṣṇurvaidūryasaṅkāśaḥ pītavāsāḥ śriyākṛtaḥ| varāho vāmanaśca syānnarasiṃho bhayānakaḥ ||39 kāryo vā dāśarathī rāmo jāmadagnyaśca vīryavān| dvibhujo'ṣṭabhujo vāpi caturbāhurarindamaḥ ||40 śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇirojasvī kāntisaṃyutaḥ| nānārūpastu kartavyo jñātvā kāryāntaraṃ vibhuḥ ||41 ityeṣa viṣṇuḥ kathitaḥ surāsvaranamasvaranamastvataḥ| tridaśeśaḥ sahasrākṣo vajrabhṛtsubhujo balī ||42 kirīṭī sagadaḥ śrīmāñśvetāmbaradharastathā| śroṇisūtreṇa mahā divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ||43 kāryo rājaśriyā yuktaḥ purohitasahāyavān| vaivasvatastu vijñeyaḥ kāleḥ kesaṃ parāyaṇaḥ ||44 tejasā sūryasaṅkāśo jāmbūnadavibhūṣitaḥ| sampūrṇacandra vadanaḥ pītavāsāstuḥ śubhekṣaṇaḥ ||45 vicitramukuṭaḥ kāryo varāṅgadavibhūṣitaḥ| tejasā sūryasaṅkāśaḥ kartavyo balavāñchubhaḥ ||46 dhanvantarirbharadvājaḥ prajānīyatayastathā| dakṣārthāḥ sadṛśāḥ kāryā kāryo rūpāṇi --- rapi ||47 arciṣmān jvalanaḥ kāryaḥ yatkaṇṭhāśvasamīraṇaḥ| saumyaḥ kāryastathā visyā--- rudra śarīriṇaḥ ||48 raktavastradharāḥ kṛṣṇā nānābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ| kartavyā rākṣasāḥ sarve bahupraharaṇānvitāḥ ||49 pūrṇacandra mukhā śubhrā bimboṣṭhī cāruhāsinī| śvetavastradharā kāntā divyālaṅkārabhūṣitā ||50 kaṭideśaniviṣṭena vāmahastena śobhanā| sapadmena vāntena dakṣiṇena śucismitā ||51 kartavyā śrīḥ prasannāsyā prathame yauvane sthitā| gṛhītaśūlaparighapāhikāpaṭṭisadhvajā ||52 bibhrāṇā kheṭakopetalaghukhaḍgaṃ ca pāṇinā| ghaṇṭāmekāṃ ca sauvarṇīṃ dadhatī ghorarūpiṇī ||53 kauśikī pītakauśeyavasanā siṃhavāhanā| secoṣṭau --- vidhātavyāḥ śuklāmbaradharāḥ --- ||54 śobhamānāśca mukuṭairnānāratnavibhūṣitaiḥ| sadṛśāvaśvinau kāryau lokasya śubhadāyakau ||55 śuklamālyāmbaradharau jāmbūnadavibhūṣitau| tripañcadaśapūtirasyedaṃ bhṛṅgavanmecakaprabhām ||56 vaidūryaśakaṃsaṅkāśā haritaśmaśravo'pi ca| rohitā vikṛtā raktalocanā bahurūpiṇaḥ ||57 nāgaiḥ śiroruhālīnairvirāgābharaṇāmbarāḥ| kāryāḥ piśācā bhūtāśca paruṣāsatyavādinaḥ ||58 bahuprakāramandahā virūpā vikṛtānanāḥ| ghorarūpā vidhātavyā hrasvā nānāsudhāśca te ||59 subhīmavikramā bhīmā saṅghā yajñopavītinaḥ| varmabhiḥ śāṭikācitrairbhūtāḥ kāryāḥ sadā budhaiḥ ||60 ye'pi noktā vidhātavyāste'pi kāryānurūpataḥ| yasya yasya ca yalliṅgamasurasya surasya ca ||61 yakṣarākṣasayorvāpi nānā gandharvayorapi| tena liṅgena kāryaḥ sa yathā sādhuvijānatā ||62 prāyeṇa vā vīryavanto hi dānavāḥ krūrakarmiṇaḥ| kirīṭinaśca kartavyā vividhāyudhapāṇayaḥ ||63 tebhyo'pīṣatkanīyāṃso daityāḥ kāryā guṇairapi| daityebhyaḥ parihīṇāstu yakṣāḥ kāryā madotkaṭāḥ ||64 hīnāstebhyo'pi gandharvā gandharvebhyo'pi pannagāḥ| nāgebhyo rākṣasā hīnāḥ krūravikrimatasūṣiṇaḥ ||65 vidyādharāśca yakṣebhyo hīnadehadharāḥ smṛtāḥ| citramālyāmbaradharāścitracarmāsipāṇayaḥ ||66 nānāveṣadharā ghorā bhūtasaṅghā bhayānakāḥ| piśācebhyo'dhikāḥ sthūlāstejasā paruṣāstathā ||67 anyūnādhikarūpāṃśca kurvīta prāyaśaḥ śubhān| divyairāsaṇābharaṇaiśca yuktāḥ| kṛtīthavidadhīta yathoditāṃstān ||68 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhāranāmni vāstuśāstre devādirūpapraharaṇasaṃyogalakṣaṇādhyāyo nāma saptasaptatitamaḥ| <78> atha doṣaguṇanirūpaṇaṃ nāmāṣṭasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ| atha varjyāni rūpāṇi brūmahe'rcādikarmasu| yathoktaṃ śāstratattvajñairgobrāhmaṇāhitārthibhiḥ ||1 aśāstrajñena ghaṭitaṃ śilpinā doṣasaṃyutam| api mādhuryasampannaṃ grāhyaṃ śāstravedibhiḥ ||2 aśliṣṭasandhiṃ vibhrāntāṃ vakrāṃ cāvanatāṃ tathā| asthitāmunnatāṃ caiva kākajaṅghāṃ tathaiva ca ||3 pratyaṅgahīnāṃ vikaṭāṃ madhye granthinatāṃ tathā| īdṛśīṃ devatāṃ prājño hi tārthaṃ naiva kārayet ||4 aśliṣṭasandhyā maraṇaṃ bhrāntayā sthānavibhramam| vakrayā kalahaṃ vidyānnatayāmivasaḥ kṣayam ||5 nityamasthitayā puṃsāmarthasya kṣayamādiśet| bhayamunnatayā vidyāddhṛdro gaṃ ca na saṃśayaḥ ||6 deśāntareṣu gamanaṃ satataṃ kākajaṅghayā| pratyaṅgahīnayā nityaṃ bhartuḥ syādanapatyatā ||7 vikaṭākārayā jñeyaṃ bhayaṃ dāruṇamardhayā| adhomukhyā śirorogaṃ tathānayāpi ca ||8 etairupetā doṣairyā varjayettāṃ prayatnataḥ| anyairapi yutāṃ doṣairarcāṃ brūmo'tha samprati ||9 udbaddhapiṇḍikā sāsisāsi svāmino duḥkhamāvahet| kukṣiṣṭiprāya durbhikṣaṃ rogān kubjārcitā nṛṇām ||10 pāśvahīnā tu bhavati rājyasyāśubhadarśanī| śālāyāsanayā sthānaṃ strīśra pratimayā bhavet ||11 āsanālayahīnāyāṃ bandhanaṃ sthānavicyutiḥ| nānākāṣṭhasamāyuktā yā caivāyasapiṇḍitā ||12 sandhibhiḥ pravisahiryā sānarthabhayadā bhavet| sambandhākṛṣṭalohena trapuṇā vā kadācana ||13 dāruṇā ca tathaivoktā pratimāyāstu śāstravedibhiḥ| sandhayaścāpi kartavyāḥ suśliṣṭāḥ puṣṭimicchatā ||14 arcanāma dharādhena śāstradṛṣṭavidhānataḥ| badhnīyāttāmralohena suvarṇarajatena vā ||15 kṛtena keṇunā cānyathā stusāmabadvāvarujāvahā| tasmātsarvaprayatnena sthapatiḥ śāstrakovidaḥ ||16 kuryādarcāṃ yathānyāyaṃ suvibhaktāṃ pramāṇataḥ| na kṣatā nopadigāṃ ca na ca vivarjitā ||17 na pratyaṅgaiḥ prahīnaṃ ca ghāṇapādairnakhādibhiḥ| subibhaktāṃ yathotsedhāṃ prasannavadanāṃ śubhām ||18 nigūḍhasandhikaraṇāṃ samāyatimṛjusthitām| īdṛśāṃ rāṇāyedarghāṃ pramāṇaguṇasaṃyutām ||19 samopacitamāṃsāṅgāḥ puruṣāḥ syuḥ samāsataḥ| pramāṇalakṣaṇayutā vastraratnavibhūṣitaḥ ||20 kṣānta guṇān parikalpya ca doṣajāta- marcāṃ yathoditaguṇāṃ vidadhītā matūnyā || śiṣyatvametya vividhamupāsate'nye| taṃ śilpinaḥ kṛtaghyeyaśca muhuḥ stuvanti ||21 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhāranāmni vāstuśāstre doṣaguṇādhyāyo nāmāṣṭasaptatitamaḥ| <79> atha ṛjvāgatādisthānalakṣaṇaṃ nāmaikonāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ| ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi nevisthānavidhikramam| saṃpātyārughāṇāṃ hi jāyante nava vṛttayaḥ ||1 pūrvabhṛṣkāgataṃ teṣāṃ tato'rdhvaṃ kṣaragataṃ bhavet| tataḥ śacīkṣataṃ vidyādadhyardhākṣamanantaram ||2 catvāryūrdhvāgatādīni parāvṛttāni tāni ca| ṛjvāgataparāvṛttaṃ tato'rdharjvāgatādikam ||3 śacīkṛt parāvṛttaṃ tato'dhyardhākṣapūrvakam| pārśvāgataṃ ca navamaṃ sthānaṃ bhittikavigraham ||4 ṛjvardhaṛjunormadhye catvāri vyantarāṇi ca| ardharjusācīkṛtayormadhye ca vyantaratrayam ||5 dvyardhārjvā sācīkṛtayormadhye dve vyantare pare| parodvyardhakṣapārśva vyantaraṃ caikamantare ||6 ṛjvāgataparāvṛttapārśvābhyāgatayordaśa| antare vyantarāṇi syuḥ sthānakānyaparāṇyapi ||7 ṛjvāgatādyaṃ madhyaṃ ca vigrahaṃ venvā---| ṛjvāgatāṃ --- śeṣabhāvyantarā vyayā ||8 ardhāpāṅgamardhapuṭamardhārdhapuṭameva ca| ardharjvaṃse'pi kathitaṃ silīdavyantaraṃ vyayaḥ ||9 ardhasācīkṛtaṃ caiva svastikaṃ ca tataḥ param| sācīkṛtośe dvāvuktāvaṃśau dvyardhākṣasaṃjñite ||10 dvyardhākṣāṃśaparāvṛttaṃ dvyardhākṣāṃsaṃ ca te ubhe| dvijvākṣe vyantare prokte citraśāstraviśāradaiḥ ||11 ṛjvāgatādadhyardhākṣaṃ yathā proktāni saṃjñayā| vyantarāṇi tathaiva syuḥ parāvṛtte yathākramam ||12 vaicitryaṃ bhittike nāstītyeva citravicitryaṃ vivido viduḥ| ekānnatriṃśadevaṃ ca sthānāni vyastavartmanā ||13 vaitastyamantaraṃ sthāpyaṃ pādayoḥ supratiṣṭhitam| hikkāyāṃ pādayoścāntabhūmau lambe pratiṣṭhite ||14 proktamṛjvāgataṃ pūrvaṃ pramāṇena nirūpitam| tato'rdharjvāgatasyedaṃ pramāṇamupalakṣayet ||15 brahmasūtraṃ tu kartavyaṃ mukhasyaiva tu madhyagam| netrarekhāsamatvena tiryaktālo bhavenmukham ||16 apāṅgasyākṣikūṭasya karṇasya ca bhavetkṣayaḥ| anyatra karṇamānaṃ syādardhāṅgulaviśeṣitam ||17 dṛksūtre brahmalekhāyā apare syātkalāhavam| yacchamātrāśrupātokṣi kṣīyatānyopavastathā ||18 triyavāḥ śvetabhāgaḥ syāttārā ca proktamānataḥ| vistāraḥ śvetabhāgaśca karavīro'pi coktavat ||19 parabhāḥ karavīraṃ syādbrahmasūtrāttathāṅgulam| pūrvabhākaravīrāttu saṅgamaścāṅgulaṃ bhavet ||20 karṇanetrāntaraṃ proktaṃ kalādhyārdhāṅgulādhikā| pūrvakū sarvadisyāvikṣāyatkathayetparām ||21 puṭo'ṅgulaṃ brahmasūtrātkapolād dvyaṅgulaṃ bhavet| pūrve paratra mātrārdhaṃ puṭaḥ syāccheṣamuktavat ||22 parabhāgāntarāṣṭa syādaṅgulaṃ dviyavādhikam| adharaḥ parabhāge tu yavaṣaṭkaṃ vidhīyate ||23 adharāntā kalā gaṇḍo brahmasūtrāt punarhanuḥ| parabhāge'ṅgulaṃ sārdhaṃ mukhalekhāṅgulaṃ tataḥ ||24 āruḍa vā yatkāryaṃ mukhayāṃ paryatalekhayā| parivartasukhādeśā jñātvā kāryā prayatnataḥ ||25 apādamadhyaṃ hi jñātaḥ sūtre'nyasmin pravartite| khare lupyeta turyāṃśaḥ pūrvetvevāvivardhate ||26 kakṣādharaḥ pare bhāge sūtrataḥ pañcagolakaḥ| pūrvabhāge tṛtaṃ vidyātṣaḍgolaparimāṇataḥ ||27 madhye sūtrāt pārśvalekhā --- gāvaccatuṣkalam| uraso madhyamāt sūtrātkakṣā syānnavamābhavā ||28 dgaṃtalekhāttasmātvaṃ vidhākalatrayam| stanāḥ pārśvakalāṃ kuryātstanaṃ vā patamaṇḍalam ||29 parato hastakaḥ kāryaḥ karmayogānusārataḥ| pārśvaparyanta sarvā bhāge ṣaṣaṃḍalālam ||30 tathaiva pūrvahastasya yathāyogaṃ prakalpanā| abhyayasvāga --- dīnāṃ kriyā syāddakṣiṇe kare ||31 madhye ṣaḍaṅgulā rekhā bāhyasūtrātpare bhavet| pūrvasmin bāhyalekhā to madhye syādaṣṭamātrakā ||32 nābhideśe pare bhāge bāhyāsau saptamātrakā| kalāmātraṃ bhavennābhistasyāḥ pūrvaṃ navāṅgulā ||33 pare bhāge kaṭiḥ sapta mātrā daśa ca pūrvataḥ| ūrulekhā pare bhāge mukhamānasya madhyataḥ ||34 prāgbhāgasya bahirlekhā ----parajānutaḥ| parabhāgendra vāsteśca sūtrasyāttadvadaṅgule ||35 parasya nalakasya syāllekhā prāgaṅgulāntare| parabhāgasya ṣaṣṭhāṃśāḥ sūtrā prāgaṅguladvayoḥ ||36 nalena parapādasya bhūmilekhā vidhīyate| tato'ṅguṣṭho'ṅgulenādhaḥ pārṣṇirūrdhvaṃ tadardhataḥ ||37 aṅguṣṭhāgraṃ brahmasūtrātparasmin pañcamātrakam| talaṃ ca parabhāgajñaistiryak pañcāṅgulaṃ smṛtam ||38 satvitastalaghāṣpyeḥ syādaṅguṣṭhāgraṃ kalātraye| aṅgulyo'ṅguṣṭhataḥ sarvā vrajatparayaṃ kramāt ||39 sanniveśasavāsāda dviraṅgulyato navāṅgulaḥ| yathoktaṃ jānu pūrvaṃ syātsūtrataścaturaṅgule ||40 nalakastadvadevāsya nalakau tryaṅgulāntarau| sūtrādakṣaḥ kalāstisrāṅguṣṭhastvaṅgulatrayam ||41 bhūmisūtrād gato'dhastātpūrvāṅguṣṭho bhavet kalā| aṅguṣṭho'ṅgulayaśceti sarvamanyadyathoditam ||42 dṛśyapārśvatalapravipāraṃhau madhyame talam| evamuktapramāṇena jñātvā yuktyā samādiśet ||43 ardharjvāgatamityetatpravaraṃ sthānamīritam| lakṣma sācī kṛtasyātha sthānakasyābhidhīyate ||44 vinyasyedbrahmasūtraṃ prāksthānabodhasya siddhaye| lalāṭaṃ parabhāge syātkeśalekhā tathā kalā ||45 parabhāgabhruvo lekhā --- rdhamudāhṛtā| paratā --- kṣilekhāyāṃ kālikā dviyato jñata ||46 jyotiṣaḥ syātpare bhāge tārā dṛśyā yavonmitā| yavamātraṃ tato jyotistasmāttārā yavadvayam ||47 śvetaṃ ca karavīraṃ ca tataḥ prāguktamānataḥ| kanīlikā tu nāsāyā mūlaṃ vidyādyavāntaram ||48 nāsāmūlaṃ pramāṇena tato jñeyaṃ yavatraye| brahmasūtrātpūrvabhāge nagantordhvagolakau ||49 āpāṅgaṃ stātreto vidyāddvigolakamite'ntare| tasmādbhāgena karṇāntaḥ karṇaḥ syādvistareṇa tu ||50 dviyavonā kalā cakṣurvyāvṛttyā parivardhitaḥ| pūrvasya karavīreṇa saha śvaityaṃ yavatrayam ||51 dvitīyaśvaityadṛktārāprasṛtiḥ proktamānataḥ| kapolalekhā parato yavadvā tā kalā bhavet ||52 brahmasūtrānnāsikāgraṃ parasmin saptabhiryavaiḥ| nāsāpuṭaḥ pūrvabhāge syādyavādhikamaṅgulam ||53 pūrve bhāge yavaṃ gojī tatropānte vidhīyate| parabhāgottaroṣṭhaḥ syātpramāṇenārdhamātrakaḥ ||54 triyavaścādharoṣṭhaḥ syāccheṣaścāpacayastayoḥ| pālyā madhye bhavet sūtraṃ pālyāstu cibukaṃ pare ||55 hanuparyantalekhā ca sūtrādardhāṅgule bhavet| hanormadhyagataṃ sūtraṃ pare syātparimaṇḍalam ||56 sahaikasūtre paradṛkparyantena parisphuṭā| mukhaparyantalekhārdhe hanorupari cādharaḥ ||57 kuryāllekhābhiretābhiḥ parabhāgaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ| sūtrāṅgulordhvamātrāyāṃ tasmād grīvā yathoditā ||58 sūtrasaṃyogātpūrvasminnaṅgule sayave'ṅgulaḥ| hikkādhyardhāṅgulaṃ sūtrātpūrve syātsupratiṣṭhitā ||59 bāhyalekhā hi tatsūtrātparasminnaṅgulāṣṭake| tāleṃ yavonagrīvāto nagrīvajñeyausūnadūrvakau ||60 hikkāsūtrātsamārabhya vakṣobhāgo'grikaṃ bhavet| tāvanmātre tarevāhu tasmātprabhṛti nirdiśet ||61 hikkāsūtrātpare bhāge stanaścāṅgulapañcake| rekhāntasūcakaḥ kāryo maṇḍalaṃ sārdhamaṅgulam ||62 tasmādanantaraṃ bāhyabhāgamātraṃ vinirdiśet| hikkāsūtrāt samārabhya stanaḥ pūrvaṣaḍaṅgule ||63 stanātṣaḍaṅgule tiryagakṣo smā dvau dvibhāgikaḥ| kakṣato dvikale'dhastādbāhyalekhā vidhīyate ||64 ābhyantarā bāhyalekhā stanātpañcāṅgule tale'ntare| brahmasūtrācca bhāgena madhyabhāge parividuḥ ||65 madhyāttvakalayāvahaḥ pare tiryagvibhajyate| madhyaprāntaḥ pūrvabhāge bhavetsūtrāddaśāṅgulaḥ ||66 tiryaṅnābhipradeśaḥ syātparato brahmasūtrataḥ| yavaiścaturbhiradhikamaṅgulānāṃ catuṣṭayam ||67 pūrvabhāge vinirdiṣṭaḥ sa evaikādaśāṅgulaḥ| madhyenaiti parasyoroḥ sūtraṃ nābhyantarāśritam ||68 prayātyaparajāccaitāt pūrvataḥ kalayā ca tat| jānvadhobhāgataścārdhakalayā triyavena ca ||69 jaṅghāmadhyena lekhāyāḥ prasaktaṃ nalakasya tu| ṣāṃte vairavaṃ parataścaturbhiḥ sūtramiṣyate ||70 anenaivānusāreṇa bahirlekhā vidhīyate| brahmasūtrātpare bhāge kaṭiraṅgulapañcake ||71 tāmālamātrā tu sā pūrthe meḍāgraṃ sūtrasaṅgatam| sūtrādarabhāgorū mūlāgraye ||72 sūtrādaparabhāgorumadhye rekhā kalādvaye| sūtrātpūrvorumūlaṃ syātpūrvataḥ kalayā tathā ||73 kalādvayena vijñeyā rekhā pūrvasya jānatuḥ| sārdhāṅgulayavaṃ jānu tatpārśvaṃ cārdhamaṅgulam ||74 sūtreṇa pādasya madhyarekhā vibhajyate| ādimadhyāntalekhāyāṃ sūtraśaucamudāhvatā ||75 sūtrātprāgbhāgamalake prāntaḥ pañcabhiraṅgulaiḥ| ardhāṅgulaṃ kṣayaḥ kāryaḥ parabhāgorujaṅghayoḥ ||76 parākṣimadhyagaṃ sūtraṃ lambabhūbhipratiṣṭhitam| parapādatanāntātprāgaṅgulena vidhīyate ||77 --- sūtrātpūrvapādasya talamaṣṭāṅgulaṃ bhavet| adhastāt talayoḥ sūkṣmā syāllekhāṣṭādaśāṅgulam ||78 aṅguṣṭhakādra kamāt pradeśinyaṅgulādhikā| parapādatalāvastūn pūrvā hyaṅguṣṭhamūlagam ||79 sūtraṃ yathāti sā bhūmilekheti parikīrtitā| sūtrādardhāṅgulenordhvaṃ tasmātpārṣṇi parasya ca ||80 aṅguṣṭhādaṅgulīpātaḥ pūrvapāde'nusārataḥ| upapradeśinīmānātkuryādatra pradeśinīm ||81 aparāścāṅgulīḥ sarvāḥ krameṇa kṣapayettataḥ| iti sācīkṛtaṃ sthānametaduktaṃ yathārthataḥ ||82 adhyardhākṣamidānīṃ ca sthānakaṃ sū pracakṣate| brahmasūtramukhe kṛtvā mānamātraṃ vidhīyate ||83 keśāntalekhā sūtrātsyānmātraikā yavasaṃyutā| pṛthagvakṣaḥ pṛthak śroṇiḥ vṛttaḥvāhaḥ susaṃskṛtiḥ ||84 bhadrā kāro bhaved bhadro vṛttavaktraḥ svabhāvataḥ| mālavyasya bhavenmūrdhā pramāṇenāṅgulatrayam ||85 caturmātralalāṭaṃ ca nāśa vaktrāśirodharā| mātrā dvādaśa vakṣesye nābhimeḍhrāntarodare ||86 aṣṭādaśāṅgulau corū jaṅghe apyevameva hi| caturaṅgulakau --- jānunī caturaṅgule ||87 mālavyasyāyamāyāmaḥ ṣaṇṇavatyaṅgulo mataḥ| vistāro vakṣasastasya mātrāḥ ṣaḍviṃśatiḥ smṛtaḥ ||88 bāhvoḥ ṣoḍaśamātraśca prabāhvorevameva saḥ| pārṣṇyau dvādaśamātrasye mālavyastveha vistutiḥ ||89 pīnāṃso dīrghabāhuśca pṛthuvakṣāḥ kṛśodaraḥ| vṛttorukaṭijaṅghaśca mālavaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||90 haṃsasya vakraṃ pṛthugaṇḍabhāgaṃ| kṛśaṃ śaśasyāyatamāsyamāhuḥ| vistāradairghyādbhavakasya tulyaṃ| sukhaṃ suvṛttaṃ tvihaca bhadra vakre ||91 syānmālāvasyā lepanaṃ tu kāntamayojyaṃ | dehī tu rūpaiśca bhavanti yuktāste karmaṇi sarvaguṇānvitāste ||92 sa durlabhaṃ syātpuruṣaḥ prameya-| māno'sti kīrṇa iti ha ṣaṣṭaḥ ||93 māṃsalena śarīreṇa grīvāsirā ayā ---| māṃsalāyātaśākhā ca nārī vṛtteti sā matā ||94 pṛthuvaktrā kaṭīhrasvā hrasvagrīvā pṛthūdarī| puṃvatkāṇḍakatulyā syātsā nārī pauruṣī matā ||95 alpakāyaśirogrīvā laghuśākhā bhavecca yā| kṛśālpabrahmasattvā ca sā nārī bālakī smṛtā ||96 puṃsparśātpaśyatā yā syātkaumāre prāptayauvanā| anyā sā bālakī proktā strīlakṣaṇavicakṣaṇaiḥ ||97 bhuvaḥ sadviyavāmātrā lekhā kṛśayavāṅgulāḥ| daktoyamantare vartma tārāya ardhamālikhet ||98 svaityaṃ caturyavaṃ dṛśyaśeṣaṃ sā tiraskṛtam| kapotarekhā parato yavavarjitamaṅgulam ||99 sūtrāpūrvapaṭāntaḥ syādardhāṅgulamitentare| nāsikānto'ṅgulaṃ sūtrātpare pūrvetapāṅgulam ||100 mūle nāsāpuṭaḥ sādraḥ sūtraṃ gojyāśca madhyagam| yavārdhamātrā gojī syāduttaroṣṭhaḥ parasya yaḥ ||101 sa brahmasūtrādārabhya vijñeyo dviyavonmitaḥ| pare tvadhastānnāsāyā rekhā cārdhāṅgulairbhavet ||102 parabhāge'dharoṣṭhasya pramāṇaṃ --- yavaṃ matam| hanuparyantalekhāyā madhye sūtraṃ pratiṣṭhitam ||103 sūtrātprākkaravīraḥ syād dviyavonāṅguladvayam| yavārdhaṃ sa ca dṛśyeta śvaityaṃ sārdhayavaṃ tataḥ ||104 --- tārā triyavā jñeyā śeṣamuktapramāṇataḥ| karṇāvartādadhaḥ karṇamadhyabhāgena saṃmitam ||105 dvyaṅgulaḥ karṇavistāraḥ karṇāvartāccaturyave| śiraḥpṛṣṭhasya lekhā syāditi jñātvoktamācaret ||106 karṇasūtrād bahirgrīvā vidhātavyaikamaṅgulam| galo grīvā ca hikkā ca sūtrād prāgaṅgulottare ||107 hikkāsūtrādbhavedūrdhvamaṃsalekhā tathāṅgulam| brahmasūtrātpare bhāge syādaṃso'ṅgulasaṃmite ||108 vakṣo'ṅgulaṃ brahmāsūtrāṃ --- nasti kālāntare| bhāgamātre bhavetkakṣāsūtrātpūrvaḥ stanasya ca ||109 kakṣātistrikalaṃ yāvatpārśvalekhā vidhīyate| dūrāgrabhujastasyādagre karmānusārataḥ ||110 prāsādamadhyaḥ sūtraḥ syādekādaśabhiraṅgulaiḥ| parabhāgasya madhyasta sūtrātsyādaṅgulaistribhiḥ ||111 aṅgulena pare bhāge sūtrato nābhiriṣyate| nābherudaralekhā tu vijñātavyāṅgulatraye ||112 śroṇī karṇo bhavennābhe mukhamardhāṅgulānvitam| brahmasūtrātkaṭiḥ pūrve tribhāgā tryaṅgulā pare ||113 brahmasūtrāśrita meḍhrastale cā parato bhavet| pūrvoktaḥ madhyabhekhāsyātsūtrātpratyaṅgulyantare ||114 tasyaiva mūlarekhā ca sūtrātprāg dvyaṅgulentare| mūlalekhā parasyoroḥ sūtrātsyāddvikale'ntare ||115 paryantajānuno bhāge paryantoparā jānutaḥ| parabhāgikā jātardve sūtrasya samyakpratiṣṭhitam ||116 jānumadhye gatā lekhā bāhyalekhāśritā bhavet| adhyardhamātraṃ jānu syādadholekhā tu tasya yā ||117 ardhāṅgulena sā sūtrātpūrvataḥ pravidhīyate| sūtrātpare parāṅguṣṭhaṃ mūlapādonamaṅgulam ||118 mūlādaṅguṣṭhakasyāgraṃ sārdhaiḥ syādaṅgulaistribhiḥ| sūtrātparaṃ syājjaṅghāyā lekhāṅgulacatuṣṭaye ||119 tasyāstu pūrvajaṅghāyā lekhā syādaṅguladvaye| pūrvajānu kalāmānaṃ śeṣaṃ kuryādyathoditam ||120 parapādatale stambhaṃ yattiryaksupratiṣṭhitam| tatprākpradelasyordhva sārdhayā kalayā bhavet ||121 prāgbhaṅgo'ṅguṣṭhamūlecchastatrāsvīyā kaniṣṭhikā| kalāmātraṃ nijāṅguṣṭhādaṃdhāsāgaṃ prapadyate ||122 yatparāṅgulambasūtraṃ pratipadyate| yatparāṅguṣṭhamūlotthaṃ lambasūtraṃ prapadyate| madhyena pūrvabhāgāpti sabandhāṅguṣṭhakasya tat ||123 pūrvapāṣṇitalādūrdhvaṃ vidadhyādaṅgulatraye| pāṣṇeḥ parasya pādasya pūrvapādaṃ tiraskṛtam ||124 adhyardhākṣaṃ yathāśāstramevaṃ sthānakamālikhet| atha pārśvāgataṃ nāmasthānaṃ pañcamamucyate ||125 vyāvartitamukhasyānte brahmasūtraṃ vidhīyate| lalāṭabāhyalekhāṃ ca sūtraspṛṣṭāṃ pradarśayet ||126 sūtrāttu nāsikāvaṃśaḥ saṃvṛddhya dvākṣamānataḥ| apāṅgo dvikale sūtrātkarṇo yaṃśāt kalādvaye ||127 karṇo dvyaṅgulavistāraḥ śiraḥpṛṣṭhaṃ kalā tataḥ| asya madhyagataṃ sūtramāsyārdhaṃ sthāpayet tataḥ ||128 aṅgule cibukaṃ sūtrāddhanumadhyaṃ caturyave| sārdhāṅgule tataḥ kaṇṭhavartigrīvāṅgale nataḥ ||129 aṅgulena tato hikkā caturbhirbrahmasūtrataḥ| mūrdhnā śravaṇapālyantenaiti sūtraṃ taducyate ||130 grīvāyāṅgulyamadhyena madhyasūtraṃ taducyate| bhāge hikkāmadhyasūtrādaṇḍamūlaṃ kalādvaye ||131 mātrāṣṭake ca pṛṣṭhaṃ to hṛllekhāpyevameva hi| stanasya maṇḍalaṃ tasmādaṅgulena vidhīyate ||132 kakṣā ca pūrvabhāge syātsūtrāt paścabhiraṅgulaiḥ| mātrātrayeṇāparasmin bhāge kakṣā vidhīyate ||133 ubhayorantayoḥ prāhurmadhyamaṣṭāṅgulaṃ budhāḥ| aṅgulairdaśabhirmadhyaṃ paryanto madhyasūtrataḥ ||134 madhyapṛṣṭhaṃ caturbhiḥ syānnābhipṛṣṭhaṃ ca pañcabhiḥ| nābhyantarekhā navabhiḥ kaṭipṛṣṭhaṃ kalātraye ||135 udaraprāntalekhā ca jñeyā daśabhiraṅgulaiḥ| māṃ mā bhrātrayeṇābhiraṣṭābhi sūtrāt sphijo madhyaṃ pracakṣate ||136 vastiśīrṣe ca navabhiḥ sphiganto'ṣṭabhiraṅgulaiḥ| aṣṭabhirmeḍhramūlaṃ syādūrumadhyaṃ ca saptabhiḥ ||137 aṅgulaiḥ pañcabhirmūlamūroḥ pārśvātyamucyate| caturbhiraṅgulaiḥ sārdhaiḥ karamadhyaṃ ca pṛṣṭhataḥ ||138 agrataḥ pañcabhiḥ sārdhaistadeva prāhuraṅgulaiḥ| karamadhyāṅgulairmadhyaṃ sūtramadhye vidhīyate ||139 jānvardhe madhyasūtraṃ syādbhāgo lekhā ca jānutaḥ| bhavedubhayataḥ sūtraṃ jaṅghā madhye ca kīrtatā ||140 jaṅgha ṣaḍaṅgulā sūtraṃ madhye syānnalakasya ca| ubhayoḥ pārśvayoḥ kāryo nalakaścāṅguladvayam ||141 caturbhiraṅgulaiḥ pārṣṇirmadhyasūtrādvidhīyate| yathoktamānenāṅgulyastathā pādatalaṃ bhavet ||142 pārśvāgatamidaṃ proktaṃ sthānaṃ bhittikasaṃjñakam| pārśvāgatasthānam || ataḥ paraṃ parāvṛttasthānakānyabhidadhmahe ||143 ṛjvā gataparāvṛttaṃ tatrādāvabhidhīyate| tatrāṅguladvayaṃ karṇau vidhātavyau pṛthakpṛthak ||144 pārṣṇiparyantayormadhyaṃ tathā saptāṅgulaṃ bhavet| aṅgulatritayaṃ sārdhaṃ pārṣṇī kāryau pṛthakpṛthak ||145 kaniṣṭhānāmikāmadhyā darśayeccaturaṅgulī| aṅguṣṭhānāmikāmadhyākaniṣṭhāvalikhentare ||146 parāvṛttamidaṃ śeṣamṛjvāgatavadādiśet| adhyardhākṣādikādrū yāni sthānāni teṣu yat ||147 bhavedyasya parāvṛttaṃ tadvaśāttasya tadbhavet| --- yasya hi yaddṛśyaṃ sthānakasyāṅgamīritam ||148 tadadṛśyaṃ parāvṛtte tasyādṛśyaṃ ca dṛśyate| sthānānī bhavitāni --- jīveṣu dvipadeṣu ca ||149 nirjīveṣvapi jānīyādyānāsanagṛhādiṣu| sthānāni mūlabhūtāni navaivaitāni vastutaḥ ||140 yāni niviśatabhaktāni tadbhedāni ca tān viduḥ| mūrdhasthitā yadā dṛṣṭā ṛjvādīni vilokayet ||151 sthānāni teṣāṃ yanmānaṃ tadasmāt tadihocyate| vistṛtyāṣṭādaśa nyasyedāyatyā dviguṇāni ca ||152 aṅgulyanyādārāsūtraṃ yathābhāgaṃ yathocitam| āyāmasyārdhadeśe ca vistāro'syāgrato'ṣṭabhiḥ ||153 --- pṛṣṭhapradeśārdra --maṅkayet| tanmadhyagāminī sūtre nyasyedāyatavistṛte ||154 aṅgānāṃ syāttadavadhirnirgamo vaṣṭamāṇakaḥ| sūnatyogato garbhasūtrādityādi ||155 stanagarbho garbhasūtrādvistṛtau syātṣaḍaṅgulaḥ| ṣaḍaṅgulaḥ syātstanayostiryaggarbhavinirgamaḥ ||156 tiryaggarbhātpṛṣṭhapakṣau sphijāvapi daśāṅgule| navāṅgule pṛṣṭhavaṃśaḥ sphijo saptāṅgule'ntare ||157 kakṣāyā mūlamāyāmādgarbhataśca daśāṅgulam| nirgamo'gre'ṅgulaṃ tasya sūtrātsapta ca pṛṣṭhataḥ ||158 garbhasūtrāttatastiryakpādāṃśo'ṣṭādaśāṅgulaḥ| garbhādyavapradeśaśca bhavetpañcabhiraṅgulaiḥ ||159 aṣṭābhirjaṭharaṃ garbhātpārśvayoḥ purato'pi ca| udarasya --- maṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ paścātsaptabhiraṅgulaiḥ ||160 sārdhairdvādaśabhirmūlamūrvoratho mato'ṅgulaiḥ| pañcāṅgulaṃ nirgamastat --- syātsapta ca pṛṣṭhataḥ ||161 ūrumūlasya pṛṣṭhāttu sphijau tryaṅgulanirgatau| meḍhramagre tato jñeyaṃ garbhasūtrātṣaḍaṅgule ||162 tiryaksūtrājjānupārśvaṃ sārdhairnavabhiraṅgulai| āyāmasūtrājjānvantapṛṣṭhe'gre caturaṅgulaḥ ||163 nalakaśca bhavedgarbhāttiryagasya ṣaḍaṅgulaḥ| garbhasūtrāttu nalakaḥ pṛṣṭhataścaturaṅgulaḥ ||164 sūtrāntāṅgulyaparyantaḥ syātsārdhaiḥ ṣaḍbhiraṅgulaiḥ| akṣaḥ sārdhāṅgule sūtrādbhavedvistṛtidarśanāt ||165 caturdaśāṅgulāḥ pādo dairghyeṇātra prakīrtitaḥ| garbhādaṣṭāṅgulāgro'sau paścādapi ṣaḍaṅgulaḥ ||166 jānunorakṣaśca syādantaramaṅgulaṃ mithaḥ| ūrvoraṅgulamuddiṣṭaṃ na bhalayoścaturaṅgulam ||167 ṛjvāgatamiti proktamadvajau madhyasūtrataḥ| parivartatagulagaṃ sāvāvapyaṅguladvayam ||168 tasmātsāvesta sārdhāṃkṣye tvaṅgule parivartanī| --- bhittikaṃ proktaṃ parāvṛtte'pyayaṃ vidhiḥ ||169 ṛjvāgatārdharjukasācisaṃjñādhyardhākṣapārśvāgatasaṃjñakāni| teṣāṃ parāvṛttacatuṣṭyaṃ ca proktānyatho viṃśatirantarāṇi ||170 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhāranāmni vāstuśāstre ṛjvāgatādisthānalakṣaṇaṃ nāmaikonāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ| <80> atha vaiṣṇavādisthānakalakṣaṇaṃ nāmāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ| athānyānyabhidhīyante ceṣṭāsthānānyanekaśaḥ| yāni jñātvā na muhyanti --- citravicakṣaṇāḥ ||1 vaiṣṇavaṃ samapādaṃ ca vaiśākhaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tathā| pratyālīḍhamathālīḍhaṃ sthānānyetāni lakṣaṇam ||2 aśvakrāmattamathāyāmavihitanākatrayaṃ strīṇām| dvau tālāvardhatālaśca pādayorantaraṃ bhavet ||3 tayoḥ samanvitastvaikastryaśraḥ pakṣasthito'paraḥ| kiñcidañcitajaṅghaṃ ca śagātrabhojyacasaṃyutam ||4 vaiṣṇavasthānametaddhi viṣṇuratrādhidaivatam| samapāde samau pādau tālamātrāntarasthitau ||5 svabhāvasauṣṭhavopetau brahmā cātrādhidaivatam| tālāstrayo'rdhatālaśca pādayorantaraṃ bhavet ||6 aśramekaṃ dvitīyaṃ ca pādaṃ pakṣasthitaṃ likhet| naipamoru bhavatyevaṃ sthānaṃ vaiśākhasaṃjñitam ||7 viśākho bhagavānasya sthānakasyādhidaivatam| aindraṃ syānmaṇḍalaṃ pādau caturmūlāntarasthitau ||8 tryaśrapakṣasthitiścaiva kaṭirjānusamā tathā| prasārya dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ pañcatālāntarasthitam ||9 ālīḍhaṃ sthānakaṃ kuryād rudra ścātrādhidaivatam| kuñcitaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā vāmapādaṃ prasārayet ||10 ālīḍhaṃ parivartena pratyālīḍhamiti smṛtam| dakṣiṇastatra samaḥ pādastryaśraḥ pakṣasthito'paraḥ ||11 samunnatakaṭirvāmaścāvahitthaṃ taducyate| ekaḥ samasthitaḥ pādo dvitīyo'gratalānvitaḥ ||12 śūdvamaviddhaṃ vātaścakrānta ucyate| sthānatrayamidaṃ strīṇāṃ nṛṇāmapi bhavetkvacit ||13 kaṭīpārśve karau vaktramuro grīvā śirastathā| sthānakeṣu samasteṣu kāryametat kriyānugam ||14 kriyāṇāṃ punarānantyāt samastena na śakyate| vaktraṃ tathāpi diṅmātramasmābhiḥ saṃpradarśyate ||15 hṛṣṭāyāḥ priyanāryāḥ puruṣasya vā priyābhyarṇe| bhavati sthitasaṃsthānaṃ tribhiriti tacca kathayāmaḥ ||16 yadbrahmasūtramṛjvāgate bhavet tanmatṛbhāge'pi| avayavavibhāgatastatkathayāmaḥ sāmprataṃ kramaśaḥ ||17 śīnaṃ tatraya vināsikādharapuṭeṣu sṛkvaṇi ca| kaṃgaṃte paracūcukapūrveṇa kalāntare nābhau ||18 paścādūrormadhye paścimagulphasya tadvadante ca| sthāne tribhagā bhāmini sūtrasya gatirvinirdiṣṭā ||19 pādau tālāntaritau kartavyau sthānake tribhaṅgākhye| ṣoḍaśaviṃśatyaṅgulamadhye'ntarito pitudaḍidākṣe ||20 gamanaṃ trividhaṃ prāhudrutamadhyavilambitaprabhedena| sthāneṣvardhanetrākhyabhittiṣu trayagamadhye ||21 prānte karavīrasyātha --- sṛkvaparyante| kaṇṭhānte parabhāgā stanatoguladummaparyante ||22 nābhyāsanne madhye meḍhrasya tathā parasya nalakasya| prānte vajjāyāte gamane syād brahmasūtragatiḥ ||23 sodhegamane tu pūrve locanakhīrake puṭe taddhi| tavibukarānte stanacūkasya madhye tathā nābhau ||24 madhye meḍhrasyānte --- parajānunaḥ krameṇaiva| aparāṅguṣṭhakamūle vijñeyaṃ brahmasūtramiti ||25 parapādadvādvakṣi sthityā kriyate tathāca pūrvāhṇe| kuryāt talamiha bhūtalasūtrārdhaṃ --- gulotkṣiptam ||26 bhūparyante'pāṅge cibukāṃśo golakāntare nābheḥ| sūtraparatvataḥ pūrveṇa parāvasārdhākṣe ||27 pārśvagate saṃsthāne paścimapādo'tra saptagolaḥ syāt| dvyardhākṣagamanamuktaṃ brūmaḥ pārśvāgatergamanam ||28 āvarte --- kūṭe gaṇḍaprānte ca sṛkvabhāgasya| galavarttau stanamadhye golatritayāntare nābheḥ ||29 sphikpārśvapaścimajānunaścā pūrvārtamāmṛtaṃ sūtram| syādaparapārṣṇipūrvasthitaṃ cabhivetthone ||30 kṣapayet parabhāgāhni svasmānmānādyathoditādatra| pūrvāhneraṅguṣṭhaḥ kartavyo bhūmisūtrasthaḥ ||31 paścādaṅguṣṭhāgraṃ suśliṣṭaṃ syād vilambite gamane| aṅguṣṭhāṅgule brahmasūtratastālike madhye ||32 drutagamane'ṅguṣṭhāgraṃ kartavyaṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgule tasmāt| parapādābhūmesaḥ protkṣipto bhavati pūrvapādaśca ||33 iti sarveṣu jñeyaṃ gamanasthāneṣu saṃsthānam| gotrāṇāṃ madhyeṣāṃ vidadhīta budhaḥ sthitiṃ yathāyogam ||34 vinyāsayoṣaṇakṣiptaṇa dṛṣṭihastādiviniveśaiḥ| atha sthānacatuṣkasya pravicchandakakīrtanāt ||35 anyā api kriyā lekhyāḥ sambhavantīha yā nṛṇām| śiṣyāṇāṃ pratipattyarthaṃ sūtrāṇi trīṇi pātayet ||36 brahmasūtragate sūtre ye ca pārśvasamāśraye| ūrdhvāni trīṇi sūtrāṇi sthānakeṣvabhiṣvapi ||37 kurvīta teṣu madhye yadbrahmasūtraṃ taducyate| bhittike punaranyasya bhāgasyāpekṣayā matam ||38 pārśvasthaṃ brahmasūtraṃ syātkāryato madhyagaṃ hi tat| ye dvayoḥ pārśvayoḥ sūtre --- hi te smṛte ||39 pradeśāvayavasyātra niṣpattyai yadyadīpsitam| tatra sūtraṃ vidhātavyaṃ tiryagūrdhvānusārataḥ ||40 apekṣetāni yāvanti pratyaṅgavyaktisiddhaye| tāvantyavayavavyaktisiddhyai tiryaṅniyojayet| ūrdhvāni trīṇi sūtrāṇi tiryaṅnā nusārataḥ ||41 sthānāni vaiṣṇavamukhānyuditāni samyak| trimaṃgitaḍite gamanairupete| sūtrasya pātanavidhiśca yathāvadukto| jñāte na bhavet tadiha sūtrabhṛtāṃ variṣṭhaḥ ||42 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhāranāmni vāstuśāstre vaiṣṇavādisthānakalakṣaṇādhyāyo nāmāśītitamaḥ| <81> atha pañcapuruṣastrīlakṣaṇaṃ nāmaikāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ| pañcānāṃ haṃsamukhyānāṃ dehabandhāti khannṛṇām| daṇḍinīpramukhānāṃ ca strīṇāṃ tā brūmahe pṛthak ||1 haṃsaḥ śaśo'tha rucako bhadro mālavya eva ca| pañcaite puruṣāsteṣu mānaṃ haṃsasya kathyate ||2 aṣṭāśītyaṅgulo haṃsasyāyāmaḥ parikīrtitaḥ| vijñeyā vṛddhiranyeṣāṃ caturṇāṃ dvyaṅgulakramāt ||3 tasyaṅguladvayaṃ sārdhaṃ śāṭālaṃ nāsikā mukham| grīvā ca vaktaścayamod bhavedekādaśāṅgulam ||4 evamevodaraṃ nābhimeḍhrayorantaraṃ daśa| viṃśatiścāṅgulānyūrū jaṅkhe ca trīṇi jānunī ||5 trīṇyaṅgulānyaṅgule ca keśabhūraṅguladvayam| keśāntamānaṃ sarveṣāmadhikaṃ syātsvamānataḥ ||6 vistāreṇa bhaved vakṣastasyaivāṅgulaviṃśatiḥ| dvādaśāṅgulavistāro bāhusaṃsasya nirdiśet ||7 daśāṅgulau prakoṣṭhau ca hastatathe ---| tathā pṛthak pṛthak cchroṇiḥ pīnāṅguli tato bhavet ||8 haṃsasvabhāvena pṛthag --- mbhāranāsikaḥ| śesasya tryaṅgulaṃ --- nāsikā vaktrameva ca ||9 grīvāpi tatpramāṇaiva vakṣastvekādaśāṅgulam| tathodaraṃ tathā nābhimeḍhrayorantaraṃ daśa ||10 ūrū viṃśatimātrau ca śaśasya parikīrtitau| tryaṅgule jānunī jaṅghe mātrāviṃśatimāyate ||11 gulphau ca tryaṅgulāyāmau tāvanmātraṃ śiro bhavet| āyāmo'yaṃ śaśasyaivaṃ syānnavatyaṅgulonmitaḥ ||12 dvāviṃśatyaṅgulaṃ vakṣyāṃ vistāreṇāsya kīrtitam| bāhuprabāhū pāṇī ca śaśakasyāpi haṃsavat ||13 samayācca sa kartavyaḥ svabhāvācca kṛśodaraḥ| tathoyavet keśorujaṅgho dvidvān vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||14 rucakasya tukhāyāmadyāma proktaḥ sārdhadaśāṅgulaḥ| grīvāṅgulatrayaṃ sārdhamāyāmenāsya kīrtitā ||15 ekādaśāṅgulo vyāpūrvakṛstasya pramāṇataḥ| tāvantyevodaraṃ tasya nābhimeḍhrāntaraṃ daśa ||16 viṃśatiścāṅgulānyūrū jānunī cāṅgulatrayam| viṃśatyaṅgulamāyāmaṃ jaṅghayostasya nirdiśet ||17 aṅgulatritayaṃ gulphau kuryāttasya śiro'pi ca| dvinavatyaṅgulāyāmo rucakaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||18 ityāyāmo'sya vistāro vakṣaso'ṅgulaviṃśatiḥ| bhujau daśāṅgulāyāmau prakoṣṭhau tadvadeva ca ||19 ekāḍaśāṅgulau hastau vistāreṇāsya kīrtitau| pīnāṃsaḥ pīnabāhuśca salīlagaticeṣṭitaḥ ||20 balavān vṛttabāhuḥ syādrucako rucakākṛtiḥ| bhadra sya prāhurāyāmaṃ mastakasyāṅgulatrayam ||21 ekāḍaśāṅgulā --- grīvā sārdhāṅgulatrayā| vakṣo jaṭharamapyasya sapādaikādaśāṅgulam ||22 nābhimeḍhrāntaraṃ cāsya vidyātsārdhadaśāṅgulam| āyāmamūrvorjānīyāt sapādāṅgulaviṃśatim ||23 jaṅghe ca tāvadāyāme jānugulphaṃ trimātrakam| caturtavartisarāmo candra syaiṣa prakīrtitaḥ ||24 āyāma eṣa vistāro vakṣasastvekaviṃśatiḥ| ekādaśāṅgulau bāhū tasya --- ||25 haṃsādipuṃsāmidamevamuktaṃ| yadvā yathālakṣaṇamānamatra| strīṇāṃ ca samyaggaditā sukhānād| yo vetti mānyaḥ sa bhavennṛpāṇām ||26 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhāranāmni vāstuśāstre pañcapuruṣastrīlakṣaṇaṃ nāmādhyāya ekāśītitamaḥ| <82> atha rasadṛṣṭilakṣaṇaṃ nāma dvyaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ| rasānāmatha vakṣyāmo dṛṣṭīnāṃ vei lakṣaṇam| tadāyattā yataścitre bhāvavyaktiḥ prajāyate ||1 śṛṅgārahāsyakaruṇā raudra preyobhayānakāḥ| vīrapratyayākṣau ca bībhatsaścādbhutastathā ||2 śāntaścaikādaśetyuktā rasāścitraviśāradaiḥ| nigadyate krameṇaiṣāṃ sarveṣāmapi lakṣaṇam ||3 sabhrūkampakaṭīkṣapeca tathā premaguṇānvitaḥ| yatreṣṭalalitā ceṣṭā sa śṛṅgāro rasaḥ smṛtaḥ ||4 vikāsilalitāpāṅgo mṛdu cā sphuritādharaḥ| līlayā sahito yaśca sa hāsyo rasa ucyate ||5 aśruklinnakapolāntaḥ śokasaṅkucitekṣaṇaḥ| cittasantāpasaṃyuktaḥ procyate karuṇo rasaḥ ||6 nirmārjitalalāṭāntaḥ saṃraktodvṛttalocanaḥ| dantadaṣṭādharoṣṭho yaḥ sa raudro rasa ucyate ||7 arthalābhasutotpattipriyadarśanaharṣajaḥ| sañjātapulakodbhedo rasaḥ pramā sa ucyate ||8 vairidarśanavitrāsasambhramodbhrāntalocanaḥ| hṛdi saṃkṣobhayogācca raso jñeyo bhayānakaḥ ||9 aṣṭāvaṣṭambhasamerthā sūtrasaṅkucitānataḥ| dhairyavīryabalotpannaḥ sa vīrastu rasaḥ smṛtaḥ ||10 īṣaduptasittatra kastacca stimitatārakaḥ| sasambhāvyaṃ vilokyārthamadbhuto jāyate rasaḥ ||11 adhivikāraiḥ prasannaiśca bhrūnetravadanādibhiḥ| arāgādviṣayeṣu syādyaḥ sa śānto rasaḥ smṛtaḥ ||12 ityete citrasaṃyoge rasāḥ proktāḥ salakṣaṇāḥ| mānuṣāṇi puraskṛtya sarvasattveṣu yojayet ||13 iti rasāḥ || atha dṛṣṭīrabhidadhmo lalitā hṛṣṭā vikāsitā vikṛtā| bhrukuṭī vibhramasaṃjñā saṃkucitā chavitanāprīva ||14 ūrdhvagatā yoginyatha dīnā dṛṣṭā ca viviṣṭahvalā kheve| syādaṅkitā bhidhānā vivikhyāva jihmā ca ||15 madhyastheti tathānyā sthireti cāṣṭāvevamuddiṣṭā| etā dṛśo'tha lakṣaṇametāsāmucyate kramaśaḥ ||16 vikasitapragallāsasambhramatra kaṭākṣavikṣepā| śṛṅgārarasodbhūtā dṛṣṭirlaliteti vijñeyā ||17 priyadarśane prasannāṃ prodgataromāñcavikasitāpāṅgā| prastarasāsijātā hṛṣṭā dṛṣṭhiḥ samākhyātā ||18 vikasitanayanaprāntā vikāsitāpāṅganayanagaṇḍatalā| krīḍākārayutāhāsyarase vikāsitā dṛṣṭiḥ ||19 vikhyātā prītivikārirvyaktabhayā bhrāntatārakā yā ca| jñeyā vikṛtyakāraiḥ sārai ca bhayānakā dṛṣṭiḥ ||20
