dīptorthatākātāsrapratatā mandadarśanā| dṛṣṭirūrdhvaṃ niviṣṭā tu bhrūkuṭiḥ parikīrtitā ||21 sattvasthā dṛḍhalakṣmā sasauṣṭha vyaktatārakā saumyā| vipratyaparajālātā dṛṣṭiḥ syād vibhramā nāma ||22 manmathamadena yuktā sparśarasonmīlitākṣipuṭayugmā| sutarusukhānandayutāsaṅkucitā nāma dṛṣṭirākhyātā ||23 nirvikārā kvacittāvannāsikāgrāvalokinī| yoginī nāma sā dṛṣṭistattve cittasya yojanāt ||24 ardhasrastottarapuṭā kiñcitsaṃruddhatārakā| mandasañcāriṇī sāsrā śoke dīnābhidhīyate ||25 saṃsthite tārake yasyāḥ sthirā vikasitā tathā| sattvamudgiratī dṛṣṭā dṛṣṭirutsāhasambhavā ||26 mlānabhrūpuṭapakṣmā yā śithilā mandacāriṇī| krāmapraviṣṭatārā ca vihvalā tāmalā smṛtā ||27 kiñciccalā sthirā kiñciduttānā tiryagāyatā| mūḍhā cakitatārā ca śaṅkitā dṛṣṭiriṣyate ||28 ānikuñcitapakṣmā yā puṭairākuñcitastā tathā| satrijanta ---tārā ca kuñcitā dṛṣṭirucyate ||29 lambitārdhapuṭā --- tiryagrūkṣekṣaṇā śanaiḥ| nigūḍhā gūḍhatārā ca jihmā dṛṣṭirudāhṛtā ||30 ṛjutārā ṛjupuṭā prasannā rāgavarjitā| tyaktādarā ca viṣaye madhyasthā dṛṣṭirucyate ||31 samatārā samapuṭā samabhrūravikāriṇī| upagārā vihīnā ca sthirā dṛṣṭiḥ prakīrtitā ||32 hastena sūcayannarthaṃ dṛṣṭyā ca pratipādayan| sajīva iti dṛśyeta sarvābhinayadarśanāt ||33 āṅgike caiva citre --- sādhanamucyate| bhavedatrādatastasmādanayościtramāśritam ||34 dṛṣṭiḥ || proktaṃ rasānāmidamatra lakṣma dṛśāṃ ca sāṃkṣiptatayā tadetyet| vijñeyacitrālikhanāntarāṇāṃ na saṃśayaṃ yāti manaḥ kadācit ||35 iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite samarāṅgaṇasūtradhāranāmni vāstuśāstre rasadṛṣṭilakṣaṇādhyāyo nāma dvyaśītitamaḥ| <83> atha patākādicatuṣṣaṣṭihastalakṣaṇaṃ nāma tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ| catuḥṣaṣṭirihedānīṃ hastānāmabhidhīyate| lakṣaṇaṃ viniyogaśca yogāyogavibhāgataḥ ||1 patākastripatākaśca tṛtīyaḥ kartarīmukhaḥ| ardhacandra stathārālaḥ śukatuṇḍastathāparaḥ ||2 muṣṭiśca śikharaścaiva kapitthaḥ khaṭakāmukhaḥ| sucyāsyaḥ padmakośāśirasau mṛgaśīrṣakaḥ ||3 kāṅgalapadmakolaśca caturo bhramarastathā| haṃsāsyo haṃsapakṣaśca sandaṃśamukulāvadi ||4 ūrṇanābhastāmracūḍha ityeṣā caturanvitā| hastānāṃ viṃśatisteṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ karma cocyate ||5 prasāritāgrāḥ sahitā yasyāṅgulyo bhavanti hi| kuñcitaśca tathāṅguṣṭha sa patāka iti smṛtaḥ ||6 utkṣiptana śiro yā --- tpāṇināṃ merasā punaḥ| natena vāmataḥ kiñcid bhrukuṭīkuṭilabhru ca ||7 stokaviṣphāritākṣeṇa prahāramabhinirdiśet| pratāpanaṃ tathodbhūto naresogratena ca ||8 tathaivāvikṛtāsyena bhālasthaḥ kiñcid vicalitaḥ karaḥ| patākasphoritākṣeṇa bhrukuṭīkuñcitabhruvā ||9 kāryo'hamiti garvaḥ syāccitraśāstraviśāradaiḥ| artheṣu vakṣyamāṇeṣu saṃyutaṃ cainamācaret ||10 dvitīyahastayukto yaḥ sa hastaḥ saṃyutaḥ smṛtaḥ| tatrāgnisūpaṇācāmaḥ purato kṣiṇataḥ punaḥ ||11 ūrdhvaṃ prasarpya kartavyaḥ pracaladviraṅguliḥ| vidadhyāditthamevoktaṃ varṣadhārānirūpaṇam ||12 kitvadhāmiyaṃtaṃ tau tāvamacchantau ca darśayet| puṣpavṛṣṭiprapatane pracaladviralāṅguliḥ ||13 kāryaṃ hastadvayaṃ vakraṃ trayo'pyatrādhikāghiḥ| kai taiva --- cottānaṃ vidhāya svastikaṃ budhaḥ ||14 kurvāṇo vicyutiṃ tasya palvalaṃ sampradarśayet| puṣpopahāraṃ saṣpāṇi ye cārthā bhūtalasthitā ||15 tānunnamitavāmabhrūḥ kiñcidudvāhayañchiraḥ| tādṛśaṃ hastayugmaṃ tu kuryādavikṛtānanaḥ ||16 adhomukhaṃ ca tenaiva kartavyāpraghaṭanā mithaḥ| saṃvṛtaṃ vā thaviśliṣṭaṃ tāraḥ --- ||17 darśanīyaṃ ca vadanamasminnavikṛtaṃ sadā| pālyaṃ chatanna ca kartavyaṃ śalkaśe parasparā ||18 kiñcidvinatamūrdhā ca vidhāyādhomukhau talau| nibiḍaṃ nibiḍenaiva nirvikāramukhāmbujaḥ ||19 uraso'gre tathordhvena parāvṛtte ca hastayoḥ| yugalena manasāśaktiṃ prayatnena pradarśayet ||20 gopyaṃ vāmena guptena kiñcidvinatamastakaḥ| kiñcidākuñcitāṃ vāmāṃ bhruvaṃ kṛtvā pradarśayet ||21 pārśvasthena patākena pāṇyaṅgadvitayena tu| adhikasthena patākena pāṇyabjadvitayena tu ||22 adhikārimukhe vāyoḥ kuryādabhinandayaṃ tataḥ| natotta --- śirāstena dvihita bhrukuṭimānake ||23 velāmurvīṃ ca matimān pāṇiyugmena darśayet| puraḥsthitena vāmena dakṣiṇena tu pāṇinā ||24 tasṛṣṭe sarpatā stokamudvāhitaśirā naraḥ| vegaṃ pradarśayennityamavikāri dadhanmukham ||25 ityuśvenuśca calatā hastayordvitayena tu| mūrdhnā tadanugenaiva tathaiva vikṛtānanaḥ ||26 kṣobhasyānayaṃ kuryāddhastābhinayakovidaḥ| udhastṛdho mukhenāvaḥ yatanparārthatāpi ca ||27 patākenābhinetavyo vidhāya bhrukuṭiṃ manāk| pārśvavyavasthitenordhvaṃ caladaṅgulinā muhuḥ ||28 utsāhanaṃ vidhātavyamuttapya ca śirodharām| tiryagviṣphāryamāṇena prabhūtamabhinirdiśet ||29 mahato'bhinayaḥ kāryaḥ pārśvayorūrdhvasarpiṇā| bhrāntenottānite cānikṛtāsyena siṃhājanam ||30 rūpayeduccamuccena patākenaiva pāṇinā| itastataḥ pracalatā darśayet puṣkarāhatim ||31 sattākṣapeṇa vaktreṇa calayai --- mukhena ca| sthitena pārśvayostiryagricyamānena darśayet ||32 pakṣotkṣepakriyāṃ nityaṃ vaktreṇa vikṛtena ca| uttānitena vāmena vidhṛtenetareṇa tu ||33 puraḥprasarpiṇādhautaṃ hastānugatadṛṣṭinā| nighṛṣṭatalahastena bhrukuṭyā mṛditaṃ punaḥ ||34 praghṛṣṭamekarūpeṇa dvitīyena prasarpatā| tena syopari hastena niviṣṭena vidhīyate ||35 anyonya gharṣaṇātyet piṣṭaṃ bhrukuṭyā ca pradarśayet| pārśvasthitena śailendraṃ dūraviṣphāritena ca ||36 pradarśayet samutkṣipyamomā bhrūlatikāṃ śanaiḥ| śailadhāraṇamanyonyaśaktenābhimukhena ca ||37 pārśvayoḥ sampraveśyādhaḥ kṛkatabhrukuṭinā tataḥ| kāryamutkṣipyamānena śailaprotpāṭanaṃ tathā ||38 śiraḥpradeśasaṃsthena dūramuttānitena ca| samunnatabhruvā kāryā parvatoddharaṇakriyā ||39 iti patākahastaḥ || patāke tu yadā vakrānāmikā tvaṅgulirbhavet| tripatākaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ karma cāsyābhidhīyate ||40 ayaṃ --- avi calanmadhyākaniṣṭhikaḥ| atrohena vidhātavyo natu mūrdhnā tathā manāk ||41 unnāmena samutkṣiptapurobhāgena cāmunā| namatā śirasā kuryāttathā vataraṇakriyām ||42 pārśvataḥ sarpatā kāryamamunaiva visarjanam| parāṅmukhānārayogra bhrukuṭiṃ viracayya vā ||43 bāraṇaṃ pārśvasaṃsthena praveśo'dho natena ca| praveśaṃ kurvatākāro vekubjamavikāritāḥ ||44 utkṣiptāṅguliyugmena tathottānena cāmunā| unnāmanaṃ vidhātavyamavikārimukhena ca ||45 pārśvato namatā kāryā prāṇenā natamastakaiḥ| nidarśanaṃ tathodvṛttenordhvāṅguliśikhena ca ||46 prasarpitamukhasyāgre vidhisambandhanaṃ punaḥ| uttānenāsumāṅgulyā śvahītvā nāmikākhyayā ||47 maṅgalyānāṃ samālambhaḥ padārthānāṃ vidhīyate| parāṅmukhena śirasaḥ pradeśe sarpatā tathā ||48 pradarśayecchiraḥ sanniveśametena pāṇinā| etāni darśanīyāni sarvāṇyavikṛtānanaiḥ ||49 hastadvayenobhayataḥ keśānāsannavartinā| uṣṇīṣamukuṭādīni prāpnotīti nirūpayet ||50 kartavyaḥ sotranāśāsyaṃ vidhānena samīparā| pāṇiḥ kṛtabhrukuṭinā tatrodvastoṅgulidvayaḥ ||51 adhomukhaṃ prasthitābhyāmaṅgulībhyāṃ pradarśayet| calābhyāṃ mukulābhyāṃ ca hastasyāsyaiva padyadān ||52 darśayetpāṇiyugmena kadācit pakṣiṇo laghūn| pavanaprabhṛtīṃścaiva padārthānaparānapi ||53 calitāṅgulinā hastadvayenādyonati---syā| adhomukhena vā sroto darśayet sarpatā puraḥ ||54 ūrdhvāvasthitinā gaṅgāsrotaḥ sūtranibhena ca| adho vinamatā pāṇidvitayena pradarśanāyet ||55 puraḥ prasarpataikena calatā vikṛtānanaḥ| hastena sarpābhinayaṃ vidadhīta vicakṣaṇaḥ ||56 aṅgulidvitayenādhomukhenāśrupramārjanam| kuryātkanīnikāḍeśasarpiṇā vinatānanaḥ ||57 adhaścārdhaṃ ca sarpantyā bhāladeśe tvanāmayā| tilakaṃ racayedekā sundra sya bhralatāṃ śaye ||58 caivānāmikayā kāryā syādro canākriyā| ālabhya rocanāṃ mūrdhni tathaiva ca vicikṣipet ||59 tathaiva ca vidhātavyamalakano pradarśanam| uttānitena hāsaśca tripatākena pāṇinā ||60 cadanesyāgraha stiryagaṅgulidvayacālanāt| tripatākāṅgulībhyāṃ tu calitābhyāmurogrataḥ ||61 śikhaṇḍiśārikākārakokilādīn pradarśayet| hastasyānugatāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ trailokya --- kārayet ||62 iti tripatākaḥ || tripatāke yadā haste bhaved pṛṣṭhāvalokinī| tarjanī madhyamāyāśca tadāsau kartarīmukhaḥ ||63 namatā saṃyutenetastataḥ sañcaraṇaṃ padaiḥ| tetasya staṃdvaṃlanaṃtvaṃ hi yugasya tadamātayā ||64 adhomukhena kartavyamatecaiva raṅgaṇam| lalāṭavartinā śṛṅgaṃ saṃyutenonnatabhruvā ||65 pradarśayedullikhatā lekhyamabhyunnatabhruvā| adhomukhena caikena tathādho namatā manāk ||66 darśayet patanaṃ vādho gacchatā maraṇaṃ tathā| namatetastataḥ śakravikṣepeṇa vivarjitam ||67 pāṇinā vrajatā bhestā kuñcitabhrūrnamacchirāḥ| nyastaṃ pradarśayet kāryādṛkasaṃyamyamācastaṃ kuryānnirghāṭanaṃ tathā ||68 pīnaṃ vāladrumīḥ kañcukarānugā| iti kartarīmukhaḥ || yasyāṅgulyastu vinatāḥ sahāṅguṣṭhena cāpavat ||69 so'rdhacandra iti proktaḥ karaḥ karmā ca kathyate| tenonnatabhrūrekena śaśilekhāṃ pradarśayet ||70 madhyasyau yasya māyastaṃ kuryānnirghāṭanaṃ tathā| pīnaṃ bāladrumāḥ kamvu kalaśā valayāni ca ||71 pradarśanīyānyetena saṃyuteneti cāpare| raśanākuṇḍalādīnāṃ talapatrasya cāmunā ||72 kaṭījaghanayoścābhinayastaddeśavartinā| asyāpyanugatā dṛṣṭiḥ kāryā sarvatra nartakaiḥ ||73 ityardhacandraḥ || ādyā dhanurnatā kāryā kuñcito'ṅguṣṭhakastathā| śeṣā bhinnordhvavalitā arāle'ṅgulayaḥ smṛtāḥ ||74 asṛtenāratotena kiñcidabhyutthitena ca| sattvaśauṇḍīryagāmbhīryadhṛtikāntīḥ pradarśayet ||75 divyāḥ pāpārdha ye cānye tānapyavikṛtānanaḥ| darśayedunnatabhrūśca pāṇinānena nartakaḥ ||76 āśīrvādaṃ tathā kānāṃ strīkeśagrahaṇaṃ ca yat| nirvarṇanaṃ ca sarvāṅgamātmano yadvidhīyate ||77 utkarṣaṇaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ kāryamabhyunnatabhruvā| darśayeddhastayugmena pradakṣiṇagatena ca ||78 vivāhaṃ saṃprayogaṃ ca kautukāni bahūni ca| aṅgulyagrasamāyogaracitasvastikena ca ||79 parimaṇḍalayātena prādakṣiṇyaṃ pradarśayet| parimaṇḍalasaṃsthānaṃ tathānena mahājalam ||80 dra vyaṃ mahītale yacca racitaṃ tatpradarśayet| dānaṃ vāraṇamāhvānamanekavacanaṃ tathā ||81 darśayeccalatā tena hastenāsaṃyutena ca| svedāpanayanaṃ kāryaṃ gandhāghrāṇaṃ tathāmunā ||82 tatpradeśe pravṛttena pāṇinā nṛttakovidaiḥ| yoṣitāṃ viṣaye caiṣa pāṇinā prāyeṇa yujyate ||83 karmāṇyetāni sarvāṇi tripatākaḥ sadācaret| nāhamityabhinetavyamasyāḍaśasthitena ca ||84 asyānuyāyinīṃ dṛṣṭiṃ vidadhīta bhruvau tathā| ityarālaḥ| arālasya yadā vakrānāmikā tvaṅgulirbhavet ||85 śukatuṇḍaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ karma cāsyābhidhīyate| na tvamityamunā tiryakprasṛtena pradarśayet ||86 vyāvṛttena tu hastena n kṛtyamiti nirdiśet| prasāritena purato namatābhimukhaṃ muhuḥ ||87 kuryādāvāhanaṃ tirya --- mātu visarjanam| vyāvṛttena tu hastena na kṛtyamiti vāratām ||88 avekṣe niponiṣeka --- parāvṛttena śasyate| daṣṭibhruvau cānugate hastasyāsya samācaret ||89 iti śukatuṇḍaḥ || aṅgulyo yasya hastasya talamadhye'grasaṃsthitāḥ| tāsāmupari cāṅguṣṭhaḥ sa muṣṭirabhidhīyate ||90 eṣa prahāre vyāyāme kāryaḥ sabhrukuṭīmukhaiḥ| pārśvasthahastayugmena nirgame tu vidhīyate ||91 iti muṣṭiḥ| yaṣyatigrahaṇamātramardhane stanapīḍane| asaṃyuto vidhātavyo sudṛṣṭibhravo tathā ||92 asyaiva tu yadā muṣṭherūrdhvo'ṅguṣṭhaḥ prayujyate| hastaḥ sa śikharo nāma tadā jñeyaḥ prayoktṛbhiḥ ||93 ayaṃ vāmo vidhātavyaḥ kuśaraśmicaturhi---| hastadvayaṃ vyāpriyato sṛṇigrahaṇakarmaṇi ||94 śaktitomaramokṣe tu savyahastaḥ prayujyate| pādauṣṭhañjane caiva calitāṅguṣṭhako bhavet ||95 alakasya samutkṣepe tatpradeśasthito bhavet| kuryādanugatāmasya dṛṣṭibhrayugalaṃ tathā ||96 iti śikharaḥ || asyaiva śikharākhyasya dvyaṅguṣṭhakanipīḍitā| yadā pradeśinī vakrā sa kapitthastadā smṛtaḥ ||97 cāpatomaracakrāsiśakti cakrāṃgadāvinā| etenānyāni śastrāṇi sarvāṇyabhinayedbudhaḥ ||98 satyapyabhinaye janma --- vikṣipenmuhuḥ| atrāpi hastānugataṃ dṛṣṭibhrūkarma śasyate ||99 iti kapitthaḥ| utkṣiptavakrā tu yadā tāṃ kāryā sa kanīyasī| asyaiva tu kapitthasya padāṃśauṣaṭakamukhaḥ ||100 anena hotraṃ havyaṃ ca namatānnaṃ vidhīyate| dvābhyāmākarṣaṇacchatrāraṃ pragrahapradarśanam ||101 etena na cāsyarādarśa vā jagra punaḥ| avakṣepasamutkṣepau vyāvṛttena tu khaṇḍanam ||102 bhramatā tu vidhātavyamamunā paripeṣaṇam| dīrghadaṇḍagrahe caiva ṣavastrītālambane tathā ||103 kuśakeśakalāpādigrahe sragdāmasaṃgrahe| dṛṣṭibhrū sahito hastaḥ prayoktavyo vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||104 iti khaṭakāmukhaḥ| khaṭakākhye yadā haste tarjanī saṃprasāritā| hastaḥ sūcīmukho nāma tadā jñeyaḥ prayoktṛbhiḥ ||105 etadīyapradeśinyā vyāpāraḥ prāyaśo bhavet| nato'rvāka kampito bālavyālodvāhikabhramāḥ ||106 te sa tatra natra karmaṇi yujyate| bhrumāyā bhinayeccakraṃ taṃ jṛmbhitaṃ calayānayā ||107 vilolayā patākādīn --- yā| dhūpadīpaplutāvallīpallavān vālapatramāt ||108 --- bhrudvayā puṣpamañjarīm| calayā vakragamanaṃ cūlikāmuddha --- yā ||109 sā budhā cādāhu vidhātardhakampitapā| dhūpadīpalatāvallīpallavān bālapannagān ||110 śikhaṇḍakān maṇḍalaṃ ca nayanaṃ cordhvalolayā| tārakānāsikādaṇḍayaṣṭī pūrvasusthayānayā ||111 dakṣiṇo darśayetrāsannatādho natākrayā| tiryaṅmaṇḍalayā sarvaṃ tayā lokaṃ pradarśayet ||112 ādyadīrghe ca vidhāste vidadhyādunnatāmimām| vinamantīṃ punaḥ kuryādaparāhṇapradarśane ||113 kartavyā vadanābhyāśe sā kuñcitavijṛmbhitā| aṅguliḥ nṛttatattvajñairvākyārthasya nirūpaṇe ||114 so'yaṃ taditi nirdeśe prasṛtottānakampitā| roṣe prakampitāgrā ca hastenābhyunnatena ca ||115 prasṛtāgreṇa na matā ca kartavyā svedarūpaṇe| kuntalāṅgadagaṇḍānāṃ kuṇḍalānāṃ ca rūpaṇe ||116 sardviśa vartanā kāryā prācalatī ca sā mūhaḥ| lalāṭasaṃvṛtodvṛttā kāryā hastinirūpaṇā ||117 prasāritonnāmitā vā ripūddeśesa vidhīyate| kāryā saṃkapānī sāgre so prakopadarśane ||118 ko'sāvityāpi nirdeśe kāryā tiryagvinirgamā| karṇakūṭanayena śabdaśravaṇestātasaṃśrayā ||119 kārye hastadvayāṅgulyau saṃyute saṃmukhe yute| viyoge vighaṭantyau tu kalahe svastikākṛtī ||120 catudhanitā kārye parasparanipīḍane| ūrdhvāgracalitā yāvatkartavyai ke --- varṇane ||121 kuryād dṛśaṃ bhruvau cāsya hastasyānugate budhaḥ| iti sūcīmukhaḥ || yasyāṅgulyastu viralāmābhoruhāṅguṣṭhena kuñcitāḥ ||122 ūrdhvāśca saṅgatāgrāśca sa bhavet padmakośakaḥ| śrīphalakasya kapitthasya grahaṇaṃ tena rūpayet ||123 bījapūrakamukhyānāmanyeṣāmapi darśanam| kāryaṃ phalānāṃ tattulyarūpeṇordhvasthitena ca ||124 kuryāt prasāritāsyena yoṣitkucanirūpaṇam| kuryād dṛṣṭibhruvau cāsya hastasyānugate budhaḥ ||125 padmakoṇakaḥ| aṅgulyaḥ saṃhatāḥ sarvāḥ sahāṅguṣṭhena yasya tu| tathānitaghāścaiva sa tu sarpaśirāḥ karaḥ ||126 uttānitaṃ tu kurvīta secanodakadānayoḥ| adhomukhaṃ vicalitaṃ bhujagasya gatau punaḥ ||127 vidhāta dviguṇāṃ vāmabāhutasthiśarādadhaḥ| vidadhyātsarpaśirasā hastenāsphoṭanakriyām ||128 racitabhrukuṭiḥ kuryādevaṃ tiryakchiro dadhat| purato'dhomukhe na bhāsyā lanamācaret ||129 dṛṣṭirbhrūsahitā kāryā hastasyāsyānuyāyinī| iti sarpaśirāḥ || adhomukhīnānisṛṇe maṅgulīnāṃ samāgatiḥ ||130 kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhakāvūrdhve tadāsau mṛgaśīrṣakaḥ| iha sāmpratamastathetyatnā prayojayet ||131 sthācchatryalābhene tiryagukti pūśvākṣe pātane| svedāpamārjane kāryo'dhomukhastatpraderyuśagaḥ ||132 kuṭṭamite saṃcalitaḥ kartavyo'dhomukhaśca saḥ| asyānuyāyinī dṛṣṭiḥ pāṇī kuryādbhavāpi ||133 iti mṛgaśīrṣakaḥ || tretāgnisaṃsthitā madhyātarjanyaṅguṣṭhakā matā| kāṅgūle'nāmikā vakrā tathācordhvā kanīyasī ||134 tretottanena karkandhūprabhṛtīni pradarśayet| taruṇāni phalānyanyadvastu kiñcicca yallaghu ||135 vākyānyaṅgulivikṣepaiḥ strīṇāṃ roṣakṛtāni ca| muktāmarakatādīnāṃ ratnānāṃ ca pradarśanam ||136 hastenānena kartavyaṃ bhruvau cāspṛṣṭaṣṭage| iti kāṅgūlaḥ || āvartinyaḥ karatale yasyāṅgulyo bhavanti hi ||137 pārśvāgatā vikīrṇāśca so'lapadmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ| tiryakpuraḥsthitaḥ kāryo hasto'yaṃ pratiṣedhane ||138 kasya tvamiti nāstīti vākye śūnye ca dhīmatā| ātmopanyasane strīṇāṃ na sandeśaccheto bhavet ||139 asya cānugatā dṛṣṭirvidhātavyā bhruvau tathā| ityalapadmaḥ || aṅgulyaḥ prasṛtāstisrastathācordhvā kanīyasī ||140 tāsāṃ madhye sthito'ṅguṣṭhaḥ sa karaścaturaḥ smṛtaḥ| adhomukhaḥ pracalito matasyena tatatkathā ||141 vinaye ca naye cāyaṃ kāryo'bhinayavedinā| vaipuṇā tūnnataśivā sāḥ kṛsvā bhretāṃ bhruvā ||142 vidadhyāccaturaṃ hastamuttānaṃ niyame punaḥ| kintu bhravaṃ --- kuṭilāṃ vinayaṃ prati nācaret ||143 adhomukhena hastena tena bālaṃ pradarśayet| bālapradarśane kuryād kuṭīvinatāniraḥ ||144 tenottānavalatā yedāturanantaram| tiryakprasarpya tūttāno bahiścāvikṛtānanaiḥ ||145 satye cānumatau caiva hasta eṣa vidhīyate| evameva prayoktavyo yukte payyeśamadhyamaḥ ||146 dvābhyāmekena vā stustau ka maṇḍalāvasthitena ca| vicāritaṃ prayoktavyaṃ vihrataṃ lajjitaṃ tathā ||147 vadanaṃ tatra kartavyamavikāryaṃ natabhruvā| vitarkitamurobhyarṇe maṇḍalāvasthitena tu ||148 adhomukhena purataḥ kāryaṃ viśliṣyatā tathā| mukhaṃ cānikṛtaṃ tatra kāryamabhyunnate bhruvau ||149 śirastu vāmato tatra nataṃ ca punaḥ| ubhābhyāṃ nayanābhyāṃ tu mṛgakarṇapradarśanam ||150 kāryaṃ taddeśavartibhyāṃ sabhrūkṣepaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ| uttānena yutenātha patrākāraṃ pradarśayet ||151 hastena caturā khe vinamayya bhruvaṃ manāk| līlāṃ ratiṃ smṛtiṃ buddhiṃ saṃjñāmāyāvicāraṇā ||152 saṅgataṃ praṇayaṃ śaucamāvartya bhāvamakṣamam| puṣṭiṃ savica śīlaṃ ca cāturyaṃ mārdavaṃ sukham ||153 praśnaṃ vārtāṃ ca veṣaṃ ca yuktiṃ dākṣiṇyayauvane| vibhavāvibhavau stokaṃ surataṃ sadvaraṃ mṛdu ||154 guṇāguṇau gṛhā dārā varṇā nānāvidhāśrayāḥ| catureṇābhinetavyāste sarve'pi yathocitam ||155 kvacitprabhāvatā kvāpi bhramatā mṛdutā kvacit| pratītirjāyate'rthasya yasya yasya yathā yathā ||156 prājñaistathā tathā śīrṣe'bhineyānyuktapāṇinā| bhrūdṛṣṭicakuragośca kāryāstadanusārataḥ ||157 maṇḍalasthena hastena pītaṃ raktaṃ ca darśayet| kiñcinnatabhrūḥ śirasā parimaṇḍalitena ca ||158 tena dbhūpradarśayet kṛṣṇaṃ nīlaṃ ca parimṛdgatā| catureṇa kapotādīn varṇān svābhāvikena ca ||159 iti caturaḥ || madhyamāṅguṣṭhasandaṃśo vakrā caiva pradeśinī| ūrdhvamanye prakīrṇo --- aṅgulyo bhramare kare ||160 kumudotpalapadmānāṃ grahaṇaṃ tena pāṇinā| tathaiva dīrghavṛntānāmanyeṣāmapi rūpayet ||161 karṇapūro vidhātavyaḥ karṇadeśe sthitena ca| dṛṣṭibhruvau cābhinnā teṣāṃ kārye karānuge ||162 iti bhramaraḥ || tarjanīmadhyamāṅgaṣṭhābhūtāgnisthā nirantarā| bhaveyurhaṃsavaktrasya śeṣa samprasāritā ||163 kiñcit praspanditāṅguṣṭhenāmunotkṣipya ca bhruvau| nissāramalpaṃ sūkṣmaṃ ca darśayenmṛdulaṃ laghu ||164 kartavye'bhinaye caiṣāṃ dṛgbhruvau ca karānuge| iti haṃsavaktraḥ || aṅgulyaḥ prasṛtāstisrastathā cordhvā kanīyasī ||165 aṅguṣṭhaḥ kuñcitaścaiva saṃsapakṣa iti smṛtaḥ| uttānena bahistiryaggrīvāyajalabhūṣaṇam ||166 kartavyaṃ tena gaṇḍasya rūpasya gaṇḍavartanam| kurvīta cainamuttānaṃ bhojane ca pratigrahe ||167 tathācamanakārye ca kartavyo'yaṃ dvijanmanām| adhastādantayorenaṃ kuryāt svastikayoginam ||168 kiñcinnatena śirasā ya pari yathārasam| ubhābhyāṃ pārśvayostiryagvaitābhyāṃ stambhadarśanam ||169 kurvītaikena romāñca vāmabāhuprasarpiṇā| saṃvāhane'nulepe ca sparśe taddeśavartinam ||170 viṣāde vibhrame strīṇāṃ stanyaṃ tatsthaṃ yathā rasaḥ| adhastalaṃ prayuñjīta tathainaṃ hanudhāraṇe ||171 asyānuyāyinīṃ dṛṣṭiṃ pāṇeḥ kuryād bhruvau tathā| iti haṃsapakṣaḥ || tarjanyaṅguṣṭhasandaṃśasva rodanasya yadā bhavet ||172 ābhugnatalamadhyaśca sandaṃśa iti sa smṛtaḥ| sa cāgramukhapārśvānāṃ bhedena trividho bhavet ||173 taṃ puṣpāvacaye puṣparmāgrathane ca prayojayet| tṛṇaparṇagrahe keśasūtrādistathāpare ||174 śilpaikādeśagrahaṇe tvagrasaṃdaṃśakaṃ sthiram| ākarṣaṇe tathā kṛṣṇe vṛntātpuṣpasya coddhṛtau ||175 vidadhyādevamevainaṃ śalākāranirūpaṇe| roṣe dhigiti vākye ca bahirbhāgaprasarpiṇam ||176 yajñopacitaṃ tatpradeśe sthitena ca| uttānenoraso'gre tu saṃyutena ca tirdvatam ||177 vacanaṃ valahā kiñcitsamadhyenādhomukhena ca| grahaṇaṃ guṇasūtrasya bāṇalakṣanirūpaṇam ||178 dhyānaṃ yogaṃ ca hṛddeśavartinā saṃpradarśayet| stokatibhinnā ye kartavyaḥ saṃyutastūrasaḥ puraḥ ||179 kutsāstayākomaleṣu sadoṣavacaneṣu ca| vivartitāgraḥ kartavyo vāmo vighaṭito manāk ||180 pravālaracane vartigrahaṇe netrarañjane| ālekhye caiṣa kartavyastathālaktakapīḍane ||181 asya bhruvau ca dṛṣṭiṃ ca kuryādanugatāṃ tataḥ| iti sandaṃśaḥ || samāgatāgrasahitā yasyāṅgulyo bhavanti hi ||182 ūrdhvaṃ haṃsamukhasyeva sa bhavenmukulaḥ karaḥ| kartavyaḥ saṃhato'trāto mukulāmbhoruhādiṣu ||183 puraḥ prasarpyoccalitaḥ kartavyo viṭacumbakaḥ| iti mukulaḥ || padmakośasya hastasya tvaṅgulyaḥ kuñcitā yadā ||184 ūrṇanābhaḥ sa vijñeyaścauryakeśagrahādiṣu| cauryakeśagrahe caiṣa kartavyo'dhomukhaḥ karaḥ ||185 śiraḥkaṇḍūyane mūrdhnaḥ pradeśe pracalanmuhuḥ| taryakavartī vidhātavyaḥ kuṣṭhavyādhernirūpaṇe ||186 adhomukhaḥ sthitenādhaḥ siṃhavyāghrādirūpaṇe| kāryo bhrukuṭivaktreṇa saṃyato'sya grahastathā ||187 atrāpi dṛṣṭibhrūkarma prāgvadeva vidhīyate| ityūrṇanābhaḥ || madhyamāṅguṣṭhasandaṃśo vakrā caiva pradeśinī ||188 mṛgavyālādiviśvāsaṃ bālasandhāraṇe tathā| ayaṃ hasto vidhātavyo bhartsane bhrukuṭīyutaḥ ||189 siṃhavyāghrādiyoge ca vicyutaḥ śabdavān bhavet| dṛṣṭibhruvau ca kartavyau nyatyamasyānuge budhaiḥ ||190 aparaiḥ chiditāsaṃjño hasto'yaṃ parikīrtitaḥ| iti tāmracūḍaḥ || asaṃyutānāṃ hastānāṃ caturviṃśatirīritā ||191 trayodaśātha kathyante saṃyutā nāmalakṣaṇaiḥ| añjaliśca kapotaśca karkaṭaḥ svastikastathā ||192 khaṭakāvardhamānaścāpyutsaṅganiṣadhāvapi| ḍolaḥ puṣpapuṭastadvanmakaro gajadantakaḥ ||193 varitthādaśa kathyante saṃyatā nāmalakṣaṇaiḥ| añjaliśca kapotasya karkaṭaḥ svastikastathā ||194 trayodaśaite kathitā hastāḥ saṃyuktasaṃjñitāḥ| patākābhyāṃ tu hastābhyāṃ saṃśleṣātso'ñjaliḥ smṛtaḥ ||195 śiraśca vinataṃ kiñcittatra kāryaṃ vipaścitā| kāryo gurunamaskāro mukhasyāsannavartinā ||196 pekṣate na mitrāṇāṃ na sthānaniyamaḥ kṛdhe| ityañjaliḥ || ubhābhyāmapi hastābhyāmanyonyaṃ pārśvasaṅgrahāt ||197 sa hastaḥ kapotanāmā syātkarma cāsyābhidhīyate| kuryātpraṇamanaṃ vakṣaḥsthitena tu na macchirāḥ ||198 gurusaṃbhāṣaṇaṃ kuryāttena śītaṃ bhayaṃ tathā| vinayasyābhyupagame cāyamityabhidhīyate ||199 tenaivāṅgulisaṃghṛṣyamāṇamuktena pāṇinā| etān vadati nedānīṃ kṛtyaṃdho ceti pradarśayet ||200 evaṃrūpo pame ca rūpeṇa| iti kapotaḥ || aṅgulyo yasya hastasyānyonyābhyantaraniḥsṛtāḥ| sa karkaṭa iti jñeyaḥ karaḥ karmāsya kathyate ||201 samunnataśirāḥ kiñcidutkṣiptabhrūśca jṛmbhaṇam| anenaivāṅgamardaṃ ca kāmārtānāṃ nirūpayet ||202 iti karkaṭaḥ || uttānau vāmapārśvasthau svastikaḥ parikīrtitaḥ| samantatastadūrdhvaṃ ca vistīrṇaṃ vanāni ca ||203 ṛtavo gaganaṃ meghā --- tenārthaṃvartinā| iti svastikaḥ || khaṭakaḥ khaṭake nyastaḥ khaṭakāvardhamānakaḥ ||204 śṛṅgārārthe prayoktavyaḥ parāvṛttastathāparaḥ| kāryo viṭagatau namramūrdhā --- tatpramāṇataḥ ||205 iti khaṭakaḥ || arālau tu viparyastāvuttānau vardhamānakau| utsaṅga iti jñeyaḥ --- sparśagrahaṇe karaḥ ||206 utsaṅgasaṃjñakau syātāṃ hastau tatkarma cocyate| viniyogastayoḥ kāryaḥ bālakaḥ prahareṇa tu ||207 vidhātavyāvimau hastau strīṇāmīrṣyāyite tathā| dakṣiṇaṃ vāpi vāmaṃ vā nyasyet kūrparamadhyagam ||208 ityutsaṅgaḥ || asyo praśithilau muktau patākau tu pralambitau| yadā bhavetāṃ karaṇe sa dola iti saṃsmṛtaḥ ||209 iti dolaḥ || yastu sarpaśirāḥ proktastasyāṅgulinirantaraḥ| dvitīya pārśvasaṃśliṣṭaḥ sa tupuṣpapuṭaḥ parāṇi ca ||210 grāsyānyatho yāni yāni dra vyāṇyetena darśayet| jalādānāpayane kuryāt --- ||211 iti puṣpapuṭaḥ || patākau tu yadā hastāvūrdhvāṅguṣṭhāvadhomukhau| uparyupari vinyastau tadāsau makaradhvajaḥ ||212 iti makaraḥ| karparau sandhitau hastau yadā stāṃ sarpaśīrṣakau| gajadantaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ karaḥ karmāsya tasya ca ||213 iti gajadantaḥ || śukatuṇḍau karau kṛtvā vakṣasyabhimukhāñcitau| śanairadhomukhāviddhau saubahisthala iti smṛtaḥ ||214 uktakaṇṭhāprabhṛtīni ca kuryādetena hastena| ityavahitthaḥ || vardhamānaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ karma cāsya nigadyate ||215 etena satyavacanaṃ parigraha sagrahastathā| saṃkheyakalpaścānena nipīḍitena kartavyaḥ ||216 anayāpi nīdṛgeṣāṃ --- krauñcau ca kāryau| nalinīpadmakośaśca tathā garuḍapakṣakaḥ ||217 eteṣāṃ nṛttahastatve'pyabhinītyupayogitām| samā---jitāṃ tatra svayamabhyuhya kalpayet ||218 ceṣṭayāṅgena hastena prayogaḥ sattvakairapi| gaṇḍoṣṭhanāsāpārśvorupādacārāmbhadibhistathā ||219 yathā yathā pratītiḥ syātprayateta tathā tathā| kṛtānukaraṇaṃ --- ||220 lakṣaṇaṃ nṛttahastānāmidānīmabhidhīyate| caturaśrau tathodvṛttau svastikau viprakīrṇakau ||221 padmakośābhidhānau cāpyarālakhaṭakāmukhau| āviddhavaktrakau sūcīmudgarevivasaṃjñakau ||222 ardharecitasaṃjñau tu tathaivottānavañcitau| pallavākhyau nirāvo'tha keśabandhau latākarau ||223 karihastau tathā pakṣavañcitākhyau tataḥ param| pakṣe pradyotakarevyāca tathā garuḍapakṣakau ||224 tataśca daṇḍapakṣākhyāvūrdhvamaṇḍalinau tataḥ| pārśvamaṇḍalinau tadvaduromaṇḍalināvapi ||225 anantaraṃ karau jñeyāvuraḥ pārśvārdhamaṇḍalau| muṣṭikasvastikākhyau ca nalinīpadmakośakau ||226 tataśca kathitau hastāvalapallavakolbaṇau| lalitau valitākhyāvityekānnatriṃśadīritā ||227 purastādvakṣasā hastau pradeśe'ṣṭāṅgule sthitau| samāna karpūraśau tu saṃmukhau khaṭakāmukhau ||228 caturaśrāviti proktau nṛttahastaviśāradaiḥ | iti caturaśrau || tāveva haṃsapakṣākhyau vyāvṛttiparivartanāt ||229 nītau svastikatāṃ paścātpaccyā vitau maṇibandhanāt| viprakīrṇāviti proktau nṛttābhinayakovidaiḥ ||230 iti viprakīrṇaḥ || tāveva haṃsapakṣākhyau kṛtvā vyāvartanakriyām| alapallavatāṃ nītau tataśca parivartitau ||231 vidhāyordhvamukhau hastau kartavyau padmakośakau| iti padmakośakau || punarvivartitaṃ kṛtvā parivartanakaṃ tataḥ ||232 arālaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ kuryādvāmaṃ ca khaṭakaḥ sukham| khaṭakākhyāstrayo hastāḥ svakṣetre'sau vidhīyate ||233 ityarālakhaṭakāmukhau || bhujāṃsakūrparaiḥ sārdhaṃ kuṭilāvartitau yadā| hastāvadhomukhatalāvāviddhāvuddhatāvubhau ||234 vinatau nāmato vidyāddīnānā viddhavakrakau| āviddhavikrakau caiva gadāveṣṭanayogataḥ ||235 itaviddhavakrakau || racitau salāvartitau| yadā tu sarpaśirasau talasthāṅguṣṭhakau karau| teyakāsthau prasṛtāgrau ca śūlanyāso bharastadā ||236 iti sūcīmukhau || hastau sūcīmukhā te maṇibandhanavicyutau| vyāvṛttiparivṛttibhyāṃ vartitau tadanantaram ||237 haṃsapakṣatvamānīya kuryātkamalavartitām| tathā drutabhramau kṛtvā recitau pārśvayoḥ śanaiḥ ||238 recitāviti vijñeyau hastau hastaviśāradaiḥ| iti recitau| vyāvṛttiparivṛttibhyāṃ vartitau caturaśravat ||239 kūrparāṃsāñcitau hastau nītau ca tripatākatām| śakiñci āśrasthitāvetau jñeyāvuttānitau ||240 ityuttānavañcitau || bāhuvartanayā kṛtvā pūrvavyāvartitakriyām| caturaśraka parivṛttibhyāṃ caturaśraḥ kṛto yadā ||241 vāmahastastaditaraḥ kṛtvādeṣvitarecitaḥ karaḥ| ardharecitasaṃjñau tau vijñātavyau tadā vudhaiḥ ||242 ityardharecitau| bāhuvartanayā bāhuśīrṣādvyāvartanena vā| karaṇena viniṣkrāntau mitaṃ vābhyarṇamāgatau ||243 patakāveva nirdiṣṭau pallavau nāmataḥ karau| iti pallavau || udveṣṭitavartanayā gatyā vasraṃtrāsrayā sthitau mūrdhnaḥ| pārśvadvitaye pallavasaṃsthanau keśabandhākhyau ||244 iti keśabandhau || abhimukhamubhau niviṣṭau bhuviṣṭirtavartanakramādasau| pallavahastau pārśvadvitaye syātāṃ latāsaṃjñau ||245 iti latāhastau || vyāvartitakaraṇābhyāṃ dakṣiṇo latāhastaḥ| unnatavilolitaḥ syāttripatāko vāmahastastu ||246 iti karihastaḥ || udveṣṭitaparivartanayā tripatākāvabhimukhau yadā ghaṭitau| karihastasanniviṣṭau karau tadā pakṣavañcitakau ||247 iti pakṣavañcitakau || tāveva tripatākau hastau kaṭiśīrṣāsanniviṣṭāgrau| viparāvṛttividhānāt pakṣapracyotakau nāmnā ||248 iti pakṣapracyotakau || tripa śākhau hastāvadhomukhā hi tad vijñeyau garuḍapakṣākhyau| iti garuḍapakṣakau || āvartitaparivartitakaraṇakṛtau haṃsapakṣakau gam ||249 pakṣatirūpatvamānāntau prasṛtau ca yadā bhavet upakṣau| vyāvartitaparivartitayogau yadi maṇḍalākṛtī syātām ||250 ūrdhvavartitādaghavadā smṛtāvūrdhvamaṇḍalinau| tathordhvamaṇḍalisaṃjñau vāvartitaṃ vidhāyā parivartitakaraṇatārau ||251 iti pārśvamaṇḍalinau || udveṣṭitau yadaika eva bhramita urasaḥ sthāne tau dvāvapi syātām| niyatamuromaṇḍalinau vijñātavyau tadā tajjñaiḥ ||252 ityuromaṇḍalinau || --- pallavo hastastathārālāhvā vāparā| vyāvartanākṛtaścaikastayoranyopaveṣṭanāt ||253 urordhayogātpārśvārdhayogācca kramaśaḥ sthitau| etau vidvān vijānīyāduraḥpārśvārdhamaṇḍalau ||254 ityuraḥpārśvārdhamaṇḍalau || śubhaṃ bhūyāt ||
